claim_sources.translation_en: The Burundian army confirms that its troops in South Kivu province of DR Congo blocked the roads of those leaving the Minembwe area in order to "protect Uvira and the Burundian border", asking residents of Minembwe to "separate from the enemies" who are there.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Abagize imyiyerekano bagirije ingabo z'Uburundi kuzibira amayira bari ahitwa Mu Mikarati, Point-zero n'ahandi.
claim_sources.translation_en: The protesters accused the Burundian troops of blocking the roads at Mu Mikarati, Point-zero and elsewhere.

claim_sources.translation_en: Brigadier General Gaspard Baratuza, speaking for the Burundian army, told BBC Gahuzamiryango that in that part of "Minembwe there is no Burundian soldier".

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Il a précisé que « les propos et commentaires relayés à travers les réseaux sociaux mettant en cause les prestations des militaires burundais déployés en RDC sont sans fondement ».
claim_sources.translation_en: He specified that "the remarks and comments relayed through social media challenging the performance of the Burundian soldiers deployed in the DRC are unfounded".

claim_sources.excerpt_original: « Ils ont ciblé notre territoire et largué trois bombes. claim_sources.translation_en: "They targeted our territory and dropped three bombs. claim_sources.translation_en: Kigali further claims that Burundi has deployed nearly 20,000 soldiers in South Kivu, in the service of Kinshasa, and besieged Banyamulenge villages in Minembwe.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: S'adressant aux diplomates le 8 décembre 2025, le ministre Bizimana a souligné que la coalition AFC/M23 avait cherché à capturer Uvira avant l'accord de paix de Washington signé le 4 décembre, mais que les troupes burundaises étaient intervenues.
claim_sources.translation_en: Addressing diplomats on 8 December 2025, Minister Bizimana stressed that the AFC/M23 coalition had sought to capture Uvira before the Washington peace agreement signed on 4 December, but that Burundian troops had intervened.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon lui, les rebelles ont utilisé des armes lourdes, de l’artillerie et même des drones kamikazes de fabrication turque. « Ce que nous regrettons, c’est que ce sont des armes qui tuent à l’aveuglette. Ils ont lancé des bombes sur les populations civiles, obligeant les gens à fuir. »
claim_sources.translation_en: According to him, the rebels used heavy weapons, artillery and even Turkish-made kamikaze drones. "What we regret is that these are weapons that kill blindly. They launched bombs on civilian populations, forcing people to flee."

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Il avait également averti : si les rebelles et leurs alliés rwandais entrent dans Uvira, « toutes les options sont sur la table », car Uvira et Bujumbura sont deux villes côtières. « Ce qui menace Uvira menace aussi Bujumbura.
claim_sources.translation_en: He had also warned: if the rebels and their Rwandan allies enter Uvira, "all options are on the table", because Uvira and Bujumbura are two coastal cities. "What threatens Uvira also threatens Bujumbura.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: « C’est encore un pur mensonge destiné à induire en erreur l’opinion internationale, le président des États-Unis, le secrétaire d’État Marco Rubio et toutes les personnes éprises de paix », a écrit sur le réseau social X (ex-Twitter) Édouard Bizimana, ministre burundais des affaires étrangères.
claim_sources.translation_en: "This is once again a pure lie intended to mislead international opinion, the President of the United States, Secretary of State Marco Rubio and all peace-loving people," wrote Édouard Bizimana, Burundi's minister of foreign affairs, on the social network X (formerly Twitter).

claim_sources.excerpt_original: l’ambassadeur burundais auprès des Nations unies, Zéphyrin Maniratanga, a affirmé que des bombardements en provenance du Rwanda avaient touché la commune de Tshibitoke le 4 décembre, blessant une femme et un enfant.
claim_sources.translation_en: the Burundian ambassador to the United Nations, Zéphyrin Maniratanga, stated that bombings coming from Rwanda had hit the commune of Tshibitoke on 4 December, wounding a woman and a child.

claim_sources.translation_en: "Whoever attacks us, we will attack," said General Ndayishimiye before residents of Bugabira (North), a commune bordering Rwanda, which he also described as a "bad neighbour", in a speech broadcast on Wednesday by local media.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le président du Burundi a déclaré à la BBC qu'il avait pris connaissance de « renseignements crédibles » selon lesquels le Rwanda envisageait d'attaquer son pays.
claim_sources.translation_en: The President of Burundi told the BBC that he had become aware of "credible intelligence" that Rwanda was planning to attack his country.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Il est revenu sur sa décision d’envoyer des troupes à l’est de la RDC pour épauler les FARDC et juguler les incursions de certains groupes rebelles burundais basés au Sud-Kivu, sans plus de précisions.
claim_sources.translation_en: He went back on his decision to send troops to eastern DRC to support the FARDC and curb the incursions of certain Burundian rebel groups based in South Kivu, without further details.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: « J’ai demandé aux rebelles de la coalition AFC-M23, qualifiés par la partie congolaise de pro rwandais ou carrément de Rwandais, s’ils sont réellement de nationalité congolaise et ils m’ont avoué qu’ils sont bel et bien des Congolais.
claim_sources.translation_en: "I asked the rebels of the AFC-M23 coalition, described by the Congolese side as pro-Rwandan or even outright Rwandan, whether they are really of Congolese nationality, and they admitted to me that they are indeed Congolese.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Et c’est là où je leur proposé d’accepter d’être cantonnés à Rumangabo afin que le processus de négociation, de désarment, de démobilisation et de réintégration puisse suivre mais la guerre a repris de plus belle »
claim_sources.translation_en: And that is where I proposed to them to agree to be cantoned at Rumangabo so that the negotiation, disarmament, demobilisation and reintegration process could follow, but the war resumed with a vengeance"

claim_sources.translation_en: Burundian president Évariste Ndayishimiye extended a hand to Rwanda, calling on it to repatriate the leaders of the Red Tabara movement exiled in Kigali, whom he considers a threat to Burundi's security.

claim_sources.translation_en: Évariste Ndayishimiye also defends the continued presence of several thousand Burundian soldiers in eastern DRC, explaining that they are intervening in support of the FARDC under regional agreements. He rejects the accusations of collaboration with the FDLR

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi w’igisirikare c’Uburundi, Général de Brigade Gaspard Baratuza, yemeje ko Major Jérémie Nitunga na Capitaine Félicien Kanjori , abasirikare babiri b’uburundi, bafatiwe muri Repubulika ya Demokarasi ya Congo, ariko ahakana ko bapfungiwe i Kinshasa.
claim_sources.translation_en: The spokesman of the Burundian army, Brigadier General Gaspard Baratuza, confirmed that Major Jérémie Nitunga and Captain Félicien Kanjori, two Burundian soldiers, were arrested in the Democratic Republic of Congo, but denied that they are detained in Kinshasa.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le centre de Mikenge, situé dans le secteur d’Itombwe, territoire de Mwenga, dans la province du Sud-Kivu à l’est de la République démocratique du Congo, a été repris ce dimanche par les Forces armées de la RDC (FARDC), appuyées par la Force de défense nationale du Burundi (FDNB) et les miliciens Wazalendo.
claim_sources.translation_en: The centre of Mikenge, located in the Itombwe sector, Mwenga territory, in South Kivu province in the east of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, was retaken this Sunday by the Armed Forces of the DRC (FARDC), supported by the Burundi National Defence Force (FDNB) and Wazalendo militiamen.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Des femmes de la communauté Banyamulenge manifestent, pancartes à la main, contre le blocus imposé par l’armée burundaise, le 4 novembre 2025.©DR/ SOS Médias Burundi
claim_sources.translation_en: Women of the Banyamulenge community demonstrate, placards in hand, against the blockade imposed by the Burundian army, on 4 November 2025.©DR/ SOS Médias Burundi

claim_sources.translation_en: At the call of the association Mahoro Peace Association, members of the Banyamulenge community demonstrate in the State of Indiana (United States), to denounce the military blockade that deprives civilians in Minembwe of food and care, December 2025.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Des milliers d’habitants de Minembwe, dans le territoire de Fizi, sont descendus dans les rues le mardi 4 novembre 2025, pour dénoncer le blocage de leurs voies d’accès commerciales par les soldats burundais déployés à Mikalati
claim_sources.translation_en: Thousands of residents of Minembwe, in Fizi territory, took to the streets on Tuesday 4 November 2025, to denounce the blocking of their commercial access routes by Burundian soldiers deployed at Mikalati

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les FARDC, par la voix de leur porte-parole, le général-major Sylvain Ekenge, qualifient cette annonce de simple manœuvre de diversion visant à alléger la pression internationale exercée sur le Rwanda et ses supplétifs de l’AFC/M23.
claim_sources.translation_en: The FARDC, through their spokesperson, Major General Sylvain Ekenge, describe this announcement as a simple manoeuvre of diversion aimed at easing the international pressure on Rwanda and its proxies of the AFC/M23.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Sur son compte X, le ministre s’est interrogé: «Quelle crédibilité accorder à cette manœuvre unilatérale du M23?, Nous attendons un retrait effectif des troupes rwandaises de toutes les zones occupées de notre territoire».
claim_sources.translation_en: On his X account, the minister asked: "What credibility to give to this unilateral manoeuvre by the M23? We expect an effective withdrawal of Rwandan troops from all occupied areas of our territory."

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Earlier on Wednesday, the DRC government described M23’s pledge to withdraw from Uvira as a “nonevent, a diversion, a distraction” while the group said its conditions for a pullout were yet to be met. “The intention is to distract the American mediation team, which is preparing to take measures against Rwanda,” DRC Communications Minister Patrick Muyaya told the Reuters news agency.

Dans un communiqué officiel rendu public ce dimanche, signé par le chef d’état-major général des Forces armées de la République démocratique du Congo (FARDC), le lieutenant-général Jules Mbanza Mwilambwe, l’armée congolaise a annoncé la suspension du général-major Sylvain Ekenge, jusque-là porte-parole des FARDC.
claim_sources.translation_en: In an official communiqué made public this Sunday, signed by the Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (FARDC), Lieutenant General Jules Mbanza Mwilambwe, the Congolese army announced the suspension of Major General Sylvain Ekenge, until then FARDC spokesperson.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ibiro bya Perezida Félix Tshisekedi byatangaje ku rubuga nkoranyambaga X ko mu nama ya bacye y'abaminisitiri yo ku wa kane, Tshisekedi yavuze ko icyo gitero ari "ihonyorwa rigaragara ry'ibyo u Rwanda rwiyemeje muri gahunda y'amasezerano y'amahoro yasinyiwe i Washington" mu cyumweru gishize hagati y'u Rwanda na DRC.
claim_sources.translation_en: The office of President Félix Tshisekedi announced on X that in a restricted ministers' meeting on Thursday, Tshisekedi said the attack was a "flagrant violation of what Rwanda committed to in the peace agreements signed in Washington" last week between Rwanda and the DRC.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: D'un ton ferme, le président Félix Tshisekedi a voulu rassurer les Congolais : "Tant qu'un seul village, tant qu'un seul quartier, tant qu'une seule colline de ce pays restera sous la menace des armes illégales, je considérerai que notre tâche n'est pas achevée."
claim_sources.translation_en: In a firm tone, President Félix Tshisekedi wanted to reassure Congolese: "As long as a single village, a single neighbourhood, a single hill of this country remains under the threat of illegal arms, I will consider our task unfinished."

claim_sources.excerpt_original: « Il n’est pas trop tard pour bien faire les choses. Je prends ce forum à témoin pour vous tendre la main, Monsieur le Président, pour que nous fassions la paix des braves. Cela demande que vous donniez l’ordre aux troupes des M23 qui sont soutenues par votre pays d’arrêter cette escalade qui a fait suffisamment des morts », a déclaré Félix Tshisekedi.
claim_sources.translation_en: "It is not too late to do things right. I take this forum as witness to extend my hand to you, Mr President, so that we make the peace of the brave. This requires that you give the order to the M23 troops that are supported by your country to stop this escalation that has caused enough deaths," Félix Tshisekedi said.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Lors du Conseil des ministres du vendredi 10 octobre 2025, la Première ministre Judith Suminwa a qualifié la main tendue du président Félix Tshisekedi à son homologue rwandais Paul Kagame comme une « quête sincère » pour la paix.
claim_sources.translation_en: During the Council of Ministers of Friday 10 October 2025, Prime Minister Judith Suminwa described President Félix Tshisekedi's outstretched hand to his Rwandan counterpart Paul Kagame as a "sincere quest" for peace.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Intervenant à l’ouverture, ce lundi 24 février à Genève (Suisse) de la 58ème session du Conseil des droits de l’homme (CDH), la Première ministre Judith Suminwa Tuluka a appelé « à des sanctions dissuasives contre le Rwanda »
claim_sources.translation_en: Speaking at the opening, this Monday 24 February in Geneva (Switzerland) of the 58th session of the Human Rights Council, Prime Minister Judith Suminwa Tuluka called for "dissuasive sanctions against Rwanda"

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Pour nous, la position est claire : le M23 et le Rwanda sont intrinsèquement liés. Comme l’a déjà souligné le Président de la République, toute négociation sérieuse devrait se faire directement avec le Rwanda.
claim_sources.translation_en: For us, the position is clear: the M23 and Rwanda are intrinsically linked. As the President of the Republic has already stressed, any serious negotiation should be held directly with Rwanda.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Judith Suminwa se prépare à prendre la parole au nom du Chef de l'État avec force et détermination, mettant en avant les attentes précises de son pays", dit la Primature.
claim_sources.translation_en: Judith Suminwa is preparing to speak on behalf of the Head of State with force and determination, putting forward her country's precise expectations, the Prime Minister's office said.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Congolese President Felix Tshisekedi has intensified his accusations against Rwanda , issuing a scathing critique against decades of what he described as "predatory aggression" against the Democratic Republic of Congo at the recent Munich Security Conference .

He commended the leadership of President Trump for paving the way to dialogue leading to the signing in Washington, D.C., of a peace agreement between the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Rwanda. The withdrawal of Rwandan troops and an end to support for M23 are non-negotiable conditions for real peace.

Le porte-parole du gouvernement de la République démocratique du Congo (RDC), Patrick Muyaya, a salué samedi 19 juillet à Kinshasa, la signature d’une déclaration de principes entre le Gouvernement congolais et la rébellion de l’AFC/M23, ce même samedi à Doha, sous la facilitation du Qatar.
claim_sources.translation_en: The spokesperson of the government of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), Patrick Muyaya, welcomed on Saturday 19 July in Kinshasa the signing of a declaration of principles between the Congolese Government and the AFC/M23 rebellion, that same Saturday in Doha, under the facilitation of Qatar.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon le gouverneur militaire du Nord-Kivu, le général-major Evariste Somo Kakule, ces échanges de tirs ont opposé un groupe de jeunes armés non identifiés aux combattants de l’AFC/M23 dans la localité de Kalangira, en chefferie de Baswagha.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to the military governor of North Kivu, Major General Evariste Somo Kakule, these exchanges of fire pitted a group of unidentified armed youths against AFC/M23 fighters in the locality of Kalangira, in the Baswagha chiefdom.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Dans un communiqué officiel, le gouverneur a précisé que cet incident n’engage en rien les FARDC, lesquelles restent fidèles au respect du cessez-le-feu, conformément à l’accord de Washington signé entre la RDC et le Rwanda, ainsi qu’à la déclaration de principes de Doha conclue entre la RDC et l’AFC/M23.
claim_sources.translation_en: In an official communiqué, the governor specified that this incident in no way involves the FARDC, which remain faithful to respecting the ceasefire, in accordance with the Washington agreement signed between the DRC and Rwanda, and the Doha declaration of principles concluded between the DRC and the AFC/M23.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ces jeunes armés seraient intervenus pour tenter de libérer trois de leurs notables arrêtés et enlevés il y a cinq jours par le responsable de l’AFC/M23 dans la localité de Kisanga, près de Masereka. Ces personnes auraient ensuite été transférées manu militari à Kipese, où elles seraient détenues et victimes d’actes de torture », a déclaré le lieutenant Marc Elongo, porte-parole du gouverneur.
claim_sources.translation_en: These armed youths reportedly intervened to try to free three of their notables arrested and abducted five days ago by the AFC/M23 official in the locality of Kisanga, near Masereka. These people were reportedly then transferred by force to Kipese, where they are reportedly detained and victims of acts of torture," said Lieutenant Marc Elongo, spokesperson of the governor.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les trois personnes détenues seraient Mumbere Charles, Kakule Mulokya Block et Solo Manzu Bungwe.
claim_sources.translation_en: The three detained persons are reportedly Mumbere Charles, Kakule Mulokya Block and Solo Manzu Bungwe.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: « Réclamer la participation du fils, M23/AFC, au dialogue entre Congolais, n’est-ce pas réclamer directement la participation du père, le Rwanda ? », a-t-il écrit. Le Gouvernement considère, en effet, que les liens entre le mouvement rebelle et Kigali sont avérés.
claim_sources.translation_en: "Demanding the participation of the son, M23/AFC, in the dialogue between Congolese, is that not directly demanding the participation of the father, Rwanda?" he wrote. The Government considers that the links between the rebel movement and Kigali are established.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Patrick Muyaya rappelle, par ailleurs, que le dialogue voulu par le chef de l’État est destiné aux acteurs nationaux n’ayant pas pris les armes. Il précise également que cette initiative devra rester complémentaire aux processus diplomatiques en cours, notamment ceux engagés à Washington et à Doha.
claim_sources.translation_en: Patrick Muyaya also recalls that the dialogue wanted by the head of state is intended for national actors who have not taken up arms. He also specifies that this initiative must remain complementary to the diplomatic processes under way, notably those begun in Washington and Doha.

claim_sources.translation_en: "The provincial Government denounces with the greatest firmness the insufficiency, even the inaction of the AFC/M23 rebels who currently administer the city of Bukavu, in the face of a situation that nevertheless demands permanent mobilisation.

claim_sources.translation_en: About twenty others are wounded and treated in the city's hospitals. These still provisional figures are confirmed to ACTUALITE.CD by medical sources and the authorities of the AFC/M23 rebellion.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les réactions continuent de se multiplier à Bukavu, ville sous contrôle de l’AFC-M23, après la mort de 29 enfants survenue jeudi 10 septembre 2026 sur l’avenue Kasheke. Ce bilan encore provisoire émane des sources hospitalières.
claim_sources.translation_en: Reactions continue to multiply in Bukavu, a city under AFC-M23 control, after the death of 29 children on Thursday 10 September 2026 on Kasheke avenue. This still provisional toll comes from hospital sources.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: « Les Etats-Unis reconnaissent le premier transport et transfert de 15 détenus des autorités de la RDC vers l’AFC/M23 dans le cadre du mécanisme d’échange de prisonniers du cadre de Doha », a déclaré sur X Massad Boulos, conseiller principal américain pour l’Afrique
claim_sources.translation_en: "The United States recognises the first transport and transfer of 15 detainees from the DRC authorities to AFC/M23 under the Doha framework's prisoner-exchange mechanism," said Massad Boulos, US senior adviser for Africa, on X

claim_sources.excerpt_original: L’opération, menée les 6 et 7 août, a été facilitée par le Comité international de la Croix-Rouge (CICR). Les quinze détenus ont quitté Beni, dans l’est de la République démocratique du Congo, avant de transiter par l’Ouganda et d’être remis à l’AFC/M23 dans le territoire de Rutshuru.
claim_sources.translation_en: The operation, carried out on 6 and 7 August, was facilitated by the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC). The fifteen detainees left Beni, in eastern DRC, before transiting through Uganda and being handed to AFC/M23 in Rutshuru territory.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le Front pour la refondation de la nation (FRN), dirigé par Joseph Kabila, annonce mettre fin à l’existence de l’Alliance Fleuve Congo (AFC) et se donne pour mission de combattre le pouvoir de Kinshasa « par tous les moyens y compris la force », selon une déclaration politique datée du 12 octobre à Goma.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Front for the Refoundation of the Nation (FRN), led by Joseph Kabila, announces it is ending the existence of the Alliance Fleuve Congo (AFC) and sets itself the mission of fighting Kinshasa's power "by all means including force", according to a political declaration dated 12 October in Goma.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon le porte-parole des FARDC, le général-major Sylvain Ekenge, après la présentation de la situation sur le terrain, le chef de l’État a donné des instructions précises aux forces de défense et de sécurité.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to the FARDC spokesperson, Major-General Sylvain Ekenge, after the presentation of the situation on the ground, the head of state gave precise instructions to the defence and security forces.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon le FRN, l’armée a bombardé, dans la nuit du 21 au 22 octobre 2026, la zone de Rugezi, dans la région de Minembwe, au Sud-Kivu, à l’aide de drones kamikazes et d’artillerie lourde.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to the FRN, the army bombarded, in the night of 21 to 22 October 2026, the Rugezi zone, in the Minembwe region, South Kivu, using kamikaze drones and heavy artillery.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le communiqué fait aussi état d’un renforcement des troupes et des équipements militaires à Luvungi et à Lubarika. Il signale par ailleurs des mouvements de troupes burundaises traversant la rivière Ruzizi en direction de la plaine de la Ruzizi, où elles rejoindraient d’autres éléments militaires.
claim_sources.translation_en: The communiqué also reports a reinforcement of troops and military equipment at Luvungi and Lubarika. It also reports movements of Burundian troops crossing the Ruzizi river towards the Ruzizi plain, where they would join other military elements.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Dans un communiqué publié ce lundi 24 août 2026, Kinshasa accuse les Forces de défense rwandaises (RDF) et leurs supplétifs de l’AFC/M23 d’être responsables d’exécutions sommaires, de violences sexuelles, de tortures et d’enlèvements.
claim_sources.translation_en: In a communiqué published this Monday 24 August 2026, Kinshasa accuses the Rwanda Defence Forces (RDF) and their AFC/M23 auxiliaries of being responsible for summary executions, sexual violence, torture and abductions.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon les données consolidées citées par le gouvernement dans ce document, plus de 300 personnes ont été tuées en juin et juillet 2026dans des exécutions sommaires, des massacres et des bombardements.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to the consolidated data cited by the government in this document, more than 300 people were killed in June and July 2026 in summary executions, massacres and bombings.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le communiqué affirme que, le 10 août 2026, plus de 100 familles d’origine rwandaise ont franchi la frontière par la piste de Kabuhanga, dans le territoire de Nyiragongo.
claim_sources.translation_en: The communiqué asserts that, on 10 August 2026, more than 100 families of Rwandan origin crossed the border by the Kabuhanga track, in Nyiragongo territory.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Elles auraient ensuite été installées à Rwibiranga, dans le groupement de Buhumba, notamment dans des entrepôts construits par le Programme alimentaire mondial (PAM).
claim_sources.translation_en: They were reportedly then settled at Rwibiranga, in Buhumba groupement, notably in warehouses built by the World Food Programme (WFP).

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kinshasa dénonce également l’imposition de taxes dans les zones contrôlées par l’AFC/M23.
claim_sources.translation_en: Kinshasa also denounces the imposition of taxes in areas controlled by the AFC/M23.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les structures sanitaires, notamment les hôpitaux publics et privés, ainsi que les orphelinats, seraient également soumis à des taxes et impôts que Kinshasa qualifie d’illégaux.
claim_sources.translation_en: Health structures, notably public and private hospitals, as well as orphanages, are reportedly also subjected to taxes and levies that Kinshasa calls illegal.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Des témoignages recueillis sur place font également état de violences sexuelles commises contre des femmes, notamment à domicile ou dans les champs. La société civile et des notables de Kaniola dénoncent notamment des viols qu’ils présentent comme un moyen de terroriser les communautés.
claim_sources.translation_en: Testimonies collected on the spot also report sexual violence committed against women, notably at home or in the fields. Civil society and notables of Kaniola in particular denounce rapes that they present as a means of terrorising communities.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Au nom du gouvernement provincial du Sud-Kivu, le porte-parole, Me Luganywa-Bashizi Didier, a condamné ces exactions.
claim_sources.translation_en: On behalf of the South Kivu provincial government, the spokesperson, Me Luganywa-Bashizi Didier, condemned these abuses.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Des hommes armés non identifiés ont emporté des médicaments, du matériel médical et des fournitures de bureau dans la nuit de lundi à mardi, selon des sources locales.
claim_sources.translation_en: Unidentified armed men took medicines, medical equipment and office supplies in the night from Monday to Tuesday, according to local sources.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: a de nouveau été la cible d’un pillage mercredi 19 août.
claim_sources.translation_en: was again the target of a looting on Wednesday 19 August.

claim_sources.translation_en: Since 13 August, several health workers had been arrested by persons presented as military cadres of the AFC/M23, in circumstances that remain to be clarified.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Parmi les personnes interpellées figure notamment le directeur des soins infirmiers.
claim_sources.translation_en: Among those arrested is notably the director of nursing care.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Craignant de nouvelles arrestations, plusieurs responsables de l’établissement avaient quitté la zone. Cette situation avait contribué à perturber le fonctionnement de l’hôpital et l’accès aux soins pendant plusieurs jours, rapporte l'agent de l’hôpital.
claim_sources.translation_en: Fearing further arrests, several officials of the facility had left the area. This situation had contributed to disrupting the hospital's functioning and access to care for several days, the hospital agent reports.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon Kagame, les FDLR, groupe armé fondé par des extrémistes hutus ayant fui le Rwanda après avoir participé au génocide des Tutsis en 1994, représentent une menace sécuritaire directe et existentielle.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to Kagame, the FDLR, an armed group founded by Hutu extremists who fled Rwanda after taking part in the genocide of the Tutsis in 1994, represent a direct and existential security threat.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umutwe wa AFC/M23 watangaje ko wafunze ikirere cy’i Goma mu rwego rwo gukumira ingabo za Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo (RDC) zikomeza kwifashisha ikibuga cy’indege cya Goma mu kumisha ibisasu mu baturage.
claim_sources.translation_en: The AFC/M23 group announced that it had closed the airspace of Goma in order to prevent the forces of the Democratic Republic of Congo from continuing to use Goma airport to drop bombs on the population.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Earlier on Monday, M23 announced the capture of Goma, which the DRC government described was a “declaration of war” by Rwanda.

The rebel leader whose fighters have captured Goma, the biggest city in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, has vowed to continue their offensive all the way to the capital, Kinshasa. Corneille Nangaa, who heads an alliance of rebel groups that includes the M23, said their ultimate aim was to topple President Félix Tshisekedi's government.
On Thursday, Nangaa presented the rebels as the new administrators of Goma, telling journalists they were there to stay and would get services up and running again.
Bahati Musanga Joseph alias Erasto, jusqu’ici conseiller du coordinateur militaire du M23 est le nouveau gouverneur de province.
claim_sources.translation_en: Bahati Musanga Joseph alias Erasto, until now adviser to the M23 military coordinator, is the new governor of the province.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le nouveau gouverneur de l’une des régions très riche en minerais au Congo, sera assisté par Minani Ngarambe Willy, vice-gouverneur en charge des questions politiques, administratives et juridiques et Amani Bahati Shadrack , en charge des questions économiques et financières notamment.
claim_sources.translation_en: The new governor of one of the mineral-rich regions of Congo will be assisted by Minani Ngarambe Willy, vice-governor for political, administrative and legal matters, and Amani Bahati Shadrack, in charge of economic and financial matters.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: L’Alliance Fleuve Congo a également annoncé d’autres nominations. Elles concernent les administrateurs des territoires occupés ou encore le maire de la ville de Goma en la personne de Julien Katembo.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Alliance Fleuve Congo also announced other appointments. They concern the administrators of the occupied territories and the mayor of the city of Goma, Julien Katembo.

claim_sources.translation_en: the local militias maintained by the Congolese authorities commonly known as the Wazalendo, and finally the Hutu genocidaires of the FDLR (Forces for the Liberation of Rwanda)

claim_sources.translation_en: Corneille Nangaa, head of the Alliance Fleuve Congo (AFC) with which the armed group is affiliated, promised 'a responsible administration that must be accountable'.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: “The Alliance Fleuve Congo (AFC/M23) informs the public that in response to the humanitarian crisis caused by the regime in Kinshasa it declares a ceasefire starting 4 February 4 2025 for humanitarian reasons,” the rebels said in a statement posted on X.

In a statement read on local radio on Monday, a rebel alliance that includes M23 said it would assist the population of Bukavu who were “abandoned” by the army and allied combatants. “Our forces have been working to restore the security for the people and their property, much to the satisfaction of the entire population,” it said.
Erasto Bahati Musanga, the rebel-appointed governor of North Kivu, announced that ports in Bukavu and Goma would reopen on Tuesday.

Meanwhile, M23 accused the Congolese authorities of being behind the attack. "We are accusing and condemning vigorously the criminal regime of Kinshasa, which just implemented its plan of exterminating civilian populations," the group said in a statement.
Congo's president, Felix Tshisekedi, called the attack "a heinous terrorist act."

Moments after the attack, Bertrand Bisimwa, the president of M23, pointed an accusing finger at neighbouring Burundi, which is allied with the Kinshasa regime in the fight against the rebel group that controls much of eastern DR Congo. Preliminary investigations indicated that the explosives used in the terrorist attack belong to the Burundian army, he said.

The explosives that hit a huge crowd of people who had turned up in their thousands for an AFC/M23 rally in Bukavu, on February 27, caused the death of at least 11 people and injured 65, of whom six are in critical condition, according to group’s leader.

L’Alliance Fleuve Congo (AFC/M23) ne participera pas aux discussions de Luanda prévues ce mardi 18 mars sous la médiation angolaise. Dans un communiqué publié ce lundi, le mouvement rebelle dénonce les sanctions individuelles prises par l’Union européenne contre plusieurs de ses dirigeants
claim_sources.translation_en: The Alliance Fleuve Congo (AFC/M23) will not take part in the Luanda discussions planned for Tuesday 18 March under Angolan mediation. In a communiqué published on Monday, the rebel movement denounces the individual sanctions taken by the European Union against several of its leaders.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: L'Alliance Fleuve Congo, une alliance rebelle qui inclut les rebelles du M23, a annoncé samedi son retrait de la ville de Walikale et de ses environs dans l'est de la République Démocratique du Congo, quelques jours après avoir pris le contrôle de cette zone riche en minerais.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Alliance Fleuve Congo, a rebel alliance that includes the M23 rebels, announced on Saturday its withdrawal from the town of Walikale and its surroundings in eastern DRC, a few days after taking control of this mineral-rich area.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Cependant, des éléments rebelles étaient encore visibles dans la ville samedi après-midi, malgré l'annonce du retrait, selon des habitants.
claim_sources.translation_en: However, rebel elements were still visible in the town on Saturday afternoon, despite the announcement of the withdrawal, according to residents.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Lawrence Kanyuka, porte-parole de l’AFC-M23, a confirmé cette présence, précisant qu’elle résultait du refus de l’armée de lever ses mesures. « Contrairement à ce qui a été indiqué dans le communiqué du dimanche 23 mars 2025, les FARDC et leurs forces coalisées n’ont pas retiré leurs drones d’attaque de Walikale.
claim_sources.translation_en: Lawrence Kanyuka, spokesperson of the AFC-M23, confirmed this presence, specifying that it resulted from the army's refusal to lift its measures. 'Contrary to what was stated in the communiqué of Sunday 23 March 2025, the FARDC and their coalition forces have not withdrawn their attack drones from Walikale.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les FARDC ont également pris acte de ce retrait et se sont engagées à éviter toute action offensive, appelant les Wazalendo à faire de même pour favoriser la désescalade
claim_sources.translation_en: The FARDC also took note of this withdrawal and committed to avoiding any offensive action, calling on the Wazalendo to do the same to promote de-escalation.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: L’Alliance Fleuve Congo (AFC/M23) a annoncé vendredi 12 avril 2025 la rupture de son accord avec la SADC (Communauté de développement de l’Afrique australe) après des affrontements violents dans la ville de Goma
claim_sources.translation_en: The Alliance Fleuve Congo (AFC/M23) announced on Friday 12 April 2025 the break of its agreement with the SADC (Southern African Development Community) after violent clashes in the city of Goma.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le mouvement rebelle accuse les forces régionales de la SAMIDRC, en coordination avec les FARDC, de mener des opérations militaires, y compris des attaques survenues dans la nuit du 11 avril 2025.
claim_sources.translation_en: The rebel movement accuses the SAMIDRC regional forces, in coordination with the FARDC, of conducting military operations, including attacks that took place on the night of 11 April 2025.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: À l’issue de pourparlers tenus à Doha sous l’égide de l’État du Qatar, les délégués du gouvernement congolais et la rébellion de l'AFC/M23 ont convenu de travailler à la conclusion d’une trêve, en vue de l’instauration d’un cessez-le-feu effectif.
claim_sources.translation_en: At the end of talks held in Doha under the auspices of the State of Qatar, the delegates of the Congolese government and the AFC/M23 rebellion agreed to work towards concluding a truce, with a view to establishing an effective ceasefire.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Dans le texte conjoint signé par Lawrence Kanyuka Porte-parole civile de l'AFC/M23 et Papy Mbuyi Kanguvu chef de la délégation congolaise et Directeur général adjoint de la Direction Générale des Migrations (DGM)
claim_sources.translation_en: In the joint text signed by Lawrence Kanyuka, civil spokesperson of the AFC/M23, and Papy Mbuyi Kanguvu, head of the Congolese delegation and deputy director general of the Directorate General of Migration (DGM)

claim_sources.excerpt_original: L’Alliance Fleuve Congo (AFC/M23), mouvement politico-militaire dirigé par Corneille Nangaa, a déclaré lundi prendre acte de l’accord signé à Washington le 27 juin entre la République démocratique du Congo (RDC) et le Rwanda, tout en exprimant de vives réserves et en réaffirmant ses exigences pour un processus de paix plus inclusif.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Alliance Fleuve Congo (AFC/M23), a politico-military movement led by Corneille Nangaa, said on Monday it took note of the agreement signed in Washington on 27 June between the DRC and Rwanda, while expressing strong reservations and reaffirming its demands for a more inclusive peace process.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: “We regret, we are obliged to inform the Congolese people and the entire International Community of the widespread violation of the ceasefire on all front lines by the tyrannical regime in Kinshasa, thereby definitively trampling point II, of the Declaration of Principles, signed in Doha on July 19 th 2025” announced the rebel movement’s Political Coordinator , Corneille Nangaa

Earlier, in a formal statement delivered before the Q&A, Nangaa accused Tshisekedi of tearing up the Doha peace agreement signed in July 2025 and of choosing war over dialogue. He said Kinshasa’s coalition forces had launched fresh offensives across eastern Congo in violation of the ceasefire.

Le gouvernement congolais et les rebelles de l'AFC-M23 ont signé le mardi 14 octobre 2025 à Doha, sous la médiation du Qatar, un mécanisme de surveillance et de vérification du cessez-le-feu dans les provinces du Nord et du Sud-Kivu.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Congolese government and the AFC-M23 rebels signed on Tuesday 14 October 2025 in Doha, under Qatari mediation, a mechanism for monitoring and verifying the ceasefire in the provinces of North and South Kivu.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: The Alliance Fleuve Congo (AFC/M23) rebel movement which controls North and South Kivu provinces of eastern DR Congo, has rejected the recent announcement by French President Emmanuel Macron regarding the planned reopening of Goma International Airport, calling the decision “premature, disconnected from reality, and made without consultation.”

L’Alliance Fleuve Congo (AFC/M23) a annoncé ce mardi qu’elle retirerait unilatéralement ses forces de la ville d’Uvira, dans l’est de la République démocratique du Congo, présentant cette décision comme une mesure de confiance destinée à soutenir le processus de paix de Doha, a-t-elle indiqué dans un communiqué.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Alliance Fleuve Congo (AFC/M23) announced this Tuesday that it would unilaterally withdraw its forces from the city of Uvira, in eastern DRC, presenting this decision as a confidence-building measure to support the Doha process, it said in a communiqué.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: L’AFC/M23 précise toutefois que ce retrait est conditionné à des garanties de sécurité, appelant les garants du processus de paix à assurer la gestion de la ville, notamment sa démilitarisation, la protection des civils et des infrastructures, ainsi que le contrôle du cessez-le-feu par le déploiement d’une force neutre.
claim_sources.translation_en: The AFC/M23 specifies, however, that this withdrawal is conditional on security guarantees, calling on the guarantors of the peace process to manage the city, notably its demilitarisation, protection of civilians and infrastructure, and monitoring of the ceasefire by deploying a neutral force.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Yagize ati: "AFC/M23 izakura ku bwayo [nta we igishije inama] ingabo zayo mu mujyi wa Uvira bijyanye n'ubusabe bw'ubuhuza bwa Leta Zunze Ubumwe [z'Amerika]."
claim_sources.translation_en: He said: "AFC/M23 will withdraw its forces from the city of Uvira on its own [without consulting anyone] in line with the request of United States mediation."

In a post on X, Bisimwa urged mediators and international partners to ensure the city was protected from "reprisals, violence and remilitarisation".

However, DR Congo's Communications Minister Patrick Muyaya dismissed the announcement of a withdrawal from Uvira as a "diversion," alleging it was an attempt to relieve pressure on Rwanda, which Kinshasa and the United Nations accuse of backing the rebels.
Rwanda's government spokesperson did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

Muyaya described the M23's decision to leave Uvira as a "positive sign" but said the government needed to confirm the situation on the ground. Earlier he had called for "vigilance" in response to the "alleged withdrawal".
« Nous avons trouvé une ville et un parc dévastés. Nous voulons désormais que les animaux du parc puissent se reproduire à nouveau pour attirer les touristes étrangers », a-t-il ajouté.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: L’abattage désordonné d’arbres par les groupes armés tels que les FDLR ou encore les milices Maï-Maï, a profondément affecté la biodiversité.

claim_sources.translation_en: Corneille Nangaa accused the central government of promoting hate speech and division. « Hate speech has now become a State doctrine » , he stated

claim_sources.translation_en: In a statement published on the social network X on 3 February, the political coordinator of the AFC/M23, Corneille Nangaa, presented this action as a direct response to what he describes as an indiscriminate military campaign waged by the central government since the end of January.

claim_sources.translation_en: the provincial authorities of Tshopo and the Armed Forces of the DRC (FARDC) announced that they had neutralised eight kamikaze drones loaded with explosives, in the night of 31 January to 1 February 2026. claim_sources.translation_en: Concerning its military action, the AFC/M23 states that « the drone neutralisation operation, which exclusively targeted military assets, caused no civilian loss

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Dans un communiqué, le porte-parole du mouvement rebelle, Lawrence Kanyuka, a fait état d’un bilan provisoire faisant état d’au moins 21 civils tués et de plus de 67 blessés, parmi lesquels des femmes, des enfants et d’autres personnes vulnérables.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: l’attaque de drones de l’armée congolaise à Mushaki, à quarante kilomètres de Goma, qui a fait 20 morts et une soixantaine de blessés parmi la population civile, selon Corneille Nangaa, coordonnateur de l’AFCM23.
claim_sources.translation_en: the Congolese army's drone attack on Mushaki, forty kilometres from Goma, which left 20 dead and about sixty wounded among the civilian population, according to Corneille Nangaa, coordinator of the AFCM23.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le ministre des Affaires étrangères de la République du Rwanda a déploré, le week-end dernier, dans une déclaration, le silence de la communauté internationale et de la Mission onusienne en RDC face aux « crimes du gouvernement de la République du Congo » . claim_sources.translation_en: The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Rwanda deplored, last weekend, in a statement, the silence of the international community and of the UN Mission in the DRC in the face of the « crimes of the government of the Republic of the Congo » . Oliver Nduhungirehe said so the day after the Congolese army's drone attack on Mushaki

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi wa AFC/M23 Lawrence Kanyuka yabwiye ibiro ntaramakuru Reuters ko nta makuru y'imva rusange yigeze amenya mu gihe uwo mutwe wamaze muri Uvira, anashinja leta ya DRC gukwirakwiza icengezamatwara rigamije kwangiza isura yawo.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le coordonnateur de l’Alliance du Fleuve Congo/Mouvement du 23 Mars (AFC-M23) a appelé, jeudi 18 septembre 2026, le président de la République du Burundi et président en exercice de l’Union africaine, Évariste Ndayishimiye, à garantir l’accès humanitaire dans les hauts plateaux de Minembwe, en province du Sud-Kivu, dans l’est de la RDC.

claim_sources.translation_en: According to the AFC/M23 official, the people of Minembwe are facing shortages of food, medicines and basic necessities, notably water, salt, soap, oil and sugar.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Il a attribué cette situation à un blocus qu’il impute au « régime de Kinshasa » et à une coalition comprenant, selon lui, les FARDC, des forces burundaises, les FDLR, les Wazalendo et des mercenaires.
claim_sources.translation_en: He attributed this situation to a blockade which he imputes to the « Kinshasa regime » and to a coalition comprising, according to him, the FARDC, Burundian forces, the FDLR, the Wazalendo and mercenaries.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Uruhande rwa leta rwavuze ko umutwe wa M23 wagize uruhare mu byo rwise "amahano kuri gereza ya Munzenze".
claim_sources.translation_en: The government side said the M23 group played a part in what it called "the horror at Munzenze prison".

claim_sources.excerpt_original: The FFM identified a pattern of widespread use of rape and other forms of sexual violence primarily against women, girls but also men, boys, including LGBT individuals by M23 during cordon-andsearch operations, house-to-house searches and in detention, as well as by FARDC and Wazalendo, during their retreat from the frontlines in January and February.
A victim recounted M23 conducting house-to-house searches looking for FARDC soldiers in Katindo neighborhood, Goma. She was gang-raped by three M23 members, together with her mother.
Others, including girls, were abducted and held – sometimes for weeks – in residences and hotels occupied by M23 members, where they were subjected to repeated rape and other abuses.
Women, men, boys and LGBT individuals were subjected to gang rapes while detained in M23 improvised detention facilities or private residences.
In North Kivu, women and adolescent girls were subjected to gang rapes by retreating FARDC and Wazalendo.
Sources specifically identified members of the ‘Guépard’ and ‘Satan II’ FARDC units, deployed along the South Kivu frontline, as responsible for multiple incidents of sexual violence and looting.

In South Kivu, emerging tensions between retreating FARDC and local Wazalendo groups escalated into violent clashes in Kamanyola and Uvira on the Burundian border in mid-February, resulting in civilian casualties. The clashes facilitated the escape of a reported 770 inmates from Uvira prison on 19 February, including some sentenced for war crimes and crimes against humanity.

Les rapports font état d’ évasions massives à la prison de Muzenze à Goma au Nord-Kivu, mais aussi à Bukavu, Uvira et Kalehe, au Sud-Kivu, et à Kalemie dans la province du Tanganyika.
claim_sources.translation_en: Reports indicate mass escapes from Muzenze prison in Goma in North Kivu, but also in Bukavu, Uvira and Kalehe, in South Kivu, and in Kalemie in Tanganyika province.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: All the survivors of gang rape by M23 fighters said the perpetrators wore uniforms that resembled those of the M23 and spoke Kinyarwanda, which is spoken by some M23 fighters. The gang rapes by M23 fighters took place between March and May 2025 when the fighters controlled Goma and Bukavu in eastern DRC.
In Rutshuru and Masisi territories in North Kivu province, as well as Kalehe territory in South Kivu province, Wazalendo groups raped women and girls. One woman was gang raped in late March 2025.

D’après diverses sources contactées par Radio Okapi dans le secteur de Katoyi, un groupe de miliciens Wazalendo a violé au moins 11 femmes ainsi qu’une fillette de 13 ans le dimanche 31 août dernier, dans la localité de Remeka.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to various sources contacted by Radio Okapi in the Katoyi sector, a group of Wazalendo militiamen raped at least 11 women and a 13-year-old girl on Sunday 31 August, in the locality of Remeka.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: D'après les informations recueillies, dans le secteur de Katoyi, un groupe de miliciens Wazalendo a violé au moins 11 femmes et une fillette de 13 ans le dimanche 31 août dans la localité de Remeka.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to the information gathered, in Katoyi sector, a group of Wazalendo militiamen raped at least 11 women and a 13-year-old girl on Sunday 31 August in the locality of Remeka.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Un rapport de monitoring partagé entre les leaders locaux signale par ailleurs deux autres cas de viol sur mineurs, enregistrés le 2 septembre.
claim_sources.translation_en: A monitoring report shared among local leaders also reports two other cases of rape of minors, recorded on 2 September.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Un rapport de monitoring partagé entre les leaders locaux fait également état de deux cas de viol sur mineurs enregistrés le 2 septembre, impliquant des jeunes filles de 12 et 14 ans, qui revenaient des champs avec leurs mères.
claim_sources.translation_en: A monitoring report shared among local leaders also reports two cases of rape of minors recorded on 2 September, involving girls aged 12 and 14, who were returning from the fields with their mothers.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les rapports font également état de vols fréquents de bétail et de pillages, dont celui du centre de santé de Bukuba/Remeka, amplifiant la précarité des populations.
claim_sources.translation_en: The reports also mention frequent cattle thefts and looting, including of the Bukuba/Remeka health centre, worsening the precariousness of the population.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le HCDH a identifié un schéma de violences sexuelles généralisées par des membres des Forces armées de la RDC et de leurs alliés les Wazalendo lors de leur retrait des lignes de front. Le groupe armé M23, pour sa part, a commis des actes de torture et de mauvais traitements, y compris des violences sexuelles, contre des détenus.
claim_sources.translation_en: OHCHR identified a pattern of widespread sexual violence by members of the DRC armed forces and their Wazalendo allies when they withdrew from the front lines. The M23 armed group, for its part, committed acts of torture and ill-treatment, including sexual violence, against detainees.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Durant le mois d’avril 2025, le BCNUDH a documenté 39 cas de violences sexuelles liées au conflit (VSLC) dans les provinces du Nord Kivu (21 cas), de l’Ituri (16 cas) et du Sud Kivu (deux cas). Ces incidents ont affecté au total 64 victimes, dont 20 victimes mineures.
claim_sources.translation_en: During April 2025, the BCNUDH documented 39 cases of conflict-related sexual violence in North Kivu (21 cases), Ituri (16 cases) and South Kivu (two cases). These incidents affected 64 victims in total, 20 of them minors.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: À Goma (capitale de la province du Nord-Kivu), le 27 janvier, deux hôpitaux ont été bombardés, tuant et blessant plusieurs patients, y compris des femmes et des enfants », a décrit M. Turk.
claim_sources.translation_en: In Goma (capital of North Kivu province), on 27 January, two hospitals were bombed, killing and wounding several patients, including women and children, M. Turk described.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: In the first six months of this year alone, nearly 28,000 survivors sought care in MSF-supported facilities in eastern DRC. That’s an average of 155 survivors each and every day. Three out of four attacks were committed by armed individuals.

In Masisi, just two weeks ago, the Kazinga Health Center—clearly marked with the MSF insignia—was looted and destroyed by a Wazalendo militia. Three MSF colleagues have been killed this year.
Medical facilities and staff are not spared : ambulances have been stopped at gunpoint, and armed actors have stormed medical facilities, threatening and terrorising both patients and staff.
Ambulances have been stopped at gunpoint, and armed actors have stormed medical facilities, threatening and terrorizing both patients and staff.
des ambulances ont été bloquées alors qu'elles tentaient de se rendre dans des centres de santé
claim_sources.translation_en: ambulances were blocked as they tried to reach health centres

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Hospitals and health centers have been overwhelmed at a time when humanitarian assistance has dropped because of lack of access and funding shortfalls.

Parmi eux, près de 100 personnes blessées par armes ont été admises, du 02 au 11 décembre 2025, à l'Hôpital Général de Référence d'Uvira (HGR), soutenu par le Comité international de la Croix-Rouge (CICR).
claim_sources.translation_en: Among them, nearly 100 people wounded by weapons were admitted, from 2 to 11 December 2025, to the Uvira General Referral Hospital (HGR), supported by the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC).

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Des structures sanitaires et scolaires sont pillées par des acteurs armés.
claim_sources.translation_en: Health and school structures are being looted by armed actors.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le 8 septembre, les forces militaires congolaises ont ouvert le feu sur des manifestants à Uvira, tuant un garçon de 8 ans et blessant au moins neuf civils, dont une fillette de 11 ans.
claim_sources.translation_en: On 8 September, Congolese military forces opened fire on protesters in Uvira, killing an 8-year-old boy and wounding at least nine civilians, including an 11-year-old girl.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Une autre femme a raconté avoir été agressée le 3 janvier 2026, alors qu’elle récupérait de la nourriture dans ses champs, en périphérie d’Uvira. Elle a rencontré un combattant du M23 et un soldat rwandais qui prétendaient aller chercher de l’eau.
claim_sources.translation_en: Another woman said she had been assaulted on 3 January 2026, while she was collecting food in her fields, on the outskirts of Uvira. She met an M23 fighter and a Rwandan soldier who claimed to be going to fetch water.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Après le viol, elle a souffert de saignements sévères et a été malade.
claim_sources.translation_en: After the rape, she suffered severe bleeding and was ill.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Elle a expliqué que, pendant l’occupation d’Uvira par le M23, les hôpitaux ne fournissaient pas de traitement pour les violences sexuelles. Elle n’a pas pu accéder à un kit PEP durant la période critique des 72 heures qui suivent un viol.
claim_sources.translation_en: She explained that, during the M23 occupation of Uvira, hospitals did not provide treatment for sexual violence. She could not obtain a PEP kit during the critical 72-hour period following a rape.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le 1 er janvier 2026, lors des célébrations du Nouvel An, le M23 a placé sept hommes et une femme en détention. [75] Il a également emmené un garçon de 16 ans qui était avec deux amis près de la base militaire « Parking » dans le quartier de Kavimvira.
claim_sources.translation_en: On 1 January 2026, during New Year celebrations, the M23 placed seven men and a woman in detention. It also took a 16-year-old boy who was with two friends near the military base "Parking" in the Kavimvira quarter.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: The M23’s control over much of North and South Kivu has significantly hampered the delivery of humanitarian aid , with the major airports in both provincial capitals closed since early 2025 and other restrictions on access and movement.

Dans son communiqué rendu public le jeudi 22 janvier, Kinshasa a dénoncé une interprétation « partielle et tronquée » des événements. Selon le gouvernement congolais, HRW aurait ignoré la genèse du conflit : une occupation illégale ponctuée de pillages et de manœuvres de déstabilisation planifiées par le groupe armé avant son départ.
claim_sources.translation_en: In its communiqué made public on Thursday 22 January, Kinshasa denounced a "partial and truncated" interpretation of the events. According to the Congolese government, HRW had ignored the genesis of the conflict: an illegal occupation punctuated by looting and destabilisation manoeuvres planned by the armed group before its departure.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: « Aucun décès ni blessé n’a été recensé au sein de la communauté depuis le retrait des troupes rwandaises » , a précisé Muyaya
claim_sources.translation_en: "No death or injury has been recorded within the community since the withdrawal of the Rwandan troops," Muyaya specified

claim_sources.excerpt_original: En réaction, le mouvement politico-militaire Alliance Fleuve Congo-AFC/M23 s’est montré critique à l’égard de ce rapport, affirmant qu’il suscite de sérieuses interrogations quant à sa crédibilité, son impartialité et son objectivité.
claim_sources.translation_en: In reaction, the political-military movement Alliance Fleuve Congo-AFC/M23 was critical of this report, saying it raises serious questions about its credibility, its impartiality and its objectivity.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Dans cette mise au point, ce mouvement rebelle soutenu par le Rwanda rappelle que son retrait d’Uvira s’est effectué en pleine journée, dans le calme et sous les regards des caméras du monde entier.
claim_sources.translation_en: In this clarification, this Rwanda-backed rebel movement recalls that its withdrawal from Uvira took place in broad daylight, calmly and under the eyes of cameras from around the world.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Elle les présente comme démontrant l’ampleur des exactions commises à Uvira non pas par ses éléments, mais, selon Lawrence Kanyuka, par la coalition gouvernementale composée des FARDC, des FNDB, des FDLR, des Wazalendo et de mercenaires étrangers.
claim_sources.translation_en: It presents them as demonstrating the scale of the abuses committed in Uvira not by its elements but, according to Lawrence Kanyuka, by the government coalition made up of the FARDC, the FNDB, the FDLR, the Wazalendo and foreign mercenaries.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Dans une mise au point faite vendredi 15 mai par Lawrence Kanyuka, chef du département de communication et porte-parole du mouvement rebelle,
claim_sources.translation_en: In a clarification made on Friday 15 May by Lawrence Kanyuka, head of the communication department and spokesperson of the rebel movement,

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Durant le semestre, le BCNUDH a documenté 267 cas de violences sexuelles dans les provinces en conflit, ayant affecté 401 victimes (282 femmes, 113 enfants, 5 hommes, et une personne de sexe et âge inconnu).
claim_sources.translation_en: During the half-year, BCNUDH documented 267 cases of sexual violence in the conflict provinces, affecting 401 victims (282 women, 113 children, 5 men, and one person of unknown sex and age).

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les groupes armés sont les principaux auteurs de ces violences sexuelles liées au conflit, 148 cas ayant affecté 259 victimes leur sont attribués. Les M23 viennent en tête, responsable de 133 victimes, suivis des Wazalendo (66 victimes), ADF (15 victimes) et APCLS (11 victimes).
claim_sources.translation_en: Armed groups are the main perpetrators of this conflict-related sexual violence; 148 cases affecting 259 victims are attributed to them. The M23 come first, responsible for 133 victims, followed by the Wazalendo (66 victims), ADF (15 victims) and APCLS (11 victims).

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les agents de l’Etat sont quant à eux responsables de 116 cas affectant 130 victimes. Les FARDC sont responsables de 130 victimes, suivies de la PNC (6 victimes).
claim_sources.translation_en: State agents are responsible for 116 cases affecting 130 victims. The FARDC are responsible for 130 victims, followed by the PNC (6 victims).

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ainsi, le 11 juin 2026, à Mudaka, territoire de Kabare, province du Sud Kivu, des Wazalendo ont, dans la nuit, fait irruption dans un domicile où se trouvaient une femme et sa fille. Les deux victimes ont été enlevées et emmenées dans la brousse, où, elles ont été violées à tour de rôle par leurs ravisseurs.
claim_sources.translation_en: Thus, on 11 June 2026, in Mudaka, Kabare territory, South Kivu province, Wazalendo burst into a home at night where a woman and her daughter were. The two victims were abducted and taken into the bush, where they were raped in turn by their captors.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: A titre illustratif, le 10 juin 2026, une fille âgée de 12 ans a été violée par un élément Wazalendo à Nyalugushwa, territoire de Kalehe, province du Sud-Kivu. La victime revenait du champ lorsqu’elle a croisé l’auteur présumé, qui l’a interceptée avant de la violer.
claim_sources.translation_en: By way of illustration, on 10 June 2026, a 12-year-old girl was raped by a Wazalendo element at Nyalugushwa, Kalehe territory, South Kivu province. The victim was returning from the field when she met the alleged perpetrator, who intercepted her before raping her.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Après les faits, l’auteur présumé l’a tuée par strangulation puis jeté son corps dans la rivière Nyabarongo.
claim_sources.translation_en: After the acts, the alleged perpetrator killed her by strangulation and then threw her body into the Nyabarongo river.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Au total, 31 violations du droit international humanitaire ont été documentées, compre- nant une attaque contre une école, 10 attaques contre des hôpitaux, 17 attaques contre des personnes protégées, et trois attaques visant des sites protégés.
claim_sources.translation_en: In total, 31 violations of international humanitarian law were documented, comprising one attack on a school, 10 attacks on hospitals, 17 attacks on protected persons, and three attacks on protected sites.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les agents de l’Etat sont responsables de cinq de ces violations, et les groupes armés responsable de 26 (M23 : 22, APCLS : 23, Nyatura :2, FDLR : 1).
claim_sources.translation_en: State agents are responsible for five of these violations, and armed groups for 26 (M23: 22, APCLS: 23, Nyatura: 2, FDLR: 1).

claim_sources.excerpt_original: De même, le 20 mai 2026, au cours des affrontements armés opposant les éléments de l’AFC/M23 aux forces loyalistes, l’hôpital de Mikenge a été visé par un bombardement attribué à des éléments de l’AFC/M23. Selon les sources, plusieurs militaires des FARDC blessés et malades qui s’y trouvaient auraient été tués.
claim_sources.translation_en: Likewise, on 20 May 2026, during armed clashes between AFC/M23 elements and loyalist forces, the Mikenge hospital was hit by a bombardment attributed to AFC/M23 elements. According to the sources, several FARDC soldiers, wounded and sick, who were there were reportedly killed.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Dans ce communiqué de presse n°13, les FARDC affirment que plusieurs frappes de drones ont visé dès les premières heures de la matinée les localités de Kalingi et Mikenge, dans les hauts plateaux de Minembwe.
claim_sources.translation_en: In this press communiqué n°13, the FARDC state that several drone strikes hit the localities of Kalingi and Mikenge from the first hours of the morning, in the Minembwe highlands.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon l’armée Congolaise, ces attaques ont notamment touché l’Hôpital Général de Mikenge qui aurait été « intentionnellement ciblé » puis complètement détruit au cours des bombardements.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to the Congolese army, these attacks notably hit the Mikenge General Hospital, which was reportedly "intentionally targeted" and then completely destroyed during the bombardments.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le mercredi 20 mai 2026, les Forces Armées de la République Démocratique du Congo ont publié un nouveau communiqué dénonçant des attaques attribuées à la coalition RDF/AFC-M23 dans plusieurs localités de Minembwe.
claim_sources.translation_en: On Wednesday 20 May 2026, the Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo published a new communiqué denouncing attacks attributed to the RDF/AFC-M23 coalition in several localities of Minembwe.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le 2 janvier 2026, à Masis-centre, province du Nord-Kivu, trois femmes, deux hommes, une fille et un garçon ont été tués et 42 autres blessés par des obus présumément largués par drone par des FARDC explosant dans un quartier résidentiel de Masisi-Centre.
claim_sources.translation_en: On 2 January 2026, in Masisi-centre, North Kivu province, three women, two men, a girl and a boy were killed and 42 others wounded by shells presumed to have been dropped by drone by the FARDC, exploding in a residential quarter of Masisi-Centre.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ce bilan a été communiqué vendredi 2 janvier 2026 par l’organisation humanitaire Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF), à la suite d’une frappe aérienne survenue dans une zone résidentielle de Masisi-centre. Selon les informations disponibles, un drone de l’armée congolaise a ciblé des positions des rebelles de l’AFC/M23 dans le quartier Mont Ngaliema, à Masisi-centre.
claim_sources.translation_en: This toll was communicated on Friday 2 January 2026 by the humanitarian organisation Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF), following an air strike in a residential area of Masisi-centre. According to available information, a drone of the Congolese army targeted positions of the AFC/M23 rebels in the Mont Ngaliema quarter, in Masisi-centre.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Un bilan provisoire fait état de quatre morts et sept blessés parmi les civils, ainsi que de plusieurs bâtiments endommagés par la frappe. Les blessés ont été évacués vers l’hôpital général de référence de Masisi.
claim_sources.translation_en: A provisional toll reports four dead and seven wounded among civilians, as well as several buildings damaged by the strike. The wounded were evacuated to the Masisi general referral hospital.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: l’agglomération de Bitale est passée sous le contrôle des rebelles de l’AFC/M23 dans la matinée du lundi 15 juin 2026, après deux jours d’intenses affrontements contre les Forces armées de la République démocratique du Congo (FARDC) et les miliciens Wazalendo.
claim_sources.translation_en: the Bitale agglomeration passed under the control of the AFC/M23 rebels on the morning of Monday 15 June 2026, after two days of intense fighting against the Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (FARDC) and Wazalendo militiamen.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Des miliciens Wazalendo, ces groupes armés alliés à l’armée congolaise, ont pris pour cible un convoi d’agents en mission dans la province du Sud-Kivu, sur l’axe Mwenga – Kamituga.
claim_sources.translation_en: Wazalendo militiamen, these armed groups allied to the Congolese army, targeted a convoy of agents on a mission in South Kivu province, on the Mwenga – Kamituga axis.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: « Le 1er mai, alors qu’une équipe de MSF se rendait à Mwenga, Kamituga et Kitutu, au sud-ouest de Bukavu, afin d’évaluer les besoins humanitaires, elle a été confrontée à un incident de sécurité.
claim_sources.translation_en: "On 1 May, while an MSF team was travelling to Mwenga, Kamituga and Kitutu, south-west of Bukavu, to assess humanitarian needs, it faced a security incident."

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Tous les membres de notre personnel sont sains et saufs et poursuivent actuellement leurs activités humanitaires prévues à Mwenga
claim_sources.translation_en: All of our staff members are safe and are currently continuing their planned humanitarian activities in Mwenga

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Au cours du mois de janvier, le BCNUDH a documenté au moins 46 cas de violences sexuelles liées aux conflits (VSLC), touchant 61 victimes (39 femmes, 21 filles et un homme). Ce chiffre représente une diminution de 59 pour cent par rapport au mois précédent[4] , où 147 victimes (102 femmes et 45 filles) avaient été documentées en décembre 2025.
claim_sources.translation_en: During January, BCNUDH documented at least 46 cases of conflict-related sexual violence (CRSV), affecting 61 victims (39 women, 21 girls and one man). This figure represents a 59 per cent decrease compared with the previous month, in which 147 victims (102 women and 45 girls) had been documented in December 2025.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Cette diminution de 59 % des cas documentés en janvier 2026 s'explique principalement par l'intensification des combats et de l'insécurité, qui a rendu les populations déplacées plus difficiles à atteindre et a considérablement limité l'accès des humanitaires aux victimes, entraînant une sous-documentation des violences plutôt qu'une réelle diminution de celles-ci.
claim_sources.translation_en: This 59% decrease in cases documented in January 2026 is mainly explained by the intensification of fighting and insecurity, which made displaced populations harder to reach and considerably limited humanitarians' access to victims, leading to under-documentation of the violence rather than a real decrease.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le M23 arrive en tête, avec 21 victimes (13 femmes et huit filles), suivi des Nyatura (quatre victimes : deux femmes et deux filles), les Raïa Mutomboki (trois victimes : deux femmes et une fille), les ADF (deux femmes).
claim_sources.translation_en: M23 comes first, with 21 victims (13 women and eight girls), followed by the Nyatura (four victims: two women and two girls), the Raïa Mutomboki (three victims: two women and one girl), the ADF (two women).

claim_sources.excerpt_original: 25 victimes (15 femmes, neuf filles et un homme) sont attribuées aux FARDC, deux femmes à la PNC, et une fille à un fonctionnaire de l’État affecté aux services des mines et énergie.
claim_sources.translation_en: 25 victims (15 women, nine girls and one man) are attributed to the FARDC, two women to the PNC, and one girl to a State official assigned to the mines and energy services.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon les données collectées par le BCNUDH, 887 cas de violences sexuelles liées au conflit ont été documentés l’année passée, affectant 1 534 victimes, dont une majorité écrasante de femmes (854) et de filles (672).
claim_sources.translation_en: According to the data collected by BCNUDH, 887 cases of conflict-related sexual violence were documented last year, affecting 1 534 victims, including an overwhelming majority of women (854) and girls (672).

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les provinces du Nord-Kivu et du Sud-Kivu concentrent à elles seules près de 80 % des victimes documentées, confirmant la persistance d’un contexte sécuritaire particulièrement fragile dans l’Est du pays. D’après le BCNUDH, les groupes armés sont responsables de 75 % des victimes.
claim_sources.translation_en: The provinces of North Kivu and South Kivu alone concentrate nearly 80% of documented victims, confirming the persistence of a particularly fragile security context in the east. According to BCNUDH, armed groups are responsible for 75% of victims.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le Mouvement du 23 mars (M23) arrive en tête avec 439 victimes, suivi des groupes Wazalendo, de la Coopérative pour le développement du Congo (CODECO), de divers groupes Maï-Maï, ainsi que des Forces démocratiques de libération du Rwanda (FDLR) et des Forces démocratiques alliées (ADF).
claim_sources.translation_en: The Mouvement du 23 mars (M23) comes first with 439 victims, followed by the Wazalendo groups, the Coopérative pour le développement du Congo (CODECO), various Maï-Maï groups, as well as the Forces démocratiques de libération du Rwanda (FDLR) and the Forces démocratiques alliées (ADF).

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le BCNUDH note également avec préoccupation l’implication d’acteurs étatiques, notamment des membres des Forces armées de la République démocratique du Congo (FARDC), de la Police nationale congolaise (PNC) et de l’Agence nationale de renseignement (ANR), dans 19 % des cas documentés.
claim_sources.translation_en: BCNUDH also notes with concern the involvement of State actors, notably members of the Forces armées de la République démocratique du Congo (FARDC), the Police nationale congolaise (PNC) and the Agence nationale de renseignement (ANR), in 19% of documented cases.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: 11. AFC/M23 was the leading perpetrator of conflict-related sexual violence according to cases documented and verified by the United Nations (see S/2025/858, para. 80 and annex 37). Humanitarian actors recorded a dramatic increase in cases of such violence since 2024, with cases disproportionately affecting women and girls (see annexes 4 and 5).

The Group reviewed a document dated 11 February 2026 that the AFC/M23 distributed to multiple humanitarian actors involved in the provision of health care, including governmental and non-governmental organisations and international organisations.

5. Following the distribution of this note, the AFC/M23-run Provincial Health Inspection Department (Inspection Provinciale de la Santé or IPS) initiated a series of inspections of the premises of humanitarian actors.

IPS inspectors requested aggregate data on sexual violence incidents and access to confidential patient files containing names of victims and other personal information. They also requested access to consumption records for supplies such as PEP kits and dignity kits.
Some humanitarian actors were ordered to cease the distribution of dignity kits to curb the number of what they alleged to be “fake” victims seeking humanitarian assistance.
6. A joint meeting was held in late March 2026 between humanitarian actors and AFC/M23 at which the issue of sexual violence data was discussed.

AFC/M23 officials present at the meeting included Colonel John Imani Nzenze, AFC/M23 Director of Intelligence and the AFC/M23 liaison with humanitarian actors, and Ms. Chantal Kayitaba Murekatete (S/2025/858, annex 39), Special Adviser on Gender, Family and Children, Education, and Social and Humanitarian Affairs.

At the meeting, the AFC/M23 reprimanded humanitarian actors and accused them of inventing data. It affirmed that AFC/M23 did not tolerate sexual violence and criticised the lack of perpetrator data in patient files as this made it more difficult for it to punish perpetrators.

Further meetings between the AFC/M23 and humanitarian actors were held in late March and April 2026, resulting in an agreement that only aggregate data on sexual violence would be shared in the future.

An armed group backed by the Congolese army (FARDC) has killed and tortured civilians, looted property, and abducted women as sexual slaves in Rutshuru territory in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), Amnesty International said today.

Between March and April 2026, Amnesty International conducted remote interviews by secure phone applications with 16 victims, survivors, and family members of civilians killed, raped, tortured, abducted, or ill-treated by CMC-FDP fighters between June and December 2025.
The two sexual violence survivors that Amnesty International interviewed were held in conditions that amount to sexual slavery.

CMC-FDP spokesperson Héritier Donald Gashegu responded in writing on 16 June 2026. CMC-FDP denied responsibility for the abuses documented here and asserted that “CMC-FDP remains committed to respecting human rights and the discipline of its combatants.”

CMC-FDP said that it “categorically rejects” the allegations that its fighters raped, sexually enslaved or forced women to “marry” its commanders. “No complaints, official reports, or referrals have been brought to the attention of our internal disciplinary or judicial bodies regarding the mentioned incidents.”

claim_sources.translation_en: In a "clarification" dated 22 September, the AFC-M23 "formally and in their entirety rejects" the accusations made in the Amnesty International report, which it considers "not established and insufficiently substantiated".
