claim_sources.translation_en: Several sources in Walungu say that the shell was fired by the M23 rebels, who are currently occupying the administrative centre of Walungu territory.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: En date du 19 avril 2025, Mme Pascaline NGWASI, Coordinatrice de « l'Association des Mères Célibataires pour le Bien-être des Enfants Abandonnés », a été arrêtée, frappée et violée par des membres du M23/AFC dans le Quartier MABENGA dans la Ville de Bukavu, Province du Sud-Kivu.
claim_sources.translation_en: On 19 April 2025, Mrs Pascaline NGWASI, Coordinator of the 'Association des Mères Célibataires pour le Bien-être des Enfants Abandonnés', was arrested, beaten and raped by members of M23/AFC in the Mabenga neighbourhood in the City of Bukavu, South Kivu Province.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Vendredi, 02 mai 2025, il avait été découvert 5 corps sans vie en décomposition de membres WAZALENDO, enlevés le 24 avril 2025 à l’hôpital de MUSHENYI par les rebelles du M23/AFC-RDF là où ils suivaient les soins de leurs blessures par balle à l’issu des combats de NYANFUNZE, vers KAZIBA.
claim_sources.translation_en: On Friday 2 May 2025, 5 lifeless decomposing bodies of WAZALENDO members had been found, abducted on 24 April 2025 from the hospital of MUSHENYI by the M23/AFC-RDF rebels, where they were receiving treatment for their gunshot wounds after the fighting at NYANFUNZE, towards KAZIBA.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ces WAZALENDO sont identifiés comme suit : - Mwalungwe Manu ; - Kapeshi Claude ; - Innocent Alias Nyoka ; - Namuto Buhende ; - Adrien Hyrondele.
claim_sources.translation_en: These WAZALENDO are identified as follows: - Mwalungwe Manu; - Kapeshi Claude; - Innocent Alias Nyoka; - Namuto Buhende; - Adrien Hyrondele.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le 23 avril 2025, des éléments du groupe armé AFC/M23 ont perpétré un massacre dans le Village de KAKABA-BUSHWEGE, dans le Secteur de MUSHENYI. Les assaillants, confondant certains villageois portant des bottines traditionnelles, communément appelé « GODIO » avec des membres du groupe armé WAZALENDO, ont exécuté sommairement cinq civils et blessé plusieurs autres.
claim_sources.translation_en: On 23 April 2025, elements of the armed group AFC/M23 carried out a massacre in the Village of KAKABA-BUSHWEGE, in the Sector of MUSHENYI. The assailants, mistaking some villagers wearing traditional boots, commonly called 'GODIO', for members of the armed group WAZALENDO, summarily executed five civilians and wounded several others.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les victimes identifiées sont : - Bashanga Lugabinja ; - Mitima Kabugi ; - Juvénal Bashomberwa Kabugi ; - Deux jeunes garçons de la famille Chibwana.
claim_sources.translation_en: The identified victims are: - Bashanga Lugabinja; - Mitima Kabugi; - Juvénal Bashomberwa Kabugi; - Two young boys of the Chibwana family.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Lundi, 30 juin 2025, les militaires M23 ont fait incursion dans la localité de MUKU, Groupement KAMISIMBI dans le territoire de WALUNGU au Sud-Kivu et ont tué 6 civils en représailles à la présence présumée de Wazalendo dans la zone sous leur contrôle.
claim_sources.translation_en: On Monday 30 June 2025, M23 soldiers made an incursion into the locality of MUKU, KAMISIMBI Grouping in the territory of WALUNGU in South Kivu and killed 6 civilians in reprisal for the alleged presence of Wazalendo in the area under their control.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Photo de la victime Francis, originaire de Kalebero et tué à Muku
claim_sources.translation_en: Photo of the victim Francis, from Kalebero and killed at Muku

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le dimanche 29 juin 2025, les militaires du M23 ont tué 4 civils dans la localité de Kaniola et incendié plusieurs maisons de paisibles citoyens.
claim_sources.translation_en: On Sunday 29 June 2025, M23 soldiers killed 4 civilians in the locality of Kaniola and burned several houses of peaceful citizens.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Vendredi, 23 mai 2025, le corps sans vie de monsieur Pascal KILOZO a été découvert dans le Quartier Kavimvira, avenue Nyagaa, Ville d’UVIRA, au bord du Lac Tanganyika. Les circonstances de sa mort restent inconnues, mais l’état dans lequel le corps a été retrouvé soulève de sérieuses inquiétudes quant à une possible exécution extrajudiciaire ou meurtre.
claim_sources.translation_en: On Friday 23 May 2025, the lifeless body of Mr Pascal KILOZO was found in the Kavimvira Neighbourhood, Nyagaa avenue, City of UVIRA, on the shore of Lake Tanganyika. The circumstances of his death remain unknown, but the state in which the body was found raises serious concerns about a possible extrajudicial execution or murder.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Dans la nuit du 4 au 5 avril 2025, un enfant artiste musicien a été froidement assassiné à Bukavu, dans la province du Sud-Kivu, par des éléments identifiés comme appartenant au mouvement armé M23-AFC.
claim_sources.translation_en: In the night of 4 to 5 April 2025, a child musician was coldly murdered in Bukavu, in South Kivu province, by elements identified as belonging to the armed movement M23-AFC.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: le Conseil des Ministres du 28 février 2025, dans son compte rendu, établit le bilan ci-après pour le Sud-Kivu, « jusqu’au 27 février 2025, la ville de Bukavu a enregistré plus de 1.130 blessés, plus de 29 décès dans les établissements de soins et 16 personnes décédées lors du meeting ».
claim_sources.translation_en: the Council of Ministers of 28 February 2025, in its record, established the following toll for South Kivu: 'up to 27 February 2025, the city of Bukavu recorded more than 1.130 wounded, more than 29 deaths in health care establishments and 16 people who died at the rally'.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: At Irambo, a nurse was sexually assaulted and another was beaten during the attack, according to Dr. Jimmy Kasongo, medical director of the health center. Medicine and money also were stolen.
Nurse on duty Bienfait Kabeya Ntumba (right) recounts how he was beaten during an attack on the United Methodist Irambo Health Center on the night of March 18 in Bukavu, Congo.

Sandra Bontamba, pharmacist at the Irambo Health Center, said the attack came 24 hours after the hospital received essential medicines. “I regret in the sense that even the stock of medicines that the hospital stocked up on yesterday was taken away,” Bontamba said.
The gunmen also looted the hospital’s medicine supplies and stole patients’ personal belongings, including telephones, clothes and watches.
Material damage included three damaged doors. More than $4,500 dollars and 789,200 Congolese francs were stolen, compromising essential funds for hospital services.
Nurse on duty Bienfait Kabeya Ntumba (right) recounts how he was beaten during an attack on the United Methodist Irambo Health Center on the night of March 18 in Bukavu, Congo.

Patients at hospitals in the second-largest city in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo have described how they sustained serious injuries during the chaotic withdrawal of the Congolese army and its allies in the days before Rwanda-backed M23 rebels marched in.
“I was lying on my bed at home, near Katana,” said 22-year-old Priscilla Nabintu from her bed in Bukavu’s general hospital. “All of a sudden, a bullet hit me [in the shin] and I started bleeding.”
Mugisho Shalukoma, 20, was recovering from a leg amputation, the result of gunshot wounds.
Ghislaine Ntakwinja, 41, said she was in her house when unidentified gunmen shot her in her right hand.

Esperance Mwamini Birindwa, a nurse with the International Committee of the Red Cross, which operates at the general hospital, said 162 people had been admitted with injuries related to the M23 takeover between 14 and 24 February.

“Despite all our efforts, evacuations sometimes take longer than expected because of access difficulties,” said ICRC project manager Emmanuel Konin. “Some patients whose lives we could have tried to save are already dead from their injuries.”
Riziki (not her real name) told DW that she survived an attack. "Three soldiers broke into my house to loot," Riziki said. "One of them came into my bedroom to rape me, but I resisted."
The crime took place in February in Kavumu village, about 30 kilometers (18 miles) north of Bukavu.

In South Kivu, MSF has assisted almost 700 people in the Kalehe and Uvira regions since the start of 2025. According to MSF's report, the vast majority of attacks reported by victims in 2025 were committed at gunpoint, with perpetrators remaining unaccountable.
MSF reports treating almost 40,000 victims there in 2024; between January and April 2025, there were almost 7,400 victims and survivors.
On a recent visit to Panzi Hospital, 185 of its 450 patients were receiving treatment for sexual violence.
The rebels captured Bukavu in February. In the following weeks, the hospital remained operational, treating injuries and gunshot wounds and delivering 110 babies—a sign of life continuing.

D’autres évasions massives des prisons de Bukavu, Kabare et Uvira ont suivi lors de l’offensive vers la capitale du Sud Kivu. Il sied de noter que certains évadés avaient été reconnus coupables ou étaient soupçonnés de graves violations des droits humains, dont de crimes sexuels et sexistes.
claim_sources.translation_en: Other mass escapes from the prisons of Bukavu, Kabare and Uvira followed during the offensive towards the South Kivu capital. It should be noted that some escapees had been convicted or were suspected of serious human rights violations, including sexual and gender-based crimes.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: In the South Kivu province, UNFPA is strengthening the response in one health facility through deployed midwives. In Minova, South Kivu, activities are still paused due to limited access, though implementing partners are prepared to resume operations as soon as the situation improves.

The traditional FDLR-RUD area of operations was in the Bwisha and Bwito chefferies, Rutshuru territory. At the time of drafting, FDLR-RUD units were particularly active in Jomba, Binza, Busanza and Bukoma, overlapping with the FDLR-FPP area of operations in Rutshuru territory.
Since April 2025, RDF units have led joint operations with AFC/M23 aimed at neutralizing FDLR (S/2025/446, paras. 39 and 71 and annex 23).
Throughout these operations, RDF and AFC/M23 systematically destroyed and burned civilian settlements inhabited by members of FDLR, their families or alleged supporters.

Since June 2025, VDP/Wazalendo units, often operating jointly with FDLR, have conducted incursions and ambushes against AFC/M23 and RDF, either to recapture strategic positions or to disrupt AFC/M23 and RDF advances and supply lines.

To halt the advancement of AFC/M23 and RDF, between mid- to late September and October, FARDC increased air strikes, notably in Bibwe, Mpeti and Minjenje between 19 and 21 September, relying on VDP/Wazalendo and FDLR elements to conduct asymmetric ground operations.

The Government of the Democratic Republic of the Congo expressed its commitment to this objective, publicly stated that it did not support FDLR and called on FDLR combatants to disarm and surrender (see annex 6).

However, the bulk of FDLR forces operated in areas controlled by AFC/M23 and RDF, beyond the operational reach of the Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of Congo (FARDC), affecting the latter’s ability to neutralize FDLR elements that refused to surrender.

« Les Forces armées de la République démocratique du Congo appellent toutes les factions des FDLR à déposer les armes », déclare le communiqué signé par le général-major Ekenge Bomusa Efomi Sylvain, porte-parole de l’armée.
claim_sources.translation_en: “The Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo call on all FDLR factions to lay down their arms”, says the communiqué signed by Major General Ekenge Bomusa Efomi Sylvain, spokesperson of the army.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: L’armée prévient qu'en cas de refus, « les FARDC procéderont au désarmement par contrainte ou par usage de la force »
claim_sources.translation_en: The army warns that in case of refusal, “the FARDC will proceed to disarmament by constraint or by use of force”.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: FARDC issued a communiqué on 10 October 2025 in which it called upon FDLR to disarm (S/2024/969, paras. 67–73) and surrender, warning that failure to comply would result in forced disarmament (see annex 35).

le ministre de l'Intégration régionale, Floribert Anzuluni, a confirmé la signature, par les FDLR (Forces démocratiques de libération du Rwanda), d'un protocole de démilitarisation, de démobilisation et de cantonnement. Selon le ministre qui s'exprimait ce mardi 28 juillet lors du briefing de presse à Kinshasa
claim_sources.translation_en: the Minister of Regional Integration, Floribert Anzuluni, confirmed the signature, by the FDLR (Forces démocratiques de libération du Rwanda), of a protocol of demilitarisation, demobilisation and cantonment. According to the minister, who was speaking this Tuesday 28 July at the press briefing in Kinshasa

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le ministre rwandais des Affaires étrangères, Olivier Nduhungirehe, estime que l’annonce du protocole de reddition des FDLR constitue une « grossière manipulation » qui n’est « en rien conforme aux accords de Washington, qui ne le prévoit nulle part ».
claim_sources.translation_en: The Rwandan Foreign Minister, Olivier Nduhungirehe, considers that the announcement of the FDLR surrender protocol is a “gross manipulation” that is “in no way consistent with the Washington accords, which does not provide for it anywhere”.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mais à Kigali, on ne veut pas entendre parler d’un « protocole négocié avec une milice génocidaire que le gouvernement de la RDC continue d’armer et de soutenir », comme l’a souligné sur le réseau X la porte-parole du gouvernement rwandais. Yolande Makolo estime que les FDLR « r estent intégrés à l’armée congolaise et actifs sur les lignes de fronts
claim_sources.translation_en: But in Kigali, they do not want to hear about a “protocol negotiated with a genocidal militia that the DRC government continues to arm and support”, as the Rwandan government spokesperson underlined on X. Yolande Makolo believes that the FDLR “remain integrated in the Congolese army and active on the front lines

claim_sources.excerpt_original: On 1 March 2025, AFC/M23 transferred several FDLR captives to the Government of Rwanda, including high-profile commander “Brigadier-General” Ezechiel Gakwerere, (see annex 38). According to AFC/M23, these individuals were arrested during their raid on Goma.
Most, including Gakwerere, were arrested during armed operations targeting hospitals
Additional information on Gakwerere and controversies around his arrest and transfer to the Rwandan authorities

On 4 January 2025, AFC/M23 and RDF took control of Masisi centre in North Kivu and managed to retain control despite repeated attempts by Wazalendo, FDLR, the Burundi National Defence Force (FDNB) and FARDC to retake it.

Two weeks later, AFC/M23 and RDF captured Minova town in Kalehe Territory, South Kivu – a key strategic location facilitating further military operations targeting Goma. The 2,500 FARDC and FDNB troops based in Minova retreated before the arrival of AFC/M23 and RDF troops, leaving behind significant quantities of military equipment.

In early April, the majority of the 7,000 to 9,000 Burundian troops were positioned in South Kivu, notably the Ruzizi Plain along the tri-border area, and in the Hauts Plateaux near Minembwe (see annex 72). Heavy clashes between FDNB supported by FARDC and Wazalendo, and AFC/M23 supported by RDF, resulted in several hundreds of FDNB casualties.

In February 2025, the President of Burundi, Évariste Ndayishimiye, accused Rwanda of intending to invade Burundi, including through its backing of the Burundian armed opposition group Red Tabara, and announced the readiness of Burundi to fight back
In mid-March, both countries agreed on verbal and military de -escalation, reportedly concluding a non-aggression agreement.

After controlling Uvira for over a month – during which AFC/M23 forced the withdrawal of FDNB, captured large FARDC bases, 84 dominated the entire Ruzizi plain along the Burundian border and established a parallel administration – AFC/ M23 and RDF troops eventually withdrew from Uvira on 18 January 2026

In late January 2026, FARDC, with support from Wazalendo, FDNB and private military contractors (see paras. 143–144), launched an offensive from Uvira towards Minembwe against MRDP/Twirwaneho and AFC/M23, who reinforced MRDP/ Twirwaneho in August 2025 and February 2026.

In late January 2026, the AFC/M23 coalition, including Twirwaneho combatants, launched an offensive and temporarily seized the strategic positions of Point Zero, Kanguli, and Tuwe-Tuwe along the Mwenga–Fizi road. Although FARDC-FDNB forces subsequently regained these positions on 29 January

Several Wazalendo factions also carried out joint operations with FDNB, which relied on them for intelligence and knowledge of the terrain. For example, FDNB operated with Yakutumba along the Uvira axis and the Ruzizi Plain prior to the AFC/M23 takeover and relied on Ngomazito elements as scouts in the Hauts Plateaux.

MRDP/Twirwaneho and AFC/M23 leaders alleged that FARDC and FDNB committed a premeditated, systematic and targeted campaign of extermination against the Banyamulenge population, including through aerial bombardments of densely populated areas. 99 While the civilian population in the Hauts Plateaux has been exposed to significant risks from ongoing hostilities, the Group of Experts did not substantiate their intentional targeting.

Additional claims cited the presence of FDLR-FOCA elements operating alongside FARDC and FDNB. The Group of Experts did not identify evidence th at such elements posed a direct threat to Rwanda justifying military intervention in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (see S/2025/446, annex 24).

Notably, control of Katogota and surrounding heights strengthens AFC/M23’s influence over the northern ‘gate’ of the Ruzizi Plain and offers options of advancing toward Uvira by bypassing strong FDNB and FARDC/Wazalendo blocking positions along RN5.

Mikalati : four civilians killed, mass abductions, and over 100 missing Several local sources report an attack carried out on Saturday by Burundian soldiers in the town of Mikalati, in the Fizi territory, against residents returning from the weekly market in Bijombo, located in the neighboring Uvira territory

A survivor, now a refugee in Mikenge, describes the attack : “We were returning after buying salt, soap, oil, and sugar. When we arrived in Mikalati, we encountered Burundian soldiers who attacked us, looted what we had, and abducted many people, especially women.”

According to him, the military commander ordered them “to kill the men and collect their belongings.” The Wazalendo community claims that 45 people, mostly women, are being held at the Mikalati military site. No official statement had been issued by the Burundian or Congolese governments as of Sunday morning.

The United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) had already warned of difficulties accessing food and healthcare in Minembwe, due to a blockade imposed for a month by the Burundian army, according to local sources.

Le 5 novembre 2025, la communauté Banyamulenge et d’autres habitants avaient déjà manifesté pour dénoncer le siège imposé, selon eux, par l’armée burundaise et les FARDC, en coalition avec les miliciens wazalendo.
claim_sources.translation_en: On 5 November 2025, the Banyamulenge community and other inhabitants had already demonstrated to denounce the siege imposed, according to them, by the Burundian army and the FARDC, in coalition with the wazalendo militiamen.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: The spokesperson for the FDNB, Brigadier General Gaspard Baratuza, acknowledged on the BBC that some Banyamulenge are trapped in areas “where the enemy is” : “It’s understandable that those who go to buy food for the enemy are blocked.”

Igisirikare c'Uburundi kimenesha ko ingabo zaco ziri mu ntara ya Kivu y'Epfo ya RD Congo zazibiye amayira y'abava mu karere ka Minembwe zigamije "gukingira Uvira n'urubibe rw'Uburundi", zigasaba abanyagihugu bari i Minembwe "kuvavanura n'abansi" bariyo.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Burundian army confirms that its troops in South Kivu province of DR Congo blocked the roads of people leaving the Minembwe area aiming "to protect Uvira and the Burundi border", asking the citizens in Minembwe to "separate from the enemies" who are there.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Général de brigade Gaspard Baratuza avugira igisirikare c'Uburundi yabwiye BBC Gahuzamiryango ko ico gice ca "Minembwe ata musirikare n'umwe w'Uburundi ahari".
claim_sources.translation_en: Brigadier General Gaspard Baratuza, spokesperson of the Burundian army, told BBC Gahuzamiryango that in that area of "Minembwe there is not one Burundian soldier there".

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mu ndwi iheze i Minembwe, ahagenzurwa n'umuhari wa Twirwaneho ufatanije na AFC/M23, habereye imyiyerekano ikomeye yiyamiriza ko ingabo z'Uburundi n'abakorana na zo bugaye amayira ashikanayo ivya nkenerwa ahanini bakura mu muji wa Uvira.
claim_sources.translation_en: In the past week in Minembwe, an area controlled by the Twirwaneho group together with AFC/M23, a big protest took place, objecting that Burundian troops and those working with them blocked the roads bringing necessities, mainly from Uvira town.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Abagize imyiyerekano bagirije ingabo z'Uburundi kuzibira amayira bari ahitwa Mu Mikarati, Point-zero n'ahandi. Basaba ko ingabo z'Uburundi zisubira mu gihugu cazo
claim_sources.translation_en: The protesters accused Burundian troops of blocking the roads at Mu Mikarati, Point-zero and elsewhere. They ask that Burundian troops return to their country.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Uburundi buragiriza Urwanda ko ari rwo rubandanya rutera ibirindiro vy'abasirikare babwo barungitswe mu buseruko bwa Repubulika ya Demokarasi ya Congo, kandi ko igihugu kidashobora kurera amaboko mu gihe kizobandanya giterwa.
claim_sources.translation_en: Burundi accuses Rwanda of being the one that continues to attack the positions of its soldiers sent to the east of the Democratic Republic of Congo, and that the country cannot sit with arms folded while it continues to be attacked.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umushikiranganji Bizimana, ata cemezo atanze, yavuze ko intumbero y'ibi bitero bikomeye bivugwa mu turere tw'intara ya Kivu y'Epfo ari uko Urwanda na M23 bipfuza kuba bafashe igisagara ca Uvira imbere y'uwa 25 Kigarama (12) uno mwaka wa 2025.
claim_sources.translation_en: Minister Bizimana, without giving any proof, said that the aim of these attacks was that Rwanda and M23 wish to have captured the town of Uvira before 25 December of this year 2025.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Nta co reta y'Urwanda irashikiriza kuri ibi birego, mbere n'umushikiranganji ajejwe imigenderanire ntarishura
claim_sources.translation_en: The Rwandan government has not yet said anything about these accusations, and even the minister in charge of foreign relations has not yet responded

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Meanwhile, at least 272 Burundian soldiers are currently serving sentences of up to life imprisonment. They were sent to Murembwe Central Prison in southwestern Burundi after refusing to be sent to fight in the DRC.

Une incursion suivie de pillage systématique par des hommes armés assimilés aux anciens combattants rwandais FDLR a été signalée la nuit du dimanche 14 septembre 2025 dans le village lacustre de Nyakakoma, en groupement Binza, territoire de Rutshuru, au Nord-Kivu.
claim_sources.translation_en: An incursion followed by systematic looting by armed men assimilated to the former Rwandan FDLR fighters was reported on the night of Sunday 14 September 2025 in the lakeside village of Nyakakoma, in the Binza grouping, Rutshuru territory, in North Kivu.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: De longues files de militaires burundais ont été aperçus mercredi 10 décembre à la frontière de Gatumba en train de rentrer dans leur pays, selon des sources locales à Uvira et Bujumbura.
claim_sources.translation_en: Long lines of Burundian soldiers were seen on Wednesday 10 December at the Gatumba border returning to their country, according to local sources in Uvira and Bujumbura.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mais ce départ d'une partie des militaires burundais est démenti par l'ambassadeur du Burundi en RDC.
claim_sources.translation_en: But this departure of part of the Burundian soldiers is denied by the ambassador of Burundi in the DRC.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mais ce départ d'une partie des militaires burundais est démenti par l'ambassadeur du Burundi en RDC.
claim_sources.translation_en: But this departure of part of the Burundian soldiers is denied by the Burundian ambassador to the DRC.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: À l'heure actuelle, la situation à Walikale reste sous contrôle des FARDC, malgré le départ d’une partie de la population. L’armée a réussi à freiner la progression des rebelles, les repoussant jusqu’à Mpofi alors qu’ils avançaient vers Walikale-centre.
claim_sources.translation_en: At present, the situation in Walikale remains under FARDC control, despite the departure of part of the population. The army managed to slow the rebels' progress, pushing them back to Mpofi as they were advancing towards Walikale-centre.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Abaturage mu mujyi wa Uvira bemeje ko abarwanyi ba Wazalendo binjiye muri uyu mujyi mu gitondo cyo kuri iki cyumweru, nyuma nimugoroba abasirikare ba FARDC na bo binjira muri Uvira.
claim_sources.translation_en: Residents of Uvira city confirmed that Wazalendo fighters entered the city on the morning of this Sunday, and in the evening FARDC soldiers also entered Uvira.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Guverineri w'intara ya Kivu y'Epfo ahagenzurwa na leta, uri i Bujumbura mu Burundi aho yahungiye, yatangaje ko bafite amakuru ko hari abarwanyi ba M23 basigaye muri Uvira, ati: "Ni ukwitonda cyane", yasabye kandi abatura kwirinda urugomo rushingiye ku moko.
claim_sources.translation_en: The governor of South Kivu province in the area controlled by the government, who is in Bujumbura in Burundi where he took refuge, said they have information that some M23 fighters remain in Uvira, saying: "be very careful", and also asked residents to avoid ethnic-based violence.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Andi mashusho yagaragaje ibikorwa by'ubusahuzi byabaye nyuma yo 'kugenda' kw'abarwanyi ba M23.
claim_sources.translation_en: Other videos showed looting that took place after the M23 fighters 'left'.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: La Haute Cour militaire ouvre ce vendredi 25 septembre à Kinshasa les débats dans le dossier de deux généraux-majors poursuivis pour leur rôle présumé dans la perte de Bukavu lors de l’offensive de l’AFC/M23 au Sud-Kivu, en 2025.
claim_sources.translation_en: The High Military Court opens this Friday 25 September in Kinshasa the debates in the case of two major generals prosecuted for their alleged role in the loss of Bukavu during the AFC/M23 offensive in South Kivu, in 2025.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les prévenus sont Robert Anvul Yav, qui commandait alors la région militaire du Sud-Kivu, et André Ehonza Uketi, ancien responsable des opérations Sukola 2 Nord.
claim_sources.translation_en: The defendants are Robert Anvul Yav, who was then commanding the South Kivu military region, and André Ehonza Uketi, former head of the Sukola 2 Nord operations.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon le ministère public, Robert Anvul Yav aurait quitté Bukavu avant l’arrivée de l’AFC/M23 et n’aurait pas organisé de contre-offensive.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to the public prosecution, Robert Anvul Yav allegedly left Bukavu before the arrival of the AFC/M23 and allegedly did not organise a counter-offensive.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: La société civile dénonce plusieurs incidents meurtriers récents. Un citoyen a été battu à mort par des éléments Wazalendo. Par ailleurs, trois enfants âgés de 10 à 15 ans ont été atteints par des balles alors qu’ils quittaient l’école ; deux sont soignés et un est décédé sur place.
claim_sources.translation_en: Civil society denounces several recent deadly incidents. A citizen was beaten to death by Wazalendo elements. In addition, three children aged 10 to 15 were hit by bullets as they were leaving school; two are being treated and one died on the spot.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon Maître Isaac Kibunda, président de la société civile de Shabunda, ces combattants armés, censés appuyer les Forces armées de la RDC sur les lignes de front, se livrent à de graves exactions contre la population civile.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to Maître Isaac Kibunda, president of the civil society of Shabunda, these armed fighters, supposed to support the Armed Forces of the DRC on the front lines, are committing serious abuses against the civilian population.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Une vive tension a été observée dans la matinée de ce vendredi 10 octobre 2025 dans la ville de Kamituga, territoire de Mwenga (Sud-Kivu). En cause : une manifestation de la population exigeant le départ immédiat des combattants Wazalendo, accusés de multiples exactions dans la région.
claim_sources.translation_en: Strong tension was observed on the morning of this Friday 10 October 2025 in the town of Kamituga, Mwenga territory (South Kivu). The cause: a demonstration by the population demanding the immediate departure of the Wazalendo fighters, accused of multiple abuses in the region.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le bilan provisoire fait état de plusieurs victimes, parmi lesquelles des éléments de la PNC et un militaire FARDC, ainsi que des civils blessés. Des dégâts matériels importants ont également été enregistrés, notamment le pillage de magasins et de boutiques de téléphones » , a déclaré la société civile du territoire de Mwenga.
claim_sources.translation_en: The provisional toll reports several victims, among them PNC elements and a FARDC soldier, as well as wounded civilians. Significant material damage was also recorded, notably the pillage of shops and phone shops, said the civil society of Mwenga territory.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le leader d’un mouvement des Wazalendo, James Fyeka Adui, arrêté à Uvira le 5 septembre dernier, a été transféré à Kinshasa depuis quelques jours, selon plusieurs sources locales. James Fyeka Adui est accusé, d’après des sources concordantes, d’être impliqué dans le meurtre d’un civil survenu à Uvira au mois de mai 2026.
claim_sources.translation_en: The leader of a Wazalendo movement, James Fyeka Adui, arrested in Uvira on 5 September, was transferred to Kinshasa a few days ago, according to several local sources. James Fyeka Adui is accused, according to concordant sources, of being involved in the murder of a civilian that took place in Uvira in May 2026.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: James « Fyeka Adui » a été interpellé le 5 septembre 2026 par les services de sécurité à Uvira.
claim_sources.translation_en: James « Fyeka Adui » was arrested on 5 September 2026 by the security services in Uvira.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le 6 septembre, des informations contradictoires avaient circulé au sujet de sa libération. Certaines sources avaient annoncé qu’il avait été relâché après son audition, avant que d’autres informations ne signalent qu’il demeurait détenu.
claim_sources.translation_en: On 6 September, contradictory information had circulated about his release. Some sources had announced he had been released after his hearing, before other information indicated that he remained detained.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Dans ce contexte, Delphin Kalembe Ngomanzito a lancé un appel ferme au retrait des combattants Wazalendo des zones urbaines, tout en plaidant pour une cohabitation pacifique entre les communautés.
claim_sources.translation_en: In this context, Delphin Kalembe Ngomanzito issued a firm call for the withdrawal of Wazalendo fighters from urban areas, while pleading for peaceful coexistence between communities.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Dans une déclaration faite lundi 5 mai 2026 à Uvira, à l’issue d’un entretien avec Jacques Kongolo, conseiller du président de la République en charge des questions communautaires et identitaires dans l’est du pays, le responsable de l’unité spéciale des Wazalendo a exhorté les combattants présents en ville à rejoindre les lignes de front.
claim_sources.translation_en: In a statement made Monday 5 May 2026 in Uvira, after a meeting with Jacques Kongolo, adviser to the President of the Republic in charge of community and identity questions in the east of the country, the head of the Wazalendo special unit urged the fighters present in the city to join the front lines.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Un moratoire de trois jours a été accordé aux combattants pour quitter la ville et regagner les positions de combat. Seuls les commandants seront autorisés à circuler en zone urbaine, avec un effectif strictement limité. Toute infraction à ces directives exposera les contrevenants à des sanctions prévues par le règlement militaire.
claim_sources.translation_en: A three-day moratorium was granted to the fighters to leave the city and return to combat positions. Only commanders will be authorized to circulate in the urban area, with a strictly limited number. Any breach will expose offenders to the sanctions provided by military regulations.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: D’après plusieurs sources locales concordantes, les Wazalendo alliés aux FARDC, sous le commandement de Jams Mutayomba et Noah Maachano, auraient également repris ce lundi matin plusieurs positions jusque-là occupées par l’AFC/M23. Les localités de Nyakigano, Nkokwe et Kashovu, dans les environs de Kasake, sont notamment citées.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to several concordant local sources, the Wazalendo allied to the FARDC, under the command of Jams Mutayomba and Noah Maachano, also retook this Monday morning several positions previously occupied by the AFC/M23. The localities of Nyakigano, Nkokwe and Kashovu, in the surroundings of Kasake, are notably cited.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Des sources proches de l’armée congolaise affirment que les Wazalendo ont repris plusieurs villages dans le groupement de Ziralo, notamment Katale, Shanje et Chambombo, près de Lumbishi.
claim_sources.translation_en: Sources close to the Congolese army affirm that the Wazalendo have retaken several villages in the Ziralo grouping, notably Katale, Shanje and Chambombo, near Lumbishi.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Deux personnes ont trouvé la mort lors d’échanges de tirs survenus dans la nuit du dimanche 24 mai, dans la cité de Runingu, territoire d’Uvira (Sud-Kivu). Ces deux groupes Wazalendo, chacun dirigé par son propre commandant, seraient en désaccord autour d’une question encore non élucidée.
claim_sources.translation_en: Two people died during exchanges of fire in the night of Sunday 24 May, in the town of Runingu, Uvira territory (South Kivu). These two Wazalendo groups, each led by its own commander, are said to disagree over a question that is still unclear.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: À Goma, Désiré Kisuba Ngabo, jusque-là maire adjoint, prend la tête de la mairie de Goma, en remplacement de Julienne Katembo Ndalieni, nommée administrateur du territoire de Lubero. Cette nomination s’inscrit dans un vaste mouvement de permutation des cadres de l’administration publique, signé le 8 avril 2026 par le gouverneur du Nord-Kivu, Bahati Musanga Erasto.
claim_sources.translation_en: In Goma, Désiré Kisuba Ngabo, until then deputy mayor, takes the head of the Goma city hall, replacing Julienne Katembo Ndalieni, appointed administrator of Lubero territory. This appointment is part of a vast movement of rotation of public administration cadres, signed on 8 April 2026 by the North Kivu governor, Bahati Musanga Erasto.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: violences survenues le lundi dernier à Rumangabo, où des cas de pillage de biens ont été signalés, ainsi que des personnes blessées par balles sur la route reliant Goma à Rutshuru
claim_sources.translation_en: violence that occurred last Monday in Rumangabo, where cases of looting of property were reported, as well as people wounded by gunfire on the road linking Goma to Rutshuru

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le maire de la ville d’Uvira Kifara Kapenda Kiki qui est retourné jeudi s’est exprimé sur l’évolution de la situation sécuritaire, le retour de l’administration publique et la reprise progressive des activités.
claim_sources.translation_en: The mayor of the city of Uvira Kifara Kapenda Kiki, who returned on Thursday, spoke about the evolution of the security situation, the return of the public administration and the gradual resumption of activities.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ceux qui occupaient la ville ont décidé de quitter Uvira. Ils sont sortis mais ils ne sont pas loin, ils nous observent encore
claim_sources.translation_en: Those who occupied the city decided to leave Uvira. They went out but they are not far, they are still watching us

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Évoquant les exactions commises durant les affrontements, l’autorité urbaine a reconnu l’existence de dérives, tant au sein des forces régulières FARDC, que parmi les groupes d’autodéfense « wazalendo »
claim_sources.translation_en: Referring to the abuses committed during the fighting, the urban authority acknowledged the existence of excesses, both within the regular FARDC forces and among the 'wazalendo' self-defence groups

claim_sources.excerpt_original: We are designating Gustave Kubwayo, commander of an FDLR intelligence and special operations unit. The FDLR has carried out ethnic violence against civilians, used child soldiers, committed sexual violence, and launched cross-border attacks that continue to threaten Rwanda’s security.

We are also designating John Imani Nzenze, chief of intelligence for the Rwanda-backed M23, an armed group that has committed killings, serious human rights abuses, and attacks on civilians in eastern DRC.

La société civile Forces vives du groupement de Kaniola, dans le territoire de Walungu au Sud‑Kivu, dénonce les exactions et crimes de guerre commis dans cette zone par des rebelles de l’AFC/M23.
claim_sources.translation_en: The civil society group Forces vives of the Kaniola groupement, in Walungu territory in South Kivu, denounces abuses and war crimes committed in this area by AFC/M23 rebels.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Dans une lettre de dénonciation adressée au BCNUDH, à la MONUSCO ainsi qu’au CICR, elle accuse un officier de ce mouvement, Charles Kagigi, d’avoir instauré un régime de terreur dans la région.
claim_sources.translation_en: In a letter of denunciation addressed to the BCNUDH, to MONUSCO and to the ICRC, it accuses an officer of this movement, Charles Kagigi, of having established a regime of terror in the region.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le 24 septembre à Kaniola, trois civils revenant d’un match des Léopards ont été exécutés sommairement . Les victimes sont Birhalugirakulimushi Jules, Kashokwire Kulimushi Isaac et Bizimana Ciraza, précise la société civile.
claim_sources.translation_en: On 24 September in Kaniola, three civilians returning from a Leopards match were summarily executed. The victims are Birhalugirakulimushi Jules, Kashokwire Kulimushi Isaac and Bizimana Ciraza, the civil society says.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le 23 septembre à Kashanja, un taximan de Kalengera, Zigashane Mashali, a été extorqué de 30 000 francs congolais (13 USD) avant d’être tué par bastonnade.
claim_sources.translation_en: On 23 September in Kashanja, a taxi driver from Kalengera, Zigashane Mashali, was extorted of 30 000 Congolese francs (13 USD) before being beaten to death.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Elle rapporte également que le colonel Kagigi, pointé du doigt dans ces crimes, a publiquement juré de « raser le groupement de Kaniola ».
claim_sources.translation_en: It also reports that Colonel Kagigi, singled out in these crimes, publicly swore to “raze the Kaniola groupement”.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Depuis samedi, des éléments de l’AFC/M23 ont pris le contrôle de Ngululu, avant de s'emparer du centre commercial de Humura le dimanche.
claim_sources.translation_en: Since Saturday, AFC/M23 elements have taken control of Ngululu, before seizing the commercial centre of Humura on Sunday.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: La situation sécuritaire demeure tendue dans plusieurs zones des territoires de Masisi et de Walikale, au Nord-Kivu, sur fond d’intensification des combats entre les rebelles de l’AFC/M23, les FARDC et les wazalendo.
claim_sources.translation_en: The security situation remains tense in several areas of the Masisi and Walikale territories, in North Kivu, amid intensifying fighting between AFC/M23 rebels, the FARDC and the wazalendo.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: AFC/M23-occupied territories were divided into three “defense zones”, led respectively by “General” Baudoin Ngaruye (first zone, covering Nyiragongo, Rutshuru and Lubero territories), “Brigadier-General” Justin Gacheri Musanga (second zone, covering Masisi and Walikale) and “General” Byamungu (third zone, covering South Kivu).

On 8 September, “Brigadier General” Baudoin Ngaruye, commander of AFC/M23’s ‘First Defense Zone’ covering the Goma–Rutshuru–Kanyabayonga–Kirumba axis, declared in Kirumba that AFC/M23 intended to resume hostilities aimed at capturing Butembo and Kisangani.

After AFC/M23 reinforcements led by “Lieutenant-Colonel” Japhet Gakufe reached Minembwe in March 2025 (S/2025/446, para. 178), a second reinforcement, led by “Lieutenant -Colonel” Oscar Ndabagaza, was blocked as it attempted to cross hostile areas before finally reaching Mikenge at the end of August.

AFC/M23 confiscated identification documents, including voter cards and land titles of the refugees, and publicly burned them220 in the presence of AFC/M23 officials – including AFC/M23 spokesperson Oscar Balinda, military spokesperson Willy Ngoma, and Goma’s military commander, “Colonel” Nsanze Nzamuye Jimmy (S/2024/432, annex 24), and in the presence of local media.221
Overall military command of AFC/M23 remained with “General” Makenga, although his position became increasingly contested within the movement and by Rwanda (see annex 23).

FARDC drone operations also targeted AFC/M23 leadership. On 14 January 2026, a drone strike targeted the “Blue Cat” bar-restaurant in the Kalundu district of Uvira, during a meeting of senior AFC/M23 and RDF officers, causing significant casualties.
On 7 March 2026, a strike in Mushaki targeted a house associated with a high-ranking AFC/M23 commander.

Igitero cy'indege nto y'intambara itajyamo umupilote (drone) cyishe uwari umuvugizi wa gisirikare w'umutwe w'inyeshyamba wa AFC/M23, Lt Col Willy Ngoma, mu rukerera rwo ku wa kabiri, cyiciwemo abantu nibura icyenda ariko gihushaho gato umukuru wa gisirikare w'uwo mutwe, Jenerali (Gen) Sultani Makenga, wahunze nta nkomyi, nkuko abantu bane babibwiye ibiro ntaramakuru Reuters.
claim_sources.translation_en: The drone attack that killed the former military spokesperson of the AFC/M23 rebel group, Lt Col Willy Ngoma, at dawn on Tuesday, killing at least nine people but narrowly missing the group's military chief, General Sultani Makenga, who escaped unharmed, as four people told the Reuters news agency.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Human Rights Watch research and the United Nations indicate that the M23’s Léon Kanyamibwa and Bertin Masozera directed military training with support from other M23 officers, and that Rwandan military trainers operated in both Rumangabo and Tshanzu.

One M23 commander, “Captain Gaston,” was named by a dozen former detainees as having been particularly brutal in his treatment of recruits. [96] Detainees often referred to Gaston by the nickname Longangi,

Senior AFC/M23 leaders, including AFC leader Corneille Nangaa Yobeluo, M23 military commander Maj. Gen. Le coordonnateur militaire de l’Alliance Fleuve Congo/Mouvement du 23 mars (AFC/M23) et chef d’état-major de l’Armée révolutionnaire congolaise (ARC), le général-major Sultani Makenga, a appelé lundi 29 décembre
claim_sources.translation_en: The military coordinator of the Alliance Fleuve Congo/Mouvement du 23 mars (AFC/M23) and chief of staff of the Armée révolutionnaire congolaise (ARC), General-Major Sultani Makenga, called on Monday 29 December

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Il s’exprimait à l’occasion d’un échange de vœux réunissant les hauts cadres de l’AFC/M23 à Goma
claim_sources.translation_en: He was speaking at an exchange of wishes bringing together the senior cadres of the AFC/M23 in Goma

claim_sources.excerpt_original: « Soyez en état de guerre, cette guerre nous allons la gagner » , a déclaré Sultani Makenga
claim_sources.translation_en: 'Be in a state of war, we are going to win this war', said Sultani Makenga

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Après vérification auprès de plusieurs sources locales et de mouvements Wazalendo, nous sommes en mesure d’apporter un démenti clair : le général Bernard Byamungu est vivant. L’homme décédé dans cette attaque n’est pas le cadre militaire de l’AFC/M23, mais un commandant Wazalendo portant le même nom : le colonel Byamungu Ruduga Abdallah, actif dans les hauts plateaux d’Uvira.
claim_sources.translation_en: After checking with several local sources and Wazalendo movements, we are able to provide a clear denial: General Bernard Byamungu is alive. The man who died in this attack is not the AFC/M23 military cadre, but a Wazalendo commander bearing the same name: colonel Byamungu Ruduga Abdallah, active in the high plateaux of Uvira.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le général de brigade François KAMANZI, commandant des opérations de la 12ᵉ Région militaire, au Kongo-Central, a rejoint le mouvement politico-militaire Front pour la Refondation de la Nation (FRN), dirigé par Joseph KABILA.
claim_sources.translation_en: Brigadier general François KAMANZI, commander of operations of the 12th Military Region, in Kongo-Central, has joined the politico-military movement Front pour la Refondation de la Nation (FRN), led by Joseph KABILA.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: a rejoint les rangs des Lions de Sarambwe, au sein de l’Armée révolutionnaire congolaise (ARC) », a déclaré Lawrence Kanyuka, porte-parole du FRN.
claim_sources.translation_en: has joined the ranks of the Lions de Sarambwe, within the Armée révolutionnaire congolaise (ARC)," said Lawrence Kanyuka, spokesperson of the FRN.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: L’état-major de la 34ᵉ région militaire a annoncé avoir interpellé à Walikale, deux commandants des wazalendo accusés d’être impliqués dans des actes d’indiscipline et des violences ayant gravement affecté les populations civiles. Il s’agit des généraux autoproclamés Kirikicho Mirimba, alias Mwana Mayi, du mouvement COPACO (Coalition des Patriotes au Congo), et Musubao Kalimba, alias Kasilasi.
claim_sources.translation_en: The staff of the 34th military region announced that it had detained, at Walikale, two Wazalendo commanders accused of involvement in acts of indiscipline and violence that gravely affected civilian populations. They are self-proclaimed generals Kirikicho Mirimba, alias Mwana Mayi, of the COPACO movement (Coalition of Patriots in Congo), and Musubao Kalimba, alias Kasilasi.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les violents combats survenus du 15 au 18 février 2026 dans les groupements de Tushunguti et Zirhalo, situés dans la chefferie de Buhavu, en territoire de Kalehe au Sud-Kivu sont les plus récents. Selon l’armée, ces affrontements ont fait 14 morts parmi les civils, 7 blessés graves et 7 femmes victimes de viol
claim_sources.translation_en: The violent fighting of 15 to 18 February 2026 in the groupements of Tushunguti and Zirhalo, located in the Buhavu chiefdom, in Kalehe territory in South Kivu, is the most recent. According to the army, these clashes left 14 civilians dead, 7 seriously wounded and 7 women victims of rape

claim_sources.excerpt_original: D’après les autorités militaires, les deux commandants se livrent depuis près de 17 mois à des affrontements fratricides.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to the military authorities, the two commanders have been engaged for nearly 17 months in fratricidal clashes.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le cas le plus flagrant est celui des derniers affrontements du 15 au 18 Fev 26, dans les groupements de Tushunguti et Zirhalo, chefferie de Buhavu, territoire de Kalehe dont le bilan est de 14 paisibles citoyens tués, 7 autres grièvement blessés, 07 femmes violées
claim_sources.translation_en: The most flagrant case is that of the latest clashes of 15 to 18 Feb 26, in the groupements of Tushunguti and Zirhalo, Buhavu chiefdom, Kalehe territory, the toll of which is 14 peaceful citizens killed, 7 others seriously wounded, 07 women raped

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Cinquante-quatre militaires du 3415e régiment des Forces armées de la République démocratique du Congo (FARDC) comparaissent depuis le lundi 26 octobre devant le tribunal militaire de garnison de Goma, siégeant en audience foraine à Walikale, au Nord-Kivu. Ils sont notamment poursuivis pour assassinat, abandon de poste, dissipation de munitions de guerre et refus d’obéissance.
claim_sources.translation_en: Fifty-four soldiers of the 3415th regiment of the Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (FARDC) have been appearing since Monday 26 October before the Goma garrison military tribunal, sitting in a circuit hearing at Walikale, in North Kivu. They are notably prosecuted for murder, abandonment of post, dissipation of war munitions and refusal to obey.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon le major Dieudonné Kasereka, chargé de communication de la 34e Région militaire, les prévenus ont été interpellés le 20 octobre à la suite d’incidents survenus à Ntoto, dans le groupement de Waloa Loanda, à la frontière avec le territoire de Masisi. Ces incidents ont fait deux morts, un militaire et un civil
claim_sources.translation_en: According to major Dieudonné Kasereka, communication officer of the 34th Military Region, the defendants were arrested on 20 October following incidents at Ntoto, in the Waloa Loanda groupement, on the border with Masisi territory. These incidents left two dead, a soldier and a civilian

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les faits se seraient produits lors d’une altercation entre les militaires et des éléments de la Police militaire qui tentaient de les empêcher de quitter sans autorisation la zone de combat.
claim_sources.translation_en: The facts allegedly occurred during an altercation between the soldiers and elements of the Military Police who were trying to prevent them from leaving the combat zone without authorisation.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Un autre groupe de dix militaires du même régiment avait été condamné le 1er septembre dernier à des peines allant de dix mois de prison à des peines de servitude pénale principale, pour avoir ouvert le feu sur leur commandant de compagnie.
claim_sources.translation_en: Another group of ten soldiers of the same regiment had been convicted on 1 September last to sentences ranging from ten months in prison to principal penal servitude, for opening fire on their company commander.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les trois condamnés sont tous issus de la 21ᵉ brigade de défense principale des FARDC. Le tribunal les a reconnus coupables d'avoir agressé sexuellement une femme de 28 ans dans le village de Kimbulu. Les faits se sont déroulés au cours de la nuit de dimanche à lundi dernier.
claim_sources.translation_en: The three convicted men are all from the 21st principal defence brigade of the FARDC. The court found them guilty of having sexually assaulted a 28-year-old woman in the village of Kimbulu. The facts took place during the night from Sunday to last Monday.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les trois militaires sont condamnés au paiement solidaire de 10 000 dollars américains en faveur de la victime, en réparation des préjudices subis.
claim_sources.translation_en: The three soldiers are ordered to pay jointly 10,000 US dollars to the victim, in reparation for the harm suffered.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les trois condamnés, tous issus de la 21ᵉ brigade de défense principale des FARDC, ont été reconnus coupables d’avoir agressé sexuellement une femme de 28 ans.
claim_sources.translation_en: The three convicts, all from the 21st principal defence brigade of the FARDC, were found guilty of having sexually assaulted a 28-year-old woman.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: un autre militaire a été condamné à sept ans de servitude pénale pour le viol d’une adolescente âgée de 15 ans. Selon le tribunal, les faits se sont déroulés au village de Kaviseghe. Le militaire aurait eu à plusieurs reprises des rapports sexuels avec l’adolescente dans sa chambre.
claim_sources.translation_en: another soldier was sentenced to seven years of penal servitude for the rape of a 15-year-old adolescent. According to the court, the facts took place in the village of Kaviseghe. The soldier allegedly had sexual relations with the adolescent several times in his room.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon le tribunal, les faits se sont déroulés au village de Kaviseghe.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to the court, the facts took place in the village of Kaviseghe.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Dans la première affaire, un militaire des FARDC a été reconnu coupable du meurtre de trois personnes : sa concubine, leur enfant et un autre militaire. Les faits remontent au 12 août, au village de Katundu. Selon les éléments retenus par le tribunal, le militaire avait ouvert le feu à bout portant sur sa concubine dans un contexte de jalousie.
claim_sources.translation_en: In the first case, a FARDC soldier was found guilty of the murder of three people: his concubine, their child and another soldier. The facts date back to 12 August, in the village of Katundu. According to the elements retained by the court, the soldier had opened fire at point-blank range on his concubine in a context of jealousy.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Cet appel intervient après la condamnation à la peine de mort, mercredi 6 mai, d’un membre du mouvement Wazalendo dénommé « Far West ».
claim_sources.translation_en: This call comes after the death sentence, on Wednesday 6 May, of a member of the Wazalendo movement called « Far West ».

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ce dernier a été reconnu coupable par le tribunal militaire de garnison de Butembo du meurtre d’un motard, ainsi que du viol suivi du meurtre de sa cliente, des faits survenus la semaine dernière à Kimbulu, dans le territoire de Lubero.
claim_sources.translation_en: The latter was found guilty by the Butembo garrison military tribunal of the murder of a motorcyclist, as well as of the rape followed by the murder of his customer, facts which occurred last week at Kimbulu, in Lubero territory.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Elle demande également la suppression pure et simple du mouvement « Far West », qu’elle accuse d’être impliqué dans de graves violations des droits humains.
claim_sources.translation_en: It also demands the outright abolition of the « Far West » movement, which it accuses of being involved in serious human rights violations.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le jugement est tombé à l'issue d'une audience foraine tenue à Kimbulu, dans le territoire de Lubero.
claim_sources.translation_en: The judgment was handed down at the end of a circuit hearing held at Kimbulu, in Lubero territory.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le tribunal a précisé que cette dernière avait subi un viol avant d'être froidement exécutée.
claim_sources.translation_en: The court specified that the latter had been raped before being coldly executed.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon le tribunal, la jeune femme avait d’abord été violée avant d’être exécutée. En plus de la peine capitale, le tribunal a décidé d’interdire le fonctionnement du groupe de miliciens Far West sur toute l’étendue du territoire de Lubero.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to the court, the young woman had first been raped before being executed. In addition to the death penalty, the court decided to ban the operation of the Far West militia group throughout Lubero territory.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les affrontements entre les rebelles du Front pour la Refondation de la Nation (FRN) et les Forces armées de la République démocratique du Congo (FARDC), appuyées par les Wazalendo, se poursuivent pour la troisième journée consécutive, ce dimanche 18 octobre 2026, à Kibati, dans le groupement Luberike, en territoire de Walikale, au Nord-Kivu.
claim_sources.translation_en: The clashes between the rebels of the Front for the Refoundation of the Nation (FRN) and the FARDC, supported by the Wazalendo, continue for the third consecutive day, this Sunday 18 October 2026, at Kibati, in the Luberike groupement, in Walikale territory, in North Kivu.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les FARDC et les Wazalendo ont lancé une offensive contre les positions du FRN dans cette zone, dans le but de déloger les rebelles.
claim_sources.translation_en: The FARDC and the Wazalendo launched an offensive against the FRN positions in this area, with the aim of dislodging the rebels.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Depuis environ deux ans, Kibati constitue l’un des principaux foyers de confrontation entre le FRN et les forces gouvernementales appuyées par les Wazalendo dans cette partie du territoire de Walikale.
claim_sources.translation_en: For about two years, Kibati has been one of the main foci of confrontation between the FRN and the government forces supported by the Wazalendo in this part of Walikale territory.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Deux commandants des rebelles de l'AFC/M23 qui étaient déployés à Misinga, dans le groupement Ikobo (territoire de Walikale), au Nord-Kivu ont été enlevés par les wazalendo la nuit de dimanche à lundi 30 juin, a appris ACTUALITE.CD des sources locales. Ces dernières ne donnent pas l’identité de ces deux rebelles kidnappés.
claim_sources.translation_en: Two commanders of the AFC/M23 rebels who were deployed at Misinga, in the Ikobo groupement (Walikale territory), in North Kivu, were kidnapped by the wazalendo in the night from Sunday to Monday 30 June, ACTUALITE.CD learned from local sources. These sources do not give the identity of the two kidnapped rebels.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ce lundi, les rebelles de l'AFC/M23 ont lancé des recherches dans la forêt de Kirumburumbu et Muuli afin de retrouver les auteurs du kidnapping de leurs commandants mais en vain. Ils se sont rabattus sur les cultivateurs qui étaient dans leurs champs. Ils les ont contraints de quitter les champs pour qu'ils poursuivent les recherches.
claim_sources.translation_en: This Monday, the AFC/M23 rebels launched searches in the forest of Kirumburumbu and Muuli to find the authors of the kidnapping of their commanders, but in vain. They fell back on the farmers who were in their fields. They forced them to leave the fields so that they would continue the searches.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon les premières informations, les Wazalendo, conduits par le général autoproclamé Ignace Dunia Sauli, ont lancé une attaque contre les positions des éléments M23, entraînant un échange de tirs d’armes lourdes. Des combats avaient déjà été enregistrés dimanche 29 juin à Luhonga.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to the first information, the Wazalendo, led by self-proclaimed general Ignace Dunia Sauli, launched an attack against the M23 elements' positions, causing an exchange of heavy-weapon fire. Fighting had already been recorded on Sunday 29 June at Luhonga.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Au moins neuf civils ont été tués et plusieurs autres grièvement blessés dans une incursion armée des présumés miliciens Wazalendo CMC-FDP dans le groupement de Bishusha en territoire de Rutshuru dans la province du Nord-Kivu, la nuit du lundi au mardi 28 octobre 2025.
claim_sources.translation_en: At least nine civilians were killed and several others seriously wounded in an armed incursion by presumed Wazalendo CMC-FDP militiamen in the Bishusha groupement in Rutshuru territory in North Kivu province, in the night from Monday to Tuesday 28 October 2025.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon nos sources sanitaires à Bishusha Centre, sous couvert d’anonymat, c’est autour de 19 h que ces hommes, armés, ont menées une incursion dans cette agglomération, ciblant en grande partie des opérateurs économiques de la région, qui figurent en nombre parmi les victimes. Lors de l’attaque, plusieurs biens et boutiques des habitants ont été pillés.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to our health sources in Bishusha Centre, speaking anonymously, it was around 7 pm that these armed men carried out an incursion into this agglomeration, targeting largely economic operators of the area, who are among the victims. During the attack, several goods and shops of the inhabitants were looted.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Parmi les blessés, on compte trois enfants, dont une fillette de 5 ans, ainsi qu’un homme dont l’état est critique.
claim_sources.translation_en: Among the wounded are three children, including a 5-year-old girl, as well as a man whose condition is critical.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: L’administrateur du territoire de Rutshuru sous le FRN accuse les Wazalendo du CMC d’être à l’origine de cette attaque qui a coûté la vie à ces paisibles civils.
claim_sources.translation_en: The administrator of Rutshuru territory under the FRN accuses the Wazalendo of the CMC of being behind this attack that cost the lives of these peaceful civilians.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: « Dans la nuit du 25 au 26 octobre, vers 1 h 30, l’agglomération de Kabizo, dans le groupement de Tongo, chefferie de Bwito, a encore une fois été victime d’une attaque meurtrière menée par les FDLR, en compagnie des Nyatura CMC FDP de Gashegu Héritier et Mbitezi.
claim_sources.translation_en: In the night of 25 to 26 October, around 1:30, the agglomeration of Kabizo, in the Tongo groupement, Bwito chiefdom, was once again the victim of a deadly attack carried out by the FDLR, together with the Nyatura CMC FDP of Gashegu Héritier and Mbitezi.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Cette attaque a visé les populations civiles et cinq personnes ont été tuées », a déclaré Euphrem Kabasha, administrateur du territoire de Rutshuru.
claim_sources.translation_en: This attack targeted the civilian populations and five people were killed, declared Euphrem Kabasha, administrator of Rutshuru territory.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: D’après des sources locales, les wazalendo ont tendu une embuscade à un convoi des rebelles qui se dirigeait vers Kabizo pour y installer un nouveau commandant. Le bilan provisoire de cette attaque fait état de trois combattants rebelles tués, selon des sources dans la zone.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to local sources, the wazalendo ambushed a convoy of the rebels that was heading to Kabizo to install a new commander. The provisional toll of this attack is three rebel fighters killed, according to sources in the area.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le porte-parole de la synergie des Wazalendo Front Nord, John Mangaiko, avait déclaré le 6 janvier 2026 à Butembo que ce dernier avait été tué lors d’une opération armée et non dans un assassinat ciblé.
claim_sources.translation_en: The spokesperson of the Wazalendo synergy Front Nord, John Mangaiko, had declared on 6 January 2026 in Butembo that the latter had been killed during an armed operation and not in a targeted assassination.

claim_sources.translation_en: According to him, Tango Fort was an armed fighter involved in attacks against other Wazalendo and in acts of insecurity against the population.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le mouvement politico-militaire Bana Bateseka, membre des Wazalendo Front Grand-Nord, a annoncé dans une vidéo publiée le 4 mars 2026 dans l’agglomération de Burondo, en territoire de Lubero, la dissolution du groupe armé Tango Fort.
claim_sources.translation_en: The political-military movement Bana Bateseka, a member of the Wazalendo Front Grand-Nord, announced in a video published on 4 March 2026 in the agglomeration of Burondo, in Lubero territory, the dissolution of the armed group Tango Fort.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon cette vidéo, le colonel Thembo, commandant adjoint du groupe Tango Fort, a annoncé son ralliement à l’idéologie de Bana Bateseka avec l’ensemble de ses combattants.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to this video, Colonel Thembo, deputy commander of the Tango Fort group, announced his rallying to the ideology of Bana Bateseka with all his fighters.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le général autoproclamé Mutayomba, l’un des commandants des Wazalendo, ces milices alliées aux FARDC, a été blessé le vendredi 21 mai 2026 à Luke, dans le territoire de Masisi.
claim_sources.translation_en: Self-proclaimed general Mutayomba, one of the Wazalendo commanders, these militias allied to the FARDC, was wounded on Friday 21 May 2026 at Luke, in Masisi territory.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon une source administrative et sécuritaire congolaise à Kivu Morning Post , le général autoproclamé Mutayomba, qui figure parmi les commandants des Wazalendo sur l’axe Katoyi, a été blessé lors des combats contre les combattants de l’AFC-M23.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to a Congolese administrative and security source to Kivu Morning Post, self-proclaimed general Mutayomba, who is among the Wazalendo commanders on the Katoyi axis, was wounded during fighting against the AFC-M23 fighters.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: « Il a été légèrement blessé lors des combats de vendredi à Luke. Il a été évacué d’urgence par hélicoptère vers Beni » , a déclaré une source administrative du territoire de Masisi. Une information confirmée par une source militaire des FARDC, qui évoque toutefois une blessure grave.
claim_sources.translation_en: 'He was lightly wounded during Friday's fighting at Luke. He was evacuated urgently by helicopter to Beni', said an administrative source of Masisi territory. Information confirmed by a FARDC military source, who however speaks of a serious injury.

claim_sources.translation_en: Twiwraneho was structured and militarised by Michel Rukunda, alias Makanika, a FARDC deserter who had been deputy commander at Walikale. He was killed in a Congolese army drone strike in Fizi, in February 2025.

D’après ce même communiqué, le bilan des attaques dans le secteur de Bapere et la chefferie de Baswagha est de 89 civils tués, dont au moins 20 femmes et un nombre encore indéterminé d'enfants.
claim_sources.translation_en: In a press release made public this Friday 21 November 2025, the United Nations mission (MONUSCO) firmly condemned the deadly attacks by the armed group Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) between 13 and 19 November 2025 in several localities of Lubero territory, in North Kivu. According to the same release, the toll of the attacks in the Bapere sector and the Baswagha chiefdom is 89 civilians killed, including at least 20 women and an as yet undetermined number of children.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Dans la localité de Byambwe(à 60 km à l'ouest de Lubero), au moins 17 civils, dont des femmes internées dans la maternité, ont été tués dans un centre de santé de l'Église catholique. Au cours de l'attaque, quatre pavillons abritant des malades ont été incendiés.
claim_sources.translation_en: In the locality of Byambwe (60 km west of Lubero), at least 17 civilians, including women admitted to the maternity ward, were killed in a Catholic Church health centre. During the attack, four pavilions housing patients were burned.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: La même source indique que les localités de Mabiango, Tunarudi, Sambalysa, Thucha et Butsili ont également été la cible d'exactions comprenant des enlèvements, des pillages de médicaments, des incendies de maisons

claim_sources.translation_en: The Biena health zone confirms the attack. claim_sources.translation_en: the spokesperson of the Burundian army neither confirmed nor denied the facts, he merely stressed that 'the number of prisoners or dead is a military secret'.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: On Thursday, January 23, 2025, the Kamenge military hospital in the north of the commercial city of Bujumbura counted 81 Burundian soldiers who were injured during the fighting with the M23 on the Congolese territory and 19 dead – a situation that evolves every day, according to our sources.
On Thursday, the Burundian army buried Lieutenant Patience Gapara, who was recently killed in the fighting with the M23 in the province of North Kivu in eastern Congo.
According to our estimates, the small East African nation has between 7,500 and 9,000 soldiers on the Congolese soil.
On May 15, 2026, several boats carrying Burundian soldiers landed in Ruzizi, near the port of Kalundu in Uvira, before deploying troops to Bijombo (Uvira territory) and Itombwe (Mwenga territory).
The deployment is estimated at approximately two battalions, aiming to rebalance the power dynamics in the Minembwe area and control movement between Rurambo, Bijombo, and Minembwe.

These operations are in addition to those already conducted in April 2026 in several strategic locations, including Point Zero, Mulima, Mikenge, Kakenge, Kalingi, and Bidegu, as part of joint operations with the FARDC and the Wazalendo militias supported by Kinshasa.

The Burundi National Defense Force (FDNB) is accused by several local and international organizations of human rights violations in the Minembwe area, including cases of road blockades, destruction of property, and looting targeting civilians.

FDNB spokesperson Brigadier General Gaspard Baratuza acknowledged that movement restrictions could be imposed on individuals considered “collaborators with the enemy,” particularly in areas where trade with local markets is observed.

Urubuga SOS Medias rwatangaje ko imodoka zitwaye abasirikare b’u Burundi zagaragaye muri santere ya Kitoga, Muhuzi no mu ishyamba rya Itombwe, kandi ko bongerewe mu bindi bice birimo Minembwe, Mikalati, Kipupu na Point Zero muri Fizi.
claim_sources.translation_en: The SOS Medias website reported that vehicles carrying Burundian soldiers were seen in the centre of Kitoga, Muhuzi and in the Itombwe forest, and that they were reinforced in other areas including Minembwe, Mikalati, Kipupu and Point Zero in Fizi.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ubu muri Kivu y’Amajyepfo hari izigera ku bihumbi 20, ziganje mu bice byo muri Uvira na Fizi.
claim_sources.translation_en: Now in South Kivu there are about 20 thousand, predominating in the Uvira and Fizi areas.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Spokesperson Jeremy Laurence said OHCHR has documented summary executions of at least 12 people by the M23 between 26 and 28 January.

Meanwhile, in other areas under M23 control in South Kivu, such as Minova, fighters have occupied schools and hospitals, forced IDPs out of camps and subjected the civilian population to forced conscription and forced labour.

The Office has also documented cases of conflict-related sexual violence by the army and allied Wazalendo fighters in Kalehe territory, located in South Kivu. It is also verifying reports that 52 women were raped by Congolese troops in South Kivu, including alleged reports of gangrape.
Additionally, DRC officials report that at least 165 women were raped by male inmates during the mass prison break from Goma’s Muzenze prison on 27 January , as M23 began its assault on the town.
Selon les autorités judiciaires, lors de l'évasion massive de la prison de Munzenze à Goma le 27 janvier au moins 165 prisonnières ont été violées
claim_sources.translation_en: According to the judicial authorities, during the mass escape from Munzenze prison in Goma on 27 January at least 165 women prisoners were raped

claim_sources.excerpt_original: At least 165 women were raped by male inmates after a mass breakout from a prison in the Democratic Republic of Congo , the United Nations said, citing officials in the central African nation.

“Our office has confirmed cases of summary execution of children by M23 after they entered the city of Bukavu last week. We are also aware that children were in possession of weapons,” said OHCHR spokesperson Ravina Shamdasani.

The OHCHR spokesperson also condemned attacks on hospitals and humanitarian warehouses as well as threats against the judiciary, directly linked to the rapid advance of the M23 fighters across North Kivu and South Kivu.
Over 70 (or 6%) of the health facilities in North Kivu have been affected, with some completely destroyed and others struggling to restart operations.
Medical supplies and equipment worth millions of dollars have also been looted from storage facilities in Goma, leaving thousands of women and girls without access to quality medical care.
Other worrying developments stemming from the crisis include break-outs from Kabare and Bukavu central prisons on 14 February, OHCHR’s Ms. Shamdasani noted.

Ms. Byun said that in South Kivu, more than half of the aid groups providing critical support to survivors of sexual violence “report being unable to reach those in need due to insecurity and continuous displacement”.
Since the beginning of the year, over 400,000 people–predominantly women and children–have been displaced in North and South Kivu, exacerbating their vulnerability to exploitation and violence.

Meanwhile, in North Kivu, “the destruction of health facilities, including mortuaries, and overcrowded hospitals increase the risk of spreading infectious diseases, including cholera, malaria, and measles,” she said.
Over 70 (or 6%) of the health facilities in North Kivu have been affected, with some completely destroyed and others struggling to restart operations.
Hospitals and morgues are overwhelmed.
The threat of infectious diseases has multiplied. Cholera, malaria, measles, meningitis, mpox and tuberculosis are among the infectious threats in the area.

The World Health Organization ( WHO ) and partners conducted an assessment with the Government over the past five days. They report that 700 people have been killed and 2,800 injured are receiving treatment in health facilities

Dans un communiqué publié lundi 24 novembre, le Bureau conjoint des Nations unies aux droits de l’homme (BCNUDH) dit avoir documenté 2.767 violations et atteintes aux droits de l’homme et violations du droit international humanitaire sur l’ensemble du territoire de la RDC au cours du premier semestre de l’année 2025.
claim_sources.translation_en: in a statement published Monday 24 November, the joint human rights office (BCNUDH) says it documented 2.767 human rights violations and abuses and violations of international humanitarian law across the whole territory of the DRC during the first half of the year

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le rapport du BCNUDH accuse aussi les agents de l’Etat d’avoir été responsables des violences sexuelles à l’encontre de 70 victimes, notamment les FARDC (69 victimes) et des agents de la PNC (une victime).
claim_sources.translation_en: the BCNUDH report also accuses State agents of being responsible for sexual violence against 70 victims, notably the FARDC (69 victims) and PNC agents (one victim).

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon les données collectées par le Bureau conjoint des Nations Unies pour les droits de l’homme en République démocratique du Congo (BCNUDH), 887 cas de violences sexuelles liées au conflit ont été documentés l’année passée, affectant 1534 victimes, dont une majorité écrasante de femmes (854) et de filles (672).
claim_sources.translation_en: according to data collected by the joint human rights office in the DRC (BCNUDH), 887 cases of conflict-related sexual violence were documented last year, affecting 1534 victims, including an overwhelming majority of women (854) and girls (672).

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les provinces orientales du Nord-Kivu et du Sud-Kivu concentrent à elles seules près de 80 % des victimes documentées
claim_sources.translation_en: The eastern provinces of North Kivu and South Kivu alone account for close to 80% of the documented victims

claim_sources.excerpt_original: D’après le rapport, les groupes armés sont responsables de 75 % des victimes. Le Mouvement du 23 mars (M23) arrive en tête avec 439 victimes, suivi des groupes Wazalendo,
claim_sources.translation_en: according to the report, armed groups are responsible for 75% of victims. The M23 comes first with 439 victims, followed by the Wazalendo groups,

claim_sources.excerpt_original: L’ONU note également avec préoccupation l’implication d’acteurs étatiques, notamment des membres des Forces armées de la RDC (FARDC), de la Police nationale congolaise et de l’Agence nationale de renseignement, dans 19 % des cas documentés.
claim_sources.translation_en: the UN also notes with concern the involvement of State actors, notably members of the FARDC, the Police nationale congolaise and the Agence nationale de renseignement, in 19% of documented cases.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Si 70 % des victimes ont accès à des soins médicaux d’urgence, moins de 2 % bénéficient d’une prise en charge holistique, comprenant un accompagnement juridique, psychologique et social.
claim_sources.translation_en: While 70% of victims have access to emergency medical care, fewer than 2% receive holistic care, including legal, psychological and social support.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Autre sujet d’inquiétude retenu dans ce rapport, il y a des violences sexuelles liées aux conflits. Le BCNUDH a recensé 61 victimes en janvier, soit une baisse de 59 % par rapport à décembre 2025,
claim_sources.translation_en: another subject of concern in the report is conflict-related sexual violence. The BCNUDH recorded 61 victims in January, a drop of 59% compared with December 2025,

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le Bureau note également un resserrement de l’espace civique : 42 acteurs politiques étaient encore détenus en janvier, dans un contexte marqué par des arrestations jugées arbitraires.
claim_sources.translation_en: the Office also notes a narrowing of civic space: 42 political actors were still detained in January, in a context marked by arrests deemed arbitrary.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le BCNUDH a également documenté 46 cas de violences sexuelles liées aux conflits en juin, contre 40 en mai. Ces faits ont concerné 73 victimes : 56 femmes, 15 filles et 2 hommes. Le Nord-Kivu concentre 73 % des victimes, soit 52 personnes, devant le Sud-Kivu avec 12 victimes et l’Ituri avec 8.
