La Première ministre, Judith Suminwa a présidé ce mercredi 8 juillet 2026 à New York, aux États-Unis d’Amérique, la 10190e séance du Conseil de sécurité des Nations unies
claim_sources.translation_en: The Prime Minister, Judith Suminwa, chaired on Wednesday 8 July 2026 in New York, in the United States of America, the 10190th meeting of the Security Council of the United Nations

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Poursuivant son intervention, la cheffe du gouvernement congolais a dénoncé les violences sexuelles commises dans l’Est de la République démocratique du Congo, qu’elle a attribuées aux groupes armés et aux forces étrangères dont le Rwanda impliquées dans le conflit.
claim_sources.translation_en: Continuing her intervention, the head of the Congolese government denounced the sexual violence committed in the East of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, which she attributed to the armed groups and foreign forces including Rwanda involved in the conflict.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Dans certaines zones affectées par les groupes armés et sous occupation par des forces étrangères, dont le Rwanda, ces violences sont liées aux déplacements forcés, aux économies illicites et aux logiques de prédation qui alimentent la guerre.
claim_sources.translation_en: In certain zones affected by armed groups and under occupation by foreign forces, including Rwanda, these violences are linked to forced displacement, illicit economies and the logic of predation that fuel the war.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: l’ambassadrice Jocelyne Kabengele Lukundulu, l’a indiqué lundi 26 octobre lors de la 10 251e séance du Conseil de sécurité avec comme thème « Les enfants et les conflits ». La diplomate congolaise a présenté les avancées de son pays en matière de protection des enfants et appelé à combattre l’impunité ainsi qu’à intégrer cette dimension dans les accords de paix.
claim_sources.translation_en: the ambassador Jocelyne Kabengele Lukundulu said so on Monday 26 October at the 10 251st meeting of the Security Council on the theme "Children and conflicts". The Congolese diplomat presented her country's progress in child protection and called for combating impunity and for integrating this dimension into peace agreements.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Sa représentante permanente adjointe auprès des Nations Unies, l’ambassadrice Jocelyne Kabengele Lukundulu, l’a indiqué lundi 26 octobre lors de la 10 251e séance du Conseil de sécurité avec comme thème « Les enfants et les conflits ».
claim_sources.translation_en: Its deputy permanent representative to the United Nations, Ambassador Jocelyne Kabengele Lukundulu, said so on Monday 26 October at the 10,251st meeting of the Security Council on the theme "Children and armed conflict".

claim_sources.excerpt_original: La situation sur le terrain demeure préoccupante. L’expérience congolaise confirme que la protection de l’enfance doit être intégrée dans la conception des cessez-le-feu, des accords de paix et des mécanismes de justice transitionnelle.
claim_sources.translation_en: The situation on the ground remains worrying. The Congolese experience confirms that child protection must be built into the design of ceasefires, peace agreements and transitional justice mechanisms.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon une source médicale de la zone de santé de Katoyi, qui s’est exprimée sous couvert d’anonymat, quatre structures sanitaires, à savoir le centre de santé (CS) Ufamandu, le CS Miano, le centre de santé de référence (CSR) Katuunda et le CS Nyandeki, ont été détruites dans le contexte de ces combats.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to a medical source in the Katoyi health zone, speaking anonymously, four health structures, namely the Ufamandu health centre, the Miano health centre, the Katuunda reference health centre and the Nyandeki health centre, were destroyed in the context of these fighting.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: D’après cette source, les bâtiments sanitaires ont été endommagés par des bombardements, après que des médicaments entreposés dans ces structures ont été pillés par des personnes non identifiées.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to this source, the health buildings were damaged by bombardments, after medicines stored in these structures were looted by unidentified persons.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: La situation sanitaire se dégrade dans le groupement Ufamandu 1er, en territoire de Masisi, à la suite des affrontements armés qui opposent les rebelles du Front pour la Refondation de la Nation (FRN) aux Forces armées de la République démocratique du Congo (FARDC), appuyées par les Wazalendo.
claim_sources.translation_en: The health situation is deteriorating in the Ufamandu 1er groupement, in Masisi territory, following armed clashes between the rebels of the Front pour la Refondation de la Nation (FRN) and the Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (FARDC), supported by the Wazalendo.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Un infirmier de l’hôpital général de référence de Masisi a été tué par balle dans la nuit du mercredi à ce jeudi 19 février 2026, à Masisi centre dans la chefferie de Bahunde, au Nord-Kivu. La victime est identifiée comme Montaigne Byanikiro
claim_sources.translation_en: A nurse of the Masisi general referral hospital was shot dead in the night from Wednesday to this Thursday 19 February 2026, in Masisi centre in the Bahunde chiefdom, in North Kivu. The victim is identified as Montaigne Byanikiro

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon des sources locales, des hommes armés non identifiés ont fait irruption à son domicile aux environs de 23 heures. Les assaillants auraient ouvert le feu à plusieurs reprises avant de prendre la fuite.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to local sources, unidentified armed men burst into his home at around 23 hours. The attackers reportedly opened fire several times before fleeing.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Dans une réaction collective, les infirmiers de Masisi ont condamné ce qu’ils qualifient de nouveau meurtre visant un membre du personnel soignant.
claim_sources.translation_en: In a collective reaction, the Masisi nurses condemned what they describe as a new murder targeting a member of the health staff.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: As reported 24 April 2025: In Goma city, North Kivu province, an unspecified number of MSF staff were shot and wounded by an unidentified perpetrator over the past few months. At least one was hospitalised.
M23 militia in North Kivu set ablaze two health centers on the pretext that they were treating members of opposition parties.

At least two health workers were killed with bladed weapons, including a nurse who was beheaded by M23, after being accused of providing medical care to opposition parties; their body was later found in the bush in North Kivu.
In total, 32 health workers were reported killed in 22 incidents in eastern DRC in 2025

In one incident that occurred during their withdrawal from a commune in North Kivu, M23 rebels looted a health center, taking all the medical equipment and medications. They then destroyed the solar power system that sustained the center’s cold chain and proceeded to break all doors and windows.
At the time of the attack, health center staff were hiding in the surrounding bush for safety
Le 11 juin dernier, le Centre de traitement Ebola de Katwa avait déjà été la cible d’une tentative d’attaque.
claim_sources.translation_en: On 11 June, the Katwa Ebola treatment centre had already been the target of an attempted attack.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les faits se sont produits à la suite d’une attaque menée par des hommes porteurs d’armes blanches qui ont fait irruption dans cet établissement sanitaire pour retirer de force une femme et son enfant, pourtant récemment testés positifs à l’épidémie d’Ebola.
claim_sources.translation_en: The events occurred following an attack by men carrying bladed weapons who burst into this health establishment to forcibly remove a woman and her child, both recently tested positive for Ebola.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Il s’agit de Zawadi Manacée et de sa fille Christelle Kavugho, âgée de six ans et demi, activement recherchées par la coordination provinciale de la riposte contre Ebola.
claim_sources.translation_en: They are Zawadi Manacée and her daughter Christelle Kavugho, aged six and a half, actively sought by the provincial coordination of the Ebola response.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: La Division provinciale de la santé du Nord-Kivu a lancé un avis de recherche après la disparition de deux malades atteints d'Ebola au Centre hospitalier adventiste de Wanamahika, situé à Mutiri, dans la ville de Butembo.
claim_sources.translation_en: The North Kivu Provincial Health Division issued a search notice after the disappearance of two patients with Ebola from the Wanamahika Adventist Hospital Centre, located at Mutiri, in the city of Butembo.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon un avis officiel publié le 16 juin rendu public par la division provinciale de la santé au Nord-Kivu, l’enfant avait été confirmée positive à la maladie à virus Ebola. Les deux patientes auraient quitté le Centre hospitalier adventiste de Mutiri avant le transfert prévu de la fillette vers un Centre de traitement Ebola (CTE).
claim_sources.translation_en: According to an official notice published on 16 June and made public by the provincial health division in North Kivu, the child had been confirmed positive for Ebola virus disease. The two patients reportedly left the Mutiri Adventist Hospital Centre before the planned transfer of the girl to an Ebola Treatment Centre (CTE).

claim_sources.excerpt_original: À Beni, le samedi 1er août, des habitants du quartier Cité Belge se sont également opposés au transfert d’une patiente suspectée d’Ebola vers un centre de traitement. L’ambulance chargée de son évacuation a été caillassée, nécessitant l’intervention des forces de l’ordre.
claim_sources.translation_en: In Beni, on Saturday 1 August, residents of the Cité Belge neighbourhood also opposed the transfer of a patient suspected of Ebola to a treatment centre. The ambulance in charge of her evacuation was stoned, requiring the intervention of law enforcement.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: 01 August 2026: In Cité Belge neighbourhood, Bungulu commune, Beni city, North Kivu province, an ambulance sent to evacuate an Ebola patient was stoned by demonstrators, who broke its windshield. Police fired warning shots to disperse the demonstrators.

01 August 2026: In Cité Belge neighbourhood, Bungulu commune, Beni city, North Kivu province, an ambulance sent to evacuate an Ebola patient was stoned by demonstrators, who broke its windshield. Police fired warning shots to disperse the demonstrators. Sources: Congo Quotidien, MSN and Reuters

Dans la zone de santé de Beni, au Nord-Kivu, des personnes ont tenté d’incendier les maisons de deux relais communautaires dans l’aire de santé de Mangothe. Le centre de santé de Ndindi a également été menacé d’incendie, avant une intervention ayant permis de rétablir l’ordre.
claim_sources.translation_en: In the Beni health zone, in North Kivu, people tried to set fire to the homes of two community relays in the Mangothe health area. The Ndindi health centre was also threatened with arson, before an intervention restored order.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: selon un rapport consulté vendredi. L’incident le plus grave signalé dans ce document s’est produit à Kasanga Tuha, dans l’aire de santé de Bunji, au Nord-Kivu. Une équipe chargée des enterrements dignes et sécurisés (EDS) y a été agressée, faisant « plusieurs blessés et un décès probable », précise le rapport de situation daté du 19 août
claim_sources.translation_en: according to a report consulted on Friday. The most serious incident reported in this document occurred at Kasanga Tuha, in the Bunji health area, in North Kivu. A team in charge of safe and dignified burials (EDS) was attacked there, leaving "several injured and one probable death", the situation report dated 19 August specifies

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Au sud, les cités de Kanyabayonga, Kayina, Kirumba et Kipese sont sous l’occupation du M23, dans le territoire de Lubero, qui est également touché par les attaques des ADF.
claim_sources.translation_en: In the south, the towns of Kanyabayonga, Kayina, Kirumba and Kipese are under M23 occupation, in Lubero territory, which is also hit by ADF attacks.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon des sources d’ACTUALITE.CD, des navettes de véhicules transportant hommes et matériel sont observées depuis environ deux semaines sur l’axe Kirumba-Katondi. Ce mouvement s’intensifie depuis un meeting tenu récemment l’AFC/M23 à Kirumba au cours duquel la rébellion avait exprimé son intention de prendre les villes de Butembo et Beni, situées dans la partie nord de la province du Nord-Kivu.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to ACTUALITE.CD's sources, shuttles of vehicles carrying men and equipment have been observed for about two weeks on the Kirumba-Katondi axis. This movement has intensified since a meeting recently held by the AFC/M23 at Kirumba, at which the rebellion expressed its intention to take the towns of Butembo and Beni, located in the northern part of North Kivu province.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Des renforts importants du mouvement politico-militaire AFC/M23 ont été signalés ce mardi dans la partie sud du territoire de Lubero
claim_sources.translation_en: Significant reinforcements of the AFC/M23 politico-military movement were reported this Tuesday in the southern part of Lubero territory

claim_sources.excerpt_original: La veille, une patrouille de l’AFC-M23 a été prise en embuscade par les combattants du CMC au niveau du village Mashango, dans le groupement de Bukombo.
claim_sources.translation_en: The day before, an AFC-M23 patrol was ambushed by CMC fighters at the village of Mashango, in the Bukombo grouping.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon plusieurs sources locales, des dizaines de civils, notamment des habitants de Katsiru venus à Mashango pour des travaux communautaires, se sont retrouvés piégés dans les échanges de tirs. Au moins 18 civils blessés ont été admis à l’hôpital de référence de Mwesso, situé dans le territoire voisin de Masisi, selon des sources médicales.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to several local sources, dozens of civilians, notably residents of Katsiru who had come to Mashango for community work, were trapped in the exchange of fire. At least 18 wounded civilians were admitted to the referral hospital of Mwesso, in the neighbouring Masisi territory, according to medical sources.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: dans les groupements de Kihondo et Bukombo, au sein de la chefferie de Bwito, dans le territoire de Rutshuru
claim_sources.translation_en: in the groupements of Kihondo and Bukombo, within the Bwito chiefdom, in Rutshuru territory

claim_sources.excerpt_original: La Représentation des étudiants du Congo (REC) Butembo-Lubero a annoncé mercredi 12 novembre la suspension immédiate des cours dans toutes les institutions de la ville de Butembo et du territoire de Lubero, à la suite de la mort tragique de Rosette Kavira Vyahula, étudiante à l’Institut supérieur technique de médecine (ISTM) Butembo, abattue par balle par un milicien muzalendo.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Representation of Students of Congo (REC) Butembo-Lubero announced on Wednesday 12 November the immediate suspension of classes in all institutions of the city of Butembo and Lubero territory, following the tragic death of Rosette Kavira Vyahula, a student at the Higher Technical Institute of Medicine (ISTM) Butembo, shot dead by a muzalendo militiaman.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Inscrite en première licence dans la faculté de Sage-femme, elle a été tuée par un milicien muzalendo répondant au nom de Nzingene à Musimba, alors qu’elle revenait de l’auditoire.
claim_sources.translation_en: Enrolled in first-year licence in the midwifery faculty, she was killed by a muzalendo militiaman going by the name of Nzingene at Musimba, as she was returning from the lecture hall.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le tir serait survenu lors d’une dispute entre groupes des wazalendo dans l’agglomération de Vweyera, vers MTB.
claim_sources.translation_en: The shot reportedly occurred during a dispute between Wazalendo groups in the Vweyera locality, towards MTB.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Transportée d’urgence à l’hôpital Saint Raphaël, connu sous le nom de Maison Rouge à Musimba, elle y a succombé à ses blessures
claim_sources.translation_en: Rushed to the Saint Raphael hospital, known as Maison Rouge, at Musimba, she succumbed to her wounds there

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon les manifestants, au moins huit meurtres ont été enregistrés en moins d’un mois dans la ville de Beni, impliquant des hommes armés, parmi lesquels des militaires déjà arrêtés.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to the demonstrators, at least eight murders were recorded in less than a month in the city of Beni, involving armed men, among them soldiers already arrested.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: À l’initiative des mouvements citoyens et des groupes de pression, une journée sans activités a été organisée
claim_sources.translation_en: At the initiative of citizen movements and pressure groups, a day without activities was organised

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Une nouvelle attaque attribuée aux rebelles des ADF la nuit de mardi à mercredi 6 mai a fait au moins 26 morts, parmi lesquels de nombreux agriculteurs.
claim_sources.translation_en: A new attack attributed to ADF rebels in the night of Tuesday to Wednesday 6 May left at least 26 dead, among them many farmers.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon la société civile locale, l'attaque est survenue dans les zones agricoles de Babila-Bakaiko, situées à environ 40 kilomètres à l’ouest de la commune rurale d’Oicha, Beni (Nord-Kivu). Cette structure citoyenne précise que les civils ont été tués précisément dans les blocs agricoles de Katere, Manzumbu, Musangwa, Wasafi et Mangambo.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to local civil society, the attack took place in the Babila-Bakaiko farming zones, located about 40 kilometres west of the rural commune of Oicha, Beni (North Kivu). This civic structure specifies that the civilians were killed in the farming blocks of Katere, Manzumbu, Musangwa, Wasafi and Mangambo.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le Prix Nobel de la paix 2018, Denis Mukwege, a vivement condamné, lundi 1er juin, les attaques attribuées aux rebelles des Forces démocratiques alliées (ADF) qui ont fait au moins 16 morts dans les localités de Ngadi et Vemba, dans le territoire de Beni (Nord-Kivu), dans la nuit du samedi 31 mai.
claim_sources.translation_en: The 2018 Nobel Peace Prize laureate, Denis Mukwege, strongly condemned on Monday 1 June the attacks attributed to ADF rebels which left at least 16 dead in the localities of Ngadi and Vemba, in Beni territory (North Kivu), in the night of Saturday 31 May.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Denis Mukwege s'est particulièrement alarmé des violences visant les membres de la communauté autochtone pygmée.
claim_sources.translation_en: Denis Mukwege was particularly alarmed by the violence targeting members of the indigenous pygmy community.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Elle évoque plusieurs violations notamment : des meurtres, des enlèvements et tortures, des mariages et grossesses forcées des violences sexuelles répétées.
claim_sources.translation_en: It cites several violations, notably: killings, abductions and torture, forced marriages and pregnancies, repeated sexual violence.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Dans un rapport publié ce mardi 5 mai, Amnesty International dénonce des exactions massives commises par les rebelles des Forces démocratiques alliées (ADF) contre des civils au Nord-Kivu et en Ituri.
claim_sources.translation_en: In a report published this Tuesday 5 May, Amnesty International denounces massive abuses committed by the rebels of the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) against civilians in North Kivu and Ituri.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les attaques visent essentiellement les populations, mais aussi les champs, les centres de santé et les habitations, souvent pillés puis incendiés, explique l’organisation.
claim_sources.translation_en: The attacks mainly target populations, but also fields, health centres and homes, often looted and then burned, the organisation explains.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Amnesty International affirme avoir documenté l’exécution sommaire de 18 mineurs artisanaux à Rubaya et Lomera. Selon les témoignages recueillis par l’organisation, dix personnes auraient été battues à mort, deux tuées par balle et six autres enlevées avant d’être retrouvées mortes.
claim_sources.translation_en: Amnesty International says it has documented the summary execution of 18 artisanal miners at Rubaya and Lomera. According to the testimonies gathered by the organisation, ten people were allegedly beaten to death, two shot dead and six others abducted before being found dead.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Amnesty International affirme avoir documenté de graves atteintes aux droits humains dans des zones minières contrôlées par le M23 au Nord-Kivu et au Sud-Kivu.
claim_sources.translation_en: Amnesty International says it has documented serious human rights abuses in mining zones controlled by the M23 in North Kivu and South Kivu.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: L’organisation dit avoir recueilli les témoignages de 26 personnes, notamment des mineurs artisanaux, des spécialistes du secteur minier, des propriétaires de puits et des proches de victimes. Ses recherches portent notamment sur une mine de coltan près de Rubaya, dans le territoire de Masisi au Nord-Kivu, et sur le site aurifère de Lomera, dans le territoire de Kabare au Sud-Kivu.
claim_sources.translation_en: The organisation says it collected testimony from 26 people, including artisanal miners, mining-sector specialists, pit owners and relatives of victims. Its research covers a coltan mine near Rubaya, in Masisi territory in North Kivu, and the gold site of Lomera, in Kabare territory in South Kivu.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le 2 janvier, un drone des FARDC a raté sa cible à Masisi centre, explosant sur des habitations et causant plus de 40 blessés civils et au moins 6 morts.
claim_sources.translation_en: On 2 January, an FARDC drone missed its target in Masisi centre, exploding on homes and causing more than 40 civilian wounded and at least 6 dead.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les rebelles de l’AFC-M23 ont pris le contrôle des agglomérations de Buhimba et Mahanga, en territoires de Walikale et Masisi, ce week-end après avoir délogé l’armée congolaise et les Wazalendo. « Depuis samedi à 12h00, les rebelles sont à Mahanga dans Osso. La population est dispersée »
claim_sources.translation_en: The AFC-M23 rebels took control of the towns of Buhimba and Mahanga, in Walikale and Masisi territories, this weekend after dislodging the Congolese army and the Wazalendo. 'Since Saturday at 12:00 the rebels have been at Mahanga in Osso. The population is dispersed,' Kipande Mungo, head of Osso Banyungu sector, told Kivu Morning Post.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: a déclaré à Kivu Morning Post Kipande Mungo, chef du secteur Osso Banyungu.
claim_sources.translation_en: Kipande Mungo, head of the Osso Banyungu sector, told Kivu Morning Post.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: L’armée accuse les rebelles de mener plusieurs attaques contre ses positions à Rutshuru, Masisi et Kalehe, et affirme qu’elle ne va pas laisser faire. De son côté, l’AFC-M23 accuse les FARDC de violer l’accord signé à Doha en rompant le cessez-le-feu.
claim_sources.translation_en: The army accuses the rebels of carrying out several attacks on its positions in Rutshuru, Masisi and Kalehe, and says it will not let this happen. For its part, the AFC-M23 accuses the FARDC of violating the agreement signed in Doha by breaking the ceasefire.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: L’armée accuse les rebelles de mener plusieurs attaques contre ses positions à Rutshuru, Masisi et Kalehe, et affirme qu’elle ne va pas laisser faire. De son côté, l’AFC-M23 accuse les FARDC de violer l’accord signé à Doha en rompant le cessez-le-feu.
claim_sources.translation_en: The army accuses the rebels of carrying out several attacks on its positions in Rutshuru, Masisi and Kalehe, and says it will not let this happen. For its part, the AFC-M23 accuses the FARDC of violating the agreement signed in Doha by breaking the ceasefire.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: À Buhimba, dans le groupement voisin de Waloa Yungu, un calme relatif est signalé après deux jours de combats violents entre les FARDC et le M23. Les combattants du M23 se sont repliés vers Mahanga et Kasopo, en territoire voisin de Masisi.
claim_sources.translation_en: At Buhimba, in the neighbouring Waloa Yungu grouping, relative calm is reported after two days of violent fighting between the FARDC and the M23. M23 fighters withdrew to Mahanga and Kasopo, in the neighbouring Masisi territory.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: La localité de Buhimba reste sous contrôle des forces gouvernementales, selon une source locale.
claim_sources.translation_en: The locality of Buhimba remains under the control of government forces, according to a local source.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: D’après notre source, les Wazalendo ont lancé leur première attaque contre les positions de l’AFC-M23 samedi 28 février 2026.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to our source, the Wazalendo launched their first attack on AFC-M23 positions on Saturday 28 February 2026.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Des combats intenses opposent depuis tôt ce lundi les combattants de l’AFC-M23 aux Wazalendo dans le village de Kibati, situé dans le groupement de Luberike, territoire de Walikale, au Nord-Kivu.
claim_sources.translation_en: Intense fighting has pitted AFC-M23 fighters against the Wazalendo since early this Monday in the village of Kibati, located in the Luberike grouping, Walikale territory, in North Kivu.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon une source locale de la société civile
claim_sources.translation_en: According to a local civil-society source

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les combats se sont intensifiés jusqu’à dimanche 1er mars, mais l’AFC-M23 a repoussé les assauts et maintenu ses positions au centre de Kibati.
claim_sources.translation_en: The fighting intensified until Sunday 1 March, but AFC-M23 repelled the assaults and held its positions in the centre of Kibati.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les combats se poursuivent notamment autour de Ngungu, Rubaya, Nyabiondo et sur l’axe menant vers Pinga, malgré les appels au cessez-le-feu.
claim_sources.translation_en: Fighting continues, notably around Ngungu, Rubaya, Nyabiondo and on the axis leading to Pinga, despite calls for a ceasefire.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Rubaya, l’un des principaux sites d’exploitation du coltan et de la cassitérite du pays, le contrôle reste entre les mains de l’AFC/M23 depuis près de deux ans.
claim_sources.translation_en: Rubaya, one of the country's main coltan and cassiterite mining sites, has remained under AFC/M23 control for nearly two years.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: le territoire de Masisi, dans la province du Nord-Kivu, reste marqué par des affrontements entre les forces armées congolaises, leurs alliés Wazalendo et les rebelles de la coalition AFC/M23, selon plusieurs sources civiles et militaires.
claim_sources.translation_en: Masisi territory, in North Kivu province, remains marked by clashes between the Congolese armed forces, their Wazalendo allies and the rebels of the AFC/M23 coalition, according to several civilian and military sources.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Dans la nuit du 23 au 24 novembre, la Coalition rapporte qu'au moins 12 personnes ont été arrêtées puis sommairement exécutées par les rebelles de la coalition AFC/M23﻿, les accusant de collaborer avec le groupe Wazalendo ou d’appartenir à ce groupe d’autodéfense
claim_sources.translation_en: In the night of 23 to 24 November, the Coalition reports that at least 12 people were arrested then summarily executed by the rebels of the AFC/M23 coalition, accusing them of collaborating with the Wazalendo group or of belonging to this self-defence group

claim_sources.excerpt_original: La Coalition Pamoja kwa Amani﻿ exprime sa vive inquiétude face aux « massacres et exécutions sommaires » de civils qui se multiplient dans la province du Sud-Kivu, notamment dans le groupement de Katana﻿, territoire de Kabare
claim_sources.translation_en: The Coalition Pamoja kwa Amani expresses its deep concern at the "massacres and summary executions" of civilians that are multiplying in South Kivu province, notably in the Katana groupement, Kabare territory

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Dans la nuit du 23 au 24 novembre, la Coalition rapporte qu'au moins 12 personnes ont été arrêtées puis sommairement exécutées par les rebelles
claim_sources.translation_en: In the night of 23 to 24 November, the Coalition reports that at least 12 people were arrested then summarily executed by the rebels

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les victimes étaient âgées de 20 à 40 ans. Parmi elles, un patient retiré d’un centre de santé avant son exécution.
claim_sources.translation_en: The victims were aged 20 to 40. Among them, a patient removed from a health centre before his execution.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: La Coalition Pamoja kwa Amani﻿ exprime sa vive inquiétude face aux « massacres et exécutions sommaires » de civils qui se multiplient dans la province du Sud-Kivu, notamment dans le groupement de Katana﻿, territoire de Kabare
claim_sources.translation_en: The Coalition Pamoja kwa Amani expresses its deep concern at the "massacres and summary executions" of civilians that are multiplying in South Kivu province, notably in the Katana groupement, Kabare territory

claim_sources.excerpt_original: la coalition Pamoja kwa Amani dénonce aussi d'autres exécutions sommaires, comme celle de deux jeunes hommes d’une même famille à Kaniola﻿, territoire de Walungu, le 21 novembre, tués puis enterrés dans une fosse commune par des éléments de l’AFC/M23.
claim_sources.translation_en: the coalition Pamoja kwa Amani also denounces other summary executions, such as that of two young men of the same family at Kaniola, Walungu territory, on 21 November, killed then buried in a mass grave by AFC/M23 elements.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: La 3eme zone de défense des FARDC, basée à Kisangani, a publié vendredi 08 août un communiqué
claim_sources.translation_en: The 3rd defence zone of the FARDC, based in Kisangani, published on Friday 8 August a communiqué

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon le porte-parole de cette zone militaire, le major Mavudisa Kamba, les forces loyalistes condamnent fermement les assassinats ciblés de civils, ainsi que le recrutement forcé de mineurs par ces groupes armés
claim_sources.translation_en: According to the spokesperson of this military zone, Major Mavudisa Kamba, the loyalist forces strongly condemn the targeted killings of civilians, as well as the forced recruitment of minors by these armed groups

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le 4 août 2025, plus de 80 civils ont été abattus au village Nyamarongo, dans la chefferie de Boavo, territoire de Kalé. - Le 24 juillet, six autres civils, dont deux mineurs, ont été exécutés à Lumbichi, accusés à tort de refuser de transporter des armes et des munitions.
claim_sources.translation_en: On 4 August 2025, more than 80 civilians were shot dead in the village of Nyamarongo, in Boavo chefferie, Kalé territory. On 24 July, six other civilians, including two minors, were executed at Lumbichi, wrongly accused of refusing to carry weapons and ammunition.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: La 3eme zone de défense des FARDC, basée à Kisangani, a publié vendredi 08 août un communiqué dans lequel elle exprime sa vive indignation face aux exactions commises par la coalition RDF/M23/AFC dans la province du Sud-Kivu
claim_sources.translation_en: The FARDC 3rd defence zone, based in Kisangani, published a communique on Friday 8 August in which it expresses its deep indignation at the abuses committed by the RDF/M23/AFC coalition in South Kivu province

claim_sources.excerpt_original: le major Mavudisa a rappelé deux massacres récents perpétrés par cette coalition : - Le 4 août 2025, plus de 80 civils ont été abattus au village Nyamarongo, dans la chefferie de Boavo, territoire de Kalé. - Le 24 juillet, six autres civils, dont deux mineurs, ont été exécutés à Lumbichi, accusés à tort de refuser de transporter des armes et des munitions.
claim_sources.translation_en: Major Mavudisa recalled two recent massacres perpetrated by this coalition: - On 4 August 2025, more than 80 civilians were shot dead in the village of Nyamarongo, in the Boavo chiefdom, Kalé territory. - On 24 July, six other civilians, including two minors, were executed at Lumbichi, wrongly accused of refusing to carry weapons and munitions.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les rebelles de l'AFC-M23﻿ ont étendu leur progression dans le territoire de Shabunda﻿, au Sud-Kivu en occupant les villages Kimbili﻿ et Nyalubemba﻿ à la suite d'une offensive menée le 20 novembre contre les positions avancées des Forces armées de la RDC (FARDC) et des combattants Wazalendo﻿, rapportent des sources concordantes.
claim_sources.translation_en: The rebels of the AFC-M23 extended their progression in Shabunda territory, South Kivu, by occupying the villages Kimbili and Nyalubemba following an offensive on 20 November against the forward positions of the FARDC and Wazalendo fighters, reported concordant sources.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: A l'issue des affrontements entre les belligérants, le centre de santé de Nyalubemba﻿ à Kimbili﻿ est débordé par les blessés civils et militaires, selon la société civile locale.
claim_sources.translation_en: After the fighting between the belligerents, the Nyalubemba health centre at Kimbili is overwhelmed by civilian and military wounded, according to local civil society.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Une évaluation menée entre le 2 et le 10 septembre 2025 auprès de 240 structures sanitaires réparties dans les deux Kivu révèle que 85% d’entre elles sont en rupture de stock de médicaments et d’intrants essentiels pour soigner les patients et les blessés.
claim_sources.translation_en: An assessment carried out between 2 and 10 September 2025 of 240 health facilities spread over the two Kivus reveals that 85% of them are out of stock of essential medicines and supplies to treat patients and the wounded.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon le CICR, le transfert des blessés vers les structures de santé appropriées pose un problème à cause des combats dans cette contrée, où des patients parcourent de longues distances à pied en risquant leur vie afin de trouver les soins adaptés. Plus de 70% de structures de santé sur les 240 évaluées ont reçu des blessés par armes.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to the ICRC, transferring the wounded to appropriate health structures is a problem because of fighting there, where patients travel long distances on foot, risking their lives, to find appropriate care. More than 70% of the 240 health structures evaluated received people wounded by weapons.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le Comité international de la Croix-Rouge (CICR) tire la sonnette d’alarme sur l’accès aux soins de santé dans les provinces du Nord et du Sud-Kivu, de plus en plus compromis en raison de l’activisme des groupes armés.
claim_sources.translation_en: The International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) is sounding the alarm on access to health care in North and South Kivu provinces, increasingly compromised by the activity of armed groups.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les Forces armées de la République démocratique du Congo (FARDC) annoncent avoir repris, dimanche 1er mard, la cité de Mikenge, située dans le territoire de Fizi, province du Sud-Kivu, après de violents affrontements contre les rebelles dans les Hauts Plateaux.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (FARDC) announce they retook, on Sunday 1 March, the city of Mikenge, located in Fizi territory, South Kivu province, after violent clashes against the rebels in the Hauts Plateaux.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le porte-parole des opérations Sukola 2 Sud Sud-Kivu, le sous-lieutenant Mbuyi Reagan, confirme que l’armée a repris le contrôle de plusieurs contrées dont la cité stratégique de Mikenge
claim_sources.translation_en: The spokesperson of operations Sukola 2 Sud South Kivu, Sub-Lieutenant Mbuyi Reagan, confirms that the army retook control of several areas including the strategic city of Mikenge

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Il ajoute que lors des combats, plusieurs rebelles ont été neutralisés, 5 capturés, et 17 autres se sont rendus. Parmi les 11 corps retrouvés, figure un commandant brigade de l’AFC-M23 ainsi qu’un officier chargé de la logistique, précise le sous-lieutenant Mbuyi Reagan.
claim_sources.translation_en: He adds that during the fighting several rebels were neutralised, 5 captured, and 17 others surrendered. Among the 11 bodies found are a brigade commander of the AFC-M23 and a logistics officer, specifies Sub-Lieutenant Mbuyi Reagan.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les affrontements ont repris tôt le matin de ce 1 mars dans le village de Bilalombili près de Mikenge dans le territoire de Mwenga au Sud-Kivu.
claim_sources.translation_en: Fighting resumed early in the morning of this 1 March in the village of Bilalombili near Mikenge in Mwenga territory in South Kivu.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon plusieurs sources locales, les éléments de la coalition Twirwaneho, Red Tabara, Android alliés au M23 qui ont attaqué les positions des Wazalendo.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to several local sources, the elements of the Twirwaneho, Red Tabara, Android coalition allied to M23 attacked the positions of the Wazalendo.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: civiles locales dénoncent le fait que les maisons ont été incendiées sans donner le nombre.
claim_sources.translation_en: local civil societies denounce the fact that the houses were burned, without giving the number.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le village de Bilalombili avait accueilli les déplacés venus de Mikenge et ailleurs, les sociétés civiles locales dénoncent le fait que les maisons ont été incendiées sans donner le nombre.
claim_sources.translation_en: The village of Bilalombili had hosted displaced people from Mikenge and elsewhere; local civil societies denounce the fact that houses were burned, without giving the number.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon des sources locales ce vendredi 26 juin, des affrontements ont eu lieu mercredi 24 juin dans les villages d’Ilundu et d’Alengei entre les Forces armées de la RDC (FARDC) et les combattants de la coalition armée Twirwaneho et leurs alliés, soutenus par le Rwanda. La milice accuse les FARDC d’avoir mené des bombardements contre ses positions à l’aide de drones.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to local sources this Friday 26 June, clashes took place on Wednesday 24 June in the villages of Ilundu and Alengei between the FARDC and the fighters of the Twirwaneho armed coalition and their allies, backed by Rwanda. The militia accuses the FARDC of having carried out bombardments against its positions using drones.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: La situation sécuritaire reste tendue dans la zone de Minembwe, en territoire de Fizi, au Sud-Kivu.
claim_sources.translation_en: The security situation remains tense in the Minembwe zone, in Fizi territory, in South Kivu.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Sur le plan régional, lors de la sixième réunion du Comité mixte de surveillance (CMS) sur la situation sécuritaire en RDC, tenue mercredi 24 juin 2026 à Londres, Kinshasa et Kigali ont réaffirmé leur engagement à désamorcer les tensions liées à la situation de Minembwe.
claim_sources.translation_en: On the regional level, during the sixth meeting of the Joint Oversight Committee (CMS) on the security situation in the DRC, held on Wednesday 24 June 2026 in London, Kinshasa and Kigali reaffirmed their commitment to defuse tensions linked to the situation of Minembwe.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: De nouveaux combats entre des combattants Wazalendos et les troupes de l’AFC/M23 ont été signalés tout au long de la journée de jeudi 2 avril 2026 dans le village de Tchambombo, groupement de Ziralo, situé sur les hauts plateaux du territoire de Kalehe.
claim_sources.translation_en: New fighting between Wazalendo fighters and AFC/M23 troops was reported throughout the day on Thursday 2 April 2026 in the village of Tchambombo, Ziralo groupement, on the highlands of Kalehe territory.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon des sources locales, de nombreux habitants ont quitté le village pour se réfugier dans la brousse et dans des villages jugés plus sécurisés.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to local sources, many residents left the village to take refuge in the bush and in villages deemed safer.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Des affrontements entre les troupes de l’AFC/M23 et les combattants Wazalendo ont été signalés ce mercredi 19 novembre 2025 dans le groupement de Kaniola ainsi qu’au centre de négoce de Mugogo, en territoire de Walungu.
claim_sources.translation_en: Clashes between AFC/M23 troops and Wazalendo fighters were reported this Wednesday 19 November 2025 in Kaniola groupement and at the Mugogo trading centre, in Walungu territory.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Plusieurs familles ont fui vers les villages environnants du groupement de Kaniola, notamment Bushushu, Nabishaka, Mwirama et Cindubi.
claim_sources.translation_en: Several families fled to the surrounding villages of Kaniola groupement, notably Bushushu, Nabishaka, Mwirama and Cindubi.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon des sources locales, les hostilités ont débuté vers une heure du matin à Kaniola-centre.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to local sources, hostilities began around one in the morning at Kaniola-centre.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Amnesty International limesema waasi wa M23 wanaoungwa mkono na Rwanda na vikundi vya Wazalendo vinavyoshirikiana na jeshi la Jamhuri ya Kidemokarsi ya Kongo, wametenda ukatili mkubwa mashariki mwa Kongo.
claim_sources.translation_en: Amnesty International said M23 rebels backed by Rwanda and Wazalendo groups collaborating with the army of the Democratic Republic of Congo have committed serious atrocities in eastern Kongo.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ukatili huo ni pamoja na kuwabaka wanawake kwa makundi, kuwaua raia kiholela na kushambulia hospitali katika eneo la mashariki mwa Kongo.
claim_sources.translation_en: The atrocities include gang-raping women, killing civilians arbitrarily and attacking hospitals in eastern Kongo.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ushuhuda wa wanawake kutoka Kivu Kaskazini na Kivu Kusini unaonesha kiwango cha ukatili huo. Wanawake 14 waliosimulia walibakwa kwa makundi.
claim_sources.translation_en: Testimony of women from North Kivu and South Kivu shows the scale of these atrocities. Fourteen women who recounted were gang-raped.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Beatrice kutoka Bukavu alisema alivamiwa na wanajeshi watano wa M23.
claim_sources.translation_en: Beatrice from Bukavu said she was attacked by five M23 soldiers.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Amnesty International ilisema mashambulizi ya M23 yalijumuisha hata hospitali, ambako wagonjwa na wahudumu walitekwa au kushikiliwa. Haya yalitokea kati ya Februari na Mei mwaka huu, wakati kundi hilo lilikuwa likidhibiti sehemu kubwa ya Goma na Bukavu.
claim_sources.translation_en: Amnesty International said M23's attacks even included hospitals, where patients and workers were abducted or held. This happened between February and May this year, when the group was controlling a large part of Goma and Bukavu.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Hata mbaya zaidi, shuhuda kadhaa huripoti unyanyasaji wa kijinsia. Wanawake na wasichana wanasemekana kuwa waathiriwa wa ubakaji, chini ya vitisho vya vitisho na kulipizwa kisasi ikiwa wataripoti.
claim_sources.translation_en: Even worse, several testimonies report sexual abuse. Women and girls are said to be victims of rape, under threats of reprisal if they report.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Wale waliohusika walikimbia uhasama katika miji na vijiji kadhaa katika jimbo la Kivu Kusini, ambalo linapakana na Burundi.
claim_sources.translation_en: Those involved fled hostilities in several towns and villages in South Kivu province, which borders Burundi.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kulingana na shuhuda kadhaa thabiti zilizokusanywa kwenye tovuti, walivuka Mto Rusizi
claim_sources.translation_en: According to several consistent testimonies collected on site, they crossed the Rusizi River

claim_sources.excerpt_original: katika eneo la Buganda la tarafa ya Bukinanyana, katika mkoa wa Bujumbura
claim_sources.translation_en: in the Buganda area of Bukinanyana commune, in Bujumbura province

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Desemba 2025, wanajeshi wa Burundi
claim_sources.translation_en: December 2025, Burundian soldiers

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Wakazi wanashutumu vikundi hivi vilivyojihami kwa kujihusisha na uporaji wa mara kwa mara.
claim_sources.translation_en: Residents accuse these armed groups of engaging in repeated looting.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Idara ya kipolisi ndani ya jeshi la Jamuhuri ya demokrasia ya Congo inaripoti kuwashikilia wanajeshi waasi kutoka Jeshi la taifa la Congo (FARDC) na wanamgambo wa Wazalendo wanaoiunga mkono serikali, waliokuwa wakihusishwa na ufyatuaji risasi holela katika mji wa Uvira, mashariki mwa nchi.
claim_sources.translation_en: The police department within the army of the Democratic Republic of Congo reports holding rebel soldiers of the national army of Congo (FARDC) and pro-government Wazalendo militiamen who were linked to indiscriminate shooting in the city of Uvira, in the east of the country.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: kwa sasa tunashuhudia kukamatwa kwa wanajeshi waasi na polisi wa idara ya kijeshi. Wale wanaopora au kufyatua risasi kiholela wanakamatwa,” alisema mkaazi huyo.
claim_sources.translation_en: at present we are witnessing the arrest of rebel soldiers by the military police. Those who loot or fire indiscriminately are being arrested," said the resident.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Raia mmoja aliambia BBC kuwa machafuko yaliyoshuhudiwa tangu Jumatano yaliendelea hadi usiku wa Alhamisi, ambapo risasi zilisikika katika maeneo kadhaa. Alisema, “Tulikuwa na wakati mgumu sana. Kulikuwa na milio ya risasi katika maeneo mengi ya mji. Usiku wa jana wanajeshi wa FARDC walivamia nyumba kadhaa kudai pesa, simu na chakula
claim_sources.translation_en: A resident told BBC that the disturbances seen since Wednesday continued into Thursday night, when gunfire was heard in several areas. He said: "We had a very hard time. There was gunfire in many parts of the city. Last night FARDC soldiers broke into several houses demanding money, phones and food

claim_sources.excerpt_original: SOS Médias Burundi Uvira, December 10, 2025 – The city of Uvira, in South Kivu, fell to the M23 rebel movement on the night of December 9. The fighters entered the city without encountering any resistance, causing shock and concern among the local population.

According to several witnesses, M23 columns simultaneously entered several strategic neighborhoods, including : the Mulongwe commercial center, the Kasenga neighborhood, the Kavimvira area, and the border post with Burundi.
In some streets of Kasenga and Kavimvira, the bodies of Wazalendo fighters were still visible in the morning. Red Cross teams were seen collecting them, a Kasenga resident reported.

One of its spokespeople clarified that the movement had “no problem with African people, much less with Burundians,” and that it could not be held responsible for the prolonged blockade of these citizens. According to him, the border on the Congolese side had remained open, and the M23 was implementing a policy of free movement in the areas under its control.

Ku wa gatandatu ni bwo M23 yatangaje ko ivanye umutwe w'ingabo zawo w'indorerezi wari usigaye ucunga umutekano muri Uvira, basaba ko MONUSCO yohereza ingabo kurinda uyu mujyi. Ku cyumweru mu gitondo, abarwanyi bo mu mitwe izwi nka Wazalendo bahise bagaruka muri Uvira, ku mugoroba w'uwo munsi ingabo za FARDC na zo zatangiye kwinjira muri uwo mujyi.
claim_sources.translation_en: On Saturday M23 announced it was withdrawing the observer force that had remained guarding Uvira, and asked that MONUSCO send troops to protect the city. On Sunday morning fighters of the groups known as Wazalendo came back to Uvira immediately, and that evening FARDC troops also began to enter the city.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Igisirikare cya Leta ya Congo (FARDC) cyatangaje ko cyafashe umujyi wa Uvira mu ntara ya Kivu y'Epfo muri Repubulika ya Demokarasi ya Congo, ko abasirikare babo ari bo bahagenzura kuva ku cyumweru tariki ya 18 Mutarama 2026.
claim_sources.translation_en: The army of the Congolese state (FARDC) announced that it had taken the city of Uvira in South Kivu province, that its soldiers have been controlling it since Sunday 18 January 2026.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: FARDC yashinje abarwanyi ba M23 - ivuga ko bafatanyije n'ingabo z'u Rwanda, gusenya no gusahura mbere yo kuva muri Uvira, ibyo Balinda mu kiganiro na BBC yahakanye, avuga ko ibyo bashinjaga M23 gusahura byose byerekanywe ko bigihari.
claim_sources.translation_en: FARDC accused M23 fighters - saying they worked together with Rwandan troops - of destroying and looting before leaving Uvira, which Balinda in an interview with BBC denied, saying that everything they were accused of looting was shown to still be there.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Oscar Balinda, umuvigizi wa M23

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Oscar Balinda, umuvigizi wa M23
claim_sources.translation_en: Oscar Balinda, spokesperson of M23

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Balinda yabwiye BBC ati: "Ibyo ni ukubeshya.
claim_sources.translation_en: Balinda told BBC: "That is a lie.

claim_sources.translation_en: Lawrence Kanyuka, spokesperson of AFC/M23, says that since Wazalendo and FARDC entered Uvira "the city has become a hotbed of fighting, violence and looting and hate speech

claim_sources.translation_en: The state army said that about 20 residents seen in looting and disturbing security have been arrested and will be brought before justice.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuturage wo muri Uvira wavuganye na BBC ku wa mbere yavuze ko habayeho gusahura ku nzu za leta, ku biro by'umujyi, ku rukiko rwa gisirikare kuri hoteli yitwa Suzanna y'umuntu uzwi nka Muchepe, n'ahandi.
claim_sources.translation_en: A resident of Uvira who spoke to BBC on Monday said that there was looting at government houses, at the city offices, at the military court, at the hotel called Suzanna of the person known as Muchepe, and elsewhere.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ubwa mbere AFC/M23 basahuye hafi ibintu byose mu mujyi, imodoka n'ibindi by'agaciro.
claim_sources.translation_en: First AFC/M23 looted almost everything in the city, vehicles and other valuables.

claim_sources.translation_en: Olivier Nduhungirehe, in a statement published on his X account after a meeting of the African Union Peace and Security Council. "Rwanda welcomes the unilateral withdrawal of AFC/M23 from Uvira, as a goodwill gesture towards the mediators and a strong signal of readiness to return to the negotiating table"

claim_sources.excerpt_original: L’annonce a été faite par le ministre rwandais des Affaires étrangères et de la Coopération internationale, Olivier Nduhungirehe, dans une déclaration publiée sur son compte X, à l’issue d’une réunion du Conseil de paix et de sécurité de l’Union africaine.
claim_sources.translation_en: The announcement was made by the Rwandan Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation, Olivier Nduhungirehe, in a statement published on his X account, following a meeting of the African Union Peace and Security Council.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: « Le Rwanda accueille favorablement le retrait unilatéral de l’AFC/M23 d’Uvira, en tant que geste de bonne volonté envers les médiateurs et signal fort de disponibilité à retourner à la table des négociations »
claim_sources.translation_en: "Rwanda welcomes the unilateral withdrawal of AFC/M23 from Uvira, as a gesture of goodwill towards the mediators and a strong signal of readiness to return to the negotiating table"

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le Rwanda a par ailleurs réitéré ses préoccupations concernant ce qu’il qualifie de « violations quotidiennes du cessez-le-feu » par la coalition armée soutenue par Kinshasa, rappelant qu’« un cessez-le-feu engage de manière égale les deux parties à un conflit et ne peut être imposé à une seule ».
claim_sources.translation_en: Rwanda also reiterated its concerns about what it calls "daily ceasefire violations" by the armed coalition backed by Kinshasa, recalling that "a ceasefire binds both parties to a conflict equally and cannot be imposed on only one".

claim_sources.excerpt_original: At this meeting, the Burundian Minister of Foreign Affairs, Édouard Bizimana, declared that the Burundi-Congo border will remain closed until further notice. Speaking about the security situation in eastern DRC, the Burundian Foreign Minister asserted that the M23 is lying when it claims to have withdrawn from the city of Uvira.

The announcement was made during a meeting of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Regional Integration and International Cooperation, held in Bujumbura, in the presence of representatives of partner countries and international organizations accredited to Burundi.
According to him, this apparent withdrawal masks a strategy of regrouping and repositioning its fighters.

announcement by the governor of South Kivu, Jean-Jacques Purusi. The previous Friday, after crossing the border, he had assured the population in Uvira—the province’s provisional capital—that the Burundi-Congo border would be reopened within two to three days, by January 30, 2026, at the latest.
Burundian authorities have announced the continued closure of this strategic border with the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), citing the persistence of serious security threats in eastern DRC.
