Wanawake na wasichana walilengwa zaidi, lakini wanaume, wavulana na watu wa jinsia moja pia walikuwa wahanga, ikiwemo wakiwa kizuizini.
claim_sources.translation_en: Also, M23 members committed sexual violence, mainly gang rape, and other forms of sexual violence, including sexual slavery. Women and girls were mostly targeted, but men, boys and people of the same sex were also victims, including while in detention.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ripoti hii imeandaliwa na Ujumbe wa Kutafuta Ukweli (FFM) wa Ofisi ya Haki za Binadamu ya Umoja wa Mataifa, kwa agizo la Baraza la Haki za Binadamu la Umoja wa Mataifa.
claim_sources.translation_en: This report was prepared by the Fact-Finding Mission (FFM) of the United Nations Human Rights Office, at the request of the United Nations Human Rights Council.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mu ijoro ryo ku wa 21 rishyira uwa 22 Nyakanga 2025, abarwanyi ba Wazalendo bikekwa ko baturutse muri Pariki ya Virunga bagabye igitero mu gace ka Mugunga ndetse no muri gurupoma ya Rusayo.
claim_sources.translation_en: In the night of 21 to 22 July 2025, Wazalendo fighters suspected to have come from Virunga Park launched an attack in the Mugunga area and in Rusayo groupement.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Muri iryo joro humvikanye urusaku rw’amasasu rwamaze amasaha agera kuri atatu, ubwo AFC/M23 yashakishaga abarwanyi ba Wazalendo bashakaga guhungabanya umutekano wa Goma.
claim_sources.translation_en: That night gunfire was heard that lasted about three hours, when AFC/M23 was searching for Wazalendo fighters who wanted to disturb Goma's security.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: ariko muri iryo joro AFC/M23 yashoboye gusubiza inyuma abarwanyi ba Wazalendo bose.
claim_sources.translation_en: but that night AFC/M23 managed to push back all the Wazalendo fighters.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Guverineri w’intara ya Kivu y’Amajyaruguru washyizweho n’iri huriro, Manzi Willy, tariki ya 22 Nyakanga yatangaje ko abarwanyi babo bakomeje gusenya ibintu byose bishobora guhungabanya umutekano w’uyu mujyi.
claim_sources.translation_en: The governor of North Kivu province appointed by this alliance, Manzi Willy, announced on 22 July that their fighters continue to destroy everything that could disturb the security of this city.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Manzi yasobanuye ko ubwo AFC/M23 yafataga Goma, ingabo byari bihanganye zahishe mu baturage imbunda, amasasu, amabombe n’ibindi bishobora kwica, kandi ko umunsi ku wundi iri huriro ribitahura.
claim_sources.translation_en: Manzi explained that when AFC/M23 took Goma, the forces it fought had hidden guns, bullets, bombs and other lethal things among the population, and that day after day the alliance recovers them.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Abatuye mu Mudugudu wa Buramba, muri Gurupoma ya Binza, Sheferi ya Bwisha, muri Teritwari ya Rutshuru, bakomeje gutaka bivovotera umutekano mucye uterwa n’inyeshyamba za wazalendo na FDLR zikomeje kubahohotera. Biravugwa ko abahohoterwa kenshi bashinjwa gukorana na AFC/M23.
claim_sources.translation_en: Residents of Buramba village, in Binza groupement, Bwisha chiefdom, in Rutshuru territory, continue to cry out about insecurity caused by Wazalendo and FDLR rebels who continue to harass them. It is said that those often harassed are accused of working with AFC/M23.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Hejuru yo gucengera mu baturage mu masaha y’ijoro nk’uko tubikesha Kivu Morning Post, izi nyeshyamba zitwaje intwaro zinatera abakoresha umuhanda Kiwanja-Ishasha, nk’ahitwa Katoro, hafi ya Katwiguru, ndetse n’ahitwa Cabafu, aho igitero giheruka cyabaye ku Cyumweru, itariki 8 Werurwe 2026.
claim_sources.translation_en: Besides infiltrating among the population at night, as we learn from Kivu Morning Post, these armed rebels also attack users of the Kiwanja-Ishasha road, at places such as Katoro, near Katwiguru, and at Cabafu, where the latest attack took place on Sunday, 8 March 2026.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Imirwano ikaze yabaye mu gitondo cyose cyo kuwa Mbere, itariki ya 12 Mutarama, hagati y’abarwanyi ba AFC / M23 n’inyeshyamba za Wazalendo zo mu mutwe wa CMC mu midugudu myinshi yo muri Gurupoma ya Bukombo muri Teritwari ya Rutshuru (Kivu y'Amajyaruguru). Nta mibare y'abiciwe muri iyi mirwano yatangajwe.
claim_sources.translation_en: Heavy fighting took place all of Monday morning, 12 January, between AFC/M23 fighters and Wazalendo rebels of the CMC group in many villages of Bukombo groupement in Rutshuru territory (North Kivu). No figures of those killed in this fighting have been announced.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Amakuru aturuka muri ako gace agera kuri Radio Okapi, dukesha iyi nkuru, avuga ko imirwano yatangiriye i Bumbasha, ku birometero bike uvuye i Mweso, mbere yo gukwira Karambi na Chahemba. Aya makuru avuga ko imirwano yatumye abaturage babarirwa mu magana bahungira mu midugudu baturanye ndetse no muri centre ya Mweso
claim_sources.translation_en: Information from the area reaching Radio Okapi, from which we draw this story, says the fighting began at Bumbasha, a few kilometres from Mweso, before spreading to Karambi and Chahemba. This information says the fighting led hundreds of residents to flee to neighbouring villages and to Mweso centre.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Iyi mirwano ikomeye yabaye kuva mu museke wo ku wa mbere, hagati y’abarwanyi ba AFC/M23 n’abarwanyi ba Wazalendo bo muri Collectif des mouvements pour le changement (CMC). Amakuru aturuka muri ako gace avuga ko iyi mirwano yabereye cyane cyane i Munguli, muri Gurupoma ya Kihondo, no muri Kikuro, muri Gurupoma ya Tongo.
claim_sources.translation_en: This heavy fighting took place from dawn on Monday, between AFC/M23 fighters and Wazalendo fighters of the Collectif des mouvements pour le changement (CMC). Information from the area says the fighting took place mainly at Munguli, in Kihondo groupement, and at Kikuro, in Tongo groupement.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ku wa gatandatu no ku Cyumweru, uduce twa Birambizo na Karambi, muri Gurupoma ya Bukombo, no muri Gurupoma ya Kihondo, niho habaye imirwano ikaze. Nk’uko amakuru aturuka muri ako gace abitangaza, iyi mirwano yatumye abaturage babarirwa mu magana bahunga ingo zabo. Ku cyumweru, byibuze amazu atandatu yatwitse mu mujyi wa Karambi no mu turere tuyikikije.
claim_sources.translation_en: On Saturday and Sunday, the areas of Birambizo and Karambi, in Bukombo groupement, and in Kihondo groupement, saw heavy fighting. According to information from the area, this fighting made hundreds of residents flee their homes. On Sunday, at least six houses were burned in Karambi town and its surroundings.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Guverineri w’Intara ya Kivu y’Amajyaruguru washyizweho n’ihuriro AFC/M23 rirwanya ubutegetsi bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, Bahati Musanga Erasto, yahinduye ubuyobozi bw’Umujyi wa Goma. Itangazo ryo ku wa 9 Mata 2026 rigaragaza ko Kisuba Ngabo Désiré yagizwe Meya wa Goma, asimbuye Julien Katembo Ndalieni wagizwe Umuyobozi wa teritwari ya Lubero.
claim_sources.translation_en: The governor of North Kivu province appointed by the AFC/M23 alliance, Bahati Musanga Erasto, changed the leadership of Goma city. An announcement of 9 April 2026 shows that Kisuba Ngabo Désiré was made Mayor of Goma, replacing Julien Katembo Ndalieni, who was made head of Lubero territory.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Nshimiyimana Juvénal wari Umuyobozi ushinzwe ubukangurambaga no gushaka abarwanyi bashya muri AFC/M23 yagizwe Visi Meya w’Umujyi wa Goma.
claim_sources.translation_en: Nshimiyimana Juvénal, who was in charge of mobilisation and recruiting new fighters in AFC/M23, was made Deputy Mayor of Goma city.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Banki ya CADECO yafunguwe na AFC/M23 nyuma y’uko Leta ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo yari imaze gufunga amabanki yo mu bice uriya mutwe ugenzura, yatangiye gutanga Serivisi z’imari ku batuye mu mujyi wa Goma.
claim_sources.translation_en: The CADECO bank, opened by AFC/M23 after the government of the Democratic Republic of Congo had closed banks in the areas that group controls, has started providing financial services to residents of Goma city.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ku wa 11 Gicurasi ni bwo CADECO yafunguye ‘guichets’ ebyiri mu mujyi wa Goma, mu muhango wayobowe na Visi-Guverineri w’Intara ya Kivu y’Amajyaruguru ushinzwe ubukungu n’imari, Shadrack Amani.
claim_sources.translation_en: On 11 May, CADECO opened two counters in Goma city at a ceremony led by the Deputy Governor of North Kivu province for economy and finance, Shadrack Amani.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: OCHA iliripoti kuwa watu wenye silaha walivamia angalau hospitali mbili katika mji mkuu wa Kivu Kaskazini, Goma, na kuwateka nyara wagonjwa kadhaa.
claim_sources.translation_en: OCHA reported that armed men raided at least two hospitals in the capital of North Kivu, Goma, and abducted several patients.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Jumapili, Februari 8, 2026, Muungano wa Mto Congo-M23 (AFC-M23), muungano wa waasi unaoendelea mashariki mwa Jamhuri ya Kidemokrasia ya Kongo (DRC), uliwasilisha makomandoo wapya 7,532 ambao walikuwa wamemaliza mafunzo yao ya kijeshi huko Tchanzu (Wilaya ya Rutshuru, Kivu Kaskazini).
claim_sources.translation_en: Sunday, 8 February 2026, the Congo River Alliance-M23 (AFC-M23), a rebel alliance operating in eastern DRC, presented 7,532 new commandos who had finished their military training at Tchanzu (Rutshuru District, North Kivu).

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Sherehe hii inaashiria hatua mpya katika muundo wa Jeshi la Mapinduzi la Kongo (ARC), mrengo wenye silaha wa harakati inayoongozwa na Jenerali Sultani Makenga.
claim_sources.translation_en: This ceremony marks a new step in the structure of the Congolese Revolutionary Army (ARC), the armed wing of the movement led by General Sultani Makenga.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: “Kuanzia leo mmekuwa askari wa ARC, jeshi lililojitokeza kuwakomboa wananchi, nchi yetu inaendeshwa na watu wazembe wanaoishi Kinshasa,” alisema Meja Jenerali Sultani Makenga, Mratibu wa Kijeshi wa AFC-M23.
claim_sources.translation_en: "From today you have become soldiers of the ARC, an army that emerged to liberate the people, our country is run by incompetent people living in Kinshasa," said Major General Sultani Makenga, Military Coordinator of AFC-M23.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kufikia mwishoni mwa mwezi Mei, mamia ya wanaume walikuwa wameketi kwenye changarawe nyeusi ya volkano katika mitaa ya Murambi, kaskazini mwa Goma, wakilindwa na wapiganaji wa M23.
claim_sources.translation_en: By the end of May, hundreds of men were sitting on the black volcanic gravel in the streets of Murambi, north of Goma, guarded by M23 fighters.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Baadhi ya wakazi mji wa Goma walisema watu wengine walikamatwa kwa sababu ndogo tu kama vile, kuvaa nguo chafu au kutonyoa ndevu, wengi walikusanywa paamoja katika uwanja wa michezo ambao wakati huo uligeuzwa gereza la wazi.
claim_sources.translation_en: Some residents of Goma city said other people were arrested for only small reasons such as wearing dirty clothes or not shaving their beards, many were gathered together in a sports stadium that at that time was turned into an open prison.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Wale ambao hawakuthibitishwa na ushahidi uliochukuliwa kuwa wa kuaminika walipelekwa katika vizuizi vya faragha.
claim_sources.translation_en: Those who were not cleared by evidence considered credible were taken to private detention places.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Msemaji wa serikali ya Kongo Patrick Muyaya alisema wakaazi wa Goma wanaendelea kukabiliwa na mateso.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Congolese government spokesperson Patrick Muyaya said Goma residents continue to face suffering.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umutwe wa M23 watangaje ko abantu bapfuye mu mirwano iheruka i Goma barenga 2,500 ari abasirikare ba leta (FARDC) na Wazalendo.
claim_sources.translation_en: The M23 group announced that the people who died in the recent fighting in Goma, more than 2,500, are government soldiers (FARDC) and Wazalendo.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Bertrand Bisimwa umwe mu bakuru b'umutwe wa M23 yatangaje ko "nta muryango w'i Goma uri mu kiriyo kubera aba bapfuye".
claim_sources.translation_en: Bertrand Bisimwa, one of the leaders of the M23 group, announced that "no family in Goma is in mourning because of these dead".

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Yavuze ko imirambo yahoze mu mihanda i Goma, yahavanywe igahambwa ari "iy'abasirikare ba FARDC n'abakorana na bo", yavuzemo Wazalendo, FDLR, abacanshuro b'i Burayi n'ingabo z'u Burundi, yemeza ko baguye ku rugamba.
claim_sources.translation_en: He said the bodies that had been in the streets of Goma, which were removed and buried, were "those of FARDC soldiers and their collaborators", including Wazalendo, FDLR, European mercenaries and Burundian forces, affirming that they died in battle.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ishami rya ONU rishinzwe ubutabazi, OCHA-RDC, rivuga ko imirambo nibura 2,000 yamaze guhambwa kandi ko indi igera kuri 900 iri mu buruhukiro bw'ibitaro bitandukanye i Goma.
claim_sources.translation_en: The UN humanitarian department, OCHA-RDC, says at least 2,000 bodies have already been buried and that another nearly 900 are in the morgues of various hospitals in Goma.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: ONU ku wa mbere yatangaje ko abantu nibura 900 bishwe naho abarenga 2,800 barakomeretse kubera iyo mirwano, kandi ko ibitaro bikigowe no kubasha kuvura izo nkomere zose.
claim_sources.translation_en: On Monday the UN announced that at least 900 people were killed and more than 2,800 injured because of that fighting, and that hospitals are still struggling to treat all those wounds.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mu gusubiza ku birego biri muri raporo ya HRW umuvugizi wa M23 Lawrence Kanyuka yanditse ubutumwa kuri X avuga ko iyo raporo, hamwe n'iya Amnesty International iheruka gusohoka, ari "ibikoresho by'icengezamatwara bikorera ubutegetsi bwa Kinshasa".
claim_sources.translation_en: In response to the allegations in the HRW report, M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka wrote a message on X saying that this report, together with the recent one by Amnesty International, are "propaganda tools working for the Kinshasa authorities".

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kanyuka yatangaje kandi raporo yasohowe na M23 mu cyumweru gishize ivuga ko mu mirwano yo gufata umujyi wa Goma hapfuye abantu 874 b'abarwanyi gusa.
claim_sources.translation_en: Kanyuka also announced a report published by M23 last week saying that in the fighting to take the city of Goma only 874 fighters died.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Patrick Muyaya, umuvugizi wa leta ya Kinshasa aheruka gutangaza ko imirambo irenga 2,000 ikiri mu mihanda i Goma ikeneye guhambwa. Yashinje ingabo z' Rwanda na M23 ubwicanyi ku basivile mu mirwano iheruka i Goma no mu nkengero zayo.
claim_sources.translation_en: Patrick Muyaya, spokesperson of the Kinshasa government, recently announced that more than 2,000 bodies are still in the streets of Goma needing burial. He accused Rwandan forces and M23 of killing civilians in the recent fighting in Goma and its surroundings.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umutwe wa M23 wishe abasivile nibura 21 i Goma mu kwezi kwa Gashyantare(2), nk'uko bivugwa na raporo ya Human Rights Watch (HRW) yasohotse uyu munsi, ivuga ko abo ari abo wemeza neza, ko hari ibimenyetso ko hari n'abandi benshi bishwe.
claim_sources.translation_en: The M23 group killed at least 21 civilians in Goma in February, according to a report by Human Rights Watch (HRW) published today, which says these are the ones it confirms and that there is evidence that many others were killed.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Raporo ya HRW ivuga ko tariki 22 Gashyantare (2) nibura imodoka eshatu za 'pickup' zirimo abarwanyi ba M23 zagiye mu bice bitandukanye bya Goma, abarwanyi bazirimo bakica abantu barindwi mu gace ka Katindo, ko nyuma habonetse indi mirambo 11 irimo umwana w'umuhungu hafi y'ahantu harimo kubakwa.
claim_sources.translation_en: The HRW report says that on 22 February at least three pickup vehicles carrying M23 fighters went to different parts of Goma, and the fighters in them killed seven people in the Katindo area, and that later 11 more bodies were found, including a boy, near a place under construction.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Iyi raporo ivuga ko ku munsi wakurikiyeho, aba barwanyi bakusanyije abantu "bagamije kubinjiza ku ngufu" muri M23, maze bakica batatu bagerageje gucika.
claim_sources.translation_en: The report says that the following day these fighters gathered people "to forcibly enlist them" in M23, and killed three who tried to escape.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: HRW ivuga ko abakozi batatu bo kwa muganga bayibwiye ko hari imirambo irenga 50 yakuwe mu gace ka Kasika hagati ya tariki 22 na 23 Gashyantare
claim_sources.translation_en: HRW says three health workers told it that more than 50 bodies were removed from the Kasika area between 22 and 23 February

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mtaalamu huyo amesema amepokea ripoti za kuaminika za watetezi wa haki za binadamu kushikiliwa bila mawasiliano, kutoweshwa kwa nguvu, na kuteswa huko Rutshuru na Masisi, Kivu Kaskazini, huku takribani watetezi sita wa haki za binadamu wakiripotiwa kutoweka baada ya kujaribu kutoroka Goma baada ya jiji hilo kuchukuliwa na M23.
claim_sources.translation_en: The expert said she has received credible reports of human rights defenders held incommunicado, forcibly disappeared and tortured in Rutshuru and Masisi, North Kivu, while about six human rights defenders were reported to have disappeared after trying to flee Goma after the city was taken by M23.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: anayehusika na hali ya watetezi wa haki za binadamu, Mary Lawlor leo ametoa wito wa msaada wa dharura na wa vitendo kwa watetezi wa haki za binadamu katika eneo hilo.
claim_sources.translation_en: responsible for the situation of human rights defenders, Mary Lawlor, today called for urgent and practical support for human rights defenders in the area.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: amesema Lawlor na kuongeza kuwa watu hao wanaishi kwa hofu na hatari ni halisi na kwama hivi karibuni, mtetezi mmoja alimpa taarifa kuwa waasi wa M23 wameandaa orodha ya watetezi wa haki za binadamu watakaokamatwa katika maeneo waliyoyadhibiti.
claim_sources.translation_en: said Lawlor, adding that these people live in fear and the danger is real, and that recently one defender told her that M23 rebels had prepared a list of human rights defenders to be arrested in the areas they controlled.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: anayehusika na hali ya watetezi wa haki za binadamu, Mary Lawlor leo ametoa wito wa msaada wa dharura na wa vitendo kwa watetezi wa haki za binadamu katika eneo hilo.
claim_sources.translation_en: responsible for the situation of human rights defenders, Mary Lawlor, today called for urgent and practical support for human rights defenders in the area.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuhuzabikorwa w’Ihuriro AFC/M23, Corneille Nangaa yabwiye abaturage bo mu Mujyi wa Goma ko nyuma y’umwaka hashyizweho ubuyobozi bw’uyu mujyi, ubu ibintu byose byamaze kujya ku murongo igisigaye ari ugukomeza urugendo rw’iterambere ndetse no kubohora Congo yose.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Coordinator of the AFC/M23 alliance, Corneille Nangaa, told the residents of Goma city that a year after the city's leadership was put in place, everything is now in order and what remains is to continue the journey of development and to liberate all of Congo.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Muri iki kiganiro, Nangaa yagiranye n’abaturage b’i Goma, yababwiye ko intambara muri uyu Mujyi yarangiye burundu
claim_sources.translation_en: In this conversation, Nangaa spoke with the residents of Goma, he told them that the war in this city is completely over

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mu masaa kumi y’urukerera rwo ku wa 11 Werurwe, drones z’ingabo za RDC zarashe ingo z’abaturage mu gace ka Himbi, zica abasivili batatu barimo Umufaransakazi wakoreraga ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku bana (UNICEF), Karine Buisset.
claim_sources.translation_en: At about four o'clock in the early morning (Kinyarwanda 'saa kumi', counted from 6 a.m.) of 11 March, drones of the DRC army fired on residents' homes in the Himbi area, killing three civilians including a Frenchwoman who worked for the United Nations children's agency (UNICEF), Karine Buisset.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: AFC/M23 yamaganye iki gitero, igaragaza ko bidakwiye ko umuryango mpuzamahanga ukomeza guceceka mu gihe Leta ya RDC irenga nkana ku masezerano y’agahenge yasinyiwe i Doha muri Qatar.
claim_sources.translation_en: AFC/M23 condemned this attack, stating that it is not right for the international community to keep silent while the DRC government deliberately violates the ceasefire agreement signed in Doha, Qatar.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa 12 Werurwe 2026, abaturage benshi batuye i Goma bahuriye mu myigaragambyo yamagana igitero cya drones ingabo za Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo zagabye muri uyu mujyi, basaba ihuriro AFC/M23 kubohora iki gihugu cyose.
claim_sources.translation_en: On the morning of 12 March 2026, many residents of Goma gathered in a protest against the drone attack that the forces of the Democratic Republic of Congo launched in this city, asking the AFC/M23 alliance to liberate this whole country.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi wa AFC/M23, Lawrence Kanyuka, yatangaje ko abigaragambya basabye “AFC/M23 gukura ubutegetsi bwa Félix Tshisekedi muri RDC yose”
claim_sources.translation_en: The AFC/M23 spokesperson, Lawrence Kanyuka, stated that the protesters asked "AFC/M23 to remove the government of Félix Tshisekedi throughout the DRC"

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Nyuma yo kwakira ubutumire bwa sosiyete sivile, mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa 12 Werurwe abaturage benshi b’i Goma bahagaritse ibikorwa byabo
claim_sources.translation_en: After receiving the civil society's invitation, on the morning of this 12 March many residents of Goma stopped their activities

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Yakomeje yibutsa uyu muryango ko ntaho ingabo z’u Rwanda zihuriye na AFC/M23. Ati “Bikwiriye gusobanuka neza, RDF ntabwo ari AFC/M23. Iperereza ryose rikozwe neza risaba kutabogama, kugera aho ibintu bibera, ibimenyetso simusiga, kubahiriza amategeko ndetse no kudatangaza imyanzuro mbere y’igihe, cyangwa ngo ushyire imbere gusaba ibihano.”
claim_sources.translation_en: She went on to remind this organisation that Rwandan forces have no connection with AFC/M23. She said: “It should be made clear, the RDF is not AFC/M23. Any properly conducted investigation requires impartiality, access to where events take place, solid evidence, respect for the law and not announcing conclusions in advance, or putting calls for sanctions first.”

claim_sources.excerpt_original: “It should be clear that the RDF is not AFC/M23,” Makolo said. “Any serious investigation requires impartiality, access, forensic rigour, due process, and not conclusions announced in advance, or bombastic calls for sanctions.”
Umuvugizi wa Guverinoma y’u Rwanda, Yolande Makolo, yanenze raporo iherutse gushyirwa hanze n’Umuryango Human Rights Watch
claim_sources.translation_en: The spokesperson of the Government of Rwanda, Yolande Makolo, criticised the report recently released by Human Rights Watch

claim_sources.excerpt_original: In a statement posted on X, Government Spokesperson Yolande Makolo dismissed the report as part of a long-standing pattern in HRW's reporting on Rwanda. “Human Rights Watch on Rwanda is a 30-year pattern: anonymous claims, no site visits or forensics, sanctions first and investigation later,” Makolo wrote.

Yagaragaje ko kuva mu myaka 30 ishize uyu muryango waranzwe n’imyitwarire ihora yisubiramo iyo bigeze ku Rwanda irimo kudatangaza imyirondoro y’abo ikesha amakuru, kutigerera ahabera ibyo uvuga, kutagira ibimenyetso simusiga ndetse no gushyira imbere ibihano.
claim_sources.translation_en: She showed that for the past 30 years this organisation has been marked by a repeating pattern when it comes to Rwanda, including not disclosing the identities of those it gets information from, not going to the places of what it reports, lacking solid evidence and putting sanctions first.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ati “Muri raporo yayo iheruka, HRW ntabwo ishobora gufata inshingano (zo gukora iperereza ritabogamye) mu gihe yirengagiza bimwe mu byo yitangarije: Kinshasa iha intwaro, igatera inkunga ndetse igakorana bya hafi na FDLR, Wazalendo, abacanshuro b’abanyamahanga n’igisirikare cy’u Burundi, byose bifatwa nk’ingabo cyangwa imitwe yitwaje intwaro izingiyeho intambara n’akaga ku kiremwamuntu mu Burasirazuba bwa RDC.”
claim_sources.translation_en: She said: “In its latest report, HRW cannot take on the responsibility (of conducting an impartial investigation) while ignoring some of what it itself stated: Kinshasa arms, funds and works closely with the FDLR, Wazalendo, foreign mercenaries and the Burundian army, all of which are regarded as forces or armed groups entangled in the war and in harm to humanity in eastern DRC.”

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ibiro by’Umuvugizi wa Guverinoma byatangaje ko nta mukozi n’umwe wa HRW wageze aho ibivugwa byabereye. Biti “Nta muntu ushinzwe gukora iperereza wakandagije ikirenge cye ahantu iyi raporo ivuga. Nta kuhasura byigeze bibaho, nta gutaburura imirambo hagamijwe iperereza ndetse nta bizamini by’abahanga byo muri laboratwari byigeze bikorwa.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Office of the Government Spokesperson stated that not a single HRW worker had gone to where the alleged events took place. It said: “No investigator has set foot at the places this report speaks of. There has been no visit there, no exhumation of bodies for investigation and no expert laboratory tests have been carried out.”

claim_sources.excerpt_original: According to Kigali, no investigators visited the locations where the alleged abuses occurred, no exhumations were conducted and no forensic examinations were undertaken.

According to Kigali, HRW's own report acknowledges that the Congolese army has supported armed groups opposed to M23, including the FDLR, a militia formed by perpetrators of the 1994 Genocide against the Tutsi.

The statement also cited passages in the report saying Congolese authorities armed, financed and coordinated operations with Wazalendo militias and that government support for such groups contributed to human rights violations.

Guverinoma yagaragaje ko HRW ivuga ko ifite amashusho yafashwe na satellite agaragaza ubwicanyi “bwakozwe n’ingabo z’u Rwanda na M23”, agaragaza ibimeze nk’imva zashyinguwemo abapfuye, ariko ko idashora guhamya niba ari imva koko cyangwa ibindi bintu bijya kumera nka zo.
claim_sources.translation_en: The government showed that HRW says it has satellite images showing killings “carried out by Rwandan forces and M23”, showing things resembling graves where the dead were buried, but that it cannot confirm whether they are graves indeed or other things that look like them.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: The statement also criticised HRW for presenting allegations as established facts while acknowledging uncertainty in sections of the report dealing with legal assessments and satellite imagery.

Rwanda faulted HRW's attempt to treat the RDF and M23 as a single actor. “Alleged M23 conduct cannot be treated as RDF conduct,” the statement said. The government accused HRW of applying “selective accountability” by focusing primarily on Rwanda and M23 while paying insufficient attention to abuses committed by Congolese government forces and their allies.

The response follows the publication of a 78-page HRW report on June 10, which alleges that Rwandan military forces and the M23 rebel movement carried out large-scale forced recruitment and abusive detention of captured combatants and civilians in North and South Kivu provinces between mid-2024 and December 2025.
Makolo yavuze ko umuti urambye kuri iki kibazo ari ukubahiriza amasezerano ya Washington, n’ubuhuza butabogamye, hagamijwe kurangiza intambara no kwimakaza ubufatanye bw’akarere.
claim_sources.translation_en: Makolo said the lasting solution to this problem is to respect the Washington agreement and impartial mediation, aimed at ending the war and promoting regional cooperation.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Makolo added that the Washington peace accords remain “the path forward” for addressing insecurity in eastern DRC through dialogue, accountability and regional cooperation.
On the FDLR, Rwanda highlighted the militia as a key security threat and accused HRW of failing to adequately examine its role and links to Congolese government forces.

Bagaragaza kandi ko uyu muryango nta na hamwe wigeze uvuga amazina y’Abanye-Congo cyangwa abo muri Wazalendo usabira ibihano. Biti “HRW ijora bikomeye u Rwanda na M23, mu gihe ubufasha Kinshasa iha imitwe yitwaje intwaro igira urugomo buvugwaho by’amahushuka.”
claim_sources.translation_en: They also say that this organisation nowhere mentioned the names of Congolese or Wazalendo members for whom it seeks sanctions. They said: “HRW harshly criticises Rwanda and M23, while the support Kinshasa gives to violent armed groups is mentioned only superficially (in passing).”

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Uretse u Rwanda, muri Gicurasi 2026, Ihuriro AFC/M23 ryashinje Human Rights Watch kuriharabika, gutangaza ibinyoma no kwirengagiza ukuri, mu buryo bushimangira ko ukorera mu murongo w’ubutegetsi bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo.
claim_sources.translation_en: Besides Rwanda, in May 2026 the AFC/M23 alliance accused Human Rights Watch of smearing it, publishing lies and ignoring the truth, in a way that, it said, shows HRW works in line with the government of the Democratic Republic of Congo.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ryatanze ubu butumwa risubiza raporo ya HRW yasohotse ku wa 14 Gicurasi, ishinja abarwanyi baryo kwicira abasivili mu Mujyi wa Uvira, gufata abagore ku ngufu no gushimuta abantu hagati y’Ukuboza 2025 na Mutarama 2026.
claim_sources.translation_en: It gave this message in response to the HRW report released on 14 May, which accuses its fighters of killing civilians in Uvira city, raping women and abducting people between December 2025 and January 2026.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Iri huriro ryagaragaje ko ingabo za RDC zikomeje gukorana n’umutwe w’iterabwoba wa FDLR washinzwe n’abagize uruhare muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994, ariko ko HRW idashaka kubivugaho muri raporo zayo. AFC/M23 yatangaje ko kubogama HRW yagaragaje muri raporo yayo gutuma uyu muryango utakarizwa icyizere mu buryo bukomeye, ibituma ibyo utangaza bidahabwa agaciro.
claim_sources.translation_en: This alliance showed that the DRC army continues to work with the terrorist FDLR group founded by people who took part in the 1994 Genocide against the Tutsi, but that HRW does not want to talk about it in its reports. AFC/M23 stated that HRW's bias in its report makes this organisation lose trust seriously, which means what it publishes is not given value.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ubutumwe bwa Makolo bwanyuze ku rubuga X kuri uyu wa 14 Gicurasi 2026, bugira buti “HRW ifite uburyo ikora kandi u Rwanda ruhora ari igipimo cyayo kigaragaza ko yakoze neza.”
claim_sources.translation_en: Makolo's message, which went through the X platform on this 14 May 2026, reads: “HRW has a way of working and Rwanda is always its yardstick showing that it has worked well.”

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Makolo yanengaga raporo HRW yashyize hanze ku wa 13 Gicurasi, ishinja ingabo z’u Rwanda n’abarwanyi b’umutwe witwaje intwaro wa M23 kwica abasivili, kubashimuta no gufata ku ngufu abagore mu Mujyi wa Uvira, kuva tariki ya 10 Ukuboza 2025 kugeza ku ya 17 Mutarama 2026.
claim_sources.translation_en: Makolo was criticising the report HRW released on 13 May, which accuses Rwandan forces and fighters of the armed group M23 of killing civilians, abducting them and raping women in Uvira city, from 10 December 2025 until 17 January 2026.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ni kenshi Leta y’u Rwanda yagaragarije umuryango mpuzamahanga ko nta ngabo zarwo ziri mu burasirazuba bwa RDC, isobanura ko icyo rwakoze ari ugushyira ingamba z’ubwirinzi ku mupaka kugira ngo ibibazo byo muri iki gihugu cy’abaturanyi bitarugeramo.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Rwandan State has often shown the international community that none of its troops are in eastern DRC, explaining that what it did was to put defensive measures on the border so that the problems of this neighbouring country do not reach it.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Muri Mutarama 2025, imitwe y’ingabo irimo FDLR yarashe mu Mujyi wa Rubavu ubwo yari ihanganiye na M23 mu Mujyi wa Goma. Ibisasu byinshi mu byarashwe byapfubijwe n’ingabo z’u Rwanda
claim_sources.translation_en: In January 2025, armed units including the FDLR fired into Rubavu town while they were fighting M23 in Goma city. Many of the shells fired were neutralised by Rwandan forces.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: HRW yasobanuye ko mu bo waganiriye na bo harimo abayobozi bo mu Burundi na RDC barimo n’abasirikare, ibituma raporo yawo ishidikanywaho cyane kubera ko abo ni bo bahanganye n’abarwanyi ba M23 mu bice birimo Uvira.
claim_sources.translation_en: HRW explained that among those it spoke to were officials from Burundi and the DRC, including soldiers, which makes its report highly doubtful because they are the ones fighting M23 fighters in areas including Uvira.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ihuriro ry’ingabo za Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo ryashinjwe kurasa indege ya gisivili yari ijyanye imiti n’ibiribwa muri Komini Minembwe mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa 27 Kanama 2026. Umwe mu bofisiye b’umutwe wa MRDP-Twirwaneho ugenzura Minembwe, Colonel Fidèle Rugabo, yatangaje ko iyi ndege yarashwe n’igisasu cy’imbunda yari ku butaka ubwo yari igeze mu gace ka Bikuba.
claim_sources.translation_en: The alliance of forces of the Democratic Republic of Congo was accused of shooting at a civilian plane that was taking medicines and food to Minembwe commune on the morning of this 27 August 2026. An officer of the MRDP-Twirwaneho group that controls Minembwe, Colonel Fidèle Rugabo, stated that the plane was hit by a shell from a gun that was on the ground when it reached the Bikuba area.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Col Rugabo yagize ati “MRDP yamaganiye kure ihanurwa ry’indege ya gisivili yari itwaye imiti n’ibiribwa.”
claim_sources.translation_en: Col Rugabo said: “MRDP strongly condemned the shooting down of a civilian plane that was carrying medicines and food.”

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Un avion a été abattu jeudi près de l'aérodrome de Minembwe, dans les hauts plateaux du territoire de Fizi (Sud-Kivu). L'incident est survenu alors que la mission du Mécanisme conjoint de vérification élargi (MCVE+), composée d'experts de l'ONU, de la RDC et du Rwanda, poursuit ses opérations de contrôle du cessez-le-feu prévu par les accords de Doha.
claim_sources.translation_en: A plane was shot down on Thursday near the Minembwe aerodrome, in the highlands of Fizi territory (South Kivu). The incident occurred while the mission of the expanded Joint Verification Mechanism (MCVE+), made up of experts from the UN, the DRC and Rwanda, continues its monitoring of the ceasefire provided for by the Doha accords.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les circonstances de la destruction de l'appareil et la nature de sa cargaison font l'objet de versions opposées.
claim_sources.translation_en: The circumstances of the destruction of the aircraft and the nature of its cargo are the subject of opposing versions.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: De son côté, Rugabo Fidèle, membre influent de la coalition Twirwaneho-M23, a confirmé publiquement la destruction de l’avion. Dans une déclaration, il accuse les FARDC d’avoir abattu « un avion civil transportant des médicaments et des aliments » et qualifie l’incident de « provocation » intervenue deux jours après le départ de l’équipe du MCVE+ de Minembwe.
claim_sources.translation_en: For his part, Rugabo Fidèle, an influential member of the Twirwaneho-M23 coalition, publicly confirmed the destruction of the plane. In a statement, he accuses the FARDC of having shot down “a civil aircraft carrying medicines and food” and describes the incident as a “provocation” that occurred two days after the MCVE+ team left Minembwe.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Des sources sécuritaires congolaises soutiennent qu’il effectuait une mission de ravitaillement au profit des positions rebelles dans les hauts plateaux.
claim_sources.translation_en: Congolese security sources maintain that it was carrying out a resupply mission for the rebel positions in the highlands.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: À ce stade, aucune source indépendante n’a confirmé si l’appareil était civil ou militaire, ni le contenu exact de sa cargaison. Les autorités congolaises n’ont pas encore publié de communiqué détaillant les circonstances de l’opération.
claim_sources.translation_en: At this stage, no independent source has confirmed whether the aircraft was civil or military, nor the exact content of its cargo. The Congolese authorities have not yet published a communiqué detailing the circumstances of the operation.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Des sources liées aux Twirwaneho-AFC/M23 présentent l’appareil comme un avion civil reliant Bukavu à Minembwe, avec des médicaments et du matériel à bord. Elles évoquent deux membres d’équipage. L’administrateur du territoire de Fizi, Sammy Kalonji Badibanga, livre une autre version. Il affirme que l’avion venait du Rwanda et transportait des militaires, du matériel ainsi que des vivres.
claim_sources.translation_en: Sources linked to Twirwaneho-AFC/M23 present the aircraft as a civil aircraft linking Bukavu to Minembwe, with medicines and equipment on board. They mention two crew members. The Fizi territory administrator, Sammy Kalonji Badibanga, gives another version. He says the aircraft came from Rwanda and was carrying soldiers, equipment and food.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Jeudi, un avion civil transportant des médicaments a été abattu près de Minembwe. Un incident survenu au lendemain d’une mission de vérification du cessez-le-feu. L’administrateur du territoire de Fizi sous le régime de Kinshasa a revendiqué l’attaque, affirmant que l’avion avait été abattu par les FARDC.
claim_sources.translation_en: On Thursday, a civil plane carrying medicines was shot down near Minembwe. An incident that occurred the day after a ceasefire verification mission. The territory administrator of Fizi under the Kinshasa regime claimed the attack, stating that the plane had been shot down by the FARDC.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Iyi ndege ihanuwe nyuma y’aho ku wa 25 Kanama, urwego mpuzamahanga ruhuriweho rushinzwe kugenzura iyubahirizwa ry’agahenge (EJVM+) rusuye Minembwe, rukagenzura ingaruka z’ibitero byahagabwe.
claim_sources.translation_en: This plane was shot down after, on 25 August, the joint international body in charge of monitoring respect for the ceasefire (EJVM+) visited Minembwe and checked the effects of the attacks launched.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi w’ihuriro AFC/M23, Lawrence Kanyuka, yatangaje ko ingabo za RDC, iz’u Burundi, Wazalendo, FDLR n’abacanshuro b’abanyamahanga, byatangiye kugaba ibitero muri Point-Zero, Nyaruhinga na Mukoko muri Minembwe mu masaa moya y’igitondo. Kanyuka yasobanuye ko muri ibi bitero, ihuriro ry’ingabo za Leta ya RDC riri kwifashisha drones z’intambara ndetse n’imbunda ziremereye
claim_sources.translation_en: AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka stated that the forces of the DRC, those of Burundi, Wazalendo, the FDLR and foreign mercenaries started launching attacks at Point-Zero, Nyaruhinga and Mukoko in Minembwe at around seven in the morning. Kanyuka explained that in these attacks the alliance of forces of the DRC government is using war drones as well as heavy guns

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Hari amakuru avuga ko kubera gutsindwa, ubuyobozi bw’igisirikare cy’u Burundi bwasabye abasirikare bacyo gutaha bwangu mu rwego rwo kwirinda ko ubuzima bwabo bwakomeza gutikirira mu ntambara yo muri RDC.
claim_sources.translation_en: There is information saying that, because of defeat, the leadership of the Burundian army asked its soldiers to return home quickly in order to avoid their lives continuing to be lost in the war in the DRC.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kuva mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa 8 Ukuboza 2025, ingabo nyinshi z’u Burundi, Imbonerakure na Wazalendo ziri guhungira i Bujumbura ziturutse mu mujyi wa Uvira. Abaturage bababonye bavuga ko basaga n’abananiwe cyane.
claim_sources.translation_en: Since the morning of this 8 December 2025, many Burundian troops, Imbonerakure and Wazalendo are fleeing to Bujumbura from Uvira city. Residents who saw them say they looked extremely tired.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ingabo z’u Burundi, iza RDC na Wazalendo biri kurushwa imbaraga, kuko byambuwe ibice byinshi. Abarwanyi ba AFC/M23 bavuye muri santere ya Kamanyola mu cyumweru gishize, ubu bageze mu gace ka Sange kari mu ntera y’ibilometero 30 berekeza mu mujyi wa Uvira.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Burundian, DRC and Wazalendo forces are being overpowered, as they were stripped of many areas. AFC/M23 fighters left Kamanyola centre last week and have now reached the Sange area, which is 30 kilometres towards Uvira city.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: U Burundi bwohereje abasirikare hafi ibihumbi 20 muri Kivu y'Amajyepfo. Inyinshi zagiye mu bice bikikije Minembwe muri teritwari ya Uvira, Fizi na Mwenga, zifunga inzira Abanyamulenge banyuragamo bajya ku masoko no ku mavuriro.
claim_sources.translation_en: Burundi sent nearly twenty thousand soldiers to South Kivu. Many went to areas around Minembwe in Uvira, Fizi and Mwenga territories, closing the routes the Banyamulenge used to go to markets and clinics.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Lieutenant Colonel Athanase Minani wari umuyobozi wa batayo ya munani y'Ingabo z'u Burundi ziri kurwanira mu Burasirazuba bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, biravugwa ko yishwe arashwe n'umutwe wa AFC/M23.
claim_sources.translation_en: Lieutenant Colonel Athanase Minani, who was commander of the eighth battalion of the Burundian Forces fighting in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, it is said was killed, shot by the AFC/M23 group.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ni amakuru yatangiye gucicikana ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa 5 Ukuboza 2025, aho bivugwa ko yaguye mu mirwano yahitanye n'abandi basirikare benshi b'u Burundi mu gace ka Luvungi, barwana ku ruhande rw'ingabo za RDC, FARDC, bahanganye na AFC/M23.
claim_sources.translation_en: It is news that began to spread on the evening of this 5 December 2025, where it is said that he fell in fighting that killed many other Burundian soldiers in the Luvungi area, fighting on the side of the DRC forces, FARDC, against AFC/M23.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Pacifique Nininahazwe, wabitangarije ku rukuta rwe rwa X. Yagize ati "Lieutenant Colonel Athanase Minani (SS1564), Umuyobozi wa batayo ya munani y'ingabo z'u Burundi muri RDC (TAFOC), yishwe arashwe mu ijoro ryakeye (n'abarinzi be batatu), mu mirwano ikomeje muri RDC."
claim_sources.translation_en: Pacifique Nininahazwe, who announced it on his X page. He said: “Lieutenant Colonel Athanase Minani (SS1564), commander of the eighth battalion of the Burundian forces in the DRC (TAFOC), was shot dead last night (with his three guards), in the continuing fighting in the DRC.”

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Yakomeje avuga ko "ni we musirikare ufite ipeti ryo hejuru mu gisirikare cy'u Burundi (FDNB) wiciwe muri iyi ntambara."
claim_sources.translation_en: He went on to say that “he is the soldier with the highest rank in the Burundian army (FDNB) killed in this war.”

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Depuis le 1er décembre, de nombreux militaires burundais ont été tués dans les localités de Lubarika, Mitambili, Katogota, Luvungi et Sange, où les affrontements sont particulièrement violents. Parmi les victimes figure le lieutenant-colonel Athanase Minani, le plus haut gradé burundais tué depuis le début de l’intervention officielle en RDC.
claim_sources.translation_en: Since 1 December, many Burundian soldiers have been killed in the localities of Lubarika, Mitambili, Katogota, Luvungi and Sange, where the clashes are particularly violent. Among the victims is Lieutenant-Colonel Athanase Minani, the highest-ranking Burundian officer killed since the start of the official intervention in the DRC.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Yaba igisirikare cy'u Burundi cyangwa AFC/M23 bahanganiye muri RDC, nta ruhande na rumwe ruremeza amakuru y'urupfu rw'uyu musirikare ukomeye w'u Burundi.
claim_sources.translation_en: Neither the Burundian army nor AFC/M23, which are in conflict in the DRC, has confirmed the news of the death of this senior Burundian soldier.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Amakuru yizewe agera kuri IGIHE avuga ko AFC/M23 yamenye ko ingabo za RDC, iz’u Burundi na Wazalendo bigiye kuyigabaho ibitero muri Kamanyola, ifata icyemezo cyo kubitanga kurasa.
claim_sources.translation_en: Reliable information reaching IGIHE says AFC/M23 learned that the DRC, Burundian and Wazalendo forces were about to launch attacks on it in Kamanyola, and it took the decision to get ahead of them in firing.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuntu wa hafi y’ubuyobozi bukuru bwa AFC/M23 yasobanuye ko ibisasu byumvikanye mu gitondo cya tariki ya 2 Ukuboza byarashwe n’abarwanyi babo, kandi ko byahungabanyije bikomeye ihuriro rya Leta ya RDC.
claim_sources.translation_en: A person close to the top leadership of AFC/M23 explained that the shells heard on the morning of 2 December were fired by their fighters, and that they seriously shook the DRC government alliance.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuntu wa hafi y’ubuyobozi bukuru bwa AFC/M23 yasobanuye ko ibisasu byumvikanye mu gitondo cya tariki ya 2 Ukuboza byarashwe n’abarwanyi babo, kandi ko byahungabanyije bikomeye ihuriro rya Leta ya RDC. Uwo munsi, ingabo za RDC n’iz’u Burundi na zo zarashe muri santere ya Kamanyola imaze amezi hafi 10 igenzura na AFC/M23, ibisasu byazo bisenya inzu z’abaturage n’ibikorwaremezo. Hapfuye abaturage batatu, abandi barakomereka.
claim_sources.translation_en: That day, the DRC and Burundian forces also fired in Kamanyola centre, which AFC/M23 has controlled for almost 10 months, their shells destroying civilians' houses and infrastructure. Three civilians died, and others were injured.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kuva mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa 5 Ukuboza 2025, Ingabo za RDC, iz’u Burundi na Wazalendo ziri kugaba ibitero mu bice byo muri Teritwari ya Uvira birimo Katogota, Kamanyola no muri Gurupoma ya Luvungi.
claim_sources.translation_en: Since the morning of this 5 December 2025, the DRC forces, Burundian forces and Wazalendo are launching attacks in areas of Uvira territory including Katogota, Kamanyola and Luvungi groupement.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ibisasu byaguye muri Santere ya Luvungi byatumye abaturage benshi bahunga berekeza mu bindi bice byo muri Uvira bitari kuberamo imirwano nka Sange, Runingu, Ndolera no mu Mujyi wa Uvira.
claim_sources.translation_en: Shells that fell in Luvungi centre made many residents flee to other areas of Uvira where there was no fighting, such as Sange, Runingu, Ndolera and Uvira city.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuyobozi Wungirije wa AFC/M23 ushinzwe ibikorwa bya politiki, Bertrand Bisimwa, yatangaje ko ingabo z’Abarundi ziri mu Burundi ziri kurasa muri Kamanyola, Katogota na Luvungi. Ati “Muri iki gitondo, ingabo z’u Burundi ziri mu Burundi ziri gusuka ibisasu mu bice bituwe cyane muri Kamanyola, Katogota na Luvungi, zigateza imfu z’inzirakarengane zirimo abana, zigasenya inzu, amashuri, insengero n’amasoko.”
claim_sources.translation_en: The Deputy Leader of AFC/M23 in charge of political activities, Bertrand Bisimwa, stated that Burundian forces who are in Burundi are firing into Kamanyola, Katogota and Luvungi. He said: “This morning, Burundian forces who are in Burundi are pouring shells onto densely inhabited areas in Kamanyola, Katogota and Luvungi, causing deaths of innocents including children, destroying houses, schools, churches and markets.”

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Iyi mirwano ikomeje mu gihe ku wa 4 Ukuboza 2025, u Rwanda na RDC byashyize umukono ku masezerano y'amahoro, ibintu AFC/M23 yavuze ko ibyo biganiro n'ayo masezerano bitayireba.
claim_sources.translation_en: This fighting continues while on 4 December 2025 Rwanda and the DRC signed a peace agreement, something that AFC/M23 said these talks and that agreement do not concern it.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Earlier this week, media outlets in DRC began reporting that AFC/M23 was withdrawing fighters from areas in the Lubero, Lunyasenge, Bukununu, Musiya, Katondi, and Kipese territories, relocating them to Alimbongo, Kirumba, and Kanyabayonga. These reports suggested that the move was prompted by pressure from the United States government on AFC/M23.

In a statement released by the Governor of North Kivu Province, Erasto Bahati, these reports were dismissed, with the governor clarifying that what is happening is simply a routine rotation of troops.
"The leadership of North Kivu Province reassures all citizens that the activities occurring along the battlefront are part of the regular military troop rotations within AFC/M23."

"It is completely different from the rumors fueled by social media and the Kinshasa government, which aim to confuse and frighten people who are living in peace and security. AFC/M23 remains committed to protecting all citizens from harm, regardless of its origin."

In an interview with Jeune Afrique published on May 10, 2026, Ndayishimiye discussed the closure of the Gatumba and Vugizo border crossings between Burundi and DR Congo on the South Kivu side. He claimed the decision was linked to the proximity of M23 fighters near Burundi’s borders, alleging that the group operates with Rwanda’s backing.

According to Ndayishimiye, Burundi considers the presence of M23 fighters near its borders as a security concern, although he expressed hope that the Washington peace agreement would increase pressure aimed at ending the tensions.

Ndayishimiye maintained that Burundian troops were sent to DR Congo to assist Congolese forces against their enemies rather than to defend Burundi itself. He explained that the deployment was carried out under regional arrangements that assigned South Kivu as Burundi’s operational zone.

He further argued that despite efforts by regional actors, fighting continued because some countries failed to contain the conflict. According to him, only Uganda and Burundi remained actively engaged, with Burundian troops operating under the directives of the Congolese army.

The Burundian leader also repeated accusations that Rwanda supports RED Tabara, a group Burundi describes as a terrorist organization responsible for attacks inside the country. Rwanda has consistently denied the allegations, insisting that it does not support any group seeking to destabilize Burundi.

In response, Ndayishimiye argued that he had previously asked President Paul Kagame to provide intelligence on FDLR positions, insisting that Burundi would attack the group if such information were made available.

When asked how Burundian troops could avoid cooperating with FDLR while operating alongside FARDC, which has repeatedly been accused of collaborating with the group, Ndayishimiye acknowledged that Congolese forces work with FDLR. However, he argued that Burundian troops operate separately under Congolese command structures and do not mix with those groups

He proposed coordinated military action involving Rwanda, DR Congo, Burundi and Uganda against armed groups operating in the region, saying such cooperation could help reassure Rwanda about its security concerns.

Under bilateral agreements signed between Burundi and DR Congo in 2022 and 2023, Burundi deployed more than 20,000 troops to South Kivu. The deployment was reduced in early December 2025 after M23 fighters captured several areas in the Ruzizi Plain and the city of Uvira.

Abantu barindwi bapfuye abandi batatu barakomereka bikomeye, mu gihe undi umwe yagize ibikomere byoroheje nyuma y’igisasu cyatezwe n’abo AFC/M23 yise abanzi mu gace ka Jomba, mu Murenge wa Gikoro, mu Mudugudu wa Rugunga, mu Ntara ya Rutshuru.
claim_sources.translation_en: Seven people died and three others were seriously injured, while another one had light injuries, after a bomb planted by those AFC/M23 called enemies in the Jomba area, in Gikoro sector, in Rugunga village, in Rutshuru province.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ibi byabaye ku wa Gatandatu, tariki ya 12 Nzeri 2026, nyuma y’uko umwana wavumbuye igisasu mu murima atabizi yatangiye kugikorakora, bikaza kurangira gituritse.
claim_sources.translation_en: This happened on Saturday, 12 September 2026, after a child who discovered a bomb in a field without knowing it began to fiddle with it, and it ended up exploding.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Itangazo rya AFC/M23 rivuga ko abakomeretse bahise bajyanwa ku Bitaro Bikuru bya Rugunga muri Teritwari ya Rutshuru.
claim_sources.translation_en: The AFC/M23 communiqué says the injured were immediately taken to Rugunga General Hospital in Rutshuru territory.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umutwe wa AFC-M23 wavuze ko wababajwe cyane n’iki gitero, unihanganisha imiryango yabuze ababo ndetse n’inshuti z’abahitanywe n’iturika ry’iki gisasu.
claim_sources.translation_en: The AFC-M23 group said it was deeply saddened by this attack, and it condoled with the families that lost their loved ones and the friends of those killed by the explosion of this bomb.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: AFC-M23 yasabye abaturage bari mu bice byabohowe gukurikiza amabwiriza yatanzwe ajyanye no kwirinda ibiturika bikiri mu butaka. Yasabye kandi abaturage kwirinda gukorakora, kwimura cyangwa kugerageza gusenya ikintu bakeka ko gishobora kuba igisasu, haba mu murima, mu rugo cyangwa ku muhanda
claim_sources.translation_en: AFC-M23 asked residents in the liberated areas to follow the instructions given on avoiding explosives still in the ground. It also asked residents to avoid touching, moving or trying to dismantle anything they suspect may be a bomb, whether in a field, at home or on the road.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ingabo za Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo n’abarwanyi b'Ihuriro ry’imitwe yitwaje intwaro rya Wazalendo baraye barasaniye mu Mujyi wa Uvira mu Ntara ya Kivu y’Amajyepfo kubera kutumvikana. Amasasu menshi muri uyu mujyi wegereye Ikiyaga cya Tanganyika yumvikanye kuva mu masaa Mbiri y’ijoro ryo ku wa 5 Nzeri 2025. Hifashishwaga imbunda zirimo Ak-47 na machine gun.
claim_sources.translation_en: The forces of the Democratic Republic of Congo and fighters of the Wazalendo alliance of armed groups shot at each other overnight in Uvira city in South Kivu because of a disagreement. A lot of gunfire in this city near Lake Tanganyika was heard from eight in the evening of 5 September 2025. Guns including AK-47 and machine guns were used.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Amakuru avuga ko abarwanyi ba Wazalendo barasanye n’ingabo za RDC ari abo mu mutwe witwaje intwaro uyoborwa na ‘Général’ John Makanaki bamaze igihe kirekire bakorera muri Kivu y’Amajyepfo.
claim_sources.translation_en: Information says the Wazalendo fighters who exchanged fire with the DRC forces are from the armed group led by 'Général' John Makanaki, who have been operating in South Kivu for a long time.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kuva tariki ya 2 Nzeri 2025, Wazalendo bari mu myigaragambyo ikomeye muri Uvira, isaba ko umusirikare wa RDC, Brig Gen. Gasita Olivier, ava muri uyu mujyi kuko ngo ni Umunyarwanda. Bashidikanya ku bwenegihugu bwe bashingiye ku kuba ari Umunyamulenge.
claim_sources.translation_en: Since 2 September 2025, Wazalendo have been in a major protest in Uvira, demanding that the DRC soldier, Brig Gen. Gasita Olivier, leave this city because he is said to be Rwandan. They doubt his nationality because he is a Munyamulenge.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ubuzima bwarahagaze muri uyu mujyi kuko Wazalendo yafunze umuhanda munini waho, ihagarika ibikorwa byose abaturage bakesha imibereho n’iterambere. Bavuze ko bazahagarika imyigaragambyo mu gihe ubuyobozi buzaba bukuye Brig Gen Gasita aha hantu.
claim_sources.translation_en: Life has come to a standstill in this city because Wazalendo closed its main road, halting all activities by which residents earn their livelihood and development. They said they would stop the protest when the authorities remove Brig Gen Gasita from this place.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ku wa 5 Nzeri 2025, Meya w’agateganyo w’uyu mujyi, Kifara Kapenda Kik’v, yayoboye inama yari igamije guhosha umwuka mubi, yitabiriwe n’abayobozi bo muri Wazalendo barimo Makanaki na 'Général' William Amur Yakutumba ariko nta musaruro yagezeho kuko imyigaragambyo yakomeje.
claim_sources.translation_en: On 5 September 2025, the acting Mayor of this city, Kifara Kapenda Kik’v, led a meeting aimed at calming the bad atmosphere, attended by Wazalendo leaders including Makanaki and 'Général' William Amur Yakutumba, but it achieved no result because the protest continued.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Muri iyi nama yumvikanyemo urusaku rwinshi rwa Wazalendo, Yakutumba yagize ati "Uwo muyobozi woherejwe hano, yitwa Gen Gasita, ntitumushaka hano muri Uvira."
claim_sources.translation_en: At this meeting where a lot of noise from Wazalendo was heard, Yakutumba said: “That leader who was sent here, called Gen Gasita, we do not want him here in Uvira.”

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Yakutumba yashimangiye ko Brig Gen Gasita agomba kuva muri Uvira, Makanaki agaragaza ko nibigera tariki ya 8 Nzeri uyu musirikare ataragenda, abarwanyi be bazafunga umupaka wa RDC n’u Burundi n’icyambu cya Uvira ku Kiyaga cya Tanganyika.
claim_sources.translation_en: Yakutumba insisted that Brig Gen Gasita must leave Uvira, Makanaki showed that if 8 September arrives and this soldier has not left, his fighters will close the DRC-Burundi border and the Uvira port on Lake Tanganyika.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi w'Ingabo za RDC, Gen Maj. Sylvain Ekenge Bomusa, yari yasabye Wazalendo kwemera kwakira Brig Gen Gasita, abasobanurira ko uyu musirikare atigeze agambanira igihugu kandi ko yashyizweho n'Umukuru w'Igihugu ariko aba barwanyi babyanze, bagasaba ko asimbuzwa.
claim_sources.translation_en: The spokesperson of the DRC Forces, Maj Gen Sylvain Ekenge Bomusa, had asked Wazalendo to accept Brig Gen Gasita, explaining to them that this soldier had never betrayed the country and that he was appointed by the Head of State, but these fighters refused it and asked that he be replaced.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: More than eight months later, on the morning of September 25, 2025, various media outlets reported that M23 had deployed additional troops and weapons in this territory to strengthen its control over areas such as Kipese, Katondi, Munyakandomi, Vulera, and Kirumba.
In February 2025, M23 captured the area of Kitsombiro in Lubero after intense clashes with the DRC’s armed forces (FARDC).

M23 has not only increased its presence in Lubero but has also bolstered its forces in the localities of Rusamambu and Bukumbirwa, signaling plans to expand its control to other parts of South Kivu Province.

In a statement released on Thursday, April 3, 2025, AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka affirmed that the rebel group had repositioned its forces in the region. He warned, however, that any aggression from Kinshasa would trigger an immediate response.

"If the forces of the Kinshasa regime persist in their provocations or attack civilians in the liberated areas as well as our positions, the gesture of goodwill undertaken will be immediately cancelled, and we will eliminate the threat at its source," Kanyuka said.
The M23 took control of Walikale on March 19, 2025, notably seizing the Kigoma airstrip, after conquering several surrounding localities, including Ngora, Kisima and Mubanda.

Subsequently, the rebel group announced its withdrawal, describing this decision as "a choice aimed at creating a climate conducive to political dialogue". Despite this withdrawal, the M23 called on local authorities and residents to guarantee security in the region.

Guverineri w’Intara ya Kivu y’Amajyaruguru washyizweho n’ihuriro AFC/M23 rirwanya ubutegetsi bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, Bahati Musanga Erasto, yahinduye ubuyobozi bw’Umujyi wa Goma.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Governor of North Kivu Province appointed by the AFC/M23 alliance fighting the government of the Democratic Republic of Congo, Bahati Musanga Erasto, changed the leadership of Goma city.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Itangazo ryo ku wa 9 Mata 2026 rigaragaza ko Kisuba Ngabo Désiré yagizwe Meya wa Goma, asimbuye Julien Katembo Ndalieni wagizwe Umuyobozi wa teritwari ya Lubero. Kisuba yari asanzwe ari Visi Meya w’uyu mujyi.
claim_sources.translation_en: The notice of 9 April 2026 shows that Kisuba Ngabo Désiré was made Mayor of Goma, replacing Julien Katembo Ndalieni who was made Head of Lubero territory. Kisuba was already Deputy Mayor of this city.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Nshimiyimana Juvénal wari Umuyobozi ushinzwe ubukangurambaga no gushaka abarwanyi bashya muri AFC/M23 yagizwe Visi Meya w’Umujyi wa Goma.
claim_sources.translation_en: Nshimiyimana Juvénal, who was the official in charge of mobilisation and recruiting new fighters in AFC/M23, was made Deputy Mayor of Goma city.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mu kiganiro Katembo yagiranye na IGIHE muri Mutarama 2026, yatangaje ko ubu Goma itekanye, kandi ko ibikorerwamo byose birimo ubucuruzi bigenda neza kurusha uko byahoze.
claim_sources.translation_en: In an interview Katembo had with IGIHE in January 2026, he stated that Goma is now safe, and that everything done there, including trade, is going better than it used to.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: AFC/M23 yafashe umujyi wa Goma tariki ya 27 Mutarama 2025. Yashyizeho abayobozi bashya kugira ngo bayifashe kuwusubiza ku murongo mu rwego rw’umutekano, imibereho y’abaturage, banakurikirane imishinga yo kubaka ibikorwaremezo.
claim_sources.translation_en: AFC/M23 took the city of Goma on 27 January 2025. It installed new officials to help it bring it back on track in security and the welfare of residents, and also follow infrastructure-building projects.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umutwe wa MDRP-Twirwaneho umaze iminsi ugaragaza ko ingabo nyinshi z’u Burundi zoherejwe mu bice bikikije Minembwe birimo Mikenke, Point-Zéro, Makombo, Mikalati, Gipupu, Murambya na Mwenga kugira ngo wicishe inzara Abanyamulenge zikoresheje uburyo bwo gufunga inzira banyuramo bajya guhaha.
claim_sources.translation_en: The MDRP-Twirwaneho group has for days been showing that many Burundian troops were deployed in areas around Minembwe including Mikenke, Point-Zéro, Makombo, Mikalati, Gipupu, Murambya and Mwenga in order to starve the Banyamulenge by closing the routes they pass to go shopping.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mu rugamba rukomeye rwabereye mu Kibaya cya Rusizi kuva mu ntangiriro z’icyumweru gishize, ingabo nyinshi z’u Burundi zavuye mu bice zagenzuraga nka Sange, Runingo, Kiliba no mu Mujyi wa Uvira, zihungana n’iza RDC, Wazalendo na FDLR.
claim_sources.translation_en: In the heavy fighting that took place in the Ruzizi Plain since the beginning of last week, many Burundian troops left areas they controlled such as Sange, Runingo, Kiliba and Uvira town, fleeing together with those of the DRC, Wazalendo and FDLR.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Bivugwa ko Ingabo z’u Burundi zavuye muri ibi bice hashingiwe ku ibwiriza zahawe n’ubuyobozi bukuru bwazo, kuko zatakarije abasirikare benshi mu ntambara barimo umwe mu bayobozi babo, Lt Col Athanase Minani, benshi bafatwa mpiri.
claim_sources.translation_en: It is said that the Burundian forces left these areas on the basis of an order they were given by their top leadership, because they lost many soldiers in the war including one of their leaders, Lt Col Athanase Minani, many being taken prisoner.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Imitwe ya Wazalendo ihamya ko hari abasirikare b’u Burundi bahunganye na yo mu ishyamba rya Itombwe, aho bagiye kwisuganyiriza kugira ngo bazatere ibice bitandukanye bigenzurwa na AFC/M23.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Wazalendo groups affirm that there are Burundian soldiers who fled with them in the Itombwe forest, where they have gone to regroup so as to attack various areas controlled by AFC/M23.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kuri uyu wa 11 Ukuboza 2025, Visi Perezida wa MRDP-Twirwaneho, Mugisha Nkurunziza Alexis, yatangarije IGIHE ingabo z’u Burundi zikiri nyinshi mu bice by’imisozi miremire bikikije Minembwe. Nkurunziza yagize ati “Ingabo z’u Burundi aho zari ziri ziracyahari. N’ubu Abarundi bari kurwana n’abaturage birwanaho hariya ku Irango, ku Ndondo.”
claim_sources.translation_en: On this 11 December 2025, the Vice-President of MRDP-Twirwaneho, Mugisha Nkurunziza Alexis, told IGIHE that Burundian troops are still numerous in the high areas around Minembwe. Nkurunziza said: “The Burundian troops are still where they were. Even now Burundians are fighting the villagers who defend themselves there at Irango, at Ndondo.”

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Tariki ya 6 Ukuboza, Ingabo z’u Burundi zafashe bugwate abaturage hafi 100 bari bagiye guhaha mu bice bihana imbibi na Minembwe. Twirwaneho yasobanuye ko bamwe bajyanywe mu kigo cya gisirikare cya Mikalati, abandi bajyanwa ahantu hatazwi.
claim_sources.translation_en: On 6 December, Burundian forces took hostage nearly 100 civilians who had gone shopping in areas bordering Minembwe. Twirwaneho explained that some were taken to the Mikalati military camp, others to an unknown place.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Nkurunziza yatangaje ko ubu ingabo z’u Burundi zamaze kurekura aba baturage, ariko ko zikomeje kugira uruhare rutaziguye bigabwa mu bice bikikije Minembwe.
claim_sources.translation_en: Nkurunziza stated that now the Burundian forces have released these residents, but that they continue to play a direct part in the attacks launched in the areas around Minembwe.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Nkurunziza yatangaje ko ingabo z’u Burundi zatesheje agaciro igihugu cyazo muri iyi ntambara, bityo ko amahitamo meza zikwiye kugira ari ugutaha, bitaba ibyo na zo zikazakurwa mu misozi miremire ikikije Minembwe ku ngufu.
claim_sources.translation_en: Nkurunziza stated that the Burundian troops had devalued their country in this war, so that the best choice they should make is to go home, otherwise they too would be removed by force from the high hills around Minembwe.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ubwo Umugaba Mukuru Wungirije wa AFC/M23, Brig Gen Bernard Byamungu yageraga mu Mujyi wa Uvira ku wa 10 Ukuboza 2025, yasabye ingabo z’u Burundi zikiri mu misozi miremire yo muri Kivu y’Amajyepfo ko zamanuka, zigataha mu mahoro.
claim_sources.translation_en: When the Deputy Chief of Staff of AFC/M23, Brig Gen Bernard Byamungu, arrived in Uvira city on 10 December 2025, he asked the Burundian troops still in the high hills of South Kivu to come down and go home in peace.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Brig Gen Byamungu yagize ati “Abari mu misozi itandukanye, turabasaba kumanuka, bambuke umupaka, basubire iwabo amahoro. Nta kibazo dufitanye n’Abarundi kubera ko turi abaturanyi, twahoze turi abaturanyi
claim_sources.translation_en: Brig Gen Byamungu said: “Those who are in the various hills, we ask them to come down, cross the border, and go back home in peace. We have no problem with the Burundians because we are neighbours, we have always been neighbours”

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Itangazo ryasohowe n’Umuvugizi w’igisirikare cya RDC muri Kivu y’Amajyepfo, Lt Reagan Mbuyi Kalonji, rivuga ko kiri kugenzura Minembwe kuva mu ijoro ryo ku wa 17 Kamena 2026, abarwanyi ba Twirwaneho bahunga berekeza muri Teritwari ya Walungu.
claim_sources.translation_en: A communiqué issued by the Spokesperson of the DRC army in South Kivu, Lt Reagan Mbuyi Kalonji, says it has been controlling Minembwe since the night of 17 June 2026, Twirwaneho fighters fleeing towards Walungu Territory.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Lt Kalonji kandi yatangaje ko ingabo za RDC zafashe abarwanyi benshi ba MRDP-Twirwaneho na M23, intwaro, amasasu n’ibindi bikoresho bya gisirikare byinshi.
claim_sources.translation_en: Lt Kalonji also stated that DRC forces captured many MRDP-Twirwaneho and M23 fighters, weapons, ammunition and many other military equipment.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kuri uyu wa 18 Kamena, IGIHE yavuganye na Visi Perezida wa MRDP-Twirwaneho ushinzwe ibikorwa bya politiki, dipolomasi n’imiyoborere, Alexis Mugisha Nkurunziza, avuga ko ibivugwa ko ingabo za RDC zafashe Minembwe ari ibinyoma. Umwe mu bofisiye bakuru ba MRDP-Twirwaneho, Col Fidèle Rugabo, yashimangiye ko Minembwe ikigenzurwa n’uyu mutwe
claim_sources.translation_en: On this 18 June, IGIHE spoke with the Vice-President of MRDP-Twirwaneho in charge of political affairs, diplomacy and governance, Alexis Mugisha Nkurunziza, who says that what is said, that DRC forces took Minembwe, is lies. One of the senior officers of MRDP-Twirwaneho, Col Fidèle Rugabo, affirmed that Minembwe is still controlled by this group

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Col Rugabo yagize ati "Ibinyoma ni byinshi. Kugeza ubu turacyari muri Minembwe. MRDP irakomeza irwanire abaturage bacu. Harakabaho M23."
claim_sources.translation_en: Col Rugabo said: “The lies are many. Up to now we are still in Minembwe. MRDP continues to fight for our people. Long live M23.”

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Perezida wa MRDP-Twirwaneho, Dr. Freddy Kaniki Rukema, yabwiye abanyamakuru bateraniye mu kiganiro cyabereye mu Mujyi wa Goma kuri uyu wa 18 Kamena ko ingabo za Leta ya RDC zakajije ibitero muri Minembwe. Dr. Kaniki yatangaje ko ibitero biri kugabwa ku basivili muri Minembwe byakajije umurego, kandi ko umuryango mpuzamahanga ubizi ariko ntacyo uri kubikoraho.
claim_sources.translation_en: The President of MRDP-Twirwaneho, Dr. Freddy Kaniki Rukema, told journalists gathered at a press conference held in Goma city this 18 June that the DRC government forces had intensified attacks in Minembwe. Dr. Kaniki stated that the attacks being launched on civilians in Minembwe had intensified, and that the international community knows about it but is doing nothing about it.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ntekereza ko bifuza ko baba babikoze. Ntibabikoze kandi ntibazabikora. Ibyo ubyandike ku rutare, ntibizahinduka.
claim_sources.translation_en: “I think they wish they had done it. They did not do it and they will not do it. Write that on stone, it will not change.”

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Amakuru yizewe ava muri Kivu y'Amajyepfo ahamya ko nubwo inzira zagoranye kuko iki gice ari icy’imisozi miremire, abarwanyi b’umutwe wa M23 bageze muri Minembwe bajya kwifatanya na Twirwaneho kurinda umutekano w’abahatuye.
claim_sources.translation_en: Reliable information from South Kivu affirms that although the routes were difficult because this area is mountainous, M23 fighters reached Minembwe to join Twirwaneho in guarding the security of those who live there.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ingabo z’u Burundi na zo zageze ku rugamba kugira ngo zifashe iza RDC gufata iyi Komini ariko amakuru ahari avuga ko ziherutse kuhatakariza abasirikare benshi, imirambo imwe muri yo ipakirwa mu ikamyo, ijyanwa i Bujumbura.
claim_sources.translation_en: Burundian troops also arrived at the front to help the DRC troops take this commune, but information available says they recently lost many soldiers there, the bodies of some of them being loaded on a truck and taken to Bujumbura.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ku wa 25 Ukuboza 2025, iyi santere yagaragayemo abarwanyi bo mu ihuriro Wazalendo rishyigikiwe n’ubutegetsi bwa RDC, bemeza ko bakuye AFC/M23 muri iyi santere.
claim_sources.translation_en: On 25 December 2025, fighters of the Wazalendo alliance, supported by the DRC government, appeared in this centre, saying they had driven AFC/M23 out of this centre.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi w’abarwanyi bagaragaye muri Makobola witwa Winston Makufuli yagize ati “Abaturage bakomeze batuze, Makobola twayisubije. Turashimira Perezida Félix Tshisekedi wohereje ingabo za FARDC kugira ngo zirinde umutekano w’igihugu cyacu.”
claim_sources.translation_en: The spokesperson of the fighters seen in Makobola, named Winston Makufuli, said: “Residents should stay calm, we took back Makobola. We thank President Félix Tshisekedi who sent FARDC troops to protect the security of our country.”

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Nubwo Makufuli yatangaje ko ihuriro ry’ingabo za Leta ya RDC ryakuye AFC/M23 muri Makobola, amakuru yizewe ahamya ko AFC/M23 yahavuye nta mirwano ibaye kuko ku wa 25 Ukuboza hari hatuje, abaturage bizihiza Noheli.
claim_sources.translation_en: Although Makufuli stated that the alliance of DRC government forces drove AFC/M23 out of Makobola, reliable information affirms that AFC/M23 left there without any fighting taking place, because on 25 December it was calm, residents celebrating Christmas.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuturage wo muri Makobola yagize ati "Saa munani z’amanywa ni bwo twababonye berekeza muri Uvira bafite imizigo yabo. Nyuma y’iminota mike, twabonye FARDC na Wazalendo bahagera.”
claim_sources.translation_en: A resident of Makobola said: “At two in the afternoon is when we saw them heading to Uvira with their luggage. A few minutes later, we saw FARDC and Wazalendo arriving there.”

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ku wa 24 Ukuboza, mu duce dutandukanye tw’iyi santere habaye imirwano ikomeye yatewe n’ibitero bya drones n’intwaro ziremereye byatangijwe n’ingabo za RDC na Wazalendo. Iyi mirwano yabereye muri Makobola 1, Makobola 2, Kiringi, Kirambi n’ahandi yatumye abaturage benshi bahungira mu bice bitekanye birimo umujyi wa Uvira uri mu majyaruguru.
claim_sources.translation_en: On 24 December, in various parts of this centre, there was heavy fighting caused by drone and heavy-weapon attacks launched by DRC forces and Wazalendo. This fighting which took place in Makobola 1, Makobola 2, Kiringi, Kirambi and elsewhere made many residents flee to safe areas including Uvira city in the north.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa 26 Ukuboza, Ingabo za RDC na Wazalendo byarashe ku cyambu cya Kalundu kiri ku Kiyaga cya Tanganyika, ahaherera ku mujyi wa Uvira, bikoresheje drones z’intambara.
claim_sources.translation_en: On the morning of this 26 December, DRC forces and Wazalendo fired at Kalundu port on Lake Tanganyika, by Uvira city, using war drones.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: AFC/M23 yemeza ko tariki ya 18 Ukuboza abarwanyi bayo bose bari bamaze kuva mu Mujyi wa Uvira, mu kubaka icyizere mu biganiro biyihuriza na Leta ya RDC i Doha muri Qatar, kugira ngo impande zombi zigere ku masezerano y’amahoro.
claim_sources.translation_en: AFC/M23 confirms that on 18 December all its fighters had left Uvira city, to build confidence in the talks bringing it together with the DRC government in Doha, Qatar, so that both sides reach a peace agreement.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Point-Zéro yafashwe n’abarwanyi ba AFC/M23 na MRDP-Twirwaneho mu gicuku cyo ku wa 4 Nyakanga 2026, nyuma y’imirwano ikomeye yabahanganishije n’ingabo za RDC zifatanyije n’iz’u Burundi, Wazalendo na FDLR.
claim_sources.translation_en: Point-Zéro was captured by fighters of AFC/M23 and MRDP-Twirwaneho in the dead of night of 4 July 2026, after heavy fighting that pitted them against DRC forces together with those of Burundi, Wazalendo and the FDLR.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: No muri Mutarama 2026, abarwanyi ba Twirwaneho bari bafashe Point-Zéro, bayifashisha mu gukumira ibitero byari bimaze igihe kirekire bigabwa kuri Minembwe, ariko bahakurwa n’ingabo za Leta ya RDC zifashishaga drones n’indege z’intambara.
claim_sources.translation_en: Also in January 2026, Twirwaneho fighters had taken Point-Zéro, using it to prevent the attacks that had long been launched on Minembwe, but they were removed from there by DRC government forces that used drones and warplanes.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Azarias Ruberwa yavuze ko ikibazo cy’ubutabazi muri ako gace kiri kgukomera kurushaho, kuko ibitero bigabwa nk’aho ari ahantu hadatuwe. Ati "Hari ikibazo gikomeye cy’ubutabazi. Bararwana nk’aho aka gace kadatuwemo n’abantu. Usibye ubwicanyi, mfite impungenge z’uko abantu bashobora kuhacika. Hari igihe abantu bashobora kurambirwa bakagenda burundu."
claim_sources.translation_en: Azarias Ruberwa said that the humanitarian problem in that area is getting worse, because attacks are launched as if it were an uninhabited place. He said: “There is a serious humanitarian problem. They fight as if this area had no people living in it. Apart from the killings, I fear that people may disappear from there. There may come a time when people get tired and leave for good.”

claim_sources.excerpt_original: AFC/M23 yatangaje ko mu gihe ingabo za Leta ya RDC zikomeje kurasa buhumyi mu bice igenzura birimo Point-Zéro, zititaye ku basivili bahatuye, izakomeza kubarwanirira, inarinda ibirindiro byayo.
claim_sources.translation_en: AFC/M23 stated that while DRC government forces continue shooting blindly in areas it controls including Point-Zéro, without regard for civilians living there, it will continue to fight for them, and defend its positions.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mu minsi ya vuba, ihuriro ry’ingabo zishyigikiye Leta ya RDC zagabye ibitero bya drones n’intwaro ziremereye muri Point Zéro, bishaka kuyisubiza, bigakomereza rwagati muri Minembwe ariko abarwanyi ba Twirwaneho na AFC/M23 bazibereye ibamba.
claim_sources.translation_en: In recent days, the alliance of forces supporting the DRC government launched drone and heavy-weapon attacks on Point Zéro, wanting to retake it, continuing into the middle of Minembwe, but Twirwaneho and AFC/M23 fighters stood firm against them.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kuri uyu wa 10 Ukwakira 2026, Umuvugizi wa AFC/M23, Lawrence Kanyuka, yatangaje ko izi ngabo zirimo iza RDC, FDLR, imitwe ya Maï-Maï, abacanshuro b’abanyamahanga ndetse n’abasirikare b’u Burundi.
claim_sources.translation_en: On this 10 October 2026, AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka stated that these forces include those of the DRC, the FDLR, Maï-Maï groups, foreign mercenaries and Burundian soldiers.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kanyuka yavuze ko ahagana saa yine z’ijoro ryo ku wa 9 Ukwakira 2026, izi ngabo zagabye ibitero by’indege zitagira abapilote, zirasa mu mudugudu wa Point Zéro no mu bice biwukikije. Yavuze ko ahagana saa saba z’ijoro ryo ku wa 9 rishyira ku wa 10 Ukwakira, ibitero nk’ibyo byagabwe muri Rugezi no mu bice bihakikije, na ho muri Minembwe.
