claim_sources.translation_en: Kanyuka said that at about ten at night on 9 October 2026, these forces launched drone attacks, shooting at Point Zéro village and the areas around it. He said that at about one in the morning of 9 into 10 October, similar attacks were launched at Rugezi and the areas around it, in Minembwe.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kanyuka yatangaje ko ibi bitero byagabwe mu duce dutuwe n’abaturage byateje impfu, benshi barahunga ndetse byongera ubukana bw’ikibazo cy’ubutabazi kimaze igihe muri iki gice.
claim_sources.translation_en: Kanyuka stated that these attacks launched in inhabited areas caused deaths, many fled, and worsened the humanitarian problem that has been present for some time in this area.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi wa AFC/M23, Lawrence Kanyuka, yatangaje ko guhera mu masaa cyenda y’urukerera rwo kuri uyu wa 20 Mata 2026, ihuriro ry’ingabo za Leta ya RDC ryagabye igitero cya drones z’ubwiyahuzi mu gace ka Mikenke muri Komini Minembwe.
claim_sources.translation_en: AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka announced that from about 3 a.m. (saa cyenda in Kinyarwanda time-reckoning) in the early morning of this 20 April 2026, the coalition of DRC government forces launched a suicide-drone attack on the Mikenke area in Minembwe commune.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi wa AFC/M23, Lawrence Kanyuka, yatangaje ko guhera mu masaa cyenda y’urukerera rwo kuri uyu wa 20 Mata 2026, ihuriro ry’ingabo za Leta ya RDC ryagabye igitero cya drones z’ubwiyahuzi mu gace ka Mikenke muri Komini Minembwe. Kanyuka yagize ati "Saa 5:30, izi ngabo zanagabye igitero ku gace gatuwe cyane ka Mitimingi muri teritwari ya Masisi, hangirika byinshi, imiryango myinshi irahunga."
claim_sources.translation_en: AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka announced that from around 3 a.m. (Kinyarwanda 'mu masaa cyenda y'urukerera', literally 'around the ninth hour of the early morning') on this 20 April 2026, the coalition of DRC government forces launched a kamikaze drone attack on the Mikenke area in Minembwe commune. Kanyuka said: "At 5:30, these forces also launched an attack on the densely populated area of Mitimingi in Masisi territory; much was damaged and many families fled."

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mu ijoro ryo ku wa 18 rishyira uwa 19 Mata, ihuriro ry’ingabo za Leta ya RDC ryagabye ibitero by’imbunda ziremereye na drones z’ubwiyahuzi mu duce turimo Kalingi na Bidegu muri Minembwe na Mitimingi no mu bice bihana imbibi.
claim_sources.translation_en: In the night of 18 to 19 April, the coalition of DRC government forces launched heavy-gun and suicide-drone attacks in areas including Kalingi and Bidegu in Minembwe and Mitimingi and neighbouring areas.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kanyuka yagize ati "AFC/M23 ikomeje kugaragaza ukurenga ku gahenge kenshi, gukorwa nkana na Leta ya Kinshasa. Ishimangira ko yiteguye rwose kurwanirira abasivili no gushyiraho umwanya ukwiye w’umutekano kugira ngo turinde abaturage intambara dushozwaho na Leta."
claim_sources.translation_en: Kanyuka said: "AFC/M23 continues to show repeated breaches of the ceasefire, committed deliberately by the Kinshasa government. It affirms that it is fully ready to defend civilians and to establish a proper security space so that we protect the population from the war launched on us by the government."

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ubwo ibi biganiro byatangiye tariki ya 13 Mata byari bikomeje, Leta ya RDC yari ikigaba ibitero bya drones n’intwaro ziremereye muri Minembwe na Masisi. AFC/M23 yamenyesheje Abanye-Congo n’umuryango mpuzamahanga ko Leta ishyize imbere intambara.
claim_sources.translation_en: While these talks that began on 13 April were under way, the DRC government was still launching drone and heavy-weapon attacks in Minembwe and Masisi. AFC/M23 informed Congolese and the international community that the government is putting war first.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ihuriro AFC/M23 rirwanya ubutegetsi bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, ryatangaje ko nta baturage bo muri Komini ya Minembwe bazongera kwicwa n’ihuriro ry’Ingabo za Leta kuko intambara yaho yarangiye.
claim_sources.translation_en: The AFC/M23 alliance, which opposes the government of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, announced that no residents of Minembwe commune will be killed again by the coalition of Government forces because the war there has ended.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuyobozi wungirije wa AFC/M23 ushinzwe ibikorwa bya politiki, dipolomasi n’imiyoborere, Bertand Bisimwa, yagejeje ubu butumwa ku baturage ba Minembwe nyuma y’aho ingabo za RDC, iz’u Burundi, FDLR na Wazalendo byambuwe ibice birimo Point-Zéro, Mikenke, Kalingi, Ilundu na Rwitsankuku.
claim_sources.translation_en: The deputy leader of AFC/M23 in charge of politics, diplomacy and governance, Bertand Bisimwa, delivered this message to the residents of Minembwe after the DRC, Burundian, FDLR and Wazalendo forces were dispossessed of areas including Point-Zéro, Mikenke, Kalingi, Ilundu and Rwitsankuku.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuyobozi wungirije wa AFC/M23 ushinzwe ibikorwa bya politiki, dipolomasi n’imiyoborere, Bertand Bisimwa, yagejeje ubu butumwa ku baturage ba Minembwe nyuma y’aho ingabo za RDC, iz’u Burundi, FDLR na Wazalendo byambuwe ibice birimo Point-Zéro, Mikenke, Kalingi, Ilundu na Rwitsankuku.
claim_sources.translation_en: The deputy leader of AFC/M23 in charge of politics, diplomacy and governance, Bertand Bisimwa, delivered this message to the residents of Minembwe after the DRC, Burundian, FDLR and Wazalendo forces were dispossessed of areas including Point-Zéro, Mikenke, Kalingi, Ilundu and Rwitsankuku.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ibi bice bimaze gufatwa, abayobozi bakuru muri AFC/M23 barimo Bisimwa, Dr. Freddy Kaniki ushinzwe ubukungu n’imari muri iri huriro akanaba Perezida wa MRDP Twirwaneho n’Umugaba Mukuru wungirije wa M23, Brig Gen Bernard Byamungu, barabisuye.
claim_sources.translation_en: These areas having been taken, senior AFC/M23 leaders including Bisimwa, Dr. Freddy Kaniki, who is in charge of economy and finance in the alliance and is also President of MRDP Twirwaneho, and the Deputy Commander-in-Chief of M23, Brig Gen Bernard Byamungu, visited them.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Bisimwa yatangaje ko abarwanyi ba AFC/M23 bakomoka mu bice byinshi by’igihugu n’aba MRDP Twirwaneho zunze ubumwe kugira ngo zihagarike umugambi w’ingabo za Leta ya RDC zifite umugambi wo kurimbura Abanye-Congo zibahora ubwoko bwabo.
claim_sources.translation_en: Bisimwa announced that AFC/M23 fighters from many parts of the country and those of MRDP Twirwaneho have united to stop the plan of the DRC government forces, which intend to wipe out Congolese because of their ethnic group.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Guverineri w’Intara ya Kivu y’Amajyaruguru washyizweho n’ihuriro AFC/M23 rirwanya ubutegetsi bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, Col Bahati Musanga Erasto, yasabye abaturage kwitandukanya n’umutwe w’iterabwoba wa FDLR, abamenyesha ko abawushinze bamennye amaraso y’inzirakarengane mu Rwanda.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Governor of North Kivu appointed by the AFC/M23 alliance, which opposes the government of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Col Bahati Musanga Erasto, asked residents to distance themselves from the terrorist group FDLR, informing them that its founders shed the blood of innocents in Rwanda.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ubu butumwa yabuhaye abatuye muri Sheferi ya Bwisha, Gurupoma ya Binza, muri teritwari ya Rutshuru, hafi y’umupaka wa Uganda, ubwo yabasuraga, aherekejwe n’abandi bayobozi bo ku rwego rwa politiki n’urw’umutekano.
claim_sources.translation_en: He gave this message to residents of Bwisha chiefdom, Binza groupement, in Rutshuru territory, near the border with Uganda, when he visited them, accompanied by other political and security officials.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Guverineri w’Intara ya Kivu y’Amajyaruguru washyizweho n’ihuriro AFC/M23 rirwanya ubutegetsi bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, Col Bahati Musanga Erasto, yasabye abaturage kwitandukanya n’umutwe w’iterabwoba wa FDLR, abamenyesha ko abawushinze bamennye amaraso y’inzirakarengane mu Rwanda. Ubu butumwa yabuhaye abatuye muri Sheferi ya Bwisha, Gurupoma ya Binza, muri teritwari ya Rutshuru, hafi y’umupaka wa Uganda, ubwo yabasuraga, aherekejwe n’abandi bayobozi bo ku rwego rwa politiki n’urw’umutekano. Ati “Bariho umuvumo w’Imana, ntibazabasha no kugera ku nzozi zabo zo gutaha bagafata igihugu baturutsemo, kuko bakivuyemo bamennye amaraso y’inzirakarengane, bageze na hano bakomeza kuyamena, ni byo biri kubakurikirana, ubu bariho amaraso afite urubanza. Turabizi neza ko bakiri mu mashyamba, kandi ntituzahwema kubarwanya kugeza tubatsinze.”
claim_sources.translation_en: We know well that they are still in the forests, and we will not cease to fight them until we defeat them.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Guverineri Bahati yavuze ko abagize FDLR ari ibisambo by’inda mbi, byirirwa bishuka abaturage, bikabambura, bigasambanya abagore n’abakobwa ku gahato. Ati “Ariya mabandi ntazigera agira igihugu nk’uko tugifite uku, icyo bashoboye ni ukujya batega ibico imodoka, bagasahura, abazirimo bakabica, ari na wo muvumo ubariho.” Yagaragaje ko abarwanyi ba FDLR baramutse badashyigikiwe na bamwe mu baturage babajyanira ibyo kurya mu mashyamba, bayivanamo bakishyikiriza AFC/M23, ikabashyikiriza u Rwanda.
claim_sources.translation_en: He indicated that if FDLR fighters were not supported by some of the residents who take them food in the forests, they would leave it and hand themselves over to AFC/M23, which would hand them over to Rwanda.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mu Ugushyingo 2025, Visi Perezida wa Komisiyo y’Igihugu Ishinzwe Gusezerera no Gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe abari abarwanyi (RDRC), Maj Gen (Rtd) Jacques Nziza, yasobanuye ko mu mezi 10, u Rwanda rwakiriye abarwanyi barenga 200 ba FDLR.
claim_sources.translation_en: In November 2025, the Vice-President of the National Commission for Demobilisation and Reintegration of former fighters (RDRC), Maj Gen (Rtd) Jacques Nziza, explained that in 10 months Rwanda had received more than 200 FDLR fighters.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuyobozi wungirije w’Ihuriro AFC/M23 ushinzwe ibikorwa bya politiki, dipolomasi n’imiyoborere, Bertrand Bisimwa, yanenze Umuryango w’Abibumbye uheruka gufatira ibihano bamwe mu bayobozi b’iryo huriro, agaragaza ko wavangiwe kandi uyoborwa n’amarangamutima.
claim_sources.translation_en: The deputy leader of the AFC/M23 alliance in charge of politics, diplomacy and governance, Bertrand Bisimwa, criticised the United Nations, which recently sanctioned some of the alliance's leaders, showing that it was misled and is driven by emotion.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Yabigarutseho yifashishije konti ye ya X aho yagaragaje ko gufatira ibihano uruhande rumwe kandi runubahiriza ibyo rusabwa mu rugendo rw’amahoro bishimangira ko Loni yataye umurongo.
claim_sources.translation_en: He made the point on his X account, where he indicated that sanctioning one side, and one that complies with what is asked of it in the peace process, confirms that the UN has lost its way.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Yagaragaje ko gushyira igitutu ku bagizweho ingaruka n’ibikorwa by’ivangura bishingiye ku moko ngo bave ku butaka bwabo ari ikosa rikomeye kandi rizagira ingaruka. Yerekanye ko ibyo bishobora kugira ingaruka ku kuba impande zihanganye zakomeza gukaza umurego, kwiyongera no kurushaho gukomere kw’ibikorwa by’urugomo n’ihohoterwa no kudindira ku rugendo rugamije kugera ku mahoro. Bisimwa yavuze ko politiki ishingiye ku rwango no ku ivangura, n'iyo yashyigikirwa n'Isi yose, idashobora na rimwe gutsinda ubutabera n'amahoro arambye.
claim_sources.translation_en: He showed that putting pressure on those affected by ethnically based discrimination to leave their land is a serious mistake that will have consequences.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuyobozi wungirije wa AFC/M23 akaba na Perezida wa MRDP-Twirwaneho, Freddy Kaniki, yavuze ko ingabo zishyigikiye ubutegetsi bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi zongeye kugota Komini Minembwe mu Ntara ya Kivu y’Amajyepfo.
claim_sources.translation_en: The deputy leader of AFC/M23 and President of MRDP-Twirwaneho, Freddy Kaniki, said that forces supporting the government of the Democratic Republic have again besieged Minembwe commune in South Kivu province.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mu ijoro ryo ku wa 21 Nzeri 2026, Kaniki yatangaje ko Minembwe iri mu bihe bikomeye by’umutekano, agaragaza ko ingabo za Leta ya RDC, iz’u Burundi, Wazalendo, FDLR n’abacanshuro b’abanyamahahanga byahisemo kurenga ku masezerano y’agahenge yemejwe mu biganiro bya Doha.
claim_sources.translation_en: On the night of 21 September 2026, Kaniki announced that Minembwe is in a serious security situation, indicating that the DRC government forces, the Burundian forces, Wazalendo, FDLR and foreign mercenaries had chosen to breach the ceasefire agreement adopted in the Doha talks.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kaniki yavuze ko abaturage bo muri Minembwe bafungiwe inzira banyuramo bajya kwivuza, banyuzamo ibiribwa ndetse bajya ku masoko; bihabanye n’imyanzuro yafatiwe mu biganiro bya Doha.
claim_sources.translation_en: Kaniki said that the residents of Minembwe have had the routes they use to go for medical care, to bring in food and to go to markets closed to them, contrary to the resolutions adopted in the Doha talks.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kaniki yavuze ko abaturage bo muri Minembwe bafungiwe inzira banyuramo bajya kwivuza, banyuzamo ibiribwa ndetse bajya ku masoko; bihabanye n’imyanzuro yafatiwe mu biganiro bya Doha. Yagize ati “Ibi ntibigomba gufatwa nk’ibisanzwe. Iki ni igihe cyo gufata icyemezo gikomeye. Uyu ni umurongo utukura.” Uyu muyobozi yavuze ko amahanga akwiye kugira icyo akora mbere y’uko habaho ikibazo gikomeye cy’ubutabazi, avuga ko AFC/M23 ikomeje gushyigikira inzira ya politiki ariko ko itazakomeza kurebera abaturage ba Minembwe bashyirwa mu kaga.
claim_sources.translation_en: Kaniki said that the residents of Minembwe have been cut off from the routes they use to go for medical care, to bring in food and to go to markets, contrary to the conclusions reached in the Doha talks. He said: "This must not be treated as normal. This is the time to take a firm decision. This is a red line." This leader said that foreign countries should do something before a serious humanitarian problem arises, saying that AFC/M23 continues to support the political path but will not keep looking on while the people of Minembwe are put in danger.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Muri iki gihe, ingabo za Leta ya RDC ziri kugaba ibitero bikomeye mu bice bikikije Minembwe birimo Point-Zéro, zifite intego yo kubyisubiza.
claim_sources.translation_en: At this time, the DRC government forces are launching strong attacks in areas around Minembwe including Point-Zéro, aiming to retake them.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Abarwanyi ba AFC/M23 na Twirwaneho bari barashoboye kugarura umutekano muri Minembwe mu ntangiriro za Nyakanga 2026 ubwo birukanaga ihuriro ry’ingabo za Leta ya RDC mu bice bihakikije birimo Point-Zéro.
claim_sources.translation_en: AFC/M23 and Twirwaneho fighters had been able to restore security in Minembwe in early July 2026 when they expelled the coalition of DRC government forces from areas around it including Point-Zéro.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuyobozi wa Teritwari ya Rutshuru washyizweho n’umutwe wa FRN, Euphrem Kabasha, yavuze ko iki gitero cyagabwe mu gace ka Kabizo kari muri Gurupoma ya Tongo muri Sheferi ya Bwito, mu masaa saba z’ijoro.
claim_sources.translation_en: The administrator of Rutshuru territory appointed by the FRN group, Euphrem Kabasha, said that this attack was carried out in the Kabizo area, in Tongo groupement in Bwito chiefdom, at around 1 a.m. (saa saba z'ijoro in Kinyarwanda time-reckoning).

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Yagize ati “Mu ijoro ryo ku wa 25 rishyira ku wa 26 Ukwakira, ahagana saa 1:30, Kabizo yongeye kugabwaho igitero cyahitanye abantu, cyagabwe na FDLR ifatanyije na Nyatura CMC FDP ya Gashegu Héritier na Mbitezi. Cyibasiye abaturage, abantu batanu baricwa.”
claim_sources.translation_en: He said: "In the night of 25 to 26 October, around 1:30, Kabizo was again attacked, with a deadly attack, carried out by the FDLR together with Nyatura CMC FDP of Gashegu Héritier and Mbitezi. It targeted residents; five people were killed."

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Iki gitero kigabwe mu gihe umutekano muri Rutshuru ukomeje kuzamba, aho imirwano yatumye n’ibikorwa by’ubuhinzi bihagarara mu duce twa Kabizo na Katovu.
claim_sources.translation_en: This attack comes while security in Rutshuru continues to deteriorate, with fighting having also halted farming activities in the areas of Kabizo and Katovu.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Col Fidèle Rugabo uri mu bofisiye ba Twirwaneho yatangaje ko saa cyenda z’urukerera rwo ku wa 18 Nzeri 2026, ingabo za RDC, iz’u Burundi, FDLR, P5 na Wazalendo byateye abaturage muri Mukoko na Nyaruhinga.
claim_sources.translation_en: Col Fidèle Rugabo, one of the officers of Twirwaneho, announced that at about 3 a.m. (saa cyenda z'urukerera, Kinyarwanda time) on 18 September 2026, the DRC forces, those of Burundi, FDLR, P5 and Wazalendo attacked residents in Mukoko and Nyaruhinga.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Yagize ati "Umwanzi mu cyerekezo cya Mukoko yateye abaturage saa cyenda z’urukerera. Umwanzi akaba arimo gukubitwa nk’ingoma."
claim_sources.translation_en: He said: "The enemy in the direction of Mukoko attacked the residents at about 3 a.m. The enemy is being beaten like a drum."

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Col Rugabo yatangaje kandi ko saa kumi n’ebyiri z’igitondo, imitwe y’ingabo ishyigikiye Leta ya RDC yateye agace ka Gipimo mu cyerekezo cya Kabanju.
claim_sources.translation_en: Col Rugabo also announced that at about 6 a.m. (saa kumi n'ebyiri z'igitondo, Kinyarwanda time), armed forces supporting the DRC government attacked the Gipimo area in the direction of Kabanju.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ibi bitero bikurikiye ibyo ihuriro ry’ingabo za Leta ya RDC rimaze iminsi rigaba mu bice bigenzurwa na Twirwaneho ndetse na AFC/M23 birimo Minembwe, Kalehe na Masisi. Col Rugabo yatangaje ko Twirwaneho na AFC/M23 byamaganiye kure ibi bitero.
claim_sources.translation_en: These attacks follow those that the coalition of DRC government forces has been launching for days in areas controlled by Twirwaneho and AFC/M23, including Minembwe, Kalehe and Masisi. Col Rugabo announced that Twirwaneho and AFC/M23 strongly condemned these attacks.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Tariki ya 16 Gashyantare 2025 ni bwo M23 yemeje ko yafashe Umujyi wa Bukavu, nyuma yo kwirukanamo abasirikare bo mu Ihuriro ry’ingabo za Leta ya RDC.
claim_sources.translation_en: On 16 February 2025 M23 confirmed that it had taken the city of Bukavu, after driving out soldiers of the alliance of the DRC government's forces.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: M23 igenzura uruhande rwa RDC ku mupaka wa Kamanyola uhuza iki gihugu n’u Rwanda kuva ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa 18 Gashyantare, nyuma yo kuhirukana abarwanyi bo mu Ihuriro ry’imitwe yitwaje intwaro rya Wazalendo.
claim_sources.translation_en: M23 has controlled the DRC side of the Kamanyola border crossing connecting this country and Rwanda since the evening of this 18 February, after driving out the fighters of the Wazalendo alliance of armed groups.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Biravugwa ko Ingabo z'u Burundi zisanzwe ari amaboko akomeye ya Leta ya RDC na zo zatangiye kuva muri iyi ntambara, zisubira i Bujumbura. Ibiro ntaramakuru Reuters byatangaje ko aya makuru byayahamirijwe n'abantu bane barimo umusirikare, abakozi b'Umuryango w'Abibumbye n'umudipolomate.
claim_sources.translation_en: It is said that the Burundian forces, who are a strong arm of the DRC government, have also started leaving this war, returning to Bujumbura. The news agency Reuters reported that it had this information confirmed by four people including a soldier, UN staff and a diplomat.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Uyu mutwe witwaje intwaro kandi ukomeje urugamba umanuka, bigaragara ko werekeza muri Teritwari ya Uvira. M23 yamaze gufata agace ka Mumosho na Nya-Ngezi muri Teritwari ya Walungu.
claim_sources.translation_en: This armed group is also continuing the fight going south, apparently heading for Uvira territory. M23 has already taken the area of Mumosho and Nya-Ngezi in Walungu territory.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: M23 imaze kwinjira muri Teritwari eshatu ari zo Kalehe, Kabare na Walungu.
claim_sources.translation_en: M23 has entered three territories, which are Kalehe, Kabare and Walungu.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: AFC/M23 yahamagariye imitwe ya politiki n’iya gisirikare iharanira kurengera abaturage yo muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, RDC, kuyiyungaho mu rugamba rugamije kubohora iki gihugu, bakavanaho ubutegetsi bwa Kinshasa bumaze imyaka bwarimitse ikibi.
claim_sources.translation_en: AFC/M23 called on political and military groups in the Democratic Republic of the Congo that strive to protect civilians to join it in the struggle to liberate this country, removing the Kinshasa government that has for years enthroned evil.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Bikubiye mu itangangazo ryashyizwe hanze ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa 17 Gashyantare 2025 n’Umuvugizi wa AFC/M23 mu rwego rwa politiki, Lawrence Kanyuka.
claim_sources.translation_en: This is contained in the communiqué released on the evening of this 17 February 2025 by the AFC/M23 spokesperson for politics, Lawrence Kanyuka.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kugeza ubu ibice AFC/M23 yamaze kubohora ibyinshi yabishyizemo abayobozi bayo bashya, barajwe ishinga no kwimakaza umutekano n’iterambere ry’abaturage. Iri huriro rigaragaza ko rirajwe ishinga no kuganira na RDC ku gukemura ibibazo by’umutekano muke muri iki gihugu, bitakunda rikemeza rizatuza ari uko rigeze i Kinshasa rikabohora abaturage.
claim_sources.translation_en: So far, in most of the areas AFC/M23 has already liberated it has installed its new administrators, who are intent on promoting security and the development of the population. The alliance indicates that it is committed to talking with the DRC to resolve the security problems in this country; failing that, it affirms it will only settle down once it has reached Kinshasa and liberated the population.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Paul Kagame: Kunyurwa, yego. Abitabiriye inama barebaga ahazaza, bemeranya ku ngingo zitanga icyizere. Ubu, icyo twareba ni uburyo imyanzuro ishyirwa mu bikorwa by’umwihariko n’uruhande rwa Congo cyane ko ari rwo rurebwa cyane.
claim_sources.translation_en: Paul Kagame: Satisfied, yes. Those who attended were looking to the future, agreeing on points that give hope. Now, what we should look at is how the resolutions are implemented, especially by the Congolese side, given that it is the one most concerned.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kuri iyo ngingo, nta mpamvu n’imwe yasobanura ukutitabira inama mu buryo bw’imbonankobone kwa Perezida wa RDC [Félix Tshisekedi]. Ijoro ryabanje, yari yahisemo kujya muri Tchad gusaba ubufasha bwa gisirikare mbere yo kwitabira inama akoresheje ikoranabuhanga. Ibyo bisobanuye imigambi ye.
claim_sources.translation_en: On that point, there is no reason that could explain the DRC President's [Félix Tshisekedi's] non-attendance in person at the meeting. The night before, he had chosen to go to Chad to ask for military assistance before attending the meeting by technology. That shows his intentions.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Twagiranye amasezerano arenga atanu na Guverinoma ya Congo kuva mu 2007 ariko ntiyigeze yubahirizwa na RDC. Umutwe ufite ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside uracyahari.
claim_sources.translation_en: We concluded more than five agreements with the Congolese government since 2007, but the DRC never implemented them. The group with a genocide ideology is still there.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Guverinoma ya RDC yahaye akazi abacanshuro, nk’uko mwese mubizi. Baturutse he? Ni i Burayi.
claim_sources.translation_en: The DRC government hired mercenaries, as you all know. Where did they come from? From Europe.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Icyo twakuye mu byavuzwe na Perezida w’u Burundi n’uwa RDC, ni umugambi wo guhungabanya u Rwanda. Ni bo batumye ibintu bigera aho bigeze bahembera intambara, banavuga ko bazakuraho Guverinoma y’u Rwanda.
claim_sources.translation_en: What we took from what the Presidents of Burundi and the DRC said is a plan to destabilise Rwanda. They are the ones who brought things to where they are by fuelling war, and they also said that they would remove the Government of Rwanda.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Naba mfitiye M23 impuhwe? Yego, nshingiye ku bihamya n’ibimenyetso. Uyu mutwe urengera abantu benshi, bamaze igihe bacunaguzwa, bicwa, bameneshejwe bakaba impunzi.
claim_sources.translation_en: Do I have sympathy for M23? Yes, based on testimony and evidence. This group defends many people who have long been persecuted, killed and driven out to become refugees.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ku bwa Wazalendo yashyizweho na Guverinoma ya Congo kugira ngo ikore ubwicanyi bushingiye ku moko? Cyangwa se ku bw’ubuyobozi bw’u Burundi bwinjiye muri aya makimbirane bufite intego imwe yo gushyigikira bagenzi babo b’Abanye-Congo mu mugambi wabo w’ubwicanyi no kurimbura abo bantu?
claim_sources.translation_en: On behalf of the Wazalendo set up by the Congolese Government to carry out ethnically based killings? Or on behalf of the leadership of Burundi, which entered this conflict with one aim, to support their Congolese counterparts in their plan of killing and wiping out those people?

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Baracyahari, bamwe barahunze, abandi berekeje mu majyepfo, aho bari kwisuganyiriza. Bakurikiye ingabo z’u Burundi, bava i Goma bajya i Bukavu.
claim_sources.translation_en: They are still there, some have fled, others have headed south, where they are regrouping. They followed the Burundian troops, from Goma to Bukavu.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ibitero bya M23 ku Mujyi wa Goma byahitanye abarenga 3000. Haba hari uruhare rw’u Rwanda muri ibyo? Nta na rumwe. Ingamba twashyizeho ni iz’ubwirinzi gusa.
claim_sources.translation_en: M23's attacks on the city of Goma killed more than 3,000. Is there any role of Rwanda in that? None at all. The measures we have put in place are only defensive.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ku rundi ruhande, umubare munini w’abahitanywe n’imirwano bari abasirikare ba FARDC, abarwanyi ba FDLR, ndetse n’imitwe yitwaje intwaro ya Wazalendo bafatanya ku rugamba. Umubare w’abasivile baguye mu ntambara ubarirwa muri 500.
claim_sources.translation_en: On the other hand, the majority of those killed in the fighting were FARDC soldiers, FDLR fighters, and the armed groups of Wazalendo who fight alongside them. The number of civilians who died in the war is counted at about 500.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ni byo, bifatwa nk’aho nta shiti ingabo z’u Rwanda ziriyo, ariko FDLR iteye inkeke ku mutekano w’u Rwanda, rutewe inkeke n’abacanshuro hamwe n’ubushotoranyi bukorwa na Félix Tshisekedi n’u Burundi ku karubanda na byo birigaragaza.
claim_sources.translation_en: True, it is regarded as though it were beyond doubt that Rwandan troops are there, but the FDLR is a threat to Rwanda's security, Rwanda is threatened by mercenaries, and the provocations openly made by Félix Tshisekedi and Burundi are also evident.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Byumvikane neza: aho guhitamo hagati y’ibibangamira umutekano no gufatirwa ibihano, nafata intwaro nkahangana n’ibigamije kungirira nabi ntitaye ku bihano.
claim_sources.translation_en: Let it be clear: rather than choosing between what threatens security and being sanctioned, I would take up arms and confront what aims to harm me, regardless of sanctions.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kubera impamvu nakubwiye, sinjya gusuhuzanya no gufata amafoto. Twagombaga guhurira i Luanda tugasinya amasezerano yari yateguwe n’abaminisitiri bacu n’abatekinisiye, ntabwo twari tugiye kuganira. Ayo masezerano rero ntabwo yumvikanyweho kubera ko Kinshasa yanze gushyiramo ibibazo by’ingenzi byakabaye biri no mu nshingano zayo.
claim_sources.translation_en: For the reason I told you, I do not go to greet people and take photographs. We were supposed to meet in Luanda to sign an agreement prepared by our ministers and technicians; we were not going to hold talks. That agreement was therefore not agreed upon because Kinshasa refused to include the key issues that should also be among its responsibilities.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: M23 na AFC bifite abanyamuryango bafite gahunda ya politiki igaragara: gukura Felix Tshisekedi ku butegetsi. Ushyigikiye iyi ntego? Nshobora kumva icyo bari kugaragaza. Dufitanye ikibazo na Leta ya Congo mu by’ukuri itaratowe, haba ku nshuro ya mbere n’iya kabiri, kandi ifite gusa umugambi wo gutoteza abaturage, guteza akavuyo kurushaho no kwigwizaho byose.
claim_sources.translation_en: I can understand what they are expressing. We have a problem with a Congolese government that, in truth, was not elected, either the first or the second time, and that has only the aim of persecuting the people, causing even more chaos and enriching itself with everything.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umutwe wa AFC/ M23 urwanya ubutegetsi bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, wahakanye amakuru avuga ko watangiye gukura abarwanyi mu bice bimwe byo mu Burasirazuba bw’igihugu ugenzura.
claim_sources.translation_en: The AFC/M23 group, which opposes the government of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, denied information saying that it had begun to withdraw fighters from some areas in the east of the country that it controls.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mu itangazo ryashyizwe hanze na Guverineri w’Intara ya Kivu y’Amajyaruguru, Erasto Bahati, yahakanye iby’aya makuru, avuga ko ikiri kuba ari ugusimbuza ingabo.
claim_sources.translation_en: In a communiqué released by the Governor of North Kivu Province, Erasto Bahati, he denied this information, saying that what is happening is the replacement of troops.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Iri tangazo rivuga ko “Ubuyobozi bw’Intara ya Kivu y’Amajyaruguru burahumuriza abatuye intara yose ko ibikorwa biri kuba ku mirongo y’urugamba ari gahunda isanzwe yo gusimbuza mu gisirikare cya AFC/M23.”
claim_sources.translation_en: This communiqué says that "The North Kivu Provincial administration reassures residents of the whole province that what is happening on the front lines is a routine programme of replacement in the AFC/M23 military."

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ibi bitandukanye n’ibihuha byatijwe umurindi n’imbuga nkoranyambaga by’ubutegetsi bwa Kinshasa, bigamije gushyira abantu mu rujijo no gutera ubwoba ababayeho mu mahoro n’umutekano.
claim_sources.translation_en: This is different from the rumours fuelled by social media of the Kinshasa authorities, aimed at confusing people and frightening those living in peace and security.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umutwe wa AFC/ M23 urwanya ubutegetsi bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, wahakanye amakuru avuga ko watangiye gukura abarwanyi mu bice bimwe byo mu Burasirazuba bw’igihugu ugenzura. Mu mpera z’iki cyumweru nibwo ibinyamakuru byo muri RDC byatangiye kwandika ko AFC/M23 iri gukura abarwanyi mu bice byo muri Teritwari ya Lubero, Lunyasenge, Bukununu, Musiya, Katondi na Kipese, bakimurirwa muri Alimbongo, Kirumba na Kanyabayonga.
claim_sources.translation_en: At the end of this week DRC newspapers began to write that AFC/M23 was withdrawing fighters from areas in Lubero Territory, Lunyasenge, Bukununu, Musiya, Katondi and Kipese, relocating them to Alimbongo, Kirumba and Kanyabayonga.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umutwe wa Twirwaneho uharanirauburenganzira bw'Abanyamulenge batotezwa ndetse bakicwa na Leta ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, RDC, watangaje ko wifatanyije n’Ihuriro AFC/M23 mu rugamba rwo gukuraho ubutegetsi bwa Kinshasa bukomeje kwica abaturage.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Twirwaneho group, which fights for the rights of Banyamulenge who are persecuted and killed by the government of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, DRC, announced that it has joined the AFC/M23 alliance in the struggle to remove the Kinshasa government that continues to kill citizens.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ni icyemezo Twirwaneho ifashe nyuma y’iminsi mike uyu mutwe utangaje ko Umuyobozi Mukuru wawo Col Rukunda Michel uzwi nka Makanika, yaguye mu gitero cya drone y’ihuriro ry’ingabo za RDC ku wa 19 Gashyantare 2025.
claim_sources.translation_en: It is a decision Twirwaneho took a few days after the group announced that its Commander-in-Chief Col Rukunda Michel, known as Makanika, died in a drone strike by the coalition of DRC forces on 19 February 2025.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuyobozi Mukuru mushya wa Twirwaneho, Brig Gen Charles Sematama yabwiye Ijwi rya Amerika ko Col Rukunda asize bakomeye ndetse urugamba yatangije bagomba kurusoza uko byagenda kose.
claim_sources.translation_en: The new Commander-in-Chief of Twirwaneho, Brig Gen Charles Sematama, told Voice of America that Col Rukunda has left them strong and that they must finish the struggle he started whatever happens.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Brig Gen Sentama yavuze ko bamaze imyaka irindwi barwana intambara yo kwirwanaho, bagerageza gutabaza amahanga, bumvisha Kinshasa ko igomba kureka ivangura ikarinda abaturage mu buryo bungana ariko bikomeza kunanirana, uyu munsi bakaba biyemeje kubyikorera ku buryo bweruye.
claim_sources.translation_en: Brig Gen Sentama said that they had been fighting a war of self-defence for seven years, trying to alert foreign countries, persuading Kinshasa that it must drop discrimination and protect the people equally, but it kept failing, and today they had resolved to do it themselves openly.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Brig Gen Sentama yavuze ko bamaze imyaka irindwi barwana intambara yo kwirwanaho, bagerageza gutabaza amahanga, bumvisha Kinshasa ko igomba kureka ivangura ikarinda abaturage mu buryo bungana ariko bikomeza kunanirana, uyu munsi bakaba biyemeje kubyikorera ku buryo bweruye. Ati “Mai Mai zose zihuje na FDLR, barahura batangira kugaba ibitero no gusenyera Abanyamulenge, ariko twabyeretse amahanga araceceka ararebera, ubwicanyi burakomeza kugeza uyu munsi n’umuyobozi bakaba bamwishe.
claim_sources.translation_en: Brig Gen Sentama said that they have spent seven years fighting a war of self-defence, trying to alert foreign countries and to persuade Kinshasa that it must stop discrimination and protect the population equally, but this kept failing, and that today they have resolved to do it themselves, openly. He said: "All the Mai Mai are united with the FDLR; they meet and start launching attacks and destroying the homes of the Banyamulenge, but we showed this to foreign countries and they stayed silent and looked on; the killings continue to this day and they have also killed the leader.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Brig Gen Sematama yanavuze ko mu rugamba rwo gukuraho ubutegetsi bwa Kinshasa ubu bamaze gufata uduce twa Minembwe two muri Teritwari ya Fizi mu Ntara ya Kivu y’Amajyepfo n’utundi. Ati “Minembwe twarayifashe, aho FARDC yari iri twayikuyemo. Uyu munsi twinjiye Mikenke ndetse tugomba gukomeza.
claim_sources.translation_en: Brig Gen Sematama also said that in the struggle to remove the Kinshasa government they had now taken areas of Minembwe in Fizi Territory in South Kivu Province and others. He said: "We took Minembwe, we drove FARDC out of where it was. Today we have entered Mikenke and we must continue.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Brig Gen Sematama ku bijyanye n’ibyo basabwa n’umuryango mpuzamahanga byo kurambika intwaro bakayoboka inzira y’ibiganiro yagize ati “Turi kwicwa. Turambike imbunda maze batwice? Bajye kubwira abandi bafite ibyo barwanira, twe turwanira kubaho kandi twabatakiye kuva kera kandi ntacyo bakoze.
claim_sources.translation_en: Brig Gen Sematama, on what the international community asks of them to lay down arms and follow the path of talks, said: "We are being killed. Should we lay down our guns so that they kill us? Let them go and tell others who have something to fight for; we are fighting to live and we appealed to them long ago and they did nothing.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Brig Gen Sematama yanavuze ko mu rugamba rwo gukuraho ubutegetsi bwa Kinshasa ubu bamaze gufata uduce twa Minembwe two muri Teritwari ya Fizi mu Ntara ya Kivu y’Amajyepfo n’utundi. Ati “Minembwe twarayifashe, aho FARDC yari iri twayikuyemo. Uyu munsi twinjiye Mikenke ndetse tugomba gukomeza. Aho Umunyamulenge hose atuye tugomba kuhakoza ikirenge ndetse kuko twiyunze n’abandi tuzakomeza ku buryo tuzabohora RDC yose abaturage bose bakagira amahoro.” Abajijwe aho izo mbaraga bazikuye ndetse n’iby’uko baba binjije ingabo nshya, uyu muyobozi mushya wa Twirwaneho yavuze ko nta ngabo nshya binjije ahubwo icyahindutse ari uko biyemeje gukuraho ubwo butegetsi. Ati “Turacyari ba bandi. Mbere baraduteraga tukirwanaho tukabarasa tukabageza mu birindiro byabo tukagaruka ariko ubu twiyemeje kubakuraho kuko bakomeje ubwicanyi. Turabwira Abanye-Congo bose guhaguruka. Turasaba abasore b’Abanyamulenge bose kuza gutabara tukiyunga tugashyira hamwe mu gukuraho iyi leta y’abicanyi kuko ari yo iri gukora jenoside ikabamaraho ababyeyi babo.”
claim_sources.translation_en: Brig Gen Sematama also said that in the struggle to remove the Kinshasa government they have now taken the areas of Minembwe in Fizi territory in South Kivu province, among others. He said: "We have taken Minembwe; we drove FARDC out of where it was. Today we entered Mikenke and we must continue. Wherever a Munyamulenge lives we must set foot, and because we have united with others we will continue until we liberate the whole of the DRC so that all the people have peace." Asked where they got this strength and whether they had brought in new troops, the new Twirwaneho leader said they had brought in no new troops; what had changed is that they had resolved to remove that government. He said: "We are still the same people. Before, they attacked us, we defended ourselves, fired at them, pushed them back to their positions and came back, but now we have resolved to remove them because they keep on killing. We tell all Congolese to rise up. We ask all young Banyamulenge men to come to the rescue so that we unite and come together to remove this government of killers, because it is the one carrying out genocide and finishing off their parents."

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ubwo butumwa yatanze ku wa 21 Gashyantare 2025, abuherekesha ifoto ya Col Rukunda, Lt Col Ngoma yavuze ko abibwira ko bazatsemba Abanyamulenge bari muri RDC bibeshya, kandi ko vuba aba Banye-Congo bazabohorwa, bidegembye mu gihugu cyabo.
claim_sources.translation_en: This message he gave on 21 February 2025, accompanying it with a photo of Col Rukunda, Lt Col Ngoma said that those who think they will wipe out the Banyamulenge in the DRC are mistaken, and that soon these Congolese will be liberated, free to move in their country.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Nyuma y’urupfu rwa Col Rukunda alias Makanika, Umuvugizi wa M23 mu rwego rwa gisirikare, Lt Col Willy Ngoma, yasezeranyije Abanyamulenge kubabohora.
claim_sources.translation_en: After the death of Col Rukunda alias Makanika, the M23 military spokesperson, Lt Col Willy Ngoma, promised to liberate the Banyamulenge.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’Amahanga n’Ubutwererane, Ambasaderi Olivier Nduhungirehe, yaburiye Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika ko ibihano byayo bibogamye bidashobora gukemura amakimbirane ari hagati y’u Rwanda na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, ahubwo ko biyenyegeza.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Minister of Foreign Affairs and Cooperation, Ambassador Olivier Nduhungirehe, warned the United States of America that its biased sanctions cannot resolve the conflict between Rwanda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo, but that they fuel it.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mu kiganiro n’umunyamakuru Marc Perelman wa France 24, Minisitiri Nduhungirehe yagaragaje ko amasezerano ya Washington atatanze umusaruro kubera ko Leta ya RDC yakomeje kurenga ku gahenge, inakomeza gufasha umutwe wa FDLR, anakira abarwanya Leta y’u Rwanda barimo umuhungu wa Juvénal Habyarimana witwa Jean Luc Habyarimana.
claim_sources.translation_en: In an interview with France 24 journalist Marc Perelman, Minister Nduhungirehe showed that the Washington agreement had not produced results because the DRC government continued to breach the ceasefire, continued to help the FDLR, and received opponents of the Rwandan government including Juvénal Habyarimana's son named Jean Luc Habyarimana.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Minisitiri Nduhungirehe yavuze ko tariki ya 5 Kamena 2026, Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’Amahanga wa Amerika, Marco Rubio, yemereye abadepite ko u Rwanda ruri kubahiriza aya masezerano, ariko ko Leta ya RDC yo ntacyo yakoze; ibishimangira ubushake buke bwa politiki.
claim_sources.translation_en: Minister Nduhungirehe said that on 5 June 2026 the US Secretary of State, Marco Rubio, acknowledged to members of the House [of Representatives] that Rwanda is complying with this agreement, but that the DRC government has done nothing; which confirms weak political will.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Yibukije Perelman ko ku 26 Kamena 2026, Umujyanama wa Perezida Trump mu bijyanye n’ubufatanye na Afurika, Massad Boulos, yabwiye Akanama k’Umuryango w’Abibumbye gashinzwe umutekano ko Leta ya RDC itigeze isenya FDLR byibura mu bice igenzura, agaragaza ko impamvu u Rwanda ari rwo rukomeje guhanwa itumvikana.
claim_sources.translation_en: He reminded Perelman that on 26 June 2026, President Trump's adviser on cooperation with Africa, Massad Boulos, told the UN Security Council that the DRC government has never dismantled the FDLR at least in the areas it controls, showing that the reason Rwanda is the one continuing to be punished is not understandable.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Minisitiri Nduhungirehe yagaragaje ko ingabo za RDC zanagabye igitero mu bice bitandukanye bigenzurwa n’ihuriro AFC/M23 n’umutwe wa MRDP Twirwanehomuri, zica abasivili benshi, abaza ati “None ni abasivili bangahe bagomba gupfa kugira ngo twumve ko RDC ikwiye kubahiriza agahenge?”
claim_sources.translation_en: Minister Nduhungirehe showed that DRC forces had also launched an attack in various areas controlled by the AFC/M23 alliance and the MRDP Twirwanehomuri group, killing many civilians, asking: "So how many civilians must die for us to understand that the DRC should respect the ceasefire?"

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ku bihano Amerika yafatiye Gasabo Refinery, umuyobozi wayo n’izindi sosiyete z’ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro tariki ya 25 Kamena, Minisitiri Nduhungirehe yagaragaje ko nta gisubizo bishobora kuzana hagati y’u Rwanda na RDC. Yagize ati “Mbere na mbere, ibi bihano birabogamye. Bibogamira ku ruhande rumwe kandi nta musaruro byatanga. Gutanga ibihano si inshingano y’umuhuza.
claim_sources.translation_en: On the sanctions America imposed on Gasabo Refinery, its head and other mineral mining companies on 25 June, Minister Nduhungirehe showed that they can bring no solution between Rwanda and the DRC. He said: "First of all, these sanctions are biased. They lean to one side and would yield no result. Imposing sanctions is not the mediator's role.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Yagize ati “Mbere na mbere, ibi bihano birabogamye. Bibogamira ku ruhande rumwe kandi nta musaruro byatanga. Gutanga ibihano si inshingano y’umuhuza. Niba umuhuza abona ko gufata ibihano ari ngombwa, kubifatira uruhande rumwe byoshya urundi.” Minisitiri Nduhungirehe yakomeje ati “Ariko ku rundi ruhande, tubwira umuhuza wa Amerika ko twagiranye amasezerano n’uruhande rwitwa RDC, rwemeye guhagarika imirwano no gusenya FDLR. Amahoro ntiyaboneka mu gihe uruhande rumwe ari rwo rwubahiriza ibyo rusabwa mu masezerano.” Yagaragaje ko ingaruka zo kubogama zatangiye kugaragara kuko ingabo za RDC zenyegeje ibitero ku Banyamulenge muri Komini Minembwe no ku birindiro bya AFC/M23 kubera ko Perezida Félix Tshisekedi yabonye ko Amerika ntacyo imutwara.
claim_sources.translation_en: He showed that the effects of bias had begun to appear because DRC forces had stepped up attacks on the Banyamulenge in Minembwe commune and on AFC/M23 positions because President Félix Tshisekedi saw that America would do nothing to him.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Muri icyo kiganiro n’abadepite, Minisitiri Rubio yababwiye ko afite icyizere ko hagati muri Nyakanga 2026, u Rwanda ruzaba rwakuyeho ingamba z’ubwirinzi rwashyizeho. Minisitiri Nduhungirehe yasobanuye ko ibyo byashingiye ku gitekerezo u Rwanda rwatanze. Ati “Icya mbere, nta gihe ntarengwa cyatanzwe na Amerika. Ni twebwe u Rwanda, mu rwego rwo kwihutisha ishyirwa mu bikorwa amasezerano y’amahoro ya Washington agamije amahoro n’iterambere, twatanze igitekerezo cy’uburyo impande zombi zakwihutisha gushyira mu bikorwa ibyo ziyemeje.”
claim_sources.translation_en: In that meeting with the legislators, Minister Rubio told them that he was confident that by mid-July 2026 Rwanda would have lifted the defensive measures it had put in place. Minister Nduhungirehe explained that this was based on an idea that Rwanda put forward.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Col Fidele Rugabo uri mu bofisiye bakuru ba Twirwaneho, yatangaje ko bafashe Point-Zéro, Baruta, Kalonge, Bicumbi na Rubemba mu masaha ya Saa munani y’igicuku cyo kuri uyu wa 4 Nyakanga 2026.
claim_sources.translation_en: Col Fidele Rugabo, one of the senior officers of Twirwaneho, announced that they had taken Point-Zéro, Baruta, Kalonge, Bicumbi and Rubemba at around 2 a.m. (saa munani y'igicuku, Kinyarwanda time) on this 4 July 2026.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Yagize ati “Ibikorwa bya gisirikare muri Point-Zéro birangiye aka kanya saa munani n’iminota 35. Point-Zéro, Baruta, Kalonge, Bicumbi na Rubemba byafashwe. Abanzi bakwiye imishwaro mu buryo burindwi.”
claim_sources.translation_en: He said: "Military operations in Point-Zéro have just ended, at 2:35 a.m. (saa munani n'iminota 35). Point-Zéro, Baruta, Kalonge, Bicumbi and Rubemba have been taken. The enemies have been scattered in seven directions."

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Twirwaneho ifashe Point-Zéro n’ibice bihana imbibi nyuma yo gufata ibindi bice by’ingenzi biri mu nkengero za Komini Minembwe birimo Mikenke na Bilalombili ku wa 1 Nyakanga.
claim_sources.translation_en: Twirwaneho has taken Point-Zéro and neighbouring areas after taking other important areas on the outskirts of Minembwe commune including Mikenke and Bilalombili on 1 July.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Tariki ya 17 Mutarama 2026, Twirwaneho yari yafashe Point-Zéro ariko iyamburwa nyuma y’igihe gito ubwo yagabwagaho ibitero bikomeye byifashishije drones n’abasirikare bo mu mutwe w’ingabo zidasanzwe za RDC uzwi nka Hiboux.
claim_sources.translation_en: On 17 January 2026, Twirwaneho had taken Point-Zéro but was dispossessed of it shortly after, when it was attacked with strong assaults using drones and soldiers of the DRC special forces unit known as Hiboux.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Col Fidele Rugabo uri mu bofisiye bakuru ba Twirwaneho, yatangaje ko bafashe Point-Zéro, Baruta, Kalonge, Bicumbi na Rubemba mu masaha ya Saa munani y’igicuku cyo kuri uyu wa 4 Nyakanga 2026. Yagize ati “Ibikorwa bya gisirikare muri Point-Zéro birangiye aka kanya saa munani n’iminota 35. Point-Zéro, Baruta, Kalonge, Bicumbi na Rubemba byafashwe. Abanzi bakwiye imishwaro mu buryo burindwi.” Uyu murwanyi yatangaje ko Ingabo za RDC, iz’u Burundi, umutwe w’iterabwoba wa FDLR na Wazalendo zitewe ikimwaro n’abarwanyi ba Twirwaneho na M23, asuhuza abo muri Fizi na Baraka; aca amarenga ko na ho bashobora kuhafata.
claim_sources.translation_en: This fighter announced that the DRC forces, those of Burundi, the terrorist group FDLR and Wazalendo are shamed by the fighters of Twirwaneho and M23; he greeted those in Fizi and Baraka, hinting that they could take those places too.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Twirwaneho na M23 byashinjaga ihuriro ry’Ingabo za Leta ya RDC gutegurira muri Point-Zéro ibitero bikomeye zagabaga muri Santere ya Minembwe no mu bindi bice by’ingenzi bituyemo Abanyamulenge birimo Mikenke.
claim_sources.translation_en: Twirwaneho and M23 had been accusing the coalition of DRC government forces of preparing at Point-Zéro the major attacks it was launching on Minembwe Centre and other key areas inhabited by Banyamulenge, including Mikenke.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Minisitiri w’Ububanyi n’Amahanga w’u Burundi, Dr. Edouard Bizimana, yiteye akanyabugabo nyuma y’aho abasirikare benshi b’igihugu cye bapfiriye muri teritwari ya Uvira mu burasirazuba bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo. Mu kiganiro n’abadipolomate cyabaye ku wa 8 Ukuboza 2025, Minisitiri Bizimana yatangaje ko AFC/M23 yari ifite intego yo gufata umujyi wa Uvira mbere y’uko amasezerano y’amahoro ya Washington ashyirwaho umukono ku wa 4 Ukuboza ariko ngo yakomwe mu nkokora n’ingabo z’u Burundi.
claim_sources.translation_en: At a briefing with diplomats held on 8 December 2025, Minister Bizimana announced that AFC/M23 had the aim of taking the city of Uvira before the Washington peace agreement was signed on 4 December, but it was reportedly hindered by Burundian forces.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mu kiganiro n’abadipolomate cyabaye ku wa 8 Ukuboza 2025, Minisitiri Bizimana yatangaje ko AFC/M23 yari ifite intego yo gufata umujyi wa Uvira mbere y’uko amasezerano y’amahoro ya Washington ashyirwaho umukono ku wa 4 Ukuboza ariko ngo yakomwe mu nkokora n’ingabo z’u Burundi. Yagize ati “Bo bashakaga ko amasezerano asinywa bamaze gufata Luvungi na Uvira. Ariko ntibyaboroheye, ingabo zacu zahagaze neza, zirwanya umwanzi. Ndagira ngo mfate uyu mwanya nshimire abasirikare b’Abarundi bari guharanira amahoro muri Congo uko bitanze kugira ngo umwanzi ntavogere igihugu cyacu.” Uyu muyobozi yatangaje ko ingabo z’u Burundi zagiye muri RDC kugira ngo zirinde imbibi z’igihugu cyazo, kandi ko zidashobora kuvayo mu gihe ibibazo byazijyanyeyo bitarakemuka.
claim_sources.translation_en: This official announced that Burundian forces went to the DRC to protect the borders of their country, and that they cannot leave while the problems that took them there have not been resolved.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ati “Bari hariya mbere na mbere kugira ngo barinde imbibi z’u Burundi, barinde Abarundi n’ibyabo kandi rero ibyo bavuga ngo bashaka ko abasirikare b’Abarundi bavayo, ntidushobora kuvayo kuko icyatujyanye ntikirarangira kandi twagiyeyo twumvikanye na Leta ya Congo.”
claim_sources.translation_en: He said: "They are there first of all to protect Burundi's borders, to protect Burundians and their property, and so what they say about wanting Burundian soldiers to leave, we cannot leave because what took us there is not finished and we went there by agreement with the Congolese government."

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi wa AFC/M23 mu rwego rwa gisirikare, Lt Col Willy Ngoma, tariki ya 6 Ukuboza yagize ati “Abambutse babonye isomo. Basanze abagabo turi maso kandi tuzaba maso. Congo ntabwo ari Cibitoke, ntabwo ari Ngozi cyangwa Bujumbura yabo, oya. Baradusanga iwacu, turwanirira ukuri, kandi bazabibona.”
claim_sources.translation_en: The AFC/M23 military spokesperson, Lt Col Willy Ngoma, said on 6 December: "Those who crossed over have learned a lesson. They found men who are alert, and we will stay alert. Congo is not Cibitoke, it is not Ngozi or their Bujumbura, no. They come to us in our home, we are fighting for the truth, and they will see."

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mu gihe kitarenze icyumweru, ingabo z’u Burundi ziri gukorana n’iza RDC, imitwe ya Wazalendo na FDLR, byambuwe ibice byinshi byo muri Kivu y’Amajyepfo birimo Katogota, Rurambo, Luberizi, Luvungi, Mutalule, Bwegera, Nyakabere na Sange.
claim_sources.translation_en: In less than a week, the Burundian forces working with those of the DRC, the Wazalendo groups and the FDLR have been dispossessed of many areas of South Kivu including Katogota, Rurambo, Luberizi, Luvungi, Mutalule, Bwegera, Nyakabere and Sange.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Abarwanyi ba AFC/M23 baturutse muri Kamanyola, ubu bari gusatira umujyi wa Uvira
claim_sources.translation_en: AFC/M23 fighters coming from Kamanyola are now approaching the city of Uvira

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Tariki ya 4 Ukuboza yabaye umunsi mubi cyane kuri bo kuko abenshi biciwe mu gitero cya AFC/M23, abarenga 100 bafatwa mpiri. Ni bwo bapfushije Lt Col Athanase Minani.
claim_sources.translation_en: 4 December was a very bad day for them, as many were killed in an AFC/M23 attack and more than 100 were taken prisoner. That was when they lost Lt Col Athanase Minani.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ibitaro byinshi by’i Bujumbura byakiriye imirambo n’inkomere z’abasirikare b’u Burundi. Ibya gisirikare bya Kamenge byonyine byakiriye inkomere 87 nk’uko byasobanuwe n’urubuga SOS, izindi zijyanwa mu yandi mavuriro arimo Tanganyika Care Polyclinic.
claim_sources.translation_en: Many hospitals in Bujumbura received bodies and wounded of Burundian soldiers. The military hospital of Kamenge alone received 87 wounded, as explained by the SOS website, others being taken to other clinics including Tanganyika Care Polyclinic.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Amakuru avuga ko nyuma yo kwamburwa santere ya Sange ku wa 8 Ukuboza, abasirikare b’u Burundi bahawe ibwiriza ryo kuva mu mujyi wa Uvira bwangu, gusa ikitaramenyekana ni niba byakozwe kugira ngo bajye kwisuganya cyangwa se niba badateze gusubirayo.
claim_sources.translation_en: Reports say that after being dispossessed of the Sange centre on 8 December, Burundian soldiers were given the instruction to leave the city of Uvira quickly, but what is not yet known is whether this was done so that they could regroup or whether they do not intend to return.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Abasirikare b’u Burundi ntibahunze bonyine, kuko aba RDC na Wazalendo, Imbonerakure n’abasivili benshi babakurikiye.
claim_sources.translation_en: Burundian soldiers did not flee alone, because those of the DRC and Wazalendo, Imbonerakure and many civilians followed them.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kugeza tariki ya 8 Ukuboza 2025, abarwanyi ba AFC/M23 bari mu ntera y’ibilometero 30 bagana mu mujyi wa Uvira. Minisitiri Bizimana ahamya ko bafite intego yo gufata uyu mujyi mbere ya Noheli,
claim_sources.translation_en: Up to 8 December 2025, AFC/M23 fighters were within 30 kilometres of the city of Uvira. Minister Bizimana asserts that they intend to take this city before Christmas,

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Abarundi benshi basigaye muri RDC biganje mu bice bikikije Minembwe muri teritwari ya Uvira, Fizi na Mwenga.
claim_sources.translation_en: Most of the Burundians remaining in the DRC are concentrated in the areas around Minembwe in Uvira, Fizi and Mwenga territories.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umutwe witwaje intwaro wa M23 wafashe santere ya Kitsombiro iherereye muri teritwari ya Lubero, intara ya Kivu y’Amajyaruguru mu burasirazuba bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo.
claim_sources.translation_en: The armed group M23 took the Kitsombiro centre located in Lubero territory, North Kivu province in the east of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Yafashwe nyuma y’imirwano ikomeye yahanganishije ingabo za RDC na M23 mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa 19 Gashyantare 2025.
claim_sources.translation_en: It was taken after heavy fighting that pitted DRC forces against M23 on the morning of this 19 February 2025.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Santere ya Kitsombiro iri mu ntera y’ibilometero 25 werekeza muri santere ya Lubero.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Kitsombiro centre is 25 kilometres in the direction of the Lubero centre.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Amakuru ava muri Lubero avuga ko ingabo za RDC zagerageje gukoresha imbunda ziremereye na kajugujugu, mu gukumira abarwanyi ba M23 ariko biba iby’ubusa. Haravugwa abasirikare bahunze urugamba, batabwa muri yombi n’ishami ry’igisirikare cya RDC rishinzwe imyitwarire.
claim_sources.translation_en: News from Lubero says that DRC forces tried to use heavy weapons and helicopters to stop the M23 fighters, but in vain. It is said that soldiers who fled the fighting were arrested by the branch of the DRC army responsible for discipline.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umutwe wa M23 usanzwe igenzura ibindi bice byo muri Lubero, birimo Alimbongo, Kanyabayonga, Kayna, Kirumba ndetse na Matembe, wafashe mu mpera z'umwaka wa 2024.
claim_sources.translation_en: The M23 group already controls other areas in Lubero, including Alimbongo, Kanyabayonga, Kayna, Kirumba and Matembe, which it took at the end of 2024.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umusirikare wa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo ufite ipeti rya Captain yishe umuyobozi mu ntara ya Kivu y’Amajyepfo washyizweho na Leta. Uyu muyobozi ushinzwe itumanaho mu ntara ya Kivu y’Amajyepfo,Lungele Mbiso, yishwe arasiwe muri teritwari ya Uvira tariki ya 5 Nyakanga 2025.
claim_sources.translation_en: A soldier of the Democratic Republic of the Congo with the rank of Captain killed an official in South Kivu province appointed by the Government. This official in charge of communication in South Kivu province, Lungele Mbiso, was shot dead in Uvira territory on 5 July 2025.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Un capitaine des FARDC a abattu l'après-midi du 05 juillet 2025 le coordonnateur de la cellule de communication du gouverneur Jean Jacques Purusi monsieur Lungele Mbiso.
claim_sources.translation_en: A FARDC captain shot dead, on the afternoon of 5 July 2025, the coordinator of the communication cell of Governor Jean Jacques Purusi, Mr Lungele Mbiso.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon la société civile locale, l'incident a eu lieu aux environs de 15h
claim_sources.translation_en: According to local civil society, the incident took place at around 3 p.m.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuyobozi wa sosiyete sivile ihuza urubyiruko rwo muri Uvira, Kiza Tiniko, yasobanuye ko abaturage na bo bakubise uyu musirikare kugeza apfuye.
claim_sources.translation_en: The leader of the civil society grouping youth in Uvira, Kiza Tiniko, explained that residents also beat this soldier until he died.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Amakuru ava muri Uvira asobanura ko mbere y’uko uyu musirikare yicwa, yataye imbunda yarasishije Lungele bitewe n’ubwoba bw’uko yashoboraga gukurikiranwa.
claim_sources.translation_en: News from Uvira explains that before this soldier was killed, he threw away the gun he had used to shoot Lungele because of fear that he could be prosecuted.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: " Il y a un capitaine qui a tué le coordonnateur de la cellule de communication du gouverneur aux environs de 15h20. En colère, la population a lynché ce militaire et est aussi mort ", explique Kiza Tiniko, président des jeunes d'Uvira.
claim_sources.translation_en: "There is a captain who killed the coordinator of the governor's communication cell at around 15:20. In anger, the population lynched this soldier and he also died," explains Kiza Tiniko, president of the youth of Uvira. The news is confirmed by several other sources, who add that the incident took place not far from the governorate and that the soldier in question threw away his weapon before being chased by the population.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: le militaire dont il est question a jeté son arme avant d'être poursuivi par la population
claim_sources.translation_en: the soldier in question threw down his weapon before being chased by the population

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Siku ya Jumamosi kundi la ADF lilikishambulia kijiji cha Ngohi Vuyinga katika eneo la Lubero, jimbo la Kivu Kaskazini, watu 9 waliuwawa na wengine wengi kupoteza makaazi yao baada ya nyumba zao kuchomwa moto, hii ikiwa ni kulingana na Samuel Kagheni moja ya viongozi wa mashirika ya kiraia katika kijiji hicho.
claim_sources.translation_en: On Saturday the ADF group attacked the village of Ngohi Vuyinga in the Lubero area, North Kivu province, 9 people were killed and many others lost their homes after their houses were burned, according to Samuel Kagheni, one of the civil-society leaders in that village.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Takriban wanamgambo kumi waliuawa wakati wa mapigano makali yaliyotokea kati ya usiku wa Jumatatu Machi 3 na asubuhi ya Jumanne Machi 4 huko Butembo, katika jimbo la Kivu Kaskazini mashariki mwa Kongo. Kulingana na mashirika ya kiraia huko Kimemi, mojawapo ya vitongoji vya jiji hilo, mapigano haya yalipinga makundi mawili ya wanamgambo wa Wazalendo.
claim_sources.translation_en: About ten militiamen were killed during violent clashes that took place between the night of Monday 3 March and the morning of Tuesday 4 March in Butembo, in North Kivu province in eastern Congo. According to civil society in Kimemi, one of the city's neighbourhoods, these clashes pitted two groups of Wazalendo militiamen against each other.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ripoti ya muda inaonyesha wanamgambo kumi waliuawa na kadhaa kujeruhiwa, kutibiwa katika miundo ya afya katika kanda.
claim_sources.translation_en: An interim report shows ten militiamen killed and several wounded, treated in health structures in the area.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: “Miili minne iliyokufa iligunduliwa asubuhi ya leo. Hawa wangekuwa wanamgambo vijana kutoka kundi la Mavina. Walikuwa wamefungwa kabla ya kunyongwa,” anashuhudia mkazi mmoja kwenye mitandao ya kijamii
claim_sources.translation_en: “Four dead bodies were discovered this morning. They would be [i.e. reportedly are] young militiamen from the Mavina group. They had been tied up before being hanged [kunyongwa: hanged or strangled],” a resident testifies on social media

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Amakuru ava mu gisagara ca Butembo c'intara ya Kivu ya Ruguru avuga ko abantu hafi cumi bapfuye mu mishamirano yadutse hagati y'imirwi ibiri y'abarwanyi ba Wazalendo. Nk'uko bivugwa n'ikinyamakuru RFI, iyi mishamirano yadutse ku wa 3 Ntwarante (3), ikaba yamaze amasaha atari make ku mitumba ya Kimemi muri ico gisagara.
claim_sources.translation_en: News from the town of Butembo in North Kivu province says that about ten people died in clashes that broke out between two groups of Wazalendo fighters. According to the newspaper RFI, these clashes broke out on 3 March and lasted several hours on the hills of Kimemi in that town.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: umuvugizi w'igisirikare muri ako karere avuga, aho muri videwo yacishije ku mbuga hwaniro amenyesha ko bazi batandatu bapfuye. Amashirahamwe adaharanira ivyicaro vya poritike yoyo avuga ko hapfuye abashika cumi ku mpande zompi.
claim_sources.translation_en: the army spokesman in that area says, in a video he put out on the internet, that they know of six dead. The non-political associations say that up to ten died on both sides.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kwa mujibu wa vyanzo vya ndani kutoka Shirika la Kipapa la Makanisa Hitaji,(ACS), linabainisha kuwa: “Zaidi ya miili 70 imepatikana katika Kanisa la Kiprotestanti huko Maiba,Kivu Kaskazini, iliyosambaratishwa na ghasia kutokana na makundi ya waasi.”
claim_sources.translation_en: According to local sources from the Pontifical Organisation for Churches in Need (ACS), it states: “More than 70 bodies have been found in a Protestant church at Maiba, North Kivu, devastated by violence from rebel groups.”

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mauaji hayo yalifanyika kati ya tarehe 12 na 15 Februari 2025 mikononi mwa waasi wa Allied Democratic Forces (ADF), kundi la kigaidi la Kiislamu lenye asili ya Uganda, ambao waliingia kijijini hapo na kuwateka takriban watu 100.
claim_sources.translation_en: The killings took place between 12 and 15 February 2025 at the hands of Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) rebels, a terrorist Islamic group of Ugandan origin, who entered the village and abducted about 100 people.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: umelaani vikali mashambulizi makubwa yaliyofanywa na kundi lenye silaha la Allied Democratic Forces ADF kati ya tarehe 13 na 19 Novemba 2025 katika baadhi ya maeneo ya Lubero, jimboni Kivu Kaskazini na kukatili maisha ya raia wengi.
claim_sources.translation_en: has strongly condemned the major attacks carried out by the armed group Allied Democratic Forces ADF between 13 and 19 November 2025 in some areas of Lubero, North Kivu, which took the lives of many civilians.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Taarifa zilizokusanywa na MONUSCO na kutolewa leo mjini Kinshasa zinaonesha kwamba mashambulizi hayo yaliyofanywa katika utawala wa Bapere na Baswagha yamesababisha vifo vya raia 89, wakiwemo wanawake 20 na idadi ya watoto bado haijulikani.
claim_sources.translation_en: Information gathered by MONUSCO and released today in Kinshasa shows that these attacks carried out in the Bapere and Baswagha administrative entities caused the deaths of 89 civilians, including 20 women, and the number of children is still not known.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Katika kijiji cha Byambwe, kilichoko kilomita 60 magharibi mwa Lubero, angalau raia 17 wakiwemo wanawake waliokuwa wakipatiwa huduma katika wodi ya uzazi waliuawa ndani ya kituo cha afya kinachoendeshwa na Kanisa Katoliki. Wakati wa shambulizi hilo, wodi nne zenye wagonjwa ziliwaka moto.
claim_sources.translation_en: In the village of Byambwe, located 60 kilometres west of Lubero, at least 17 civilians including women who were receiving care in the maternity ward were killed inside the health centre run by the Catholic Church. During the attack, four wards with patients caught fire.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Taarifa zilizokusanywa na MONUSCO na kutolewa leo mjini Kinshasa zinaonesha kwamba mashambulizi hayo yaliyofanywa katika utawala wa Bapere na Baswagha yamesababisha vifo vya raia 89, wakiwemo wanawake 20 na idadi ya watoto bado haijulikani.
claim_sources.translation_en: Information gathered by MONUSCO and released today in Kinshasa shows that these attacks carried out in the Bapere and Baswagha administrative entities caused the deaths of 89 civilians, including 20 women, and the number of children is still not known.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: umelaani vikali mashambulizi makubwa yaliyofanywa na kundi lenye silaha la Allied Democratic Forces ADF kati ya tarehe 13 na 19 Novemba 2025 katika baadhi ya maeneo ya Lubero, jimboni Kivu Kaskazini na kukatili maisha ya raia wengi.
claim_sources.translation_en: has strongly condemned the large-scale attacks carried out by the armed group Allied Democratic Forces ADF between 13 and 19 November 2025 in some areas of Lubero, North Kivu province, which took the lives of many civilians.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umoja wa Mataifa kupitia Ujumbe wake wa kulinda amani nchini Jamhuri ya Kidemokrasia ya Congo, (MONUSCO) umelaani vikali mashambulio ya hivi karibuni yaliyofanywa na Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) katika mikoa ya Beni na Lubero, Kaskazini mwa Kivu kati ya tarehe 9 na 16 ya mwezi huu wa Agosti. Mashambulio haya yamesababisha vifo vya raia takribani 52 wakiwemo wanawake na watoto,
claim_sources.translation_en: The United Nations through its peacekeeping mission in the Democratic Republic of Congo (MONUSCO) has strongly condemned the recent attacks carried out by the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) in the regions of Beni and Lubero, North Kivu, between the 9th and 16th of this month of August. These attacks caused the deaths of about 52 civilians including women and children,

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Afisa wa serikali katika eneo hilo Macaire Sivikunula amesema shambulio hilo limetokea jana usiku katika kijiji cha Ntoyo, kilichopo katika eneo la Lubero, jimbo la Kivu Kaskazini. Msimamizi wa kijeshi wa Lubero Kanali Alain Kiwewa, ameliambia shirika la habari la Reuters kwamba, idadi ya watu waliouawa ni takriban watu 60 na huenda ikaongezeka kwani baadhi ya watu bado hawajapatikana.
claim_sources.translation_en: A government official in the area, Macaire Sivikunula, said the attack took place last night in the village of Ntoyo, in the Lubero area, North Kivu province. Lubero's military administrator Colonel Alain Kiwewa told the news agency Reuters that the number of people killed is about 60 and may rise because some people have still not been found.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Washukiwa wa waasi wa ADF wamewaua raia 19 katika shambulio la usiku huko mashariki mwa Jamhuri ya Kidemokrasia ya Congo (DRC), maafisa wawili wa eneo hilo walisema Jumatatu, hali inayozidi kuzorotesha usalama katika eneo hilo lenye utajiri wa madini.
claim_sources.translation_en: Suspected ADF rebels have killed 19 civilians in a night attack in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), two local officials said on Monday, further worsening security in the mineral-rich area.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Shambulio hilo, linalodhaniwa kufanywa na kundi la Allied Democratic Forces (ADF), lilitokea katika kijiji cha Mukondo kilichopo mkoa wa Kivu Kaskazini, alisema Alain Kiwewa, msimamizi wa kijeshi wa eneo la Lubero ambako Mukondo iko, akiongeza kuwa idadi ya vifo inaweza kuongezeka.
claim_sources.translation_en: The attack, believed to have been carried out by the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF), took place in the village of Mukondo in North Kivu province, said Alain Kiwewa, military administrator of the Lubero area where Mukondo is located, adding that the death toll could rise.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Washambuliaji huko Mukondo walivaa sare zinazofanana na zile za jeshi la Kongo, jambo lililowaruhusu kuingia kijijini bila kushukiwa. Kisha waliwashambulia watu kwa kutumia bunduki, visu, na marungu, alisema mchungaji wa eneo hilo ambaye alikataa kutaja jina lake kwa sababu za kiusalama.
claim_sources.translation_en: The attackers at Mukondo wore uniforms resembling those of the Congolese army, which allowed them to enter the village without suspicion. They then attacked people using guns, knives and clubs, said a local pastor who declined to give his name for security reasons.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Watu 10 wameuawa mashariki mwa Jamhuri ya Kidemokrasia ya Kongo na waasi wenye itikadi kali wenye mafungamano na kundi la kigaidi linalojiita Dola la Kiislamu (IS).
claim_sources.translation_en: 10 people have been killed in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo by extremist rebels linked to the terrorist group calling itself the Islamic State (IS).

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Waasi hao wa ADF walishambulia jana kijiji cha Makoko katika eneo la Lubero, Jimbo la Kivu Kaskazini. Wakati wa mashambulizi hayo, hakukuwa na askari wa Kongo katika kijiji hicho, ispokuwa wapiganaji wanaojulikana kama Wazalendo, ambao mara kadhaa wamekua wakishirikiana na vikosi vya Kongo. Hayo yameelezwa na mbunge wa jimbo hilo David Sikuli,
claim_sources.translation_en: Those ADF rebels attacked the village of Makoko yesterday in the Lubero area, North Kivu Province. During those attacks there were no Congolese soldiers in the village, except fighters known as Wazalendo, who have several times cooperated with Congolese forces. This was stated by the member of parliament for that province, David Sikuli,

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mamlaka za afya nchini Jamhuri ya Kidemokrasi ya Congo zimo katika hali ya taharuki baada ya msichana wa miaka sita aliyekuwa akipatiwa matibabu ya Ebola, kutekwa nyara kutoka kituo cha afya mashariki mwa nchi hiyo. Watu wenye silaha walivamia kliniki moja karibu na mji wa Butembo, jimbo la Kivu Kaskazini, na kumchukua mtoto huyo pamoja na mama yake
claim_sources.translation_en: Health authorities in the Democratic Republic of Congo are in a state of alarm after a six-year-old girl who was being treated for Ebola was abducted from a health facility in the east of the country. Armed people stormed a clinic near the town of Butembo, in North Kivu province, and took the child together with her mother

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Dkt. Lubambo Maboko Gaston, meneja wa kukabiliana na mlipuko wa Ebola katika jimbo hilo, ametoa wito wa dharura kwa watekaji na familia hiyo. "Hadi sasa bado hatujawapata watu hao wawili. Tunatoa wito rasmi kwao kwenda haraka iwezekanavyo katika kituo cha matibabu ya Ebola," Dkt. Gaston aliliambia shirika la habari la Reuters.
claim_sources.translation_en: Dr. Lubambo Maboko Gaston, manager of the Ebola outbreak response in the province, has made an urgent call to the abductors and the family. “So far we have not found these two people. We officially call on them to go as quickly as possible to the Ebola treatment centre,” Dr Gaston told the news agency Reuters.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Msururu mpya wa mashambulizi yanayohusishwa na waasi wa Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) yamesababisha maombolezo katika eneo la Beni katika jimbo la Kivu Kaskazini
claim_sources.translation_en: A new series of attacks attributed to Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) rebels has caused mourning in the Beni area in North Kivu province

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kati ya usiku wa Jumamosi, Mei 30, na Jumapili, Mei 31, 2026, takriban raia 17 waliuawa katika mashambulizi kadhaa yaliyoratibiwa kwenye shoka za Vemba-Katota na Vemba-Masulukwede, kulingana na vyanzo vya ndani na watendaji wa mashirika ya kiraia.
claim_sources.translation_en: Between the night of Saturday, May 30, and Sunday, May 31, 2026, about 17 civilians were killed in several coordinated attacks on the Vemba-Katota and Vemba-Masulukwede axes, according to local sources and civil-society actors.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Katika maeneo ya afya ya Butembo na Beni, mashariki mwa Jamhuri ya Kidemokrasia ya Kongo (DRC), pamoja na Kisangani, kaskazini mashariki mwa nchi, madaktari, wauguzi, mafundi wa maabara, na wahudumu wa afya ya jamii bado wanakataa kurejea kazini. Wanadai kulipwa mishahara yao na marupurupu ya hatari
claim_sources.translation_en: In the health zones of Butembo and Beni, in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), as well as Kisangani, in the north-east of the country, doctors, nurses, laboratory technicians and community health workers still refuse to return to work. They demand to be paid their salaries and risk allowances

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kesi dhidi ya wanajeshi sitini watoro wa vikosi vya jeshi la Jamhuri ya Kidemokrasia ya Congo (FARDC) na washirika wawili wa kike imefunguliwa leo. Watuhumiwa hao walifikishwa katika mahakama ya kijeshi ya Butembo mjini Musienene, katika mkoa wa Kivu Kaskazini.
claim_sources.translation_en: The case against sixty deserter soldiers of the armed forces of the Democratic Republic of Congo (FARDC) and two female accomplices opened today. The accused were brought before the Butembo military tribunal in Musienene, in North Kivu province.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: "Watuhumiwa wanashtakiwa na mahakama ya kijeshi ya Butembo kwa kumkimbia adui, wizi, ubakaji, unyang'anyi na makosa mengine katika maeneo ya Lubero-Centre, Kimbulu na Musienene," Seros Muyisa, mwandishi wa habari wa eneo hilo ambaye alikuwepo katika kikao hicho, aliiambia BBC.
claim_sources.translation_en: “The accused are being prosecuted by the Butembo military tribunal for fleeing the enemy, theft, rape, extortion and other offences in the areas of Lubero-Centre, Kimbulu and Musienene,” Seros Muyisa, a local journalist who was present at the hearing, told the BBC.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ivugurura: Abasirikare 55 mu baregwaga ibyaha birimo guhunga urugamba no gusahura barabihamijwe, bakatirwa urwo gupfa. Urubanza rw'aba basirikare b'ingabo za FARDC bagera kuri 60 bashinjwa guta urugamba bagahunga bagakora ibikorwa by'ubugizi bwa nabi rwatangiye kuburanishwa ku wa mbere mu mujyi wa Butembo w'intara ya Kivu ya Ruguru muri DR Congo.
claim_sources.translation_en: Update: 55 of the soldiers accused of offences including fleeing the battlefield and looting were convicted and sentenced to death. The trial of these FARDC soldiers, about 60 accused of abandoning the front and fleeing and committing criminal acts, began on Monday in the city of Butembo in North Kivu province in DR Congo.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: M23 imekuwa ikijaribu kuzunguka ngome za FARDC katika mji wa Lubero tangu mwishoni mwa Februari bila mafanikio. M23 iliuteka Mji wa Kasugho Machi 2, 2025, kabla ya kuondoka Machi 7 na kuelekea Bunyatenge, eneo lenye machimbo ya dhahabu lililo umbali wa saa sita kutoka Kasugho nchini humo.
claim_sources.translation_en: M23 has been trying to encircle FARDC strongholds in the town of Lubero since late February without success. M23 captured the town of Kasugho on 2 March 2025, before leaving on 7 March and heading for Bunyatenge, a gold-mining area six hours from Kasugho in that country.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Dans l'est de la République démocratique du Congo, les cas de violences sexuelles continuent d'augmenter.
claim_sources.translation_en: In the east of the Democratic Republic of Congo, sexual violence cases continue to rise.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Rien que pour la ville de Butembo, dans la province du Nord-Kivu, le Réseau pour les droits de l'Homme, le Redho, dit avoir enregistré, en 2025, 280 crimes de ce genre qui ont été portés devant la justice, dans un rapport rendu public à la mi-mars.
claim_sources.translation_en: For the city of Butembo alone, in North Kivu province, the Network for Human Rights, Redho, says it recorded 280 such crimes in 2025 that were brought to justice, in a report made public in mid-March.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Muhindo Wasingya, le coordonnateur du Redho, s'inquiète notamment de la lenteur des procédures judiciaires qui favorise le recours à des accords à l'amiable entre les familles.
claim_sources.translation_en: Muhindo Wasingya, the coordinator of Redho, is particularly worried about the slowness of judicial procedures, which favours the use of out-of-court settlements between families.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: M23 imeendeleza mashambulizi mashariki mwa Kongo na kuingia katika mji wa Walikale, siku mbili baada ya marais Tshisekedi wa Kongo na Kagame wa Rwanda kutoa wito wa kusitisha mapigano kufuatia mkutano wao huko Qatar.
claim_sources.translation_en: M23 has continued attacks in eastern Congo and entered the town of Walikale, two days after the presidents Tshisekedi of Congo and Kagame of Rwanda called for a ceasefire following their meeting in Qatar.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Muungano wa makundi ya waasi wa AFC/M23 umesema katika taarifa yake iliyochapishwa kwenye jukwaa la X, kwamba umeamua kuviondoa vikosi vyake kutoka kwenye mji wa Walikale na pia kutoka kwenye maeneo ya jirani ya mji huo.
claim_sources.translation_en: The alliance of rebel groups AFC/M23 said in its statement published on the X platform that it had decided to withdraw its forces from the town of Walikale and also from the areas neighbouring that town.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Waziri wa Mambo ya Nje wa Kongo Therese Kayikwamba Wagner, amewaambia waandishi wa Habari kwamba serikali inasubiri kwa hamu kuona kama kweli M23 watajiondoa kutoka kwenye mji wa Walikale
