claim_sources.translation_en: Congo's Foreign Minister Therese Kayikwamba Wagner has told journalists that the government is waiting eagerly to see whether M23 will really withdraw from the town of Walikale

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Akithibitisha kuondoka kwa M23, msemaji wa jeshi la Kongo Sylvain Ekenge siku ya Ijumaa alisema kwamba wanajeshi wake wameshuhudia kuondoa kwao.
claim_sources.translation_en: Confirming M23's departure, the Congolese army spokesperson Sylvain Ekenge said on Friday that his soldiers had witnessed their leaving.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Waasi wa kundi la M23 katika mashariki mwa Jamhuri ya Kongo wamejiondoa kutoka mji wa kimkakati wa Walikale, wakielezea hatua hiyo kama ishara ya nia njema kabla ya mazungumzo ya amani.
claim_sources.translation_en: Rebels of the M23 group in the east of the Republic of Congo have withdrawn from the strategic town of Walikale, describing the move as a gesture of goodwill before peace talks.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Télesphore Mithondeke, ukora muri sosiyete sivile muri Masisi, yasabye ko hakorwa iperereza kugira ngo hamenyekane ababigizemo uruhare, anasaba impande zose ziri mu mirwano kubahiriza amategeko mpuzamahanga arengera abasivili mu gihe cy’intambara. Mithondeke yavuze ko mu gace ka Kaleta-Bitoyi, ahitwa Ufamandu II, igitero cya drone cyahitanye umugore n’umwana.
claim_sources.translation_en: Télesphore Mithondeke, who works in civil society in Masisi, asked that an investigation be carried out to establish who was responsible, and asked all parties in the fighting to respect international law protecting civilians in wartime. Mithondeke said that in the Kaleta-Bitoyi area, at Ufamandu II, a drone attack killed a woman and a child.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mu itangazo ryasohowe ku wa Mbere tariki ya 28 Nzeri(9), umuryango uharanira inyungu z’abaturage wa Forces vives de Masisi wavuze ko hari abaturage benshi bishwe cyangwa bagakomereka, abandi bagahunga imidugudu yabo. Uyu muryango wavuze ko bamwe mu baturage bishwe n’ibitero by’indege zitagira abapilote (drones) zitwarwamo ibisasu
claim_sources.translation_en: In a communique issued on Monday 28 September(9), the community-interest organisation Forces vives de Masisi said that many residents had been killed or wounded, and others had fled their villages. The organisation said some of the residents were killed by attacks of pilotless aircraft (drones) carrying bombs.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mithondeke kandi yavuze ko imirwano yabereye i Burungu ahitwa Bashali, yahitanye abaturage umunani.
claim_sources.translation_en: Mithondeke also said that fighting at Burungu in Bashali killed eight residents.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuhari AFC/M23 wahakanye ivyagiriji vya Amnesty International bivuga ko wishe kandi ugahohotera abacukuzi bato bato, ukanatwara inzahabu na coltan mu Rwanda. Mw’itangazo yasohoye i Goma ejo ku wa kabiri, AFC/M23 yavuze ko Amnesty itatanze ivyemezo bifadika bishobora gusuzumwa.
claim_sources.translation_en: The AFC/M23 movement denied Amnesty International's allegations that it killed and abused small-scale miners, and took gold and coltan to Rwanda. In a statement it issued in Goma yesterday, Tuesday, AFC/M23 said Amnesty had not provided solid evidence that could be examined.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mu cegeranyo casohotse ku munsi wa mbere uheze, Amnesty yari yagirije uwo muhari ibirego vy'ubwicanyi, ugukubagura abantu, ukubapfunga ata mategeko akurikijwe, ukubakoresha ku nguvu no kubinjiza mu mirwi y’abarwanyi ku nguvu. Iryo shirahamwe ryavuze ko ivyo vyabereye ahacukurwa coltan i Rubaya muri Kivu ya Ruguru no ku birombwe vy’inzahabu vya Lomera muri Kivu y’Epfo.
claim_sources.translation_en: In the report published last Monday, Amnesty had accused that movement of killings, ill-treating ('ugukubagura') people, imprisoning them without legal procedure, using them by force [forced labour] and forcibly recruiting them into armed groups. The organisation said these took place at the coltan mining site in Rubaya in North Kivu and at the gold mines of Lomera in South Kivu.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Lumumba Kambere Muyisa, umuvugizi wa guverineri w'intara ya Kivu ya Ruguru, yabwiye ibitangazamakuru ko ibice byo hejuru by'icyo kirombe byahubukiye mu kirombe ku wa gatatu kubera imvura nyinshi
claim_sources.translation_en: Lumumba Kambere Muyisa, spokesperson of the governor of the province of North Kivu, told the media that the upper parts of that mine had collapsed into the mine on Wednesday because of heavy rain

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Leta ya DRC yavuze ko guhera muri Gashyantare (2) mu 2025, iteka rya minisitiri ryategetse ko akarere k'ubucukuzi bw'amabuye y'agaciro ka Rubaya katemerewe gucukurwamo kuko nta buryo bw'umutekano na bucye buhari ku bacukuzi, yibutsa ko no muri Kamena (6) mu 2025 abasivile barenga 300 bapfuye i Rubaya mu buryo nk'ubwo.
claim_sources.translation_en: The DRC government said that since February (2) 2025 a ministerial order had ordered that the Rubaya mining area is not permitted to be mined because there is no security or little of it for miners, and recalled that in June (6) 2025 more than 300 civilians also died at Rubaya in a similar way.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kuri uyu wa Kabiri, itariki ya 20 Ukwakira, ahitwa Ntoto, umurwa mukuru wa Gurupoma ya Waloa Uroba, muri Teritwari ya Walikale mu Ntara ya Kivu y’Amajyaruguru, umusirikare n’umusivili bishwe n’amasasu ubwo imitwe ibiri y’Ingabo za Repubulika ya Demokarasi ya Congo (FARDC) yasubiranagamo.
claim_sources.translation_en: On this Tuesday, 20 October, at Ntoto, the capital of the Waloa Uroba groupement, in Walikale territory in North Kivu province, a soldier and a civilian were killed by bullets when two units of the Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of Congo (FARDC) fought each other.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Amakuru agera kuri ACTUALITE.CD avuga ko undi musirikare n’umusivili na bo bakomeretse bikabije. Umuyobozi wa Gurupoma ya Waloa Uroba, Barthélemy Mulengezi Luc, yasobanuye ko ibyabaye byabaye igihe itsinda ry'abasirikare bari baturutse ku rugamba bagerageza kwambuka Ntoto.
claim_sources.translation_en: Information reaching ACTUALITE.CD says that another soldier and a civilian were also seriously wounded. The head of the Waloa Uroba groupement, Barthélemy Mulengezi Luc, explained that what happened occurred when a group of soldiers coming from the front tried to cross Ntoto.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Abasirikare 54 bo muri régiment ya 3415 y’Ingabo za Repubulika ya Demokarasi ya Congo (FARDC) batangiye kuburanishwa imbere y’Urukiko rwa Gisirikare rwa Goma, ruteraniye mu buryo bwihariye i Walikale, muri Kivu y’Amajyaruguru, kuva ku wa Mbere, itariki ya 26 Ukwakira.
claim_sources.translation_en: 54 soldiers of the 3415th regiment of the Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of Congo (FARDC) began to be tried before the Goma Military Court, sitting specially in Walikale, in North Kivu, from Monday 26 October.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Aba basirikare bashinjwa ibyaha birimo ubwicanyi, guta imirimo yabo, gusesagura amasasu n’ibikoresho bya gisirikare, ndetse no kwanga kumvira amategeko. ‎Biteganyijwe ko umwanzuro w’urukiko uzasohoka mu ntangiriro z’ukwezi k’Ugushyingo.
claim_sources.translation_en: These soldiers are accused of offences including murder, desertion, wasting ammunition and military equipment, and refusing to obey orders. The court's decision is expected at the start of November.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Nk’uko byatangajwe na Major Dieudonné Kasereka, ushinzwe itumanaho mu Karere ka 34 ka Gisirikare, aba basirikare batawe muri yombi ku wa 20 Ukwakira nyuma y’ibyabereye i Ntoto, mu gace ka Waloa Loanda, hafi y’umupaka na Teritwari ya Masisi.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to Major Dieudonné Kasereka, in charge of communications in the 34th Military Region, these soldiers were arrested on 20 October after the events at Ntoto, in the Waloa Loanda area, near the border with Masisi territory.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ihuriro rya AFC/M23 na Wazalendo ishyigikiwe n’ubutegetsi bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo biri mu mirwano ikomeye muri santere ya Nyabiondo iherereye muri teritwari ya Masisi, intara ya Kivu y’Amajyaruguru.
claim_sources.translation_en: The AFC/M23 alliance and the Wazalendo, backed by the authorities of the Democratic Republic of Congo, are in heavy fighting in the Nyabiondo centre, located in Masisi territory, North Kivu province.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mu masaa saba y’ijoro ryo ku wa 19 rishyira uwa 20 Ukwakira, imitwe ya Wazalendo yagabye igitero kuri AFC/M23 muri Nyabiondo, hatangira imirwano ikomeye.
claim_sources.translation_en: At around saa saba [about 1 a.m.] in the night of the 19th going into the 20th of October, Wazalendo groups launched an attack on AFC/M23 in Nyabiondo, and heavy fighting began.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ku mugoroba wa tariki ya 18 Ukwakira, indege z’ingabo za RDC zarashe ku birindiro bya AFC/M23 muri Mpeti na Buhaya muri Walikale. Umuyobozi wungirije wa AFC/M23, Bertrand Bisimwa, yamaganye iki gitero, yibutsa ko Leta ya RDC iri kurenga ku masezerano impande zombi zagiranye ubwo zari i Doha muri Qatar.
claim_sources.translation_en: On the evening of 18 October, aircraft of the DRC army fired on AFC/M23 positions at Mpeti and Buhaya in Walikale. The deputy head of AFC/M23, Bertrand Bisimwa, condemned the attack, recalling that the DRC government is violating the agreement the two sides made when they were in Doha, Qatar.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umutwe wa M23 wigaruriye Centre y’ubucuruzi ya Mubi yo muri Teritwari ya Walikale,
claim_sources.translation_en: The M23 group took the trading Centre of Mubi in Walikale territory,

claim_sources.translation_en: M23 took it on Friday 21 March, with reports saying it took it without fighting because before it entered, the alliance of government forces had already fled it.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Iyi Centre iherereye mu bilometero bibarirwa muri 36 uvuye i Walikale-Centre, ku muhanda ujya mu mujyi wa Kisangani.
claim_sources.translation_en: This centre is located about 36 kilometres from Walikale-Centre, on the road to the city of Kisangani.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Katika taarifa iliyotolewa Jumapili Machi 23, msemaji wa serikali Yolande Makolo alisema kwamba wamepokea vyema habari kwamba shughuli za kijeshi za jeshi la FARDC na kundi la Wazalendo linalowaunga mkono yatasitishwa pia.
claim_sources.translation_en: In a statement issued on Sunday March 23, government spokesperson Yolande Makolo said that they had welcomed the news that the military activities of the FARDC army and the Wazalendo group that supports it would also be suspended.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Jeshi la Jamhuri ya demokrasi ya Congo limeimarisha kampeni yake ya kutaka waasi wa Democratic Forces for the Liberation of Rwanda (FDLR), kutoka Rwanda linaloendesha shughuli zake nchini DRC, kujisalimisha kwa mamlaka za Congo au kwa walinda amani wa Umoja wa Mataifa (MONUSCO).
claim_sources.translation_en: The army of the Democratic Republic of Congo has stepped up its campaign to get the rebels of the Democratic Forces for the Liberation of Rwanda (FDLR), from Rwanda and operating in the DRC, to surrender to Congolese authorities or to United Nations peacekeepers (MONUSCO).

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Maafisa wa polisi na jeshi la FRDC wamekuwa wakitumia vipaza sauti katika eneo la Walikale, jimbo la Kivu Kaskazini, kuwahimiza waasi hao wajisalimishe.
claim_sources.translation_en: Police and FRDC army officers have been using loudspeakers in the Walikale area, North Kivu province, to urge those rebels to surrender.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Oparesheni hiyo pia katika eneo la Pinga, mpakani mwa Masisi, ambako kunatajwa kuwa baadhi ya makundi ya FDLR yanapiga kambi huko.
claim_sources.translation_en: The operation is also in the Pinga area, on the border of Masisi, where some FDLR groups are said to be camped.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: M23 ilianzisha mashambulizi ya kushtukiza yaliyovunja ngome za vikosi vya serikali karibu na mji mkuu wa wilaya ya Masisi na kuishia kuteka eneo la Nyabiondo na vijiji kadhaa jirani, kuanzia juzi Machi 9, 2025.
claim_sources.translation_en: M23 launched surprise attacks that broke the strongholds of government forces near the capital of the Masisi district and ended up capturing the Nyabiondo area and several neighbouring villages, from the day before yesterday, March 9, 2025.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Bimwe mu binyamakuru muri Congo bivuga ko ku wa kane umutwe wa M23 wafashe agace ka Kazinga muri Masisi, gusa aya makuru ntaremezwa n'uruhande urwo ari rwo rwose muri izi zirwana.
claim_sources.translation_en: Some of the media in Congo say that on Thursday the M23 group took the area of Kazinga in Masisi, but this information has not yet been confirmed by any of the sides fighting.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi wa AFC/M23, Lawrence Kanyuka, yatangaje ko FARDC iri gukora ibyaha by’intambara kuko iri kurasa abaturage idasize n’amatungo yabo.
claim_sources.translation_en: The spokesperson of AFC/M23, Lawrence Kanyuka, announced that the FARDC is committing war crimes because it is shooting at residents without sparing even their livestock.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kanyuka yavuze ko ku wa Kane, tariki ya 26 Gashyantare 2026, ahagana saa kumi na Cumi n’Itanu z’amanywa (16:15), ingabo zishyize hamwe, cyane cyane iz’omutwe wa FDLR, zinjiye mu gice cy’icyayi cya JTN giherereye i Mweso.” Akomeza agira ati ” Mu bikorwa by’ubugome bukabije, abo barwanyi barashe inka 19, aho 15 zapfuye ako kanya naho 4 zigakomereka bikabije.
claim_sources.translation_en: Kanyuka said that on Thursday, 26 February 2026, at about 16:15 in the afternoon, the combined forces, especially those of the FDLR group, entered the JTN tea area located at Mweso." He continued: "In the most serious acts of cruelty, those fighters shot 19 cows, of which 15 died immediately and 4 were seriously wounded.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi wa AFC/M23, Lawrence Kanyuka, yatangaje ko FARDC iri gukora ibyaha by’intambara kuko iri kurasa abaturage idasize n’amatungo yabo.
claim_sources.translation_en: The spokesperson of AFC/M23, Lawrence Kanyuka, announced that the FARDC is committing war crimes because it is shooting at residents without sparing even their livestock.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Icyababaje kurushaho, ni uko barashe amasasu y’urufaya ku mukobwa w’imyaka 19 witwa Wamahoro, ukomoka i Kitchanga, akaba yahise yitaba Imana ako kanya.”
claim_sources.translation_en: What was most painful is that they fired bursts of bullets at a 19-year-old girl called Wamahoro, from Kitchanga, who died immediately."

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mji wa MPATI, ulioko katika eneo la kichifu la Bashali, eneo la Masisi,
claim_sources.translation_en: The town of MPATI, located in the Bashali chiefdom, Masisi territory,

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Wanawake waliohojiwa na SOS Media Burundi mnamo Septemba 21, 2025, walisimulia vitendo vya kinyama vilivyofanywa na wanamgambo wa NYATURA na Collectif des Mouvements pour le Changement – Vikosi vya Ulinzi vya Watu (CMC-FDP).
claim_sources.translation_en: The women interviewed by SOS Media Burundi on September 21, 2025, recounted brutal acts committed by militiamen of NYATURA and the Collectif des Mouvements pour le Changement – People's Defence Forces (CMC-FDP).

claim_sources.excerpt_original: M. N., mkazi wa MPATI, alishuhudia: “Takriban wanawake wote hapa walibakwa wakati wa vita. Mimi mwenyewe niliteswa na vitendo vya kinyama mikononi mwa wanaume wa Jenerali Guidon.
claim_sources.translation_en: M. N., a resident of MPATI, testified: "Almost all the women here were raped during the war. I myself was tortured by brutal acts at the hands of General Guidon's men.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Perezida Kagame yavuze ko mu turere M23 igenzura, ikora neza mu guhangana na FDLR n'indi mitwe y'abagizi ba nabi, ariko mu turere twa Masisi, Walikale n’ahandi ingabo za FARDC zigenzura, FDLR iracyahaboneka aho ifatanya n'ingabo za Guverinoma.
claim_sources.translation_en: President Kagame said that in the areas M23 controls it works well in combating FDLR and other criminal groups, but in the areas of Masisi, Walikale and elsewhere that FARDC forces control, FDLR is still found there, cooperating with government forces.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Shambulio la anga lililohusishwa na Wanajeshi wa Jamhuri ya Kidemokrasia ya Kongo (FARDC) liliua takriban raia saba na kuwajeruhi wengine zaidi ya 40 mnamo Ijumaa, Januari 2, 2026, Masisi-Center,
claim_sources.translation_en: An air strike attributed to the Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of Congo (FARDC) killed about seven civilians and wounded more than 40 others on Friday, January 2, 2026, at Masisi-Center,

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kwa mujibu wa Shirika la Madaktari Wasio na Mipaka (MSF), watu 42 ambao wengi wao walijeruhiwa katika shambulio hilo kwa sasa wamelazwa katika Hospitali Kuu ya Rufaa ya Masisi.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to Doctors Without Borders (MSF), 42 people, most of whom were wounded in the attack, are currently admitted to the Masisi General Referral Hospital.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ujumbe wa Umoja wa Mataifa wa Kutuliza Utulivu katika Jamhuri ya Kidemokrasia ya Kongo (MONUSCO) umelaani Jumamosi, Januari 3, 2026, shambulio la ndege zisizo na rubani lililotokea siku iliyotangulia huko Masisi-Center.
claim_sources.translation_en: The United Nations Stabilisation Mission in the Democratic Republic of Congo (MONUSCO) condemned on Saturday, January 3, 2026, the drone strike that took place the previous day in Masisi-Center.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: SOS Médias Burundi Goma, Novemba 27, 2025 – Mapigano makali yalizuka alfajiri siku ya Alhamisi kati ya waasi wa M23, wenye mfungamano na Muungano wa Kongo River Alliance (AFC), vuguvugu la kisiasa na kijeshi linaloipinga Kinshasa, na wanamgambo wa ndani wa Wazalendo, wanaoungwa mkono na mamlaka ya Kongo.
claim_sources.translation_en: SOS Médias Burundi Goma, November 27, 2025 – Heavy fighting broke out at dawn on Thursday between M23 rebels, linked to the Congo River Alliance (AFC), a political and military movement opposing Kinshasa, and local Wazalendo militiamen, who are supported by the Congolese authorities.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Makabiliano hayo yalifanyika katika kijiji cha Kibati, katika kundi la Luberike, eneo la Walikale, jimbo la Kivu Kaskazini.
claim_sources.translation_en: The clashes took place in the village of Kibati, in the Luberike grouping, Walikale territory, North Kivu province.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: FARDC (Vikosi vya Wanajeshi vya Jamhuri ya Kidemokrasia ya Kongo) walitumia jeshi lao la anga kushambulia nyadhifa za AFC/M23 huko Kibati (Walikale) na Kasopo (Masisi).
claim_sources.translation_en: The FARDC (Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of Congo) used their air force to attack AFC/M23 positions at Kibati (Walikale) and Kasopo (Masisi).

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Hakuna takwimu rasmi za majeruhi zinazopatikana, kwani eneo hilo linabaki kuwa gumu kufikiwa.
claim_sources.translation_en: No official casualty figures are available, as the area remains difficult to reach.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi w'igisirikare ca Repubulika ya Demokarasi ya Congo (FARDC), Jenerali Majoro Sylvain Ekenge amenyesha ko inyeshamba za M23 zisubije igisagara ca Masisi ku muhingamo w'uno wa kane , inyuma y'aho mu gatondo ko kuri uno musi nyene amenyeshereje ko ingabo za reta zari zakigaruye ejo ku wa gatatu.
claim_sources.translation_en: The spokesperson of the army of the Democratic Republic of Congo (FARDC), Major General Sylvain Ekenge, announces that M23 rebels retook the town of Masisi on the afternoon of this Thursday, after he had announced in the morning of this same day that the government forces had retaken it yesterday, Wednesday.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi w'igisirikare ca Repubulika ya Demokarasi ya Congo (FARDC), Jenerali Majoro Sylvain Ekenge amenyesha ko inyeshamba za M23 zisubije igisagara ca Masisi ku muhingamo w'uno wa kane , inyuma y'aho mu gatondo ko kuri uno musi nyene amenyeshereje ko ingabo za reta zari zakigaruye ejo ku wa gatatu.
claim_sources.translation_en: The spokesperson of the army of the Democratic Republic of Congo (FARDC), Major General Sylvain Ekenge, announces that M23 rebels retook the town of Masisi on the afternoon of this Thursday, after he had announced in the morning of this same day that the government forces had retaken it yesterday, Wednesday.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Jenerali Majoro Ekenge avuga ko ingabo za reta zivyifatamwo neza, kandi ko ari zo zigenzura igisagara cose ca Ngungu no mu micungararo yaco.
claim_sources.translation_en: Major General Ekenge says that the government forces are doing well there, and that they are the ones controlling the whole town of Ngungu and its surroundings.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Uasi wa kundi la M23, linaloungwa mkono na Rwanda, ulichukua udhibiti wa mji wa Masisi, mji muhimu mashariki mwa Jamhuri ya Kidemokrasia ya Congo, Jumamosi.
claim_sources.translation_en: The rebellion of the M23 group, backed by Rwanda, took control of the town of Masisi, an important town in the east of the Democratic Republic of Congo, on Saturday.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Wakati huo huo, jeshi la DRC limerudi nyuma, likisema linaepuka kupoteza maisha zaidi katika mji wa Masisi.
claim_sources.translation_en: Meanwhile, the DRC army has pulled back, saying it is avoiding losing more lives in the town of Masisi.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: "Ni kwa masikitiko makubwa kufahamu kuhusu kutekwa kwa kituo cha Masisi na M23," Alexis Bahunga, mbunge wa jimbo la Kivu Kaskazini, aliliambia shirika la habari la AFP. "Tunaiomba serikali kuchukua hatua zinazolenga kurejesha mamlaka ya serikali katika eneo lote," aliongeza.
claim_sources.translation_en: "It is with great sadness to learn of the capture of the Masisi centre by M23," Alexis Bahunga, member of parliament of North Kivu province, told the news agency AFP. "We ask the government to take steps aimed at restoring government authority in the whole area," he added.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi wa AFC/M23, Lawrence Kanyuka, yatangaje ko iki gitero cyagabwe mu gace ka Malemo na Kalembe ku rugabano rwa Masisi na Walikale mu ijoro ryo ku wa 24 Gicurasi 2026.
claim_sources.translation_en: AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka announced that this attack was launched in the Malemo and Kalembe area on the border of Masisi and Walikale in the night of 24 May 2026.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kanyuka yagize ati “Muri Malemo bishe abasivili batatu, bakomeretsa batandatu, banashimuta umuyobozi waho, ubu kugeza uyu munsi ibyamubayeho ntibiramenyekana.”
claim_sources.translation_en: Kanyuka said: "In Malemo they killed three civilians, wounded six, and also abducted its leader, and until today what happened to him is not known."

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ihuriro AFC/M23 rirwanya ubutegetsi bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, ryatangaje ko abarwanyi b’umutwe w’iterabwoba wa FDLR bari kumwe na Wazalendo, biciye muri Teritwari ya Masisi na Walikale abaturage 10.
claim_sources.translation_en: The AFC/M23 alliance, which opposes the government of the Democratic Republic of Congo, announced that fighters of the terrorist group FDLR, together with Wazalendo, killed 10 residents in the territories of Masisi and Walikale.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: AFC/M23 yatangaje ko nyuma yo kuva muri utu duce, FDLR na Wazalendo muri utu duce, byasahuye bikomeye agace ka Bweru, bitwara inka 11 z’abaturage ndetse n’ingurube nyinshi.
claim_sources.translation_en: AFC/M23 announced that after leaving these areas, FDLR and Wazalendo in these areas looted the Bweru area heavily, taking 11 cows of residents and many pigs.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi wa AFC/M23, Lawrence Kanyuka, yavuze ko ingabo za Leta ya RDC zagabye ibitero mu rukerera rwo ku wa Kane, tariki ya 10 Nzeri 2026, mu bice birimo Ihula, Malemo, Minjenje na Kibati n’ahabikikije.
claim_sources.translation_en: The AFC/M23 spokesperson, Lawrence Kanyuka, said that the DRC government forces launched attacks at dawn on Thursday, 10 September 2026, in areas including Ihula, Malemo, Minjenje and Kibati and the surrounding areas.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mu butumwa yanyujije ku rubuga rwa X, Kanyuka yavuze ko imirwano yari igikomeje ubwo yatangazaga aya makuru, ndetse ko abaturage benshi bahunze ingo zabo.
claim_sources.translation_en: In a message he posted on X, Kanyuka said the fighting was still going on when he announced this, and that many residents had fled their homes.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi wa AFC/M23 yavuze ko uku gukaza imirwano kwagize ingaruka ku mutekano w’abaturage ndetse ko bishobora no kubangamira ibikorwa by’ubutabazi.
claim_sources.translation_en: The AFC/M23 spokesperson said that this escalation of fighting affected the security of residents and could also hinder aid work.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Yavuze ko imiryango itanga ubutabazi n’abakozi bayo batabasha kugera ku baturage bagizweho ingaruka n’ibitero by’ingabo za Leta ya Congo n’abafatanyabikorwa bayo.
claim_sources.translation_en: He said that aid organisations and their staff cannot reach the residents affected by the attacks of the forces of the government of Congo and its partners.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Amakuru aturuka muri ako gace avuga ko AFC/M23 yigaruriye umusozi wa Mindjendje, uherereye mu gace ka Banakindi, muri groupement ya Kisimba.
claim_sources.translation_en: Information from the area says that AFC/M23 took the hill of Mindjendje, located in the Banakindi area, in the Kisimba groupement.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Imirwano yabereye kuri uyu wa Kane, tariki ya 10 Nzeri 2026, yatangiye mu gitondo, ikomereza mu bice biri hafi y’umupaka w’uturere twa Walikale na Masisi. Abaturage bo muri ako gace bavuga ko imirwano yari ikomeye, ndetse hakaba harakoreshejwe n’indege zitagira abapilote.
claim_sources.translation_en: The fighting that took place on this Thursday, 10 September 2026, began in the morning, continuing in areas near the border of the territories of Walikale and Masisi. Residents of the area say that the fighting was heavy, and that drones were also used.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Various reports from the Waloa Loanda groupement (in Walikale Territory , North Kivu) indicate that a large number of armed individuals , believed to be FDLR rebels , are disturbing security in Mishipo , in the Makungurano area.

reports suggest that in a meeting with locals, the group's leader told residents to vacate the area , claiming that he had bought the land

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Nk’uko bitangazwa n’imiryango itegamiye kuri leta (sosiyete sivile) yo muri ako gace, iyi mirwano yatumye abaturage benshi bahunga. Bamwe berekeza i Ramba muri Gurupoma ya Mubuku, mu gihe abandi bahungiye mu mashyamba.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to non-governmental organisations (civil society) of the area, this fighting made many residents flee. Some headed to Ramba in Mubuku groupement, while others fled into the forests.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Indi mirwano muri icyo gice yabaye kuwa Gatatu, itariki 2 Nzeri, ubwo ihuriro ry’izo ngabo zirwanira ubutegetsi zateraga Umudugudu wa Lomera, muri Teritwari ya Kabare. claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umutwe wa AFC/M23 wafashe agace ka Tushunguti gaherereye muri Groupement ya Ziralo, muri Teritwari ya Kalehe mu Ntara ya Kivu y’Amajyepfo, nyuma y’imirwano ikomeye n’ingabo za Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo (FARDC) n’imitwe yitwaje intwaro iyishyigikiye.
claim_sources.translation_en: The AFC/M23 group took the area of Tushunguti, located in Ziralo groupement, in Kalehe territory in South Kivu province, after heavy fighting with the army of the Democratic Republic of Congo (FARDC) and the armed groups that support it.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Amakuru ava muri ako gace avuga ko abarwanyi ba AFC/M23 bashoboye kwirukana abarwanyi ba Wazalendo n’abandi bari ku ruhande rwa Leta ya Kinshasa, maze bigarurira Tushunguti.
claim_sources.translation_en: Information from the area says that AFC/M23 fighters were able to drive out the Wazalendo fighters and others on the side of the Kinshasa government, and so took over Tushunguti.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ingabo za Repubulika ya Demokarasi ya Congo (FARDC), zifashijwe n'abarwanyi ba Wazalendo, zongeye kwigarurira centre ya Numbi kuri uyu wa Kabiri, itariki ya 6 Ukwakira 2026, muri Teritwari ya Kalehe muri Kivu y'Amajyepfo, nyuma y'amezi menshi hagenzurwa n'inyeshyamba za M23, nk'uko amakuru aturuka mu gace abivuga.
claim_sources.translation_en: The armed forces of the Democratic Republic of Congo (FARDC), helped by Wazalendo fighters, recaptured the centre of Numbi on Tuesday 6 October 2026 in Kalehe territory in South Kivu, after months of control by M23 rebels, according to information from the area.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Nk'uko amakuru amwe abivuga, abarwanyi ba M23 bari basubiye inyma basubira muri Numbi kuwa Mbere nyuma yo gutakaza ibirindiro cyane cyane i Shanje, Gasenda, n'udusozi twa Bukumba.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kuri uyu wa Gatatu, itariki ya 7 Ukwakira 2026, guhera saa yine n'igice za mu gitondo, ihuriro ry’ingabo zirwanira ubutegetsi bwa Kinshasa, cyane cyane abagize umutwe wa FDLR, zakoze ibikorwa byo gusenya mu gace ka Shanje no mu nkengero zaho muri Teritwari ya Kalehe.
claim_sources.translation_en: On this Wednesday, 7 October 2026, from 'saa yine n'igice za mu gitondo' (10:30 a.m. on the Kinyarwanda clock; the page was published at 06:34 that day, so the hour may be a literal rendering of 4:30), the alliance of forces fighting for the Kinshasa government, especially members of the FDLR group, carried out acts of destruction in the Shanje area and its surroundings in Kalehe territory.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ihuriro AFC/M23 mu itangazo ryashyize ahagaragara ryavuze ko amakuru y’inyongera ku bijyanye n’ibyangiritse ndetse n’ababa baguye muri ibi bikorwa bizatangazwa nyuma.
claim_sources.translation_en: The AFC/M23 alliance, in a communiqué it released, said that further information on the damage and on any who died in these acts will be published later.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ihuriro rya AFC/M23 rivuga ko ingabo zishyigikiye ubutegetsi bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, zirimo abarwanyi ba FDLR, zagabye ibitero mu bice bya Shanje no mu nkengero zaho, muri Teritwari ya Kalehe, Kivu y’Amajyepfo.
claim_sources.translation_en: The AFC/M23 alliance says that the forces supporting the government of the Democratic Republic of Congo, including FDLR fighters, launched attacks in the Shanje area and its surroundings, in Kalehe territory, South Kivu.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mu butumwa bwatanzwe ku wa 7 Ukwakira 2026, Umuvugizi wa AFC/M23, Lawrence Kanyuka, yavuze ko ibyo bitero byatangiye guhera saa Kumi n’igice, avuga ko byagize ingaruka ku baturage n’ibikorwa byabo. Kanyuka yavuze ko mu byangijwe harimo amazu y’abasivili ndetse n’isoko,
claim_sources.translation_en: In a message given on 7 October 2026, the AFC/M23 spokesperson, Lawrence Kanyuka, said those attacks began from 'saa Kumi n'igice' (half past the tenth hour on the Kinyarwanda clock: 04:30 or 16:30; no morning or evening qualifier is printed), saying they had affected residents and their activities. Kanyuka said that what was destroyed included civilians' houses and the market,

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Yatangaje ko amakuru arambuye ku buso bw’ibyangijwe ndetse n’umubare w’abantu bashobora kuba barapfuye cyangwa bagakomereka azatangazwa nyuma.
claim_sources.translation_en: He announced that detailed information on the extent of the damage and on the number of people who may have died or been wounded will be published later.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: ambaye aliileza DW jinsi askari watatu walivovamia nyumba yake na mmoja wao kujaribu kumbaka.
claim_sources.translation_en: who told DW how three soldiers broke into her home and one of them tried to rape her.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Tukio hilo lilitokea Februari katika kijiji cha Kavumu, kilomita 30 kutoka Bukavu.
claim_sources.translation_en: The incident took place in February in Kavumu village, 30 kilometres from Bukavu.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Miongoni mwa waathirika ni Riziki (jina limebadilishwa kwa usalama wake), ambaye aliileza DW jinsi askari watatu walivovamia nyumba yake na mmoja wao kujaribu kumbaka.
claim_sources.translation_en: Among the victims is Riziki (name changed for her safety), who told DW how three soldiers broke into her house and one of them tried to rape her.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Katika vijiji vya kaskazini mwa jimbo la Kivu Kusini, wanawake na watoto walikumbwa na vitendo vya ubakaji na ukatili wa kingono kutoka kwa wanaume waliokuwa na silaha.
claim_sources.translation_en: In villages in the north of South Kivu province, women and children suffered rape and sexual violence from armed men.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Makundi ya kijamii na wanaharakati wanalilaumu jeshi la Kongo pamoja na wapiganaji wa kundi la Wazalendo (kutoka Kivu Kaskazini) kushiriki katika matukio haya.
claim_sources.translation_en: Community groups and activists blame the Congolese army along with fighters of the Wazalendo group (from North Kivu) for taking part in these incidents.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: kuligeuza vijiji kadhaa kando ya Ziwa Kivu kuwa maeneo ya vita kati ya Januari na Februari
claim_sources.translation_en: turned several villages along Lake Kivu into war zones between January and February

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Katika maeneo yaliyotekwa na M23, kama Bukavu na Goma, mashuhuda wameripoti ongezeko la ubakaji – hasa dhidi ya wake za watu na wasichana – ambapo baadhi ya wanawake hulazimishwa kufanya ngono ili kupata huduma fulani. Waathirika wengi hawaripoti kutokana na hofu au aibu.
claim_sources.translation_en: In areas captured by M23, such as Bukavu and Goma, witnesses have reported an increase in rape, especially of men's wives and girls, with some women forced to have sex in order to obtain certain services. Many survivors do not report because of fear or shame.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kaskazini mwa Kivu Kusini, MSF imewahudumia karibu wahanga 700 tangu mwanzo wa mwaka.
claim_sources.translation_en: In the north of South Kivu, MSF has attended to nearly 700 victims since the start of the year.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kabla ya AFC/M23 kuuteka mji wa Bukavu mnamo Februari, askari wa jeshi la Kongo walikuwa tayari wamehukumiwa kwa ukatili wa kijinsia dhidi ya wanawake katika vijiji kadhaa vya wilaya za Kabare na Kalehe. AFC-M23 walipofika Bukavu, washtakiwa walikimbia, pamoja na majaji na mawakili.
claim_sources.translation_en: Before AFC/M23 captured the city of Bukavu in February, soldiers of the Congolese army had already been convicted of sexual violence against women in several villages of the Kabare and Kalehe districts. When AFC-M23 arrived in Bukavu, the accused fled, along with judges and lawyers.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Lakini pia baadae visa vya ubakaji vilishuhudiwa licha yakuwa vilitupiliwa mbali na AFC/M23.
claim_sources.translation_en: But later cases of rape were also witnessed, although they were dismissed by AFC/M23.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Nono Mwavita ni Mtetezi wa haki za wanawake, anasema usalama wa mwanamke bado haujaimarika na anatoa wito kwa pande zote kwenye migogoro kulinda wanawake na watoto.
claim_sources.translation_en: Nono Mwavita is a women's rights defender; she says women's security is still not improved and calls on all parties to the conflicts to protect women and children.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Nk'uko bigaragara mu itangazo ryashyizwe ahagaraga n'Umuvugizi wa FRN, Lawrence Kanyuka, "mu ijoro ryo ku wa 25 rishyira ku wa 26 Ukwakira 2026, ingabo zifatanyije zishyigikiye ubutegetsi bwa Kinshasa zongereye ibitero zigaba Kuwihene, Rugezi, Point Zéro n’inkengero zaho mu karere ka Minembwe.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to the communiqué published by the FRN spokesperson, Lawrence Kanyuka, 'in the night of 25 to 26 October 2026, the joint forces supporting the Kinshasa government increased attacks on Kuwihene, Rugezi, Point Zéro and surroundings in the Minembwe area.'

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Iri tangazo rivuga ko ibi bitero byakozwe hifashishijwe indege zitagira abapilote zikoreshwa nk’ibisasu (kamikaze drones) hamwe n’intwaro ziremereye, zirimo za mortier 120mm na 82mm.
claim_sources.translation_en: The communiqué says these attacks were carried out using drones used as bombs (kamikaze drones) together with heavy weapons, including 120mm and 82mm mortars.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mu gitondo cyo ku wa Mbere, itariki ya 26 Ukwakira 2026, ahagana saa kumi za mu gitondo (4:00 a.m.), izo ngabo n'ubundi zagabye ibitero ahitwa Mitimbili na Munanira, mu Murenge wa Kaziba muri Teritwari ya Walungu, muri Kivu y’Amajyepfo," ibi ni ibikomeza gutangazwa muri iryo tangazo.
claim_sources.translation_en: 'On the morning of Monday, 26 October 2026, at about four in the morning (4:00 a.m.), those forces also launched attacks at Mitimbili and Munanira, in Kaziba chiefdom in Walungu territory, in South Kivu,' is what the communiqué goes on to state.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kuri uyu wa Mbere, itariki ya 12 Ukwakira 2026, haravugwa imirwano mishya, iri kubera muri Sheferi ya Kaziba, mu Ntara ya Kivu y’Amajyepfo, hagati y’abarwanyi ba AFC/M23 na FARDC ishyigikiwe na Wazalendo.
claim_sources.translation_en: On this Monday, 12 October 2026, new fighting is reported, taking place in Kaziba chiefdom, in South Kivu province, between AFC/M23 fighters and FARDC supported by Wazalendo.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Nk’uko amakuru aturuka muri ako gace agera kuri Bwiza abitangaza, imirwano yongeye gutangira saa kumi n'ebyiri za mu gitondo ku dusozi twa Mitimbili, muri Gurupoma ya Muhumba, mu burasirazuba bwa Kaziba, hafi y'umupaka na Sheferi ya Bafulero.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to information from that area reaching Bwiza, fighting restarted at 'saa kumi n'ebyiri za mu gitondo' (the twelfth hour on the Kinyarwanda clock, 06:00 in the morning) on the Mitimbili hills, in Muhumba groupement, in the east of Kaziba, near the border with Bafulero chiefdom.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Urundi rugamba rwa kabiri ruri kubera ahitwa muri Mwera, muri Gurupoma ya Butuzi groupement, nkuko bigaragara mu yandi makuru agaragara ku rubuga nkoranyambaga rwa X.
claim_sources.translation_en: A second battle is taking place at Mwera, in Butuzi groupement, as shown in other information appearing on the social network X.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ihuriro ry’imitwe yitwaje intwaro rya Wazalendo rishyigikiwe n’ubutegetsi bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo ryirukanye abanyeshuri n’abarimu mu mashuri yo muri teritwari ya Kabare na Walungu mu ntara ya Kivu y’Amajyepfo.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Wazalendo alliance of armed groups, backed by the government of the Democratic Republic of Congo, expelled students and teachers from schools in Kabare and Walungu territories in South Kivu province.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ibikorwa byo gusohora abanyeshuri n’abarimu mu mashuri byatangiye tariki ya 9 Nzeri 2025.
claim_sources.translation_en: The actions of expelling students and teachers from schools began on 9 September 2025.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Amashusho yakwirakwiye ku mbuga nkoranyambaga agaragaza bose bahunga, abarwanyi bo muri Wazalendo bababwira ko kwiga cyangwa kwigisha kwabo ntacyo bibabwiye.
claim_sources.translation_en: Videos that circulated on social media show all of them fleeing, with Wazalendo fighters telling them that their studying or teaching means nothing to them.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umwe muri Wazalendo yumvikanye avuga mu rurimi rw’Igiswahili, ati “Abanyeshuri dusanga bari kwiga turabica. Ndabivuze, nta mishyikirano irabaho.
claim_sources.translation_en: One of the Wazalendo was heard speaking in the Swahili language, saying: 'We kill students we find studying. I say it, there is no negotiation.'

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Undi murwanyi yagize ati “Abanyeshuri bose, umuntu wese ajye iwabo kandi urajya ku ishuri arapfa.
claim_sources.translation_en: Another fighter said: 'All students, everyone should go home, and whoever goes to school will die.'

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ihuriro AFC/M23 rirwanya ubutegetsi bwa RDC ryamaganye uguceceka k’umuryango mpuzamahanga, imiryango y’ubutabazi n’abaharanira uburenganzira bw’ikiremwamuntu mu gihe Wazalendo ikomeje ibikorwa byambura abaturage uburenganzira bwabo.
claim_sources.translation_en: The AFC/M23 alliance, which opposes the DRC government, condemned the silence of the international community, humanitarian organisations and human rights defenders while Wazalendo continues actions that deprive the population of their rights.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi w’iri huriro, Lawrence Kanyuka, yashingiye ku magambo yavuzwe na Wazalendo, agira ati “Aya magambo ashora abantu mu bwicanyi n’ibyaha by’intambara agamije gusenya ahazaza h’abana bacu.”
claim_sources.translation_en: The alliance's spokesperson, Lawrence Kanyuka, citing words spoken by Wazalendo, said: 'These words push people into killings and war crimes, aiming to destroy the future of our children.'

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mapigano mengine makali kati ya M23 na Wazalendo yalitokea jana Jumapili huko Burhale katika wilaya ya Walungu ambapo magari na nyumba zinazoshukiwa kuwahifadhi M23 zilichomwa moto na Wazalendo katika eneo linaloitwa Mashango.
claim_sources.translation_en: Other heavy fighting between M23 and Wazalendo took place yesterday, Sunday, at Burhale in Walungu district, where vehicles and houses suspected of sheltering M23 were burned by Wazalendo in the area called Mashango.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mashuhuda wanasema mapambano makali yamefanyika tangu mapema asubuhi katika kijiji cha Kasheke baada ya mapambano mengine makali kutokea hapo na katika vijiji vya Lemera, Bushaku na kwenye baadhi ya vijiji vya wilaya za Kabare na Kalehe.
claim_sources.translation_en: Witnesses say heavy fighting has taken place since early morning in the village of Kasheke after other heavy fighting occurred there and in the villages of Lemera and Bushaku and in some villages of the Kabare and Kalehe districts.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Vyanzo vya mashirika ya kiraia vilikadiria kuwa karibu vijiji 12 vimekuwa chini ya udhibiti wa Wazalendo, habari ambayo haijathibitishwa na M23.
claim_sources.translation_en: Civil society sources estimated that nearly 12 villages had come under the control of Wazalendo, information that has not been confirmed by M23.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Amakuru ava muri Repubulika ya Demokarasi ya Congo (DR Congo) avuga ko inyeshamba z'umuhari M23 uvugwa ko ufashwe mu mugongo n'Urwanda zigaruriye igisagara gikomeye ca Nzibira kiri mu ntara ya Kivu y'Epfo.
claim_sources.translation_en: News from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DR Congo) says that the rebels of the M23 group, said to be backed by Rwanda, took the important town of Nzibira in South Kivu province.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ababibonye bavuga ko inyeshamba zabanje gucucagira ibisasu ibirindiro vy'ingabo za reta zikoresheje vya bimodoka vy'intambara bitamenwa n'amasasu asanzwe, imbere y'uko zifata iki gisagara ku mugoroba w'ejo ku wa Mungu.
claim_sources.translation_en: Eyewitnesses say the rebels first bombarded the positions of the government forces, using those armoured war vehicles that ordinary bullets do not pierce, before taking this town on the evening of yesterday, Sunday.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Radio Okapi ifashwe mu mugongo n'ishirahamwe mpuzamakungu ONU, ikorera muri Congo, isubiramwo ababibonye bavuga ko intambara zabaye urutavanako mu bigwati bitari bike vyo mu micungararo y'ico gisagara harimwo Cisaza, Cibanda, Muyange, Karhuliza na Kalongo.
claim_sources.translation_en: Radio Okapi, supported by the international organisation UN, repeating witnesses, says the fighting took place in a number of villages around the town, including Cisaza, Cibanda, Muyange, Karhuliza and Kalongo.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Imirwano ku mpande zombi yarushijeho gukomera ku Cyumweru tariki 21 Nzeri 2025, ariko birangira M23 itsinsuye ingabo za Leta n’abarwanyi ba Wazalendo.
claim_sources.translation_en: The fighting on both sides grew more intense on Sunday, 21 September 2025, but ended with M23 defeating the government forces and Wazalendo fighters.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Imirwano ikomeye yabereye mu duce twa Cisaza, Cibanda, Muyange, Karhuliza na Kalongo nk’uko Radio Okapi yabitangaje.
claim_sources.translation_en: The heavy fighting took place in the areas of Cisaza, Cibanda, Muyange, Karhuliza and Kalongo, as Radio Okapi reported.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Abarwanyi b’ihuriro AFC/M23 bafashe Umujyi wa Nzibira uherereye muri Teritwari ya Walungu
claim_sources.translation_en: Fighters of the AFC/M23 coalition took the town of Nzibira, located in Walungu Territory

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umutwe wa AFC/M23 urashinja igisirikare cya leta ya DR Congo kugaba ibitero "by'ubukana burenze" gikoresheje za 'drones' "mu duce dutuwe n'abaturage" i Lumbishi muri teritwari ya Karehe mu ntara ya Kivu y'Epfo kuri uyu wa mbere.
claim_sources.translation_en: The AFC/M23 group accuses the army of the DR Congo government of carrying out 'excessively severe' attacks using drones 'in areas inhabited by civilians' at Lumbishi in Kalehe territory in South Kivu province on this Monday.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mu itangazo, Lawrence Kanyuka yavuze ko ibitero byo kuri uyu wa mbere byifashishije indege za 'drones' za CH-4 "byangije ibintu byinshi kandi bigateza guhunga kw'abaturage benshi b'abasivile".
claim_sources.translation_en: In a communiqué, Lawrence Kanyuka said that the attacks of this Monday, which used CH-4 drones, 'destroyed many things and caused the flight of many civilians'.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Jacques Kongolo, umujyanama wa Perezida Félix Tshisekedi yabwiye BBC Gahuzamiryango kuri uyu wa mbere ko uruhande rwa leta atari rwo ruhonyora amasezerano y'agahenge. Komeza usome Kongolo yagize ati: "[Nibo] Bakoresha amadrones y'u Rwanda mu kuturasa bagahita babeshya ngo ni twe twarashe".
claim_sources.translation_en: Jacques Kongolo, adviser to President Félix Tshisekedi, told BBC Gahuzamiryango on Monday that the government side is not the one violating the ceasefire agreements. Kongolo said: '[They] use Rwanda's drones to shoot at us and then lie that it is we who fired.'

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ibice bya Lumbishi, Shanje, Kavumu na Numbi muri Teritwari ya Kalehe, mu Ntara ya Kivu y'Amajyepfo byongeye kwigarurirwa n'abarwanyi ba AFC/M23 nyuma y’amasaha make Wazalendo zihigaruriye.
claim_sources.translation_en: The areas of Lumbishi, Shanje, Kavumu and Numbi in Kalehe territory, in South Kivu province, were again taken over by AFC/M23 fighters a few hours after Wazalendo had taken them.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kuwa Kabiri, itariki 6 Ukwakira 2026, nibwo ihuriro ry'ingabo zirwanira ubutegetsi bwa Kinshasa, cyane cyane inyeshyamba za Wazalendo na FDLR, ryari ryafashe Umujyi wa Shanje, agace ka Gasenda n'udusozi twa Bukumba, muri Teritwari ya Kalehe.
claim_sources.translation_en: On Tuesday, 6 October 2026, the alliance of forces fighting for the Kinshasa government, mainly the Wazalendo militias and FDLR, had taken the town of Shanje, the area of Gasenda and the Bukumba hills, in Kalehe territory.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Amakuru mashya aravuga ko amazu agera kuri 60, harimo na za kiosque, yatwitse muri centre ya Shanje, ndetse haba no gusahura no kwiba inka, harimo n'amashyo abiri y'inka, bivugwa ko ari aya Gen. Gabriel Amisi Kumba, uzwi ku izina rya Tango Four.
claim_sources.translation_en: New information says that about 60 houses, including kiosks, were burned in the centre of Shanje, and there was also looting and theft of cattle, including two herds said to belong to Gen. Gabriel Amisi Kumba, known as Tango Four.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi w'uyu mutwe, Lawrence Kanyuka, yifashishije urubuga nkoranyambaga rwa X yatangaje ko biriya bitero byibasiye ahantu hatuwe cyane byagabwe n'Ingabo za Leta ya RDC, FARDC, umutwe wa FDLR, imitwe yitwaje intwaro ya Wazalendo, abacanshuro b'abanyamahanga ndetse n'Ingabo z'u Burundi, FDNB.
claim_sources.translation_en: The spokesperson of this group, Lawrence Kanyuka, using the social network X, announced that those attacks, which struck heavily inhabited places, were carried out by the Army of the DRC government, FARDC, the FDLR group, the Wazalendo armed groups, foreign mercenaries and the Burundian Army, FDNB.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kuri uyu wa Kabiri tariki ya 11 Kanama 2026, guhera saa 05:00 za mu gitondo, ihuriro ry'ingabo z'ubutegetsi bwa Kinshasa, zirimo FARDC, FDLR, imitwe ya Wazalendo, abacanshuro b'abanyamahanga ndetse n'Ingabo z'u Burundi (FDNB), ryagabye ibitero rusange zikoresheje imbunda ziremereye mu bice byinshi bituwe cyane bya Teritwari ya Kalehe, birimo Chambombo, Cyangugu, Kaziba ya Rumbishi, Kwisimbi na Gafufura.
claim_sources.translation_en: On this Tuesday, 11 August 2026, from 05:00 in the morning, the alliance of the Kinshasa government's forces, including FARDC, FDLR, the Wazalendo groups, foreign mercenaries and the Army of Burundi (FDNB), launched general attacks using heavy guns in many densely populated parts of Kalehe territory, including Chambombo, Cyangugu, Kaziba ya Rumbishi, Kwisimbi and Gafufura.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: AFC/M23 yavuze ko ibyo bitero byagize ingaruka ku baturage, aho bamwe bishwe abandi bagakomereka, mu gihe imitungo yangiritse ndetse n'imiryango imwe ikava mu byayo ihunga.
claim_sources.translation_en: AFC/M23 said that those attacks affected the population, with some killed and others wounded, while property was damaged and some families left their homes fleeing.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ihuriro AFC/M23 rirwanya ubutegetsi bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo ryatangaje ko ku wa 17 Kanama 2026, ingabo za FARDC, umurwe wa FDLR n’indi mitwe yitwaje intwaro ikorana na Guverinoma ya Kinshasa yagabye ibitero icyarimwe mu bice bitandukanye, birimo ibyo muri Teritwari ya Kalehe no ku murongo wa Minembwe.
claim_sources.translation_en: The AFC/M23 alliance, which opposes the government of the Democratic Republic of Congo, announced that on 17 August 2026 the FARDC army, the FDLR group and other armed groups working with the Kinshasa government launched simultaneous attacks in different areas, including in Kalehe territory and on the Minembwe line.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi wa AFC/M23, Lawrence Kanyuka yavuze ko uyu mutwe wavuze ko muri ibyo bitero harimo Ingabo za Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, FARDC, FDLR, imitwe ya Wazalendo, abacanshuro b’abanyamahanga ndetse n’Ingabo z’u Burundi, FDNB.
claim_sources.translation_en: AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka said that the group had said those attacks included the Army of the Democratic Republic of Congo, FARDC, FDLR, the Wazalendo groups, foreign mercenaries and the Army of Burundi, FDNB.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: AFC-M23 yatangaje ko guhera saa Moya n’iminota 50, ibitero byagabwe icyarimwe mu bice ituwe cyane bya Katare, Tushunguti, Nyamugari na Kivoka, byose biri muri Teritwari ya Kalehe.
claim_sources.translation_en: AFC-M23 announced that from 'saa Moya n'iminota 50' (07:50 on the Kinyarwanda clock), attacks were launched simultaneously on the densely populated areas of Katare, Tushunguti, Nyamugari and Kivoka, all in Kalehe territory.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: AFC-M23 yavuze ko muri ibyo bitero hakoreshejwe ibisasu bya mortier bya milimetero 120 ndetse n’indege zitagira abapilote zo mu bwoko bwa KT-6.
claim_sources.translation_en: AFC-M23 said that those attacks used 120-millimetre mortar shells and unmanned aircraft of the KT-6 type.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: AFC-M23 ivuga ko ibyo bitero byahitanye ubuzima bw’abasivili, bisenya inzu, amashuri n’ibindi bikorwaremezo by’abasivili, ndetse bigatuma imiryango yose iva mu byabo.
claim_sources.translation_en: AFC-M23 says those attacks killed civilians and destroyed houses, schools and other civilian infrastructure, and caused whole families to leave their homes.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Iyi nkongi y’umuriro ukomeye yadutse mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Kane, tariki ya 10 Nzeri 2026, kuri Avenue Kasheke 3 mu gace ka Buholo – Kasha, muri Komini ya Bagira.
claim_sources.translation_en: This large fire broke out on the morning of this Thursday, 10 September 2026, on Avenue Kasheke 3 in the Buholo – Kasha area, in Bagira commune.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Inyubako zibasiwe n’umuriro harimo amashuri abiri, ishuri ribanza rya Mogo n’iryitwa Furaha.
claim_sources.translation_en: The buildings struck by the fire include two schools, the Mogo primary school and the one called Furaha.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kugeza ku isaha ya saa cyenda z’amanywa (15:00) zo ku wa Kane, tariki ya 10 Nzeri 2026, imirambo nibura 27 yari imaze kubarurwa mbere yo kujyanwa mu buruhukiro bw’imirambo (morgue) hakoreshejwe imodoka z’imbangukiragutabara.
claim_sources.translation_en: Up to 'saa cyenda' in the daytime (15:00) on Thursday, 10 September 2026, at least 27 bodies had been counted before being taken to the morgue using ambulances.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuriro wadutse ahagana saa mbiri za mu gitondo (8:00 a.m.), kandi mu gihe kitageze ku isaha imwe, ubukana bw’ibyangiritse bwari bumaze kugaragara, nk’uko byatangajwe na Patrice Mugaruka Buduge, umuyobozi w’agace ka Buholo-Kasha.
claim_sources.translation_en: The fire broke out at about 'saa mbiri' in the morning (8:00 a.m.), and in under an hour the severity of the damage was already visible, as stated by Patrice Mugaruka Buduge, head of the Buholo-Kasha area.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Imibare y’abapfuye iracyari iy’agateganyo.
claim_sources.translation_en: The death toll is still provisional.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ihuriro AFC-M23 ryatangaje ko abana n'abanyeshuri 24, barimo abakobwa 19 n’abahungu batanu, ari bo bapfiriye mu nkongi y’umuriro yibasiye amazu yo mu gace ka Tshimpunda ho muri Komini ya Kadutu, mu Mujyi wa Bukavu.
claim_sources.translation_en: The AFC-M23 alliance announced that 24 children and students, including 19 girls and five boys, died in the fire that struck houses in the Tshimpunda area in Kadutu commune, in the city of Bukavu.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi w'iri huriro, Lawrence Kanyuka, mu itangazo yasohoye kuri uyu wa Kane tariki ya 10 Nzeri 2026 yavuze ko iyo nkongi yabaye mu masaha ya mbere ya nyuma ya saa sita.
claim_sources.translation_en: The spokesperson of this alliance, Lawrence Kanyuka, in a communiqué he issued this Thursday, 10 September 2026, said that the fire took place in the first hours after midday.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ibyangijwe n’inkongi birimo Ishuri Ribanza rya Mosala riri muri Komini ya Kadutu ndetse n'Ishuri Ribanza rya Nongo riri muri Komini ya Bagira.
claim_sources.translation_en: The damage from the fire includes the Mosala primary school in Kadutu commune and the Nongo primary school in Bagira commune.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: AFC-M23 yatangaje ko usibye abantu 24 bapfuye, abandi 29 barimo kuvurirwa mu bitaro bitandukanye byo mu Mujyi wa Bukavu nyuma yo gukomereka. Muri abo barwayi, 21 bari mu bitaro by'indembe, aho 17 bari mu Bitaro Bikuru bya Kadutu, mu gihe abandi bane bari ku Bitaro Bikuru by’Intara ya Bukavu.
claim_sources.translation_en: AFC-M23 announced that besides the 24 people who died, another 29 are being treated in various hospitals in the city of Bukavu after being injured. Of those patients, 21 are in critical condition, 17 of them at Kadutu General Hospital, while four others are at the Bukavu Provincial General Hospital.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kuva ku mugoroba wo ku wa 12 Werurwe 2025, iki kirwa gikora ku bihugu bibiri aribyo Repubulika ya Demokarasi ya Congo n’u Rwanda kiragenzurwa na M23.
claim_sources.translation_en: Since the evening of 12 March 2025, this island, which touches two countries, the Democratic Republic of Congo and Rwanda, has been controlled by M23.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umwe mu banyamakuru bakorera kuri icyo kirwa avuga ko abasirikare ba Leta bahunze mbere y’uko abarwanyi ba M23 bakandagiza ikirenge kuri icyo kirwa.
claim_sources.translation_en: One of the journalists working on the island says that the government soldiers fled before the M23 fighters set foot on the island.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kwa mujibu wa Umoja wa Mataifa, kuna angalau watu 42,000 wanaoishi katika kambi za muda, lakini hakuna rekodi rasmi kwa wale waliokolewa na familia za wenyeji. Wenyeji wanakadiria kuwa kunaweza kuwa na wakimbizi wengi kama 60,000 wanaoishi Idjwi.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to the United Nations, there are at least 42,000 people living in temporary camps, but there is no official record of those taken in by local families. Locals estimate there may be as many as 60,000 refugees living on Idjwi.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kuna hospitali kuu moja tu, na kuna magari machache tu, mara nyingi haiwezekani kwa wale walio katika maeneo ya mbali kupata matibabu. "Wakati mwingine tunalazimika kutembea kilomita 10 na mgonjwa kwenye machela," anasema Yves. "Wakati mwingine wanakufa njiani kwa sababu hatuwezi kufika kwa haraka vya kutosha.
claim_sources.translation_en: There is only one main hospital, and there are only a few vehicles, so it is often impossible for those in remote areas to get treatment. 'Sometimes we have to walk 10 km with a patient on a stretcher,' says Yves. 'Sometimes they die on the way because we cannot get there quickly enough.'

claim_sources.excerpt_original: anasema Yves Minani, mjasiriamali na mkurugenzi wa kituo cha redio cha ndani
claim_sources.translation_en: says Yves Minani, an entrepreneur and director of a local radio station

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umutwe wa M23 watangaje ko igisirikare cya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo (FARDC) cyakoresheje indege y’intambara yo mu bwoko bwa Sukhoï 25, ikarasa ibisasu mu bice bituwemo n’abaturage muri Teritwari ya Kalehe, bigahitana abantu 10 mu gihe abandi 25 bakomeretse.
claim_sources.translation_en: The M23 group announced that the army of the Democratic Republic of Congo (FARDC) used a Sukhoï 25 type warplane and fired bombs into inhabited areas in Kalehe territory, killing 10 people while another 25 were wounded.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mu itangazo ryashyizwe ahagaragara n’umuvugizi wa M23 ushinzwe ibya politiki, Lawrence Kanyuka, yemeje ko icyo gitero cyabaye kuri Kane, tariki 13 Gashyantare 2025
claim_sources.translation_en: In the communiqué issued by the M23 spokesperson for political matters, Lawrence Kanyuka, he confirmed that the attack took place on Thursday, 13 February 2025

claim_sources.excerpt_original: M23 ivuga ko iki gitero cyasenye Ibitaro Bikuru bya Kalehe, byari bisanzwe byakira abarwayi benshi muri aka gace, ndetse n’amazu menshi y’abaturage.
claim_sources.translation_en: M23 says that this attack destroyed the Kalehe General Hospital, which usually received many patients in this area, as well as many residents' houses.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: M23 ivuga ko yafashe aka gace kugira ngo ihagarike ihohoterwa rivugwa mu Mujyi wa Bukavu, aho ishinja FARDC n’abayifasha barimo FDLR, abasirikare b’u Burundi na Wazalendo, kuba barishe abaturage, bagasahura imitungo yabo, ndetse bagakora ihohoterwa rikabije ku bagore.
claim_sources.translation_en: M23 says it took this area in order to stop the violence reported in Bukavu city, where it accuses FARDC and those who help it, including FDLR, Burundian soldiers and Wazalendo, of having killed residents, looted their property and committed serious violence against women.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umwe mu bakuriye sosiyete civile ya Kalehe utifuje gutangazwa, yabwiye BBC ko kuva ku mugoroba wo ku wa gatatu Kalehe centre - umujyi mukuru wa teritwari ya Karehe - irimo abarwanyi ba M23.
claim_sources.translation_en: A leader of Kalehe civil society who did not want to be named told BBC that since the evening of Wednesday, Kalehe centre, the main town of Kalehe territory, has had M23 fighters in it.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ku wa gatatu, igisirikare cya leta muri iyi ntara cyatangaje ko M23 mu gikorwa cyo kurenga ku gahenge kasabwe n'inama y'i Dar es Salaam, M23 yateye ibirindiro by'ingabo muri Kalehe Centre na Ihusi ko "ibyo bitero byateye kubura ubuzima bw'abasivile benshi".
claim_sources.translation_en: On Wednesday, the government army in this province announced that M23, in an action violating the ceasefire requested by the Dar es Salaam meeting, M23 attacked army positions at Kalehe Centre and Ihusi that 'these attacks caused the loss of many civilian lives'.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Uruhande rwa M23 ntacyo ruratangaza ku byavuzwe n'ingabo za leta zivuga ko ari ingabo z'u Rwanda zifatanya na M23 – ibyo izi mpande zombi zo zihakana.
claim_sources.translation_en: The M23 side has not yet announced anything on what the government army said, that Rwandan troops are fighting alongside M23, which both sides deny.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Abarwanyi ba AFC/M23 banyomoje amakuru akomeje gusakazwa ku mbuga nkoranyambaga n’Abarundi, avuga ko bambuwe ikibuga cy’indege cya Kavumu giherereye mu Ntara ya Kivu y’Amajyepfo mu Burasirazuba bwa RDC.
claim_sources.translation_en: AFC/M23 fighters denied information continuing to circulate on social media, by Burundians, saying they had been dispossessed of Kavumu airport located in South Kivu province in eastern DRC.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ni mu gihe kandi AFC/M23-Twirwaneho ivuga ko amakuru ari gukwirakwizwa ko yambuwe Kavumu ari ibinyoma, isaba abantu kwitondera ibihuha. Yagize ati: “Wazalendo na FARDC nta mbaraga bafite.”
claim_sources.translation_en: At the same time AFC/M23-Twirwaneho says that the information being spread that it was dispossessed of Kavumu is lies, and asks people to be wary of rumours. It said: 'Wazalendo and FARDC have no strength.'

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umutekano wakomeje kwangirika mu gitondo cyo kuri iki Cyumweru, itariki ya 22 Gashyantare, i Kavumu, muri Teritwari ya Kabare, muri Kivu y'Amajyepfo nyuma y'imirwano yahiriwe kuri uyu wa Gatandatu ushize.
claim_sources.translation_en: Security kept deteriorating on the morning of this Sunday, 22 February, in Kavumu, in Kabare territory, in South Kivu, after the fighting that took place this past Saturday.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuturage wo muri ako gace yagize ati: "Imirwano yatangiye nyuma y'uko umurwanyi wa Wazalendo ajyanwe mu kigo nderabuzima. Nyuma y'amasaha make, imirwano yatangiye. Kuva Katana kugera Kavumu, twumvaga urusaku rw'amasasu".
claim_sources.translation_en: A resident of the area said: 'The fighting began after a Wazalendo fighter was taken to a health centre. After a few hours, the fighting began. From Katana to Kavumu, we heard the noise of gunfire.'

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kuri uyu wa Gatatu, itariki ya 30 Nyakanga, imirwano ikaze yabereye mu Mudugudu wa Kamakombe, muri Teritwari ya Kabare (Kivu y'Amajyefo), hagati y'inyeshyamba za M23 n'umutwe wa Wazalendo ukorera muri ako karere.
claim_sources.translation_en: On this Wednesday, 30 July, heavy fighting took place in the village of Kamakombe, in Kabare territory (South Kivu), between M23 rebels and the Wazalendo group operating in that area.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Iyi mirwano bivugwa ko yatangiriye ku wa Kabiri mu Mudugudu wa Mbayo, uherereye muri Gurupoma ya Bugorhe, nyuma y’uko ngo umutwe wa M23 wongerewe ingufu ku kibuga cy’indege cya Kavumu.
claim_sources.translation_en: This fighting is said to have started on Tuesday in the village of Mbayo, in Bugorhe groupement, after M23 was reportedly reinforced at Kavumu airport.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Abahagarariye sosiyete sivili baremeza ko nyuma y’umunsi w’ibitero bikaze ndetse n’ibitero byo gusubiza, inyeshyamba za AFC/M23 zazindutse zishaka kwirukana uwo mutwe i Kamakombe mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Gatatu.
claim_sources.translation_en: Civil society representatives confirm that after a day of heavy attacks and counter-attacks, AFC/M23 rebels set out early to drive that group out of Kamakombe on the morning of this Wednesday.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Abantu bitwaje intwaro, bikekwa ko barimo n’abasirikare ba leta na Wazalendo, bateye impagarara mu mpera z’icyumweru mu mujyi wa Bukavu n’inkengero zawo no mu duce twa Kavumu, Katana muri teritwari ya Kabare muri DR Congo, aho bashinjwa gusahura no kwica abasivile, nk’uko bivugwa n’abaturage.
claim_sources.translation_en: Armed people, suspected to include government soldiers and Wazalendo, caused disturbance over the weekend in the city of Bukavu and its outskirts and in the areas of Kavumu and Katana in Kabare territory in DR Congo, where they are accused of looting and killing civilians, as residents say.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Guverineri Jean-Jacques Purusi wa Kivu y’Epfo yatanze ubutumwa bwo guhumuriza rubanda. Yemeje ko i Kavumu hishwe abasivile bagera kuri barindwi, avuga ko ababikoze bagomba kubiryozwa.
claim_sources.translation_en: Governor Jean-Jacques Purusi of South Kivu gave a message to reassure the public. He confirmed that about seven civilians were killed at Kavumu, and said those who did it must be held to account.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Guverineri Jean-Jacques Purusi wa Kivu y’Epfo yatanze ubutumwa bwo guhumuriza rubanda.
claim_sources.translation_en: Governor Jean-Jacques Purusi of South Kivu gave a message to reassure the public.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Guverineri Purusi yumvikanye avuga ko abakoze ibyo "ntawakwemeza ko ari abasirikare ba leta" ati: "Birashoboka ko ari amabandi afatira ku buryo ibintu bimeze akagura intwaro agatangira gutera ubwoba rubanda.
claim_sources.translation_en: Governor Purusi was heard saying that those who did this 'no one could confirm are government soldiers', saying: 'It is possible that they are bandits who take advantage of how things are, buy weapons and start frightening the people.'

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ku byabaye i Kavumu no hafi yaho, Guverineri Purusi avuga ko byabaye ubwo habaga guhindura abari ku rugamba hakoherezwa amatsinda mashya, "kuko abakoze cyane bagomba gusimburwa". Ati: "Bava i Karehe kugera i Kavumu hari bamwe bakoze urwo rugomo,
claim_sources.translation_en: On what happened at Kavumu and nearby, Governor Purusi says it happened when those at the front were being replaced and new teams sent, 'because those who have worked hard must be replaced'. He said: 'From Kalehe to Kavumu there are some who committed that violence,'

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Abagize sosiyete sivile basohoye itangazo bavuga ko ibi bikorwa muri rusange byiciwemo abantu barenga icyenda, abantu bagasahurwa, abandi bagakomereka. Bashinja ingabo za leta na Wazalendo.
claim_sources.translation_en: Members of civil society issued a statement saying that in these acts as a whole more than nine people were killed, people were looted, and others were wounded. They blame government forces and Wazalendo.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Radio RFI isubiramo Maitre Pascal Mupenda umwe mu bategetsi b’i Kabare agira ati: "Kubera iki abasirikare bagakwiye kuturinda ari bo ubu bari kuduteza umutekano mucye? Birababaje kuba ubu tubarura abantu icyenda bapfuye.
claim_sources.translation_en: Radio RFI repeats Maitre Pascal Mupenda, one of the authorities of Kabare, saying: 'Why are the soldiers who should protect us the ones now causing us insecurity? It is sad that we are now counting nine people dead.'

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Turifuza ko abo basirikare bose bagenda.
claim_sources.translation_en: We want all those soldiers to leave.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ku wa gatandatu, abantu bitwaje intwaro barashe amasasu mu kirere mu mujyi wa Bukavu mbere yo kwinjira mu maduka n’amasoko mato mato bagasahura, nk’uko abatuye i Bukavu babigaragaje ku mbuga nkoranyambaga.
claim_sources.translation_en: On Saturday, armed people fired shots into the air in the city of Bukavu before entering shops and small markets and looting, as Bukavu residents showed on social media.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ku cyumweru, Patrick Muyaya uvugira leta ya Kinshasa abajijwe uko ibintu bimeze yabwiye ikinyamakuru Top Congo FM ko, mu minsi yashize M23 – yita ingabo z’u Rwanda – yasatiriye igafata Nyabibwe, ati: "Guhera Nyabibwe hari ibindi bitero bakoze byo gusatira bavuye i Nyabibwe ariko byose byaburijwemo."
claim_sources.translation_en: On Sunday, Patrick Muyaya, spokesman for the Kinshasa government, asked how things stood, told the media outlet Top Congo FM that in recent days M23, which he calls Rwandan troops, had advanced and taken Nyabibwe, saying: 'From Nyabibwe there were other attacks they made to advance from Nyabibwe, but all were thwarted.'

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ibyo rero byakurikiwe n’ibihuha byageze muri Kivu y’Epfo (i Bukavu) aho bamwe bavugaga ngo bari muri 10 cyangwa 15km ariko mu by’ukuri bari muri kilometero zirenga 100".
claim_sources.translation_en: 'That was then followed by rumours that reached South Kivu (Bukavu) where some were saying they were within 10 or 15 km, but in reality they were more than 100 kilometres away.'

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi wa AFC/M23, Lawrence Kanyuka, kuri uyu wa 28 Kanama 2025 yasobanuye ko ibi bitero bya drones za CH-4 n’intwaro ziremereye byagabwe mu gace ka Mikenke mu misozi ya Minembwe ituyemo Abanyamulenge no mu bice bigize teritwari ya Kalehe.
claim_sources.translation_en: The spokesperson of AFC/M23, Lawrence Kanyuka, on this 28 August 2025 explained that these attacks of CH-4 drones and heavy weapons were launched in the Mikenke area in the Minembwe hills where Banyamulenge live and in areas that are part of Kalehe territory.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ati “Kuva mu ijoro ryo ku wa Gatatu tariki ya 27 Kanama 2025, ihuriro ry’ingabo za Leta ya Kinshasa (FARDC, FDLR, Mai Mai Wazalendo, abacancuro, Imbonerakure n’ingabo z’u Burundi, riri kurasa nta kuvangura ibice bituwe cyane muri Minembwe (Mikenke) na Kalehe (Katana, Kavumu, Katasomwa, Nyabibwe) no mu bice bihana imbibi, rikoresheje drones za CH-4 zigaba ibitero n’intwaro ziremereye. Ibitero birakomeje.”
claim_sources.translation_en: He said: 'Since the night of Wednesday 27 August 2025, the alliance of the forces of the Kinshasa government (FARDC, FDLR, Mai Mai Wazalendo, mercenaries, Imbonerakure and the Burundian army, is firing indiscriminately on densely populated areas in Minembwe (Mikenke) and Kalehe (Katana, Kavumu, Katasomwa, Nyabibwe) and neighbouring areas, using CH-4 drones launching attacks and heavy weapons. The attacks continue.'

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Abarwanyi ba Wazalendo bagabye ibitero ku birindiro bya AFC/M23 muri Katana, Mumosho na Chirunga muri teritwari ya Kabare mu ntara ya Kivu y’Amajyepfo, mu gitondo cyo ku wa 18 Kamena.
claim_sources.translation_en: Wazalendo fighters launched attacks on AFC/M23 positions in Katana, Mumosho and Chirunga in Kabare territory in South Kivu province, on the morning of 18 June.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Abaturage basobanuye ko Wazalendo yageragezaga gukura AFC/M23 muri utu duce.
claim_sources.translation_en: Residents explained that Wazalendo were trying to remove AFC/M23 from these areas.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: On May 20, 2025, the National Commission for Monitoring the Implementation of the Addis Ababa Agreement in Ethiopia released a comprehensive report detailing serious crimes committed against civilians in Goma and Bukavu between January and April 2025, during the occupation by AFC-M23 rebels.
The report, unveiled at the National Museum in Kinshasa, was presented by Alphonse Ntumba Lwaba, the commission's coordinator,
Huko mjini Uvira jimboni Kivu Kusini, mashirika ya kiraia ya eneo hilo yanaripoti kuwa takribani raia 12 wameuawa na makundi yaliyojihami tangu tarehe 18 mwezi huu wa Januari.
claim_sources.translation_en: In the town of Uvira in South Kivu province, local civil society organisations report that about 12 civilians have been killed by armed groups since 18 January this month.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: “Na kutokana na hofu ya kuendelea kwa vurugu hizo, takriban watu 2,400 wamekimbia mji wa Uvira kuelekea Kamanyola, ambako wamehifadhiwa na wenyeji wao, na wengine wakiwa kwenye vituo vya pamoja wakitafuta usalama,” amesema Dujarric
claim_sources.translation_en: "Because of fear of continuing violence, about 2,400 people have fled the town of Uvira towards Kamanyola, where they are hosted by locals, and others in collective centres seeking safety," Dujarric said

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ituze ryagarutse ku wa mbere mu mujyi wa Uvira mu ntara ya Kivu y'Epfo nyuma y'imirwano yabaye ku cyumweru yiciwemo abantu 12, abasivile n'abasirikare, nk'uko bivugwa na Radio Okapi.
claim_sources.translation_en: Calm returned on Monday in the town of Uvira in South Kivu province after the fighting on Sunday in which 12 people, civilians and soldiers, were killed, according to Radio Okapi.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Serge Kigwati ukuriye sosiyete civile muri ako gace nawe yemeje ko imirwano muri Uvira yatewe no kuba Wazalendo barashatse kwambura intwaro abasirikare ba FARDC bahunze bava i Bukavu. Maze FARDC babyanga bikavamo kurasana.
claim_sources.translation_en: Serge Kigwati, who heads civil society in the area, also confirmed that the fighting in Uvira was caused by Wazalendo trying to disarm FARDC soldiers who fled from Bukavu. FARDC then refused, resulting in shooting at each other.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Wakati huo huo, matukio kadhaa ya uporaji yametokea katika maghala karibu na bandari ya Kalundu, katika ofisi kadhaa za serikali, na pia katika baadhi ya nyumba za watu, hasa zile za wanajamii wa Banyamulenge.
claim_sources.translation_en: Meanwhile, several incidents of looting have occurred in warehouses near Kalundu port, in several government offices, and also in some people's homes, especially those of members of the Banyamulenge community.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Wapiganaji wa kundi la Wazalendo na baadhi ya wanajeshi wa Kongo, FARDC wamerejea katika mji wa Uvira Jumapili
claim_sources.translation_en: Fighters of the Wazalendo group and some Congolese soldiers, FARDC, returned to the town of Uvira on Sunday

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Katika taarifa kwa vyombo vya habari, gavana wa Kivu Kusini chini ya utawala wa Kinshasa Jean-Jacques Purusi ameonya kuwepo kwa baadhi ya wapiganaji wa AFC/M23 wanaodaiwa kujificha katika mji wa Uvira ili kuleta fujo na kuwalaumu Wazalendo na jeshi la Kongo. Hata hivyo, Purusi amethibitisha kwamba AFC/M23 wamejiondoa hadi kwenye maeneo ya Sange licha yakuwa walitakiwa kujiondoa hadi Kamanyola.
claim_sources.translation_en: In a press release, the governor of South Kivu under Kinshasa's authority, Jean-Jacques Purusi, warned of the presence of some AFC/M23 fighters allegedly hiding in the town of Uvira to cause chaos and blame the Wazalendo and the Congolese army. However, Purusi confirmed that AFC/M23 withdrew to the Sange area although they were supposed to withdraw to Kamanyola.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kwenye akaunti yake ya mtandao wa kijamii X, Corneille Nangaa, mratibu wa AFC/M23, alisema kuwa AFC/M23 ilijiondoa Uvira kwa nia njema. Nangaa ameeleza kwamba anachukizwa na vitendo vya kujilipizia kisasi, uporaji wa mali ya umma, mauaji yaliyolengwa, na kulazimishwa kuhama kwa jamii ya Watutsi ya Banyamulenge.
claim_sources.translation_en: On his social media account on X, Corneille Nangaa, coordinator of AFC/M23, said that AFC/M23 withdrew from Uvira in good faith. Nangaa explained that he is appalled by acts of reprisal, looting of public property, targeted killings, and the forced displacement of the Tutsi Banyamulenge community.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Byafashe indi ntera ku wa Kane, tariki ya 1 Gicurasi, ubwo aba basanzwe ari abafatanyabikorwa mu kurwanya M23 bahisemo kurasana mu buryo bweruye. Iyo mirwano yatangiye ahagana saa kumi n’imwe z’igitondo, itangirira ahitwa i Kasenga, mbere yo gukwira mu bice bihakikije mu gihe gito.
claim_sources.translation_en: It escalated on Thursday, 1 May (Gicurasi), when these usual partners in fighting the M23 chose to shoot at each other openly. The fighting began at around saa kumi n'imwe in the morning (about 05:00 in Swahili/Kinyarwanda time reckoning), starting at a place called Kasenga, before spreading to surrounding areas in a short time.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Abatuye ahitwa Kakombe bavuga ko urusaku rw’amasasu rwakomeje kumvikana kuri uyu wa Gatanu, bakemeza ko ku bwabo nta yandi mahitamo bafite uretse guhunga.
claim_sources.translation_en: Residents of the place called Kakombe say gunfire continued to be heard on this Friday, and confirm that in their view they have no other choice but to flee.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Wazalendo ivuga ko hari abasirikare ba FARDC bateguye ubwato bugomba kubambutsa bubajyana i Kalemie, mu gihe abarwanyi ba M23 baba bateye umujyi wa Uvira.
claim_sources.translation_en: Wazalendo says that some FARDC soldiers have prepared a boat to ferry them across and take them to Kalemie, should M23 fighters attack the town of Uvira.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Abasirikare b’Abarundi boherejwe kurinda umujyi wa Uvira banze kwivanga muri iyi mirwano, basa n’abarambiwe iyi ntambara bashowemo ku nyungu za Perezida Ndayishimiye.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Burundian soldiers sent to protect the town of Uvira refused to get involved in this fighting, appearing weary of this war they were pushed into for President Ndayishimiye's interests.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Abatuye umujyi wa Uvira uherereye muri Kivu y’Amajyepfo, bavuga ko kuva AFC/M23 yawuvamo, insoresore z’abagizi ba nabi bashyigikiwe n’umutwe wa Wazalendo, bigabije inzu n’insengero by’Abanyamulenge n’abandi bavuga ururimi rw’Ikinyarwanda, barabasahura, barabasenyera ndetse hagira uwitambika akagirirwa nabi cyane.
claim_sources.translation_en: The residents of the town of Uvira, located in South Kivu, say that since AFC/M23 left it, groups of young criminals backed by the Wazalendo group have seized the houses and churches of Banyamulenge and other Kinyarwanda speakers, looting them and destroying them, and that anyone who stood in the way was badly harmed.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Impuzamashyirahamwe Iharanira Uburenganzira bwa Muntu (DPC), yasohoye urwandiko ku ya 18 Mutarama 2026, rugaragaza impungenge ifite ku mutekano w’abatuye muri Uvira, cyane cyane Abanyamulenge, kubera ko uwo mujyi utarimo ubuyobozi nyuma yaho AFC/M23 iwuviriyemo, bigatuma wibasirwa n’ubugizi bwa nabi.
