claim_sources.translation_en: The Impuzamashyirahamwe Iharanira Uburenganzira bwa Muntu (DPC) issued a letter on 18 January 2026, expressing concern over the safety of residents of Uvira, especially Banyamulenge, because the town has no administration since AFC/M23 left it, leaving it exposed to criminality.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kanali Fureko, mwanachama wa jamii ya Banyamulenge na afisa aliyejumuishwa hivi majuzi katika wanamgambo wa eneo la Wazalendo, wakiungwa mkono na mamlaka ya Kongo, alikamatwa Jumamosi hii, Novemba 8, huko Lemera, katika eneo la Uvira, alipokuwa akisafiri kwenda Mulenge, pia katika eneo la Uvira, jimbo la Kivu Kusini.
claim_sources.translation_en: Colonel Fureko, a member of the Banyamulenge community and an officer recently integrated into the local Wazalendo militia, backed by the Congolese authorities, was arrested this Saturday, November 8, at Lemera, in Uvira territory, while travelling to Mulenge, also in Uvira territory, South Kivu province.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Wenzake wa zamani wanamtuhumu kuwa na uhusiano na kundi la waasi la M23 na wapiganaji wa Twirwaneho, ambao pia wanaundwa na vijana wa Banyamulenge. Kwa mujibu wa vyanzo kadhaa vya habari, Fureko na vijana wanane wa Banyamulenge aliokuwa nao walipigwa, kujeruhiwa na kuvuliwa silaha na sare zao na kusababisha taharuki mkoani humo.
claim_sources.translation_en: His former colleagues accuse him of links with the M23 rebel group and Twirwaneho fighters, who are also made up of young Banyamulenge. According to several sources, Fureko and the eight young Banyamulenge he was with were beaten, wounded and stripped of their weapons and uniforms, causing tension in the province.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Wapiganaji wa kikosi cha Wazalendo wamelazimika kusimama kidete kutetea Mji wa Uvira dhidi ya wapiganaji wa M23, baada ya askari wa FARDC kudaiwa kutoroka mapigano, huku wengine wakidandia mitumbwi na kutorokea Kalemie nchini humo.
claim_sources.translation_en: Fighters of the Wazalendo unit have had to stand firm to defend the town of Uvira against M23 fighters, after FARDC soldiers were alleged to have fled the fighting, while others hopped into canoes and escaped to Kalemie in that country.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ku munsi wa gatatu, nta muntu yashobora gucaruka muri uwo muji kubera ubusuma bwakozwe n'abantu bafise ibirwanisho, aho bivye n'ibigega vy'amashirahamwe y'abagiraneza.
claim_sources.translation_en: On the third day, nobody could move around the town because of the looting carried out by people with weapons, where the stores of charitable organisations were also stolen.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ishirahamwe ry'abaganga batagira imbibe -MSF, ritanga infashanyo zo kwa muganga, ryateye akamo risaba ko abanyagihugu bokingirwa, kandi n'ubufasha bukabashikira. "Tudashobora kugenda mu muji, imigwi y'abaganga n'abajejwe ubundi bufasha irageramiwe. Ibitaro mu karere, bikomeza kwakira abakomeretse buri munsi, harimwo n'abanyagihugu basanzwe". Niko ivuga mw'itangazo ryashizwe ku rubuga rwabo rwa X.
claim_sources.translation_en: Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF), which provides medical aid, raised an alarm asking that civilians be protected and that aid reach them. "Unable to move around the town, medical teams and those in charge of other aid are in danger. Hospitals in the region keep receiving the wounded every day, including ordinary civilians". So it says in a statement posted on its X page.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ku wa Gatatu tariki ya 31 Ukuboza 2025, ni bwo RDC biciye muri Minisitiri wayo w'Itumanaho akanaba Umuvugizi wa Guverinoma yayo yashinje Ingabo z'u Rwanda ibyo birego.
claim_sources.translation_en: On Wednesday 31 December 2025, the DRC, through its Minister of Communication and also its Government Spokesperson, accused the Rwandan Forces of these allegations.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Minisitiri Patrick Muyaya mu itangazo yasohoye, kandi yashinje Ingabo z'u Rwanda kugaba ibitero mu bice bya Kamanyola-Uvira "zikoresheje amabombe na drone za Kamikaze", ngo byicirwamo abarenga 1,500 na ho ababarirwa mu 500,000 bava mu byabo.
claim_sources.translation_en: Minister Patrick Muyaya, in the statement he issued, also accused the Rwandan Forces of launching attacks in the Kamanyola-Uvira areas 'using bombs and Kamikaze drones', reportedly killing more than 1,500 and displacing about 500,000.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Uyu mugabo kandi yashinje Ingabo z'u Rwanda kohereza batayo eshatu z'abasirikare mu misozi miremire ya Uvira, Fizi na Mwenga, akavuga ko ziyoberanyije zikigira abarwanyi ba Twirwaneho.
claim_sources.translation_en: This man also accused the Rwandan Forces of sending three battalions of soldiers to the high mountains of Uvira, Fizi and Mwenga, saying they were disguised as Twirwaneho fighters.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: AFC/M23 biciye mu muvugizi wayo, Lawrence Kanyuka, yasubije ko ibivugwa na Leta ya Kinshasa ari icengezamatwara n'ibinyoma bigamije kuyobya rubanda.
claim_sources.translation_en: AFC/M23, through its spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka, replied that what the Kinshasa government says is propaganda and lies intended to mislead the public.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Iri huriro risobanura ko ubwicanyi bwibasiye abaturage bo muri Kivu y'Amajyepfo mu gihe cy'imirwano yo mu kwezi gushize, bukomoka ku bitero by’indege n’ibisasu byarashwe n’ingabo z’ubutegetsi bwa Kinshasa zirimo FARDC, FDLR, imitwe ya Mai-Mai Wazalendo, abacanshuro b’abanyamahanga, n’ingabo z’igihugu z’u Burundi.
claim_sources.translation_en: The coalition explains that the killings that affected residents of South Kivu during last month's fighting stem from air attacks and shells fired by Kinshasa's forces including FARDC, FDLR, Mai-Mai Wazalendo militias, foreign mercenaries and Burundi's national army.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ni ibitero byibasiye uduce dutuwe cyane twa Kamanyola, Luvungi, Sange, no mu nkengero zatwo, bihitana abantu 8 abandi 55 barakomereka muri Kamanyola gusa.
claim_sources.translation_en: These were attacks that hit the densely populated areas of Kamanyola, Luvungi, Sange and surroundings, killing 8 people and wounding another 55 in Kamanyola alone.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mu duce Ingabo za Leta ngo zashatse gusubiramo harimo umujyi wa Uvira n'uwa Makobola, aho izo ngabo zanakoreye "ibikorwa byo gusambanya abagore ku ngufu no gusahura ku buryo buteguwe."
claim_sources.translation_en: In the areas that the government forces reportedly tried to retake, including the town of Uvira and Makobola, where those forces also carried out 'acts of raping women and organised looting.'

claim_sources.excerpt_original: AFC/M23 kandi yashinje ingabo za Leta kuba zariraye mu baturage bari mu myigaragambyo y'amahoro yo ku wa 22 Ukuboza zikabarasaho zikoresheje imbunda nini n'izoroheje, ku buryo byashyize ubuzima bw’abaturage mu kaga gakomeye kandi bikaba ari ukurenga ku burenganzira bwabo bw’ibanze.
claim_sources.translation_en: AFC/M23 also accused the government forces of having opened fire on residents who were in a peaceful demonstration on 22 December using heavy and light weapons, which put residents' lives in serious danger and violated their basic rights.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Abarwanyi bo mu mutwe wa Front pour la Refondation de la Nation (FRN), uyobowe na Joseph Kabila, bigaruriye agace ka Kadezi bitandukanye na Kawezi nk’uko byakomeje kuvugwa, n’ubwo utu duce tujya kwitiranwa kandi tukaba turi muri Kivu y’Amajyepfo ariko turatandukanye.
claim_sources.translation_en: Fighters of the Front pour la Refondation de la Nation (FRN), led by Joseph Kabila, took the area of Kadezi, different from Kawezi as had continued to be said, although these places tend to be confused and are both in South Kivu but are distinct.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Imisozi ya Kadezi iherereye ku ntera ya kilometero 70 uvuye mu mujyi wa Uvira, mu Ntara ya Kivu y’Amajyepfo muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo (RDC).
claim_sources.translation_en: The Kadezi hills are located 70 kilometres from the town of Uvira, in South Kivu province in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC).

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Amakuru yo gufatwa kwa kariya gace yacicikanye ku mbuga nkoranyambaga kuva mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Mbere tariki ya 26 Ukwakira, 2026.
claim_sources.translation_en: News of the capture of that area spread on social media from the morning of this Monday, 26 October 2026.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Amakuru aturuka muri ako gace avuga ko imirwano yatangiye mu rukerera rwo ku wa Gatandatu, tariki ya 10 Ukwakira 2026,
claim_sources.translation_en: Information from the area says the fighting began in the early hours of Saturday, 10 October 2026,

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Amakuru yatanzwe n’abaturage bo muri ako karere avuga ko ahagana saa yine za mu gitondo, abarwanyi bivugwa ko bari mu ihuriro rya AFC/M23, Twirwaneho na Red-Tabara bagabye igitero ku birindiro by’abarwanyi ba Wazalendo bo mu matsinda ya Binjigi na Masango. Ayo makuru avuga ko abarwanyi ba Wazalendo bashoboye gusubiza inyuma icyo gitero, ariko imirwano igakomeza mu cyerekezo cya Magunda.
claim_sources.translation_en: Information provided by residents of the area says that at around saa yine in the morning, fighters said to be in the AFC/M23, Twirwaneho and Red-Tabara coalition attacked the positions of the Wazalendo fighters of the Binjigi and Masango groups. That information says the Wazalendo fighters managed to push back the attack, but fighting continued in the direction of Magunda.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kugeza igihe iyi nkuru yandikwaga, nta tangazo ryemewe ryari ryatangajwe risobanura uko imirwano yarangiye, niba hari abayiguyemo cyangwa abakomeretse, ndetse n’ibyangiritse ku mitungo y’abaturage.
claim_sources.translation_en: As of writing, no official statement had been issued explaining how the fighting ended, whether there were dead or wounded, and the damage to residents' property.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuyobozi wa Kamanyola, Hassan Shabani, yatangaje ko kuva tariki ya 2 kugeza ku ya 4 Ukuboza, muri iyi santere hatewe ibisasu bigera ku 150 byaturutse mu Burundi, byica abaturage umunani.
claim_sources.translation_en: The head of Kamanyola, Hassan Shabani, announced that from 2 to 4 December, about 150 shells fired from Burundi hit this centre, killing eight residents.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuganga mu Bitaro bya Saint-Joseph muri Kamanyola yatangaje ko ubwo Ingabo z’u Burundi zarasaga muri iyi santere, bakiriye inkomere 55, zirimo 27 zari zakomeretse cyane, zoherezwa mu Btaro bikuru bya Bukavu kugira ngo zihabwe ubuvuzi bwisumbuyeho.
claim_sources.translation_en: A doctor at Saint-Joseph Hospital in Kamanyola said that when the Burundian forces fired on this centre, they received 55 wounded, 27 of them seriously wounded, who were sent to Bukavu General Hospital for further treatment.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuturage wiciwe umugore n’abana babiri yatangarije urubuga CTGL (Conspiracy Tracker Great Lakes) ko mu gihe Ingabo z’u Burundi zarasaga muri Kamanyola, babuze uko bahunga kuko nta buryo bwo kubibafashamo bari bafite. Ati "Ntitwagize amahirwe yo guhunga kuko nta buryo twari dufite. Twasabwe kuguma mu nzu. Ni uko igisasu cyaje, kigwa ku nzu yacu. Abantu bane barapfuye.
claim_sources.translation_en: A resident whose wife and two children were killed told the CTGL (Conspiracy Tracker Great Lakes) site that when the Burundian forces were firing on Kamanyola, they could not flee because they had no means to do so. He said: "We had no chance to flee because we had no means. We were told to stay in the house. Then the shell came and fell on our house. Four people died.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuyobozi wa Kamanyola, Hassan Shabani, yatangaje ko kuva tariki ya 2 kugeza ku ya 4 Ukuboza, muri iyi santere hatewe ibisasu bigera ku 150 byaturutse mu Burundi, byica abaturage umunani.
claim_sources.translation_en: The head of Kamanyola, Hassan Shabani, announced that from 2 to 4 December, about 150 shells fired from Burundi hit this centre, killing eight residents.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Amashuri yararashwe, inzu z’abasivili zararashwe, ibitaro byarashwe, abantu umunani barapfuye.
claim_sources.translation_en: Schools were shelled, civilians' houses were shelled, the hospital was shelled, eight people died.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umwana w'umuhungu w'imyaka 12 yapfuye arashwe, abantu nibura icyenda na bo barakomereka mu myigaragambyo yabayemo guhangana hagati y'abasirikare n'abigaragambya ku wa mbere mu mujyi wa Uvira mu ntara ya Kivu y'Epfo ya DR Congo.
claim_sources.translation_en: A 12-year-old boy died of gunshots and at least nine people were wounded in a protest that saw a clash between soldiers and protesters on Monday in the town of Uvira in South Kivu province of DR Congo.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi w'igisirikare cya FARDC muri ako gace, Lt. Reagan Mbuyi Kalonji yatangaje ko uwo mwana yishwe ubwo igisirikare cyagerageza kubuza abigaragambya kwinjira mu biro bikuru bya gisirikare muri uyu mujyi.
claim_sources.translation_en: The FARDC military spokesperson in that area, Lt. Reagan Mbuyi Kalonji, said the child was killed when the army tried to prevent protesters from entering the main military office in this town.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ibiro ntaramakuru Associated Press bisubiramo guverineri Jean-Jacques Purusi w'iyi ntara igice kigenzurwa na leta avuga ko abapfuye muri iyi myigaragambyo ari abantu batatu, abandi batanu ko bakomeretse.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Associated Press news agency repeats governor Jean-Jacques Purusi of this province, in the part controlled by the government, saying the dead in this protest are three people, and five others wounded.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Perezida wa M23 akanaba umuhuzabikorwa wungirije w'ihuriro Alliance Fleuve Congo, Bertrand Bisimwa, abinyujije ku rubuga rwe rwa X yatangaje ko icyemezo cya Leta ya Kinshasa cyo gukupa internet muri Uvira kigamije guhisha amabi ingabo zayo zikomeje gukorera muri uriya mujyi.
claim_sources.translation_en: The president of M23 and also deputy coordinator of the Alliance Fleuve Congo, Bertrand Bisimwa, via his account on X, announced that the decision by the Kinshasa government to cut the internet in Uvira aims to hide the evil acts its forces continue to commit in that town.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Inzu z'Abatutsi mu Mujyi wa Uvira, mu Ntara ya Kivu y'Amajyepfo, zagabweho ibitero n'abaturage, bayobowe n'abarwanyi ba Wazalendo basubiye muri uyu mujyi basahura buri kintu cyane cyane mu nzu z'Abatutsi.
claim_sources.translation_en: The houses of Tutsi in the town of Uvira, in South Kivu province, were attacked by residents, led by Wazalendo fighters who returned to this town, looting everything, especially in the houses of Tutsi.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Andi makuru avuga ko hari Itorero rifatwa nk'iryiganjemo Abatutsi ryasahuwe muri iki gitondo cyo ku Cyumweru.
claim_sources.translation_en: Other reports say that a church considered to be predominantly Tutsi was looted this Sunday morning.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Biravugwa ndetse ko Abasivili batanu bapfuye nubwo tutabasha kubyemeza. Ibi biravugwa nyuma y'uko inyeshyamba za Wazalendo zifatanya n’Ingabo za Repubulika ya Demokarasi ya Congo (FARDC) zisubiye mu Mujyi wa Uvira, muri Kivu y'Amajyepfo,
claim_sources.translation_en: It is also said that five civilians died, although we cannot confirm it. This is said after the Wazalendo insurgents allied with the Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of Congo (FARDC) returned to the town of Uvira, in South Kivu,

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ishyirahamwe Amohoro Peace Association ry'Abanyamulenge ryasohoye itangazo rivuga ko Abanyamulenge bari mu kaga. "Uvira iragana mu bihe byihutirwa by'ubutabazi. Nyuma yo kugenda ku gahato kwa AFC/M23 ku gitutu cya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, abasivili b'Abanyamulenge barimo guhigwa, mu gihe imitwe yitwara gisirikare ya Wazalendo yibasiye, ikica, ikanasahura amazu y’abantu bise "Banyarwanda," ijambo ryakoreshejwe kenshi mu kwibasira abatutsi Banyamulenge.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Banyamulenge association Amohoro Peace Association issued a statement saying Banyamulenge are in danger. "Uvira is heading into an emergency humanitarian situation. After the forced departure of AFC/M23 under pressure from the United States, Banyamulenge civilians are being hunted, while the Wazalendo armed groups have targeted, killed and looted the homes of people they call 'Banyarwanda', a term often used to target Tutsi Banyamulenge.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Reta ya Repubulika ya Demokarasi ya Congo ivuga ko yategetse ingabo zayo kutivuna umuhari uyigwanya wa M23 mu gihe uriko uratera intambwe zikomeye mu gisagara ca Uvira, akarere ka nyuma gakomeye kari gasigaye katarafatwa mu buseruko bw'ico gihugu. Reta ya Congo isigura ko yashatse kwirinda ko abasivire bahasiga ubuzima.
claim_sources.translation_en: The government of the Democratic Republic of Congo says it ordered its troops not to confront the M23 armed group as it makes major advances in the town of Uvira, the last major area remaining unseized in the east of that country. The government of Congo explains that it wanted to avoid civilians losing their lives there.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mw'itangazo ryaciye ku rubuga rwa X rwa Lawrence Kanyuka, umuvugizi w'uwo murwi, avuga ko amenyesha abantu bose ko kuva mu mezi arenga atatu, AFC/M23 yiyamirije amajambo abiba urwanko, ibitero vyibasira abenegihugu kubera uko bavutse basa, n'ubwicanyi bukorerwa "mu turere twabohowe" na M23 bukozwe n'abarwanyi bafashanya na reta ya Kinshasa na somambike wabo, ari we Uburundi.
claim_sources.translation_en: In the statement on the X account of Lawrence Kanyuka, the spokesperson of that group, he says he informs everyone that for more than three months AFC/M23 has denounced hate speech, attacks targeting citizens because of how they look by birth, and killings carried out 'in the areas liberated' by M23 by fighters allied with the Kinshasa government and its accomplice, namely Burundi.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ati: "Uyu musi, iyi nkeke yakuweho kandi turemeza ko igisagara ca Uvira ubu cabohowe. Turahimiriza abenegihugu gusubira mu bikorwa vyabo mu mutekano ntangere: AFC/M23 irahari kugira ngo ibakingire."
claim_sources.translation_en: He says: "Today, this threat has been removed and we confirm that the town of Uvira is now liberated. We urge citizens to return to their activities in perfect safety: AFC/M23 is there to protect them."

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ariko, Olivier Muhasha, umwe mu banyamakuru bari mu muji wa Uvira, yabwiye BBC Gahuzamiryango muri aka gatondo ko aba barwanyi boba binjiye mu makaritiye abiri gusa, Kavimvira na Kagenge, ayandi nayo akaba ari mu minwe y'igisirikare ca reta n'abarwanyi ba Wazalendo. Uvira igizwe n'amakaritiye 14.
claim_sources.translation_en: But Olivier Muhasha, one of the journalists in the town of Uvira, told BBC Gahuzamiryango this morning that these fighters had reportedly entered only two quarters, Kavimvira and Kagenge, and that the others were in the hands of the government army and Wazalendo fighters. Uvira is made up of 14 quarters.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: hari amakuru ataremezwa neza avuga ko abarwanyi ba M23 boba binjiye
claim_sources.translation_en: there is not yet fully confirmed information saying that M23 fighters may have entered ['boba' marks a hedge: reportedly]

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Hagati aho, mu gihe buramatari w'intara ya Kivu y'Epfo, Jean-Jacques Purusi, ejo ku wa kabiri yabwiye Radio Okapi yo muri Congo ko Uvira yagenzurwa n'ingabo za reta akabeshuza ibihuha vyavuga ko inyeshamba za M23 zoba zari zinjiye muri iki gisagara
claim_sources.translation_en: Meanwhile, as the governor of South Kivu province, Jean-Jacques Purusi, yesterday on Tuesday told Radio Okapi of Congo that Uvira was controlled by government forces and denied rumours that M23 rebels had entered this town

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ihuriro AFC/M23 rirwanya ubutegetsi bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo ryahanuye indege y’intambara yo mu bwoko bwa Sukhoi-25 yifashishwaga n’igisirikare cy’iki gihugu (FARDC) mu kurigabaho ibitero.
claim_sources.translation_en: The AFC/M23 alliance, which opposes the government of the Democratic Republic of Congo, shot down a Sukhoi-25 type war plane used by that country's army (FARDC) in attacking it.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Amakuru aturuka mu ntara ya Kivu y’Amajyepfo yemeza ko iyi ndege yarasiwe mu kirere cyo ku cyambu cya Kalundu muri teritwari ya Uvira, intara ya Kivu y’Amajyepfo, mu ma Saa Saba y’amanywa yo kuri uyu wa 26 Ukuboza 2025, igwa mu kiyaga cya Tanganyika.
claim_sources.translation_en: Information from South Kivu province confirms that this aircraft was shot in the air above Kalundu port in Uvira territory, South Kivu province, at around saa saba in the afternoon of this 26 December 2025, falling into Lake Tanganyika.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Bivugwa ko abantu babiri bari bayirimo baguye muri Tanganyika, barapfa.
claim_sources.translation_en: It is said that the two people aboard fell into Tanganyika and died.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ingabo za RDC zagabye igitero ku cyambu cya Kalundu kiri ku kiyaga cya Tanganyika ku ruhande rw’umujyi wa Uvira, abo bivugwa ko ubwato bubiri bwa AFC/M23 bwarashwe, abarwanyi bari baburimo bahasiga ubuzima.
claim_sources.translation_en: The DRC forces launched an attack on Kalundu port on Lake Tanganyika, on the Uvira town side, in which two AFC/M23 boats are said to have been shot and the fighters aboard lost their lives.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Drones z’intambara z’ingabo za RDC kandi zarashe ibigo bya AFC/M23 birimo icya Kala muri teritwari ya Uvira, ahahoze ikigo cy’ingabo ziri mu butumwa bw’amahoro bw’Umuryango w’Abibumbye (MONUSCO).
claim_sources.translation_en: The DRC army's war drones also hit AFC/M23 bases including the one at Kala in Uvira territory, where the base of the UN peacekeeping force (MONUSCO) used to be.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Abarwanyi ba AFC/M23 bagabweho ibi bitero nyuma yo kuva muri santere ya Makobola ku gicamunsi cyo ku wa 25 Ukuboza. Ingabo za RDC na Wazalendo byahise bijya kuhagenzura nk’uko abaturage baho babyemeza.
claim_sources.translation_en: The AFC/M23 fighters were attacked in this way after leaving Makobola centre in the afternoon of 25 December. The DRC forces and Wazalendo immediately went to take control of it, as local residents confirm.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Imirwano ku wa kabiri hagati y'imitwe ya Wazalendo n'ingabo za FARDC mu mujyi wa Uvira yatumye abantu bahasiga ubuzima kandi itera impagarara nk'uko abategetsi b'uyu mujyi babivuga. Ibinyamakuru muri DR Congo bivuga ko abantu bagera ku munani bapfuye.
claim_sources.translation_en: The fighting on Tuesday between the Wazalendo groups and FARDC forces in the town of Uvira caused people to lose their lives and created tension, as the town's authorities say. Media in DR Congo say about eight people died.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Imwe mu mirwano hagati y'impande zombi yabereye mu gace ka Kavimvira kari hafi y'umupaka n'u Burundi. Radio RFI ivuga ko yavuye ku kutumvikana hagati ya Wazalendo na FARDC ku kwinjira kw'abantu bavuye mu Burundi.
claim_sources.translation_en: Some of the fighting between the two sides took place in the Kavimvira area near the border with Burundi. Radio RFI says it came from a disagreement between Wazalendo and FARDC over the entry of people coming from Burundi.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mu itangazo ry'ubutegetsi rivuga ku byabaye, rivuga ko Guverineri w'iyi ntara asaba Wazalendo n'ingabo za leta "gufata ingamba zo kwirinda kugwa mu mutego w'umwanzi" avuga ko uwo mwanzi "akwiza amakuru atari yo ko yagose umujyi wa Uvira, kandi bidafite ishingiro".
claim_sources.translation_en: In the government statement on what happened, it says the governor of this province asks the Wazalendo and the government army to "take measures to avoid falling into the enemy's trap", saying that enemy "is spreading false information that he has surrounded the town of Uvira, and that it has no basis".

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kubera iki kibazo, Guverineri w'iyi ntara Jean Jacques Purusi, ku ruhande rwa leta, yatumije "inama idasanzwe" imuhuza n'abahagarariye ingabo, abakuriye amadini, urubyiruko n'abagore, abategetsi gakondo, hamwe n'abakuriye abitwa "Volontaires pour la Défense de la Patrie" cyangwa Wazalendo.
claim_sources.translation_en: Because of this problem, the governor of this province, Jean Jacques Purusi, on the government's side, convened an "extraordinary meeting" bringing him together with representatives of the army, religious leaders, youth and women, traditional authorities, and the heads of the so-called "Volontaires pour la Défense de la Patrie" or Wazalendo.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ishirahamwe Human Rights Watch (HRW) rivuga ko abatohoza baryo babonye ibimenyetso vyerekana ko abasivile 53 bishwe ata rubanza — abagabo 46, umugore umwe hamwe n'abahungu batanu — mu bitero vyakorewe ku mazu y'abanyagihugu mu bice bitandukanye vy'igisagara inyuma y'uko abo barwanyi, bashigikiwe n'Urwanda, bafashe Uvira mu kwezi kwa Kigarama (12).
claim_sources.translation_en: The organisation Human Rights Watch (HRW) says its investigators found evidence that 53 civilians were killed without trial, 46 men, one woman and five boys, in attacks on residents' homes in different parts of the town after those fighters, backed by Rwanda, took Uvira in the month of December (12).

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Abatohoza bayo kandi baragendeye ibibanza bitatu bivugwa ko birimwo ibinogo rusangi vyatawemwo abantu i Uvira, harimwo kimwe kiri ahantu hahora hacunzwe n'abasirikare ba ONU bashinzwe kugarukana amahoro.
claim_sources.translation_en: Its investigators also visited three sites said to contain mass graves in which people were thrown in Uvira, one of them in a place permanently guarded by UN peacekeepers.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: HRW ivuga ko yatohoje kandi yandika ivyaha umunani vy'ugusambanya abagore ku nguvu, vyagirizwa abo barwanyi hamwe n'abasirikare b'Urwanda mu gihe bari bigaruriye ico gisagara.
claim_sources.translation_en: HRW says it investigated and documented eight rape offences, alleged against those fighters and the Rwandan soldiers during the time they occupied that town.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umugore umwe yavuze ati: "Baranyambuye impuzu zose, bambohera amaboko inyuma bakoresheje impuzu zanje, hanyuma baransambanya ku nguvu," Yongeyeko ko igihe umugabo wiwe yagerageza kumutabara, yarashwe agapfa.
claim_sources.translation_en: One woman said: "They took off all my clothes, tied my hands behind my back with my clothes, then raped me." She added that when her husband tried to help her, he was shot dead.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Urwanda rwagumye ruhakana ko rushigikiye M23 canke ko abasirikare barwo barungitswe mu buseruko bwa RD Congo, igihugu kirangwamwo amabuye y'agaciro menshi . Ariko HRW ivuga ko benshi mu bo yabajije bavuze ko babonye amahano yakozwe n'abasirikare b'Urwanda bambaye umwambaro ubaranga hamwe n'abarwanyi ba M23.
claim_sources.translation_en: Rwanda has continued to deny that it backs M23 or that its soldiers were sent to eastern DR Congo, a country rich in minerals. But HRW says that many of those it interviewed said they saw atrocities committed by Rwandan soldiers in uniform and by M23 fighters.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: M23 na Reta y'Urwanda ntibarishura ubusabe bwa BBC bwo kugira ico bavuze.
claim_sources.translation_en: M23 and the Rwandan government did not reply to the BBC's request that they say something.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ni nyuma y'uko ku wa gatandatu nijoro Minisitiri Edouard Bizimana yanditse ku rubuga X ko ari "ingenzi gushimangira uruhare rubi rwa Qatar mu gukoresha ijambo ryayo n'amafaranga ikabuza Amerika kugira icyo ikora".
claim_sources.translation_en: This is after on Saturday night Minister Edouard Bizimana wrote on X that it is "important to stress Qatar's bad role in using its word and money to prevent America from taking action".

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mu nyandiko ye Bizimana yashinjaga u Rwanda "gukomeza gufata uturere mu burasirazuba bwa DR Congo" binyuranyije n'amasezerano ya Washington ariko Amerika ntigire icyo ibikoraho.
claim_sources.translation_en: In his post Bizimana accused Rwanda of "continuing to take areas in the east of DR Congo" contrary to the Washington agreements but America not doing anything about it.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mu gisa no gukosora ibyavuzwe na Minisitiri we w'ububanyi n'amahanga, Perezida Evariste Ndayishimiye w'u Burundi yatangaje ko igihugu cye 'igihe cyose cyashimiye 'uruhare rw'ingenzi' rwa Qatar mu buhuza ku kibazo cya Repubulika ya Demokarasi ya Congo.
claim_sources.translation_en: In what looked like correcting what his foreign minister said, President Evariste Ndayishimiye of Burundi declared that his country has always praised Qatar's 'important role' in mediation on the question of the Democratic Republic of Congo.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Bizimana iyi nyandiko ye yaje kuyisiba, ariko nyuma yo gukomeza guhanahanwa no gutangwaho ibitekerezo n'abantu batandukanye, byatumye kuri iki cyumweru nimugoroba Perezida Ndayishimiye asa n'uyigarukaho. Atavuze ko ari ubutumwa bwa Bizimana arimo kuvugaho, Ndayishimiye yanditse ku rubuga X ko ari ngombwa gusobanura "ikitumvikanye neza cyose n'imvugo itari yo ku ruhare rwa Qatar mu iterambere no kubaka amahoro".
claim_sources.translation_en: Bizimana ended up deleting this post of his, but after it continued to be shared and commented on by various people, on Sunday evening President Ndayishimiye seemed to return to it. Without saying that he was talking about Bizimana's message, Ndayishimiye wrote on X that it is necessary to explain "everything that was not clearly understood and the wrong words on Qatar's role in development and building peace".

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Katika jimbo la Kivu Kusini, takribani raia 20 wameuawa na wengine 10 wamejeruhiwa tangu Machi 23 katika mapigano yaliyotokea maeneo ya Uvira, Kalehe na Mwenga. “Uharibifu wa makazi na mifugo umelazimisha familia nyingi kukimbia, huku upatikanaji wa chakula na huduma za afya ukiendelea kuwa mdogo,” ameeleza Msemaji huyo wa Umoja wa Mataifa.
claim_sources.translation_en: In the province of South Kivu, about 20 civilians have been killed and another 10 wounded since 23 March in fighting in the areas of Uvira, Kalehe and Mwenga. "The destruction of homes and livestock has forced many families to flee, while access to food and health services remains limited," said the UN spokesperson.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: En réaction, le porte-parole du CMC-FDP rejette catégoriquement ces accusations. Il affirme qu’aucune plainte officielle n’a été déposée devant les instances disciplinaires ou judiciaires internes du mouvement, contestant ainsi les conclusions du rapport.
claim_sources.translation_en: In reaction, the CMC-FDP spokesperson categorically rejects these accusations. He states that no official complaint was filed before the movement's internal disciplinary or judicial bodies, thus contesting the report's conclusions.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: L’organisation Amnesty International accuse le groupe armé Collectif des Mouvements pour le Changement Forces de Défense du Peuple (CMC-FDP) d’être impliqué dans de graves violations des droits humains dans le groupement de Bukombo, en chefferie de Bwito, territoire de Rutshuru (Nord-Kivu). Dans un rapport publié jeudi 25 juin 2026
claim_sources.translation_en: Amnesty International accuses the armed group Collectif des Mouvements pour le Changement Forces de Défense du Peuple (CMC-FDP) of involvement in serious human rights violations in Bukombo groupement, Bwito chiefdom, Rutshuru territory (North Kivu). In a report published on Thursday 25 June 2026

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Waziri wa Habari na Msemaji wa Serikali, Patrick Muyaya amewashutumu waasi hao kwa kuendeleza vita, siku chache tu baada ya kusaini makubaliano ya amani na kulitaja tangazo lao la kuondoka kama upotoshaji.
claim_sources.translation_en: Minister of Information and Government Spokesperson Patrick Muyaya has accused the rebels of continuing the war, just days after signing a peace agreement, and called their announcement of leaving a distortion.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ni dhahiri huu ni ujanja wa kumvuruga mpatanishi ambaye ni Marekani, aliyejitolea kuchukua hatua, kwa sababu ni wazi kuwa kilichotokea Uvira hakikubaliki.
claim_sources.translation_en: It is obvious this is a ploy to disrupt the mediator, which is the United States, which has committed to act, because it is clear that what happened in Uvira is unacceptable.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Serikali ya Jamhuri ya Kidemokrasia ya Kongo imelikataa tangazo la waasi wa M23 kwamba wanajiondoa kwenye mji wa Uvira ulioko Kivu Kusini.
claim_sources.translation_en: The government of the Democratic Republic of the Congo has rejected the announcement by the M23 rebels that they are withdrawing from the town of Uvira in South Kivu.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: indique, dans un communiqué publié le 6 mars, par le vice-Premier ministre de l’Intérieur, Jacquemain Shabani.
claim_sources.translation_en: states, in a communiqué published on 6 March, by the Vice-Prime Minister for the Interior, Jacquemain Shabani.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Pire que tout, Kigali a déployé ses troupes le 28 février, les 3 et 4 mars derniers, dans les hôpitaux de Ndosho et CBCA Virunga pour enlever des malades, dont la plupart des militaires congolais et leurs garde-malades. Malheureusement, certains d’entre eux ont été sauvagement exécutés
claim_sources.translation_en: Worse still, Kigali deployed its troops on 28 February and on 3 and 4 March, in the Ndosho and CBCA Virunga hospitals to take away patients, most of them Congolese soldiers, and their carers. Unfortunately, some of them were savagely executed

claim_sources.excerpt_original: L’armée rwandaise et ses supplétifs du M23 ont effectué une série d’incursions dans les hôpitaux de Goma en enlevant une centaine de malades et garde-malades, parmi lesquels des soldats de la RDC. Ils ont sommairement été exécutés, ajoute le communiqué du ministère de l’Intérieur.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Rwandan army and its M23 auxiliaries carried out a series of incursions into Goma hospitals, taking about a hundred patients and carers, among them DRC soldiers. They were summarily executed, adds the communiqué of the Ministry of the Interior.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Après des travaux de documentation, le ministre des droits humains, Samuel Mbemba a dévoilé mardi 7 avril, le rapport sur les actes de violations qu’auraient commis les rebelles de l'AFC/M23 lors de l’occupation de la ville d’Uvira et ses environs, dans la province du Sud-Kivu, avec le soutien du Rwanda.
claim_sources.translation_en: After documentation work, the human rights minister, Samuel Mbemba, unveiled on Tuesday 7 April the report on the violations the AFC/M23 rebels allegedly committed during the occupation of the city of Uvira and its surroundings, in South Kivu province, with Rwanda's support.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le rapport répertorie plus de 15 000 personnes tuées directement dans les offensives armées des rebelles, et d’autres par manque d’accès aux soins. Le gouvernement dit avoir dénombré plus 14 400 femmes violées dans ces atrocités
claim_sources.translation_en: The report lists more than 15 000 people killed directly in the rebels' armed offensives, and others through lack of access to care. The government says it counted more [than] 14 400 women raped in these atrocities (the French reads 'plus 14 400', without 'de').

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Plus de 1 500 morts, victimes directes des offensives armées et du manque d’accès aux soins.
claim_sources.translation_en: More than 1,500 dead, direct victims of the armed offensives and of the lack of access to care.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les trois fosses découvertes à Mayi Moto, avaient permis l'ensevelissement de 115 cadavres, d’après le gouvernement. Une autre, trouvée à Kilomani contient 31 corps humains entassés. Une autre encore a été trouvée à Kala et deux autres fosses communes à Rutembo.
claim_sources.translation_en: The three graves found at Mayi Moto had been used to bury 115 corpses, according to the government. Another, found at Kilomani, contains 31 human bodies piled up. Another was found at Kala and two other mass graves at Rutembo.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Comme Human Rights Watch, le gouvernement congolais a lui aussi débusqué plusieurs fosses communes après le départ des rebelles de l’AFC/M23 de la ville stratégique d’Uvira et ses environs.
claim_sources.translation_en: Like Human Rights Watch, the Congolese government also uncovered several mass graves after the AFC/M23 rebels left the strategic city of Uvira and its surroundings.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le gouverneur du Sud-Kivu, Jean-Jacques Purusi, a confirmé cette information lors de son passage, mardi 20 janvier, au cours de l'émission Dialogue entre Congolais sur Radio Okapi. Le chef de l'exécutif provincial a rassuré sur la situation sécuritaire de cette cité stratégique du Sud-Kivu, confirmant que les forces loyalistes contrôlent désormais la ville.
claim_sources.translation_en: The governor of South Kivu, Jean-Jacques Purusi, confirmed this information during his appearance on Tuesday 20 January on the programme Dialogue entre Congolais on Radio Okapi. The head of the provincial executive reassured on the security situation of this strategic city of South Kivu, confirming that loyalist forces now control the city.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: La vie a repris son cours normal dans la ville d’Uvira, après le retrait des troupes rebelles de l’AFC/M23, soutenues par l’armée rwandaise. Le gouverneur du Sud-Kivu, Jean-Jacques Purusi, a confirmé cette information lors de son passage, mardi 20 janvier, au cours de l'émission Dialogue entre Congolais sur Radio Okapi.
claim_sources.translation_en: Life has returned to normal in the city of Uvira after the withdrawal of the AFC/M23 rebel troops, supported by the Rwandan army. The governor of South Kivu, Jean-Jacques Purusi, confirmed this information during his appearance on Tuesday 20 January on the programme Dialogue entre Congolais on Radio Okapi.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Jean-Jacques Purusi a également annoncé le rétablissement imminent de l'autorité de l'État dans cette partie du pays.
claim_sources.translation_en: Jean-Jacques Purusi also announced the imminent restoration of State authority in this part of the country.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le porte-parole des Forces armées congolaises (FARDC), le général major Sylvain Ekenge a appelé ce samedi 6 septembre, les habitants d’Uvira (Sud-Kivu) au calme et à ne pas céder à la manipulation de l’ennemi.
claim_sources.translation_en: The spokesperson of the Congolese armed forces (FARDC), Major General Sylvain Ekenge, called on Saturday 6 September the residents of Uvira (South Kivu) to stay calm and not give in to the enemy's manipulation.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Sylvain Ekenge accuse les rebelles et leurs alliés de vouloir instrumentaliser certains Wazalendo pour créer des tensions communautaires et déstabiliser la paix dans la région.
claim_sources.translation_en: Sylvain Ekenge accuses the rebels and their allies of wanting to instrumentalise certain Wazalendo to create community tensions and destabilise peace in the region.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Devant la presse ce samedi, le porte-parole des FARDC a dénoncé les tentatives de manipulation autour de la nomination du général Olivier Gasita
claim_sources.translation_en: Before the press this Saturday, the FARDC spokesperson denounced attempts at manipulation around the appointment of General Olivier Gasita

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Il a lancé ce message suite à une série de manifestations organisées par les Wazalendo et certains mouvements citoyens qui exigent le départ du général Olivier Gasita
claim_sources.translation_en: He issued this message following a series of demonstrations organised by the Wazalendo and some citizen movements demanding the departure of General Olivier Gasita

claim_sources.excerpt_original: C’est le président de l’Assemblée nationale, Vital Kamerhe, qui l’a annoncé lundi 8 septembre 2025, à l’issue d’une réunion interinstitutionnelle présidée par le chef de l’État.
claim_sources.translation_en: It was the president of the National Assembly, Vital Kamerhe, who announced it on Monday 8 September 2025, after an inter-institutional meeting chaired by the head of state.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: De son côté, le gouvernement et les FARDC réaffirment leur confiance au général Gasita, qui bénéficie du soutien direct du président Tshisekedi.
claim_sources.translation_en: For its part, the government and the FARDC reaffirm their confidence in General Gasita, who enjoys the direct support of President Tshisekedi.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le président de la République, Félix Tshisekedi, a décidé de dépêcher une mission gouvernementale à Uvira, après les manifestations contre la nomination du général Sylvain Gasita comme chef du renseignement militaire dans cette partie du pays.
claim_sources.translation_en: The President of the Republic, Félix Tshisekedi, decided to send a government mission to Uvira, after the demonstrations against the appointment of General Sylvain Gasita as head of military intelligence in this part of the country.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: « Concernant la crise sécuritaire dans l’Est de la République, le chef de l’État est préoccupé par la situation et cherche des solutions à travers une mission gouvernementale qui sera envoyée à Uvira », a-t-il déclaré.
claim_sources.translation_en: "Concerning the security crisis in the East of the Republic, the head of state is concerned about the situation and is seeking solutions through a government mission that will be sent to Uvira," he said.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Réagissant à ces rapports lors d’un briefing de presse coanimé avec son collègue de la Santé publique, Hygiène et Prévoyance sociale, Samuel Roger Kamba, le porte-parole du gouvernement, Patrick Muyaya, a indiqué que ces publications ne constituaient pas une surprise pour les autorités congolaises.
claim_sources.translation_en: Reacting to these reports at a press briefing co-hosted with his colleague from Public Health, Hygiene and Social Welfare, Samuel Roger Kamba, the government spokesperson, Patrick Muyaya, said that these publications were not a surprise to the Congolese authorities.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon lui, Kinshasa agit notamment sur "un front judiciaire et un front économique".
claim_sources.translation_en: According to him, Kinshasa is acting notably on 'a judicial front and an economic front'.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: face aux accusations contenues dans les récents rapports de Human Rights Watch et Global Witness concernant la situation sécuritaire, humanitaire et l’exploitation des ressources naturelles dans les zones sous contrôle de la rébellion de l’AFC/M23 dans l’Est de la RDC.
claim_sources.translation_en: in response to the accusations contained in the recent reports by Human Rights Watch and Global Witness concerning the security and humanitarian situation and the exploitation of natural resources in the areas under the control of the AFC/M23 rebellion in eastern DRC.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le porte-parole du gouvernement estime que le choix de l’ancien chef de l’État de prendre les armes constitue une attaque contre les institutions et l’ordre constitutionnel. « Le choix qu’il fait de prendre les armes, c’est de s’attaquer à la République et à l’ordre constitutionnel », affirme-t-il.
claim_sources.translation_en: The government spokesperson considers that the former head of state's choice to take up arms constitutes an attack on the institutions and the constitutional order. "The choice he is making to take up arms is to attack the Republic and the constitutional order," he says.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le porte-parole du gouvernement congolais, Patrick Muyaya, appelle les leaders de la Coalition Article 64 (C64), à clarifier leur position après la création du Front pour la refondation de la nation (FRN), dirigé par l’ancien président Joseph Kabila.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Congolese government spokesperson, Patrick Muyaya, calls on the leaders of the Coalition Article 64 (C64) to clarify their position after the creation of the Front pour la refondation de la nation (FRN), led by former president Joseph Kabila.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Dans une vidéo diffusée dimanche 18 octobre sur les réseaux sociaux, Patrick Muyaya interpelle les responsables de cette plateforme de l’opposition
claim_sources.translation_en: In a video circulated on Sunday 18 October on social media, Patrick Muyaya challenges the leaders of this opposition platform

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon des sources parlementaires, le chef de l'État a indiqué que l'émergence de cette nouvelle plateforme politico-militaire ne constituait nullement une surprise pour lui.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to parliamentary sources, the head of state indicated that the emergence of this new political-military platform was in no way a surprise to him.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: a été au centre des échanges entre le président de la République, Félix-Antoine Tshisekedi Tshilombo, et les députés ainsi que sénateurs de la majorité présidentielle, samedi 24 octobre à Kinshasa.
claim_sources.translation_en: was at the centre of the exchanges between the President of the Republic, Félix-Antoine Tshisekedi Tshilombo, and the deputies and senators of the presidential majority, on Saturday 24 October in Kinshasa.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: L’épouse du notable local Rugamba et ses cinq enfants – un garçon et quatre filles – ont été tués lors de l’attaque de leur domicile par des hommes armés, dans la nuit de jeudi à vendredi 3 juillet. L’armée congolaise et le mouvement rebelle AFC/M23, qui contrôle la zone, s’accusent mutuellement d’être responsables de cette tuerie.
claim_sources.translation_en: The wife of the local notable Rugamba and her [or his: French 'ses'] five children – a boy and four girls – were killed during the attack on their home by armed men, in the night from Thursday to Friday 3 July. The Congolese army and the AFC/M23 rebel movement, which controls the area, accuse each other of being responsible for this killing.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le meurtre de six membres d’une même famille dans l’agglomération de Kabizo, dans la chefferie de Bwito, territoire de Rutshuru, suscite de vives réactions.
claim_sources.translation_en: The killing of six members of the same family in the Kabizo agglomeration, in Bwito chiefdom, Rutshuru territory, is provoking strong reactions.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Cette version a été rejetée par le porte-parole de la 34e région militaire, major Dieudonné Kasereka. Ce dernier dénonce une campagne de désinformation visant, selon lui, à dissimuler les exactions « commises par les éléments du RDF/AFC-M23 »
claim_sources.translation_en: This version was rejected by the spokesperson of the 34th military region, Major Dieudonné Kasereka. He denounces a disinformation campaign aimed, according to him, at concealing the abuses "committed by the elements of the RDF/AFC-M23"

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Sur son compte X, l’AFC/M23 attribue l’attaque aux rebelles FDLR qu’il accuse d’agir en collaboration avec les FARDC.
claim_sources.translation_en: On its X account, AFC/M23 attributes the attack to the FDLR rebels, which it accuses of acting in collaboration with the FARDC.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Sur son compte X, l’AFC/M23 attribue l’attaque aux rebelles FDLR qu’il accuse d’agir en collaboration avec les FARDC.
claim_sources.translation_en: On its X account, the AFC/M23 attributes the attack to the FDLR rebels, whom it accuses of acting in collaboration with the FARDC.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le lieutenant-colonel Mutimura, porte-parole des FDLR-FOCA, rejette catégoriquement le désarmement. Il justifie la lutte armée par la protection des réfugiés rwandais et pose comme condition un dialogue inter-rwandais et un retour en toute dignité.
claim_sources.translation_en: Lieutenant-colonel Mutimura, spokesperson of the FDLR-FOCA, categorically rejects disarmament. He justifies the armed struggle by the protection of Rwandan refugees and sets as a condition an inter-Rwandan dialogue and a return in full dignity.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: L’armée congolaise a lancé il y a un mois un ultimatum aux Forces démocratiques de libération du Rwanda (FDLR) : se rendre et déposer les armes pour un rapatriement au Rwanda, ou faire face à la force. Cette décision est prise dans le cadre de la mise en œuvre de l’accord de Washington du 27 juin, indique l’armée
claim_sources.translation_en: The Congolese army launched an ultimatum a month ago to the Democratic Forces for the Liberation of Rwanda (FDLR): surrender and lay down arms for repatriation to Rwanda, or face force. This decision is taken within the framework of implementing the Washington accord of 27 June, the army says.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: L’armée congolaise a lancé il y a un mois un ultimatum aux Forces démocratiques de libération du Rwanda (FDLR) : se rendre et déposer les armes pour un rapatriement au Rwanda, ou faire face à la force. Cette décision est prise dans le cadre de la mise en œuvre de l’accord de Washington du 27 juin, indique l’armée, sans préciser le calendrier d’un éventuel désarmement.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Congolese army issued an ultimatum a month ago to the Forces démocratiques de libération du Rwanda (FDLR): surrender and lay down their arms for repatriation to Rwanda, or face force. This decision was taken as part of the implementation of the Washington agreement of 27 June, the army says, without specifying the timetable for a possible disarmament.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Jeshi la Kongo limesema madai hayo ya M23 siyo ya kweli na hata mkanda wa video ulioonesha wapiganaji waliokamatwa Kongo wakikabidhiwa kwa Rwanda ni wa "kughushi".
claim_sources.translation_en: The Congolese army said those claims by M23 are not true and even the video showing fighters captured in Congo being handed over to Rwanda is "forged".

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Taarifa ya jeshi hilo imetolewa baada ya kundi la M23 linaloungwa mkono na Rwanda mashariki mwa Kongo, kutangaza kuwa limewakamata wapiganaji wa kundi la FDLR
claim_sources.translation_en: The army's statement was issued after the Rwanda-backed M23 group in eastern Congo announced that it had captured fighters of the FDLR group

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Operesheni hiyo ilitangazwa rasmi mjini Kisangani katika jimbo la Tshopo na Naibu kamanda wa jeshi la Kongo, Jenerali Ychaligonza Jacques, ambaye alitoa wito kwa wapiganaji wa FDLR kujisalimisha.
claim_sources.translation_en: The operation was officially announced in the town of Kisangani in Tshopo province by the deputy commander of the Congolese army, General Ychaligonza Jacques, who called on FDLR fighters to surrender.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Jeshi la Jamhuri ya Kidemokrasia ya Kongo limeanzisha operesheni za kuwasaka waasi wa FDLR mashariki mwa nchi
claim_sources.translation_en: The army of the Democratic Republic of the Congo has launched operations to hunt down the FDLR rebels in the east of the country

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le ministre de la Défense nationale a indiqué, lors du conseil des ministres du vendredi 6 février, que dans le Sud-Kivu, les Forces armées de la RDC, (FARDC) ont fait échec aux attaques de "la coalition RDF-M23-AFC" en reconquérant plusieurs localités dont Minembwe-centre.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Minister of National Defence indicated, at the Council of Ministers on Friday 6 February, that in South Kivu the Armed Forces of the DRC (FARDC) defeated the attacks of "the RDF-M23-AFC coalition" by reconquering several localities including Minembwe-centre.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ni raporo uyu muryango washyize ahagaragara ku wa 20 Kanama 2025 ivuga ko abaturage bo mu duce twegereye Pariki y’Igihugu ya Virunga biganjemo Abahutu, biciwe mu midugudu 14 hagati ya tariki 10 na 30 Nyakanga

claim_sources.translation_en: Kanyuka said that the city of Uvira had been a key stronghold of the forces united with the Kinshasa government, including Wazalendo, FDLR, Mai-Mai, foreign mercenaries, and the Burundian army.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Nyamara kuva Uvira yabohorwa, ngo ibintu byabaye byiza. Ngo abaturage babayeho mu mahoro, bakora imirimo yabo mu bwisanzure no mu mutuzo, nta kubangamirwa, nta bujura kandi nta hohoterwa.
claim_sources.translation_en: But since Uvira was liberated, things have reportedly been good. Reportedly, people live in peace, carry out their work freely and calmly, with no obstruction, no theft and no abuse.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Muri uwo muhango, imibiri y’abapfuye yashyizwe kuri stade yitiriwe Ubumwe (Stade de l’Unité), aho imiryango yabuze ababo

claim_sources.translation_en: The AFC/M23 spokesperson for politics, Laurence Kanyuka, in a message on X said: Today we met to honour the civilians killed, shot by the bloodthirsty united forces working with the Kinshasa government.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi wa AFC/M23, Lawrence Kanyuka, abinyujije ku rubuga rwe rwa X, yavuze ko usibye kuba Abanye-Congo bo mu bwoko bw'Abanyamulenge bari kwicwa, Leta ya RDC iri no gukora ibikorwa byo kuvana abaturage mu byabo ku mbaraga.
claim_sources.translation_en: The AFC/M23 spokesperson, Lawrence Kanyuka, via his X account, said that besides Congolese of the Banyamulenge ethnic group being killed, the DRC government is also carrying out actions to remove people from their homes by force.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kugeza ubu mu bo byamenyekanye ko biciwe muri kiriya gice, harimo umukambwe Rudaga Adriyani w'imyaka 95 y'amavuko wiciwe mu bitero bya drone ihuriro ry'ingabo za Leta ya Kinshasa zagabye mu bice bya Minembwe, ku wa Mbere tariki ya 23 Werurwe 2026.
claim_sources.translation_en: So far among those known to have been killed in that area is the elder Rudaga Adriyani, aged 95, killed in drone attacks that the alliance of Kinshasa government forces carried out in Minembwe areas, on Monday 23 March 2026.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kimbulungu yagaragaje ko nubwo Leta ya Congo n’abakorana bya hafi na yo bashinje AFC/M23 uruhare mu itorokwa ry’imfungwa za gereza ya Munzenze ndetse n’urupfu rw’aba bagore, ibi byago byabaye mbere y’uko abarwanyi babo bahagera.
claim_sources.translation_en: Kimbulungu showed that although the Congolese government and those close to it blame AFC/M23 for the escape of the Munzenze prison inmates and the deaths of these women, this tragedy happened before their fighters got there.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kimbulungu, umunyamabanga wa AFC/M23, yasobanuye ko kuva tariki ya 02 kugeza 13 Gashyantare, iri huriro rya AFC/M23 ryabonye mu mujyi wa Goma imirambo 874, nubwo Leta ya Congo yo yemeza ko hapfuye abagera ku 3000.
claim_sources.translation_en: Kimbulungu, secretary of AFC/M23, explained that from 2 to 13 February AFC/M23 saw 874 bodies in the city of Goma, although the Congolese government says about 3000 died.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Par ailleurs, des bombardements attribués à des drones en provenance du Rwanda, pays agresseur, a visé mercredi matin l’Hôpital général de Minembwe et certaines habitations civiles, selon les mêmes sources.
claim_sources.translation_en: Moreover, bombardments attributed to drones from Rwanda, the aggressor country, targeted the Minembwe general hospital and some civilian homes on Wednesday morning, according to the same sources.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umutwe w'inyeshyamba wa AFC/M23 urwanya ubutegetsi bwa Repubulika ya Demokarasi ya Congo (DRC) wemeje urupfu rw'uwari umuvugizi wa gisirikare wawo, Lt Col Willy Ngoma, uvuga ko yishwe ku itariki ya 24 y'ukwezi gushize kwa Gashyantare (2) mu "ntambara isesuye" ushinja Kinshasa gusubukura.
claim_sources.translation_en: The rebel group AFC/M23, opposed to the government of the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), confirmed the death of the man who was its military spokesperson, Lt Col Willy Ngoma, saying he was killed on the 24th of last month, February (2), in a 'full-scale war' that it accuses Kinshasa of resuming.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mu itangazo yasohoye ku wa gatandatu, umuvugizi wa M23 Lawrence Kanyuka yavuze ko "ubutegetsi bwa Kinshasa bwarenze ku bushake ku gahenge buteza intambara isesuye kuri AFC/M23, bugambiriye mu buryo bw'ibanze abasirikare bacu n'abaturage bacu b'abasivile bukoresheje 'drone' zabwo hanze y'imirongo y'imbere yo ku rugamba".
claim_sources.translation_en: In a statement issued on Saturday, M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka said that the Kinshasa regime deliberately violated the ceasefire, causing a full-scale war on AFC/M23, mainly targeting our soldiers and our civilians using its drones outside the front lines.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Nta cyo leta ya DRC yari yatangaza ku mugaragaro kuri iri tangazo rya M23 cyangwa ku rupfu rwa Lt Col Ngoma.
claim_sources.translation_en: The DRC government had not made any official announcement on this M23 statement or on the death of Lt Col Ngoma.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon la mise au point officielle, le retrait du RDF/M23 de la ville d’Uvira, intervenu le 17 janvier 2026, est survenu après une période caractérisée par des pillages systématiques, des vols à grande échelle, des menaces, des intimidations ainsi que des actes de stigmatisation communautaire ayant profondément affecté la sécurité des civils et la cohésion sociale.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to the official clarification, the withdrawal of the RDF/M23 from the city of Uvira, on 17 January 2026, came after a period marked by systematic looting, large-scale theft, threats, intimidation and acts of community stigmatisation that deeply affected civilians' security and social cohesion.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: À ce stade, aucun décès ni blessé n’a été signalé au sein de la communauté banyamulenge depuis le retrait du RDF/M23.
claim_sources.translation_en: At this stage, no death or injury has been reported within the Banyamulenge community since the withdrawal of the RDF/M23.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: L’hôpital général de référence de Kibuwa dans la zone de santé portant le même nom au territoire de Walikale dans le Nord Kivu a été pillé vendredi par les rebelles du M23 pendant leur retrait de cette cité.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Kibuwa general referral hospital in the health zone of the same name in Walikale territory, North Kivu, was looted on Friday by M23 rebels during their withdrawal from this town.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Dr Yves Tshongo, Médecin Chef de zone de Kibuwa a confirmé cette information sans donner des détails. « L’hopital a été effectivement attaqué par les éléments de M23.
claim_sources.translation_en: Dr Yves Tshongo, chief medical officer of the Kibuwa zone, confirmed this information without giving details. The hospital was indeed attacked by M23 elements.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ihuriro AFC/M23 ritavuga rumwe n’ubutegetsi bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, ryatangaje ko ribabajwe no kubona umuryango mpuzamahanga ukomeje kuruca ukarumira ku bwicanyi buri gukorwa n’ubutegetsi bwa Kinshasa bukorerwa abatuye mu bice birimo Minembwe, Mikenge, na Karingi muri Kivu y’Epfo.
claim_sources.translation_en: The AFC/M23 alliance, opposed to the government of the Democratic Republic of Congo, said it is saddened to see the international community remaining silent on the killings being carried out by the Kinshasa government against residents of areas including Minembwe, Mikenge and Karingi in South Kivu.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kanyuka yakomeje avuga ko ibi bikorwa by’ubugome ndengakamere bikomeje gukorerwa “abaturage b’inzirakarengane kandi badafite kirengera, bukozwe n’ingabo za FARDC, FNDB, Wazalendo, FDLR n’abacancuro b’abanyamahanga
claim_sources.translation_en: Kanyuka went on to say that these acts of extreme cruelty continue to be committed against "innocent and defenceless civilians, carried out by the forces of FARDC, FNDB, Wazalendo, FDLR and foreign mercenaries

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kwa mujibu wa Mwende Kanane, mfanyakazi wa mashirika ya kibinadamu, hali ilikuwa mbaya kupita maelezo: "Mashirika ya kibinadamu, hasa Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu, yalitumia ambulansi chache zilizokuwepo kukusanya miili iliyokuwa imelala mitaani. Hali ya kibinadamu ilikuwa ngumu sana, hata kulikuwa na taarifa za ubakaji gerezani kabla ya wafungwa kutoroka.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to Mwende Kanane, a humanitarian organisations worker, the situation was beyond description. Humanitarian organisations, especially the Red Cross, used the few ambulances available to collect bodies lying in the streets. The humanitarian situation was very hard, there were even reports of rape in the prison before the prisoners escaped.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Zaidi ya hayo, hali ya usalama ilizidi kuwa tete baada ya wafungwa kutoroka kutoka gereza la Munzenze, hali iliyochangia ongezeko la uhalifu na visa vya ubakaji, hasa dhidi ya wanawake.
claim_sources.translation_en: Moreover, the security situation became more fragile after inmates escaped from Munzenze prison, a situation that contributed to an increase in crime and cases of rape, especially against women.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kulingana na Umoja wa Mataifa, idadi ya waliopoteza maisha ilifikia takribani 3,000.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to the United Nations, the number of people who died reached about 3,000.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: L’Alliance Fleuve Congo-M23 (AFC-M23) a rejeté, ce jeudi 4 juin 2026, les accusations des Forces armées de la République démocratique du Congo (FARDC) l’impliquant dans l’exécution sommaire de dix civils dans la localité de Kiseguru, en territoire de Rutshuru, au Nord-Kivu
claim_sources.translation_en: The Alliance Fleuve Congo-M23 (AFC-M23) rejected, on Thursday 4 June 2026, the accusations of the Armed Forces of the DRC (FARDC) implicating it in the summary execution of ten civilians in the locality of Kiseguru, in Rutshuru territory, North Kivu

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Dans une mise au point, le mouvement rebelle qualifie ces accusations d’« allégations mensongères, infondées et politiquement motivées ».
claim_sources.translation_en: In a clarification, the rebel movement describes these accusations as 'false, unfounded and politically motivated allegations'.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: le ministre de la Défense nationale et des Anciens combattants, Alain Tribert Mutabazi, a défendu le déploiement des troupes burundaises en RDC. Selon lui, cette présence s’inscrit dans un accord de coopération sécuritaire conclu entre Bujumbura et Kinshasa.
claim_sources.translation_en: the Minister of National Defence and Veterans, Alain Tribert Mutabazi, defended the deployment of Burundian troops in the DRC. According to him, this presence is part of a security cooperation agreement concluded between Bujumbura and Kinshasa.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Nyuma yuko M23 ifashe Uvira, Minisitiri w'ububanyi n'amahanga w'u Burundi Édouard Bizimana yavuze ko byabaye "gukubita urushyi mu maso
claim_sources.translation_en: After M23 took Uvira, the minister of foreign affairs of Burundi Édouard Bizimana said that it was a "slap in the face

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Yabwiye ibiro ntaramakuru AFP ati: "Gusinya amasezerano ubundi ntuyashyire mu bikorwa ni agasuzuguro kuri buri wese, mbere na mbere kuri Perezida Trump."
claim_sources.translation_en: He told the news agency AFP: "To sign agreements and then not implement them is contempt for everyone, first of all for President Trump."

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Minisitiri w'ububanyi n'amahanga w'u Burundi Édouard Bizimana yari yabwiye Radio RFI y'Abafaransa mbere y'ifatwa rya Uvira ko izo ngabo zahava gusa ari uko leta ya Kinshasa ibisabye kuko ari yo bagiranye amasezerano.
claim_sources.translation_en: Burundi's Minister of Foreign Affairs Édouard Bizimana had told the French radio RFI before the capture of Uvira that those troops would leave only if the Kinshasa government asked for it, because it is with it that they made the agreement.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ambasaderi w'u Rwanda muri ONU Martin Ngoga yavuze ko nta mugambi rufite wo gutera u Burundi. Mbere, M23 na yo yavuze ko nta mugambi nk'uwo ifite.
claim_sources.translation_en: Rwanda's ambassador to the UN Martin Ngoga said that it has no plan to attack Burundi. Earlier, M23 also said that it has no such plan.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ambasaderi w'u Rwanda muri ONU Martin Ngoga yavuze ko nta mugambi rufite wo gutera u Burundi. Mbere, M23 na yo yavuze ko nta mugambi nk'uwo ifite.
claim_sources.translation_en: Rwanda's ambassador to the UN Martin Ngoga said that it has no plan to attack Burundi. Earlier, M23 also said that it has no such plan.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le président burundais Évariste Ndayishimiye a salué vendredi l’engagement des forces de défense et de sécurité de son pays déployées en République démocratique du Congo, lors d’une émission publique organisée au stade Royal de Muramvya, dans la province de Gitega. Le chef de l’État burundais a félicité les forces burundaises engagées en RDC pour leur courage et leur engagement.
claim_sources.translation_en: Burundian President Évariste Ndayishimiye on Friday praised the commitment of the defence and security forces of his country deployed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, during a public broadcast organised at the Royal stadium in Muramvya, in Gitega province. The Burundian head of state congratulated the Burundian forces engaged in the DRC for their courage and commitment.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Face à cette situation, le futur président de l’Union africaine, Évariste Ndayishimiye, a interpellé les États-Unis d’Amérique, garants des accords de Washington signés entre Kinshasa et Kigali, afin qu’ils accentuent la pression sur les parties en vue du respect des différents engagements pris.
claim_sources.translation_en: Faced with this situation, the future president of the African Union, Évariste Ndayishimiye, called on the United States of America, guarantors of the Washington accords signed between Kinshasa and Kigali, to step up pressure on the parties with a view to respecting the various commitments made.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: L’AFC/M23 s'inquiète de l’attitude du président burundais et président entrant de l’Union africaine, attitude qui contribue à la persistance de violences ciblées contre les communautés banyamulenge.
claim_sources.translation_en: AFC/M23 is concerned about the attitude of the Burundian president and incoming president of the African Union, an attitude that contributes to the persistence of targeted violence against Banyamulenge communities.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Elle appelle, à ce titre, la communauté internationale ainsi que les institutions continentales à assumer pleinement leurs responsabilités, en exerçant une vigilance soutenue afin de prévenir toute escalade et d’éviter une aggravation des tensions ethniques et de la crise humanitaire dans la région" a réagi Corneille Nangaa, Coordonnateur du mouvement rebelle soutenu par le Rwanda
claim_sources.translation_en: It therefore calls on the international community and continental institutions to fully assume their responsibilities by exercising sustained vigilance in order to prevent any escalation and avoid a worsening of ethnic tensions and of the humanitarian crisis in the region," reacted Corneille Nangaa, Coordinator of the Rwanda-backed rebel movement

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les troupes de Kinshasa, soutenues notamment par les milices wazalendos et les effectifs de l'armée burundaise, ont été contraintes de rebrousser chemin alors qu'elles étaient à moins de deux kilomètres de l'aéroport de Minembwe.
claim_sources.translation_en: Kinshasa's troops, supported notably by the Wazalendo militias and by the Burundian army personnel, were forced to turn back when they were less than two kilometres from Minembwe airport.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Plusieurs témoignages venus des milieux rebelles congolais mais aussi des rangs burundais évoquent un nombre important de tués dans ces affrontements près de Minembwe. Tous les chiffres oscillent entre 100 et 150 Burundais en une matinée.
claim_sources.translation_en: Several testimonies from Congolese rebel circles but also from Burundian ranks mention a large number of dead in these clashes near Minembwe. All the figures range between 100 and 150 Burundians in one morning.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Depuis le début de l'intervention militaire burundaise en RDC, à la demande de Kinshasa, en 2022, aucun chiffre officiel "crédible" n'a été publié par Bujumbura.
claim_sources.translation_en: Since the start of the Burundian military intervention in the DRC, at Kinshasa's request, in 2022, no 'credible' official figure has been published by Bujumbura.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon Kagame, un contingent de plus de vingt mille soldats burundais opérerait actuellement dans plusieurs provinces, notamment Uvira, Minembwe, Kalemie, Kindu, Walikale et Kisangani. Il accuse également le Burundi de frappes régulières contre les civils, notamment à Minembwe, et déplore le silence de la communauté internationale.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to Kagame, a contingent of more than twenty thousand Burundian soldiers would currently be operating in several provinces, notably Uvira, Minembwe, Kalemie, Kindu, Walikale and Kisangani. He also accuses Burundi of regular strikes against civilians, notably at Minembwe, and laments the silence of the international community.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le président rwandais critique enfin le « réflexe systématique » d’accuser Kigali de tous les incidents dans l’Est congolais. Au moment de la publication, les autorités burundaises n’avaient pas réagi.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Rwandan president finally criticises the 'systematic reflex' of accusing Kigali for all incidents in eastern Congo. At the time of publication, the Burundian authorities had not reacted.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Igisirikare c’Uburundi nticigeze gitangaza amakuru nk’ayo kandi n’ibinyamakuru mpuzamakungu vyizewe ntibirigera bitangaza amakuru ku gitigiri c’ingabo Uburundi bufise, iziri hanze n’iziri mu gihugu.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Burundian army has never published such information, and reliable international media have never published information on the number of troops Burundi has, those abroad and those in the country.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Nk’akarorero urubuga rwiyita “Ukuri Kunywanisha Online TV” bavugako abategetsi mu gisirikare ca Congo bari muri Uvira hamwe n’abandi bategetsi hamwe n’abagwizatunga bariko bahungira mu Burundi mu gisagara ca Bujumbura.
claim_sources.translation_en: For example, a site calling itself "Ukuri Kunywanisha Online TV" says that Congolese military officials who were in Uvira, together with other officials and wealthy people, are fleeing to Burundi, to the city of Bujumbura.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Baravuga kandi ko mu makambi y’igisirikare c’Uburundi ari ku butaka bw’Uburundi ata basirikare bashika ibihumbi bitanu (5000) bahari kuko bose bari kugwana mu buseruko bwa Congo.
claim_sources.translation_en: They also say that in the Burundian army's camps on Burundian soil there are not even five thousand (5000) soldiers present, because all of them are fighting in eastern Congo.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yamaganye ibihano Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika zafatiye bamwe mu bayobozi bakuru b’Ingabo z’u Rwanda (RDF), ivuga ko bibogamye kandi bigamije kugaragaza isura ihabanye n’ukuri ku bibazo by’umutekano muke bimaze igihe mu Burasirazuba bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo (RDC). Ni mu itangazo Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yasohoye kuri uyu wa Mbere, tariki ya 2 Werurwe 2026
claim_sources.translation_en: The Government of Rwanda has rejected the sanctions that the United States of America imposed on some senior officers of the Rwanda Defence Force (RDF), saying they are biased and aimed at showing a picture contrary to the truth about the insecurity that has lasted a long time in the east of the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). This is in the statement that the Government of Rwanda issued on this Monday, 2 March 2026

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kuri uyu wa Mbere ni bwo Amerika yatangaje ko yafatiye ibihano abasirikare bakuru ba RDF barimo Maj Gen Vincent Nyakarundi, Maj. Gen Ruki Karusisi, Gen Mubarakh Muganga na Brig Gen Stanislas Gashugi.
claim_sources.translation_en: On this Monday America announced that it had imposed sanctions on senior RDF soldiers including Maj Gen Vincent Nyakarundi, Maj. Gen Ruki Karusisi, Gen Mubarakh Muganga and Brig Gen Stanislas Gashugi.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: U Rwanda rugaragaza ko Amerika yirengagije ibitero bya ‘drones’ n’ibyo ku butaka bikomeje kugabwa n’Ingabo za RDC, binyuranyije n’amasezerano yo guhagarika imirwano, kandi bigahitana ubuzima bw’abasivili benshi.
claim_sources.translation_en: Rwanda points out that America has ignored the drone attacks and ground attacks that DRC forces continue to carry out, contrary to the agreement to stop the fighting, and which kill many civilians.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi wa Guverinoma y’u Rwanda, Yolande Makolo, yagaragaje ko umuryango Human Rights Watch uharanira uburenganzira bw’ikiremwamuntu utavuze ku Rwanda, akazi kawo katagaragara. Ubutumwe bwa Makolo bwanyuze ku rubuga X kuri uyu wa 14 Gicurasi 2026, bugira buti “HRW ifite uburyo ikora kandi u Rwanda ruhora ari igipimo cyayo kigaragaza ko yakoze neza.”
claim_sources.translation_en: The spokesperson of the Government of Rwanda, Yolande Makolo, showed that the human rights organisation Human Rights Watch, if it does not speak about Rwanda, its work is not visible. Makolo's message on X on this 14 May 2026 reads: “HRW has its way of working and Rwanda is always its measure showing that it has worked well.”

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Makolo yanengaga raporo HRW yashyize hanze ku wa 13 Gicurasi, ishinja ingabo z’u Rwanda n’abarwanyi b’umutwe witwaje intwaro wa M23 kwica abasivili, kubashimuta no gufata ku ngufu abagore mu Mujyi wa Uvira, kuva tariki ya 10 Ukuboza 2025 kugeza ku ya 17 Mutarama 2026.
claim_sources.translation_en: Makolo was criticising the HRW report that it released on 13 May, accusing Rwandan soldiers and fighters of the armed group M23 of killing civilians, abducting them and raping women in the city of Uvira, from 10 December 2025 to 17 January 2026.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mu kiganiro yagiranye na televiziyo France 24 cyatangajwe ku wa mbere, Minisitiri w'ububanyi n'amahanga w'u Rwanda Olivier Nduhungirehe yibajije impamvu u Rwanda "rwonyine" ari rwo rufatirwa ibihano, mu gihe amasezerano y'amahoro – yayobowe n'Amerika yashyizweho umukono mu Kuboza (12) mu 2025 hagati ya Perezida w'u Rwanda Paul Kagame na Perezida wa DRC Félix Tshisekedi – areba impande zombi.
claim_sources.translation_en: In an interview with France 24 broadcast on Monday, Rwanda's Minister of Foreign Affairs Olivier Nduhungirehe wondered why Rwanda “alone” is the one being sanctioned, while the peace agreement – led by America, signed in December (12) in 2025 between Rwanda's President Paul Kagame and DRC President Félix Tshisekedi – concerns both sides.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Foreign Affairs Minister Olivier Nduhungirehe defended Rwanda against accusations over the conflict in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, saying the country should not be blamed for political and security problems that require Congolese solutions.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: « Ces bombardements ont causé plusieurs pertes en vies humaines et contraint de nombreux civils à fuir leurs habitations, provoquant ainsi de nouveaux déplacements forcés de populations », a déploré Lawrence Kanyuka, porte-parole de l’ AFC-M23.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: la coalition des forces du régime de Kinshasa, notamment les FARDC, FDLR, milices Wazalendo, mercenaires ainsi que la Force de Défense Nationale du Burundi, a déclenché des attaques généralisées et coordonnées sur l’ensemble des lignes de front, visant délibérément des zones densément peuplées au moyen d’artillerie lourde et de drones de combat” , a déclaré l’AFC-M23 dans un communiqué.
claim_sources.translation_en: the coalition of forces of the Kinshasa regime, notably the FARDC, FDLR, Wazalendo militias, mercenaries and the Burundian National Defence Force, launched generalised and coordinated attacks along all front lines, deliberately targeting densely populated areas with heavy artillery and combat drones,' the AFC-M23 said in a communiqué.

claim_sources.translation_en: The AFC-M23 accuses the Congolese army of having launched several attacks against its positions.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: “Axe Lubero : les villages de Kabesebese et Mutondi sont également sous le feu des attaques, qui se poursuivent activement.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: L’Alliance Fleuve Congo / Mouvement du 23 Mars (AFC/M23) a accusé les Forces armées de la République démocratique du Congo (FARDC) et leurs alliés Wazalendo d’être responsables de pillages, de violences ciblées et de la propagation de discours de haine à Uvira, dans l’est de la RDC.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Alliance Fleuve Congo / Mouvement du 23 Mars (AFC/M23) accused the Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (FARDC) and their Wazalendo allies of being responsible for looting, targeted violence and the spread of hate speech in Uvira, in eastern DRC.

claim_sources.translation_en: In a message published on the social network X, its spokesperson, Lawrence Kanyuka, says that these abuses particularly target Banyamulenge civilians

claim_sources.excerpt_original: De nouveaux combats ont été signalés dimanche 13 septembre 2026 dans plusieurs zones du Sud-Kivu et du Nord-Kivu entre l’AFC-M23 et l’armée congolaise, alliée aux Wazalendo.
claim_sources.translation_en: New fighting was reported on Sunday 13 September 2026 in several areas of South Kivu and North Kivu between the AFC-M23 and the Congolese army, allied to the Wazalendo.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Dans son communiqué, Lawrence Kanyuka, porte-parole de l’AFC-M23, accuse les forces coalisées de Kinshasa, les FDLR, les milices Wazalendo, des mercenaires étrangers ainsi que la Force de défense nationale du Burundi d’avoir intensifié leurs opérations sur plusieurs fronts.
