claim_sources.excerpt_original: Dans le territoire de Walikale, au Nord-Kivu, Lawrence Kanyuka affirme que les attaques ont débuté vers 14h00 contre Minjenje et Kibati. Il fait état d’opérations terrestres et aériennes, menées notamment avec des drones et de l’artillerie lourde.
claim_sources.translation_en: In Walikale territory, in North Kivu, Lawrence Kanyuka states that the attacks began around 14:00 against Minjenje and Kibati. He reports ground and air operations, carried out notably with drones and heavy artillery.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon Lawrence Kanyuka, porte-parole de l’AFC-M23, toute attaque recevra désormais une réponse proportionnée et les forces du mouvement éloigneront la menace au-delà de leurs positions de départ.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to Lawrence Kanyuka, spokesperson of the AFC-M23, any attack will now receive a proportionate response and the movement's forces will keep the threat away beyond their starting positions.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: L’ensemble du mois de mai 2026 a été marqué par une intensification préoccupante des offensives terrestres et aériennes menées par les forces coalisées du régime de Kinshasa contre des zones densément peuplées ainsi que contre nos positions sur plusieurs axes, notamment à Minembwe, Masisi, Numbi et Walikale”
claim_sources.translation_en: 'The whole of May 2026 was marked by a worrying intensification of land and air offensives carried out by the coalition forces of the Kinshasa regime against densely populated areas and against our positions on several axes, notably at Minembwe, Masisi, Numbi and Walikale'

claim_sources.excerpt_original: D’autres combats sont signalés sur l’axe Kibati et dans les zones environnantes, situées à la frontière des territoires de Walikale et de Masisi. L’AFC-M23 accuse l’armée congolaise d’avoir attaqué ses zones en utilisant de l’artillerie lourde.
claim_sources.translation_en: Other fighting is reported on the Kibati axis and in the surrounding areas, on the border of Walikale and Masisi territories. The AFC-M23 accuses the Congolese army of having attacked its areas using heavy artillery.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ibyo byatangajwe mu itangazo ryashyizwe kuri X na Laurence Kanyuka, Umuvugizi w’umutwe wa AFC/M23 mu bya politiki, ku itariki 5 Gashyantare 2024.
claim_sources.translation_en: This was announced in a statement posted on X by Laurence Kanyuka, spokesperson of the AFC/M23 movement for politics, on 5 February 2024.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: M23 yagize Bahati Musanga Joseph Guverineri wa Kivu y’Amajyaruguru, aho azungirizwa na Manzi Ngarambe Willy , wagizwe Visi-Guverineri ushinzwe ibijyanye na politiki, ubuyobozi, n’amategeko.
claim_sources.translation_en: M23 made Bahati Musanga Joseph Governor of North Kivu, assisted by Manzi Ngarambe Willy, made Vice-Governor in charge of politics, administration and legal matters.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Raporo ya HRW yatangajwe ku wa gatatu ishinja inyeshyamba za M23 kwica abasivile nibura 140 biganjemo Abahutu mu kwezi gushize
claim_sources.translation_en: The HRW report, published on Wednesday, accuses M23 rebels of killing at least 140 civilians, mostly Hutu, last month

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ariko M23 ivuga ko isanzwe yarahakanye ibi "birego bidafite ishingiro" mu nyandiko yayo yo ku itariki ya 7 y'uku kwezi kwa Kanama (8).
claim_sources.translation_en: But M23 says it had already rejected these 'unfounded allegations' in its document of 7 August (8).

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Itangazo rya M23, ryasohowe n'umuvugizi wayo Lawrence Kanyuka, rivuga ko ibi birego bya HRW na ONU bishingiye ku mpamvu za politike, ikanashinja iyi miryango kubogamira ku "butegetsi bw'abadashoboye na busa" bwa Kinshasa.
claim_sources.translation_en: The M23 statement, issued by its spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka, says these HRW and UN allegations are based on political motives, and accuses these organisations of bias towards the 'utterly incapable government' of Kinshasa.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: M23 yanzura ivuga ko iyi raporo ya HRW ari "ikinyoma no kugoreka ukuri", ikaba ari n'"igikoresho cy'icengezamatwara" cy'ubutegetsi bwa Kinshasa kigamije "guharabika AFC/M23 irwanira kubohora abantu bayo".
claim_sources.translation_en: M23 concludes by saying that this HRW report is a 'lie and distortion of the truth', and is also a 'propaganda tool' of Kinshasa's government aimed at 'discrediting AFC/M23, which is fighting to liberate its people'.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mbere, leta y'u Rwanda yahakanye ibyo birego bya ONU, ndetse mu itangazo ku wa gatatu yahaye ikiganiro Newshour cya BBC yavuze ko "RDF nta ho ihuriye" n'ibi bivugwa ko byagezweho mu iperereza rya HRW. Iryo tangazo rigira riti: "M23 ntabwo igenzurwa n'u Rwanda ndetse ibi bibazo bikwiye kuba ari bo [M23] bibazwa."
claim_sources.translation_en: Earlier, the Rwandan government rejected those UN allegations, and in a statement on Wednesday to BBC's Newshour it said that 'RDF has nothing to do with' what is alleged to have been found in the HRW investigation. The statement says: 'M23 is not controlled by Rwanda and these matters should be put to them [M23].'

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Dans un communiqué sur son compte X, Lawrence Kanyuka porte parole de l’AFC-M23 a accusé les FARDC d’attaques contre leurs positions. Il a indiqué qu’au moins trois civils ont été tués et 5 autres blessés lors d’une frappe des FARDC à Kamanyola.
claim_sources.translation_en: In a communiqué on his X account, Lawrence Kanyuka, spokesperson of the AFC-M23, accused the FARDC of attacks on their positions. He said that at least three civilians were killed and 5 others injured in a FARDC strike at Kamanyola.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: La 33ème région militaire des Forces armées congolaise basée à Uvira a affirmé avoir stopper les attaques des combattants de l’AFC-M23.
claim_sources.translation_en: The 33rd military region of the Congolese armed forces, based in Uvira, said it had stopped the attacks of the AFC-M23 fighters.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: “Comme si cela ne suffisait pas, ces ennemis de la paix ont également attaqué nos positions dans les localités de Rugezi et Ngungu à Minembwe dans les hauts plateaux de Fizi, à Kaziba en territoire de Walungu, à Kasika à Mwenga mais également à Civanga-Hombo en territoire de Kalehe”
claim_sources.translation_en: 'As if that were not enough, these enemies of peace also attacked our positions in the localities of Rugezi and Ngungu at Minembwe in the Fizi highlands, at Kaziba in Walungu territory, at Kasika in Mwenga, but also at Civanga-Hombo in Kalehe territory'

claim_sources.excerpt_original: a renchérit , Le porte-parole de la 33ème région militaire, Le Capitaine Sylvain Bijanu.
claim_sources.translation_en: added the spokesperson of the 33rd military region, Captain Sylvain Bijanu.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: De nouveaux affrontements ont été signalés mardi 7 avril 2026 dans la matinée entre les Forces armées de la République démocratique du Congo (FARDC) et les combattants de l’AFC/M23 dans plusieurs villages du Sud-Kivu.
claim_sources.translation_en: New clashes were reported on the morning of Tuesday 7 April 2026 between the Armed Forces of the DRC (FARDC) and AFC/M23 fighters in several villages of South Kivu.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ces combats touchent Mikenge, sur les hauts plateaux de Minembwe, et plusieurs villages du territoire de Kalehe, selon Lawrence Kanyuka, chef du département de communication de l’AFC/M23.
claim_sources.translation_en: This fighting affects Mikenge, on the Minembwe highlands, and several villages of Kalehe territory, according to Lawrence Kanyuka, head of the communication department of AFC/M23.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Dans une déclaration publiée sur son compte X, le porte-parole de l’AFC/M23 affirme que « le régime de Kinshasa, à travers ses forces coalisées, a déclenché des attaques généralisées sur plusieurs axes, visant des populations civiles ».
claim_sources.translation_en: In a statement published on his X account, the spokesperson of AFC/M23 says that 'the Kinshasa regime, through its coalition forces, has launched generalised attacks on several axes, targeting civilian populations'.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le mouvement ajoute que les attaques se sont étendues à partir de 6h50 aux localités de Lumbishi, Katale et Tushunguti, dans le territoire de Kalehe, où des zones civiles ont également été atteintes.
claim_sources.translation_en: The movement adds that the attacks spread from 06:50 to the localities of Lumbishi, Katale and Tushunguti, in Kalehe territory, where civilian areas were also hit.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Lawrence Kanyuka, porte-parole de l’AFC-M23, a confirmé cette présence, expliquant qu’elle est due à la présence continue des avions d’attaque des FARDC dans la région
claim_sources.translation_en: Lawrence Kanyuka, spokesperson of the AFC-M23, confirmed this presence, explaining that it is due to the continued presence of FARDC attack aircraft in the region

claim_sources.excerpt_original: « Contrairement à ce qui avait été indiqué dans le communiqué du dimanche 23 mars 2025, les FARDC et leurs forces coalisées n’ont pas retiré leurs drones d’attaque de Walikale. Cette situation retarde le repositionnement des forces de l’AFC/M23 dans la zone.
claim_sources.translation_en: 'Contrary to what was indicated in the communiqué of Sunday 23 March 2025, the FARDC and their coalition forces have not withdrawn their attack drones from Walikale. This situation delays the repositioning of AFC/M23 forces in the area.'

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Il convient de souligner que cet acte constitue un obstacle majeur au respect du cessez-le-feu et compromet ainsi les initiatives de paix en cours », a déclaré Kanyuka sur X ce lundi 24 mars.
claim_sources.translation_en: 'It should be stressed that this act constitutes a major obstacle to respect for the ceasefire and thus compromises the ongoing peace initiatives,' Kanyuka said on X this Monday 24 March.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Dans un communiqué signé par son porte-parole, Lawrence Kanyuka, le mouvement politico militaire cite plusieurs zones où auraient été observés « d’importants mouvements de troupes et de matériel militaire » , notamment Nzimbira, Mwenga, Bunyakiri, Kibuwa, Pinga et Uvira. L’AFC/M23 affirme que ces déploiements empruntent différents axes, dont Kindu–Shabunda, Kinshasa–Bujumbura, Kisangani–Walikale et Kalemie–Uvira.
claim_sources.translation_en: In a communiqué signed by its spokesperson, Lawrence Kanyuka, the politico-military movement cites several areas where 'significant movements of troops and military materiel' were allegedly observed, notably Nzimbira, Mwenga, Bunyakiri, Kibuwa, Pinga and Uvira. AFC/M23 says these deployments use various axes, including Kindu–Shabunda, Kinshasa–Bujumbura, Kisangani–Walikale and Kalemie–Uvira.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon le groupe armé, deux navires militaires transportant plus de 1 125 combattants des « forces coalisées du régime de Kinshasa » auraient accosté à Uvira dimanche 10 août en provenance de Kalemie.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to the armed group, two military ships carrying more than 1,125 fighters of the 'coalition forces of the Kinshasa regime' allegedly docked at Uvira on Sunday 10 August from Kalemie.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: L’Alliance Fleuve Congo (AFC/M23) a accusé lundi les autorités congolaises de poursuivre « des manœuvres militaires offensives »
claim_sources.translation_en: The Alliance Fleuve Congo (AFC/M23) on Monday accused the Congolese authorities of pursuing "offensive military manoeuvres"

claim_sources.excerpt_original: AFC/M23 mu itangazo ryasohowe n'umuvugizi wayo, Lawrence Kanyuka, yavuze ko ibyo bitero byabaye mu ijoro ryo ku Cyumweru tariki ya 24 Gicurasi 2026, ahagana saa yine z’ijoro.
claim_sources.translation_en: AFC/M23, in a statement issued by its spokesperson, Lawrence Kanyuka, said the attacks took place on the night of Sunday 24 May 2026, at about ten o'clock at night.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ku wa 24 Gicurasi 2026 ahagana saa yine z’ijoro, itsinda rinini ry’abarwanyi ba FDLR rifashijwe n’imitwe ya Wazalendo ryagabye igitero gikomeye kandi cyateguwe ku midugudu ya Malemo na Kalembe iri hagati ya Masisi na Walikale.
claim_sources.translation_en: On 24 May 2026 at about ten o'clock at night, a large group of FDLR fighters, assisted by Wazalendo groups, launched a major and planned attack on the villages of Malemo and Kalembe between Masisi and Walikale.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kanyuka yavuze ko muri Malemo abaturage barindwi bishwe, abandi batatu bagakomereka bikomeye. Muri Kalembe ho yavuze ko abandi bantu batatu bishwe, icyenda bagakomereka, ndetse hakanashimutwa umukuru w’umudugudu.
claim_sources.translation_en: Kanyuka said that in Malemo seven residents were killed and three others seriously injured. In Kalembe he said three other people were killed, nine injured, and a village chief was abducted.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Nk’uko byatangajwe na Lawrence Kanyuka, mbere yo kuva muri ako gace abo barwanyi banasahuye abaturage bo mu mudugudu wa Bweru, batwara inka 11 n’ingurube nyinshi.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to Lawrence Kanyuka, before leaving the area those fighters also looted residents of Bweru village, taking 11 cows and many pigs.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Lawrence Kanyuka, umuvugizi wa AFC/M23 ushinzwe ibya politiki, ni we watangaje aya makuru kuri X kuri uyu wa Kane tariki ya 10 Nzeri 2026.
claim_sources.translation_en: Lawrence Kanyuka, AFC/M23 spokesperson for politics, announced this on X on Thursday 10 September 2026.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Yavuze ko guhera saa 05:00, ingabo za Leta ya Kinshasa n’imitwe izifasha urugamba bakajije ibitero ku bice bituwe cyane biri ku nkengero za Masisi na Walikale. Mu duce yagaragaje harimo Ihula, Malemo, Minjenje, Kibati no mu nkengero zatwo.
claim_sources.translation_en: He said that from 05:00, Kinshasa government forces and groups assisting them intensified attacks on heavily populated areas on the edges of Masisi and Walikale. The areas he named included Ihula, Malemo, Minjenje, Kibati and their surroundings.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kanyuka kandi yavuze ko ahagana saa 07:00, izo ngabo zagabye igitero kuri Buhimba no mu nkengero zayo, muri Teritwari ya Masisi. Yavuze ko icyo gitero cyari kiyobowe n’ingabo zo ku butaka, zifashishije za mortier za milimetero 82 ndetse n’imbunda za mitrailleuse za milimetero 12,7.
claim_sources.translation_en: Kanyuka also said that at about 07:00 those forces attacked Buhimba and its surroundings, in Masisi territory. He said the attack was led by ground forces, using 82 mm mortars and 12.7 mm machine guns.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kanyuka yavuze ko imiryango itanga ubutabazi n’abakozi bayo bafite ingorane zo kugera ku baturage bugarijwe n’ingaruka z’imirwano, kubera umutekano muke uri mu bice byibasiwe.
claim_sources.translation_en: Kanyuka said that aid organisations and their staff have difficulty reaching residents hit by the effects of the fighting, because of the insecurity in the affected areas.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Abarwanyi ba AFC/M23 bongeye kugenzura agace ka Remeka gaherereye muri Teritwari ya Masisi, nyuma ya Operasiyo ya gikomando yakozwe n’abarwanyi b’uyu mutwe mu ijoro ryo ku wa Gatatu tariki ya 23 Nzeri 2026.
claim_sources.translation_en: AFC/M23 fighters regained control of the Remeka area in Masisi territory, after a commando operation carried out by this group's fighters on the night of Wednesday 23 September 2026.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ifatwa ryako kandi ryanemejwe na Guverineri wungirije w'Intara ya Kivu y'Amajyaruguru, Ngarambe Manzi Willy, mu butumwa yanyujije ku rubuga rwe rwa X.
claim_sources.translation_en: Its capture was also confirmed by the Deputy Governor of North Kivu Province, Ngarambe Manzi Willy, in a message he posted on his X account.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Amakuru yizewe agera kuri BWIZA avuga ko muri iryo joro abakomando ba AFC/M23 bagabye igitero
claim_sources.translation_en: Reliable information reaching BWIZA says that during that night AFC/M23 commandos launched an attack

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umutwe wa AFC/M23 biciye mu muvugizi wawo, Lawrence Kanyuka, watangaje ko igitero cyiciwemo bariya bantu cyabaye ku Cyumweru tariki ya 29 Werurwe saa 18:30, ubwo ihuriro ry'ingabo za Leta ya RDC zacengeraga muri Centre ituwe n'abaturage benshi ya Shanji.
claim_sources.translation_en: The AFC/M23 group, through its spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka, announced that the attack in which those people were killed took place on Sunday 29 March at 18:30, when the coalition of the DRC government's forces infiltrated the densely populated centre of Shanji.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Abishwe nk'uko AFC/M23 ibivuga, barimo Shadai Ndagije, Bisengi Mpenze, Gitinywa Etienne, Gashimye Hitimana, Daniel Hategeka, Ndayambaje Muhire na Iradukunda Nsanzumuhire. Igitero cyiciwemo aba bantu kandi cyanakomerekeyemo abandi barenga 20 nk'uko uriya mutwe ubivuga.
claim_sources.translation_en: Those killed, according to AFC/M23, include Shadai Ndagije, Bisengi Mpenze, Gitinywa Etienne, Gashimye Hitimana, Daniel Hategeka, Ndayambaje Muhire and Iradukunda Nsanzumuhire. The attack in which these people were killed also injured more than 20 others, according to that group.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umutwe wa AFC/M23 kuva ku wa Mbere tariki ya 23 Werurwe, watangiye kuvana ingabo zawo mu bice bitandukanye wagenzuraga byo muri Teritwari ya Lubero, mu ntara ya Kivu y'Amajyaruguru.
claim_sources.translation_en: Since Monday 23 March, the AFC/M23 group has begun withdrawing its troops from various areas it controlled in Lubero territory, in North Kivu province.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Uduce byamenyekanye ko uriya mutwe wamaze kuvanamo ingabo turimo Kipese, Munyakondomi, Ivatama, Ilambula, Luseke na Musimba.
claim_sources.translation_en: The areas known to have been vacated by that group include Kipese, Munyakondomi, Ivatama, Ilambula, Luseke and Musimba.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Amakuru aturuka imbere muri AFC/M23, avuga ko uriya mutwe wafashe icyemezo cyo kuvana ingabo zawo muri turiya duce wari umaze umwaka urenga ugenzura, nk'ingamba irema icyizere cy'uko ugishyize imbere "gukemuka amakimbirane yo mu burasirazuba bwa Congo Kinshasa mu mahoro".
claim_sources.translation_en: Information from inside AFC/M23 says that the group decided to withdraw its troops from those areas it had controlled for more than a year, as a measure creating confidence that it puts first 'resolving the conflict in eastern Congo Kinshasa peacefully'.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Nk'uko byatangajwe na AFC/M23 mu itangazo ry'Umuvugizi Lawrence Kanyuka, ngo ni igitero cyateguwe kandi gikoranwa ubugome ndengakamere.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to what AFC/M23 announced in a statement by spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka, it was an attack planned and carried out with extreme cruelty.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kuri iki Cyumweru, itariki ya 28 Kamena 2026, ahagana mu ma saa 1h00 ', ihuriro ry’ingabo z’ubutegetsi bwa Kinshasa zatwitse amazu menshi y’abasivili i Lumbishi nyuma yo kwishora mu busahuzi bwakozwe mu buryo bwateguwe."
claim_sources.translation_en: On this Sunday, 28 June 2026, at about 01:00, the coalition of forces of Kinshasa's government burned many civilian houses at Lumbishi after engaging in looting carried out in an organised manner.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Imiryango yose yatikiriye mu muriro muri iki gitero cyakoranwe ubugome burengeje urugero".
claim_sources.translation_en: Entire families perished in the fire in this attack carried out with excessive cruelty.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Dans un communiqué publié ce mardi 25 février 2025, l’AFC/M23 affirme que plusieurs villages de Minembwe, notamment Irundu et Nyarujoka, ont été la cible de bombardements.
claim_sources.translation_en: In a communiqué published this Tuesday 25 February 2025, the AFC/M23 says that several villages of Minembwe, notably Irundu and Nyarujoka, were targeted by bombardments.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: En parallèle, le M23 alerte sur une recrudescence des persécutions contre la communauté Banyamulenge dans la ville d’Uvira. Elle affirme que ces actes se traduisent par des arrestations arbitraires, des disparitions forcées et d’autres formes de répression.
claim_sources.translation_en: In parallel, the M23 warns of a surge in persecutions against the Banyamulenge community in the city of Uvira. It says these acts take the form of arbitrary arrests, enforced disappearances and other forms of repression.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Jusqu’à présent, les autorités congolaises n’ont pas officiellement réagi à ces accusations.
claim_sources.translation_en: So far, the Congolese authorities have not officially reacted to these accusations.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: « Le 25 février 2025, plusieurs villages de Minembwe, notamment Irundu et Nyarujoka, ont été bombardés
claim_sources.translation_en: "On 25 February 2025, several villages of Minembwe, notably Irundu and Nyarujoka, were bombed

claim_sources.excerpt_original: L’Alliance Fleuve Congo (AFC-M23) a déploré, dimanche 11 octobre 2026, des attaques généralisées des Forces armées congolaises et de leurs alliés, les accusant d’avoir intensifié les offensives contre les civils dans les provinces du Nord-Kivu et du Sud-Kivu.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Alliance Fleuve Congo (AFC-M23) deplored, on Sunday 11 October 2026, generalised attacks by the Congolese armed forces and their allies, accusing them of having intensified offensives against civilians in the provinces of North Kivu and South Kivu.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: « Le même dimanche, à 6 h 15, ces forces ont intensifié leurs offensives terrestres en direction de Kuwihene et de ses environs, sur l’axe de Rugezi, dans la région de Minembwe, en déployant en première ligne des éléments des FDLR, aux côtés de mercenaires étrangers.
claim_sources.translation_en: 'The same Sunday, at 6:15, these forces intensified their ground offensives towards Kuwihene and its surroundings, on the Rugezi axis, in the Minembwe region, deploying FDLR elements on the front line alongside foreign mercenaries.'

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ces attaques, menées au moyen d’assauts terrestres et de tirs d’armes lourdes, entraînent des pertes en vies humaines et provoquent des déplacements massifs de populations civiles », a déclaré Lawrence Kanyuka, porte-parole de l’AFC-M23.
claim_sources.translation_en: 'These attacks, carried out by ground assaults and heavy weapons fire, cause loss of life and provoke mass displacement of civilian populations,' said Lawrence Kanyuka, spokesperson of the AFC-M23.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les Forces armées de la République démocratique du Congo (FARDC) ont fermement rejeté les accusations du groupe armé MRDP-Twirwaneho, actif dans les Hauts plateaux de Fizi, qui affirme que des éléments des FDLR formés au Burundi auraient infiltré le pays pour commettre des massacres ciblés contre les populations banyamulenge.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (FARDC) firmly rejected the accusations of the armed group MRDP-Twirwaneho, active in the Fizi high plateaux, which claims that FDLR elements trained in Burundi had allegedly infiltrated the country to commit targeted massacres against Banyamulenge populations.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Dans un communiqué publié le 26 juillet, le général-major Sylvain Ekenge, porte-parole des FARDC, qualifie ces allégations de « non fondées » et les considère comme une tentative de manipulation visant à déstabiliser l’opinion publique et à saboter les efforts de paix en cours, notamment ceux des processus de Washington et de Doha.
claim_sources.translation_en: In a communiqué published on 26 July, Maj. Gen. Sylvain Ekenge, spokesperson of the FARDC, describes these allegations as 'unfounded' and considers them an attempt at manipulation aimed at destabilising public opinion and sabotaging the ongoing peace efforts, notably those of the Washington and Doha processes.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: A l’inverse, les FARDC affirment détenir des informations vérifiées sur un projet de massacre planifié à Minembwe (Sud-Kivu), impliquant le groupe Twirwaneho en collaboration avec Red Tabara, un autre groupe armé actif dans la région.
claim_sources.translation_en: Conversely, the FARDC say they hold verified information on a massacre project planned at Minembwe (South Kivu), involving the Twirwaneho group in collaboration with Red Tabara, another armed group active in the region.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ces violences surviennent alors que, jeudi , les rebelles du M23 ont pris le contrôle de Katogota , une localité située à environ 80 km au nord de la ville d'Uvira . Jusqu’à présent, le M23 n’a ni confirmé ni démenti sa présence à Katogota
claim_sources.translation_en: These acts of violence come as, on Thursday, M23 rebels took control of Katogota, a locality about 80 km north of the city of Uvira. So far, M23 has neither confirmed nor denied its presence at Katogota

claim_sources.excerpt_original: mais des vidéos circulant sur les réseaux sociaux depuis jeudi montrent des hommes armés affirmant appartenir au M23 dans cette zone.
claim_sources.translation_en: but videos circulating on social media since Thursday show armed men claiming to belong to M23 in this area.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: M23 claimed that the attack, which targeted their military positions in the Masisi territory on Jan. 2, was carried out by the Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of Congo (FARDC) and their allies. The rebel group said all the victims are civilians, a claim questioned by at least one expert

The administrator of the Masisi territory, Emmanuel Ndizeye, said during the ceremony that the area had been hit by “a series of bombings.” He specified that the bodies transferred to Goma came only from areas accessible by road.

Erasto Musanga, named as the governor of North Kivu by the M23 administration, accused Congolese President Félix Tshisekedi of being responsible for the violence. “Even as we speak, Tshisekedi is killing more people,” he said, threatening legal action through the M23's own justice system.
Patrick Muyaya, the spokesperson for the Congolese government, said in a post on X that Thursday's funeral was “the height of indecency and inhumanity.”

Dans la nuit du 21 au 22 octobre 2026, les forces coalisées du régime de Kinshasa ont intensifié leurs bombardements contre la zone densément peuplée de Rugezi, dans la région de Minembwe. Ces attaques ont été menées au moyen de drones kamikaze et de tirs a l'artillerie lourde. Les bombardements se poursuivent à l’heure actuelle.
claim_sources.translation_en: On the night of 21 to 22 October 2026, the coalition forces of the Kinshasa regime intensified their bombardments of the densely populated zone of Rugezi, in the Minembwe region. These attacks were carried out using kamikaze drones and heavy artillery fire. The bombardments are continuing at this time.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le régime de Kinshasa est entre dans une phase décisive de ses préparatifs militaires et se prépare à déclencher une offensive de grande envergure mobilisant simultanément des forces terrestres, des moyens aériens et de l’artillerie lourde. Il renforce des troupes et des équipements militaires à Luvungi et à Lubarika.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Kinshasa regime has entered a decisive phase of its military preparations and is preparing to launch a large-scale offensive simultaneously mobilising land forces, air assets and heavy artillery. It is reinforcing troops and military equipment at Luvungi and Lubarika.
