claim_sources.translation_en: Colonel Innocent Zimurinda, commander of the headquarters, has been sanctioned by the UN since December 2010, by the European Union since the same date, and by the United States since January 2013.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: le « général de brigade » Justin Gacheri Musanga (deuxième zone, couvrant Masisi et Walikale) et le « général » Innocent Byamungu (troisième zone, couvrant le Sud-Kivu).
claim_sources.translation_en: the 'brigadier general' Justin Gacheri Musanga (second zone, covering Masisi and Walikale) and the 'general' Innocent Byamungu (third zone, covering South Kivu).

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Operationally, Bwito and Bwisha chiefdoms fall under the AFC/M23 “First Defence Zone” command, led by “Brigadier General” Baudoin Ngaruye (CDi.019).
One RDF brigade operated within the “first defence zone” of AFC/M23, covering Goma, Nyiragongo, Binza, Bwito and Rutshuru, as well as Kanyabayonga, Kirumba and Kipese in Lubero

Another RDF brigade operated in the “second defence zone”, covering Masisi, Walikale, Bibwe and Kalembe, along the Pinga front line, as well as areas of South Kivu, including Walungu, Mwenga and Minembwe.
“Colonel” Gafishi Semikobe Simon, officially appointed AFC/M23 “Officer for Mobilisation and Recruitment” on 11 February 2025, also carried out responsibilities relating to the “security files”.
Au début du mois de décembre 2025, plus de 100 combattants maïmaï s’étaient rendu à l’AFC-M23 à Uvira, en présence du Général Byamungu Maheshe commandant adjoint de l’AF-CM23.
claim_sources.translation_en: At the beginning of December 2025, more than 100 Mai-Mai fighters had surrendered to the AFC-M23 in Uvira, in the presence of General Byamungu Maheshe, deputy commander of the AF-CM23.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le 25 septembre, des positions Wazalendo ont été visées dans les groupements de Kaniola et Kamisimibi. Le lendemain, le général Bernard Byamungu, numéro deux du mouvement, a tenu un meeting public à Nzibira.
claim_sources.translation_en: On 25 September, Wazalendo positions were targeted in the groupements of Kaniola and Kamisimibi. The next day, General Bernard Byamungu, number two of the movement, held a public meeting at Nzibira.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Goma, 24 mai 2026- Bernard Maheshe Byamungu, alias « Tiger One », l’un des principaux chefs militaires de la coalition AFC/M23-RDF, est décédé après avoir été blessé lors d’une frappe de drone, selon des sources proches de la rébellion.
claim_sources.translation_en: Goma, 24 May 2026- Bernard Maheshe Byamungu, alias 'Tiger One', one of the main military chiefs of the AFC/M23-RDF coalition, has died after being wounded in a drone strike, according to sources close to the rebellion.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le tribunal militaire de garnison de Beni (Nord-Kivu) a condamné à la peine capitale trois officiers des FARDC pour désertion et violation de consignes.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Beni garrison military tribunal (North Kivu) sentenced three FARDC officers to the death penalty for desertion and breach of orders.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Deux hommes se présentant comme des commandants Wazalendo ont, eux, écopé de vingt ans de prison pour avoir notamment recruté illégalement des militaires et diffusé de fausses informations.
claim_sources.translation_en: Two men presenting themselves as Wazalendo commanders, for their part, got twenty years in prison for having notably illegally recruited soldiers and spread false information.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le verdict est tombé vendredi 10 juillet soir, à l'issue d'un procès en flagrance.
claim_sources.translation_en: The verdict came on Friday 10 July in the evening, at the end of a flagrante delicto trial.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les militaires condamnés à la peine de mort sont deux lieutenants et un capitaine.
claim_sources.translation_en: The soldiers sentenced to death are two lieutenants and a captain.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon le tribunal, ils avaient été recrutés par un homme, qui se présentait comme coordonnateur du Comité national des patriotes, le CONAP, une structure qui prétendait de regrouper l'ensemble des groupes Wazalendo du pays.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to the court, they had been recruited by a man who presented himself as coordinator of the Comité national des patriotes, the CONAP, a structure which claimed to bring together all the Wazalendo groups of the country.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon la justice militaire, ils avaient mis en place, dans le quartier Malepe à Beni, un réseau clandestin de recrutement des civils et des militaires, en utilisant abusivement, et sans mandat officiel, le nom de la Réserve armée de la défense, la RAD.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to military justice, they had set up, in the Malepe quarter in Beni, a clandestine network recruiting civilians and soldiers, using abusively and without official mandate the name of the Armed Defence Reserve, the RAD.

claim_sources.translation_en: Armed clashes intensified in the territories of Fizi, Mwenga, Uvira, Kalehe and Shabunda, worsening humanitarian needs and the risks of new displacement.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les évaluations rapides multisectorielles réalisées en mars font état de plus de 542 200 personnes retournées à l’échelle provinciale, dont la majorité est concentrée dans le territoire d’Uvira.
claim_sources.translation_en: Rapid multisectoral assessments carried out in March report more than 542 200 returnees at provincial level, the majority concentrated in Uvira territory.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Une personne a perdu la vie et deux autres ont été blessées lors de l’effondrement du pont de Kavimvira, survenu mardi 16 juin sur la Route nationale n°5 (RN5), à Uvira, dans la province du Sud-Kivu, selon des sources sanitaires locales.
claim_sources.translation_en: One person died and two others were injured in the collapse of the Kavimvira bridge, which occurred on Tuesday 16 June on National Road No. 5 (RN5), in Uvira, in South Kivu province, according to local health sources.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Il y a eu trois blessés et parmi ces trois blessés, un a succombé à l’hôpital. Il s’agit d’un jeune garçon qui a reçu un coup à la tête et qui est décédé. Les deux autres présentent des blessures légères
claim_sources.translation_en: There were three injured and among these three injured, one died at the hospital. It is a young boy who received a blow to the head and died. The other two have minor injuries

claim_sources.excerpt_original: De son côté, la Nouvelle Société Civile Congolaise (NSCC) Sud-Sud affirme que ses enquêtes de terrain font état d’un bilan plus lourd. Dans un communiqué publié mardi dans la soirée, l’organisation évoque trois décès, dont deux mineurs âgés de 14 et 17 ans ainsi qu’un adulte, en plus d’une femme blessée.
claim_sources.translation_en: For its part, the Nouvelle Société Civile Congolaise (NSCC) Sud-Sud says its field investigations show a heavier toll. In a statement published Tuesday evening, the organisation reports three deaths, including two minors aged 14 and 17 and an adult, in addition to an injured woman.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Occupée pendant un mois par les rebelles de l’AFC/M23, la capitale provisoire du Sud-Kivu, en RDC, est restée un point de repli majeur pour les wazalendo. En quête de reconnaissance et d’influence, ces miliciens sont devenus aussi incontournables qu’encombrants.
claim_sources.translation_en: Occupied for a month by the AFC/M23 rebels, the provisional capital of South Kivu, in the DRC, has remained a major fallback point for the Wazalendo. Seeking recognition and influence, these militiamen have become as unavoidable as they are cumbersome.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les rebelles ont pour l’instant reculé, mais entre les wazalendos, alliés de circonstance de Kinshasa, et les équilibres régionaux qui se jouent à ses portes, Uvira vit sous tension permanente.
claim_sources.translation_en: The rebels have for now pulled back, but between the wazalendos, Kinshasa's allies of circumstance, and the regional balances at play at its gates, Uvira lives under permanent tension.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les forces armées congolaises et les groupes armés présents dans les Hauts Plateaux du Sud-Kivu entravent l’acheminement de l’aide humanitaire et empêchent les civils de fuir les combats dans l’est de la République démocratique du Congo , a déclaré aujourd’hui Human Rights Watch.
claim_sources.translation_en: Congolese armed forces and armed groups present in the Hauts Plateaux of South Kivu are obstructing the delivery of humanitarian aid and preventing civilians from fleeing the fighting in eastern DRC, Human Rights Watch said today.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: L’ONU a qualifié de « sévères » les restrictions humanitaires pesant sur l’accès aux Hauts Plateaux du Sud-Kivu, une zone couvrant certaines parties des territoires de Fizi, Mwenga et Uvira.
claim_sources.translation_en: The UN has described as 'severe' the humanitarian restrictions on access to the Hauts Plateaux of South Kivu, an area covering parts of the territories of Fizi, Mwenga and Uvira.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les territoires de Masisi, Rutshuru et Walikale au Nord-Kivu, ainsi que ceux d’Uvira, Fizi et Mwenga au Sud-Kivu, demeurent les plus touchés par les violences. Les combats ont entraîné le déplacement de milliers de civils, contraints de fuir leurs villages. Les destructions matérielles sont également importantes
claim_sources.translation_en: The territories of Masisi, Rutshuru and Walikale in North Kivu, as well as those of Uvira, Fizi and Mwenga in South Kivu, remain the most affected by violence. The fighting has displaced thousands of civilians, forced to flee their villages. Material destruction is also significant

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon des sources officielles locales, ces véhicules étaient restés cachés pendant près d’un an au Burundi, après la prise d’Uvira par les rebelles de l’AFC/M23.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to official local sources, these vehicles had remained hidden for nearly a year in Burundi, after the capture of Uvira by the AFC/M23 rebels.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le tribunal militaire garnison d’Uvira a condamné à la peine de mort 18 militaires du bataillon Simba, poursuivis pour lâcheté au front. Dans son réquisitoire, le ministère public avait requis la peine de mort contre l’ensemble des prévenus, accusés d’avoir fait preuve de lâcheté au front.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Uvira garrison military tribunal sentenced to death 18 soldiers of the Simba battalion, prosecuted for cowardice at the front. In its submissions, the public prosecutor had requested the death penalty against all the defendants, accused of having shown cowardice at the front.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Entre janvier et juin 2026, le BCNUDH a recensé 2 607 violations dans les provinces affectées par les conflits, concernant 5 032 victimes. Le Bureau relève la poursuite des hostilités et de l’expansion territoriale de l’AFC/M23. Malgré son retrait d’Uvira et de la plaine de la Ruzizi, des représailles, des déplacements de populations et une intensification des combats ont continué à être signalés dans les hauts plateaux.
claim_sources.translation_en: Between January and June 2026, the BCNUDH recorded 2 607 violations in the conflict-affected provinces, concerning 5 032 victims. The Office notes the continuation of hostilities and the territorial expansion of the AFC/M23. Despite its withdrawal from Uvira and the Ruzizi plain, reprisals, population displacement and an intensification of fighting continued to be reported in the highlands.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les activités socio-économiques sont restées largement paralysées ce mercredi 5 aout dans la ville d'Uvira, à la suite d'un appel à une journée ville morte lancé par les forces vives locales.
claim_sources.translation_en: Socio-economic activities remained largely paralysed this Wednesday 5 August in the city of Uvira, following a call for a ville morte day launched by the local forces vives.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: La situation est restée tendue vendredi 2 octobre, à Kabindula, siège de la chefferie de Bavira, dans le territoire d’Uvira (Sud-Kivu), après l’installation d’un nouveau chef de groupement à la tête de cette entité coutumière, rapportent des sources locales.
claim_sources.translation_en: The situation remained tense on Friday 2 October, at Kabindula, seat of the Bavira chiefdom, in Uvira territory (South Kivu), after the installation of a new groupement head at the head of this customary entity, local sources report.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: La cérémonie d’intronisation de Kabale Ghislain s’est déroulée sous haute protection. Il remplace Romain Lenge, qui assurait jusque-là l’intérim à la tête de la chefferie.
claim_sources.translation_en: The enthronement ceremony of Kabale Ghislain took place under heavy protection. He replaces Romain Lenge, who had until then been acting as head of the chiefdom.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Des manifestations ont été organisées pour protester contre cette installation. La police est intervenue pour disperser les manifestants
claim_sources.translation_en: Demonstrations were organised to protest against this installation. The police intervened to disperse the demonstrators

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Toutefois, des sources présentées comme fiables démentent ces informations. Dans la ville d’Uvira et ses environs, notamment à Kiliba, Kabunambo, Sange et Luvungi, les activités se sont déroulées normalement, selon un activiste des droits humains contacté dans la zone.
claim_sources.translation_en: However, sources presented as reliable deny this information. In the city of Uvira and its surroundings, notably at Kiliba, Kabunambo, Sange and Luvungi, activities took place normally, according to a human rights activist contacted in the area.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: des rumeurs largement relayées sur les réseaux sociaux ont fait état d’une avancée des troupes du Front pour la Refondation de la Nation (FRN) vers le village de Kawizi, situé à environ 10 kilomètres de la ville d’Uvira.
claim_sources.translation_en: rumours widely relayed on social networks reported an advance of the troops of the Front pour la Refondation de la Nation (FRN) towards the village of Kawizi, situated about 10 kilometres from the city of Uvira.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Des milliers d'habitants parmi elles des femmes et enfants fuyant les affrontements entre le RFN et l'armée appuyée par les Wazalendo sont arrivés depuis quelques jours à Rurambo dans les hauts plateaux d'Uvira dans la province du Sud-Kivu.
claim_sources.translation_en: Thousands of inhabitants, among them women and children, fleeing the clashes between the RFN and the army supported by the Wazalendo, arrived a few days ago at Rurambo in the Uvira highlands in South Kivu province.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Pendant ce temps à Kaziba, les structures locales indiquent avoir enregistré près de 12.000 ménages déplacés après 10 jours d'affrontements entre le RFN et l'armée Congolaise.
claim_sources.translation_en: Meanwhile at Kaziba, local structures say they have recorded nearly 12.000 displaced households after 10 days of clashes between the RFN and the Congolese army.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Parmi eux figure le général de brigade François Kamanzi, ancien commandant des opérations de la 12e région militaire dans la province du Congo central, qui a déserté les FARDC pour rejoindre le nouveau mouvement.
claim_sources.translation_en: Among them is brigadier general François Kamanzi, former commander of operations of the 12th military region in the province of Kongo Central, who deserted the FARDC to join the new movement.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Certains hauts officiers des Forces armées de la République démocratique du Congo (FARDC) rejoignent également le FRN.
claim_sources.translation_en: Some senior officers of the Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (FARDC) are also joining the FRN.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon des sources de la société civile contactées par Radio Maendeleo, plus de 2 500 ménages ont quitté Kaziba-centre et Kafindjo. Ils se sont dispersés dans la chefferie voisine de Ngweshe, toujours en territoire de Walungu, à Burhinyi et Luhwinja, dans le territoire de Mwenga, dans la chefferie de Bafuliru, en territoire d’Uvira, ainsi que dans la ville de Bukavu.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to civil society sources contacted by Radio Maendeleo, more than 2 500 households left Kaziba-centre and Kafindjo. They dispersed to the neighbouring chiefdom of Ngweshe, still in Walungu territory, to Burhinyi and Luhwinja, in Mwenga territory, to the Bafuliru chiefdom, in Uvira territory, as well as to the city of Bukavu.

claim_sources.translation_en: caused a massive displacement of the inhabitants of at least six villages. These are notably the localities of Loashi, Bukombo, Bonde, Nyabiondo, Burore, Kaanja, Bushani and Ngeshe, in North Kivu province.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ces habitants, dont plusieurs étaient déjà des déplacés, ont trouvé refuge au centre de santé de Kashebere, tandis que d'autres se sont dirigés vers Kibua et dans la brousse environnante, selon des notables locaux.
claim_sources.translation_en: These inhabitants, many of whom were already displaced, found refuge at the Kashebere health centre, while others went towards Kibua and the surrounding bush, according to local notables.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Cependant, les acteurs locaux déplorent l'absence d'aide humanitaire dans la région affectée par les combats, à l'exception de Médecins sans frontières (MSF), qui continue d'apporter son soutien à l'hôpital de Nyabiondo.
claim_sources.translation_en: However, local actors deplore the absence of humanitarian aid in the region affected by the fighting, with the exception of Médecins sans frontières (MSF), which continues to support the Nyabiondo hospital.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: La rébellion du M23 intensifie sa campagne de recrutement des jeunes au Nord-Kivu, pour le compte de ce qu’elle appelle armée révolutionnaire congolaise (ARC).
claim_sources.translation_en: The M23 rebellion is intensifying its campaign to recruit young people in North Kivu, on behalf of what it calls the Congolese revolutionary army (ARC).

claim_sources.excerpt_original: La campagne de recrutement a lieu également dans les territoires. Notamment dans le territoire de Nyiragongo, chefferie Bukumu, et dans la cité de Kitshanga, groupement Bukoma, en territoire de Rutshuru.
claim_sources.translation_en: The recruitment campaign also takes place in the territories. Notably in Nyiragongo territory, Bukumu chiefdom, and in the town of Kitshanga, Bukoma groupement, in Rutshuru territory.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Une structure dénommée comité de recrutement et de mobilisation est à pied d’œuvre à travers les quartiers de la ville de Goma et les localités des territoires de la province.
claim_sources.translation_en: A structure called the recruitment and mobilisation committee is at work across the neighbourhoods of the city of Goma and the localities of the province's territories.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Dans un communiqué publié ce lundi 28 avril, une organisation locale de défense des droits humains, qui a souhaité garder l’anonymat pour des raisons de sécurité,
claim_sources.translation_en: In a communiqué published this Monday 28 April, a local human rights organisation, which wished to remain anonymous for security reasons,

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon cette organisation, dont les propos sont corroborés par des sources administratives locales du secteur de Katoyi, au moins dix formes de violations des droits humains auraient été perpétrées par le groupe armé PARECO-FF, dirigé par le chef milicien Kigingi Jean de Dieu.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to this organisation, whose remarks are corroborated by local administrative sources of Katoyi sector, at least ten forms of human rights violations were reportedly committed by the PARECO-FF armed group, led by the militia chief Kigingi Jean de Dieu.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Parmi ces abus figurent l’instauration d’une administration fiscale et judiciaire parallèle imposée par cette milice dans le secteur de Katoyi. Le groupe, qui se revendique membre de la coalition VDP/Wazalendo, impose des taxes illégales dans tous les villages
claim_sources.translation_en: Among these abuses is the establishment of a parallel fiscal and judicial administration imposed by this militia in Katoyi sector. The group, which claims to belong to the VDP/Wazalendo coalition, imposes illegal taxes in all the villages

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Des centaines de familles déplacées, contraintes de fuir les récents affrontements entre les rebelles de l’AFC-M23 et les groupes armés Wazalendo, vivent dans des conditions alarmantes à Mweso dans le groupement Bashali Mokoto, territoire de Masisi (Nord-Kivu). Selon des sources locales, ces personnes hébergées dans des écoles et des églises, sont vulnérables et totalement dépourvues d’assistance humanitaire.
claim_sources.translation_en: Hundreds of displaced families, forced to flee the recent clashes between the AFC-M23 rebels and the Wazalendo armed groups, live in alarming conditions at Mweso in Bashali Mokoto groupement, Masisi territory (North Kivu). According to local sources, these people, housed in schools and churches, are vulnerable and totally without humanitarian assistance.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Un calme précaire s’observe ce lundi 26 octobre à Katobo, dans la localité de Banamulindwa (groupement Kisimba), dans le territoire de Walikale, au Nord-Kivu, après des affrontements ayant opposé les rebelles du FRN aux FARDC appuyées par les wazalendo sur la colline stratégique de Rushihe, qui surplombe le village de Katobo.
claim_sources.translation_en: A precarious calm is observed this Monday 26 October at Katobo, in the locality of Banamulindwa (Kisimba groupement), in Walikale territory, North Kivu, after clashes between the FRN rebels and the FARDC supported by the wazalendo on the strategic hill of Rushihe, which overlooks the village of Katobo.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ce nouveau drame intervient à peine un mois après une autre catastrophe survenue le 28 janvier 2026, sur le même site de Kasasa, où un éboulement avait coûté la vie à plus de 400 personnes, sans compter les disparus.
claim_sources.translation_en: This new tragedy comes barely a month after another disaster on 28 January 2026, on the same Kasasa site, where a landslide had cost the lives of more than 400 people, not counting the missing.

in 2025, the United Nations Organization Stabilization Mission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (MONUSCO) verified 1,534 cases of conflict-related sexual violence, an 86 per cent increase from 2024.

Cases included rape, gang rape, sexual slavery and forced marriage, often as a form of torture and apparent reprisal, accompanied by other forms of extreme physical violence, and affected 854 women, 672 girls, 4 men and 4 boys, with survivors as young as 1 year old.

Difenda Kasibandi, un des leaders des islamistes des Forces démocratiques alliées (ADF) a été éliminé lors d’une opération conjointe FARDC-UPDF à Asangwa, dans les périphéries de la rivière Lindi, à la limite entre les territoires de Lubero et de Mambasa, ont annoncé ce mardi 24 mars, les Forces Armées de la République Démocratique du Congo.
claim_sources.translation_en: Difenda Kasibandi, one of the leaders of the islamists of the Forces démocratiques alliées (ADF), was eliminated during a joint FARDC/UPDF operation at Asangwa, on the outskirts of the Lindi river, on the boundary between the Lubero and Mambasa territories, the Forces Armées de la République Démocratique du Congo announced this Tuesday 24 March.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: L’opération militaire a ciblé un groupe des islamistes conduits par le chef des ADF, Abouakas, l'un des principaux idéologues du mouvement qui a récemment dirigé des attaques sanglantes contre la population civile dans le secteur des Bapere (Lubero).
claim_sources.translation_en: The military operation targeted a group of islamists led by the ADF chief, Abouakas, one of the movement's main ideologues, who recently directed bloody attacks against the civilian population in the Bapere sector (Lubero).

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le lieutenant général autoproclamé Makanaki a souligné que cet acte constitue une agréable surprise et un réel réconfort pour les Wazalendo, « car cela touche directement leur cœur ».
claim_sources.translation_en: The self-proclaimed lieutenant general Makanaki stressed that this act is a pleasant surprise and a real comfort for the Wazalendo, 'because it touches their heart directly'.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: En avril 2025, le ministre de la Défense nationale avait annoncé à Uvira (Sud-Kivu) que les combattants locaux Wazalendo, qui appuyaient l’armée dans la défense de cette cité, dépendaient désormais exclusivement du coordonnateur national de la Réserve armée de défense (RAD), le général Padiri Bulenda.
claim_sources.translation_en: In April 2025, the national defence minister had announced in Uvira (South Kivu) that the local Wazalendo fighters, who supported the army in the defence of that city, now depended exclusively on the national coordinator of the Réserve armée de défense (RAD), General Padiri Bulenda.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umutwe wa Twirwaneho ukorera i Mulenge mu ntara ya Kivu y'Epfo watangaje ko ugenzura agace ka Minembwe n'inkengero zayo, kandi "ku nshuro ya mbere" wemeza ko wifatanyije na AFC/M23, nk'uko umwe mu bari i Minembwe abivuga.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Twirwaneho group, based in Mulenge in South Kivu province, announced that it controls the Minembwe area and its surroundings, and "for the first time" confirms that it has allied with AFC/M23, as one of those in Minembwe says.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: BBC yagerageje kuvugisha igisirikare n'uruhande rwa leta ku bivugwa na Twirwaneho n'abari i Minembwe ariko kugeza ubu ntibasubije ibibazo babajijwe.
claim_sources.translation_en: BBC tried to speak to the military and the government side about what Twirwaneho and those in Minembwe are saying, but so far they have not answered the questions they were asked.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Twirwaneho yafashe Point-Zéro mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa 16 Mutarama 2026, nyuma y’umunsi umwe ifashe ibindi by’ingenzi muri teritwari ya Fizi birimo umusozi wa Baruta, ikanahanura drone y’ihuriro ry’ingabo za Leta ya RDC.
claim_sources.translation_en: Twirwaneho took Point-Zéro on the morning of this 16 January 2026, a day after taking other key points in Fizi territory including Baruta hill, and shooting down a drone of the DRC state army coalition.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ubuyobozi bwa Twirwaneho bwatangaje ko ubwo ingabo za RDC, iz’u Burundi, Wazalendo na FDLR byari bimaze kwamburwa Point-Zéro, umusozi wa Baruta no ku Isumo, byahunze byerekeza mu gace ka Mulima na Mutambala.
claim_sources.translation_en: Twirwaneho's leadership announced that when the DRC, Burundian, Wazalendo and FDLR forces had been dispossessed of Point-Zéro, Baruta hill and Isumo, they fled toward the Mulima and Mutambala area.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Certaines femmes se livrent à la prostitution pour pouvoir nourrir leurs enfants, déplore une source parmi les réfugiés.
claim_sources.translation_en: Some women engage in prostitution in order to feed their children, laments a source among the refugees.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: La crise alimentaire entraîne également la dislocation de plusieurs familles.
claim_sources.translation_en: The food crisis is also causing several families to break apart.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: FFM imebaini mfumo wa matumizi yaliyoenea ya ukatili wa kijinsia, hasa ubakaji na ubakaji wa makundi dhidi ya wanawake na wasichana, na uporaji uliofanywa na wanachama wa FARDC na Wazalendo walipokuwa wakirudi kutoka mstari wa mbele mnamo mwezi Januari na Februari.
claim_sources.translation_en: The FFM identified a pattern of widespread use of sexual violence, especially rape and gang rape against women and girls, and looting carried out by FARDC and Wazalendo members as they were returning from the front line in January and February.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ripoti hii imeandaliwa na Ujumbe wa Kutafuta Ukweli (FFM) wa Ofisi ya Haki za Binadamu ya Umoja wa Mataifa, kwa agizo la Baraza la Haki za Binadamu la Umoja wa Mataifa.
claim_sources.translation_en: This report was prepared by the Fact-Finding Mission (FFM) of the United Nations Human Rights Office, at the request of the United Nations Human Rights Council.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Raia na wapiganaji wa zamani wa serikali walisajiliwa kwa nguvu. M23 ilitangaza kuwa ilikuwa imewapata wanachama wapya 7,000 kufikia mwezi Septemba.
claim_sources.translation_en: Civilians and former government fighters were registered by force. M23 announced that it had gained 7,000 new members by September.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mnamo Oktoba, kundi hilo lilianza kuteua mahakimu wake, lakini wadadisi walisema mfumo wa mahakama za waasi hao haukuwa na haki.
claim_sources.translation_en: In October, the group began appointing its own magistrates, but observers said the rebels' court system was not fair.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Inkambi z'impunzi zari ziri ku nkengero z'umujyi wa Goma zahoze zirimo abantu ibihumbi amagana ubu ni imbuga gusa nyuma y'ifatwa ry'uyu mujyi wigaruriwe n'abarwanyi ba M23.
claim_sources.translation_en: The displacement camps on the outskirts of Goma city, which used to hold hundreds of thousands of people, are now bare ground after the capture of the city taken over by M23 fighters.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umwe mu banyamakuru wigenga ukorera i Goma wasuye inkambi za Kanyaruchinya na Lushagara yabwiye BBC ko yasanze amahema hafi yose muri izi nkambi ari hasi.
claim_sources.translation_en: An independent journalist working in Goma who visited the Kanyaruchinya and Lushagara camps told BBC that he found almost all the tents in these camps down.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ntibizwi neza niba impunzi zari zisigaye muri izi nkambi zaratashye ku bushake cyangwa ku gahato.
claim_sources.translation_en: It is not clearly known whether the displaced people remaining in these camps went home voluntarily or by force.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Dany Kalume, umwe mu bagize sosiyete sivile ya Goma yabwiye BBC ko benshi mu bari batuye muri izi nkambi basubiye mu ngo zabo mu duce twa Rutshuru na Masisi tugenzurwa na M23, ko mu cyumweru gishize M23 yatanze imodoka zo gucyura abari basigaye muri zimwe muri izo nkambi.
claim_sources.translation_en: Dany Kalume, a member of Goma civil society, told BBC that many of those who lived in these camps returned to their homes in M23-controlled areas of Rutshuru and Masisi, and that last week M23 provided vehicles to take back those who remained in some of those camps.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Abatuye mu mujyi wa Goma no mu bice bihana imbibi mu burasirazuba bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo babyukiye mu myigaragambyo yamagana kuva mu mujyi wa Uvira kw’abarwanyi b’ihuriro AFC/M23. Iyi myigaragambyo yabaye mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa 22 Ukuboza 2025.
claim_sources.translation_en: Residents of Goma city and neighbouring areas in the east of the Democratic Republic of Congo woke up to a protest against the withdrawal of AFC/M23 fighters from the city of Uvira. This protest took place in the morning of 22 December 2025.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Tariki ya 17 n’iya 18 Ukuboza, abarwanyi ba AFC/M23 bavuye mu mujyi wa Uvira bari bamazemo icyumweru.
claim_sources.translation_en: On 17 and 18 December, AFC/M23 fighters left the city of Uvira where they had spent a week.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ikindi uyu muryango ugaragaza ni uko Ingabo za RDC n’abo bafatanyije bakoze ibikorwa byo guhohotera abantu, kwica, gufata ku ngufu no gufunga abantu bitemewe mu nkengero za Goma.
claim_sources.translation_en: Another thing this organisation shows is that the DRC army and those allied with it carried out acts of mistreating people, killing, rape and unlawful detention of people in the outskirts of Goma.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: AFC/M23 kandi yashinje ingabo za Leta ya RDC kugaba ibitero mu bice byo muri Teritwari ya Walungu mu Ntara ya Kivu y’Amajyepfo, birimo Nzibira, Kishadu na Chulwe ndetse na Katoyi muri Teritwari ya Masisi.
claim_sources.translation_en: AFC/M23 also accused the forces of the DRC government of launching attacks in areas of Walungu territory in the Province of South Kivu, including Nzibira, Kishadu and Chulwe, as well as Katoyi in Masisi territory.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Urubuga SOS Medias rw’Abarundi rwatangaje ko mu bitaro bya gisirikare bya Kamenge byonyine, bicumbikiye inkomere 87 z’abasirikare b’u Burundi.
claim_sources.translation_en: The SOS Medias website of the Burundians announced that in the Kamenge military hospital alone, 87 wounded Burundian soldiers were being housed.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Rien que ces derniers jours, plus d’une centaine de blessés ont été signalés, dont 87 admis à l’hôpital militaire de Kamenge, au nord de Bujumbura. Tandis que les autorités burundaises gardent le silence sur les pertes réelles
claim_sources.translation_en: Just in recent days, more than a hundred wounded have been reported, 87 of them admitted to the Kamenge military hospital, north of Bujumbura. While the Burundian authorities keep silent on the real losses

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le manque de lits oblige certains patients à partager le même couchage : « Les deux salles d’urgence sont pleines. Un seul lit peut accueillir jusqu’à trois patients », rapporte un autre journaliste.
claim_sources.translation_en: The lack of beds forces some patients to share the same bed: “The two emergency rooms are full. A single bed can accommodate up to three patients,” reports another journalist.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Izindi nkomere zoherejwe mu bindi bitaro birimo Tanganyika Care Polyclinic. Ibitaro byinshi by’i Bujumbura biracucitse cyane kubera iki kibazo, aho igitanda kiri guhuriraho abarwayi bagera kuri batatu.
claim_sources.translation_en: Other wounded were sent to other hospitals including Tanganyika Care Polyclinic. Many hospitals in Bujumbura are extremely overcrowded because of this problem, with one bed shared by up to three patients.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Igisirikare cy’u Burundi cyohereje ku mupaka abasirikare benshi kugira ngo bakire abahunga mu rwego rwo kubungabunga ituze. Abari kuva muri RDC bari kwamburwa intwaro mbere yo gukomereza aho bacumbika.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Burundian army sent many soldiers to the border to receive those fleeing in order to keep calm. Those coming from the DRC were being disarmed before continuing to where they are lodged.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Lt Col Minani yahoze mu ngabo za kera z'u Burundi (Ex FAB), akaba yarazamuwe mu ntera agahabwa ipeti rya Lieutenant Colonel muri Nyakanga uyu mwaka.
claim_sources.translation_en: Lt Col Minani was formerly in the old Burundian army (Ex FAB), and had been promoted to the rank of Lieutenant Colonel in July this year.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: The bilateral contingent, known as TAFOC, began operations in South Kivu in 2022 alongside Congolese forces against armed groups including RED Tabara, FOREBU, FNL and Twirwaneho.

In recent days, the group recruited 7,437 new fighters who had undergone six months of military training at the Rumangabo military base in North Kivu Province. These recruits include former FARDC soldiers as well as members of the Wazalendo coalition who joined M23 after capturing cities such as Goma and Bukavu.

Furthermore, the Congolese government and the M23 rebels are to begin direct talks on April 9, 2025 in Doha, the capital of Qatar, as part of ongoing efforts to restore peace. This meeting will mark the first direct negotiation between the two parties since the rebels took control of two provincial capitals in eastern Congo.

A meeting initially planned in Angola on March 18 was abruptly cancelled after the M23 withdrew in protest against the sanctions imposed by the European Union on its leaders. However, diplomatic efforts resumed following an unexpected meeting in mid-March between Congolese President Félix Tshisekedi and his counterpart Paul Kagame in Doha.
Komite yahawe Burugumesitiri wungirije, Katembo Isevisya wari mu buyobozi bwa teritwari ya Lubero, Radjabu Kwizera Elie agirwa Burugumesitiri wungirije wa Komini Karisimbi.
claim_sources.translation_en: The committee was given a deputy burgomaster, Katembo Isevisya who was in the leadership of Lubero territory, Radjabu Kwizera Elie is made deputy burgomaster of Karisimbi commune.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Intumwa za AFC/M23 zasubiye mu biganiro i Doha tariki ya 12 Ukuboza, ariko Leta ya RDC yanze koherezayo intumwa zayo, yinubira ko abarwanyi b’iri huriro bafashe umujyi wa Uvira tariki ya 9 Ukuboza.
claim_sources.translation_en: AFC/M23 delegates returned to the talks in Doha on 12 December, but the DRC government refused to send its delegates there, complaining that this alliance's fighters took Uvira city on 9 December.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Perezida w’Inama y’Abaminisitiri ya Togo akaba n’umuhuza washyizweho n’Umuryango wa Afurika Yunze Ubumwe (AU), Faure Essozimna Gnassingbé, yagiriye uruzinduko rw’amasaha make i Kinshasa tariki ya 22 Ukuboza, rwari rugamije kuganira ku ntambara yo mu burasirazuba bwa RDC.
claim_sources.translation_en: The President of the Council of Ministers of Togo and mediator appointed by the African Union (AU), Faure Essozimna Gnassingbé, made a visit of a few hours to Kinshasa on 22 December, aimed at discussing the war in eastern DRC.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Leta ya RDC ikomeje kugaba ibitero nyuma y’aho yo na AFC/M23 byumvikanye ko imirimo y’urwego mpuzamahanga ruzajya rugenzura iyubahirizwa ry’agahenge mu ntara ya Kivu y’Amajyaruguru na Kivu y’Amajyepfo, itangira vuba.
claim_sources.translation_en: The DRC government keeps launching attacks after it and AFC/M23 agreed that the work of the international body that will monitor compliance with the ceasefire in North Kivu and South Kivu province would start soon.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Amasezerano atangiza ibikorwa by’uru rwego yasinyiwe mu Busuwisi tariki ya 14 Mata, ubwo impande zombi zari zikomeje ibiganiro by’amahoro byibandaga ahanini ku korohereza abari mu bikorwa byo gutabara abagizweho ingaruka n’intambara.
claim_sources.translation_en: The agreement launching the activities of this body was signed in Switzerland on 14 April, while the two sides were continuing peace talks focused mainly on facilitating those carrying out relief for people affected by the war.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ibi bice bimaze gufatwa, abayobozi bakuru muri AFC/M23 barimo Bisimwa, Dr. Freddy Kaniki ushinzwe ubukungu n’imari muri iri huriro akanaba Perezida wa MRDP Twirwaneho n’Umugaba Mukuru wungirije wa M23, Brig Gen Bernard Byamungu, barabisuye.
claim_sources.translation_en: These areas having been taken, senior AFC/M23 leaders including Bisimwa, Dr. Freddy Kaniki, who is in charge of economy and finance in the alliance and is also President of MRDP Twirwaneho, and the Deputy Commander-in-Chief of M23, Brig Gen Bernard Byamungu, visited them.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Tariki ya 8 Nyakanga wari umunsi w’indirimbo z’amashimwe ku batuye muri Minembwe, ziherekejwe n’imbyino z’igisirimba.
claim_sources.translation_en: 8 July was a day of songs of thanksgiving for the residents of Minembwe, accompanied by igisirimba dances.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Guverineri Bahati yavuze ko abagize FDLR ari ibisambo by’inda mbi, byirirwa bishuka abaturage, bikabambura, bigasambanya abagore n’abakobwa ku gahato.
claim_sources.translation_en: Governor Bahati said FDLR members are greedy thieves who spend their days deceiving the residents, robbing them and raping women and girls by force.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Guverineri Bahati yavuze ko abagize FDLR ari ibisambo by’inda mbi, byirirwa bishuka abaturage, bikabambura, bigasambanya abagore n’abakobwa ku gahato. Ati “Ariya mabandi ntazigera agira igihugu nk’uko tugifite uku, icyo bashoboye ni ukujya batega ibico imodoka, bagasahura, abazirimo bakabica, ari na wo muvumo ubariho.”
claim_sources.translation_en: He said: "Those bandits will never have a country as we have ours; what they can do is to ambush vehicles, loot, and kill those inside, which is the curse on them."

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Raporo y’Umuryango w’Abibumbye igaragaza ko abarwanyi ba FDLR bafashwe, bagacyurwa mu Rwanda kuva AFC/M23 yafata umujyi wa Goma muri Mutarama 2025, ari benshi cyane ugereranyije n’abatashye mu gihe Leta ya RDC yahagenzuraga.
claim_sources.translation_en: A United Nations report shows that FDLR fighters captured and sent home to Rwanda since AFC/M23 took the city of Goma in January 2025 are very many compared to those who went home when the DRC government controlled the area.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ibihano Bisimwa yavugaga ni ibyo Loni iheruka gufatira Umuhuzabikorwa wa AFC/M23, Corneille Nangaa, Col Nzenze Imani ushinzwe iperereza n’ibikorwa bya gisirikare muri iri huriro na Brig Gen Charles Sematama uyobora umutwe wa Twirwaneho ukorera muri Komini Minembwe.
claim_sources.translation_en: The sanctions Bisimwa was talking about are those the UN recently imposed on the AFC/M23 Coordinator, Corneille Nangaa, Col Nzenze Imani, in charge of intelligence and military operations in the alliance, and Brig Gen Charles Sematama, who leads the Twirwaneho group operating in Minembwe commune.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Brig Gen Sematama we akazira kuyobora umutwe ushinjwa "kwica abasivili, kwinjiza abana mu gisirikare no kujya mu bikorwa bihungabanya amahoro n’umutekano by’abaturage."
claim_sources.translation_en: As for Brig Gen Sematama, he is penalised for leading a group accused of "killing civilians, recruiting children into the army and engaging in activities that disturb the peace and security of the population."

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kuva uwo munsi, abarwanyi ba M23 batangiye ibikorwa byo gushakisha abafite intwaro bari bacyihishe muri Bukavu no guhangana n’abasirikare bari bahungiye mu Majyepfo y’Uburasirazuba bw’uyu mujyi.
claim_sources.translation_en: From that day, M23 fighters began operations to search for armed people who were still hiding in Bukavu and to confront soldiers who had fled to the south-east of the city.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Tariki ya 16 Gashyantare 2025 ni bwo M23 yemeje ko yafashe Umujyi wa Bukavu, nyuma yo kwirukanamo abasirikare bo mu Ihuriro ry’ingabo za Leta ya RDC.
claim_sources.translation_en: On 16 February 2025 M23 confirmed that it had taken the city of Bukavu, after driving out soldiers of the alliance of the DRC government's forces.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kugeza ubu ibice AFC/M23 yamaze kubohora ibyinshi yabishyizemo abayobozi bayo bashya, barajwe ishinga no kwimakaza umutekano n’iterambere ry’abaturage.
claim_sources.translation_en: Up to now, in most of the areas AFC/M23 has already liberated, it has put its new leaders, who are committed to establishing security and the development of the people.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Tariki ya 2 Werurwe 2026, Amerika yafatiye ibihano ingabo z’u Rwanda n’abayobozi bazo, izishinja kurenga ku masezerano y’amahoro ya Washington.
claim_sources.translation_en: On 2 March 2026, America imposed sanctions on the Rwandan army and its officials, accusing them of violating the Washington peace agreement.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mu mujyi wa Uvira ni ho himukiye ibiro bya Guverineri w’intara washyizweho na Leta, Jean-Jacques Purusi, muri Gashyantare ubwo ihuriro AFC/M23 ryari rimaze gufata umujyi wa Bukavu.
claim_sources.translation_en: It is to the city of Uvira that the office of the government-appointed provincial Governor, Jean-Jacques Purusi, moved in February, when the AFC/M23 alliance had just taken the city of Bukavu.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kwa mujibu wa vyombo vya habari nchini DRC, taarifa iliyosainiwa na kiongozi wa wazalendo, Shukuru Bulenda, vikundi hivyo vilivyoasi ni pamoja na Mai-Mai Kabidon (FPP-AP), sehemu ya Mai-Mai Kifuafua na kikundi cha Nduma Defense of Congo-Renovated (NDC-R/M). Vikundi hivyo, vinadaiwa kujiunga na AFC/M23, juzi Machi 9, 2025.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to media in the DRC, a statement signed by the Wazalendo leader, Shukuru Bulenda, [says] the groups that defected include Mai-Mai Kabidon (FPP-AP), part of Mai-Mai Kifuafua and the Nduma Defense of Congo-Renovated (NDC-R/M) group. These groups are alleged to have joined AFC/M23 the day before yesterday, March 9, 2025.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Vurugu ziliongezeka tarehe 2 Mei katika eneo la Lubero, na kulazimisha takriban watu 30,000 kukimbia makazi yao, kwa mujibu wa ofisi ya Umoja wa Mataifa ya kuratibu misaada ya kibinadamu na masuala ya dharura OCHA
claim_sources.translation_en: Violence increased on 2 May in the Lubero area, forcing about 30,000 people to flee their homes, according to the United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs and emergencies OCHA

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Abategetsi bo mu nyeshyamba za M23 mu burasirazuba bwa Repubulika ya Demokarasi ya Congo (DRC) bavuga ko abantu barenga 200 bapfuye nyuma yuko ikirombe gicukurwamo amabuye y'agaciro gihirimye mu mujyi wa Rubaya ukungahaye ku mabuye y'agaciro.
claim_sources.translation_en: M23 authorities in the east of the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) say that more than 200 people died after a mine had collapsed in the mineral-rich town of Rubaya.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kwa mujibu wa vyombo vya habari nchini DRC, taarifa iliyosainiwa na kiongozi wa wazalendo, Shukuru Bulenda, vikundi hivyo vilivyoasi ni pamoja na Mai-Mai Kabidon (FPP-AP), sehemu ya Mai-Mai Kifuafua na kikundi cha Nduma Defense of Congo-Renovated (NDC-R/M). Vikundi hivyo, vinadaiwa kujiunga na AFC/M23, juzi Machi 9, 2025.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to media in the DRC, a statement signed by the Wazalendo leader, Shukuru Bulenda, the groups that defected include Mai-Mai Kabidon (FPP-AP), part of Mai-Mai Kifuafua and the group Nduma Defense of Congo-Renovated (NDC-R/M). Those groups are alleged to have joined AFC/M23, the day before yesterday, March 9, 2025.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ku wa kane uduce twa 'groupement' za Nyamaboko1 muri Masisi "twabaye isibaniro ry'imirwano iteye ubwoba" nk'uko Voltaire Batundi ukuriye sosiyete sivile ya Masisi yabibwiye BBC. Iyo mirwano yatangiye kuva mu gitondo imara hafi umunsi wose mu bice bitandukanye, yatumye abantu babarirwa mu bihumbi bava mu ngo zabo barahunga
claim_sources.translation_en: On Thursday the areas of the Nyamaboko1 groupements in Masisi "became the hotbed of terrifying fighting", as Voltaire Batundi, head of Masisi civil society, told the BBC. That fighting began in the morning and lasted almost all day in different areas, and made thousands of people leave their homes and flee

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Tarehe 25 Novemba ni Siku ya Kimataifa ya Kutokomeza Ukatili dhidi ya Wanawake. Nchini Jamhuri ya Kidemokrasia ya Kongo, mamia ya wanawake wa dhehebu la kikatoliki waliandamana Kivu Kusini kudai kukomeshwa ukatili huo.
claim_sources.translation_en: 25 November is the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, hundreds of Catholic women marched in South Kivu to demand an end to that violence.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Wanawake hao waliowakilisha parokia 44 za dayosisi kuu ya Bukavu, walifanya gwaride la amani kupinga unyanyasaji wa kidijitali na unyanyasaji wa kingono unaotumika kama silaha ya vita.
claim_sources.translation_en: Those women, who represented 44 parishes of the Bukavu archdiocese, held a peaceful march against digital harassment and sexual violence used as a weapon of war.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Kwa kuwa maandamano ya umma yamepigwa marufuku na watawala wapya wa jiji la Bukavu, gwaride hili liliandaliwa katika kiwanja cha kituo cha Olame, kikiwa mojawapo ya miundo ya dayosisi ya Bukavu.
claim_sources.translation_en: Because public demonstrations have been banned by the new rulers of Bukavu city, this march was held in the grounds of the Olame centre, one of the structures of the Bukavu diocese.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mashirika ya kiraia ya eneo hilo yanazungumzia kuhusu vifo vya watu wasiopunguwa saba wakiwemo raia watano na watu waliojeruhiwa wanaotibiwa katika vituo vya afya vya Kavumu. Wapiganaji hao wa Wazalendo walijaribu kuuteka uwanja wa ndege wa Kavumu kwa dakika chache kabla ya kutimuliwa kwa nguvu na vikosi vya M23.
claim_sources.translation_en: The local civil society organisations speak about the deaths of no fewer than seven people including five civilians and of wounded people being treated at the health facilities of Kavumu. Those Wazalendo fighters tried to capture Kavumu airport for a few minutes before being forced out by M23 forces.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: AFC/M23 ikigera ku Idjwi yabanje gutanga ikiganiro kuri radiyo yo kuri iki kirwa yitwa Obuguma mbere yo gukorana inama n’abaturage. Mustapha Maomboleo, umuyobozi wa teritwari ya Idjwi, yavuze ko icyo kiganiro cyari kigamije guhumuriza abatuye icyo kirwa.
claim_sources.translation_en: On arriving at Idjwi, AFC/M23 first gave a talk on the island's radio called Obuguma before holding a meeting with residents. Mustapha Maomboleo, head of Idjwi territory, said that the talk was meant to reassure the residents of the island.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Imirwano yatangiye ku wa kabiri igakomera ku wa gatatu yatumye abaturage bo muri utu duce bahungira mu byerekezo bitandukanye birimo kuri bimwe mu birwa byo mu kiyaga cya Kivu no ku kirwa kinini cya Idjwi, abandi berekeje mu majyepfo bagana i Bukavu, nk'uko umwe mu bagize sosiyete civile ya Kalehe yabibwiye BBC.
claim_sources.translation_en: The fighting that began on Tuesday and grew on Wednesday made people in these areas flee in various directions, including to some of the islands in Lake Kivu and to the large island of Idjwi, others heading south towards Bukavu, as one member of Kalehe civil society told BBC.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mu gitondo cyo ku Cyumweru tariki ya 13 Mata ni bwo abarwanyi ba Wazalendo bagabye ibitero mu gace ka Kavumu ko muri Teritwari ya Kabare, mu ntara ya Kivu y’Amajyepfo.
claim_sources.translation_en: On the morning of Sunday 13 April, Wazalendo fighters launched attacks in the Kavumu area in Kabare territory, South Kivu province.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Amashusho yakwirakwijwe ku mbuga nkoranyambaga yerekana izi nyeshyamba zari zifite amabendera ya RDC ziri muri Centre ya Kavumu ndetse zigana ku kibuga cy’indege cyo muri aka gace M23 yigaruriye mu mezi abiri ashize.
claim_sources.translation_en: Videos circulated on social media show these militias, carrying DRC flags, in Kavumu centre and heading towards the airport of this area that M23 took two months ago.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Amakuru avuga ko nyuma y’uko y’imirwano yamaze akanya gato M23 yahise yisubiza Kavumu yose. Ni imirwano amakuru agera ku bitangazamakuru bya BWIZA yemeza ko yiciwemo Wazalendo benshi, barimo n’uwari uyoboye igitero cyo ku Cyumweru.
claim_sources.translation_en: Information says that after a brief fight M23 immediately retook all of Kavumu. It is a fight in which information reaching the media of BWIZA confirms that many Wazalendo were killed, including the one who led the attack of Sunday.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Mu gace ka Nyangezi na Lurhala muri teritwari ya Walungu mu ntara ya Kivu y’Amajyepfo, imirwano yatangiye tariki ya 17 Kamena 2025, abaturage bashya ubwoba bitewe n’intwaro ziremereye zifashishijwe.
claim_sources.translation_en: In the Nyangezi and Lurhala area in Walungu territory in South Kivu province, fighting began on 17 June 2025, and residents were seized by fear because of the heavy weapons used.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Amakuru aturuka muri Nyangezi, mu bilometero bigera kuri 45 uvuye mu mujyi wa Bukavu, avuga ko mu gitondo cyo ku wa 18 Kamena, abaturage benshi bahunze santere yaho mu rwego rwo gukiza ubuzima bwabo.
claim_sources.translation_en: Information coming from Nyangezi, about 45 kilometres from Bukavu city, says that on the morning of 18 June many residents fled its trading centre in order to save their lives.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Umuturage yagize ati “Turi guhunga. Imirwano yatangiye ejo, igera muri Weza.
claim_sources.translation_en: A resident said: "We are fleeing. The fighting started yesterday and reached Weza.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Majira ya jioni, askari wa jeshi la Kongo waliziondoa familia kadhaa za Banyamulenge ambazo zilihofia usalama wao katika mji wa Uvira na kuwapeleka mahali salama.
claim_sources.translation_en: In the evening, Congolese army soldiers removed several Banyamulenge families who feared for their safety in the town of Uvira and took them to a safe place.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Uvira, 17 septembre 2026 — Douze militaires burundais auraient été tués par leurs propres camarades après avoir tenté de quitter leurs positions sur le front de Bijombo, dans le territoire d’Uvira, au Sud-Kivu.
claim_sources.translation_en: Twelve Burundian soldiers are said to have been killed by their own comrades after trying to leave their positions on the Bijombo front, in Uvira territory, South Kivu.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon The Great Lakes Eye , qui cite un colonel burundais s’exprimant sous couvert d’anonymat, les faits se seraient produits dans la nuit du 10 septembre à Kiliba Haut , dans le groupement de Kagando.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to The Great Lakes Eye, which cites a Burundian colonel speaking anonymously, the events are said to have occurred in the night of 10 September at Kiliba Haut, in Kagando groupement.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: La Force de défense nationale du Burundi (FDNB) n’a, à ce jour, publié aucun communiqué confirmant ou démentant ces informations.
claim_sources.translation_en: The Burundi National Defence Force (FDNB) has so far issued no communiqué confirming or denying this information.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Leta ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, yakupye internet mu mujyi wa Uvira uherereye mu ntara ya Kivu y'Amajyepfo, nyuma y'iminsi mike ingabo zayo ziwugarutsemo.
claim_sources.translation_en: The government of the Democratic Republic of Congo has cut the internet in the town of Uvira in South Kivu province, a few days after its forces returned to it.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Leta ya Congo Kinshasa ntacyo iratangaza ku makuru yo gukupa internet muri Uvira cyangwa ngo isobanure icyatumye ifata kiriya cyemezo. Amakuru icyakora avuga ko Perezida Félix Antoine Tshisekedi ari we watanze itegeko ry'uko internet ivanwaho.
claim_sources.translation_en: The government of Congo Kinshasa has not yet said anything about the news of cutting the internet in Uvira or explained why it took that decision. However, reports say President Félix Antoine Tshisekedi is the one who gave the order that the internet be removed.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Raporo y'Itsinda ry'Impuguke z'Umuryango w'Abibumbye kuri Congo, yashinje Gen (Rtd) James Kabarebe wahoze ari Umugaba Mukuru w'Ingabo z'u Rwanda kugira uruhare rukomeye mu ihuzwa ry'igitero cya AFC/M23 cyafashe umujyi wa Uvira mu ntara ya Kivu y'Amajyepfo.
claim_sources.translation_en: The report of the United Nations Group of Experts on Congo accused Gen (Rtd) James Kabarebe, former Chief of Staff of the Rwandan army, of a major role in coordinating the AFC/M23 attack that captured the town of Uvira in South Kivu province.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Iyo raporo ivuga ko igitero cyagabwe kuri Uvira cyari kiyobowe mu buryo butaziguye na ba Gen. Sultani Makenga na Bernard Byamungu, abayobozi ba gisirikare ba AFC/M23. Ariko yongeraho ko Gen (Rtd) Kabarebe "yagize uruhare rukomeye mu guhuza" icyo gikorwa cya gisirikare.
claim_sources.translation_en: The report says the attack launched on Uvira was directly led by Gens Sultani Makenga and Bernard Byamungu, military leaders of AFC/M23. But it adds that Gen (Rtd) Kabarebe 'played a major role in coordinating' that military operation.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le gouverneur du Sud-Kivu, Jean-Jacques Purusi, a regagné, ce vendredi 23 janvier 2026, la ville d’Uvira, siège provisoire des institutions provinciales, après le retrait des éléments de l’AFC-M23 qui occupaient la zone.
claim_sources.translation_en: The governor of South Kivu, Jean-Jacques Purusi, returned, this Friday 23 January 2026, to the city of Uvira, provisional seat of the provincial institutions, after the withdrawal of the AFC-M23 elements who occupied the area.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Pour rappel, Jean-Jacques Purusi, les membres de son gouvernement provincial ainsi que plusieurs animateurs des institutions du Sud-Kivu s’étaient repliés à Fizi-Baraka après la chute de la ville d’Uvira, le 10 décembre 2025.
claim_sources.translation_en: As a reminder, Jean-Jacques Purusi, the members of his provincial government and several officials of South Kivu institutions had fallen back to Fizi-Baraka after the fall of the city of Uvira on 10 December 2025.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Cette arrivée intervient quelques jours après le retrait des rebelles dans la ville occupée pendant quelques jours alors que l’autorité province a été contraint de prendre fuite pour Bujumbura,la capitale économique de la République du Burundi.
claim_sources.translation_en: This arrival comes a few days after the withdrawal of the rebels from the city, occupied for a few days, while the provincial authority had been forced to flee to Bujumbura, the economic capital of the Republic of Burundi.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon des témoignages concordants, les militaires burundais postés à Mikalati ont intercepté plusieurs groupes — des femmes, des hommes et des jeunes — qui tentaient de rejoindre le marché pour acheter des produits de première nécessité tels que le sel, le sucre ou le savon.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to concordant testimonies, the Burundian soldiers posted at Mikalati intercepted several groups — women, men and young people — who were trying to reach the market to buy basic necessities such as salt, sugar or soap.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Un porte-parole de la Force de Défense Nationale du Burundi (FDNB) n’était pas disponible pour répondre à ces allégations. Cependant, dans la plupart des cas, les autorités burundaises ont nié les accusations selon lesquelles l’armée burundaise et des membres de la ligue des jeunes du CNDD-FDD, le parti au pouvoir, qui les accompagnent parfois en RDC, malmèneraient les Banyamulenge.
claim_sources.translation_en: A spokesperson of the Burundi National Defence Force (FDNB) was not available to respond to these allegations. However, in most cases, the Burundian authorities have denied the accusations that the Burundian army and members of the youth league of the CNDD-FDD, the ruling party, who sometimes accompany them in the DRC, mistreat the Banyamulenge.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Ils veulent qu’on meure sans sel, ni sucre, ni huile », témoigne Espérance, une commerçante de Minembwe refoulée le week-end dernier.
claim_sources.translation_en: They want us to die without salt, or sugar, or oil », testifies Espérance, a trader from Minembwe turned back last weekend.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Comment vivre sans sel ni savon ? », déplore Éric M., un autre habitant.
claim_sources.translation_en: How to live without salt or soap? », laments Éric M., another inhabitant.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Le week-end dernier, plusieurs habitants de Minembwe, principalement issus de la communauté Banyamulenge, ont été refoulés par des soldats burundais alors qu’ils se rendaient au marché de Bijombo, dans le groupement du même nom, territoire de Fizi.
claim_sources.translation_en: Last weekend, several residents of Minembwe, mainly from the Banyamulenge community, were turned back by Burundian soldiers as they were on their way to the Bijombo market, in the groupement of the same name, Fizi territory.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: On 25 January 2025, the High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy issued a statement on behalf of the Union expressing its deep concern at the latest escalation of the conflict in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), as aggravated by the renewed offensive of the M23 armed group supported by the Rwanda Defence Force (RDF). (3) The RDF’s unauthorised presence in the DRC constitutes a violation of that country’s territorial integrity and sustains the armed conflict, instability and insecurity in the region.

Revenues from the illegal extraction and trafficking of natural resources from eastern DRC are being used to fund, inter alia, the M23 armed group and its operations, and are thereby contributing to the escalation of the conflict. (5) In view of the gravity of the situation in the DRC, nine persons and one entity should be added to the list of natural or legal persons, entities and bodies set out in Annex Ia to Regulation (EC) No 1183/2005.

Gasabo Gold Refinery Place of establishment: Kigali, Rwanda The Gasabo Gold Refinery, based in Kigali, began its refining activities on 1 June 2022 following the closure of Aldango Gold Refinery. The illegal extraction and trafficking of natural resources from eastern DRC, such as gold, contributes to the escalation of the conflict. The transit of gold through the only gold refinery in Rwanda, Gasabo Gold Refinery, contributes to the illicit export via Rwanda of illegally extracted gold.

Still more reported a militia-led policing force that has carried out arbitrary arrests and other abuses. “For three months, the state was completely absent in Uvira. An alternative was necessary to keep the city standing at the time, but there were abuses,” said a civil society activist. “People were whipped, arrested, some died in detention.”

For its part, the Congolese army has carried out raids in search of alleged M23 collaborators, mainly in hotels across the city. These operations have led to arbitrary arrests and contributed to a climate of fear, particularly among Banyamulenge.

Le 20 février, le cimetière de Musigiko, situé dans le territoire de Kabare au Sud-Kivu, a été le lieu d'inhumation de 18 personnes ayant perdu la vie lors des affrontements survenus lors de la prise de la ville de Bukavu par les rebelles du M23. Les corps, placés dans des sacs mortuaires, ont été déposés dans une fosse commune à Bukavu.
claim_sources.translation_en: On 20 February, the Musigiko cemetery, located in Kabare territory in South Kivu, was the place of burial of 18 people who lost their lives in the clashes during the capture of the city of Bukavu by the M23 rebels. The bodies, placed in body bags, were deposited in a mass grave in Bukavu.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: John Kashinzwe, secrétaire provincial de la Croix-Rouge au Sud-Kivu, a précisé que ces dépouilles avaient été récupérées dans divers endroits de la ville avant d'être inhumées. La Croix-Rouge, en collaboration avec le Comité international de la Croix-Rouge (CICR), avait précédemment annoncé avoir recueilli 26 corps dans différents quartiers de Bukavu après la prise de la ville par le M23.
claim_sources.translation_en: John Kashinzwe, provincial secretary of the Red Cross in South Kivu, specified that these remains had been recovered from various places in the city before being buried. The Red Cross, in collaboration with the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC), had previously announced having collected 26 bodies in different districts of Bukavu after the city was taken by the M23.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Selon des témoignages recueillis sur place, plusieurs habitants ont quitté leurs domiciles pour se réfugier vers les localités de Buhandahanda et de Nzinzi.
claim_sources.translation_en: According to testimonies gathered on site, several residents left their homes to take refuge in the localities of Buhandahanda and Nzinzi.

claim_sources.excerpt_original: Les familles disent craindre une dégradation de la situation après l’installation, samedi, d’un camp militaire attribué aux combattants de l’AFC/M23 dans le secteur.
claim_sources.translation_en: Families say they fear a worsening of the situation after the installation, on Saturday, of a military camp attributed to AFC/M23 fighters in the area.

sides: Journalist in Uvira, via BBC Gahuza: fighters reportedly in only two of 14 quarters that morning [r7-E-UV-034, note 2343]
Governor Purusi, 9 December: town held by government troops, M23 entry denied [r7-E-UV-035, note 2344]
AFC/M23 spokesperson: Uvira totally under M23 control [r1-UV-2025Q4-021, note 1338]
Witnesses, via SOS Médias Burundi: M23 columns entered several neighbourhoods at once [r4-G-UV-DEEP-004, note 1877]

discrepancies.title: Burundian army on the Minembwe roads: admitted closure, denied presence
sides: BBC Gahuza, 25 November 2025: the Burundian army admitted closing the roads [r7-E-FIZ-007, note 1991]
FDNB spokesperson to BBC, 12 November 2025: roads blocked, but not one Burundian soldier in Minembwe [r1-UC-BI-FDLR-036, note 1072]
FDNB communiqué, 26 November 2025: no FDNB soldier in the locality of Minembwe [r1-ST-BI-007, note 801]

discrepancies.title: Burundian part in the early August 2025 attacks south of Minembwe
sides: Twirwaneho spokesperson, 5 August, via Umuryango.rw: Burundian forces took no part in that day's attacks [r7-E-FIZ-021, note 2002]
MRDP-Twirwaneho communiqué, 6 August, via Kivu Morning Post: FARDC attacks with support of the FDLR and the Burundian army [r1-SKS-2025Q3-006, note 693]

discrepancies.title: When AFC/M23 left Uvira
sides: Rwanda's foreign minister: withdrawal began 16 December 2025, completed 17 January 2026 [r7-L-RW-004, note 2401]
Ebuteli: AFC/M23 withdrew from Uvira on 16 January 2026 [r1-UV-2026Q1-001, note 1356]
SOS Médias Burundi: last elements left 17-18 January 2026 [r1-UV-2026Q1-002, note 1357]

discrepancies.title: Toll, place and time of the Bukavu school fire of 10 September 2026
sides: Umuseke, crediting Radio Maendeleo: at least 27 bodies by 15:00 (provisional), fire in the morning, Buholo-Kasha, Bagira commune [r7-E-SKN-030, note 2293]
AFC/M23 communiqué via Bwiza: 24 children and students dead, fire after noon, Tshimpunda, Kadutu commune [r7-E-SKN-031, note 2294]
Actualite.cd: two schools in Kadutu commune, pupils killed, about twenty wounded [r1-ST-DRC-2026-004, note 837]

discrepancies.title: Who held Numbi, Shanje and Lumbishi after 6 October 2026
sides: Enquete.cd: FARDC with Wazalendo retook Numbi centre on 6 October [r1-SKN-2026Q4-005, note 644]
Bwiza: AFC/M23 retook Lumbishi, Shanje, Kavumu and Numbi a few hours after the Wazalendo took them [r7-E-SKN-026, note 2289]
Radio Maendeleo, 20 October: FRN troops retook Shanje, Lumbishi and Numbi in a later counter-offensive [r1-SKN-2026Q4-006, note 645]

discrepancies.title: Drone strike on Minembwe general hospital: date and side
sides: FARDC military sources via ACP/MediaCongo: drones from Rwanda hit the hospital on Wednesday 17 June 2026 [r7-L-M23-006, note 2380]
AFC/M23 spokesperson via Kivu Morning Post: Kinshasa coalition combat drones bombed the hospital on Wednesday 24 June 2026 [r1-SKS-2026Q2-016, note 765]

discrepancies.title: ADF attack of 15 January 2025 in Lubero: Muhangi about 30 dead or Makoko 10
sides: Radio Okapi, civil society: about thirty civilians killed at Muhangi (local sources: 32) [r1-NKN-2025H1-011, note 186]
DW Swahili: 10 killed in an ADF attack on Makoko village, Lubero [r7-E-NKN-011, note 2221]

discrepancies.title: Toll of the ADF attacks at Ngadi and Vemba, 30-31 May 2026
sides: Radio Okapi, citing Denis Mukwege: at least 16 killed at Ngadi and Vemba [r4-G-LOCAL-NK-009, note 1848]
Radio Moto Beni-Butembo: at least 7 killed at Ngadi (provisional) [r6-F-BENI-010, note 1911]
SOS Médias Burundi Swahili: about 17 civilians killed in several coordinated attacks [r7-E-NKN-013, note 2223]

discrepancies.title: Opening day of the Butembo trial of FARDC deserters
sides: BBC Swahili: trial opened on the day of its report, 25 February 2025 [r7-E-NKN-015, note 2225]
BBC Gahuza: trial began on Monday (24 February 2025) [r7-E-NKN-016, note 2226]

discrepancies.title: Date of the AFC/M23 reshuffle of Goma mayors
sides: Umuryango.rw: announcement of 9 April 2026 [r7-E-GOMA-014, note 2015]
Kivu Morning Post: 8 April 2026 [r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-009, note 1147]

discrepancies.title: Civilian toll of the Himbi drone strike, 11 March 2026
sides: Umuryango.rw (Rwandan outlet): three residents killed, DRC army drones [r7-E-GOMA-032, note 2030]
UN News citing MONUSCO: a French UNICEF employee killed in a drone attack on a building housing humanitarian workers; no three-death toll [r1-ATR-NK-2026-003, note 3]

discrepancies.title: Who died in the battle for Goma, and how many
sides: M23, via BBC Gahuza: more than 2,500 dead, all FARDC and Wazalendo [r7-E-GOMA-023, note 2022]
M23 spokesperson, citing an M23 report: only 874 fighters died in the fighting to take Goma [r7-E-GOMA-025, note 2024]
OCHA: at least 2,000 bodies buried, about 900 in morgues [r7-E-GOMA-024, note 2023]
Kinshasa (Muyaya): more than 2,000 bodies [r7-E-GOMA-026, note 2025]

discrepancies.title: Who killed a family of six at Kabizo (Rutshuru)
sides: FARDC 34th military region: AFC/M23 version is disinformation hiding RDF/AFC-M23 abuses [r7-L-DRC-014, note 2368]
AFC/M23: FDLR rebels acting with the FARDC [r7-L-DRC-015, note 2369]

discrepancies.title: Date of the drone strike that killed Twirwaneho leader Makanika
sides: UN Group of Experts: FARDC CH-4 drone strike on 15 February 2025 [r1-GOE-080, note 100]
Igihe, relaying Twirwaneho: died in a drone strike on 19 February 2025 [r7-E-IGIHE-167, note 2176]

discrepancies.title: Day Twirwaneho took Point-Zéro in January 2026
sides: SOS Médias Burundi: Friday 16 January 2026 [r1-SKS-2026Q1-002, note 736]
BBC Gahuza: after fighting on 14-15 January, known on 16 January [r7-E-FIZ-001, note 1985]
Igihe: 17 January 2026 [r7-E-IGIHE-186, note 2194]

discrepancies.title: Who carried out the Kabizo night attack of 25-26 October 2026
sides: Kivu Morning Post: the FRN-appointed administrator accused the Wazalendo of the CMC [r1-UCD-NK-FARDC-WZ-017, note 1182]
Igihe: the same administrator's account as relayed by Igihe (FDLR and Nyatura CMC/FDP) [r7-E-IGIHE-137, note 2148]

discrepancies.title: Who fired the explosions at Kamanyola on 2 December 2025 (two Igihe accounts)
sides: Igihe, citing a source close to AFC/M23: AFC/M23 fired [r7-E-IGIHE-046, note 2070]
Igihe: DRC and Burundian forces fired on Kamanyola [r7-E-IGIHE-047, note 2071]

discrepancies.title: What the plane shot down near Minembwe on 27 August 2026 was carrying
sides: Igihe: medicines and food [r7-E-IGIHE-021, note 2052]
Fizi administrator, per Igihe: came from Rwanda with soldiers, equipment and food [r7-E-IGIHE-027, note 2058]
Security sources: rebel resupply [r7-E-IGIHE-025, note 2056]

discrepancies.title: Whether Burundi ordered its troops home after the fall of Uvira
sides: Igihe: the army leadership ordered the troops home [r7-E-IGIHE-036, note 2062]
Burundi's foreign minister Bizimana: the troops cannot leave [r7-E-IGIHE-190, note 2198]

discrepancies.title: When Burundian troops left Uvira in December 2025
sides: Igihe: Burundian troops left Uvira on 8 December 2025 [r7-E-IGIHE-037, note 2063]
Burundian troops at the Gatumba border on 10 December [r1-UC-BI-FDLR-041, note 1077]
Burundi's ambassador denied the departure [r1-UC-BI-FDLR-042, note 1078]
Governor Purusi, 9 December: government troops still held Uvira [r7-E-UV-035, note 2344]

discrepancies.title: Civilian toll at Kamanyola, 2 December 2025
sides: AFC/M23: 3 civilians killed and 5 injured in a FARDC strike [r7-S2-M23A-013, note 2428]
SOS Médias Burundi: 5 wounded, no deaths [r1-SKC-2025H2-007, note 486]
Three children killed in central Kamanyola [r1-SKC-2025H2-001, note 480]

discrepancies.title: Toll at Shanje, 29 March 2026
sides: AFC/M23: more than 20 injured [r7-S2-M23A-021, note 2436]
15 wounded [r1-SKN-2026Q1-009, note 606]
9 killed and 20 wounded [r1-SKN-2026Q1-011, note 608]

discrepancies.title: Why AFC/M23 pulled fighters out of Lubero
sides: Bwiza, citing sources inside AFC/M23: a pull-out to build confidence [r7-S2-M23A-022, note 2437]
AFC/M23 governor Bahati: routine troop rotation; denies pulling fighters out [r7-S2-M23B-016, note 2458]

discrepancies.title: Who shelled Gisenyi/Rubavu
sides: Igihe: armed units including the FDLR [r7-E-IGIHE-019, note 2050]
OHCHR: cross-border shelling between the FARDC and the RDF [r2-G-DOC-HRC-059, note 1669]

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that FARDC brigadier general François Kamanzi, commander of operations of the 12th military region in Kongo-Central, had joined the Front pour la Refondation de la Nation (FRN) led by Joseph Kabila; FRN spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka said he joined the ranks of the 'Lions de Sarambwe' within the Armée révolutionnaire congolaise (ARC).
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le général de brigade François KAMANZI, commandant des opérations de la 12ᵉ Région militaire, au Kongo-Central, a rejoint le mouvement politico-militaire Front pour la Refondation de la Nation (FRN), dirigé par Joseph KABILA.
statements_all.translation_en: Brigadier general François KAMANZI, commander of operations of the 12th Military Region, in Kongo-Central, has joined the politico-military movement Front pour la Refondation de la Nation (FRN), led by Joseph KABILA.

statements_all.text: A Rwandan broadcaster's website reported that Rwandan Foreign Minister Olivier Nduhungirehe, speaking to AFP in Moscow on 28 October 2026, defended Rwanda against accusations over the conflict in eastern DRC, saying the country should not be blamed for political and security problems that require Congolese solutions; he said Rwanda must not be held as a scapegoat for what is happening in Congo forever, and rejected Kinshasa's description of former Congolese president Joseph Kabila as a Rwandan proxy.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Foreign Affairs Minister Olivier Nduhungirehe defended Rwanda against accusations over the conflict in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, saying the country should not be blamed for political and security problems that require Congolese solutions.

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that Fizi territory administrator Samy Badibanga said the surrenders concerned the zones of Mikenge-Minembwe, Mulima, Rugezi, Bikarakara and Kabandja, and that FRN fighters and their allies kept surrendering to the FARDC for protection, citing Twiraneho, AFC-M23, Red Tabara and FNL Zabampema among the allies.
statements_all.excerpt_original: D’après Samy Badibanga, ces redditions concernent notamment les zones de Mikenge-Minembwe, Mulima, Rugezi, Bikarakara et Kabandja. L’autorité territoriale affirme que les combattants du FRN et leurs alliés continuent de se rendre auprès des FARDC pour bénéficier de leur protection. Il cite notamment les groupes Twiraneho, AFC-M23, Red Tabara et FNL Zabampema parmi les alliés des éléments concernés.
statements_all.translation_en: According to Samy Badibanga, these surrenders concern in particular the zones of Mikenge-Minembwe, Mulima, Rugezi, Bikarakara and Kabandja. The territorial authority says FRN fighters and their allies continue to surrender to the FARDC to benefit from their protection. He cites the groups Twiraneho, AFC-M23, Red Tabara and FNL Zabampema among the allies of the elements concerned.

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that rumours of FRN fighters' presence at Kawizi, a locality about eight kilometres ("huit kilomètres") from Uvira city, were denied by local civil-society forces ("forces vives") and by the FARDC, who said the locality remained under their control.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Par ailleurs, des rumeurs faisant état d’une présence des combattants du FRN à Kawizi, localité située à environ huit kilomètres de la ville d’Uvira, ont été démenties par les forces vives locales ainsi que par les FARDC. Ces dernières assurent que cette agglomération demeure sous leur contrôle.
statements_all.translation_en: Moreover, rumours reporting a presence of FRN fighters at Kawizi, a locality situated about eight kilometres from the city of Uvira, were denied by the local forces vives as well as by the FARDC. The latter assure that this agglomeration remains under their control.

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that Captain Sylvain Bijanu, spokesperson of the 33rd military region, rejected the information about an FRN advance towards Uvira, and that Governor Jean-Jacques Purusi denounced a 'media war' by FRN fighters and called Uvira a 'fortress' protected by the FARDC and their allies.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le porte-parole de la 33ᵉ région militaire, le capitaine Sylvain Bijanu, a également rejeté les informations faisant état d’une progression du FRN vers Uvira.
statements_all.translation_en: The spokesperson of the 33rd military region, captain Sylvain Bijanu, also rejected the information reporting an advance of the FRN towards Uvira.

statements_all.text: The Rio Times reported that Congolese officials said the rebels had not advanced, and that Radio Okapi reported the army and the South Kivu governor call Uvira calm and secure.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Congolese officials say the rebels have not advanced, after a report by the Rwandan news site Taarifa on Tuesday 27 October 2026. Radio Okapi, a Congolese radio network, reported the same day that the army and the South Kivu governor call Uvira calm and secure.

statements_all.text: BBC Gahuza reported a statement by FRN spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka that Brigadier General François Kamanzi was head of operations in the 12th military region in Kongo-Central province and that two other senior soldiers also chose to join the FRN.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Itangazo ry'umuvugizi wa FRN Lawrence Kanyuka rivuga ko Général de Brigade François Kamanzi yari umukuru w'ibikorwa mu karere ka 12 ka gisirikare mu ngabo za DRC ko mu ntara ya Kongo-Central. Kanyuka yongeyeho ko abandi basirikare bakuru babiri na bo bahisemo kwifatanya na FRN
statements_all.translation_en: A statement by FRN spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka says that Général de Brigade François Kamanzi was head of operations in the 12th military region in the army of DRC, in the province of Kongo-Central. Kanyuka added that two other senior soldiers also chose to join FRN
