statements_all.text: Chimp Reports reported that FRN spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka confirmed on Tuesday, October 27, that Kamanzi, formerly operations commander of the FARDC 12th Military Region in Kongo Central, had joined the FRN's military wing; the outlet reported that Kinshasa had not publicly confirmed the reported defection.
statements_all.excerpt_original: FRN spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka confirmed on Tuesday, October 27, that Kamanzi, formerly operations commander of the Congolese Armed Forces (FARDC) 12th Military Region in Kongo Central, had joined the movement’s military wing.

statements_all.role: head of the communication and media department and spokesperson of the FRN
statements_all.setting: social-media post as reported (own X account)
statements_all.text: FRN spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka said in a post on his X account that Brigadier General François Kamanzi, commander of operations of the 12th military region in Kongo-Central, had joined the 'Lions de Sarambwe' within the Armée révolutionnaire congolaise (ARC), having chosen to break with the Kinshasa regime whose daily attacks, the post says, deliberately target civilian populations.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Nous confirmons qu’à ce jour, le général de brigade François KAMANZI, commandant des opérations de la 12ᵉ Région militaire au Kongo-Central, a rejoint les rangs des Lions de Sarambwe, au sein de l’Armée révolutionnaire congolaise (ARC). Ce haut gradé a choisi de rompre avec le régime de Kinshasa, dont les attaques quotidiennes prennent délibérément pour cible les populations civiles.
statements_all.translation_en: We confirm that, as of today, Brigadier General François KAMANZI, commander of operations of the 12th Military Region in Kongo-Central, has joined the ranks of the Lions de Sarambwe, within the Congolese Revolutionary Army (ARC). This senior officer chose to break with the Kinshasa regime, whose daily attacks deliberately target civilian populations.

statements_all.role: head of the communication and media department and spokesperson of the FRN
statements_all.setting: social-media post as reported (own X account)
statements_all.text: FRN spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka said in the same post that two other officers had also joined the FRN's ranks, that their identities would be made public in the coming days, and encouraged other FARDC members and all Congolese to join the FRN.
statements_all.excerpt_original: nous annonçons que deux autres officiers ont également rejoint nos rangs. Leurs identités seront rendues publiques dans les prochains jours. Nous encourageons les autres membres des FARDC, ainsi que l’ensemble des Congolais, à rejoindre le Front pour la Refondation de la Nation (FRN)
statements_all.translation_en: we announce that two other officers have also joined our ranks. Their identities will be made public in the coming days. We encourage the other members of the FARDC, as well as all Congolese, to join the Front pour la Refondation de la Nation (FRN)

statements_all.role: Minister of Higher and University Education
statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that Higher Education minister Marie-Thérèse Sombo, launching the 2026-2027 academic year in Kongo Central on Monday 26 October 2026, said the provisional suspension of academic activities at Goma and Bukavu institutions aims to protect students and staff, preserve the legality of university governance and prevent irregular academic acts from compromising the value of diplomas.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Alors que cette question continue de susciter des réactions, la ministre a rappelé les raisons de la suspension provisoire des activités académiques dans les établissements concernés. « Cette décision vise à protéger les étudiants et les personnels, à préserver la légalité de la gouvernance universitaire et à empêcher que des actes académiques irréguliers ne compromettent la valeur des diplômes.
statements_all.translation_en: While this issue continues to provoke reactions, the minister recalled the reasons for the provisional suspension of academic activities in the institutions concerned. 'This decision aims to protect students and staff, preserve the legality of university governance and prevent irregular academic acts from compromising the value of diplomas.

statements_all.text: Ouragan.cd reported that South Kivu governor Jean-Jacques Purusi said "Il n'y a aucun problème à Uvira", calling the rumours an enemy montage and use of a digital army to panic the population.
statements_all.excerpt_original: « Il n’y a aucun problème à Uvira. Il s’agit encore une fois d’un montage ennemi. Il s’agit de l’utilisation à outrance de son armée numérique pour essayer de faire paniquer la population.
statements_all.translation_en: « There is no problem in Uvira. It is once again an enemy montage. It is the excessive use of his digital army to try to make the population panic.

statements_all.text: Ouragan.cd reported that Purusi said that Minova, Katana, Kabamba, Bukavu and lately Uvira had 'fallen' through panic created on social networks, and that the M23 backed by Rwanda, 'today FRN', was trying to create panic.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Minova, Katana, Kabamba, Bukavu, et dernièrement Uvira, étaient tombées par cette panique qu’ils ont créée à travers des réseaux sociaux en disant que l’ennemi est en train de progresser »
statements_all.translation_en: Minova, Katana, Kabamba, Bukavu, and lately Uvira, had fallen through this panic that they created through social networks by saying that the enemy is advancing »

statements_all.text: Ouragan.cd reported that Purusi said the provincial government was about to receive the UN fact-finding mission on the human-rights situation in South and North Kivu.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Tout de suite, nous allons recevoir la mission d’enquête de l’ONU sur la situation des droits de l’homme au Sud et au Nord-Kivu »
statements_all.translation_en: Right away, we are going to receive the UN fact-finding mission on the human rights situation in South and North Kivu »

statements_all.role: deputy permanent representative to the United Nations
statements_all.setting: speech at the Security Council, as reported
statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that DRC deputy permanent representative to the UN Ambassador Jocelyne Kabengele Lukundulu said at the Security Council's 10,251st meeting, on the theme of children and conflicts, on 26 October that the situation on the ground remained worrying and that child protection must be integrated into the design of ceasefires, peace agreements and transitional justice mechanisms.
statements_all.excerpt_original: l’ambassadrice Jocelyne Kabengele Lukundulu, l’a indiqué lundi 26 octobre lors de la 10 251e séance du Conseil de sécurité avec comme thème « Les enfants et les conflits ». La diplomate congolaise a présenté les avancées de son pays en matière de protection des enfants et appelé à combattre l’impunité ainsi qu’à intégrer cette dimension dans les accords de paix.
statements_all.translation_en: the ambassador Jocelyne Kabengele Lukundulu said so on Monday 26 October at the 10 251st meeting of the Security Council on the theme "Children and conflicts". The Congolese diplomat presented her country's progress in child protection and called for combating impunity and for integrating this dimension into peace agreements.

statements_all.text: Bwiza (Rwanda) reported that 54 soldiers of the 3415th regiment of the FARDC began to be tried before the Goma Military Court, sitting specially in Walikale, from Monday 26 October, and that they are accused of offences including murder, abandoning their duties, wasting ammunition and military equipment, and refusing to obey orders; according to Major Dieudonné Kasereka, in charge of communications in the 34th military region, the soldiers were arrested on 20 October after the events at Ntoto, in the Waloa Loanda area.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Abasirikare 54 bo muri régiment ya 3415 y’Ingabo za Repubulika ya Demokarasi ya Congo (FARDC) batangiye kuburanishwa imbere y’Urukiko rwa Gisirikare rwa Goma, ruteraniye mu buryo bwihariye i Walikale, muri Kivu y’Amajyaruguru, kuva ku wa Mbere, itariki ya 26 Ukwakira.
statements_all.translation_en: 54 soldiers of the 3415th regiment of the Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of Congo (FARDC) began to be tried before the Goma Military Court, sitting specially in Walikale, in North Kivu, from Monday 26 October.

statements_all.text: Bwiza reported a communiqué of Lawrence Kanyuka, whom it called FRN spokesperson, saying that on Monday 26 October 2026 at about 4:00 a.m. the Kinshasa-backed forces attacked Mitimbili and Munanira in Kaziba chiefdom, Walungu territory, after attacks on Kuwihene, Rugezi and Point Zéro in the Minembwe area the previous night using kamikaze drones and 120mm and 82mm mortars.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Nk'uko bigaragara mu itangazo ryashyizwe ahagaraga n'Umuvugizi wa FRN, Lawrence Kanyuka, "mu ijoro ryo ku wa 25 rishyira ku wa 26 Ukwakira 2026, ingabo zifatanyije zishyigikiye ubutegetsi bwa Kinshasa zongereye ibitero zigaba Kuwihene, Rugezi, Point Zéro n’inkengero zaho mu karere ka Minembwe.
statements_all.translation_en: According to the communiqué published by the FRN spokesperson, Lawrence Kanyuka, 'in the night of 25 to 26 October 2026, the joint forces supporting the Kinshasa government increased attacks on Kuwihene, Rugezi, Point Zéro and surroundings in the Minembwe area.'

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that, according to local sources, the Wazalendo ambushed a convoy of FRN rebels heading to Kabizo to install a new commander, near Kabizo and Katovu, Rutshuru, with a provisional toll of three rebel fighters killed, per sources in the area.
statements_all.excerpt_original: D’après des sources locales, les wazalendo ont tendu une embuscade à un convoi des rebelles qui se dirigeait vers Kabizo pour y installer un nouveau commandant. Le bilan provisoire de cette attaque fait état de trois combattants rebelles tués, selon des sources dans la zone.
statements_all.translation_en: According to local sources, the wazalendo ambushed a convoy of the rebels that was heading to Kabizo to install a new commander. The provisional toll of this attack is three rebel fighters killed, according to sources in the area.

statements_all.setting: closed meeting with majority MPs as reported by parliamentary sources
statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that, according to parliamentary sources, head of state Félix Tshisekedi told members of parliament and senators of the presidential majority that the emergence of the FRN was in no way a surprise to him.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Selon des sources parlementaires, le chef de l'État a indiqué que l'émergence de cette nouvelle plateforme politico-militaire ne constituait nullement une surprise pour lui.
statements_all.translation_en: According to parliamentary sources, the head of state indicated that the emergence of this new political-military platform was in no way a surprise to him.

statements_all.text: The Kivu Morning Post reported that the FRN accused Kinshasa's forces on Thursday 22 October 2026 of preparing generalised attacks, saying the army bombarded the Rugezi zone in the Minembwe region, South Kivu, with kamikaze drones and heavy artillery in the night of 21 to 22 October.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Selon le FRN, l’armée a bombardé, dans la nuit du 21 au 22 octobre 2026, la zone de Rugezi, dans la région de Minembwe, au Sud-Kivu, à l’aide de drones kamikazes et d’artillerie lourde.
statements_all.translation_en: According to the FRN, the army bombarded, in the night of 21 to 22 October 2026, the Rugezi zone, in the Minembwe region, South Kivu, using kamikaze drones and heavy artillery.

statements_all.text: The Kivu Morning Post reported that the FRN communiqué also reported reinforcement of troops and military equipment at Luvungi and Lubarika and movements of Burundian troops crossing the Ruzizi river towards the Ruzizi plain, where, according to the communiqué, they would join other military elements.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le communiqué fait aussi état d’un renforcement des troupes et des équipements militaires à Luvungi et à Lubarika. Il signale par ailleurs des mouvements de troupes burundaises traversant la rivière Ruzizi en direction de la plaine de la Ruzizi, où elles rejoindraient d’autres éléments militaires.
statements_all.translation_en: The communiqué also reports a reinforcement of troops and military equipment at Luvungi and Lubarika. It also reports movements of Burundian troops crossing the Ruzizi river towards the Ruzizi plain, where they would join other military elements.

statements_all.role: head of the communication and media department and spokesperson of the Front pour la Refondation de la Nation (FRN)
statements_all.setting: social-media post as reported (own X account)
statements_all.text: FRN spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka said in a post on his X account that in the night of 21 to 22 October 2026 the coalition forces of the Kinshasa regime intensified their bombardments of the densely populated zone of Rugezi, in the Minembwe region, using kamikaze drones and heavy artillery fire, and that the bombardments were continuing.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Dans la nuit du 21 au 22 octobre 2026, les forces coalisées du régime de Kinshasa ont intensifié leurs bombardements contre la zone densément peuplée de Rugezi, dans la région de Minembwe. Ces attaques ont été menées au moyen de drones kamikaze et de tirs a l'artillerie lourde. Les bombardements se poursuivent à l’heure actuelle.
statements_all.translation_en: On the night of 21 to 22 October 2026, the coalition forces of the Kinshasa regime intensified their bombardments of the densely populated zone of Rugezi, in the Minembwe region. These attacks were carried out using kamikaze drones and heavy artillery fire. The bombardments are continuing at this time.

statements_all.role: head of the communication and media department and spokesperson of the Front pour la Refondation de la Nation (FRN)
statements_all.setting: social-media post as reported (own X account)
statements_all.text: FRN spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka said in a post on his X account that the Kinshasa regime had entered a decisive phase of its military preparations and was preparing a large-scale offensive mobilising land forces, air assets and heavy artillery simultaneously, reinforcing troops and military equipment at Luvungi and Lubarika.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le régime de Kinshasa est entre dans une phase décisive de ses préparatifs militaires et se prépare à déclencher une offensive de grande envergure mobilisant simultanément des forces terrestres, des moyens aériens et de l’artillerie lourde. Il renforce des troupes et des équipements militaires à Luvungi et à Lubarika.
statements_all.translation_en: The Kinshasa regime has entered a decisive phase of its military preparations and is preparing to launch a large-scale offensive simultaneously mobilising land forces, air assets and heavy artillery. It is reinforcing troops and military equipment at Luvungi and Lubarika.

statements_all.role: head of the communication and media department and spokesperson of the Front pour la Refondation de la Nation (FRN)
statements_all.setting: social-media post as reported (own X account)
statements_all.text: FRN spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka said in a post on his X account that there were movements of Burundian troops crossing the Ruzizi river towards the Ruzizi plain, joining other elements gathered at the established headquarters, and that foreign mercenaries were also part of the military set-up.
statements_all.excerpt_original: des mouvements de troupes Burundaises franchissant la rivière Ruzizi en direction de la plaine de la Ruzizi. Ces troupes rejoignent d’autres éléments regroupés au quartier général établi. Les mercenaires étrangers font aussi partie de ce dispositif militaire.
statements_all.translation_en: movements of Burundian troops crossing the Ruzizi river towards the Ruzizi plain. These troops are joining other elements gathered at the established headquarters. Foreign mercenaries are also part of this military set-up.

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that the vice-presidents of the Front pour la refondation de la nation (FRN), Corneille Nangaa and Bertrand Bisimwa, presented the FRN's organisation in Goma on Wednesday 21 October, and that Nangaa set out an institutional architecture of four organs including a Collège des fondateurs of 20 members and a Conseil de la révolution of five members.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Les vice-présidents du Front pour la refondation de la nation (FRN), Corneille Nangaa et Bertrand Bisimwa, ont présenté mercredi 21 octobre à Goma, dans l’est de la République démocratique du Congo (RDC), l’organisation et les orientations du FRN, nouveau mouvement politico-militaire dirigé par l’ancien président Joseph Kabila.
statements_all.translation_en: The vice-presidents of the Front pour la refondation de la nation (FRN), Corneille Nangaa and Bertrand Bisimwa, presented on Wednesday 21 October in Goma, in the east of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), the organisation and orientations of the FRN, a new politico-military movement led by former president Joseph Kabila.

statements_all.text: Sosoyamboka.net reported that, in a declaration published on Sunday 18 October, Congolese government spokesperson Patrick Muyaya denounced the creation of the FRN as a new label masking the actors in the crisis, and said: "Quelle que soit sa dénomination, ce groupe armé relooké est appelé à disparaître au terme du processus de Doha".
statements_all.excerpt_original: Dans une déclaration publiée dimanche 18 octobre, Patrick Muyaya a dénoncé la création de ce mouvement qu’il présente comme une nouvelle appellation destinée à masquer la nature des acteurs impliqués dans la crise sécuritaire dans l’Est de la République démocratique du Congo (RDC).
statements_all.translation_en: In a declaration published on Sunday 18 October, Patrick Muyaya denounced the creation of this movement, which he presents as a new name meant to mask the nature of the actors involved in the security crisis in eastern DRC.

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that government spokesperson Patrick Muyaya, after the creation of the FRN, said that the former head of state's choice to take up arms was an attack on the Republic and the constitutional order.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le porte-parole du gouvernement estime que le choix de l’ancien chef de l’État de prendre les armes constitue une attaque contre les institutions et l’ordre constitutionnel. « Le choix qu’il fait de prendre les armes, c’est de s’attaquer à la République et à l’ordre constitutionnel », affirme-t-il.
statements_all.translation_en: The government spokesperson considers that the former head of state's choice to take up arms constitutes an attack on the institutions and the constitutional order. "The choice he is making to take up arms is to attack the Republic and the constitutional order," he says.

statements_all.text: Agenzia Fides reported that the NGO ACMEJ, which had sent it a note on 23 October, said that during a speech at Kamanyola on 17 October a delegation of the FRN and of Rwanda reportedly told the civilian population of its intention to launch a new offensive against villages of the Ruzizi plain, highland areas and part of Mwenga territory, and that according to ACMEJ the objective would be to retake Uvira.
statements_all.excerpt_original: L’ACMEJ rapporte par ailleurs que, lors d’un discours prononcé à Kamanyola le 17 octobre, une délégation du FRN et du Rwanda aurait fait part à la population civile de son intention de lancer une nouvelle offensive contre les villages de la plaine de Ruzizi, les zones des hauts plateaux et une partie du territoire de Mwenga.
statements_all.translation_en: ACMEJ also reports that, during a speech delivered at Kamanyola on 17 October, a delegation of the FRN and of Rwanda reportedly informed the civilian population of its intention to launch a new offensive against the villages of the Ruzizi plain, the highland areas and part of Mwenga territory.

statements_all.role: spokesperson of FRN fighters in the Minembwe area
statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that the FRN accused government forces on Monday 19 October 2026 of having bombarded Rugezi and its surroundings in the Minembwe region between the evening of Saturday 17 and Sunday 18 October 2026; it also reported that Colonel Fidèle Rugabo, described as spokesperson of FRN fighters in the Minembwe area, said the populations of Rugezi and Gipimo were attacked during the night.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le Front pour la refondation de la nation (FRN) a accusé, lundi 19 octobre 2026, les forces gouvernementales d’avoir bombardé Rugezi et ses environs, dans la région de Minembwe. Ces attaques ont eu lieu entre la soirée du samedi 17 octobre et le dimanche 18 octobre 2026.
statements_all.translation_en: The Front pour la refondation de la nation (FRN) accused government forces, on Monday 19 October 2026, of having bombarded Rugezi and its surroundings in the Minembwe region. These attacks took place between the evening of Saturday 17 October and Sunday 18 October 2026.

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that FRN spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka said that from 01:00 on Friday 16 October 2026 the coalition forces of the Kinshasa regime were intensely bombarding Rugezi and its surroundings in the Minembwe region with heavy artillery and kamikaze drones.
statements_all.excerpt_original: « Depuis 1h00, ce vendredi 16 octobre 2026, les forces coalisées du régime de Kinshasa bombardent intensément Rugezi et ses environs, dans la région de Minembwe, à l’aide d’artillerie lourde et de drones kamikazes », a déclaré Lawrence Kanyuka, porte-parole du FRN.
statements_all.translation_en: "Since 01:00 this Friday 16 October 2026, the coalition forces of the Kinshasa regime are intensely bombarding Rugezi and its surroundings, in the Minembwe region, using heavy artillery and kamikaze drones," said Lawrence Kanyuka, FRN spokesperson.

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that FRN vice-president Bertrand Bisimwa, in a speech at Bukavu on Thursday, defended continued teaching in FRN-held zones despite measures by the Congolese government, and that the FRN promised to support teachers whose pay had been suspended by Kinshasa.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Dans un discours prononcé à Bukavu à cette occasion, Bertrand Bisimwa, vice-président du FRN, a défendu la continuité de l’enseignement dans ces zones, malgré les tensions politiques et les mesures prises par le gouvernement congolais.
statements_all.translation_en: In a speech delivered in Bukavu on this occasion, Bertrand Bisimwa, vice-president of the FRN, defended the continuity of teaching in these zones, despite the political tensions and the measures taken by the Congolese government.

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that FARDC spokesperson Major-General Sylvain Ekenge said that at the meeting chaired by President Tshisekedi the army chief of staff presented the operational situation and the commander-in-chief gave instructions to the defence and security forces.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Selon le porte-parole des FARDC, le général-major Sylvain Ekenge, après la présentation de la situation sur le terrain, le chef de l’État a donné des instructions précises aux forces de défense et de sécurité.
statements_all.translation_en: According to the FARDC spokesperson, Major-General Sylvain Ekenge, after the presentation of the situation on the ground, the head of state gave precise instructions to the defence and security forces.

statements_all.setting: statement as reported by SOS Médias Burundi
statements_all.text: SOS Médias Burundi reported that Twirwaneho spokesperson Fidèle Rugabo confirmed that AFC/M23 and Twirwaneho fighters had retaken control of Rubarati and Ruhuha (Bijombo highlands, Uvira territory); the outlet said this had not been independently confirmed when written.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le porte-parole du mouvement Twirwaneho, Fidèle Rugabo, a confirmé que les combattants de l’AFC/M23 et de Twirwaneho avaient repris le contrôle de Rubarati et de Ruhuha. Au moment de la rédaction de cet article, ces informations n’avaient toutefois pas fait l’objet d’une confirmation indépendante.
statements_all.translation_en: The spokesperson of the Twirwaneho movement, Fidèle Rugabo, confirmed that AFC/M23 and Twirwaneho fighters had retaken control of Rubarati and Ruhuha. At the time of writing, this information had however not been independently confirmed.

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that the Front pour la refondation de la nation (FRN), led by Joseph Kabila, announced in a political declaration dated 12 October in Goma that it ended the existence of the Alliance Fleuve Congo, which it 'succeeds by right', and aims to fight Kinshasa 'by all means including force'.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le Front pour la refondation de la nation (FRN), dirigé par Joseph Kabila, annonce mettre fin à l’existence de l’Alliance Fleuve Congo (AFC) et se donne pour mission de combattre le pouvoir de Kinshasa « par tous les moyens y compris la force », selon une déclaration politique datée du 12 octobre à Goma.
statements_all.translation_en: The Front for the Refoundation of the Nation (FRN), led by Joseph Kabila, announces it is ending the existence of the Alliance Fleuve Congo (AFC) and sets itself the mission of fighting Kinshasa's power "by all means including force", according to a political declaration dated 12 October in Goma.

statements_all.text: SOS Médias Burundi reported that Burundi accuses Rwanda of supporting RED-Tabara, that Burundian authorities identify Alexis Sinduhije, a former journalist and president of the opposition party MSD, currently in exile in Belgium, as the group's leader, and that Kigali rejects these accusations.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Burundi accuses Rwanda of supporting RED-Tabara. Burundian authorities identify Alexis Sinduhije, a former journalist and president of the opposition party Movement for Solidarity and Democracy (MSD), currently in exile in Belgium, as the group’s leader. Kigali rejects these accusations.

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that AFC-M23 said on Sunday 11 October 2026 that the Congolese armed forces and their allies had intensified offensives against civilians in North and South Kivu, and that, according to spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka, at 06:15 those forces intensified ground offensives towards Kuwihene on the Rugezi axis in the Minembwe region, with FDLR elements on the front line alongside foreign mercenaries, causing deaths and mass displacement of civilians.
statements_all.excerpt_original: L’Alliance Fleuve Congo (AFC-M23) a déploré, dimanche 11 octobre 2026, des attaques généralisées des Forces armées congolaises et de leurs alliés, les accusant d’avoir intensifié les offensives contre les civils dans les provinces du Nord-Kivu et du Sud-Kivu.
statements_all.translation_en: The Alliance Fleuve Congo (AFC-M23) deplored, on Sunday 11 October 2026, generalised attacks by the Congolese armed forces and their allies, accusing them of having intensified offensives against civilians in the provinces of North Kivu and South Kivu.

statements_all.text: According to Igihe, AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka said on 10 October 2026 that forces including those of the DRC, FDLR, Maï-Maï groups, foreign mercenaries and Burundian soldiers launched drone attacks on the night of 9 October 2026 ("saa yine z'ijoro", about 10 p.m.) on Point Zéro village and surroundings, and similar attacks later that night ("saa saba z'ijoro" of 9 into 10 October) at Rugezi and surroundings in Minembwe; he said the attacks on inhabited areas caused deaths and mass flight.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Kuri uyu wa 10 Ukwakira 2026, Umuvugizi wa AFC/M23, Lawrence Kanyuka, yatangaje ko izi ngabo zirimo iza RDC, FDLR, imitwe ya Maï-Maï, abacanshuro b’abanyamahanga ndetse n’abasirikare b’u Burundi.
statements_all.translation_en: On this 10 October 2026, AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka stated that these forces include those of the DRC, the FDLR, Maï-Maï groups, foreign mercenaries and Burundian soldiers.

statements_all.role: spokesperson of the ministry in charge of security (per SOS Médias Burundi)
statements_all.setting: press presentation of suspects, as reported
statements_all.text: SOS Médias Burundi reported that Burundian authorities presented 13 people to journalists on 9 October, a majority of them Banyamulenge refugees, whom the authorities accused of espionage for Rwanda and for armed groups active in eastern RDC; Pierre Nkurikiye said the suspects collaborated with armed groups active in the region, including the AFC/M23, Red-Tabara and Twirwaneho.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Les autorités burundaises ont présenté vendredi 9 octobre à des journalistes triés sur le volet 13 personnes, dont une majorité de réfugiés banyamulenge, accusées d’espionnage au profit du Rwanda et de groupes armés actifs dans l’est de la République démocratique du Congo (RDC).
statements_all.translation_en: Burundian authorities on Friday 9 October presented to hand-picked journalists 13 people, a majority of them Banyamulenge refugees, accused of espionage for Rwanda and for armed groups active in eastern DRC.

statements_all.role: spokesperson of the ministry in charge of security (per SOS Médias Burundi)
statements_all.setting: press presentation of suspects, as reported
statements_all.text: SOS Médias Burundi reported that, on the occasion of the presentation of the suspects, the spokesperson of the ministry in charge of security, Pierre Nkurikiye, called on Burundians to monitor the Banyamulenge and to stop renting houses to them.
statements_all.excerpt_original: À cette occasion, le porte-parole du ministère en charge de la Sécurité, Pierre Nkurikiye, a appelé les Burundais à surveiller les Banyamulenge et à ne plus leur louer de maisons.
statements_all.translation_en: On that occasion, the spokesperson of the ministry in charge of security, Pierre Nkurikiye, called on Burundians to monitor the Banyamulenge and to stop renting houses to them.

statements_all.text: MediaCongo reported that Rwandan President Paul Kagame reminded the African Union facilitators on Wednesday that Rwanda would maintain its posture as long as the root causes of the conflict are not resolved; the outlet wrote that by root causes he mainly alluded to the 'continuing presence' of the FDLR in eastern DRC, and that according to Kagame the FDLR represent a direct and existential security threat.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Selon Kagame, les FDLR, groupe armé fondé par des extrémistes hutus ayant fui le Rwanda après avoir participé au génocide des Tutsis en 1994, représentent une menace sécuritaire directe et existentielle.
statements_all.translation_en: According to Kagame, the FDLR, an armed group founded by Hutu extremists who fled Rwanda after taking part in the genocide of the Tutsis in 1994, represent a direct and existential security threat.

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that at a press conference in Goma on Wednesday 7 October 2026 the AFC/M23 accused the Congolese authorities of imposing a blockade on the people of Minembwe; Corneille Nangaa said they faced shortages of food, medicines and basic necessities and attributed the blockade to the Kinshasa regime and a coalition of FARDC, Burundian forces, FDLR, Wazalendo and mercenaries.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Selon le responsable de l’AFC/M23, les populations de Minembwe sont confrontées à des pénuries de nourriture, de médicaments et de produits de première nécessité, notamment d’eau, de sel, de savon, d’huile et de sucre.
statements_all.translation_en: According to the AFC/M23 official, the people of Minembwe are facing shortages of food, medicines and basic necessities, notably water, salt, soap, oil and sugar.

statements_all.text: Bwiza reported that, according to information announced by the AFC/M23 alliance, forces fighting for Kinshasa, chiefly FDLR members, began destruction at Shanje and its surroundings (Kalehe territory) on Wednesday 7 October 2026 from 'saa yine n'igice za mu gitondo', burning many civilian houses and the market; the AFC/M23 communiqué said further information on damage and casualties would be published later.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Amakuru atangazwa n’Ihuriro AFC/M23 aravuga ko amazu menshi y'abasivili yatwitse hamwe n'isoko ryaho,
statements_all.translation_en: Information announced by the AFC/M23 alliance says that many civilian houses were burned together with the local market,

statements_all.text: Umuryango.rw reported that AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka said in a message on 7 October 2026 that attacks by forces supporting the Kinshasa government, including FDLR fighters, in the Shanje area of Kalehe territory had destroyed civilian houses and the market, and that details of the damage and of any dead or wounded would be published later.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Ihuriro rya AFC/M23 rivuga ko ingabo zishyigikiye ubutegetsi bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, zirimo abarwanyi ba FDLR, zagabye ibitero mu bice bya Shanje no mu nkengero zaho, muri Teritwari ya Kalehe, Kivu y’Amajyepfo.
statements_all.translation_en: The AFC/M23 alliance says that the forces supporting the government of the Democratic Republic of Congo, including FDLR fighters, launched attacks in the Shanje area and its surroundings, in Kalehe territory, South Kivu.

statements_all.text: Top Africa News reported that African Union facilitators held closed-door talks with AFC/M23 leaders in Goma on Monday, meeting political coordinator Corneille Nangaa and his deputies Bertrand Bisimwa and Freddy Kaniki; AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka said the movement received the mission in the framework of efforts toward a political, durable and African-led resolution of the conflict, and no joint communiqué or concrete agreements were announced.
statements_all.excerpt_original: AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka said the movement received the mission in the framework of efforts toward a political, durable and African-led resolution of the conflict. No joint communiqué or concrete agreements were announced after the meeting.

statements_all.role: spokesperson of the South Kivu provincial government
statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that the South Kivu provincial government (Kinshasa-appointed), in a communiqué of Monday 5 October signed by its spokesperson Didier Kabi, expressed concern at the extension of the closing hours of two border posts controlled by the AFC/M23, Ruzizi 1er in Bukavu and Grande Barrière in Goma, saying it could facilitate the entry of new populations and their settlement in AFC/M23-controlled zones.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Dans un communiqué signé lundi 5 octobre par son porte-parole, Didier Kabi, le gouvernement provincial du Sud-Kivu se dit particulièrement préoccupé par cette décision.
statements_all.translation_en: In a communiqué signed on Monday 5 October by its spokesperson, Didier Kabi, the South Kivu provincial government says it is particularly concerned by this decision.

statements_all.text: Tic-Tac Hebdo reported that AFC/M23 North Kivu governor Bahati Musanga Erasto signed communiqué n°01/007/CAB/GP-NK/2026 of 2 October, setting the Grande Barrière border post at Goma to open daily from 5 a.m. to 2 a.m. the following day; the document was circulated by Lawrence Kanyuka.
statements_all.excerpt_original: À Goma, le communiqué officiel n°01/007/CAB/GP-NK/2026, daté du 2 octobre et signé par le gouverneur Bahati Musanga Erasto , fixe les nouveaux horaires de la Grande Barrière. La mesure entre en vigueur à compter de sa signature et prévoit une ouverture quotidienne de 5 h à 2 h du matin le lendemain, soit une plage de fonctionnement de 21 heures sur 24.
statements_all.translation_en: In Goma, official communiqué n°01/007/CAB/GP-NK/2026, dated 2 October and signed by governor Bahati Musanga Erasto, sets the new hours of the Grande Barrière. The measure takes effect on signature and provides for daily opening from 5 a.m. to 2 a.m. the next day, an operating window of 21 hours out of 24.

statements_all.role: Deputy High Commissioner for Human Rights
statements_all.setting: statement to the Human Rights Council
statements_all.text: UN News reported, in its account of an address by Deputy High Commissioner for Human Rights Awa Dabo to the UN Human Rights Council, that OHCHR documented at least 1.080 victims of conflict-related sexual violence across the country (a national figure) between June 2025 and May 2026, mainly women and children, that the real figures are probably much higher, and that armed groups were reportedly responsible for 74% of the victims recorded.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Entre juin 2025 et mai 2026, le HCDH a documenté au moins 1.080 victimes à travers le pays, principalement des femmes et des enfants.
statements_all.translation_en: Between June 2025 and May 2026, OHCHR documented at least 1.080 victims across the country, mainly women and children.

statements_all.role: Minister of the Interior, Public Security and Community Development
statements_all.setting: remarks to police officials as reported
statements_all.text: SOS Médias Burundi reported that Burundi's Minister of the Interior, Public Security and Community Development, Léonidas Ndaruzaniye, announced on Thursday that people from, or who merely transited through, eastern DRC zones controlled by the AFC-M23 would not be allowed to enter Burundi, and that he said 'Nous sommes les alliés de Kinshasa'.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le ministre de l’Intérieur, de la Sécurité publique et du Développement communautaire, Léonidas Ndaruzaniye, a annoncé jeudi que les personnes originaires de ces territoires, mais aussi celles qui y ont simplement transité, ne seront pas autorisées à entrer au Burundi.
statements_all.translation_en: The Minister of the Interior, Public Security and Community Development, Léonidas Ndaruzaniye, announced on Thursday that persons originating from these territories, but also those who have merely transited through them, will not be authorised to enter Burundi.

statements_all.text: MediaCongo reported that South Kivu governor Jean-Jacques Purusi said that preliminary estimates counted up to 49 mass graves identified in the Uvira sector and that more than 241 bodies had already been counted in three of them alone. This entry is dated by the article reporting the statement: the graves relate to killings during the earlier rebel occupation of the city (see actor), not to events of this quarter.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Selon le gouverneur Jean-Jacques Purusi, les estimations préliminaires recensent jusqu'à 49 fosses communes identifiées dans le secteur d'Uvira. « Rien que dans trois de ces fosses communes, nous comptabilisons déjà plus de 241 corps », a précisé le chef de l'exécutif provincial.
statements_all.translation_en: According to governor Jean-Jacques Purusi, preliminary estimates count up to 49 mass graves identified in the Uvira sector. "In just three of these mass graves we already count more than 241 bodies", the head of the provincial executive specified.

statements_all.text: BBC News Gahuza reported that FDNB spokesperson Brigadier General Gaspard Baratuza confirmed that two Burundian soldiers, Major Jérémie Nitunga and Captain Félicien Kanjori, were arrested in the DRC, but denied they were held in Kinshasa.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi w’igisirikare c’Uburundi, Général de Brigade Gaspard Baratuza, yemeje ko Major Jérémie Nitunga na Capitaine Félicien Kanjori , abasirikare babiri b’uburundi, bafatiwe muri Repubulika ya Demokarasi ya Congo, ariko ahakana ko bapfungiwe i Kinshasa.
statements_all.translation_en: The spokesman of the Burundian army, Brigadier General Gaspard Baratuza, confirmed that Major Jérémie Nitunga and Captain Félicien Kanjori, two Burundian soldiers, were arrested in the Democratic Republic of Congo, but denied that they are detained in Kinshasa.

statements_all.text: UN News reported, in its own account around a Security Council meeting, that fighting continued in the highlands of Mwenga, Fizi and Uvira in South Kivu, causing new displacement and hindering aid delivery, and that the first two missions of the ceasefire verification mechanism had gone to Minembwe (South Kivu) and then Masisi (North Kivu).
statements_all.excerpt_original: Au Sud-Kivu, les affrontements se poursuivent dans les hauts plateaux de Mwenga, Fizi et Uvira, provoquant de nouveaux déplacements et entravant l’acheminement de l’aide.
statements_all.translation_en: In South Kivu, fighting continues in the highlands of Mwenga, Fizi and Uvira, causing new displacement and hindering the delivery of aid.

statements_all.role: president of South Kivu civil society
statements_all.text: UN News reported that Néné Bintu Iragi, president of South Kivu civil society, told the Security Council that in territories controlled by AFC/M23 there were killings, arson, arbitrary detentions and 'collective punishments' and a parallel administration imposing taxes on the population.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Dans les territoires contrôlés par l’AFC/M23, elle a dénoncé assassinats, incendies, détentions arbitraires et « punitions collectives », ainsi qu’une administration parallèle imposant ses taxes à la population.
statements_all.translation_en: In the territories controlled by the AFC/M23, she denounced killings, arson, arbitrary detentions and 'collective punishments', as well as a parallel administration imposing its taxes on the population.

statements_all.role: representative of Rwanda to the UN Security Council
statements_all.text: Rwanda's representative told the Security Council that, according to 'information available', on 8 March 2026 an FARDC helicopter airlifted 12 tonnes of ammunition and food rations to Ntoto, which were subsequently distributed among FARDC, FDLR, Pareco and APCSS elements, and that as recently as 15 August 2026 'information available indicated' FARDC operating alongside CNRND, FLN, FDLR and an armed group the auto-generated transcript renders as "Wazalandonyatwa" in what it renders as "Warungu" territory.
statements_all.excerpt_original: On the 8th of March, 2026, Information available indicates that FARDC helicopter airlifted 12 tonnes of ammunition and food rations to Ntoto, which were subsequently distributed among FARDC, FDLR, Pareco and APCSS elements.

statements_all.role: representative of Rwanda to the UN Security Council
statements_all.text: Rwanda's representative told the Security Council that, according to 'information available in the public domain', since 2017 more than 650 villages had been destroyed or burned in the South Kivu highlands, more than 700,000 cattle looted and sold in public markets, and at least 147 schools and 57 health facilities destroyed.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Information available in the public domain indicates that over nearly a decade, since 2017, more than 650 villages have been destroyed or burned in the South Kivu highlands. More than 700,000 cattle have been looted and sold in the public markets. And at least 147 schools and 57 health facilities have been destroyed.

statements_all.role: representative of the DRC to the UN Security Council
statements_all.text: The representative of the DRC told the Security Council that the DRC was particularly concerned by consistent reports of the displacement and transplantation of Rwandan populations in Congolese localities emptied of their inhabitants, followed by repeated massacres which the speaker said were perpetrated by the RDF and the AFC/M23.
statements_all.excerpt_original: we are particularly concerned by the consistent reports of the displacement and transplantation of Rwandan populations in Congolese localities emptied of their inhabitants, followed their repeated massacres perpetrated by the RDF and the AFC M23.

statements_all.role: representative of Burundi to the UN Security Council
statements_all.text: The representative of Burundi told the Security Council that Burundi called for the cessation of all support to armed groups and for the implementation of commitments undertaken to address security concerns in the region, in full respect for the sovereignty and territorial integrity of the DRC, and wished future Secretary-General reports to continue to provide a precise and balanced account of the contribution of regional actors to peace efforts, mediation, ceasefire verification and civilian protection.
statements_all.excerpt_original: We call for the cessation of all support to armed groups and for the implementation of commitments undertaken to address security concerns in the region, in full respect for the sovereignty and territorial integrity of the DRC.

statements_all.party: Robert Anvul Yav; André Ehonza Uketi
statements_all.text: Mediacongo reported that, in earlier hearings, the two accused generals contested the prosecution's reading of events, explaining that AFC/M23 forces had a significant advantage in men and equipment.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Lors de leurs précédentes auditions, les deux officiers ont contesté cette lecture des événements. Ils ont notamment expliqué que les forces de l’AFC/M23 disposaient d’un avantage important en hommes et en équipements, dans un contexte marqué par le repli des troupes gouvernementales.
statements_all.translation_en: During their previous hearings, the two officers contested this reading of events. They explained in particular that the AFC/M23 forces had a significant advantage in men and equipment, in a context marked by the withdrawal of government troops.

statements_all.text: Azarias Ruberwa said, according to Igihe, that there is a serious humanitarian problem around Point-Zéro and Minembwe because attacks are launched as if the area were uninhabited, adding that he feared people might be displaced permanently.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Azarias Ruberwa yavuze ko ikibazo cy’ubutabazi muri ako gace kiri kgukomera kurushaho, kuko ibitero bigabwa nk’aho ari ahantu hadatuwe. Ati "Hari ikibazo gikomeye cy’ubutabazi. Bararwana nk’aho aka gace kadatuwemo n’abantu. Usibye ubwicanyi, mfite impungenge z’uko abantu bashobora kuhacika. Hari igihe abantu bashobora kurambirwa bakagenda burundu."
statements_all.translation_en: Azarias Ruberwa said that the humanitarian problem in that area is getting worse, because attacks are launched as if it were an uninhabited place. He said: “There is a serious humanitarian problem. They fight as if this area had no people living in it. Apart from the killings, I fear that people may disappear from there. There may come a time when people get tired and leave for good.”

statements_all.text: Igihe reported that AFC/M23 said that as long as DRC government forces continue to fire blindly at areas it controls, including Point-Zéro, without regard for civilians living there, it will continue to fight for them and protect its positions.
statements_all.excerpt_original: AFC/M23 yatangaje ko mu gihe ingabo za Leta ya RDC zikomeje kurasa buhumyi mu bice igenzura birimo Point-Zéro, zititaye ku basivili bahatuye, izakomeza kubarwanirira, inarinda ibirindiro byayo.
statements_all.translation_en: AFC/M23 stated that while DRC government forces continue shooting blindly in areas it controls including Point-Zéro, without regard for civilians living there, it will continue to fight for them, and defend its positions.

statements_all.role: deputy governor of North Kivu (AFC/M23 de facto administration)
statements_all.text: Bwiza reported, citing reliable information reaching it, that AFC/M23 fighters regained control of Remeka in Masisi territory after a commando operation on the night of Wednesday 23 September 2026, and that the capture was also confirmed by Ngarambe Manzi Willy, whom the outlet calls the Deputy Governor of North Kivu Province, in a message on X.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Abarwanyi ba AFC/M23 bongeye kugenzura agace ka Remeka gaherereye muri Teritwari ya Masisi, nyuma ya Operasiyo ya gikomando yakozwe n’abarwanyi b’uyu mutwe mu ijoro ryo ku wa Gatatu tariki ya 23 Nzeri 2026.
statements_all.translation_en: AFC/M23 fighters regained control of the Remeka area in Masisi territory, after a commando operation carried out by this group's fighters on the night of Wednesday 23 September 2026.

statements_all.setting: press conference, as reported by Kivu Morning Post
statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that at the same press conference Corneille Nangaa said that in the night of 23 to 24 September a humanitarian convoy of UN and NGO organisations had been blocked at Mulima on its way to Minembwe, and that the convoy, headed by OCHA, ACTED and Médecins du Monde, was according to the AFC/M23 deliberately attacked by the Kinshasa coalition forces.
statements_all.excerpt_original: un incident survenu dans la nuit du 23 au 24 septembre, affirmant qu’un convoi humanitaire comprenant notamment des organisations de l’ONU et des ONG avait été bloqué à Mulima alors qu’il se dirigeait vers Minembwe. Le convoi, chapeauté par OCHA, ACTED et Médecins du Monde, a été, selon l’AFC/M23, délibérément attaqué par les forces coalisées de Kinshasa.
statements_all.translation_en: an incident that occurred in the night of 23 to 24 September, asserting that a humanitarian convoy including notably UN organisations and NGOs had been blocked at Mulima while it was heading to Minembwe. The convoy, headed by OCHA, ACTED and Médecins du Monde, was, according to the AFC/M23, deliberately attacked by the coalition forces of Kinshasa.

statements_all.text: Beto.cd reported that Burundian President Évariste Ndayishimiye said on France 24 on 23 September 2026, on the margins of the UN General Assembly, that he saw no sign of disengagement of Rwandan forces from eastern DRC and judged that the FDLR were only a pretext.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Sur France 24, le 23 septembre, en marge de l’Assemblée générale des Nations unies, le président burundais Évariste Ndayishimiye dit ne voir aucun signe de désengagement des forces rwandaises de l’est de la RDC et juge que les FDLR ne sont qu’un prétexte.
statements_all.translation_en: On France 24, on 23 September, on the margins of the UN General Assembly, Burundian President Évariste Ndayishimiye says he sees no sign of disengagement of Rwandan forces from eastern DRC and judges that the FDLR are only a pretext.

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that AFC-M23, in a clarification dated 22 September signed by Bertrand Bisimwa, "formally and in their entirety" rejected the accusations in Amnesty International's report on abuses at mining sites in areas under its control, calling them "not established and insufficiently substantiated".
statements_all.excerpt_original: Dans une « mise au point » datée du 22 septembre, l’AFC-M23 « rejette formellement et dans leur ensemble » les accusations formulées dans le rapport d’Amnesty International, qu’elle juge « non établies et insuffisamment étayées ».
statements_all.translation_en: In a "clarification" dated 22 September, the AFC-M23 "formally and in their entirety rejects" the accusations made in the Amnesty International report, which it considers "not established and insufficiently substantiated".

statements_all.text: BBC News Gahuza (Kirundi) reported that AFC/M23 denied Amnesty International's allegations that it killed and abused small-scale miners and took gold and coltan to Rwanda; in a statement it issued in Goma on Tuesday, AFC/M23 said Amnesty had not provided solid evidence that could be examined.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Umuhari AFC/M23 wahakanye ivyagiriji vya Amnesty International bivuga ko wishe kandi ugahohotera abacukuzi bato bato, ukanatwara inzahabu na coltan mu Rwanda. Mw’itangazo yasohoye i Goma ejo ku wa kabiri, AFC/M23 yavuze ko Amnesty itatanze ivyemezo bifadika bishobora gusuzumwa.
statements_all.translation_en: The AFC/M23 movement denied Amnesty International's allegations that it killed and abused small-scale miners, and took gold and coltan to Rwanda. In a statement it issued in Goma yesterday, Tuesday, AFC/M23 said Amnesty had not provided solid evidence that could be examined.

statements_all.role: deputy coordinator of the AFC/M23 (signatory of the mise au point)
statements_all.text: JamboRDC reported that in a mise au point published on Tuesday, signed by Bertrand Bisimwa, deputy coordinator of the AFC/M23, the movement said it rejects 'formally and as a whole' the accusations in Amnesty International's report on the Rubaya and Lomera mining sites, which it judges 'not established and insufficiently substantiated'.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Dans une mise au point publiée mardi 22 septembre 2026, le mouvement affirme rejeter « formellement et dans leur ensemble » les accusations contenues dans le rapport d’Amnesty International, qu’il juge « non établies et insuffisamment étayées ». Signé par Bertrand Bisimwa, coordonnateur adjoint de l’AFC/M23,
statements_all.translation_en: In a clarification published on Tuesday 22 September 2026, the movement says it rejects "formally and as a whole" the accusations contained in Amnesty International's report, which it judges "not established and insufficiently substantiated". Signed by Bertrand Bisimwa, deputy coordinator of the AFC/M23,

statements_all.role: deputy coordinator of the AFC/M23 (signatory of the mise au point)
statements_all.text: JamboRDC reported that the AFC/M23 said each case alleged by Amnesty should establish the reality of the alleged facts, their date and place, the identity of the alleged perpetrators and any link with the AFC/M23 and its chain of command, and that 'an accusation does not in itself constitute proof'.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le mouvement estime que chaque cas devrait notamment permettre d’établir la réalité des faits allégués, leur date et leur lieu, l’identité des auteurs présumés ainsi que leur éventuel lien avec l’AFC/M23 et sa chaîne de commandement. « Une accusation ne constitue pas, à elle seule, une preuve, » soutient le mouvement.
statements_all.translation_en: The movement considers that each case should in particular make it possible to establish the reality of the alleged facts, their date and place, the identity of the alleged perpetrators and their possible link with the AFC/M23 and its chain of command. "An accusation does not in itself constitute proof," the movement maintains.

statements_all.role: coordinator of the Wazalendo in South Kivu province, as ACP describes him
statements_all.setting: statement at a workshop, as reported
statements_all.text: The Agence Congolaise de Presse (ACP), the state news agency, reported from a Ministry of the Interior workshop at Uvira that Willian Amuri Yakutumba, whom ACP described as coordinator of the 'Wazalendo' in South Kivu province, said that not all armed persons are Wazalendo and that the Wazalendo must be distinguished from other armed groups or individuals in South Kivu; ACP also described Alexis Dunia as 'also coordinator of wazalendo'.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Les participants à un atelier organisé par le ministère de l’Intérieur à Uvira, dans la province du Sud -Kivu (Est de la République démocratique du Congo), ont plaidé, mercredi, lors de la deuxième journée des travaux, pour une meilleure compréhension des «Wazalendo»
statements_all.translation_en: The participants in a workshop organised by the ministry of the interior in Uvira, in the province of Sud Kivu (east of the République démocratique du Congo), pleaded on Wednesday, on the second day of the proceedings, for a better understanding of the wazalendo

statements_all.role: deputy AFC/M23 leader and President of MRDP-Twirwaneho
statements_all.setting: statement as reported by Igihe (night of 21 September 2026)
statements_all.text: AFC/M23 deputy leader and MRDP-Twirwaneho President Freddy Kaniki said, according to Igihe, that forces supporting the DRC government had again besieged Minembwe commune in South Kivu.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Umuyobozi wungirije wa AFC/M23 akaba na Perezida wa MRDP-Twirwaneho, Freddy Kaniki, yavuze ko ingabo zishyigikiye ubutegetsi bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi zongeye kugota Komini Minembwe mu Ntara ya Kivu y’Amajyepfo.
statements_all.translation_en: The deputy leader of AFC/M23 and President of MRDP-Twirwaneho, Freddy Kaniki, said that forces supporting the government of the Democratic Republic have again besieged Minembwe commune in South Kivu province.

statements_all.role: deputy AFC/M23 leader and President of MRDP-Twirwaneho
statements_all.setting: statement as reported by Igihe (night of 21 September 2026)
statements_all.text: Kaniki said, according to Igihe, that Minembwe was in a serious security situation and that the DRC, Burundian, Wazalendo, FDLR and foreign mercenary forces had chosen to breach the ceasefire agreement adopted at the Doha talks.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Mu ijoro ryo ku wa 21 Nzeri 2026, Kaniki yatangaje ko Minembwe iri mu bihe bikomeye by’umutekano, agaragaza ko ingabo za Leta ya RDC, iz’u Burundi, Wazalendo, FDLR n’abacanshuro b’abanyamahahanga byahisemo kurenga ku masezerano y’agahenge yemejwe mu biganiro bya Doha.
statements_all.translation_en: On the night of 21 September 2026, Kaniki announced that Minembwe is in a serious security situation, indicating that the DRC government forces, the Burundian forces, Wazalendo, FDLR and foreign mercenaries had chosen to breach the ceasefire agreement adopted in the Doha talks.

statements_all.text: Kaniki said, according to Igihe, that residents of Minembwe had their routes closed to them for going to seek health care, for bringing food and for going to markets, contrary to the Doha resolutions.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Kaniki yavuze ko abaturage bo muri Minembwe bafungiwe inzira banyuramo bajya kwivuza, banyuzamo ibiribwa ndetse bajya ku masoko; bihabanye n’imyanzuro yafatiwe mu biganiro bya Doha.
statements_all.translation_en: Kaniki said that the residents of Minembwe have had the routes they use to go for medical care, to bring in food and to go to markets closed to them, contrary to the resolutions adopted in the Doha talks.

statements_all.role: deputy AFC/M23 leader and President of MRDP-Twirwaneho
statements_all.text: Kaniki called on the international community, according to Igihe, to act before a serious humanitarian problem arises, saying AFC/M23 continues to support the political path but will not keep watching Minembwe residents being put in danger.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Kaniki yavuze ko abaturage bo muri Minembwe bafungiwe inzira banyuramo bajya kwivuza, banyuzamo ibiribwa ndetse bajya ku masoko; bihabanye n’imyanzuro yafatiwe mu biganiro bya Doha. Yagize ati “Ibi ntibigomba gufatwa nk’ibisanzwe. Iki ni igihe cyo gufata icyemezo gikomeye. Uyu ni umurongo utukura.” Uyu muyobozi yavuze ko amahanga akwiye kugira icyo akora mbere y’uko habaho ikibazo gikomeye cy’ubutabazi, avuga ko AFC/M23 ikomeje gushyigikira inzira ya politiki ariko ko itazakomeza kurebera abaturage ba Minembwe bashyirwa mu kaga.
statements_all.translation_en: Kaniki said that the residents of Minembwe have been cut off from the routes they use to go for medical care, to bring in food and to go to markets, contrary to the conclusions reached in the Doha talks. He said: "This must not be treated as normal. This is the time to take a firm decision. This is a red line." This leader said that foreign countries should do something before a serious humanitarian problem arises, saying that AFC/M23 continues to support the political path but will not keep looking on while the people of Minembwe are put in danger.

statements_all.role: spokesperson, operational sector Sokola 1 Grand-Nord and Front Nord
statements_all.text: 7sur7.cd reported that the FARDC, in a communiqué signed by Lieutenant Marc Elongo, spokesperson of operational sector Sokola 1 Grand-Nord and Front Nord, said on 20 September they observe the ceasefire on all North Kivu front lines while denouncing attacks they attribute to AFC/M23-RDF on the Walikale-Masisi axis, which they said violate the Doha and Washington accords and cause displacement toward Walikale, with villages burned and fields destroyed.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Toujours selon ce communiqué signé par le lieutenant Marc Elongo, porte-parole du secteur opérationnel Sokola 1 Grand-Nord et Front Nord, ces attaques provoquent de nouveaux déplacements de populations civiles vers Walikale.
statements_all.translation_en: According to the same communiqué signed by Lieutenant Marc Elongo, spokesperson of operational sector Sokola 1 Grand-Nord and Front Nord, these attacks cause new displacement of civilians toward Walikale.

statements_all.role: representative of the DRC to the UN Security Council
statements_all.text: The representative of the DRC told the Security Council that on the 20th September a TB2 drone strike attributed to the Rwandan Defense Forces targeted a Congolese position in Pinga, killing five people and seriously injuring eight others.
statements_all.excerpt_original: And this good faith was put to the test on the 20th September, when a TB2 drone strike attributed to the Rwandan Defense Forces targeted a Congolese position in Pinga. killing five people and seriously injuring eight others.

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that AFC/M23 coordinator Corneille Nangaa called on Burundian President and African Union chair Évariste Ndayishimiye to guarantee humanitarian access to the Minembwe highlands, denouncing what he called a 'blocus humanitaire' affecting the mostly Banyamulenge Tutsi zone.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le coordonnateur de l’Alliance du Fleuve Congo/Mouvement du 23 Mars (AFC-M23) a appelé, jeudi 18 septembre 2026, le président de la République du Burundi et président en exercice de l’Union africaine, Évariste Ndayishimiye, à garantir l’accès humanitaire dans les hauts plateaux de Minembwe, en province du Sud-Kivu, dans l’est de la RDC.
statements_all.translation_en: The coordinator of the Alliance Fleuve Congo/Mouvement du 23 Mars (AFC-M23) called on Thursday 18 September 2026 on the President of the Republic of Burundi and current chair of the African Union, Évariste Ndayishimiye, to guarantee humanitarian access in the Minembwe highlands, in South Kivu province, in eastern DRC.

statements_all.text: Twirwaneho officer Col Fidèle Rugabo said, according to Igihe, that at 'saa cyenda z’urukerera' on 18 September 2026 DRC, Burundian, FDLR, P5 and Wazalendo forces attacked residents at Mukoko and Nyaruhinga, and that 'the enemy is being beaten like a drum'.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Col Fidèle Rugabo uri mu bofisiye ba Twirwaneho yatangaje ko saa cyenda z’urukerera rwo ku wa 18 Nzeri 2026, ingabo za RDC, iz’u Burundi, FDLR, P5 na Wazalendo byateye abaturage muri Mukoko na Nyaruhinga.
statements_all.translation_en: Col Fidèle Rugabo, one of the officers of Twirwaneho, announced that at about 3 a.m. (saa cyenda z'urukerera, Kinyarwanda time) on 18 September 2026, the DRC forces, those of Burundi, FDLR, P5 and Wazalendo attacked residents in Mukoko and Nyaruhinga.

statements_all.text: Col Rugabo said, according to Igihe, that at 'saa kumi n’ebyiri z’igitondo' pro-government armed forces attacked the Gipimo area in the direction of Kabanju.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Col Rugabo yatangaje kandi ko saa kumi n’ebyiri z’igitondo, imitwe y’ingabo ishyigikiye Leta ya RDC yateye agace ka Gipimo mu cyerekezo cya Kabanju.
statements_all.translation_en: Col Rugabo also announced that at about 6 a.m. (saa kumi n'ebyiri z'igitondo, Kinyarwanda time), armed forces supporting the DRC government attacked the Gipimo area in the direction of Kabanju.

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that the South Kivu provincial government, led by Governor Jean-Jacques Purusi from Uvira, denounced the 'insufficiency, even inaction' of the AFC/M23 rebels administering Bukavu after a fire, and the pressure and 'predation' of the population under their administration.
statements_all.excerpt_original: « Le Gouvernement provincial dénonce avec la plus grande fermeté l’insuffisance, voire l’inaction des Rebelles de l’AFC/M23 qui administrent actuellement la ville de Bukavu, face à une situation qui exige pourtant une mobilisation permanente.
statements_all.translation_en: "The provincial Government denounces with the greatest firmness the insufficiency, even the inaction of the AFC/M23 rebels who currently administer the city of Bukavu, in the face of a situation that nevertheless demands permanent mobilisation.

statements_all.setting: communiqué and social-media post as reported
statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that, in a communiqué, AFC-M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka accused coalition forces of Kinshasa, the FDLR, Wazalendo militias, foreign mercenaries and the Burundian National Defence Force of intensifying operations on several fronts on Sunday 13 September 2026, and said attacks on Walikale territory began around 14:00 against Minjenje and Kibati, with ground and air operations including drones and heavy artillery.
statements_all.excerpt_original: De nouveaux combats ont été signalés dimanche 13 septembre 2026 dans plusieurs zones du Sud-Kivu et du Nord-Kivu entre l’AFC-M23 et l’armée congolaise, alliée aux Wazalendo.
statements_all.translation_en: New fighting was reported on Sunday 13 September 2026 in several areas of South Kivu and North Kivu between the AFC-M23 and the Congolese army, allied to the Wazalendo.

statements_all.text: Igihe reported that AFC/M23 expressed deep sorrow, condoled with the families, and asked residents of liberated areas to follow instructions on avoiding explosives still in the ground, not to touch, move or try to dismantle anything they suspect may be a bomb.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Umutwe wa AFC-M23 wavuze ko wababajwe cyane n’iki gitero, unihanganisha imiryango yabuze ababo ndetse n’inshuti z’abahitanywe n’iturika ry’iki gisasu.
statements_all.translation_en: The AFC-M23 group said it was deeply saddened by this attack, and it condoled with the families that lost their loved ones and the friends of those killed by the explosion of this bomb.

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that the South Kivu provincial government, which depends on the central government in Kinshasa, denounced the pressure and predation to which it said the population of Bukavu is subjected under the administration of AFC/M23, citing levies including so-called sanitation taxes and taxes on commercial activity and, according to several testimonies, acts of intimidation, violence and flogging.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Il dénonce également le contexte de pression et de prédation auquel est soumise la population de Bukavu, confrontée à une succession de drames et à une précarité extrême sous l’administration de l’AFC/M23.
statements_all.translation_en: It also denounces the context of pressure and predation to which the population of Bukavu is subjected, faced with a succession of tragedies and extreme precariousness under the administration of the AFC/M23.

statements_all.text: UMUSEKE (Rwanda) reported on 10 September 2026 that AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka said government forces launched attacks at dawn on Thursday 10 September 2026 in areas including Ihula, Malemo, Minjenje and Kibati and their surroundings, and that, posting on X, he said the fighting was continuing and many residents had fled.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi wa AFC/M23, Lawrence Kanyuka, yavuze ko ingabo za Leta ya RDC zagabye ibitero mu rukerera rwo ku wa Kane, tariki ya 10 Nzeri 2026, mu bice birimo Ihula, Malemo, Minjenje na Kibati n’ahabikikije.
statements_all.translation_en: The AFC/M23 spokesperson, Lawrence Kanyuka, said that the DRC government forces launched attacks at dawn on Thursday, 10 September 2026, in areas including Ihula, Malemo, Minjenje and Kibati and the surrounding areas.

statements_all.text: UMUSEKE (Rwanda) reported that the AFC/M23 spokesperson said the escalation of fighting affected residents' security and could hinder aid work, and that aid organisations and their staff could not reach residents affected by the attacks.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi wa AFC/M23 yavuze ko uku gukaza imirwano kwagize ingaruka ku mutekano w’abaturage ndetse ko bishobora no kubangamira ibikorwa by’ubutabazi.
statements_all.translation_en: The AFC/M23 spokesperson said that this escalation of fighting affected the security of residents and could also hinder aid work.

statements_all.text: Bwiza reported that the AFC-M23 alliance announced that 24 children and students, 19 girls and five boys, died in a fire that struck houses in the Tshimpunda area of Kadutu commune, Bukavu, and that spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka said in a communiqué of Thursday 10 September 2026 that the fire happened in the first hours after noon.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Ihuriro AFC-M23 ryatangaje ko abana n'abanyeshuri 24, barimo abakobwa 19 n’abahungu batanu, ari bo bapfiriye mu nkongi y’umuriro yibasiye amazu yo mu gace ka Tshimpunda ho muri Komini ya Kadutu, mu Mujyi wa Bukavu.
statements_all.translation_en: The AFC-M23 alliance announced that 24 children and students, including 19 girls and five boys, died in the fire that struck houses in the Tshimpunda area in Kadutu commune, in the city of Bukavu.

statements_all.text: Bwiza reported that AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka said on X on Thursday 10 September 2026 that, from 05:00, forces of the Kinshasa government and the groups supporting them intensified attacks on populated areas on the edges of Masisi and Walikale (Ihula, Malemo, Minjenje, Kibati and surroundings), that at about 07:00 they attacked Buhimba (Masisi) with ground forces using 82 mm mortars and 12.7 mm machine guns, and that aid organisations and their staff had difficulty reaching affected residents.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Lawrence Kanyuka, umuvugizi wa AFC/M23 ushinzwe ibya politiki, ni we watangaje aya makuru kuri X kuri uyu wa Kane tariki ya 10 Nzeri 2026.
statements_all.translation_en: Lawrence Kanyuka, AFC/M23 spokesperson for politics, announced this on X on Thursday 10 September 2026.

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that AFC-M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka said that from 14:00 on Thursday 10 September 2026 until late at night the coalition forces of the Kinshasa regime continued indiscriminate bombardments with kamikaze drones against Point-Zéro and Nyamabuguma in the Minembwe region.
statements_all.excerpt_original: « Depuis 14h00 hier, jeudi 10 septembre 2026, et jusqu’à tard dans la nuit, les forces coalisées du régime de Kinshasa ont poursuivi leurs bombardements indiscriminés contre Point-Zéro et Nyamabuguma, dans la région de Minembwe, au moyen de drones kamikazes », a déclaré Lawrence Kanyuka, porte-parole de l’AFC-M23.
statements_all.translation_en: "Since 14:00 yesterday, Thursday 10 September 2026, and until late at night, the coalition forces of the Kinshasa regime continued their indiscriminate bombardments against Point-Zéro and Nyamabuguma, in the Minembwe region, using kamikaze drones", said Lawrence Kanyuka, spokesperson of the AFC-M23.

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that, according to Twirwaneho spokesperson colonel Fidèle Rugabo, two battalions, 'dont celui des Hiboux et des forces burundaises' (the wording is ambiguous: including that of the Hiboux and of Burundian forces), had been deployed on the Rurambo axis, and that on the Bijombo axis four battalions of the FARDC and of the Burundian army, with elements of the P5 and Wazalendo, were visible towards Kirungwa, Munanira, Gataka, Zikambitse-Marimba, Rubarati and Kajoka.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Selon le colonel Fidèle Rugabo, porte-parole du Twirwaneho, deux bataillons, dont celui des Hiboux et des forces burundaises, ont été déployés sur l’axe Rurambo. Sur l’axe Bijombo, quatre bataillons des FARDC et de l’armée burundaise, ainsi que des éléments du P5 et des Wazalendo, ont été visibles vers Kirungwa, Munanira et Gataka, Zikambitse-Marimba, Rubarati et Kajoka.
statements_all.translation_en: According to Colonel Fidèle Rugabo, spokesperson of Twirwaneho, two battalions, including that of the Hiboux and Burundian forces, were deployed on the Rurambo axis. On the Bijombo axis, four battalions of the FARDC and of the Burundian army, as well as elements of the P5 and Wazalendo, were visible towards Kirungwa, Munanira and Gataka, Zikambitse-Marimba, Rubarati and Kajoka.

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that the South Kivu provincial government spokesperson, Me Luganywa-Bashizi Didier, condemned the abuses reported at Kaniola and called for those responsible to be brought to justice.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Au nom du gouvernement provincial du Sud-Kivu, le porte-parole, Me Luganywa-Bashizi Didier, a condamné ces exactions.
statements_all.translation_en: On behalf of the South Kivu provincial government, the spokesperson, Me Luganywa-Bashizi Didier, condemned these abuses.

statements_all.role: spokesperson, operation Sukola 2 Sud South Kivu
statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that the spokesperson of operation Sukola 2 Sud South Kivu, Lieutenant-Colonel Reagan Mbuyi Kalonji, said that following the FARDC response against what he called the 'terrorist coalition RDF and its allies M23, Twirwaneho and Red Tabara' in the Hauts Plateaux of Uvira and Fizi, the FARDC had neutralised 23 rebels, 11 others had surrendered and several weapons were recovered.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Selon le porte-parole de l’opération Sukola 2 Sud Sud-Kivu, le lieutenant-colonel Reagan Mbuyi Kalonji, cette avancée résulte d’une riposte militaire menée dans ces zones. « À la suite de notre riposte contre la coalition terroriste RDF et ses alliés du M23, Twirwaneho et Red Tabara, dans les Hauts Plateaux d’Uvira et de Fizi, les FARDC ont neutralisé 23 rebelles, 11 autres se sont rendus et plusieurs armes ont été récupérées », a-t-il déclaré.
statements_all.translation_en: According to the spokesperson of operation Sukola 2 Sud South Kivu, Lieutenant-Colonel Reagan Mbuyi Kalonji, this advance resulted from a military response in these areas. "Following our response against the terrorist coalition RDF and its allies M23, Twirwaneho and Red Tabara, in the Hauts Plateaux of Uvira and Fizi, the FARDC neutralised 23 rebels, 11 others surrendered and several weapons were recovered," he said.

statements_all.setting: statement to the press as reported
statements_all.text: MediaCongo, relaying ACP/MCP, reported that the spokesperson of operations Sukola 2 Sud-Sud-Kivu, Sub-lieutenant Reagan Mbuyi, said that after the FARDC's riposte against the RDF coalition and its M23-Twirwaneho and Red Tabara allies in the Uvira and Fizi highlands, the FARDC had neutralised 23 rebels, 11 had surrendered and several weapons had been recovered.
statements_all.excerpt_original: « À la suite de sa riposte contre la coalition terroriste RDF et ses alliés rebelles du M23-Twirwaneho et Red Tabara dans les Hauts-Plateaux d’Uvira et Fizi,
statements_all.translation_en: « Following its riposte against the terrorist coalition RDF and its rebel allies of the M23-Twirwaneho and Red Tabara in the Hauts-Plateaux of Uvira and Fizi,

statements_all.text: Igihe reported that these attacks followed ones that the DRC government forces coalition had been launching for days on areas controlled by Twirwaneho and AFC/M23, including Minembwe, Kalehe and Masisi; Col Rugabo said, according to Igihe, that Twirwaneho and AFC/M23 strongly condemned these attacks.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Ibi bitero bikurikiye ibyo ihuriro ry’ingabo za Leta ya RDC rimaze iminsi rigaba mu bice bigenzurwa na Twirwaneho ndetse na AFC/M23 birimo Minembwe, Kalehe na Masisi. Col Rugabo yatangaje ko Twirwaneho na AFC/M23 byamaganiye kure ibi bitero.
statements_all.translation_en: These attacks follow those that the coalition of DRC government forces has been launching for days in areas controlled by Twirwaneho and AFC/M23, including Minembwe, Kalehe and Masisi. Col Rugabo announced that Twirwaneho and AFC/M23 strongly condemned these attacks.

statements_all.text: A Rwandan broadcaster's website reported that Rwanda's Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation Olivier Nduhungirehe, writing on X, disputed remarks by US adviser Massad Boulos by saying AFC/M23 had completed its withdrawal from Uvira weeks before the US imposed sanctions on the RDF; the outlet reported him saying AFC/M23 began leaving Uvira on 16 December 2025 and completed its withdrawal on 17 January 2026, and that the Congolese army later returned to the city alongside Burundian forces, the FDLR and Wazalendo armed groups.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Rwanda’s Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation Olivier Nduhungirehe said AFC/M23 had completed its withdrawal from Uvira weeks before the United States imposed sanctions on the Rwanda Defence Force. Writing on X, Nduhungirehe disputed remarks made by US Senior Adviser for Africa Massad Boulos during an interview with France 24.

statements_all.text: BBC News Gahuza reported that AFC/M23 spokesperson Oscar Balinda said that gold and coltan mined in the east of the DRC pass through Rwanda but only in transit to foreign markets; that he said the Amnesty report was the same as others published by organisations he said are paid by the Kinshasa government to tarnish the name of AFC/M23, and the outlet wrote that he gave no evidence for this; and that Amnesty said AFC/M23 had not answered its questions, while AFC/M23 denies that Amnesty ever approached it.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi w'umuhari wa AFC/M23, Oscar Balinda, avuga ko inzahabu na coltan bicukurwa mu buseruko bwa Repubulika ya Demokarasi ya Congo bica mu Rwanda ariko ko bihaca gusa biriko birajanwa ku masoko yo hanze.
statements_all.translation_en: AFC/M23 spokesperson Oscar Balinda says that the gold and coltan mined in the east of the Democratic Republic of Congo pass through Rwanda but only pass there while being taken to foreign markets.

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that AFC/M23 political spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka said that forces his movement calls the 'coalisées du régime de Kinshasa' intensified their ground attacks on the Point Zéro area at around 04:45 in the early hours of the morning; he also said these forces attacked Kasika (Mwenga territory) early that morning, and that government forces attacked Nyaruhinga and Mukoko in the Minembwe area. This is the AFC/M23 account.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Lawrence Kanyuka, porte-parole politique de l’AFC/M23, a affirmé que des attaques ont été signalées dès les premières heures de la matinée. Selon lui, les forces que son mouvement qualifie de « coalisées du régime de Kinshasa » ont intensifié, vers 04H45, leurs attaques terrestres contre la zone de Point Zéro
statements_all.translation_en: Lawrence Kanyuka, political spokesperson of the AFC/M23, said that attacks were reported from the early hours of the morning.
