According to him, the forces his movement calls the 'coalition of the Kinshasa regime' intensified, around 04:45, their ground attacks on the Point Zéro area

statements_all.text: SOS Médias Burundi reported that a Wazalendo fighter present in the Malimba area said that the FARDC, the FDNB and the Wazalendo had retaken positions previously held by AFC/M23, Twirwaneho and Red Tabara fighters at Malimba, Ruhuha and Rubarati; SOS Médias Burundi noted this could not be independently verified.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Un combattant des milices Wazalendo entretenues par Kinshasa, présent dans la zone de Malimba, affirme que les FARDC, la FDNB et les milices Wazalendo entretenues par Kinshasa ont repris plusieurs positions précédemment occupées par des combattants de l’AFC/M23, de Twirwaneho et de Red Tabara à Malimba, Ruhuha et Rubarati.
statements_all.translation_en: A fighter of the Wazalendo militias maintained by Kinshasa, present in the Malimba area, says that the FARDC, the FDNB and the Wazalendo militias maintained by Kinshasa retook several positions previously occupied by fighters of the AFC/M23, Twirwaneho and Red Tabara at Malimba, Ruhuha and Rubarati.

statements_all.text: SOS Médias Burundi reported that Twirwaneho spokesperson Fidèle Rugabo said his fighters had repelled several attacks by the FARDC, the FDNB, the Wazalendo militias and the FDLR, citing in a post on X Kabanju, Kipupu, Nyamabuguma and Point Zéro in Fizi and Mwenga territories; SOS Médias Burundi said these claims could not be independently verified.
statements_all.excerpt_original: De son côté, le porte-parole de Twirwaneho, Fidèle Rugabo, affirme que ses combattants ont repoussé plusieurs attaques menées par les FARDC, la FDNB, les milices Wazalendo entretenues par Kinshasa et les FDLR. Dans un message publié sur le réseau social X, il cite notamment Kabanju, Kipupu, Nyamabuguma et Point Zéro, dans les territoires de Fizi et Mwenga.
statements_all.translation_en: For his part, the Twirwaneho spokesperson, Fidèle Rugabo, says his fighters repelled several attacks by the FARDC, the FDNB, the Wazalendo militias maintained by Kinshasa and the FDLR. In a message posted on the social network X, he cites in particular Kabanju, Kipupu, Nyamabuguma and Point Zéro, in the territories of Fizi and Mwenga.

statements_all.text: Colonel Fidèle Rugabo of MRDP-Twirwaneho said, according to Igihe: 'MRDP strongly condemned the shooting down of a civilian plane that was carrying medicines and food'.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Col Rugabo yagize ati “MRDP yamaganiye kure ihanurwa ry’indege ya gisivili yari itwaye imiti n’ibiribwa.”
statements_all.translation_en: Col Rugabo said: “MRDP strongly condemned the shooting down of a civilian plane that was carrying medicines and food.”

statements_all.text: ReelActu reported that Rugabo Fidèle, a member of the Twirwaneho-M23 coalition, publicly confirmed the destruction of the plane and accused the FARDC of shooting down 'a civil aircraft carrying medicines and food', calling the incident a 'provocation' that came two days after the MCVE+ team left Minembwe.
statements_all.excerpt_original: De son côté, Rugabo Fidèle, membre influent de la coalition Twirwaneho-M23, a confirmé publiquement la destruction de l’avion. Dans une déclaration, il accuse les FARDC d’avoir abattu « un avion civil transportant des médicaments et des aliments » et qualifie l’incident de « provocation » intervenue deux jours après le départ de l’équipe du MCVE+ de Minembwe.
statements_all.translation_en: For his part, Rugabo Fidèle, an influential member of the Twirwaneho-M23 coalition, publicly confirmed the destruction of the plane. In a statement, he accuses the FARDC of having shot down “a civil aircraft carrying medicines and food” and describes the incident as a “provocation” that occurred two days after the MCVE+ team left Minembwe.

statements_all.text: ReelActu reported that Congolese security sources maintain the plane was carrying out a resupply mission for rebel positions in the highlands.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Des sources sécuritaires congolaises soutiennent qu’il effectuait une mission de ravitaillement au profit des positions rebelles dans les hauts plateaux.
statements_all.translation_en: Congolese security sources maintain that it was carrying out a resupply mission for the rebel positions in the highlands.

statements_all.text: LSi Africa reported that Fizi territory administrator Sammy Kalonji Badibanga said the plane came from Rwanda and was carrying soldiers, equipment and food, while sources linked to Twirwaneho-AFC/M23 described it as a civil aircraft linking Bukavu to Minembwe with medicines and equipment on board and two crew members.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Des sources liées aux Twirwaneho-AFC/M23 présentent l’appareil comme un avion civil reliant Bukavu à Minembwe, avec des médicaments et du matériel à bord. Elles évoquent deux membres d’équipage. L’administrateur du territoire de Fizi, Sammy Kalonji Badibanga, livre une autre version. Il affirme que l’avion venait du Rwanda et transportait des militaires, du matériel ainsi que des vivres.
statements_all.translation_en: Sources linked to Twirwaneho-AFC/M23 present the aircraft as a civil aircraft linking Bukavu to Minembwe, with medicines and equipment on board. They mention two crew members. The Fizi territory administrator, Sammy Kalonji Badibanga, gives another version. He says the aircraft came from Rwanda and was carrying soldiers, equipment and food.

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post wrote that a civil plane carrying medicines was shot down near Minembwe on Thursday, and that the Fizi territory administrator 'under the Kinshasa regime' claimed the attack, saying the plane had been shot down by the FARDC.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Jeudi, un avion civil transportant des médicaments a été abattu près de Minembwe. Un incident survenu au lendemain d’une mission de vérification du cessez-le-feu. L’administrateur du territoire de Fizi sous le régime de Kinshasa a revendiqué l’attaque, affirmant que l’avion avait été abattu par les FARDC.
statements_all.translation_en: On Thursday, a civil plane carrying medicines was shot down near Minembwe. An incident that occurred the day after a ceasefire verification mission. The territory administrator of Fizi under the Kinshasa regime claimed the attack, stating that the plane had been shot down by the FARDC.

statements_all.text: According to Igihe, AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka said that DRC, Burundian, Wazalendo, FDLR and foreign mercenary forces began attacking Point-Zero, Nyaruhinga and Mukoko in Minembwe at about seven in the morning and that the DRC coalition was using combat drones and heavy weapons.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi w’ihuriro AFC/M23, Lawrence Kanyuka, yatangaje ko ingabo za RDC, iz’u Burundi, Wazalendo, FDLR n’abacanshuro b’abanyamahanga, byatangiye kugaba ibitero muri Point-Zero, Nyaruhinga na Mukoko muri Minembwe mu masaa moya y’igitondo. Kanyuka yasobanuye ko muri ibi bitero, ihuriro ry’ingabo za Leta ya RDC riri kwifashisha drones z’intambara ndetse n’imbunda ziremereye
statements_all.translation_en: AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka stated that the forces of the DRC, those of Burundi, Wazalendo, the FDLR and foreign mercenaries started launching attacks at Point-Zero, Nyaruhinga and Mukoko in Minembwe at around seven in the morning. Kanyuka explained that in these attacks the alliance of forces of the DRC government is using war drones as well as heavy guns

statements_all.text: RFI (carried by Yahoo Actualités) reported that, alongside Kinshasa's suspension of academic activities, a separate decision suspended the salaries of 48 agents accused of having joined AFC/M23, pledged allegiance to it or accepted positions under its authority, and that in response AFC/M23 deputy coordinator Bertrand Bisimwa announced a substitute mechanism; RFI added that UN experts' December 2025 report had said AFC/M23 ordered universities to cut their links with the Congolese higher-education ministry.
statements_all.excerpt_original: En réponse, Bertrand Bisimwa, coordonnateur adjoint de l'AFC/M23, annonce un mécanisme de substitution.
statements_all.translation_en: In response, Bertrand Bisimwa, deputy coordinator of the AFC/M23, announces a substitute mechanism.

statements_all.role: Minister of Higher and University Education
statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that the DRC higher-education ministry (ESURSI), headed by Marie-Thérèse Sombo, issued a ministerial order, announced on Tuesday 25 August 2026, suspending academic activities for academic year 2026-2027 at several institutions in Goma and Bukavu, including the Université Officielle de Bukavu, ISC-Bukavu, ISTM-Bukavu, ISP-Bukavu, ISDR-Bukavu and ISAM-Bukavu.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le ministère de l’Enseignement supérieur, universitaire, Recherche scientifique et Innovations (ESURSI), dirigé par Marie-Thérèse Sombo, a pris un arrêté ministériel portant suspension des activités académiques au sein de plusieurs établissements d’enseignement supérieur et universitaire des villes de Goma et de Bukavu, dans les provinces du Nord-Kivu et du Sud-Kivu.
statements_all.translation_en: The Ministry of Higher and University Education, Scientific Research and Innovation (ESURSI), headed by Marie-Thérèse Sombo, issued a ministerial order suspending academic activities within several higher-education and university institutions in the cities of Goma and Bukavu, in the provinces of North Kivu and South Kivu.

statements_all.text: Al Jazeera reported that Rwandan President Paul Kagame, at a news conference in Kigali, said that the FDLR's presence in the DRC is Rwanda's main concern and that 'if this problem is not resolved, it is natural for Rwanda to remain involved' in the conflict; Al Jazeera added that Rwanda denies Kinshasa's allegations against it.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Speaking at a news conference in Kigali, Kagame reiterated that the FDLR’s presence in the DRC is Rwanda’s main concern, adding that “if this problem is not resolved, it is natural for Rwanda to remain involved” in the conflict.

statements_all.text: Al Jazeera reported that Kagame said Rwanda has information that Congolese authorities 'are arming the FDLR and integrating its members into their own forces'.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Kagame said Rwanda has information that Congolese authorities “are arming the FDLR and integrating its members into their own forces”.

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that in a communiqué published on Monday 24 August 2026 the DRC government accused the Rwanda Defence Forces (RDF) and their AFC/M23 auxiliaries of summary executions, sexual violence, torture and abductions, citing consolidated data of more than 300 people killed in June and July 2026.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Dans un communiqué publié ce lundi 24 août 2026, Kinshasa accuse les Forces de défense rwandaises (RDF) et leurs supplétifs de l’AFC/M23 d’être responsables d’exécutions sommaires, de violences sexuelles, de tortures et d’enlèvements.
statements_all.translation_en: In a communiqué published this Monday 24 August 2026, Kinshasa accuses the Rwanda Defence Forces (RDF) and their AFC/M23 auxiliaries of being responsible for summary executions, sexual violence, torture and abductions.

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that the same government communiqué asserted that more than 100 families of Rwandan origin crossed the border via the Kabuhanga track in Nyiragongo territory on 10 August 2026 and were reportedly then settled at Rwibiranga (Buhumba groupement), and that Kinshasa denounced the imposition of taxes in areas controlled by the AFC/M23, including fees in schools and taxes reportedly imposed on health structures.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le communiqué affirme que, le 10 août 2026, plus de 100 familles d’origine rwandaise ont franchi la frontière par la piste de Kabuhanga, dans le territoire de Nyiragongo.
statements_all.translation_en: The communiqué asserts that, on 10 August 2026, more than 100 families of Rwandan origin crossed the border by the Kabuhanga track, in Nyiragongo territory.

statements_all.role: AFC-M23-appointed administrator of Masisi (as reported by KT Press)
statements_all.text: KT Press (Rwanda) reported that by 24-25 August 2026 the AFC-M23-appointed administrator of Masisi had visited Remeka, taken part in community work and launched maintenance of the Ngungu-Remeka road, and had urged remaining Wazalendo fighters to join AFC-M23.
statements_all.excerpt_original: By August 24–25, the AFC-M23-appointed administrator of Masisi had visited Remeka, participated in community work and launched maintenance of the Ngungu-Remeka road. He called for peaceful coexistence and urged remaining Wazalendo fighters to join AFC-M23.

statements_all.text: Rwandan outlet Umuryango reported that AFC/M23 spokesman Kanyuka said in a post on X on 21 August 2026 that civilians, including women and children, were killed in attacks at Luntukulu on the Nzibira road in South Kivu.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Mu butumwa yashyize kuri X ku wa 21 Kanama 2026, Kanyuka yavuze ko mu gace ka Luntukulu, ku muhanda wa Nzibira, abasivili barimo abagore n’abana baguye mu bitero.
statements_all.translation_en: In a message he posted on X on 21 August 2026, Kanyuka said that in the Luntukulu area, on the Nzibira road, civilians including women and children died in the attacks.

statements_all.text: Umuryango reported that Kanyuka, the rebel coalition's spokesman, also said the armed forces of the Democratic Republic of Congo were continuing to launch bomb attacks in the Minembwe area, and that kamikaze drones and TK-6 weapons were being used in these operations.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Kanyuka kandi yavuze ko ingabo za Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo zikomeje kugaba ibitero by’ibisasu mu gace ka Minembwe. Yavuze ko muri ibyo bikorwa hakoreshwa drones za kamikaze ndetse n’intwaro za TK-6
statements_all.translation_en: Kanyuka also said the armed forces of the Democratic Republic of Congo continue to launch bomb attacks in the Minembwe area. He said these operations use kamikaze drones and TK-6 weapons.

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that AFC-M23, in a communiqué, accused government coalition forces of summarily executing several civilians at Luntukulu, on the Nzibira axis; according to AFC-M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka the victims allegedly included women and children.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Dans un communiqué, l’AFC-M23 accuse les éléments des forces coalisées gouvernementales d’avoir sommairement exécuté plusieurs civils dans la localité de Luntukulu, sur l’axe Nzibira.
statements_all.translation_en: In a communiqué, the AFC-M23 accuses elements of the government coalition forces of having summarily executed several civilians in the locality of Luntukulu, on the Nzibira axis.

statements_all.text: Bwiza reported that FDNB spokesperson Brigadier General Gaspard Baratuza told journalists on Tuesday 29 September 2026 that Maj. Nitunga Jérémie and Capt Kanjori Félicien were arrested by the DRC state on 21 August 2026 and are held at the FARDC headquarters in Baraka, where they were arrested after being found with telephones, and that it is suspected they may have been used 'in improper activities or in giving certain information'.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Byemejwe n'umuvugizi wa FDNB, Général de Brigade Gaspard Baratuza, ubwo kuri uyu Kabiri tariki ya 29 Nzeri 2026 yagiranaga ikiganiro n’abanyamakuru.
statements_all.translation_en: This was confirmed by the FDNB spokesperson, Brigadier General Gaspard Baratuza, when on this Tuesday 29 September 2026 he held a conversation with journalists.

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that AFC/M23 coordinator Corneille Nangaa condemned on Wednesday 19 August 2026 remarks by opposition politician Martin Fayulu about the Banyamulenge community, calling them 'irresponsables' and 'incendiaires', in a statement on X.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le coordonnateur de l’AFC/M23, Corneille Nangaa, a condamné mercredi 19 août 2026 les propos tenus par l’opposant Martin Fayulu au sujet de la communauté banyamulenge, les qualifiant d’« irresponsables », d’« incendiaires » et de nature à fragiliser davantage la cohésion nationale en République démocratique du Congo.
statements_all.translation_en: The coordinator of the AFC/M23, Corneille Nangaa, condemned on Wednesday 19 August 2026 the remarks made by opposition figure Martin Fayulu about the Banyamulenge community, describing them as « irresponsible », « inflammatory » and likely to further weaken national cohesion in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

statements_all.role: commander of the Sukola 2 South Kivu operational sector
statements_all.text: Beto.cd reported that, after two bombs fell on the Mwalu hotel in Fizi-Centre, South Kivu, in the night of Tuesday to Wednesday 19 August 2026 around one o'clock in the morning, Colonel Michel Apoko Bangala, commander of the Sukola 2 South Kivu operational sector, reported two seriously wounded and major material damage, attributed the strike to Rwandan forces and spoke of TB2-type devices.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Dans la nuit du mardi au mercredi 19 août 2026, vers une heure du matin, deux bombes tombent sur l’hôtel Mwalu, à Fizi-Centre, au Sud-Kivu. Le colonel Michel Apoko Bangala, commandant du secteur opérationnel Sukola 2 Sud-Kivu, fait état de deux blessés graves et d’importants dégâts matériels, attribue la frappe aux forces rwandaises et parle d’engins de type TB2.
statements_all.translation_en: In the night of Tuesday to Wednesday 19 August 2026, around one o'clock in the morning, two bombs fall on the Mwalu hotel, in Fizi-Centre, South Kivu. Colonel Michel Apoko Bangala, commander of the Sukola 2 South Kivu operational sector, reports two seriously wounded and major material damage, attributes the strike to Rwandan forces and speaks of TB2-type devices.

statements_all.text: RFI reported that the newly built Mwalu hotel in Fizi-centre was hit by a drone strike at one in the morning in the night of 18 to 19 August, that two civilians were seriously injured, and that the Congolese army accuses the AFC/M23 of being behind the attack, citing two explosive devices dropped by drones.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Il a été touché par un tir de drone à Fizi-centre, ville sous contrôle de l'armée congolaise (FARDC), à environ 250 kilomètres au sud de Bukavu, le chef-lieu provincial. C'était à une heure du matin. Deux civils ont été grièvement blessés.
statements_all.translation_en: It was hit by a drone strike in Fizi-centre, a town under Congolese army (FARDC) control, about 250 kilometres south of Bukavu, the provincial capital. It was one in the morning. Two civilians were seriously injured.

statements_all.text: A joint statement by the representatives of the DRC Government and of the AFC, published by the US State Department after meetings in Switzerland, said the Parties developed a roadmap setting out sequenced steps and timelines for negotiations under the Doha Framework Agreement and agreed on the importance of a standardized method for reporting allegations of ceasefire violations.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Following this evaluation, the Parties developed a roadmap setting out sequenced steps and timelines for negotiations under the Doha Framework Agreement

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that Uvira's national deputy Claude Misare, in a letter of Monday 17 August to the Minister of National Defence, asked for clarification on the destination of resources for the support of Wazalendo deployed in combat zones.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Dans une lettre adressée lundi 17 août au ministre de la Défense nationale, Claude Misare demande des éclaircissements sur la destination de ces ressources, notamment sur les mécanismes de prise en charge des Wazalendo déployés dans les zones de combat.
statements_all.translation_en: In a letter addressed Monday 17 August to the Minister of National Defence, Claude Misare asks for clarification on the destination of these resources, notably the mechanisms for supporting Wazalendo deployed in combat zones.

statements_all.text: Umuryango.rw reported that AFC/M23 announced that on 17 August 2026 FARDC, FDLR and other armed groups working with the Kinshasa government launched simultaneous attacks (the spokesperson listing also FDLR, Wazalendo groups, foreign mercenaries and the Burundian army FDNB among the attackers) in places including Kalehe territory (Katare, Tushunguti, Nyamugari and Kivoka) and on the Minembwe line, with AFC-M23 saying 120mm mortars and KT-6 drones were used and that the attacks killed civilians and destroyed homes and schools.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Ihuriro AFC/M23 rirwanya ubutegetsi bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo ryatangaje ko ku wa 17 Kanama 2026, ingabo za FARDC, umurwe wa FDLR n’indi mitwe yitwaje intwaro ikorana na Guverinoma ya Kinshasa yagabye ibitero icyarimwe mu bice bitandukanye, birimo ibyo muri Teritwari ya Kalehe no ku murongo wa Minembwe.
statements_all.translation_en: The AFC/M23 alliance, which opposes the government of the Democratic Republic of Congo, announced that on 17 August 2026 the FARDC army, the FDLR group and other armed groups working with the Kinshasa government launched simultaneous attacks in different areas, including in Kalehe territory and on the Minembwe line.

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that, in a communiqué, the AFC-M23 accused the 'coalition forces of the Kinshasa regime' of launching simultaneous heavy-artillery attacks on densely populated areas of Kalehe territory (Rumbishi, Chambombo, Cyamatare and Gasovu), which spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka said caused several deaths and forced many civilians to flee. The outlet added that the Congolese army had not yet reacted.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Dans un communiqué, l’ AFC-M23 a accusé les forces coalisées du régime de Kinshasa d’avoir lancé des attaques simultanées à l’artillerie lourde contre plusieurs zones densément peuplées du territoire de Kalehe, notamment Rumbishi, Chambombo, Cyamatare et Gasovu.
statements_all.translation_en: In a communiqué, the AFC-M23 accused the coalition forces of the Kinshasa regime of launching simultaneous heavy-artillery attacks against several densely populated areas of Kalehe territory, notably Rumbishi, Chambombo, Cyamatare and Gasovu.

statements_all.text: A joint statement by the governments taking part in the sixth Joint Security Coordination Mechanism meeting in Geneva (DRC, Rwanda, US, Qatar, Togo as AU mediator, AU Commission), published by the US State Department, said the DRC and Rwanda agreed to advance two initiatives to strengthen monitoring and verification of Washington Accords implementation on the ground.
statements_all.excerpt_original: The DRC and Rwanda agreed to advance two initiatives to strengthen monitoring and verification of Washington Accords implementation on the ground.

statements_all.text: Bwiza reported that AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka said on X on Tuesday 11 August 2026 that the Kinshasa government's forces, including FARDC, FDLR, Wazalendo groups, foreign mercenaries and the Burundian army (FDNB), had launched general attacks from 05:00 with heavy weapons on densely populated parts of Kalehe territory, including Chambombo, Cyangugu, Kaziba ya Rumbishi, Kwisimbi and Gafufura, with some residents killed and injured.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi w'uyu mutwe, Lawrence Kanyuka, yifashishije urubuga nkoranyambaga rwa X yatangaje ko biriya bitero byibasiye ahantu hatuwe cyane byagabwe n'Ingabo za Leta ya RDC, FARDC, umutwe wa FDLR, imitwe yitwaje intwaro ya Wazalendo, abacanshuro b'abanyamahanga ndetse n'Ingabo z'u Burundi, FDNB.
statements_all.translation_en: The spokesperson of this group, Lawrence Kanyuka, using the social network X, announced that those attacks, which struck heavily inhabited places, were carried out by the Army of the DRC government, FARDC, the FDLR group, the Wazalendo armed groups, foreign mercenaries and the Burundian Army, FDNB.

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that the Congolese Ministry of Higher Education (ESU-RSI) firmly condemned on Monday 10 August the AFC/M23's appointments at several public higher-education institutions in Goma and Bukavu, calling the appointments publicised on 7 August 2026 by the de facto authorities a 'grave and unacceptable interference'.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le ministère de l’Enseignement supérieur, universitaire, de la Recherche scientifique et des Innovations (ESU-RSI) a fermement condamné, ce lundi 10 aout, les nominations effectuées par l’AFC/M23 au sein de plusieurs établissements publics d’enseignement supérieur et universitaire de Goma et Bukavu, dans les provinces du Nord-Kivu et du Sud-Kivu.
statements_all.translation_en: The Ministry of Higher, University Education, Scientific Research and Innovation (ESU-RSI) firmly condemned this Monday 10 August the appointments made by the AFC/M23 within several public higher and university education institutions of Goma and Bukavu, in North Kivu and South Kivu provinces.

statements_all.person: lieutenant de second classe Meya Gbé Jérémie
statements_all.text: La Prunelle RDC reported that in a communication published on Friday 7 August the FARDC operational sector Sukola 2 Nord–Sud-Kivu said RDF-AFC-M23 coalition fighters had tried an incursion into Bunje (Ziralo grouping) before firing several 82 mm mortar rounds towards inhabited areas, which according to the army killed three people, including a woman and her two children, and seriously wounded several; the sector's spokesperson, Second Lieutenant Meya Gbé Jérémie, said the coalition had fired 'à l’aveuglette' into densely populated areas.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Selon l’armée, ces tirs auraient touché des agglomérations densément peuplées et fait trois morts , dont une femme et ses deux enfants, ainsi que plusieurs blessés graves.
statements_all.translation_en: According to the army, these shots reportedly hit densely populated areas and killed three people, including a woman and her two children, and seriously wounded several.

statements_all.text: La Prunelle RDC reported that Lawrence Kanyuka, spokesperson of the armed movement, in a communication on X accused the coalition forces of the Kinshasa government of having bombed the Lumbishi market, the movement first reporting five civilians dead and several wounded and then, in an update, 9 dead.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Dans une communication diffusée sur X, son porte-parole Lawrence Kanyuka accuse les forces coalisées du gouvernement de Kinshasa d’avoir bombardé le marché de Lumbishi. Dans un premier bilan, le mouvement armé avait fait état de cinq morts parmi les civils et de plusieurs blessés .
statements_all.translation_en: In a communication broadcast on X, its spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka accuses the coalition forces of the Kinshasa government of having bombed the Lumbishi market. In a first toll, the armed movement had reported five dead among civilians and several wounded.

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that the United States, via Massad Boulos on X, acknowledged the first transport and transfer of 15 detainees from DRC authorities to AFC/M23 under the Doha prisoner-exchange mechanism.
statements_all.excerpt_original: « Les Etats-Unis reconnaissent le premier transport et transfert de 15 détenus des autorités de la RDC vers l’AFC/M23 dans le cadre du mécanisme d’échange de prisonniers du cadre de Doha », a déclaré sur X Massad Boulos, conseiller principal américain pour l’Afrique
statements_all.translation_en: "The United States recognises the first transport and transfer of 15 detainees from the DRC authorities to AFC/M23 under the Doha framework's prisoner-exchange mechanism," said Massad Boulos, US senior adviser for Africa, on X

statements_all.role: military spokesperson quoted by Actualite.cd (role not stated in the excerpt)
statements_all.setting: statement to the press as reported
statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that Lieutenant Reagan Mbuyi Kalonji attributed the 7 August 2026 fire at Bundje to the RDF/AFC-M23 coalition, saying it had launched 82 mm mortar bombs blindly into densely populated areas, killing three people including a woman and her two children.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Au moins trois personnes, dont une femme et ses deux enfants, ont été tuées et plusieurs autres blessées vendredi 7 août 2026 lors d’affrontements entre les combattants Wazalendo et les éléments de l’AFC/M23 à Bundje, dans le groupement de Ziralo, chefferie de Buhavu, en territoire de Kalehe, au Sud-Kivu.
statements_all.translation_en: At least three people, including a woman and her two children, were killed and several others wounded on Friday 7 August 2026 during clashes between Wazalendo fighters and AFC/M23 elements at Bundje, in the Ziralo groupement, Buhavu chiefdom, in Kalehe territory, in South Kivu.

statements_all.role: spokesperson, Sukola 2 Nord Sud-Kivu operational sector
statements_all.setting: statement to the press as reported
statements_all.text: 7sur7.cd quoted the army spokesperson in the Sukola 2 Nord Sud-Kivu operational sector, named by the outlet as Sous-lieutenant Jérémie Meya, as saying that the RDF/AFC-M23 coalition tried unsuccessfully to make an incursion into Bunje on Friday 7 August and threw bombs blindly at populated areas, killing three civilians including a woman and her two children, and that the FARDC condemn these violations and reserve the right to respond.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Selon le porte-parole de l'armée dans le secteur opérationnel Sukola 2 Nord Sud-Kivu, Sous-lieutenant Jérémie Meya, les victimes ont été tuées dans des bombardements des rebelles du M23.
statements_all.translation_en: According to the army spokesperson in the Sukola 2 Nord South Kivu operational sector, Sub-lieutenant Jérémie Meya, the victims were killed in bombardments by the M23 rebels.

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that the Vice-Governor of South Kivu, Jean-Jacques Elakano, urged all Wazalendo components to act responsibly and respect the provisions set by the Provincial Security Council, and called for the dismantling of all unauthorised barriers.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Réagissant à ces dénonciations, le vice-gouverneur du Sud-Kivu, Jean-Jacques Elakano, a exhorté toutes les composantes des Wazalendo à faire preuve de responsabilité et à respecter les dispositions arrêtées par le Conseil provincial de sécurité. Il a notamment appelé au démantèlement de toutes les barrières non autorisées, afin de mettre fin aux perceptions illégales signalées par les usagers.
statements_all.translation_en: Reacting to these denunciations, the vice-governor of South Kivu, Jean-Jacques Elakano, urged all components of the Wazalendo to show responsibility and respect the provisions set by the Provincial Security Council. He notably called for the dismantling of all unauthorised barriers, in order to end the illegal levies reported by users.

statements_all.setting: social-media post (X) as reported by Bwiza
statements_all.text: Bwiza reported that Rwandan government spokesperson Yolande Makolo, on X, accused Muyaya of continuing to turn the day of remembrance for the victims of the Gatumba killings into a platform for spreading messages against Rwanda; Bwiza reported that Muyaya had also accused Rwanda of having links with M23 and with the Twirwaneho and Red-Tabara groups.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Yolande Makolo yifashishije urubuga rwa X, yashinje Muyaya kuba akomeje guhindura umunsi wo kwibuka abazize ubwicanyi bwo mu Gatumba urubuga rwo gukwirakwizamo ubutumwa burwanya u Rwanda.
statements_all.translation_en: Yolande Makolo, using the X platform, accused Muyaya of continuing to turn the day of remembrance for the victims of the Gatumba killings into a platform for spreading messages against Rwanda.

statements_all.setting: warning as reported by Enquête.cd (date of the warning not given)
statements_all.text: Enquête.cd reported that the military governor of North Kivu, Major General Evariste Somo Kakule, had recently warned that anyone who obstructed Ebola response operations or attacked the agents mobilised would be severely punished.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le gouverneur militaire du Nord-Kivu, le général-major Evariste Somo Kakule, avait récemment averti que toute personne qui entraverait les opérations de riposte contre Ebola ou s’en prendrait aux agents mobilisés serait sévèrement sanctionnée.
statements_all.translation_en: The military governor of North Kivu, Major General Evariste Somo Kakule, had recently warned that anyone who hindered the Ebola response operations or attacked the agents mobilised would be severely punished.

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that DRC Minister of Regional Integration Floribert Anzuluni confirmed at a press briefing in Kinshasa on Tuesday 28 July that the FDLR had signed a protocol of demilitarisation, demobilisation and cantonment.
statements_all.excerpt_original: le ministre de l'Intégration régionale, Floribert Anzuluni, a confirmé la signature, par les FDLR (Forces démocratiques de libération du Rwanda), d'un protocole de démilitarisation, de démobilisation et de cantonnement. Selon le ministre qui s'exprimait ce mardi 28 juillet lors du briefing de presse à Kinshasa
statements_all.translation_en: the Minister of Regional Integration, Floribert Anzuluni, confirmed the signature, by the FDLR (Forces démocratiques de libération du Rwanda), of a protocol of demilitarisation, demobilisation and cantonment. According to the minister, who was speaking this Tuesday 28 July at the press briefing in Kinshasa

statements_all.setting: communiqué/announcement as reported by the Secretary-General
statements_all.text: The UN Secretary-General reported that on 28 July the Government of the Democratic Republic of the Congo announced that a faction of FDLR elements had signed a protocol on disarmament, demobilization and cantonment through sensitization, and that the Government of Rwanda rejected the plan, arguing that the Washington Accords require the verifiable neutralization of FDLR and claiming it was a delaying tactic by the DRC Government.
statements_all.excerpt_original: On 28 July, the Government of the Democratic Republic of the Congo announced that a faction of FDLR elements had signed a protocol on disarmament, demobilization and cantonment through sensitization,

statements_all.text: Forum des As reported that Muyaya said the dialogue announced by President Tshisekedi is intended for national actors who have not taken up arms and must remain complementary to the diplomatic processes in Washington and Doha.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Patrick Muyaya rappelle, par ailleurs, que le dialogue voulu par le chef de l’État est destiné aux acteurs nationaux n’ayant pas pris les armes. Il précise également que cette initiative devra rester complémentaire aux processus diplomatiques en cours, notamment ceux engagés à Washington et à Doha.
statements_all.translation_en: Patrick Muyaya also recalls that the dialogue wanted by the head of state is intended for national actors who have not taken up arms. He also specifies that this initiative must remain complementary to the diplomatic processes under way, notably those begun in Washington and Doha.

statements_all.text: Forum des As reported that government spokesperson Patrick Muyaya wrote in a post on X on Thursday 23 July that demanding the participation of the 'son', M23/AFC, in the dialogue between Congolese was directly demanding that of the 'father', Rwanda; the outlet added that the government considers the links between the rebel movement and Kigali established.
statements_all.excerpt_original: « Réclamer la participation du fils, M23/AFC, au dialogue entre Congolais, n’est-ce pas réclamer directement la participation du père, le Rwanda ? », a-t-il écrit. Le Gouvernement considère, en effet, que les liens entre le mouvement rebelle et Kigali sont avérés.
statements_all.translation_en: "Demanding the participation of the son, M23/AFC, in the dialogue between Congolese, is that not directly demanding the participation of the father, Rwanda?" he wrote. The Government considers that the links between the rebel movement and Kigali are established.

statements_all.role: coordinator of the civil society of North Kivu
statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that, in a declaration on Tuesday 21 July in Mangina, Beni territory, the coordination of North Kivu civil society implicated the ADF in the north and the AFC/M23 coalition in the south in the worsening security situation; its coordinator John Banyene said: 'Le M23 continue de massacrer, torturer, violer, piller les ressources naturelles et les biens de la population'. Radio Okapi, summarising the declaration, said the rebels were deploying recently trained troops at Tchanzu with logistical support from the Rwanda Defence Forces (RDF).
statements_all.excerpt_original: John Banyene, coordonnateur de la société civile du Nord-Kivu, dénonce les exactions commises dans les zones sous contrôle des rebelles : « Le M23 continue de massacrer, torturer, violer, piller les ressources naturelles et les biens de la population
statements_all.translation_en: John Banyene, coordinator of North Kivu civil society, denounces the abuses committed in the rebel-controlled zones: "The M23 continues to massacre, torture, rape, plunder the natural resources and the property of the population

statements_all.text: Mediacongo reported that, speaking to the press, the Congolese government spokesperson said Rwanda uses ambulances to transport drones intended to carry out attacks on civilians in South Kivu, and that he described these practices as war crimes.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le porte-parole du gouvernement congolais révèle que le Rwanda utilise des ambulances pour transporter des drones destinés à mener des attaques contre les civils au Sud-Kivu. Il a qualifié ces pratiques de crimes de guerre.
statements_all.translation_en: The Congolese government spokesperson reveals that Rwanda uses ambulances to transport drones intended to carry out attacks against civilians in South Kivu. He described these practices as war crimes.

statements_all.text: Fizi territory administrator Samy Badibanga reported that Rwandan air force fighter jets had once again bombed Rugezi, Mulima, Point Zéro, Kazaroho, Bilalo Mbili and Mikenge on Wednesday 8 July 2026, causing enormous material and human damage; the territorial authority said several civilians were wounded in these bombings.
statements_all.excerpt_original: « Les avions de chasse de l’armée de l’air du Rwanda ont une fois de plus bombardé les agglomérations de Rugezi, Mulima, Point Zéro, Kazaroho, Bilalo Mbili et Mikenge, causant d’énormes dégâts matériels et humains, ce mercredi 8 juillet 2026 » , a rapporté l’administrateur du territoire de Fizi, Samy Badibanga.
statements_all.translation_en: "Rwandan air force fighter jets have once again bombed the agglomerations of Rugezi, Mulima, Point Zéro, Kazaroho, Bilalo Mbili and Mikenge, causing enormous material and human damage, this Wednesday 8 July 2026," reported the Fizi territory administrator, Samy Badibanga.

statements_all.setting: speech at the Security Council, as reported
statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that Prime Minister Judith Suminwa, chairing the Security Council's 10190th meeting on 8 July 2026 in New York, denounced sexual violence in eastern DRC, which she attributed to armed groups and foreign forces including Rwanda, saying that in zones affected by armed groups and under occupation by foreign forces, including Rwanda, these violences were linked to forced displacement, illicit economies and predation.
statements_all.excerpt_original: La Première ministre, Judith Suminwa a présidé ce mercredi 8 juillet 2026 à New York, aux États-Unis d’Amérique, la 10190e séance du Conseil de sécurité des Nations unies
statements_all.translation_en: The Prime Minister, Judith Suminwa, chaired on Wednesday 8 July 2026 in New York, in the United States of America, the 10190th meeting of the Security Council of the United Nations

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that Congolese government spokesperson Patrick Muyaya, at a press briefing, said of the Hauts-Plateaux that 'le Rwanda excelle avec des tirs de drones à partir de son territoire', calling this once again proof of bad faith in not advancing the peace process, and added that the armed forces were well mobilised. This is the Kinshasa government's accusation.
statements_all.excerpt_original: « Vous suivez certainement aussi la situation sécuritaire dans les Hauts-Plateaux, où le Rwanda excelle avec des tirs de drones à partir de son territoire. C’est encore une nouvelle fois une preuve de la mauvaise foi pour ne pas avancer dans le processus qui est prévu, le processus de paix. Mais nos forces armées sont bien mobilisées », a déclaré Patrick Muyaya lors d’un briefing presse.
statements_all.translation_en: "You are surely also following the security situation in the Hauts-Plateaux, where Rwanda excels with drone fire from its territory. It is once again proof of bad faith in not advancing the process that is planned, the peace process. But our armed forces are well mobilised", Patrick Muyaya said during a press briefing.

statements_all.text: MediaCongo reported that UN Secretary-General's spokesperson Stéphane Dujarric on Monday condemned drone attacks reported in Fizi, Mwenga and Uvira territories, South Kivu, without identifying their authors, and that according to the UN violent clashes since 4 July, including reported drone attacks, had reportedly left at least five dead and dozens wounded among civilians.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le porte-parole du secrétaire général de l’ONU, Stéphane Dujarric a condamné lundi les attaques de drones signalées dans les territoires de Fizi, Mwenga et Uvira, situés dans la province du Sud-Kivu, dans l’est de la République démocratique du Congo (RDC), sans identifier leurs auteurs.
statements_all.translation_en: The spokesperson of the UN Secretary-General, Stéphane Dujarric, on Monday condemned the drone attacks reported in the territories of Fizi, Mwenga and Uvira, located in South Kivu province, in the east of the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), without identifying their perpetrators.

statements_all.role: Lieutenant, spokesperson of operation Sukola 2 Sud Sud-Kivu
statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that Lieutenant Reagan Mbuyi Kalonji, spokesperson of operation Sukola 2 Sud Sud-Kivu, said the positions of Kimete, Wihene and Kashamata had been retaken by the army, and that AFC/M23-Twirwaneho - RDF - Red Tabara elements had been forced to fall back towards Rugezi and Bigaragara, south of Minembwe.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Selon le lieutenant Reagan Mbuyi Kalonji, porte-parole de l'opération Sukola 2 Sud Sud-Kivu, « les positions stratégiques de Kimete, Wihene et Kashamata ont été reprises par l'armée loyaliste ». « Les éléments de la coalition rebelle AFC/M23-Twirwaneho - RDF - Red Tabara ont été contraints de se replier en direction de Rugezi et Bigaragara, au sud de Minembwe », selon le porte-parole militaire.
statements_all.translation_en: According to Lieutenant Reagan Mbuyi Kalonji, spokesperson of operation Sukola 2 Sud Sud-Kivu, "the strategic positions of Kimete, Wihene and Kashamata were retaken by the loyalist army". "The elements of the rebel coalition AFC/M23-Twirwaneho - RDF - Red Tabara were forced to fall back towards Rugezi and Bigaragara, south of Minembwe", according to the military spokesperson.

statements_all.setting: statement at a security council meeting, as reported
statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that the vice-governor of South Kivu, Jean-Jacques Elakano, at a security council meeting held on Monday in Uvira, denied rumours of the fall of Baraka to the rebels and urged the population to stay calm and carry on with their activities.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Cette assurance est partagée par le vice‑gouverneur du Sud‑Kivu, Jean‑Jacques Elakano. Lors d’une réunion du conseil de sécurité tenue ce lundi à Uvira, il a démenti les rumeurs évoquant la chute de Baraka aux mains des rebelles, invitant la population au calme et à poursuivre ses activités.
statements_all.translation_en: This assurance is shared by the vice-governor of South Kivu, Jean-Jacques Elakano. At a security council meeting held on Monday in Uvira, he denied rumours of the fall of Baraka into the hands of the rebels, urging the population to remain calm and continue their activities.

statements_all.text: SOS Médias Burundi reported that, in a statement signed by Fidèle Rugabo, the military spokesperson for the armed group Twirwaneho, the fighters claimed to have launched an offensive on Saturday, July 4, against the Point Zero position, before taking control after several hours of fighting; the outlet said no official reaction had been recorded at the time of publication.
statements_all.excerpt_original: In a statement signed by Fidèle Rugabo, the military spokesperson for the armed group Twirwaneho, the fighters claim to have launched an offensive on Saturday, July 4, against the Point Zero position, before taking control after several hours of fighting.

statements_all.text: Twirwaneho officer Col Fidele Rugabo announced, according to Igihe, that Twirwaneho had taken Point-Zéro, Baruta, Kalonge, Bicumbi and Rubemba at 'saa munani y’igicuku' on 4 July 2026, ending military operations at Point-Zéro at 'saa munani n’iminota 35'.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Col Fidele Rugabo uri mu bofisiye bakuru ba Twirwaneho, yatangaje ko bafashe Point-Zéro, Baruta, Kalonge, Bicumbi na Rubemba mu masaha ya Saa munani y’igicuku cyo kuri uyu wa 4 Nyakanga 2026.
statements_all.translation_en: Col Fidele Rugabo, one of the senior officers of Twirwaneho, announced that they had taken Point-Zéro, Baruta, Kalonge, Bicumbi and Rubemba at around 2 a.m. (saa munani y'igicuku, Kinyarwanda time) on this 4 July 2026.

statements_all.text: Col Fidele Rugabo said, according to Igihe, that the DRC, Burundian, FDLR and Wazalendo forces had been shamed by Twirwaneho and M23 fighters, and he greeted residents of Fizi and Baraka, hinting that Twirwaneho might take those places too.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Col Fidele Rugabo uri mu bofisiye bakuru ba Twirwaneho, yatangaje ko bafashe Point-Zéro, Baruta, Kalonge, Bicumbi na Rubemba mu masaha ya Saa munani y’igicuku cyo kuri uyu wa 4 Nyakanga 2026. Yagize ati “Ibikorwa bya gisirikare muri Point-Zéro birangiye aka kanya saa munani n’iminota 35. Point-Zéro, Baruta, Kalonge, Bicumbi na Rubemba byafashwe. Abanzi bakwiye imishwaro mu buryo burindwi.” Uyu murwanyi yatangaje ko Ingabo za RDC, iz’u Burundi, umutwe w’iterabwoba wa FDLR na Wazalendo zitewe ikimwaro n’abarwanyi ba Twirwaneho na M23, asuhuza abo muri Fizi na Baraka; aca amarenga ko na ho bashobora kuhafata.
statements_all.translation_en: This fighter announced that the DRC forces, those of Burundi, the terrorist group FDLR and Wazalendo are shamed by the fighters of Twirwaneho and M23; he greeted those in Fizi and Baraka, hinting that they could take those places too.

statements_all.setting: statement to the press as reported
statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that the spokesperson of the 34th military region, Major Dieudonné Kasereka, rejected the AFC/M23's version of the Kabizo killings and denounced a disinformation campaign meant, in his words, to conceal abuses committed by RDF/AFC-M23 elements.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Cette version a été rejetée par le porte-parole de la 34e région militaire, major Dieudonné Kasereka. Ce dernier dénonce une campagne de désinformation visant, selon lui, à dissimuler les exactions « commises par les éléments du RDF/AFC-M23 »
statements_all.translation_en: This version was rejected by the spokesperson of the 34th military region, Major Dieudonné Kasereka. He denounces a disinformation campaign aimed, according to him, at concealing the abuses "committed by the elements of the RDF/AFC-M23"

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that, on its X account, the AFC/M23 attributed the Kabizo attack to FDLR rebels, whom it accused of acting in collaboration with the FARDC.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Sur son compte X, l’AFC/M23 attribue l’attaque aux rebelles FDLR qu’il accuse d’agir en collaboration avec les FARDC.
statements_all.translation_en: On its X account, the AFC/M23 attributes the attack to the FDLR rebels, whom it accuses of acting in collaboration with the FARDC.

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that the Fizi territory administrator, Samy Badibanga, said: 'Les infrastructures sanitaires et scolaires ont été détruites, et plusieurs élèves ont vu leurs écoles anéanties dans les villages de Mulima, Kangouli et leurs environs' (health and school infrastructure destroyed; several pupils' schools wiped out in Mulima, Kangouli and surroundings). The source does not name or number the health facilities.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Les infrastructures sanitaires et scolaires ont été détruites, et plusieurs élèves ont vu leurs écoles anéanties dans les villages de Mulima, Kangouli et leurs environs », a détaillé l’administrateur du territoire de Fizi, Samy Badibanga.
statements_all.translation_en: "Health and school infrastructure were destroyed, and several pupils saw their schools wiped out in the villages of Mulima, Kangouli and surroundings", detailed the Fizi territory administrator, Samy Badibanga.

statements_all.role: minister / government spokesperson (title not stated in the excerpt)
statements_all.text: Congolese government spokesperson Patrick Muyaya said in an RFI interview that he could share images in which Rwanda uses ambulances to transport drones and carry out attacks using the medical equipment of an ambulance; he called it a serious and substantiated accusation and said: "It is a war crime."
statements_all.excerpt_original: Je pourrais vous partager des images sur lesquelles le Rwanda utilise les ambulances pour transporter des drones et faire des attaques en partant de l'utilisation des matériels médicaux d'une ambulance. C'est une accusation grave. C'est une accusation qui est étayée. C'est un crime de guerre.
statements_all.translation_en: I could share with you images in which Rwanda uses ambulances to transport drones and carry out attacks, using the medical equipment of an ambulance. It is a serious accusation. It is a substantiated accusation. It is a war crime.

statements_all.text: Bwiza reported that, in Lubero where the AFC/M23 permanent secretary was visiting development projects, he told residents of Kanyabayonga that they would not be abandoned and said: 'we are still here, we are going nowhere', rejecting social-media claims that the group would leave.
statements_all.excerpt_original: I Lubero, aho Umunyamabanga Uhoraho wa AFC/ M23 yasuraga ibikorwa by'iterambere biri gushyirwa mu bikorwa n'ihuriro, yaboneyeho kuganira n'abaturage ba Kanyabayonga abizeza ko batazabatererana. Ati: "Kuva imbuga nkoranyambaga zabeshya abaturage ko tuzagenda turi he? Turacyari hano, ntaho tuzajya, kandi nijeje abaturage ko tutari hano ngo tuzahave, ahubwo turi hano ngo dushimangire amahoro bafite
statements_all.translation_en: In Lubero, where the permanent secretary of AFC/M23 was visiting the development projects being carried out by the alliance, he took the opportunity to talk to the residents of Kanyabayonga and reassured them that they would not be abandoned. He said: "Since when did social media lie to residents that we are leaving, where are we? We are still here, we are going nowhere, and I assured residents that we are not here to leave, but we are here to strengthen the peace they have"

statements_all.text: Umuryango reported that the AFC/M23 announced that fighting in the Minembwe commune, South Kivu, had ended after it said it had taken areas held by the FARDC and their allies, and said it had captured Point-Zéro, Mikenke, Kalingi, Ilundu and Rwitsankuku; the message was given by AFC/M23 deputy leader Bisimwa during a visit to the area.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Ihuriro AFC/M23 ryatangaje ko ibikorwa by’imirwano muri Komini ya Minembwe, mu Ntara ya Kivu y’Amajyepfo, byasojwe nyuma y’uko rivuga ko ryigaruriye ibice byari bifitwe n’ingabo za Leta ya Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo (FARDC) n’abo bafatanyaga.
statements_all.translation_en: The AFC/M23 coalition announced that fighting operations in the Minembwe commune, South Kivu Province, had ended after it says it took areas that had been held by the forces of the DRC government (FARDC) and their allies.

statements_all.setting: statement as reported (medium not stated by the page)
statements_all.text: Afrikarabia reported that Rwandan Foreign Minister Olivier Nduhungirehe considered the DRC's announcement of an FDLR surrender protocol a 'grossière manipulation' that is in no way consistent with the Washington accords.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le ministre rwandais des Affaires étrangères, Olivier Nduhungirehe, estime que l’annonce du protocole de reddition des FDLR constitue une « grossière manipulation » qui n’est « en rien conforme aux accords de Washington, qui ne le prévoit nulle part ».
statements_all.translation_en: The Rwandan Foreign Minister, Olivier Nduhungirehe, considers that the announcement of the FDLR surrender protocol is a “gross manipulation” that is “in no way consistent with the Washington accords, which does not provide for it anywhere”.

statements_all.text: Afrikarabia reported that Rwandan government spokesperson Yolande Makolo, on X, rejected a 'protocole négocié avec une milice génocidaire que le gouvernement de la RDC continue d'armer et de soutenir' and said the FDLR remain integrated in the Congolese army and active on the front lines.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Mais à Kigali, on ne veut pas entendre parler d’un « protocole négocié avec une milice génocidaire que le gouvernement de la RDC continue d’armer et de soutenir », comme l’a souligné sur le réseau X la porte-parole du gouvernement rwandais. Yolande Makolo estime que les FDLR « r estent intégrés à l’armée congolaise et actifs sur les lignes de fronts
statements_all.translation_en: But in Kigali, they do not want to hear about a “protocol negotiated with a genocidal militia that the DRC government continues to arm and support”, as the Rwandan government spokesperson underlined on X. Yolande Makolo believes that the FDLR “remain integrated in the Congolese army and active on the front lines

statements_all.role: deputy AFC/M23 coordinator for politics, diplomacy and governance
statements_all.setting: address to Minembwe residents, as reported
statements_all.text: AFC/M23 said, according to Igihe, that no residents of Minembwe commune would be killed again by the government forces coalition because the war there was over; AFC/M23 deputy leader for political affairs, diplomacy and governance Bertand Bisimwa (as Igihe spells the name) delivered the message to Minembwe residents.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Ihuriro AFC/M23 rirwanya ubutegetsi bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, ryatangaje ko nta baturage bo muri Komini ya Minembwe bazongera kwicwa n’ihuriro ry’Ingabo za Leta kuko intambara yaho yarangiye.
statements_all.translation_en: The AFC/M23 alliance, which opposes the government of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, announced that no residents of Minembwe commune will be killed again by the coalition of Government forces because the war there has ended.

statements_all.text: AFC/M23 deputy leader Bertand Bisimwa said, according to Igihe, that AFC/M23 fighters from many parts of the country and MRDP Twirwaneho had united to stop what he described as a plan by the DRC government forces to wipe out Congolese because of their ethnic origin.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Bisimwa yatangaje ko abarwanyi ba AFC/M23 bakomoka mu bice byinshi by’igihugu n’aba MRDP Twirwaneho zunze ubumwe kugira ngo zihagarike umugambi w’ingabo za Leta ya RDC zifite umugambi wo kurimbura Abanye-Congo zibahora ubwoko bwabo.
statements_all.translation_en: Bisimwa announced that AFC/M23 fighters from many parts of the country and those of MRDP Twirwaneho have united to stop the plan of the DRC government forces, which intend to wipe out Congolese because of their ethnic group.

statements_all.role: deputy AFC/M23 coordinator for politics, diplomacy and governance
statements_all.setting: social-media post (X) as reported by Igihe
statements_all.text: AFC/M23 deputy leader Bertrand Bisimwa criticised the United Nations on X, according to Igihe, after the UN sanctioned several AFC/M23 leaders, saying it had been misled and was driven by emotion, and that sanctioning only the side that respects its peace commitments showed the UN had lost its way.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Umuyobozi wungirije w’Ihuriro AFC/M23 ushinzwe ibikorwa bya politiki, dipolomasi n’imiyoborere, Bertrand Bisimwa, yanenze Umuryango w’Abibumbye uheruka gufatira ibihano bamwe mu bayobozi b’iryo huriro, agaragaza ko wavangiwe kandi uyoborwa n’amarangamutima.
statements_all.translation_en: The deputy leader of the AFC/M23 alliance in charge of politics, diplomacy and governance, Bertrand Bisimwa, criticised the United Nations, which recently sanctioned some of the alliance's leaders, showing that it was misled and is driven by emotion.

statements_all.setting: social-media post (X) as reported by Igihe
statements_all.text: Bisimwa said, according to Igihe, that putting pressure on people affected by ethnic discrimination to leave their land is a grave mistake that will have consequences.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Yagaragaje ko gushyira igitutu ku bagizweho ingaruka n’ibikorwa by’ivangura bishingiye ku moko ngo bave ku butaka bwabo ari ikosa rikomeye kandi rizagira ingaruka. Yerekanye ko ibyo bishobora kugira ingaruka ku kuba impande zihanganye zakomeza gukaza umurego, kwiyongera no kurushaho gukomere kw’ibikorwa by’urugomo n’ihohoterwa no kudindira ku rugendo rugamije kugera ku mahoro. Bisimwa yavuze ko politiki ishingiye ku rwango no ku ivangura, n'iyo yashyigikirwa n'Isi yose, idashobora na rimwe gutsinda ubutabera n'amahoro arambye.
statements_all.translation_en: He showed that putting pressure on those affected by ethnically based discrimination to leave their land is a serious mistake that will have consequences.

statements_all.text: Igihe reported that Twirwaneho and M23 had accused the DRC government forces coalition of using Point-Zéro to prepare major attacks on Minembwe centre and other key Banyamulenge areas including Mikenke.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Twirwaneho na M23 byashinjaga ihuriro ry’Ingabo za Leta ya RDC gutegurira muri Point-Zéro ibitero bikomeye zagabaga muri Santere ya Minembwe no mu bindi bice by’ingenzi bituyemo Abanyamulenge birimo Mikenke.
statements_all.translation_en: Twirwaneho and M23 had been accusing the coalition of DRC government forces of preparing at Point-Zéro the major attacks it was launching on Minembwe Centre and other key areas inhabited by Banyamulenge, including Mikenke.

statements_all.text: UN News reported that the Security Council renewed on Monday, until 1 July 2027, the sanctions regime on armed groups active in the DRC and the mandate of its Group of Experts, and in its resolution reaffirmed its demand for an 'immediate and unconditional' withdrawal of Rwandan forces from Congolese territory, an end to Kigali's support for M23 and an end to Congolese army support for the FDLR.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Dans sa résolution, le Conseil réaffirme son exigence d'un retrait « immédiat et inconditionnel » des forces rwandaises du territoire congolais, la fin du soutien de Kigali au M23 et la cessation de l’appui apporté par l'armée congolaise aux FDLR.
statements_all.translation_en: In its resolution, the Council reaffirms its demand for an 'immediate and unconditional' withdrawal of Rwandan forces from Congo's territory, the end of Kigali support for M23 and the cessation of support provided by the Congo's army to the FDLR.

statements_all.text: BBC News Gahuza reported that Rwandan Foreign Minister Olivier Nduhungirehe, in a France 24 interview broadcast on Monday, wondered why Rwanda 'alone' is being sanctioned although the US-led peace agreement signed in December 2025 concerns both sides, and said of the sanctions: 'Those sanctions first of all are unfair to us, they concern one side and are not productive.'
statements_all.excerpt_original: Mu kiganiro yagiranye na televiziyo France 24 cyatangajwe ku wa mbere, Minisitiri w'ububanyi n'amahanga w'u Rwanda Olivier Nduhungirehe yibajije impamvu u Rwanda "rwonyine" ari rwo rufatirwa ibihano, mu gihe amasezerano y'amahoro – yayobowe n'Amerika yashyizweho umukono mu Kuboza (12) mu 2025 hagati ya Perezida w'u Rwanda Paul Kagame na Perezida wa DRC Félix Tshisekedi – areba impande zombi.
statements_all.translation_en: In an interview with France 24 broadcast on Monday, Rwanda's Minister of Foreign Affairs Olivier Nduhungirehe wondered why Rwanda “alone” is the one being sanctioned, while the peace agreement – led by America, signed in December (12) in 2025 between Rwanda's President Paul Kagame and DRC President Félix Tshisekedi – concerns both sides.

statements_all.text: Bwiza reported that AFC/M23, in a statement by spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka, said that on Sunday 28 June 2026 at around 01:00 the coalition of forces of the Kinshasa government burned many civilian houses at Lumbishi (Kalehe) after organised looting, and that entire families perished in the fire.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Nk'uko byatangajwe na AFC/M23 mu itangazo ry'Umuvugizi Lawrence Kanyuka, ngo ni igitero cyateguwe kandi gikoranwa ubugome ndengakamere.
statements_all.translation_en: According to what AFC/M23 announced in a statement by spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka, it was an attack planned and carried out with extreme cruelty.

statements_all.role: Special Representative of the Secretary-General, Head of MONUSCO
statements_all.text: UN News reported that MONUSCO head James Swan told the Security Council that the security situation in the east remained highly unstable, with heavy fighting between AFC/M23, supported by Rwandan forces (as UN News wrote), and the FARDC allied with Wazalendo, and that clashes were mainly in Rubaya and around Rutshuru in North Kivu and in the high plains of South Kivu.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Heavy fighting has continued between the Alliance Fleuve Congo/23rd of March Movement (AFC/M23), supported by Rwandan forces, and the Congolese Army (FARDC) allied with the Wazalendo armed group.

statements_all.text: UN News reported that Swan said the use of offensive drones, artillery and heavy weapons had sharply increased risks to civilians and infrastructure, that AFC/M23 had partially withdrawn from some areas but continued to consolidate parallel administrative structures, and called for swift deployment of the ceasefire monitoring mechanism under the Doha process.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Although the AFC/M23 has partially withdrawn from some areas, the group continues to consolidate parallel administrative structures in territory under its control.

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that, in reaction to Amnesty International's June 2026 report accusing the CMC-FDP armed group of serious abuses in Rutshuru, the CMC-FDP spokesperson categorically rejected the accusations and said that no official complaint had been filed before the movement's internal disciplinary or judicial bodies.
statements_all.excerpt_original: En réaction, le porte-parole du CMC-FDP rejette catégoriquement ces accusations. Il affirme qu’aucune plainte officielle n’a été déposée devant les instances disciplinaires ou judiciaires internes du mouvement, contestant ainsi les conclusions du rapport.
statements_all.translation_en: In reaction, the CMC-FDP spokesperson categorically rejects these accusations. He states that no official complaint was filed before the movement's internal disciplinary or judicial bodies, thus contesting the report's conclusions.

statements_all.text: A joint statement by the governments taking part in the Sixth Joint Oversight Committee for the Peace Agreement between the DRC and Rwanda, published by the US State Department, said that the DRC updated on its work to neutralize the FDLR and Rwanda updated on the process of its disengagement of forces/lifting of defensive measures.
statements_all.excerpt_original: The DRC updated on its work to neutralize the FDLR, and Rwanda updated on the process of its disengagement of forces/lifting of defensive measures.

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that, at the sixth meeting of the Comité mixte de surveillance (CMS) on the security situation in the DRC, held on Wednesday 24 June 2026 in London, Kinshasa and Kigali reaffirmed their commitment to de-escalate tensions linked to the situation of Minembwe.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Sur le plan régional, lors de la sixième réunion du Comité mixte de surveillance (CMS) sur la situation sécuritaire en RDC, tenue mercredi 24 juin 2026 à Londres, Kinshasa et Kigali ont réaffirmé leur engagement à désamorcer les tensions liées à la situation de Minembwe.
statements_all.translation_en: On the regional level, during the sixth meeting of the Joint Oversight Committee (CMS) on the security situation in the DRC, held on Wednesday 24 June 2026 in London, Kinshasa and Kigali reaffirmed their commitment to defuse tensions linked to the situation of Minembwe.

statements_all.setting: post on X, as reported by Kivu Morning Post
statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka said on X that at 14:00 on Wednesday 24 June 2026 'les forces coalisées du régime de Kinshasa ont bombardé, à l’aide de drones de combat, l’hôpital général de Minembwe, y compris le pavillon pédiatrique'. The outlet also quoted AFC/M23 deputy coordinator Bertrand Bisimwa: « Le bombardement d’un hôpital en temps de guerre est un crime de guerre ». This is an AFC/M23 allegation; the article gives no casualty figure for the hospital and carries no FARDC response.
statements_all.excerpt_original: « À 14h00 ce mercredi 24 juin 2026, les forces coalisées du régime de Kinshasa ont bombardé, à l’aide de drones de combat, l’hôpital général de Minembwe, y compris le pavillon pédiatrique où sont pris en charge des enfants malades et particulièrement vulnérables »
statements_all.translation_en: 'At 14:00 this Wednesday 24 June 2026, the coalition forces of the Kinshasa regime bombed, using combat drones, the Minembwe general hospital, including the paediatric ward where sick and particularly vulnerable children are treated'

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that in a communiqué the AFC/M23 accused the Congolese army and its allies of intensifying air strikes on civilian zones, saying that from 22 June 2026 at 23:30 to 23 June at 12:00 they struck Bidegu and surroundings with kamikaze drones and KT-6, and that, according to spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka, on 23 June between 06:00 and 11:00 they intensified strikes on Gakenke and Mikenge.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Dans un communiqué publié sur son compte, l’AFC/M23 accuse l’armée congolaise et ses alliés d’avoir intensifié des frappes aériennes contre des zones civiles.
statements_all.translation_en: In a communiqué published on its account, the AFC/M23 accuses the Congolese army and its allies of having intensified air strikes against civilian zones.

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that government spokesperson Patrick Muyaya, reacting at a press briefing to recent Human Rights Watch and Global Witness reports on the security, humanitarian and natural-resources situation in AFC/M23-held areas, said the publications were not a surprise to the Congolese authorities and that Kinshasa was acting on a judicial front and an economic front.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Réagissant à ces rapports lors d’un briefing de presse coanimé avec son collègue de la Santé publique, Hygiène et Prévoyance sociale, Samuel Roger Kamba, le porte-parole du gouvernement, Patrick Muyaya, a indiqué que ces publications ne constituaient pas une surprise pour les autorités congolaises.
statements_all.translation_en: Reacting to these reports at a press briefing co-hosted with his colleague from Public Health, Hygiene and Social Welfare, Samuel Roger Kamba, the government spokesperson, Patrick Muyaya, said that these publications were not a surprise to the Congolese authorities.

statements_all.text: SOS Médias Burundi quoted former national deputy Moïse Nyarugabo as saying 'La menace sur Minembwe est écartée', that despite Sukhoi bombardments, drones and heavy artillery the forces engaged had been pushed back beyond the Lwiko river; it reported he accused the coalition of bombardments causing civilian losses and mass displacement.
statements_all.excerpt_original: « La menace sur Minembwe est écartée. Malgré les bombardements de Soukhoï, des drones et l’artillerie lourde, les forces engagées ont été repoussées au-delà de la rivière Lwiko », a-t-il déclaré.
statements_all.translation_en: 'The threat to Minembwe is removed. Despite the Sukhoi bombardments, drones and heavy artillery, the forces engaged have been pushed back beyond the Lwiko river,' he said.

statements_all.person: Alexis Mugisha Nkurunziza; Col Fidèle Rugabo
statements_all.role: Vice-President (political, diplomacy and governance); senior officer
statements_all.text: Igihe reported that MRDP-Twirwaneho Vice-President Alexis Mugisha Nkurunziza said the claim that DRC forces had taken Minembwe was false, and that Col Fidèle Rugabo affirmed that the group still controls Minembwe, saying 'The lies are many. Up to now we are still in Minembwe... Long live M23'.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Kuri uyu wa 18 Kamena, IGIHE yavuganye na Visi Perezida wa MRDP-Twirwaneho ushinzwe ibikorwa bya politiki, dipolomasi n’imiyoborere, Alexis Mugisha Nkurunziza, avuga ko ibivugwa ko ingabo za RDC zafashe Minembwe ari ibinyoma. Umwe mu bofisiye bakuru ba MRDP-Twirwaneho, Col Fidèle Rugabo, yashimangiye ko Minembwe ikigenzurwa n’uyu mutwe
statements_all.translation_en: On this 18 June, IGIHE spoke with the Vice-President of MRDP-Twirwaneho in charge of political affairs, diplomacy and governance, Alexis Mugisha Nkurunziza, who says that what is said, that DRC forces took Minembwe, is lies. One of the senior officers of MRDP-Twirwaneho, Col Fidèle Rugabo, affirmed that Minembwe is still controlled by this group

statements_all.text: Igihe reported that MRDP-Twirwaneho President Dr Freddy Kaniki Rukema told journalists at a press conference in Goma on 18 June that DRC government forces had intensified attacks in Minembwe, that attacks on civilians there had increased and that the international community knew but was doing nothing; asked whether Minembwe had been taken, he said they had not done it and would not.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Perezida wa MRDP-Twirwaneho, Dr. Freddy Kaniki Rukema, yabwiye abanyamakuru bateraniye mu kiganiro cyabereye mu Mujyi wa Goma kuri uyu wa 18 Kamena ko ingabo za Leta ya RDC zakajije ibitero muri Minembwe. Dr. Kaniki yatangaje ko ibitero biri kugabwa ku basivili muri Minembwe byakajije umurego, kandi ko umuryango mpuzamahanga ubizi ariko ntacyo uri kubikoraho.
statements_all.translation_en: The President of MRDP-Twirwaneho, Dr. Freddy Kaniki Rukema, told journalists gathered at a press conference held in Goma city this 18 June that the DRC government forces had intensified attacks in Minembwe. Dr. Kaniki stated that the attacks being launched on civilians in Minembwe had intensified, and that the international community knows about it but is doing nothing about it.

statements_all.text: DW (Swahili) reported that the Congolese army claimed to have controlled Minembwe since Wednesday evening and that Twirwaneho had fled, but that residents denied it. Human rights defender Maniragaba Byashonyi said no FARDC soldiers were in the centre of Minembwe and that the centre was controlled by MRDP/Twirwaneho.
statements_all.excerpt_original: jeshi la Kongo ladai limedhibiti Minembwe tangu Jumatano jioni na Twirwaneho wamekimbia, lakini wakaazi wanakanusha taarifa hiyo huku.
statements_all.translation_en: the Congolese army claims to have controlled Minembwe since Wednesday evening and Twirwaneho have fled, but residents deny that report.

statements_all.text: Igihe reported that FARDC's military spokesperson in South Kivu, Lt Reagan Mbuyi Kalonji, said in a communiqué that FARDC had been controlling Minembwe since the night of 17 June 2026, that Twirwaneho fighters were fleeing towards Walungu territory, and that FARDC had captured many MRDP-Twirwaneho and M23 fighters, weapons, ammunition and other military equipment.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Itangazo ryasohowe n’Umuvugizi w’igisirikare cya RDC muri Kivu y’Amajyepfo, Lt Reagan Mbuyi Kalonji, rivuga ko kiri kugenzura Minembwe kuva mu ijoro ryo ku wa 17 Kamena 2026, abarwanyi ba Twirwaneho bahunga berekeza muri Teritwari ya Walungu.
statements_all.translation_en: A communiqué issued by the Spokesperson of the DRC army in South Kivu, Lt Reagan Mbuyi Kalonji, says it has been controlling Minembwe since the night of 17 June 2026, Twirwaneho fighters fleeing towards Walungu Territory.

statements_all.setting: communiqué via military source as reported
statements_all.text: MediaCongo, relaying ACP/MCP and citing the same military sources as its report on FARDC advances around Minembwe, reported that bombardments attributed to drones from Rwanda, which it called the aggressor country, targeted the Minembwe general hospital and some civilian homes on Wednesday morning.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Par ailleurs, des bombardements attribués à des drones en provenance du Rwanda, pays agresseur, a visé mercredi matin l’Hôpital général de Minembwe et certaines habitations civiles, selon les mêmes sources.
statements_all.translation_en: Moreover, bombardments attributed to drones from Rwanda, the aggressor country, targeted the Minembwe general hospital and some civilian homes on Wednesday morning, according to the same sources.

statements_all.text: Amnesty International reported that CMC-FDP spokesperson Héritier Donald Gashegu responded in writing on 16 June 2026 and denied responsibility for the abuses Amnesty documented, asserting that CMC-FDP remains committed to respecting human rights.
statements_all.excerpt_original: CMC-FDP spokesperson Héritier Donald Gashegu responded in writing on 16 June 2026. CMC-FDP denied responsibility for the abuses documented here and asserted that “CMC-FDP remains committed to respecting human rights and the discipline of its combatants.”

statements_all.text: Amnesty International reported that CMC-FDP said it "categorically rejects" the allegations that its fighters raped, sexually enslaved or forced women to "marry" its commanders, and that no complaints, official reports or referrals had been brought to the attention of its internal disciplinary or judicial bodies regarding the incidents.
statements_all.excerpt_original: CMC-FDP spokesperson Héritier Donald Gashegu responded in writing on 16 June 2026. CMC-FDP denied responsibility for the abuses documented here and asserted that “CMC-FDP remains committed to respecting human rights and the discipline of its combatants.”

statements_all.text: The UN Secretary-General wrote in his annual report on children and armed conflict that he condemned the 2025 offensive in North Kivu and South Kivu by M23 with the direct support and participation of the Rwanda Defence Forces, leading to a significant increase in child casualties and abductions; that ongoing military operations by all parties, together with the increased use of drone strikes, were deeply concerning; and that the scale of sexual violence by the defence and security forces and by armed groups was appalling.
statements_all.excerpt_original: I condemn the 2025 offensive in North Kivu and South Kivu by M23 with the direct support and participation of the Rwanda Defence Forces, leading to a significant increase in child casualties and abductions.

statements_all.text: According to Kigali, as reported by Igihe, HRW's own report acknowledges that the Congolese army has supported armed groups opposed to M23, including the FDLR.
statements_all.excerpt_original: According to Kigali, HRW's own report acknowledges that the Congolese army has supported armed groups opposed to M23, including the FDLR, a militia formed by perpetrators of the 1994 Genocide against the Tutsi.

statements_all.text: Igihe reported that the Rwandan statement cited passages in the HRW report saying that Congolese authorities armed, financed and coordinated operations with Wazalendo militias and that government support for such groups contributed to human rights violations.
statements_all.excerpt_original: The statement also cited passages in the report saying Congolese authorities armed, financed and coordinated operations with Wazalendo militias and that government support for such groups contributed to human rights violations.

statements_all.text: Rwanda's Office of the Government Spokesperson said, according to Igihe, that 'alleged M23 conduct cannot be treated as RDF conduct' and accused HRW of 'selective accountability', saying it focused primarily on Rwanda and M23 and paid insufficient attention to abuses by Congolese government forces and their allies.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Rwanda faulted HRW's attempt to treat the RDF and M23 as a single actor. “Alleged M23 conduct cannot be treated as RDF conduct,” the statement said. The government accused HRW of applying “selective accountability” by focusing primarily on Rwanda and M23 while paying insufficient attention to abuses committed by Congolese government forces and their allies.

statements_all.text: Igihe reported that Rwanda's statement highlighted the FDLR as a key security threat and accused HRW of failing to adequately examine its role and its links to Congolese government forces.
statements_all.excerpt_original: On the FDLR, Rwanda highlighted the militia as a key security threat and accused HRW of failing to adequately examine its role and links to Congolese government forces.

statements_all.role: spokesperson/officer cited in communiqué (role not stated)
statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that in a communiqué MRDP-Twirwaneho denounced ongoing attacks on civilians in Minembwe and Mikenge, rejected FARDC accusations that Minembwe served as a sanctuary for Burundian RED-Tabara rebels, demanded the immediate withdrawal of Burundian forces from Congolese territory and called for an independent international investigation into human rights violations in the region. The outlet quoted Colonel Kamasa Ndakize Welcome, in the communiqué, as calling those accusations false.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le MRDP-Twirwaneho rejette catégoriquement les accusations des FARDC selon lesquelles Minembwe servirait de sanctuaire aux rebelles burundais du RED-Tabara.
