statements_all.role: governor of North Kivu appointed by AFC/M23, per Umuryango.rw
statements_all.setting: appointment announcement, as reported by Umuryango.rw
statements_all.text: Umuryango.rw reported that an announcement of 9 April 2026 by the AFC/M23-appointed governor of North Kivu, Bahati Musanga Erasto, named Kisuba Ngabo Désiré mayor of Goma in place of Julien Katembo Ndalieni, who was made head of Lubero territory, and named Nshimiyimana Juvénal, formerly in charge of mobilisation and recruitment of new fighters in AFC/M23, deputy mayor of Goma.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Guverineri w’Intara ya Kivu y’Amajyaruguru washyizweho n’ihuriro AFC/M23 rirwanya ubutegetsi bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, Bahati Musanga Erasto, yahinduye ubuyobozi bw’Umujyi wa Goma. Itangazo ryo ku wa 9 Mata 2026 rigaragaza ko Kisuba Ngabo Désiré yagizwe Meya wa Goma, asimbuye Julien Katembo Ndalieni wagizwe Umuyobozi wa teritwari ya Lubero.
statements_all.translation_en: The governor of North Kivu province appointed by the AFC/M23 alliance, Bahati Musanga Erasto, changed the leadership of Goma city. An announcement of 9 April 2026 shows that Kisuba Ngabo Désiré was made Mayor of Goma, replacing Julien Katembo Ndalieni, who was made head of Lubero territory.

statements_all.text: Igihe reported that the AFC/M23-appointed Governor of North Kivu, Bahati Musanga Erasto, changed the leadership of Goma city, and that a notice of 9 April 2026 named Kisuba Ngabo Désiré, until then deputy mayor, mayor of Goma, replacing Julien Katembo Ndalieni, who became head of Lubero territory.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Guverineri w’Intara ya Kivu y’Amajyaruguru washyizweho n’ihuriro AFC/M23 rirwanya ubutegetsi bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, Bahati Musanga Erasto, yahinduye ubuyobozi bw’Umujyi wa Goma.
statements_all.translation_en: The Governor of North Kivu Province appointed by the AFC/M23 alliance fighting the government of the Democratic Republic of Congo, Bahati Musanga Erasto, changed the leadership of Goma city.

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that on Wednesday 8 April 2026 the command of the 34th military region of North Kivu confirmed the voluntary surrender of 263 elements from the ranks of the AFC/M23 between February and March 2026.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le commandement de la 34ᵉ région militaire du Nord-Kivu, a confirmé, ce mercredi 8 avril, la reddition volontaire de 263 éléments issus des rangs de l'AFC/M23 entre février et mars 2026.
statements_all.translation_en: The command of the 34th military region of North Kivu confirmed, this Wednesday 8 April, the voluntary surrender of 263 elements from the ranks of the AFC/M23 between February and March 2026.

statements_all.text: SOS Médias Burundi reported that the Burundian army spokesperson, Brigadier General Gaspard Baratuza, acknowledged on the BBC that Banyamulenge are trapped in areas 'where the enemy is', saying 'It’s understandable that those who go to buy food for the enemy are trapped.'
statements_all.excerpt_original: The spokesperson for the Burundian army, Brigadier General Gaspard Baratuza, acknowledged on the BBC that Banyamulenge are trapped in areas “where the enemy is” : “It’s understandable that those who go to buy food for the enemy are trapped.”

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that DRC Human Rights Minister Samuel Mbemba presented an official report on 7 April according to which more than 14 400 women were victims of rape during the period of occupation, sexual violence the report says was recorded in different localities of Uvira and its surroundings.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le ministre congolais des Droits humains, Samuel Mbemba, a présenté le 7 avril un rapport officiel documentant plusieurs violations commises contre les populations civiles dans cette partie de l’Est de la République démocratique du Congo. Selon ce document, plus de 14 400 femmes ont été victimes de viols durant la période d’occupation.
statements_all.translation_en: The Congolese Human Rights Minister, Samuel Mbemba, presented on 7 April an official report documenting several violations committed against civilian populations in this part of eastern DRC. According to this document, more than 14,400 women were victims of rape during the occupation period.

statements_all.role: FARDC spokesperson, Operation Sokola 2, South Kivu
statements_all.text: DW Swahili reported that the FARDC spokesperson for the Sokola 2 operations in South Kivu, Luteni (Lieutenant) Reagan Mbuyi, said the aircraft brought down came from Rwanda, that 'one of those helicopters from Rwanda, we shot it down', and that 13 rebel fighters of the group DW prints as Tugwaného and of M23 AFC had surrendered to the FARDC.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Moja ya helikopta hizo kutoka Rwanda, tuliitungua helikopta hiyo na kufuatia operesheni hiyo, kulikuwa na wapiganaji wa waasi 13 wa kundi la Tugwaného na M23 AFC waliojisalimisha kwa FARDC.
statements_all.translation_en: One of those helicopters from Rwanda, we shot that helicopter down and following that operation there were 13 rebel fighters of the Tugwaného group and M23 AFC who surrendered to the FARDC.

statements_all.text: DW Swahili reported that, despite the army saying the situation had calmed, local sources in the war zone said fighting began again that day in the early morning at Mikenge and neighbouring areas.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Licha ya jeshi kusema kuwa hali imekuwa shwari, vyanzo vya ndani kwenye eneo la vita vimesema, mapigano yalianza tena hii leo saa kumi na moja na dakika arobaini na tano alfajiri huko Mikenge na katika maeneo jirani.
statements_all.translation_en: Despite the army saying the situation has become calm, local sources in the war zone said fighting began again today at 5:45 in the morning (Swahili time 'saa kumi na moja na dakika arobaini na tano alfajiri', literally 'eleven forty-five at dawn') at Mikenge and in neighbouring areas.

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that DRC Minister of Human Rights Samuel Mbemba presented on 7 April a report on violations allegedly committed by AFC/M23 during the occupation of Uvira and its surroundings with Rwandan support; the government said it had counted more than 14 400 women raped, and the page gives two different figures for people killed, which it does not reconcile (see note).
statements_all.excerpt_original: Après des travaux de documentation, le ministre des droits humains, Samuel Mbemba a dévoilé mardi 7 avril, le rapport sur les actes de violations qu’auraient commis les rebelles de l'AFC/M23 lors de l’occupation de la ville d’Uvira et ses environs, dans la province du Sud-Kivu, avec le soutien du Rwanda.
statements_all.translation_en: After documentation work, the human rights minister, Samuel Mbemba, unveiled on Tuesday 7 April the report on the violations the AFC/M23 rebels allegedly committed during the occupation of the city of Uvira and its surroundings, in South Kivu province, with Rwanda's support.

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that the Congolese government said it had found several mass graves after the AFC/M23 left Uvira: three graves at Mayi Moto holding 115 bodies according to the government, one at Kilomani with 31 bodies, one at Kala and two at Rutembo.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Les trois fosses découvertes à Mayi Moto, avaient permis l'ensevelissement de 115 cadavres, d’après le gouvernement. Une autre, trouvée à Kilomani contient 31 corps humains entassés. Une autre encore a été trouvée à Kala et deux autres fosses communes à Rutembo.
statements_all.translation_en: The three graves found at Mayi Moto had been used to bury 115 corpses, according to the government. Another, found at Kilomani, contains 31 human bodies piled up. Another was found at Kala and two other mass graves at Rutembo.

statements_all.role: AFC/M23 spokesperson / head of communication department
statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that, in a statement on X, the AFC/M23 spokesperson said the 'Kinshasa regime, through its coalition forces' launched generalised attacks on several axes targeting civilian populations on Tuesday 7 April 2026, with attacks, per the movement, spreading from 06:50 to Lumbishi, Katale and Tushunguti in Kalehe territory where civilian areas were also hit.
statements_all.excerpt_original: De nouveaux affrontements ont été signalés mardi 7 avril 2026 dans la matinée entre les Forces armées de la République démocratique du Congo (FARDC) et les combattants de l’AFC/M23 dans plusieurs villages du Sud-Kivu.
statements_all.translation_en: New clashes were reported on the morning of Tuesday 7 April 2026 between the Armed Forces of the DRC (FARDC) and AFC/M23 fighters in several villages of South Kivu.

statements_all.text: Jeune Afrique published an interview with Rwandan President Paul Kagame under the headline quote 'N’attendez pas de moi que je lève nos mesures de défense alors que vous laissez Félix Tshisekedi faire ce qu’il veut' (Do not expect me to lift our defence measures while you let Félix Tshisekedi do what he wants).
statements_all.excerpt_original: Paul Kagame : « N’attendez pas de moi que je lève nos mesures de défense alors que vous laissez Félix Tshisekedi faire ce qu’il veut »
statements_all.translation_en: Paul Kagame: "Do not expect me to lift our defence measures while you let Félix Tshisekedi do what he wants"

statements_all.setting: remarks in answer to a question, as reported
statements_all.text: Kigali Today (Rwanda) reported that Rwandan President Kagame said that in the areas M23 controls, it does well in combating FDLR and other criminal groups, but that in Masisi, Walikale and other areas controlled by FARDC, FDLR is still found there, cooperating with government forces.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Perezida Kagame yavuze ko mu turere M23 igenzura, ikora neza mu guhangana na FDLR n'indi mitwe y'abagizi ba nabi, ariko mu turere twa Masisi, Walikale n’ahandi ingabo za FARDC zigenzura, FDLR iracyahaboneka aho ifatanya n'ingabo za Guverinoma.
statements_all.translation_en: President Kagame said that in the areas M23 controls it works well in combating FDLR and other criminal groups, but in the areas of Masisi, Walikale and elsewhere that FARDC forces control, FDLR is still found there, cooperating with government forces.

statements_all.text: Opinion Info and Actualite.cd reported that South Kivu governor Jean-Jacques Purusi, at a press briefing with Patrick Muyaya on Thursday 2 April 2026, said about 210 bodies had been found in three mass graves (Actualite.cd: at least 210); Opinion Info quotes him as saying Human Rights Watch had just detected more than 61 mass graves and that 31 mass graves had been found in only three municipalities, and names the three graves as Kamvivira, Kilomoni and Kimanga.
statements_all.excerpt_original: « Human Rights Watch vient de détecter plus de 61 fosses communes. Et nous avons découvert 31 fosses communes seulement dans trois municipalités. Il y a des crimes de masse », a-t-il déclaré, soulignant qu’environ 210 corps inertes ont été retrouvés dans trois fosses communes à Kamvivira, Kilomoni et Kimanga.
statements_all.translation_en: "Human Rights Watch has just detected more than 61 mass graves. And we discovered 31 mass graves in only three municipalities. There are mass crimes," he said, stressing that about 210 lifeless bodies were found in three mass graves at Kamvivira, Kilomoni and Kimanga.

statements_all.text: Umunota.com reported that Muyaya, in a message posted on X, said that all the attacks launched on the Banyamulenge in Minembwe were launched by M23 together with Rwanda.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Ibi Yolande Makolo yabitangaje asubiza ubutumwa Muyaya yanyujije kurubuga rwa X, aho yavuze ko ibitero byose byagabwe ku Banyamulenge muri Minembwe byagabwe na M23 ifatanyije n’u Rwanda.
statements_all.translation_en: Yolande Makolo said this in reply to a message that Muyaya posted on X, in which he said that all the attacks launched on the Banyamulenge in Minembwe were launched by M23 together with Rwanda.

statements_all.text: Umunota.com reported that Makolo, replying to Muyaya, said his words were a ploy to shift the crimes of FARDC onto M23, and wrote: 'Accusing others of what you do, where the one who committed crimes pins them on the one they were committed against. It is usually used to encourage people to violence or genocide.'
statements_all.excerpt_original: Makolo yagaragaje ko imvugo za Muyaya ari amayeri yo gushaka kwegeka ibyaha bya FARDC kuri M23. Yagize ati “Gushinja abandi ibyo mukora aho uwakoze ibyaha abyegeka ku wabikorewe. ubusanzwe bikoreshwa mu gushishikariza abantu ubugizi bwa nabi cyangwa Jenoside.
statements_all.translation_en: Makolo showed that Muyaya's words are a ploy to try to shift the crimes of FARDC onto M23. She said: “Accusing others of what you do, where the one who committed crimes pins them on the one they were committed against. It is usually used to encourage people to violence or genocide.

statements_all.setting: communiqué and social-media post as reported
statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that AFC-M23 accused the Congolese army of launching several attacks on its positions on 31 March 2026 and said the coalition of the Kinshasa regime (FARDC, FDLR, Wazalendo militias, mercenaries and the Burundian National Defence Force) launched generalised attacks on all front lines and that, according to spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka, fighting was recorded on the Minembwe axis (Rugezi, Kalingi, Gakenke, Bidegu); the AFC-M23 communication also listed the villages of Kabesebese and Mutondi on the Lubero axis as under attack.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Des affrontements ont repris ce mardi 31 mars 2026 dans l’est de la République démocratique du Congo.
statements_all.translation_en: Fighting resumed this Tuesday 31 March 2026 in the east of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

statements_all.role: spokesperson, Sukola 2 Nord-Sud Kivu operational sector
statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that the spokesperson of the Sukola 2 Nord-Sud Kivu operational sector, Meya Jérémie, said the group led by "Muswahili" was involved in several serious human rights violations, the alleged acts including looting, extortion, torture and forced labour, notably in mining areas.
statements_all.excerpt_original: D’après le porte-parole du secteur opérationnel Sukola 2 Nord-Sud Kivu, Meya Jérémie, le groupe dirigé par « Muswahili » est impliqué dans plusieurs violations graves des droits humains. Parmi les faits reprochés figurent des pillages, des extorsions, des actes de torture ainsi que des travaux forcés, notamment dans les zones minières de la région.
statements_all.translation_en: According to the spokesperson of the Sukola 2 Nord-Sud Kivu operational sector, Meya Jérémie, the group led by "Muswahili" is involved in several serious human rights violations. Among the alleged acts are looting, extortion, acts of torture and forced labour, notably in the mining areas of the region.

statements_all.role: deputy army commander (Naibu kamanda wa jeshi la Kongo)
statements_all.text: DW Swahili reported that the Congolese army had started operations to hunt FDLR rebels, announced officially at Kisangani (Tshopo) by the deputy army commander, General Ychaligonza Jacques, who called on FDLR fighters to surrender.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Operesheni hiyo ilitangazwa rasmi mjini Kisangani katika jimbo la Tshopo na Naibu kamanda wa jeshi la Kongo, Jenerali Ychaligonza Jacques, ambaye alitoa wito kwa wapiganaji wa FDLR kujisalimisha.
statements_all.translation_en: The operation was officially announced in the town of Kisangani in Tshopo province by the deputy commander of the Congolese army, General Ychaligonza Jacques, who called on FDLR fighters to surrender.

statements_all.role: Governor of North Kivu Province (M23 administration)
statements_all.text: Into Rwanda reported that a statement released by Erasto Bahati, whom it calls the Governor of North Kivu Province, dismissed reports of an AFC/M23 pull-back, saying that what is happening is a routine rotation of troops, and quoted the statement as saying the activities along the battlefront are part of the regular military troop rotations within AFC/M23.
statements_all.excerpt_original: the Governor of North Kivu Province, Erasto Bahati, these reports were dismissed, with the governor clarifying that what is happening is simply a routine rotation of troops. The statement read: “The leadership of North Kivu Province reassures all citizens that the activities occurring along the battlefront are part of the regular military troop rotations within AFC/M23.”

statements_all.setting: announcement as reported by the Group of Experts
statements_all.text: The Group of Experts reported that on 29 March 2026 FARDC announced the launch of an operation to neutralize FDLR around Pinga-Walikale and deployed additional troops from Kisangani to Walikale, but that at the time of writing no anti-FDLR operations had taken place.
statements_all.excerpt_original: On 29 March 2026, FARDC announced the launch of an operation to neutralize FDLR around Pinga-Walikale and deployed additional troops from Kisangani to Walikale for these operations. 51 However, the commitment of FARDC remained questionable (see S/2024/969, paras. 67–73) since at the time of writing no anti-FDLR operations had taken place

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that AFC spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka said that on 29 March 2026 at 18h30 'la coalition de Kinshasa' infiltrated the densely populated centre of Shanje, Kalehe territory, where it 'executed 7 innocent civilians', whom he named; the outlet reported that he also said more than twenty people were wounded, and he alleged that the Kinshasa regime continues to ally itself with FDLR elements and deploy them on various fronts.
statements_all.excerpt_original: « Le 29 mars 2026 à 18h30, la coalition de Kinshasa a infiltré le centre densément peuplé de Shanje, dans le territoire de Kalehe, au Sud-Kivu, où elle a exécuté 7 civils innocents
statements_all.translation_en: "On 29 March 2026 at 6:30 p.m., the Kinshasa coalition infiltrated the densely populated centre of Shanje, in Kalehe territory, in South Kivu, where it executed 7 innocent civilians

statements_all.text: According to Igihe, North Kivu Governor Erasto Bahati (AFC/M23 administration) dismissed the reports of withdrawal in a statement, saying the activities along the front were regular troop rotations within AFC/M23 and that the rumours were fuelled by social media and the Kinshasa government.
statements_all.excerpt_original: In a statement released by the Governor of North Kivu Province, Erasto Bahati, these reports were dismissed, with the governor clarifying that what is happening is simply a routine rotation of troops.

statements_all.role: North Kivu governor appointed by AFC/M23
statements_all.text: Igihe reported that AFC/M23 denied reports that it had begun withdrawing fighters from some areas it controls in the east of the country; in a communiqué, Erasto Bahati, whom Igihe calls the provincial governor, said what was happening on the front lines was a routine replacement of troops in the AFC/M23 military and that the reports were rumours fuelled by the Kinshasa authorities' social media.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Umutwe wa AFC/ M23 urwanya ubutegetsi bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, wahakanye amakuru avuga ko watangiye gukura abarwanyi mu bice bimwe byo mu Burasirazuba bw’igihugu ugenzura.
statements_all.translation_en: The AFC/M23 group, which opposes the government of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, denied information saying that it had begun to withdraw fighters from some areas in the east of the country that it controls.

statements_all.text: Bwiza reported that AFC/M23, through spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka, said that an attack at 18:30 on Sunday 29 March, when the coalition of DRC government forces entered the densely populated centre of Shanji, killed people it named as Shadai Ndagije, Bisengi Mpenze, Gitinywa Etienne, Gashimye Hitimana, Daniel Hategeka, Ndayambaje Muhire and Iradukunda Nsanzumuhire, and injured more than 20 others.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Umutwe wa AFC/M23 biciye mu muvugizi wawo, Lawrence Kanyuka, watangaje ko igitero cyiciwemo bariya bantu cyabaye ku Cyumweru tariki ya 29 Werurwe saa 18:30, ubwo ihuriro ry'ingabo za Leta ya RDC zacengeraga muri Centre ituwe n'abaturage benshi ya Shanji.
statements_all.translation_en: The AFC/M23 group, through its spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka, announced that the attack in which those people were killed took place on Sunday 29 March at 18:30, when the coalition of the DRC government's forces infiltrated the densely populated centre of Shanji.

statements_all.role: movement position as summarised by Actualite.cd
statements_all.setting: position summarised by the outlet, not a quoted statement
statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that the AFC/M23 maintains that the humanitarian situation is improving in the zones it controls and alarming in the zones controlled by Kinshasa, in the context of the dispute over reopening Goma airport.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Celle-ci affirme plutôt qu’il y a une amélioration de la situation humanitaire dans les zones sous son contrôle, soutenant en revanche que la situation est alarmante dans les zones contrôlées par le gouvernement de Kinshasa.
statements_all.translation_en: It claims instead that there is an improvement in the humanitarian situation in the zones under its control, maintaining on the other hand that the situation is alarming in the zones controlled by the Kinshasa government.

statements_all.text: Anadolu Agency reported that North Kivu Governor Evariste Kakule Somo told local media in Lubero on Thursday that he had observed an 'effective withdrawal' from several areas, called on the population to stay calm and said the rebel movement was part of 'the implementation of the peace agreements, notably those negotiated under US auspices'.
statements_all.excerpt_original: le gouverneur du Nord-Kivu, Evariste Kakule Somo, a déclaré à des médias locaux à Lubero qu’il avait constaté un « retrait effectif » de plusieurs zones, ce que plusieurs médias ont mentionné dans leur couverture. Il a appelé la population à rester calme, affirmant que le mouvement des rebelles s’inscrit dans le cadre de « la mise en œuvre des accords de paix, notamment ceux négociés sous l’égide des États-Unis ».
statements_all.translation_en: The governor of North Kivu, Evariste Kakule Somo, told local media in Lubero that he had observed an 'effective withdrawal' from several areas, which several media mentioned in their coverage. He called on the population to stay calm, stating that the rebels' movement was part of 'the implementation of the peace agreements, notably those negotiated under US auspices'.

statements_all.role: Deputy Special Representative of the Secretary-General for protection and operations
statements_all.text: UN News reported that on Thursday Vivian van de Perre, MONUSCO Deputy Special Representative for protection and operations, told the Security Council that recent hostilities between the government and AFC/M23 were marked by growing use of offensive drones and continued GPS jamming and spoofing, and that a recent 'joint exploratory mission' to Uvira found that security guarantees and freedom of movement are indispensable before peacekeepers can be deployed.
statements_all.excerpt_original: « Les récentes hostilités entre le gouvernement et l'AFC/M23 ont également été marquées par le recours croissant à des drones offensifs, ainsi que par la poursuite du brouillage et de la falsification des signaux GPS », a précisé Mme van de Perre.
statements_all.translation_en: "Recent hostilities between the government and the AFC/M23 have also been marked by the growing use of offensive drones, as well as continued jamming and spoofing of GPS signals", Ms van de Perre specified.

statements_all.text: The UN Group of Experts reported that in an interview with Jeune Afrique on 26 March 2026 President Paul Kagame rejected Rwanda's responsibility in the DRC conflict, portraying it as a Congolese internal issue.
statements_all.excerpt_original: In an exclusive interview granted to Jeune Afrique on 26 March 2026, 382 President Paul Kagame addressed questions about Rwanda’s role in the ongoing conflict in the DRC, the US sanctions and the RDF’s expected withdrawal from the DRC. Kagame rejected Rwanda’s responsibility in the DRC conflict, portraying the conflict as a Congolese internal issue

statements_all.setting: interview (as summarised by the UN Group of Experts)
statements_all.text: The UN Group of Experts, in its own summary (not a transcript) of an interview President Paul Kagame gave to Jeune Afrique on 26 March 2026, reported that Kagame indicated no intention to withdraw or scale down Rwanda's military posture, stating that defensive measures would remain in place until the perceived threat was addressed, by any means necessary.
statements_all.excerpt_original: In an exclusive interview granted to Jeune Afrique on 26 March 2026,382 President Paul Kagame addressed questions about Rwanda’s role in the ongoing conflict in the DRC, the US sanctions and the RDF’s expected withdrawal from the DRC.

statements_all.setting: interview (as summarised by the UN Group of Experts)
statements_all.text: The UN Group of Experts, in its own summary (not a transcript) of an interview President Paul Kagame gave to Jeune Afrique on 26 March 2026, reported that Kagame described the fall of Uvira as "inevitable", a necessary consequence of the situation on the ground, claiming that it should not have come as a surprise to any of the parties, including the US, since they were informed on a daily basis of the "evolution of the situation".
statements_all.excerpt_original: In an exclusive interview granted to Jeune Afrique on 26 March 2026,382 President Paul Kagame addressed questions about Rwanda’s role in the ongoing conflict in the DRC, the US sanctions and the RDF’s expected withdrawal from the DRC.

statements_all.role: Minister of Foreign Affairs (cheffe de la diplomatie congolaise)
statements_all.setting: statement to the diplomatic corps, as reported
statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that Foreign Minister Thérèse Kayikwamba Wagner, in an exchange with the diplomatic corps accredited in Kinshasa on Wednesday 25 March 2026, called the situation 'préoccupante', said the reopening of Goma airport for humanitarian flights had not happened, and accused the AFC/M23 of lacking political will.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Au cours d’un échange avec l’ensemble du corps diplomatique accrédité à Kinshasa, mercredi 25 mars 2026, la cheffe de la diplomatie congolaise, Thérèse Kayikwamba Wagner, a présenté une situation qu’elle qualifie de « préoccupante ».
statements_all.translation_en: During an exchange with the whole diplomatic corps accredited in Kinshasa, on Wednesday 25 March 2026, the head of Congolese diplomacy, Thérèse Kayikwamba Wagner, presented a situation that she describes as 'worrying'.

statements_all.setting: reply to RSF as reported by Radio Okapi
statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that, contacted by RSF, AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka rejected the allegations about detention containers in Goma, calling them "informations totalement infondées" and "propagande", and said the movement makes no arrests of journalists.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Contacté par RSF, le porte-parole de la coalition AFC/M23, Lawrence Kanyuka, a rejeté ces allégations, les qualifiant d'« informations totalement infondées » et de « propagande ». Il affirme que le mouvement ne procède à aucune arrestation de journalistes.
statements_all.translation_en: Contacted by RSF, the spokesperson of the AFC/M23 coalition, Lawrence Kanyuka, rejected these allegations, calling them "totally unfounded information" and "propaganda". He says the movement carries out no arrests of journalists.

statements_all.text: Bwiza reported that AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka said on his X account that, besides Banyamulenge Congolese being killed, the DRC government was also forcibly removing people from their homes in Minembwe; the outlet wrote that among those known so far to have been killed in that area was the elder Rudaga Adriyani, aged 95, killed in drone attacks that the coalition of Kinshasa government forces carried out in the Minembwe areas on Monday 23 March 2026.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi wa AFC/M23, Lawrence Kanyuka, abinyujije ku rubuga rwe rwa X, yavuze ko usibye kuba Abanye-Congo bo mu bwoko bw'Abanyamulenge bari kwicwa, Leta ya RDC iri no gukora ibikorwa byo kuvana abaturage mu byabo ku mbaraga.
statements_all.translation_en: The AFC/M23 spokesperson, Lawrence Kanyuka, via his X account, said that besides Congolese of the Banyamulenge ethnic group being killed, the DRC government is also carrying out actions to remove people from their homes by force.

statements_all.role: no statement (as stated by a Rwandan outlet)
statements_all.text: Umuseke (Rwanda) wrote that AFC/M23 had said it returned to Congo some 5000 soldiers and members of their families who had been stranded in the city of Goma, and that Congo "ntacyo yabivuzeho" (had said nothing about it).
statements_all.excerpt_original: Mu gihe gishize AFC/M23 yavuze ko yasubije Congo abasirikare n’abo mu miryango yabo bagera ku 5000 bari baraheze mu mujyi wa Goma, ibyo Congo ntacyo yabivuzeho.
statements_all.translation_en: Some time ago AFC/M23 said it had returned to Congo about 5000 soldiers and their families who had been stranded in the city of Goma, on which Congo has said nothing.

statements_all.setting: agreed plan as described by the Group of Experts
statements_all.text: The Group of Experts reported that a meeting in Washington, D.C. on 17 and 18 March 2026 between representatives of the Governments of the DRC, Rwanda and the United States resulted in an 'initial steps plan' that foresaw withdrawal of RDF and AFC/M23 'personnel and equipment', Rwanda's disengagement from defined areas, efforts by the DRC to neutralize the FDLR, and restrictions on drone strikes.
statements_all.excerpt_original: a meeting in Washington, D.C. on 17 and 18 March 2026 between representatives of the Governments of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Rwanda and the United States resulted in commitments defined in an “initial steps plan

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that, according to the rebellion (AFC/M23), the 17 March fighting in the Ruzizi plain was a 'guerre généralisée' (generalised war) waged by the government army and its allies.
statements_all.excerpt_original: D’après la rébellion, il s’agit d’une « guerre généralisée » menée par l’armée gouvernementale et ses alliés.
statements_all.translation_en: According to the rebellion, it is a 'generalised war' waged by the government army and its allies.

statements_all.role: Resident and Humanitarian Coordinator in the DRC
statements_all.setting: interview/statement reported by Radio Okapi after a meeting
statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that Bruno Lemarquis, Resident and Humanitarian Coordinator in the DRC, on a mission in Goma since Monday 16 March, called on the leaders of the AFC/M23 rebellion to guarantee absolute respect for humanitarian space, in a statement made during a meeting with the de facto authorities of Goma and its surroundings, led by Corneille Nangaa.
statements_all.excerpt_original: En mission à Goma depuis lundi 16 mars, Bruno Lemarquis, Coordonnateur résident et humanitaire en RDC, a lancé un appel aux responsables de la rébellion AFC/M23 pour garantir le respect absolu de l’espace humanitaire.
statements_all.translation_en: On a mission in Goma since Monday 16 March, Bruno Lemarquis, Resident and Humanitarian Coordinator in the DRC, called on the leaders of the AFC/M23 rebellion to guarantee absolute respect for humanitarian space.

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that the spokesperson of the 33rd military region had announced the closure of road traffic from Runingu on the Bukavu-Uvira axis, leaving public transport vehicles and humanitarian convoys blocked there.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le porte-parole de la 33e région militaire avait déjà annoncé hier la fermeture du trafic routier à partir de Runingu, sur l'axe Bukavu-Uvira. Plusieurs véhicules de transport en commun et convois humanitaires sont bloqués sur place
statements_all.translation_en: The spokesperson of the 33rd military region had already announced yesterday the closure of road traffic from Runingu, on the Bukavu-Uvira axis. Several public transport vehicles and humanitarian convoys are blocked there

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that the Forum des ONGI en RDC, in a communiqué condemning drone strikes in Goma, recalled that in 2025, 13 humanitarians were killed in the region against 9 in 2024, and that 626 security incidents targeting them were recorded in 2025 against 428 the previous year, citing OCHA.
statements_all.excerpt_original: L’organisation rappelle qu’en 2025, 13 humanitaires ont été tués dans cette région, contre 9 en 2024. Au total, 626 incidents sécuritaires les visant ont été recensés en 2025, contre 428 l’année précédente (OCHA 2025 ; OCHA 2024).
statements_all.translation_en: The organisation recalls that in 2025, 13 humanitarians were killed in this region, compared with 9 in 2024. In total, 626 security incidents targeting them were recorded in 2025, against 428 the previous year (OCHA 2025; OCHA 2024).

statements_all.setting: statement, as reported by Umuryango.rw (no channel given)
statements_all.text: Umuryango.rw reported that AFC/M23 condemned the attack and said it was not right for the international community to keep silent while the DRC government deliberately violates the ceasefire agreement signed in Doha, Qatar.
statements_all.excerpt_original: AFC/M23 yamaganye iki gitero, igaragaza ko bidakwiye ko umuryango mpuzamahanga ukomeza guceceka mu gihe Leta ya RDC irenga nkana ku masezerano y’agahenge yasinyiwe i Doha muri Qatar.
statements_all.translation_en: AFC/M23 condemned this attack, stating that it is not right for the international community to keep silent while the DRC government deliberately violates the ceasefire agreement signed in Doha, Qatar.

statements_all.text: Umuryango.rw reported that on the morning of 12 March 2026 many Goma residents gathered in a protest against the drone attack launched on the city by the forces of the DRC, asking AFC/M23 to liberate the whole country, after an invitation from civil society, and that AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka said the protesters asked AFC/M23 to remove Félix Tshisekedi's government throughout the DRC.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa 12 Werurwe 2026, abaturage benshi batuye i Goma bahuriye mu myigaragambyo yamagana igitero cya drones ingabo za Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo zagabye muri uyu mujyi, basaba ihuriro AFC/M23 kubohora iki gihugu cyose.
statements_all.translation_en: On the morning of 12 March 2026, many residents of Goma gathered in a protest against the drone attack that the forces of the Democratic Republic of Congo launched in this city, asking the AFC/M23 alliance to liberate this whole country.

statements_all.setting: meeting as reported by Journal de Kinshasa (no public statement quoted)
statements_all.text: Journal de Kinshasa reported that on Thursday 12 March the Deputy Prime Minister for Defence, Guy Kabombo, received François Moreillon, head of the ICRC delegation in the DRC, to discuss the release of war detainees, which the page links to the AFC/M23 announcement from Rumangabo of the release of more than five thousand FARDC.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Ce jeudi 12 mars, dans le silence feutré d’un cabinet ministériel à Kinshasa, une rencontre discrète mais lourde de sens s’est tenue. Le Vice-Premier ministre de la Défense, Guy Kabombo, a reçu François Moreillon, le chef de la délégation du Comité international de la Croix-Rouge (CICR) en RDC.
statements_all.translation_en: This Thursday 12 March, in the hushed silence of a ministerial office in Kinshasa, a discreet but significant meeting was held. The Deputy Prime Minister for Defence, Guy Kabombo, received François Moreillon, head of the delegation of the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) in the DRC.

statements_all.role: head of the ICRC delegation in Kinshasa
statements_all.setting: reaction as quoted by Actualite.cd (date of the reaction not stated; article of 9 March 2026)
statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that François Moreillon, head of the ICRC delegation in Kinshasa, reacted to the AFC/M23 communiqué by saying the ICRC had taken note of it and, as a neutral intermediary, stood ready to accompany such an operation with the agreement of all parties.
statements_all.excerpt_original: «Le CICR a pris connaissance du communiqué de l'AFC/M23 annonçant sa décision de libérer un certain nombre d'éléments FARDC détenus. En tant qu'intermédiaire neutre, le CICR se tient prêt à accompagner une telle opération avec l’accord de toutes les parties», a réagi François Moreillon , chef de la délégation du CICR à Kinshasa.
statements_all.translation_en: "The ICRC has taken note of the AFC/M23 communiqué announcing its decision to release a number of detained FARDC elements. As a neutral intermediary, the ICRC stands ready to accompany such an operation with the agreement of all parties", reacted François Moreillon, head of the ICRC delegation in Kinshasa.

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that the East African Community summit of heads of state held on Saturday 7 March 2026 in Arusha urged the African Union, in its final communiqué, to provide the financial and logistical resources needed for the AU-led mediation process on eastern DRC.
statements_all.excerpt_original: "Le Sommet a exhorté l'Union Africaine à fournir les ressources financières et logistiques nécessaires au processus de médiation dirigé par l'Union Africaine sur l'Est de la République Démocratique du Congo afin d'assurer un engagement rapide et durable jusqu'à son point", lit-on dans le communiqué final
statements_all.translation_en: "The Summit urged the African Union to provide the financial and logistical resources necessary for the African Union-led mediation process on Eastern DRC", reads the final communiqué

statements_all.text: BBC News Afrique reported that, according to the government, more than 200 people, including 70 children, were killed when a landslide caused a mining area to collapse in eastern DRC; it quoted the Ministry of Mines communiqué giving a provisional toll of more than 200 dead and many injured, and said it could not independently verify the toll. It also reported that the ministry blamed the M23 rebels, that the M23 had not yet commented, that a source at Rubaya told the BBC the collapse was caused by attacks by government forces and that only six people had died, and that the government had not responded to that claim.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Selon le gouvernement, plus de 200 personnes, dont 70 enfants, ont été tuées après qu'un glissement de terrain a provoqué l'effondrement d'une zone minière dans l'est de la République démocratique du Congo.
statements_all.translation_en: according to the government, more than 200 people, including 70 children, were killed after a landslide caused the collapse of a mining area in the east of the democratic republic of the congo.

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that national deputy Placide Wenda, in an alert launched on Tuesday 3 March in Kinshasa, denounced serious crimes including torture and human mutilations by armed men in Shabunda territory, and noted that inhabitants reportedly had ears cut off or eyes gouged out; Radio Okapi said two people died in one week in clashes between two Wazalendo factions on the Kalole-Masanganjia axis to Mukoloka.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Deux personnes ont perdu la vie en une semaine à la suite des accrochages entre deux factions Wazalendo , sur l’axe Kalole-Masanganjia jusqu’à Mukoloka, en territoire de Shabunda (Sud-Kivu). Dans une alerte lancée mardi 3 mars à Kinshasa, le député national Placide Wenda dénonce des crimes graves, notamment des actes de torture et des mutilations humaines que commettent ces hommes armés.
statements_all.translation_en: Two people lost their lives in one week following clashes between two Wazalendo factions on the Kalole-Masanganjia axis up to Mukoloka, in Shabunda territory (South Kivu). In an alert launched on Tuesday 3 March in Kinshasa, national deputy Placide Wenda denounces serious crimes, notably acts of torture and human mutilations committed by these armed men.

statements_all.text: AP and Reuters (as published by Al Jazeera) reported that Rwandan government spokesperson Yolande Makolo said in a statement that the US sanctions 'unjustly' target Rwanda and 'misrepresent the reality and distort the facts of the conflict' in eastern DRC, and accused the DRC of violating the peace agreement.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Rwandan government spokesperson Yolande Makolo said in a statement that the sanctions “unjustly” target Rwanda and “misrepresent the reality and distort the facts of the conflict” in eastern DRC. She accused DRC of violating the peace agreement

statements_all.text: AP and Reuters (as published by Al Jazeera) reported that the Congolese government said it welcomed the US sanctions on the Rwandan military, describing them as 'a strong signal in support of respect' for its territorial integrity and sovereignty.
statements_all.excerpt_original: The Congolese government, however, said it welcomed the sanctions, describing them as “a strong signal in support of respect” for its territorial integrity and ⁠sovereignty.

statements_all.text: The US Department of the Treasury announced on 2 March 2026 that its Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) had imposed sanctions on the Rwanda Defence Force (RDF) and four of its senior officials, stating that the RDF is actively supporting, training, and fighting alongside the M23.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Today, the U.S. Department of the Treasury’s Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) imposed sanctions on the Rwanda Defence Force (RDF)—the military of Rwanda—and four of its senior officials. The RDF is actively supporting, training, and fighting alongside the March 23 Movement (M23)

statements_all.text: The US Treasury said that, days after the Washington Accords signing, M23 captured Uvira, a strategic city on the border with Burundi, in an offensive that resulted in civilian deaths and forced thousands of residents to flee their homes; it said that despite M23's subsequent exit from Uvira, its continued presence near the border with Burundi, and the RDF's continued support for M23, carried the risk of escalating the conflict into a broader regional war.
statements_all.excerpt_original: M23 captured Uvira, a strategic city located along the DRC-Burundi border. This military offensive resulted in civilian deaths and forced thousands of residents to flee their homes. Despite its subsequent exit from Uvira, M23’s continued presence near the border with Burundi

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that FARDC spokesperson in the region, Lieutenant Reagan Mbuyi Kalonji, said villages including Mikenge, Kakenge, Bilalombili and Bidegu 1 had been retaken, and that five elements were captured, 17 surrendered and 11 bodies left on the ground, among them a brigade commander of AFC/M23 and a logistics officer of Twirwaneho.
statements_all.excerpt_original: de nouvelles cités et villages stratégiques ont été reconquis notamment Mikenge, Kakenge, Bilalombili et Bidegu 1. Outre ces villages récupérés par l’armée républicaine, plusieurs rebelles ont été neutralisés, cinq éléments capturés, 17 rendus et 11 corps abandonnés en même le sol
statements_all.translation_en: new strategic towns and villages were reconquered, notably Mikenge, Kakenge, Bilalombili and Bidegu 1. Besides these villages recovered by the republican army, several rebels were neutralised, five elements captured, 17 surrendered and 11 bodies abandoned on the ground

statements_all.text: Human Rights Watch reported that the US sanctioned the Rwandan army and four commanders (Maj. Gen. Vincent Nyakarundi, Maj. Gen. Ruki Karusisi, Gen. Mubarakh Muganga and Brig. Gen. Stanislas Gashugi), and that military and UN sources told HRW several thousand Rwandan soldiers, including special forces, crossed into the DRC in the weeks before the December Uvira offensive.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Des sources militaires et onusiennes ont déclaré à Human Rights Watch que plusieurs milliers de soldats rwandais, y compris des forces spéciales, avaient traversé la frontière congolaise dans les semaines précédant l'offensive sur Uvira en décembre.
statements_all.translation_en: Military and UN sources told Human Rights Watch that several thousand Rwandan soldiers, including special forces, had crossed the Congolese border in the weeks before the Uvira offensive in December.

statements_all.role: Government of Rwanda (statement issued by the government)
statements_all.text: Ijambo.net reported that the Government of Rwanda, in a statement issued on Monday 2 March 2026, rejected the sanctions the United States had imposed on some senior RDF officers, saying they were biased and aimed at presenting a picture contrary to the truth about the long-running insecurity in eastern DRC. The outlet reported that the US named Maj Gen Vincent Nyakarundi, Maj. Gen Ruki Karusisi, Gen Mubarakh Muganga and Brig Gen Stanislas Gashugi, and that Rwanda said the US had ignored drone and ground attacks by DRC forces that it said continued despite the agreement to stop fighting and killed many civilians.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yamaganye ibihano Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika zafatiye bamwe mu bayobozi bakuru b’Ingabo z’u Rwanda (RDF), ivuga ko bibogamye kandi bigamije kugaragaza isura ihabanye n’ukuri ku bibazo by’umutekano muke bimaze igihe mu Burasirazuba bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo (RDC). Ni mu itangazo Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yasohoye kuri uyu wa Mbere, tariki ya 2 Werurwe 2026
statements_all.translation_en: The Government of Rwanda has rejected the sanctions that the United States of America imposed on some senior officers of the Rwanda Defence Force (RDF), saying they are biased and aimed at showing a picture contrary to the truth about the insecurity that has lasted a long time in the east of the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). This is in the statement that the Government of Rwanda issued on this Monday, 2 March 2026

statements_all.role: AFC/M23 communiqué (signatory not named in the excerpt)
statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that the AFC/M23 announced in a communiqué that it had once again handed over to the International Committee of the Red Cross more than 5 000 FARDC elements captured on different fronts, to be repatriated to Kinshasa under ICRC supervision, at a ceremony held on Monday 2 March 2026 at Rumangabo camp; Actualite.cd added that the rebels deplored Kinshasa's refusal to release their arrested comrades.
statements_all.excerpt_original: «L’Alliance Fleuve Congo/Mouvement du 23 Mars (AFC/M23) informe l’opinion publique qu’elle a une fois de plus remis au Comité international de la Croix-Rouge (CICR) plus de 5 000 éléments des FARDC, capturés sur différents fronts.
statements_all.translation_en: "The Alliance Fleuve Congo/March 23 Movement (AFC/M23) informs the public that it has once again handed over to the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) more than 5,000 FARDC elements, captured on different fronts.

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that the FARDC announced they had retaken the cité of Mikenge, Fizi territory, South Kivu, on Sunday '1er mard' (read as 1 March), after violent clashes with rebels in the Hauts Plateaux, and that the spokesperson of operations Sukola 2 Sud South Kivu, Sub-Lieutenant Mbuyi Reagan, said several rebels were neutralised, 5 captured and 17 surrendered, and that among 11 bodies found were an AFC-M23 brigade commander and a logistics officer.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Les Forces armées de la République démocratique du Congo (FARDC) annoncent avoir repris, dimanche 1er mard, la cité de Mikenge, située dans le territoire de Fizi, province du Sud-Kivu, après de violents affrontements contre les rebelles dans les Hauts Plateaux.
statements_all.translation_en: The Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (FARDC) announce they retook, on Sunday 1 March, the city of Mikenge, located in Fizi territory, South Kivu province, after violent clashes against the rebels in the Hauts Plateaux.

statements_all.person: Colonel John Imani Nzenze; Ms. Chantal Kayitaba Murekatete
statements_all.role: AFC/M23 Director of Intelligence and liaison with humanitarian actors; Special Adviser on Gender, Family and Children, Education, and Social and Humanitarian Affairs
statements_all.setting: meeting statements as reported by the Group of Experts
statements_all.text: The Group of Experts reported that at a joint meeting in late March 2026 AFC/M23 officials reprimanded humanitarian actors and accused them of inventing data about sexual violence, affirmed that AFC/M23 did not tolerate sexual violence, and criticised the lack of perpetrator data in patient files; the officials present included Colonel John Imani Nzenze and Ms. Chantal Kayitaba Murekatete.
statements_all.excerpt_original: A joint meeting was held in late March 2026 between humanitarian actors and AFC/M23 at which the issue of sexual violence data was discussed. AFC/M23 officials present at the meeting included Colonel John Imani Nzenze, AFC/M23 Director of Intelligence and the AFC/M23 liaison with humanitarian actors, and Ms. Chantal Kayitaba Murekatete

statements_all.setting: statement as reported by the Group of Experts
statements_all.text: The Group of Experts reported that AFC/M23 representatives announced that no withdrawal was taking place, describing movements as routine troop rotations.
statements_all.excerpt_original: AFC/M23 representatives announced that no withdrawal was taking place, describing movements as routine troop rotations

statements_all.setting: public statements as reported by the Group of Experts
statements_all.text: The Group of Experts reported public statements by the President of Rwanda, Paul Kagame, that 'defensive measures' also included troop deployment in the DRC.
statements_all.excerpt_original: as well as public statements by the President of Rwanda, Paul Kagame, that “defensive measures” also included troop deployment in the Democratic Republic of the Congo

statements_all.role: FARDC commander of the Mwenga sector
statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that Mwenga territory administrator Ishikitilo Mao said that on receiving the civil society's letter about some undisciplined soldiers "we convened a meeting with the military authorities", and that the FARDC commander in charge of the Mwenga sector admitted the presence of "brebis galeuses" (black sheep) within his troops and said he had already sanctioned three elements, including one Muzalendo volunteer, transferred to the general staff in Kisangani.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le commandant FARDC en charge du secteur de Mwenga admet la présence de « brebis galeuses » au sein de ses troupes. Il reconnaît avoir déjà sanctionné trois éléments, dont un volontaire Muzalendo, transférés auprès de l’État-major à Kisangani.
statements_all.translation_en: The FARDC commander in charge of the Mwenga sector admits the presence of "black sheep" within his troops. He acknowledges having already sanctioned three elements, including one Muzalendo volunteer, transferred to the general staff in Kisangani.

statements_all.role: AFC/M23 Director of Intelligence and liaison with humanitarian actors (present with Ms. Chantal Kayitaba Murekatete, Special Adviser on Gender, Family and Children, Education, and Social and Humanitarian Affairs)
statements_all.setting: meeting statements as reported by the UN Group of Experts
statements_all.text: The UN Group of Experts reported that at a joint meeting in late March 2026 between humanitarian actors and AFC/M23, attended by AFC/M23 officials including Colonel John Imani Nzenze, AFC/M23 Director of Intelligence and liaison with humanitarian actors, and Ms. Chantal Kayitaba Murekatete, Special Adviser on Gender, Family and Children, Education, and Social and Humanitarian Affairs, AFC/M23 reprimanded humanitarian actors and accused them of inventing data, affirmed that it did not tolerate sexual violence and criticised the lack of perpetrator data in patient files; further meetings in late March and April 2026 resulted in an agreement that only aggregate data on sexual violence would be shared.
statements_all.excerpt_original: 6. A joint meeting was held in late March 2026 between humanitarian actors and AFC/M23 at which the issue of sexual violence data was discussed.

statements_all.text: Kigali Today's Kinyarwanda version of a Jeune Afrique interview reports that Paul Kagame, asked about the capture of Uvira on 10 December (six days after the Washington agreement) and US pressure, said that 'they' wanted to convince people there was a link between the capture of Uvira and the Washington agreement and that it was a way of rejecting the agreement, 'That is not true at all', and added that whether or not the Washington agreement was signed, 'the capture of Uvira was necessary'.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Paul Kagame: Oya. Ni ibindi. Bashakaga kwemeza abantu ko hari isano hagati yo gufatwa kwa Uvira n’amasezerano ya Washington, kandi ko gufatwa kwa Uvira kwari uburyo bwo kwanga ayo masezerano. Ibyo si ukuri na gato.
statements_all.translation_en: Paul Kagame: No. It is other things. They wanted to convince people that there is a link between the capture of Uvira and the Washington agreement, and that the capture of Uvira was a way of rejecting that agreement. That is not true at all.

statements_all.text: Kigali Today's Kinyarwanda version of a Jeune Afrique interview reports that Paul Kagame, asked whether he agreed with the reading that Rwandan troops are on eastern DRC soil after Rwanda's ambassador in Washington said on 22 January that Rwanda has 'security cooperation with AFC/M23', answered 'Yes, of course', and said that defensive measures mean protecting Rwanda and its borders from threats, including using military equipment and sending troops on the ground, and that if guarding the border requires dealing with the problem 5, 10 or 20 kilometres back, it is a defensive measure.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Paul Kagame: Yego, birumvikana. Ingamba z’ubwirinzi ni ukuvuga kurinda igihugu cyacu n’imipaka yacu ku bidutera akaga, harimo gukoresha ibikoresho bya gisirikare, kohereza ingabo ku butaka cyangwa ibindi. Nta gihabanye. Niba zirinze umupaka wacu kandi bisaba guhangana n’ikibazo kuri kilometero 5, 10 cyangwa 20 inyuma, ni ingamba z’ubwirinzi.
statements_all.translation_en: Paul Kagame: Yes, of course. Defensive measures means protecting our country and our borders from what endangers us, including using military equipment, sending troops on the ground or other things. There is no contradiction. If they are guarding our border and it requires dealing with the problem 5, 10 or 20 kilometres behind, it is a defensive measure.

statements_all.text: Kigali Today's Kinyarwanda version of a Jeune Afrique interview reports that, asked about repeated reports that M23 has violated human rights and forcibly put people into the army since taking Goma in January 2025, Paul Kagame answered that he would accept that allegation if told that Goma has more peace than before M23 went there, and said things are now better than before and that Goma and Bukavu are doing well.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Jeune Afrique: Kuva M23 yafata Goma muri Mutarama 2025, kenshi bavuze ko yica uburenganzira bwa muntu kandi igashyira abantu mu gisirikare ku ngufu
statements_all.translation_en: Jeune Afrique: Since M23 took Goma in January 2025, it has often been said that it violates human rights and puts people into the army by force

statements_all.text: Kigali Today's Kinyarwanda version of a Jeune Afrique interview reports that Paul Kagame said that M23 is not a Rwandan group but a Congolese group that came to be called AFC/M23, which also includes former president Joseph Kabila.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Paul Kagame: Mbere na mbere, banza wumve uwo tuvugaho. M23 si umutwe w’u Rwanda, ahubwo ni umutwe w’Abanyekongo waje kwitwa AFC/M23, ukaba unabarizwamo uwahoze ari Perezida Joseph Kabila.
statements_all.translation_en: Paul Kagame: First of all, first understand who we are talking about. M23 is not a Rwandan group, but a Congolese group that came to be called AFC/M23, and which also includes former President Joseph Kabila.

statements_all.text: Kigali Today's Kinyarwanda version of a Jeune Afrique interview reports that Paul Kagame said that in areas M23 holds it works well in confronting 'these criminals', but in the territories of Masisi, Walikale and elsewhere where FARDC operate, the FDLR are still present in cooperation with the government.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Paul Kagame: Mu gihe guverinoma ya Kongo yagaragaje ubushake bwo guhagarika ibikorwa bya FDLR, ibisubizo bigeze he? Mu turere M23 ifite, ikora neza mu guhangana n’aba bagizi ba nabi, ariko mu turere twa Masisi, Walikale n’ahandi FARDC zikora, FDLR ziracyariho mu bufatanye na guverinoma.
statements_all.translation_en: Paul Kagame: While the Congolese government has shown willingness to stop FDLR activities, where are the results? In the areas M23 has, it works well in confronting these criminals, but in the territories of Masisi, Walikale and elsewhere where FARDC operate, the FDLR are still there in cooperation with the government.

statements_all.text: Ouragan.cd reported that, on the margins of the 61st session of the UN Human Rights Council, DRC Human Rights Minister Samuel Mbemba said at the rostrum that he counted more than 17 000 documented serious human rights violations, nearly 15 000 deaths and about eight million displaced.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Les chiffres sont accablants. A la tribune, le ministre Samuel Mbemba a dénombré plus de 17 000 violations graves de droits de l’homme documentées, près de 15 000 morts et environ huit millions de déplacés.
statements_all.translation_en: The figures are damning. At the rostrum, Minister Samuel Mbemba counted more than 17 000 documented serious human rights violations, nearly 15 000 deaths and about eight million displaced.

statements_all.text: BBC Gahuza reported that AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka told Reuters he knew of no mass graves during the group's time in Uvira, and accused the DRC government of spreading propaganda aimed at damaging its image.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi wa AFC/M23 Lawrence Kanyuka yabwiye ibiro ntaramakuru Reuters ko nta makuru y'imva rusange yigeze amenya mu gihe uwo mutwe wamaze muri Uvira, anashinja leta ya DRC gukwirakwiza icengezamatwara rigamije kwangiza isura yawo.
statements_all.translation_en: AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka told the news agency Reuters that he had learned of no mass graves during the time the group spent in Uvira, and accused the DRC government of spreading propaganda aimed at damaging its image.

statements_all.text: BBC Gahuza reported that AFC/M23 confirmed the death of its military spokesperson Lt Col Willy Ngoma, saying he was killed on the 24th of February in a 'full-scale war' it accuses Kinshasa of resuming; in a statement issued on Saturday, M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka said that the Kinshasa regime deliberately violated the ceasefire, mainly targeting AFC/M23 soldiers and civilians with its drones outside the front lines. The BBC reported that the DRC government had made no official announcement on the M23 statement or on Ngoma's death.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Umutwe w'inyeshyamba wa AFC/M23 urwanya ubutegetsi bwa Repubulika ya Demokarasi ya Congo (DRC) wemeje urupfu rw'uwari umuvugizi wa gisirikare wawo, Lt Col Willy Ngoma, uvuga ko yishwe ku itariki ya 24 y'ukwezi gushize kwa Gashyantare (2) mu "ntambara isesuye" ushinja Kinshasa gusubukura.
statements_all.translation_en: The rebel group AFC/M23, opposed to the government of the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), confirmed the death of the man who was its military spokesperson, Lt Col Willy Ngoma, saying he was killed on the 24th of last month, February (2), in a 'full-scale war' that it accuses Kinshasa of resuming.

statements_all.text: Umuryango.rw (Rwanda) reported that AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka said that on Thursday 26 February 2026, at about 16:15, combined forces, especially those of the FDLR, entered the JTN tea area at Mweso and shot 19 cows, of which 15 died immediately and 4 were seriously wounded.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi wa AFC/M23, Lawrence Kanyuka, yatangaje ko FARDC iri gukora ibyaha by’intambara kuko iri kurasa abaturage idasize n’amatungo yabo.
statements_all.translation_en: The spokesperson of AFC/M23, Lawrence Kanyuka, announced that the FARDC is committing war crimes because it is shooting at residents without sparing even their livestock.

statements_all.text: Umuryango.rw (Rwanda) reported that AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka said the fighters fired bursts of bullets at a 19-year-old girl called Wamahoro, from Kitchanga, who died immediately.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi wa AFC/M23, Lawrence Kanyuka, yatangaje ko FARDC iri gukora ibyaha by’intambara kuko iri kurasa abaturage idasize n’amatungo yabo.
statements_all.translation_en: The spokesperson of AFC/M23, Lawrence Kanyuka, announced that the FARDC is committing war crimes because it is shooting at residents without sparing even their livestock.

statements_all.role: president of the M23 and deputy coordinator of AFC/M23
statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that Bertrand Bisimwa, whom it described as president of the movement and its deputy coordinator, said on Wednesday that the Kinshasa regime had 'once again trampled the ceasefire' by launching a 'generalised offensive on all front lines and beyond', and that there had been 'no public reprimand, no condemnation' of it; the outlet also reported that spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka, in a separate communiqué, reported attacks that day in Minembwe and Kalehe.
statements_all.excerpt_original: « Nous constatons que le régime de Kinshasa a, une fois de plus, foulé aux pieds le cessez-le-feu en déclenchant une offensive généralisée sur l’ensemble des lignes de front et au-delà.
statements_all.translation_en: "We note that the Kinshasa regime has, once again, trampled the ceasefire by launching a generalised offensive on all front lines and beyond."

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that AFC-M23 political spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka said the Kinshasa regime had once again trampled the ceasefire and that on Tuesday 24 February 2026 at 07h00 its 'forces coalisées' (coalition forces) launched deliberate attacks on densely populated areas of Kitendebwa, Kashihe and Kiduveri in Kalehe territory. The outlet, in its own narration, refers to the ceasefire signed in Doha.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Ce mardi 24 février 2026, à 07h00 précises, ses forces coalisées ont lancé des attaques sauvages et délibérées contre des zones densément peuplées de Kitendebwa, Kashihe et Kiduveri, dans le territoire de Kalehe », a déclaré Lawrence Kanyuka, porte-parole politique de l’AFC-M23.
statements_all.translation_en: This Tuesday 24 February 2026, at exactly 07:00, its coalition forces launched savage and deliberate attacks against densely populated areas of Kitendebwa, Kashihe and Kiduveri, in Kalehe territory," said Lawrence Kanyuka, political spokesperson of the AFC-M23.

statements_all.role: FARDC (army), via BBC correspondent in Kinshasa
statements_all.text: BBC Gahuza reported, citing its Kinshasa correspondent, that the Congolese army (FARDC) confirmed it had carried out strikes on Rubaya centre on Tuesday that 'killed' AFC/M23 spokesperson Willy Ngoma.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Igisirikare cya DR Congo (FARDC) cyemeje ko cyakoze ibitero muri centre ya Rubaya mu burasirazuba bw'iki gihugu ku wa kabiri "kigahitana" Willy Ngoma umuvugizi w'umutwe wa AFC/M23, nk'uko umunyamakuru wa BBC i Kinshasa abivuga.
statements_all.translation_en: The DR Congo army (FARDC) confirmed that it carried out strikes on Rubaya centre in the east of the country on Tuesday that 'killed' Willy Ngoma, spokesperson of the AFC/M23, according to the BBC reporter in Kinshasa.

statements_all.text: BBC Gahuza reported that AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka wrote on X at about 5 a.m. on Tuesday that the drone attacks 'fired blindly' at the Rubaya area 'killing innocent civilians', calling it a 'crime against humanity and a war crime'.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Gusa mu gitondo ahagana saa kumi n'imwe ku wa kabiri, umuvugizi wa AFC/M23, Lawrence Kanyuka, yanditse ubutumwa ku rubuga X avuga ko ibitero bya 'drones' "byarashe buhumyi" agace ka Rubaya "byica abasivile b'inzirakarengane", abyita "icyaha ku nyoko muntu n'icyaha cy'intambara".
statements_all.translation_en: But at about 5 a.m. on Tuesday, AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka wrote a message on X saying that the 'drone' attacks 'fired blindly' at the Rubaya area 'killing innocent civilians', calling it a 'crime against humanity and a war crime'.

statements_all.role: acting Special Representative of the UN Secretary-General in the DRC
statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported, citing a MONUSCO communiqué, that MONUSCO and the ICGLR (CIRGL) were on a mission in Uvira from 23 to 27 February to prepare deployment of the joint ceasefire monitoring mechanism, and quoted acting Special Representative Vivian Van de Perre as saying MONUSCO's mandate in South Kivu is focused on ceasefire monitoring and does not include protection of civilians.
statements_all.excerpt_original: En mission du 23 au 27 février à Uvira (Sud-Kivu), la Mission de l’Organisation des Nations unies pour la stabilisation en RDC (MONUSCO) et la Conférence internationale sur la région des Grands Lacs (CIRGL) préparent le déploiement du Mécanisme conjoint de suivi du cessez-le-feu.
statements_all.translation_en: On a mission from 23 to 27 February in Uvira (South Kivu), the United Nations Organization Stabilization Mission in the DRC (MONUSCO) and the International Conference on the Great Lakes Region (ICGLR) are preparing the deployment of the Joint Ceasefire Monitoring Mechanism.

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that the authorities of the DRC and Burundi agreed to reopen on Monday 23 February 2026 the common border between Bujumbura and Uvira, through the Kavimvira and Gatumba border posts, with traffic resuming immediately, after the population of Uvira had been cut off from Bujumbura since the AFC-M23's temporary occupation of the city on 10 December 2025.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Les autorités de la République démocratique du Congo et du Burundi ont convenu de rouvrir, lundi 23 février 2026, la frontière commune entre les villes de Bujumbura et Uvira. Le trafic a immédiatement repris, à la grande satisfaction des populations des deux pays voisins.
statements_all.translation_en: The authorities of the Democratic Republic of Congo and Burundi agreed to reopen, on Monday 23 February 2026, the common border between the cities of Bujumbura and Uvira. Traffic immediately resumed, to the great satisfaction of the populations of the two neighbouring countries.

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that AFC/M23 political coordinator Corneille Nangaa said in Goma, in front of EU commissioner Hadja Lahbib and then the press, that the 'premiers demandeurs' for reopening the Goma international airport were the authorities in Goma, i.e. his movement, and that the AFC/M23 now said it accepted 'the principle' of discussions on the reopening process, 'taking into account the constraints' of the area it controls.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Devant la commissaire européenne Hadja Lahbib, puis face à la presse, le coordonnateur politique de la rébellion a assuré que les « premiers demandeurs » de la réouverture étaient les autorités présentes à Goma, c’est-à-dire son mouvement.
statements_all.translation_en: Before European commissioner Hadja Lahbib, then before the press, the rebellion's political coordinator assured that the 'first requesters' of the reopening were the authorities present in Goma, that is, his movement.

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that, despite the ceasefire announced for 18 February at noon, clashes continued in eastern DRC between the FARDC and AFC/M23; it said the truce had been proposed on 11 February by Angola after a meeting in Luanda, and that the DRC officially adhered to it while AFC/M23 had committed to an immediate halt to hostilities under the Doha process.
statements_all.excerpt_original: En dépit du cessez-le-feu annoncé pour le 18 février à midi, les affrontements se poursuivent dans l’est de la RDC entre les Forces armées de la République démocratique du Congo (FARDC) et la rébellion de l’AFC/M23.
statements_all.translation_en: Despite the ceasefire announced for 18 February at noon, clashes continue in eastern DRC between the FARDC and the AFC/M23 rebellion.

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that, hours after EU commissioner Hadja Lahbib described the humanitarian situation as "catastrophique", AFC/M23 political coordinator Corneille Nangaa told the press in Goma on 20 February that the situation is catastrophic "non plus dans la zone contrôlée par l'AFC/M23", and asserted that humanitarian access in territories under his movement's control would be "garanti".
statements_all.excerpt_original: Corneille Nangaa, coordonnateur politique de l’AFC/M23, lui a opposé une lecture radicalement différente. « La situation est catastrophique, non plus dans la zone contrôlée par l’AFC/M23 », a-t-il affirmé devant la presse le 20 février,
statements_all.translation_en: Corneille Nangaa, political coordinator of the AFC/M23, offered a radically different reading. "The situation is catastrophic, no longer in the zone controlled by the AFC/M23", he said before the press on 20 February,

statements_all.text: Umuryango.rw reported that AFC/M23 said it was saddened to see the international community remaining silent on killings being carried out by the Kinshasa government against residents of areas including Minembwe, Mikenge and Karingi in South Kivu; Kanyuka said these acts against innocent and defenceless civilians were being carried out by FARDC, FNDB, Wazalendo, FDLR and foreign mercenaries.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Ihuriro AFC/M23 ritavuga rumwe n’ubutegetsi bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, ryatangaje ko ribabajwe no kubona umuryango mpuzamahanga ukomeje kuruca ukarumira ku bwicanyi buri gukorwa n’ubutegetsi bwa Kinshasa bukorerwa abatuye mu bice birimo Minembwe, Mikenge, na Karingi muri Kivu y’Epfo.
statements_all.translation_en: The AFC/M23 alliance, opposed to the government of the Democratic Republic of Congo, said it is saddened to see the international community remaining silent on the killings being carried out by the Kinshasa government against residents of areas including Minembwe, Mikenge and Karingi in South Kivu.

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that the DRC responded favourably to the Angolan proposal and officially accepted the principle of a ceasefire in the east, and that, according to the Presidency of the Republic, this acceptance of the ceasefire from 18 February was made "in a spirit of responsibility, appeasement and search for a peaceful solution to the conflict".
statements_all.excerpt_original: Selon la Présidence de la République, cette acceptation du cessez-le-feu à partir du 18 février prochain s’inscrit « dans un esprit de responsabilité, d’apaisement et de recherche d’une solution pacifique au conflit ».
statements_all.translation_en: According to the Presidency of the Republic, this acceptance of the ceasefire from 18 February is part of "a spirit of responsibility, appeasement and the search for a peaceful solution to the conflict".

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that the AFC/M23, while not joining the Angolan scheme, which it says it does not recognise, also reaffirmed its commitment to implement, without delay and in good faith, the ceasefire mechanism agreed under the Doha process.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Sans pour autant s’inscrire dans le schéma angolais, qu’elle dit ne pas reconnaître, la rébellion de l’AFC/M23, soutenue par le Rwanda, a de son côté également réaffirmé son engagement à mettre en œuvre, sans délai et de bonne foi, le mécanisme de cessez-le-feu convenu dans le cadre du processus de Doha.
statements_all.translation_en: Without fitting into the Angolan scheme, which it says it does not recognise, the AFC/M23 rebellion, supported by Rwanda, also reaffirmed on its side its commitment to implement, without delay and in good faith, the ceasefire mechanism agreed under the Doha process.

statements_all.role: senior adviser for Africa (as described by the outlet)
statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that the senior US adviser for Africa, whom it called "Monsieur Afrique de l'administration Trump", wrote on X that, encouraged by the DRC's acceptance of Angola's ceasefire proposal, all parties must immediately cease hostilities, including drone attacks that continue to cost innocent civilians their lives, and that the priority is now to make the ceasefire monitoring and verification mechanism agreed in Doha operational.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Encouragés par l'acceptation par la RDC de la proposition de cessez-le-feu angolaise, nous insistons sur la nécessité d'agir concrètement sur le terrain. Toutes les parties doivent immédiatement cesser les hostilités, y compris les attaques de drones qui continuent de coûter la vie à des civils innocents.
statements_all.translation_en: Encouraged by the DRC's acceptance of the Angolan ceasefire proposal, we insist on the need to act concretely on the ground. All parties must immediately cease hostilities, including drone attacks that continue to cost innocent civilians their lives.

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that AFC/M23 accused the FARDC of multiple ceasefire violations despite the negotiation process under way in Doha, and said it was open to any peace and de-escalation initiative.
statements_all.excerpt_original: L’AFC/M23 a accusé les FARDC de violations multiples du cessez-le-feu malgré le processus de négociation en cours à Doha.
statements_all.translation_en: The AFC/M23 accused the FARDC of multiple ceasefire violations despite the negotiation process under way in Doha.

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that AFC/M23, through its coordinator Corneille Nangaa, said it was concerned by the attitude of the Burundian president and incoming African Union chair, an attitude it said contributes to the persistence of targeted violence against Banyamulenge communities, and that it called on the international community and continental institutions to exercise sustained vigilance.
statements_all.excerpt_original: L’AFC/M23 s'inquiète de l’attitude du président burundais et président entrant de l’Union africaine, attitude qui contribue à la persistance de violences ciblées contre les communautés banyamulenge.
statements_all.translation_en: AFC/M23 is concerned about the attitude of the Burundian president and incoming president of the African Union, an attitude that contributes to the persistence of targeted violence against Banyamulenge communities.

statements_all.text: Kigali Today (Rwandan outlet) reported that Minister Nduhungirehe, answering an RFI journalist, said 'Nta munsi n’umwe utambuka hatabayeho ibitero byo mu kirere bigabwe na Guverinoma ya Congo, ku birindiro bya AFC/M23' (not a day passes without air attacks by the Congolese Government on AFC/M23 positions), which he called a violation of the ceasefire agreements.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Nta munsi n’umwe utambuka hatabayeho ibitero byo mu kirere bigabwe na Guverinoma ya Congo, ku birindiro bya AFC/M23 kandi ibyo ni ukurenga ku masezerano yo guhagarika intambara,
statements_all.translation_en: Not a single day passes without air attacks by the Government of Congo on AFC/M23 positions, and that is a violation of the agreements to stop the war,

statements_all.role: Major General, military coordinator of AFC-M23
statements_all.setting: speech, as reported by SOS Médias Burundi
statements_all.text: SOS Médias Burundi quoted Major General Sultani Makenga, AFC-M23 military coordinator, as saying to the new troops: 'From today you have become soldiers of the ARC, an army that emerged to liberate the people, our country is run by incompetent people living in Kinshasa'.
statements_all.excerpt_original: “Kuanzia leo mmekuwa askari wa ARC, jeshi lililojitokeza kuwakomboa wananchi, nchi yetu inaendeshwa na watu wazembe wanaoishi Kinshasa,” alisema Meja Jenerali Sultani Makenga, Mratibu wa Kijeshi wa AFC-M23.
statements_all.translation_en: "From today you have become soldiers of the ARC, an army that emerged to liberate the people, our country is run by incompetent people living in Kinshasa," said Major General Sultani Makenga, Military Coordinator of AFC-M23.

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that, in a communiqué reacting to an African Union Commission statement, the AFC/M23 said that since 22 January 2026 localities including Minembwe, Twangiza, Rwitsankuku, Katogota, Sange, Kalundu port, Masisi, Walikale, Rutshuru, Lubero, Mwenga and Kalehe had been targeted by 'huit à douze drones d’attaque pilotés par des mercenaires étrangers', that these strikes allegedly hit civilian targets including hospitals, schools and churches, and that its own drone-neutralisation operation caused no civilian loss.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le mouvement affirme que, depuis le 22 janvier 2026, plusieurs localités des Hauts-Plateaux et du Sud-Kivu auraient été ciblées par « huit à douze drones d’attaque pilotés par des mercenaires étrangers », citant notamment Minembwe, Twangiza, Rwitsankuku, Katogota, Sange, le port de Kalundu, Masisi, Walikale, Rutshuru, Lubero, Mwenga et Kalehe.
statements_all.translation_en: The movement says that, since 22 January 2026, several localities of the Hauts-Plateaux and of South Kivu had reportedly been targeted by « eight to twelve attack drones piloted by foreign mercenaries », citing in particular Minembwe, Twangiza, Rwitsankuku, Katogota, Sange, the port of Kalundu, Masisi, Walikale, Rutshuru, Lubero, Mwenga and Kalehe.

statements_all.setting: address to residents, as reported by Umuryango.rw
statements_all.text: Umuryango.rw reported that AFC/M23 coordinator Corneille Nangaa told residents of Goma that, a year after the city's administration was installed, everything was now in order, that the war in the city was completely over, and that what remained was to continue development and to liberate all of Congo.
