statements_all.excerpt_original: Umuhuzabikorwa w’Ihuriro AFC/M23, Corneille Nangaa yabwiye abaturage bo mu Mujyi wa Goma ko nyuma y’umwaka hashyizweho ubuyobozi bw’uyu mujyi, ubu ibintu byose byamaze kujya ku murongo igisigaye ari ugukomeza urugendo rw’iterambere ndetse no kubohora Congo yose.
statements_all.translation_en: The Coordinator of the AFC/M23 alliance, Corneille Nangaa, told the residents of Goma city that a year after the city's leadership was put in place, everything is now in order and what remains is to continue the journey of development and to liberate all of Congo.

statements_all.role: Minister of National Defence (not named on the page)
statements_all.setting: Council of Ministers briefing as reported
statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that the Minister of National Defence said at the Council of Ministers of Friday 6 February [2026] that the FARDC had defeated attacks by 'la coalition RDF-M23-AFC' in South Kivu by retaking several localities including Minembwe-centre.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le ministre de la Défense nationale a indiqué, lors du conseil des ministres du vendredi 6 février, que dans le Sud-Kivu, les Forces armées de la RDC, (FARDC) ont fait échec aux attaques de "la coalition RDF-M23-AFC" en reconquérant plusieurs localités dont Minembwe-centre.
statements_all.translation_en: The Minister of National Defence indicated, at the Council of Ministers on Friday 6 February, that in South Kivu the Armed Forces of the DRC (FARDC) defeated the attacks of "the RDF-M23-AFC coalition" by reconquering several localities including Minembwe-centre.

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that the administrator of Fizi territory, Samy Badibanga Kalonji, said the number of internally displaced people was approaching one million across Fizi territory, and that fighting on Thursday 5 February at 'Point Zéro' caused a new mass displacement.
statements_all.excerpt_original: L’administrateur du territoire de Fizi, Samy Badibanga Kalonji, reformule son appel à une aide humanitaire d’urgence en faveur des personnes rendues vulnérables par ces guerres à répétition. Selon lui, le nombre de déplacés internes avoisine désormais un million sur l’ensemble du territoire de Fizi.
statements_all.translation_en: The administrator of Fizi territory, Samy Badibanga Kalonji, repeats his call for emergency humanitarian aid for people made vulnerable by these repeated wars. According to him, the number of internally displaced people is now approaching one million across the whole of Fizi territory.

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that in a statement posted on X on 3 February, Corneille Nangaa presented as a response to what he called an indiscriminate military campaign by the central government the AFC/M23's claimed operation against what it described as the Congolese army's drone command centre in Kisangani (Tshopo).
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le mouvement politico-militaire AFC/M23 affirme avoir mené une opération ciblée contre ce qu’il décrit comme le centre de commandement des drones de l’armée congolaise à Kisangani, dans la province de la Tshopo.
statements_all.translation_en: The politico-military movement AFC/M23 says it carried out a targeted operation against what it describes as the command centre of the Congolese army's drones in Kisangani, in Tshopo province.

statements_all.role: spokesperson, Sukola Sud operations in South Kivu
statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that the spokesperson of the Sukola Sud operations in South Kivu, Sub-Lieutenant Mbuyi Reagan, said on Monday 2 February that the army had been fighting for five days to retake Minembwe, regarded as the stronghold of Twirwaneho and its allies.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Selon le porte-parole des opérations Sukola Sud au Sud-Kivu, le sous-lieutenant Mbuyi Reagan, l’armée combat depuis cinq jours pour reprendre le contrôle de Minembwe, considéré comme le fief des Twirwaneho et de leurs alliés.
statements_all.translation_en: According to the spokesperson of the Sukola Sud operations in South Kivu, Sub-Lieutenant Mbuyi Reagan, the army has been fighting for five days to regain control of Minembwe, regarded as the stronghold of the Twirwaneho and their allies.

statements_all.role: spokesperson, Sukola Sud operations in South Kivu
statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that Sub-Lieutenant Mbuyi Reagan, FARDC spokesperson, said the enemy was dropping bombs blindly in populated areas where civilians were, while the regular army 'does not fight in agglomerations' and protects the population.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Face à ces pertes, ils larguent des bombes à l’aveuglette dans les agglomérations où se trouve la population civile. Mais nous, l’armée régulière, nous ne combattons pas dans les agglomérations, nous protégeons la population
statements_all.translation_en: Faced with these losses, they drop bombs blindly in the built-up areas where the civilian population is. But we, the regular army, do not fight in built-up areas, we protect the population.

statements_all.text: The Qatari foreign ministry said on 2 February 2026 that the DRC government and AFC/M23 had signed in Doha the terms of reference stemming from the International Conference on the Great Lakes Region, and that the two parties renewed their commitment to the ceasefire and the Doha Framework Agreement for Peace signed between them on November 15, 2025.
statements_all.excerpt_original: The Government of the Democratic Republic of the Congo and the Alliance Fleuve Congo / March 23 Movement (AFC/M23) have signed the terms of reference stemming from the International Conference on the Great Lakes Region.

statements_all.role: Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation
statements_all.setting: press conference / meeting with partner countries and international organisations
statements_all.text: SOS Médias Burundi (Swahili edition, dateline Bujumbura) reported that at a session of Burundi's Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation in Bujumbura, Foreign Minister Édouard Bizimana announced that the Burundi-Congo border would remain closed until further notice, insisted that the M23 was lying when it claimed to be withdrawing from the city of Uvira, and said this apparent withdrawal hid a strategy of regrouping its fighters.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Waziri wa Mambo ya Nje na Ushirikiano wa Kimataifa wa Burundi, Édouard Bizimana, alitangaza kwamba mpaka wa Burundi na Kongo utaendelea kufungwa hadi ilani nyingine. Akizungumzia hali ya usalama mashariki mwa DRC, Waziri wa Mambo ya Nje wa Burundi alisisitiza kuwa M23 inadanganya inapodai kujiondoa katika mji wa Uvira.
statements_all.translation_en: The Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation of Burundi, Édouard Bizimana, announced that the border between Burundi and Congo would remain closed until further notice. Speaking about the security situation in eastern DRC, the Burundian Foreign Minister insisted that M23 is lying when it claims to withdraw from the city of Uvira.

statements_all.role: Minister of Foreign Affairs, Regional Integration and International Cooperation
statements_all.text: SOS Médias Burundi reported that Burundian Foreign Minister Édouard Bizimana declared at a Bujumbura meeting with representatives of partner countries and international organisations that the Burundi-Congo border would remain closed until further notice, and asserted that the M23 was lying when it claimed to have withdrawn from Uvira, saying the apparent withdrawal masked a regrouping and repositioning of its fighters.
statements_all.excerpt_original: At this meeting, the Burundian Minister of Foreign Affairs, Édouard Bizimana, declared that the Burundi-Congo border will remain closed until further notice. Speaking about the security situation in eastern DRC, the Burundian Foreign Minister asserted that the M23 is lying when it claims to have withdrawn from the city of Uvira.

statements_all.role: AFC/M23 coordinator, message on X as reported by BBC
statements_all.text: BBC News Gahuza reported that the AFC/M23 confirmed it carried out a drone attack on Kisangani airport (Tshopo) as a 'warning' to Kinshasa, as its leader said, and that the movement said its drones destroyed a military drone base at the airport 'where attacks killing civilians were prepared' in Masisi, Walikale, Rutshuru, Minembwe and elsewhere; BBC said it could not independently verify either side's claims.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Umutwe wa AFC/M23 wemeje ko ari wo wagabye igitero cya 'drones' ku kibuga cy'indege cyo mu mujyi wa Kisangani mu ntara ya Tshopo mu buryo bwo "kuburira" Kinshasa, nk'uko umukuru w'uyu mutwe abivuga.
statements_all.translation_en: The AFC/M23 group confirmed that it carried out the 'drones' attack on the airport in the city of Kisangani in Tshopo province as a way of 'warning' Kinshasa, as the head of this group says.

statements_all.text: BBC News Gahuza reported that the Tshopo provincial government said eight bomb-carrying drones tried to attack Bangoka airport at Kisangani on Sunday but were all shot down before reaching their target, and that the government side condemned the attack on a civilian airport and blamed the M23 and Rwandan forces.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Leta y'intara ya Tshopo yatangaje ko ku Cyumweru indege umunani za 'drones' zitwaye ibisasu zagerageje igitero ku kibuga cy'indege kizwi nka Bangoka cy'umujyi wa Kisangani, ariko ko zose zarashwe "zitaragere ku mugambi mubisha wazo".
statements_all.translation_en: The Tshopo provincial government announced that on Sunday eight 'drones' carrying bombs attempted an attack on the airport known as Bangoka in the city of Kisangani, but that all were shot down 'before reaching their evil aim'.

statements_all.role: provincial coordinator of the RAD, South Kivu
statements_all.text: Tumaini Africa News reported that the RAD provincial coordinator for South Kivu, Alexis Mwamba Dunia, accompanied by representatives of the VDP Wazalendo, expressed gratitude to President Tshisekedi and the central government for a 325 US dollar incentive payment called 'effort de guerre', in a press briefing held in Kalundu commune, Uvira city.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le coordinateur provincial de la Réserve armée de la défense (RAD), sud-Kivu, Alexis Mwamba Dunia, accompagné des représentants des Volontaires pour la défense de la patrie (VDP) Wazalendo, a exprimé sa reconnaissance au Président de la République, Félix Antoine Tshisekedi Tshilombo, ainsi qu’au gouvernement central, pour l’octroi d’une prime d’encouragement de 325 dollars américains, dénommée « effort de guerre ».
statements_all.translation_en: The provincial coordinator of the Réserve armée de la défense (RAD), Sud Kivu, Alexis Mwamba Dunia, accompanied by representatives of the Volontaires pour la défense de la patrie (VDP) Wazalendo, expressed his gratitude to the president of the republic, Félix Antoine Tshisekedi Tshilombo, and to the central government, for the granting of an incentive payment of 325 US dollars, called 'effort de guerre'.

statements_all.role: North Kivu governor appointed by AFC/M23
statements_all.setting: speech to residents during a visit, as reported
statements_all.text: The AFC/M23-appointed Governor of North Kivu, Col Bahati Musanga Erasto, asked residents of the Binza groupement (Bwisha chiefdom, Rutshuru territory, near the Ugandan border) to distance themselves from the FDLR, telling them its founders had shed innocent blood in Rwanda, according to Igihe.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Guverineri w’Intara ya Kivu y’Amajyaruguru washyizweho n’ihuriro AFC/M23 rirwanya ubutegetsi bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, Col Bahati Musanga Erasto, yasabye abaturage kwitandukanya n’umutwe w’iterabwoba wa FDLR, abamenyesha ko abawushinze bamennye amaraso y’inzirakarengane mu Rwanda.
statements_all.translation_en: The Governor of North Kivu appointed by the AFC/M23 alliance, which opposes the government of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Col Bahati Musanga Erasto, asked residents to distance themselves from the terrorist group FDLR, informing them that its founders shed the blood of innocents in Rwanda.

statements_all.role: North Kivu governor appointed by AFC/M23
statements_all.text: Col Bahati Musanga Erasto, the provincial governor appointed by AFC/M23, said, according to Igihe, of the FDLR, that 'we know well that they are still in the forests, and we will not cease to fight them until we defeat them.'
statements_all.excerpt_original: Guverineri w’Intara ya Kivu y’Amajyaruguru washyizweho n’ihuriro AFC/M23 rirwanya ubutegetsi bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, Col Bahati Musanga Erasto, yasabye abaturage kwitandukanya n’umutwe w’iterabwoba wa FDLR, abamenyesha ko abawushinze bamennye amaraso y’inzirakarengane mu Rwanda. Ubu butumwa yabuhaye abatuye muri Sheferi ya Bwisha, Gurupoma ya Binza, muri teritwari ya Rutshuru, hafi y’umupaka wa Uganda, ubwo yabasuraga, aherekejwe n’abandi bayobozi bo ku rwego rwa politiki n’urw’umutekano. Ati “Bariho umuvumo w’Imana, ntibazabasha no kugera ku nzozi zabo zo gutaha bagafata igihugu baturutsemo, kuko bakivuyemo bamennye amaraso y’inzirakarengane, bageze na hano bakomeza kuyamena, ni byo biri kubakurikirana, ubu bariho amaraso afite urubanza. Turabizi neza ko bakiri mu mashyamba, kandi ntituzahwema kubarwanya kugeza tubatsinze.”
statements_all.translation_en: We know well that they are still in the forests, and we will not cease to fight them until we defeat them.

statements_all.role: North Kivu governor appointed by AFC/M23
statements_all.text: Igihe reported that Governor Bahati indicated that if FDLR fighters were not supported by some of the residents who take them food in the forests, they would leave it and hand themselves over to AFC/M23, which would hand them to Rwanda.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Guverineri Bahati yavuze ko abagize FDLR ari ibisambo by’inda mbi, byirirwa bishuka abaturage, bikabambura, bigasambanya abagore n’abakobwa ku gahato. Ati “Ariya mabandi ntazigera agira igihugu nk’uko tugifite uku, icyo bashoboye ni ukujya batega ibico imodoka, bagasahura, abazirimo bakabica, ari na wo muvumo ubariho.” Yagaragaje ko abarwanyi ba FDLR baramutse badashyigikiwe na bamwe mu baturage babajyanira ibyo kurya mu mashyamba, bayivanamo bakishyikiriza AFC/M23, ikabashyikiriza u Rwanda.
statements_all.translation_en: He indicated that if FDLR fighters were not supported by some of the residents who take them food in the forests, they would leave it and hand themselves over to AFC/M23, which would hand them over to Rwanda.

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that the Tshopo provincial authorities and the FARDC announced they had neutralised eight explosive-laden kamikaze drones in the night of 31 January to 1 February 2026, and that the Tshopo authorities accused the AFC/M23 of trying to target Bangoka airport.
statements_all.excerpt_original: les autorités provinciales de la Tshopo et les Forces armées de la RDC (FARDC) ont annoncé avoir neutralisé huit drones kamikazes chargés d’explosifs, dans la nuit du 31 janvier au 1ᵉʳ février 2026. Les autorités de la province de la Tshopo ont accusé l’AFC/M23 d’avoir tenté de viser l’aéroport de Bangoka
statements_all.translation_en: the provincial authorities of Tshopo and the Armed Forces of the DRC (FARDC) announced that they had neutralised eight kamikaze drones loaded with explosives, in the night of 31 January to 1 February 2026. The authorities of Tshopo province accused the AFC/M23 of having tried to target Bangoka airport

statements_all.role: spokesperson of the governor of North Kivu province
statements_all.text: BBC News Gahuza reported that Lumumba Kambere Muyisa, spokesperson of the governor of North Kivu province, told the media that the upper parts of the mine had fallen into the mine on Wednesday because of heavy rain.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Lumumba Kambere Muyisa, umuvugizi wa guverineri w'intara ya Kivu ya Ruguru, yabwiye ibitangazamakuru ko ibice byo hejuru by'icyo kirombe byahubukiye mu kirombe ku wa gatatu kubera imvura nyinshi
statements_all.translation_en: Lumumba Kambere Muyisa, spokesperson of the governor of the province of North Kivu, told the media that the upper parts of that mine had collapsed into the mine on Wednesday because of heavy rain

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that Lubero territory administrator Colonel Kiwewa Mitela Alain said that since the night of 24 January 2026 the ADF had carried out a deadly attack on Musenge village, burning almost the whole village, a health centre and a Catholic church, and that two soldiers were found burned.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Il a indiqué que depuis la nuit du 24 janvier 2026, les ADF ont mené une attaque meurtrière contre le village de Musenge, incendiant presque tout le village, un centre de santé ainsi qu’une église catholique. Deux militaires ont été retrouvés calcinés.
statements_all.translation_en: He said that since the night of 24 January 2026, the ADF carried out a deadly attack on the village of Musenge, burning almost the entire village, a health centre and a Catholic church. Two soldiers were found burned.

statements_all.role: Deputy Prime Minister, Minister of National Defence and Veterans
statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that Defence Minister Guy Kabombo Muadiamvita told the Council of Ministers that security forces had returned to Uvira to ensure public order and that the scenario of chaos foreseen by the rebellion after its withdrawal had been foiled.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Guy Kabombo Muadiamvita, a fait état du retour des forces de sécurité à Uvira afin d’y assurer l’ordre public et la sécurité des populations. À cette occasion, il a indiqué que le scénario de chaos présagé par la rébellion après son retrait de la ville avait été déjoué
statements_all.translation_en: Guy Kabombo Muadiamvita reported the return of the security forces to Uvira in order to ensure public order and the security of the population. On this occasion he indicated that the scenario of chaos foreseen by the rebellion after its withdrawal from the city had been foiled.

statements_all.text: SOS Médias Burundi reported that the governor of South Kivu, Jean-Jacques Purusi, after crossing the border, had assured the population in Uvira that the Burundi-Congo border would be reopened within two to three days, by 30 January 2026 at the latest; the same report says the border's continued closure was later announced.
statements_all.excerpt_original: announcement by the governor of South Kivu, Jean-Jacques Purusi. The previous Friday, after crossing the border, he had assured the population in Uvira—the province’s provisional capital—that the Burundi-Congo border would be reopened within two to three days, by January 30, 2026, at the latest.

statements_all.text: Ouragan.cd reported that in a communiqué made public on Thursday 22 January the Congolese government denounced a "partial and truncated" interpretation of events by Human Rights Watch, and that Muyaya said no death or injury had been recorded within the Banyamulenge community since the withdrawal of the Rwandan troops.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Dans son communiqué rendu public le jeudi 22 janvier, Kinshasa a dénoncé une interprétation « partielle et tronquée » des événements. Selon le gouvernement congolais, HRW aurait ignoré la genèse du conflit : une occupation illégale ponctuée de pillages et de manœuvres de déstabilisation planifiées par le groupe armé avant son départ.
statements_all.translation_en: In its communiqué made public on Thursday 22 January, Kinshasa denounced a "partial and truncated" interpretation of the events. According to the Congolese government, HRW had ignored the genesis of the conflict: an illegal occupation punctuated by looting and destabilisation manoeuvres planned by the armed group before its departure.

statements_all.setting: interview/remarks to the press as reported
statements_all.text: Actualité.cd reported that Uvira city mayor Kifara Kapenda Kiki, who had returned to Uvira on Thursday, said that those who had occupied the city had left Uvira but 'ils ne sont pas loin', and acknowledged abuses ('dérives') both within the FARDC and among the wazalendo self-defence groups during the fighting.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le maire de la ville d’Uvira Kifara Kapenda Kiki qui est retourné jeudi s’est exprimé sur l’évolution de la situation sécuritaire, le retour de l’administration publique et la reprise progressive des activités.
statements_all.translation_en: The mayor of the city of Uvira Kifara Kapenda Kiki, who returned on Thursday, spoke about the evolution of the security situation, the return of the public administration and the gradual resumption of activities.

statements_all.text: BBC Afrique reported that the Congolese government, in a communiqué of 22 January 2026, rejected the Human Rights Watch statement of 20 January 2026 on Uvira as a "partial or truncated" reading of events, and held the RDF/M23 primarily responsible for endangering civilians, notably through its illegal armed occupation of the city.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le gouvernement congolais rejette le communiqué publié le 20 janvier 2026 par Human Rights Watch sur la situation sécuritaire à Uvira, estimant que l'organisation propose une lecture "partielle ou tronquée" des faits.
statements_all.translation_en: The Congolese government rejects the communiqué published on 20 January 2026 by Human Rights Watch on the security situation in Uvira, considering that the organisation offers a "partial or truncated" reading of the facts.

statements_all.role: provincial coordinator of the RAD, South Kivu
statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that the RAD provincial coordinator, Alexis Mwamba Dunia, announced on Thursday 22 January 2026 security measures for Uvira: at a press conference he formally banned carrying firearms and bladed weapons in urban areas and the erection of illegal roadblocks by self-defence groups, demanded the immediate withdrawal of the Wazalendo from the city centre, and said that urban security now fell exclusively under the PNC and the Military Police; the outlet added that the RAD was setting up a special unit to secure the city.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le coordonnateur provincial de la Réserve Armée de la Défense (RAD), Alexis Mwamba Dunia, a annoncé jeudi 22 janvier 2026 une série de mesures sécuritaires pour rétablir l’ordre public dans la ville d’Uvira, au Sud-Kivu.
statements_all.translation_en: The provincial coordinator of the Réserve Armée de la Défense (RAD), Alexis Mwamba Dunia, announced on Thursday 22 January 2026 a series of security measures to restore public order in the city of Uvira, in Sud Kivu.

statements_all.role: Ministry of Communication and Media (mise au point)
statements_all.text: Reporter.cd reported that the DRC government, in an official 'mise au point' reframing a Human Rights Watch communiqué on Uvira, said that the RDF/M23 withdrawal from the city of Uvira on 17 January 2026 came after a period of systematic looting, large-scale theft, threats, intimidation and acts of community stigmatisation, and that at that stage no death or injury had been reported within the Banyamulenge community since the RDF/M23 withdrawal.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Selon la mise au point officielle, le retrait du RDF/M23 de la ville d’Uvira, intervenu le 17 janvier 2026, est survenu après une période caractérisée par des pillages systématiques, des vols à grande échelle, des menaces, des intimidations ainsi que des actes de stigmatisation communautaire ayant profondément affecté la sécurité des civils et la cohésion sociale.
statements_all.translation_en: According to the official clarification, the withdrawal of the RDF/M23 from the city of Uvira, on 17 January 2026, came after a period marked by systematic looting, large-scale theft, threats, intimidation and acts of community stigmatisation that deeply affected civilians' security and social cohesion.

statements_all.role: President of M23 and deputy coordinator of the Alliance Fleuve Congo
statements_all.text: Bwiza reported that Bertrand Bisimwa, president of M23 and deputy coordinator of the Alliance Fleuve Congo, said on X that the Kinshasa government's decision to cut internet in Uvira aimed to hide the bad acts its forces were committing there.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Perezida wa M23 akanaba umuhuzabikorwa wungirije w'ihuriro Alliance Fleuve Congo, Bertrand Bisimwa, abinyujije ku rubuga rwe rwa X yatangaje ko icyemezo cya Leta ya Kinshasa cyo gukupa internet muri Uvira kigamije guhisha amabi ingabo zayo zikomeje gukorera muri uriya mujyi.
statements_all.translation_en: The president of M23 and also deputy coordinator of the Alliance Fleuve Congo, Bertrand Bisimwa, via his account on X, announced that the decision by the Kinshasa government to cut the internet in Uvira aims to hide the evil acts its forces continue to commit in that town.

statements_all.text: SOS Médias Burundi reported that security sources within the FARDC said more than twenty Banyamulenge families remained under the protection of the regular forces, as some community leaders called on their own members and on the FARDC to stop the pillage and killings.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Des sources sécuritaires au sein des FARDC indiquent que plus de vingt familles de la communauté Banyamulenge restent actuellement sous protection des forces régulières.
statements_all.translation_en: Security sources within the FARDC indicate that more than twenty families of the Banyamulenge community currently remain under the protection of the regular forces.

statements_all.text: UN News (Kiswahili), relaying Radio Okapi, reported that the DRC government announced a phased plan to restore State authority in Uvira after the departure of AFC/M23 fighters, and that a government spokesperson called the M23 departure a "short-lived event" and said the only acceptable outcome was full, effective and unconditional withdrawal of AFC/M23 and the Rwandan army from the whole DRC.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Msemaji wa serikali amesema kuondoka kwa M23 ni “tukio la muda mfupi” na akasisitiza kuwa matokeo pekee yanayokubalika ni “kuondoka kikamilifu, kwa ufanisi na bila masharti kwa AFC/M23 na jeshi la Rwanda kutoka katika eneo zima la DRC.”
statements_all.translation_en: The government spokesperson said that M23's departure is a "short-lived event" and stressed that the only acceptable outcome is "full, effective and unconditional withdrawal of AFC/M23 and the Rwandan army from the entire DRC territory."

statements_all.setting: statement in a meeting with HRW, as reported
statements_all.text: Human Rights Watch reported that Congolese Defence Minister Guy Kabombo Muadiamvita told it in a meeting on 20 January 2026 that 'the Banyamulenge should not be forcibly displaced or deported, and should feel free to return to Uvira if they wish to do so'.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Congolese Defense Minister Guy Kabombo Muadiamvita, in a meeting with Human Rights Watch on January 20, said that “the Banyamulenge should not be forcibly displaced or deported, and should feel free to return to Uvira if they wish to do so.”

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that South Kivu governor Jean-Jacques Purusi, speaking on Radio Okapi's Dialogue entre Congolais on Tuesday 20 January, confirmed that life had resumed in Uvira after the AFC/M23 withdrawal and that loyalist forces now controlled the city; he announced the imminent restoration of State authority.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le gouverneur du Sud-Kivu, Jean-Jacques Purusi, a confirmé cette information lors de son passage, mardi 20 janvier, au cours de l'émission Dialogue entre Congolais sur Radio Okapi. Le chef de l'exécutif provincial a rassuré sur la situation sécuritaire de cette cité stratégique du Sud-Kivu, confirmant que les forces loyalistes contrôlent désormais la ville.
statements_all.translation_en: The governor of South Kivu, Jean-Jacques Purusi, confirmed this information during his appearance on Tuesday 20 January on the programme Dialogue entre Congolais on Radio Okapi. The head of the provincial executive reassured on the security situation of this strategic city of South Kivu, confirming that loyalist forces now control the city.

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that AFC/M23, in a message on X by spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka, accused the FARDC and allied Wazalendo of looting, targeted violence and hate speech in Uvira after the AFC/M23 withdrawal, and said that loyalist forces had also multiplied attacks on its positions in the Fizi highlands and that there had been recent clashes at Kipese (Lubero) and Kasoko (Masisi).
statements_all.excerpt_original: L’Alliance Fleuve Congo / Mouvement du 23 Mars (AFC/M23) a accusé les Forces armées de la République démocratique du Congo (FARDC) et leurs alliés Wazalendo d’être responsables de pillages, de violences ciblées et de la propagation de discours de haine à Uvira, dans l’est de la RDC.
statements_all.translation_en: The Alliance Fleuve Congo / Mouvement du 23 Mars (AFC/M23) accused the Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (FARDC) and their Wazalendo allies of being responsible for looting, targeted violence and the spread of hate speech in Uvira, in eastern DRC.

statements_all.role: acting FARDC spokesperson, deputy commander of the communication and information service
statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that an army communiqué signed by Lieutenant-Colonel Mak Hazukay Mongba, acting FARDC spokesperson, deplored the systematic pillage of the city by soldiers of the AFC/M23-RDF coalition before their evacuation, and said some twenty civilians involved in looting were arrested and would be brought before the courts.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Dans le même document, signé par le lieutenant-colonel Mak Hazukay Mongba, commandant adjoint du service de communication et d’information des FARDC, chargé des opérations et du renseignement et porte-parole ad intérim des FARDC, l’armée déplore le pillage systématique de la ville par les militaires de la coalition AFC/M23-RDF avant leur évacuation.
statements_all.translation_en: In the same document, signed by Lieutenant-Colonel Mak Hazukay Mongba, deputy commander of the FARDC communication and information service in charge of operations and intelligence and acting FARDC spokesperson, the army deplores the systematic pillage of the city by soldiers of the AFC/M23-RDF coalition before their evacuation.

statements_all.text: Congo Indépendant reported that the army deplored systematic pillage attributed to M23/RDF/AFC elements before their evacuation, and that the rebels rejected these accusations and blamed the abuses on the army and its Wazalendo allies.
statements_all.excerpt_original: l’armée déplore des pillages systématiques imputés aux éléments de la coalition M23/RDF/AFC avant leur évacuation. Du berger à la bergère, les rebelles rejettent ces accusations et imputent les exactions à l’armée et ses alliés Wazalendo.
statements_all.translation_en: the army deplores systematic pillage attributed to elements of the M23/RDF/AFC coalition before their evacuation. Each side blames the other: the rebels reject these accusations and blame the abuses on the army and its Wazalendo allies.

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that the DRC government announced a plan for the progressive restoration of State authority in the city of Uvira and its surroundings, including coordinated security, judicial and humanitarian measures.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le gouvernement de la République démocratique du Congo annonce la mise en œuvre d’un plan de restauration progressive de l’autorité de l’État dans la ville d’Uvira et ses environs. Ce plan inclut des mesures sécuritaires, judiciaires et humanitaires coordonnées, destinées à rétablir durablement la sécurité, protéger les populations civiles et favoriser la stabilisation de cette partie du territoire national.
statements_all.translation_en: The government of the Democratic Republic of Congo announces the implementation of a plan for the progressive restoration of State authority in the city of Uvira and its surroundings. This plan includes coordinated security, judicial and humanitarian measures, intended to durably restore security, protect civilian populations and promote the stabilisation of this part of the national territory.

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that the government communiqué of Monday 19 January denounced the deportation of civilian populations, in particular members of the Banyamulenge community, alleging that some were forced to leave Uvira by the AFC/M23 to be used as justification for the movement's presence on Congolese soil.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Dans son communiqué publié le lundi 19 janvier, le gouvernement congolais dénonce la déportation de populations civiles, en particulier des membres de la communauté Banyamulenge. Certains auraient été forcés de quitter Uvira par l’AFC/M23 afin d’être utilisés comme justification de la présence du mouvement armé sur le sol congolais.
statements_all.translation_en: In its communiqué published on Monday 19 January, the Congolese government denounces the deportation of civilian populations, in particular members of the Banyamulenge community. Some were reportedly forced to leave Uvira by the AFC/M23 in order to be used as justification for the armed movement's presence on Congolese soil.

statements_all.text: Congo Indépendant reported that, after an emergency meeting chaired by Prime Minister Judith Suminwa, government spokesperson Patrick Muyaya gave a stocktake of 1,500 dead, 3,000 displaced and 12,000 children out of school and separated from their parents.
statements_all.excerpt_original: A l’issue d’une « réunion d’urgence » présidée, lundi 20 janvier 2026, par la Première ministre Judith Suminwa, le porte parole du gouvernement a fait un compte-rendu aux allures d’ « état des lieux »: 1.500 morts, 3.000 déplacés, 12.000 enfants non scolarisés et séparés de leurs parents.
statements_all.translation_en: At the end of an 'emergency meeting' chaired on Monday 20 January 2026 by Prime Minister Judith Suminwa, the government spokesperson gave an account resembling a 'stocktake': 1,500 dead, 3,000 displaced, 12,000 children out of school and separated from their parents.

statements_all.text: Congo Indépendant reported that South Kivu governor Jean-Jacques Purusi, sceptical, spoke of a 'faux retrait' (false withdrawal) and called for vigilance, judging that the enemy remains active and cunning.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Tel un « chat échaudé qui craint l’eau froide », le gouverneur du Sud-Kivu, Jean-Jacques Purusi, reste sceptique. Aussi, parle-t-il d’un « faux retrait » et appelle à la vigilance, estimant que l’ennemi demeure actif et rusé.
statements_all.translation_en: Like a 'scalded cat that fears cold water', the governor of South Kivu, Jean-Jacques Purusi, remains sceptical. He speaks of a 'false withdrawal' and calls for vigilance, judging that the enemy remains active and cunning.

statements_all.role: M23 spokesperson (Oscar Balinda in the article)
statements_all.text: BBC News Gahuza reported that M23 spokesperson Balinda, in an interview with BBC, denied FARDC's accusation of destruction and looting in Uvira, calling it a lie and saying that the items it was accused of looting had been shown to be still there.
statements_all.excerpt_original: FARDC yashinje abarwanyi ba M23 - ivuga ko bafatanyije n'ingabo z'u Rwanda, gusenya no gusahura mbere yo kuva muri Uvira, ibyo Balinda mu kiganiro na BBC yahakanye, avuga ko ibyo bashinjaga M23 gusahura byose byerekanywe ko bigihari.
statements_all.translation_en: FARDC accused M23 fighters - saying they worked together with Rwandan troops - of destroying and looting before leaving Uvira, which Balinda in an interview with BBC denied, saying that everything they were accused of looting was shown to still be there.

statements_all.role: Governor of South Kivu under Kinshasa
statements_all.text: Deutsche Welle Kiswahili reported that South Kivu governor Jean-Jacques Purusi, in a press release, warned that some AFC/M23 fighters were allegedly hiding in Uvira to cause chaos and blame the Wazalendo and the Congolese army, and confirmed that AFC/M23 had withdrawn to the Sange area although they were supposed to withdraw to Kamanyola.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Katika taarifa kwa vyombo vya habari, gavana wa Kivu Kusini chini ya utawala wa Kinshasa Jean-Jacques Purusi ameonya kuwepo kwa baadhi ya wapiganaji wa AFC/M23 wanaodaiwa kujificha katika mji wa Uvira ili kuleta fujo na kuwalaumu Wazalendo na jeshi la Kongo. Hata hivyo, Purusi amethibitisha kwamba AFC/M23 wamejiondoa hadi kwenye maeneo ya Sange licha yakuwa walitakiwa kujiondoa hadi Kamanyola.
statements_all.translation_en: In a press release, the governor of South Kivu under Kinshasa's authority, Jean-Jacques Purusi, warned of the presence of some AFC/M23 fighters allegedly hiding in the town of Uvira to cause chaos and blame the Wazalendo and the Congolese army. However, Purusi confirmed that AFC/M23 withdrew to the Sange area although they were supposed to withdraw to Kamanyola.

statements_all.text: Deutsche Welle Kiswahili reported that Corneille Nangaa, AFC/M23 coordinator, said on X that AFC/M23 withdrew from Uvira in good faith and that he was appalled by acts of reprisal, looting of public property, targeted killings and the forced displacement of the Tutsi Banyamulenge community.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Kwenye akaunti yake ya mtandao wa kijamii X, Corneille Nangaa, mratibu wa AFC/M23, alisema kuwa AFC/M23 ilijiondoa Uvira kwa nia njema. Nangaa ameeleza kwamba anachukizwa na vitendo vya kujilipizia kisasi, uporaji wa mali ya umma, mauaji yaliyolengwa, na kulazimishwa kuhama kwa jamii ya Watutsi ya Banyamulenge.
statements_all.translation_en: On his social media account on X, Corneille Nangaa, coordinator of AFC/M23, said that AFC/M23 withdrew from Uvira in good faith. Nangaa explained that he is appalled by acts of reprisal, looting of public property, targeted killings, and the forced displacement of the Tutsi Banyamulenge community.

statements_all.role: governor, as described by BBC Gahuza (not named in the passage)
statements_all.text: BBC Gahuza reported that the South Kivu governor on the government-controlled side, then in Bujumbura where he had taken refuge, said the government had information that some M23 fighters remained in Uvira, urged great caution and asked the population to avoid ethnic violence.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Guverineri w'intara ya Kivu y'Epfo ahagenzurwa na leta, uri i Bujumbura mu Burundi aho yahungiye, yatangaje ko bafite amakuru ko hari abarwanyi ba M23 basigaye muri Uvira, ati: "Ni ukwitonda cyane", yasabye kandi abatura kwirinda urugomo rushingiye ku moko.
statements_all.translation_en: The governor of South Kivu province in the area controlled by the government, who is in Bujumbura in Burundi where he took refuge, said they have information that some M23 fighters remain in Uvira, saying: "be very careful", and also asked residents to avoid ethnic-based violence.

statements_all.text: BBC News Gahuza reported that the Congolese army (FARDC) announced it had taken the city of Uvira and that its soldiers had been controlling it since Sunday 18 January 2026.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Igisirikare cya Leta ya Congo (FARDC) cyatangaje ko cyafashe umujyi wa Uvira mu ntara ya Kivu y'Epfo muri Repubulika ya Demokarasi ya Congo, ko abasirikare babo ari bo bahagenzura kuva ku cyumweru tariki ya 18 Mutarama 2026.
statements_all.translation_en: The army of the Congolese state (FARDC) announced that it had taken the city of Uvira in South Kivu province, that its soldiers have been controlling it since Sunday 18 January 2026.

statements_all.text: Bwiza reported that the Banyamulenge organisation Amohoro Peace Association issued a statement saying Banyamulenge were in danger, that Uvira was heading into a humanitarian emergency, and that after AFC/M23's withdrawal under United States pressure Banyamulenge civilians were being hunted while Wazalendo groups were targeting, killing and looting the homes of people called 'Banyarwanda'.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Ishyirahamwe Amohoro Peace Association ry'Abanyamulenge ryasohoye itangazo rivuga ko Abanyamulenge bari mu kaga. "Uvira iragana mu bihe byihutirwa by'ubutabazi. Nyuma yo kugenda ku gahato kwa AFC/M23 ku gitutu cya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, abasivili b'Abanyamulenge barimo guhigwa, mu gihe imitwe yitwara gisirikare ya Wazalendo yibasiye, ikica, ikanasahura amazu y’abantu bise "Banyarwanda," ijambo ryakoreshejwe kenshi mu kwibasira abatutsi Banyamulenge.
statements_all.translation_en: The Banyamulenge association Amohoro Peace Association issued a statement saying Banyamulenge are in danger. "Uvira is heading into an emergency humanitarian situation. After the forced departure of AFC/M23 under pressure from the United States, Banyamulenge civilians are being hunted, while the Wazalendo armed groups have targeted, killed and looted the homes of people they call 'Banyarwanda', a term often used to target Tutsi Banyamulenge.

statements_all.setting: press remarks as reported by a Rwandan outlet
statements_all.text: Kigali Today reported that AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrance Kanyuka, standing in the city centre, spoke about the AFC/M23 departure from Uvira; Kanyuka said that Uvira had been a key stronghold of forces allied with the Kinshasa government, including Wazalendo, FDLR, Mai-Mai, foreign mercenaries and the Burundian army. The outlet, in reported speech ('ngo'), added that since Uvira was 'liberated' things had reportedly been good and people lived in peace, with no obstruction, no theft and no abuse.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Avuga kuri iki gikorwa, Lawrance Kanyuka, umuvugizi wa AFC/M23 wari uhagaze mu mujyi rwagati yagize ati
statements_all.translation_en: Speaking about this event, Lawrance Kanyuka, the AFC/M23 spokesperson who was standing in the middle of the city, said

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that accusations of Rwandan involvement in the conflict in eastern DRC, supported by several international reports including those of the UN Group of Experts, are ones that Kigali continues to reject.
statements_all.excerpt_original: accusations soutenues par plusieurs rapports internationaux, notamment ceux du Groupe d’experts des Nations unies, que Kigali continue de rejeter.
statements_all.translation_en: accusations supported by several international reports, notably those of the UN Group of Experts, that Kigali continues to reject.

statements_all.setting: letter to UN Secretary-General, as reported
statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that AFC/M23 political coordinator Corneille Nangaa, in a letter of Thursday 15 January 2026 to UN Secretary-General António Guterres, announced that he had placed the city of Uvira under the responsibility of the international community.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Ce retrait fait suite à une correspondance adressée le jeudi 15 janvier 2026 au Secrétaire général des Nations unies, António Guterres, par le coordonnateur politique de la rébellion de l’AFC/M23, Corneille Nangaa. Dans cette lettre, il annonçait avoir placé la ville stratégique d’Uvira sous la responsabilité de la communauté internationale.
statements_all.translation_en: This withdrawal follows a letter sent on Thursday 15 January 2026 to the UN Secretary-General, António Guterres, by the political coordinator of the AFC/M23 rebellion, Corneille Nangaa. In this letter, he announced that he had placed the strategic city of Uvira under the responsibility of the international community.

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that, at the new-year exchange of wishes with the diplomatic and consular corps, President Évariste Ndayishimiye called on Rwanda to repatriate the leaders of the Red Tabara movement exiled in Kigali, whom he considers a threat to Burundi's security, and said Burundi had not broken off relations.
statements_all.excerpt_original: le président burundais Évariste Ndayishimiye a tendu la main au Rwanda, l’appelant à rapatrier les responsables du mouvement Red Tabara exilés à Kigali, qu’il considère comme une menace pour la sécurité du Burundi.
statements_all.translation_en: Burundian president Évariste Ndayishimiye extended a hand to Rwanda, calling on it to repatriate the leaders of the Red Tabara movement exiled in Kigali, whom he considers a threat to Burundi's security.

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that Burundian President Évariste Ndayishimiye, according to the outlet, said that a momentum had been interrupted because of Rwanda's expansionist aims expressed through the AFC/M23 rebellion in South Kivu, and the outlet added that he alluded to the rebels' occupation of Uvira and their announced withdrawal under US pressure, a withdrawal the outlet said Kinshasa disputed.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Selon le Chef de l'État burundais, cet élan a été interrompu en raison des visées expansionnistes du Rwanda, exprimées à travers la rébellion de l’AFC/M23 dans la province du Sud-Kivu.
statements_all.translation_en: According to the Burundian Head of State, this momentum was interrupted because of Rwanda's expansionist aims, expressed through the AFC/M23 rebellion in South Kivu province.

statements_all.text: SOS Médias Burundi reported that AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka, in a message on X on Wednesday 14 January, accused Congolese authorities of repeated ceasefire violations and said drones of the Kinshasa coalition forces bombed the port of Kalundu around 2:20 p.m., causing significant material damage and loss of life.
statements_all.excerpt_original: In a message posted on Wednesday, January 14, on the social media X (formerly Twitter), AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka accused Congolese authorities of repeated violations of the ceasefire in effect in eastern DRC. He claims that drones belonging to the Kinshasa coalition forces bombed the port of Kalundu around 2:20 p.m., causing significant material damage and loss of life.

statements_all.text: SOS Médias Burundi reported that sources close to the AFC/M23 denied that M23 members were present at the Blue Cut bar in Kalundu when it was hit by a drone, asserting that no leaders or fighters from the movement were there.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Sources close to the AFC/M23 deny these claims, asserting that no leaders or fighters from the movement were present at the time of the attack.

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that Burundian President Évariste Ndayishimiye, as future president of the African Union, called on the United States, as guarantor of the Washington accords, to increase pressure on the parties so that they respect their commitments.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Face à cette situation, le futur président de l’Union africaine, Évariste Ndayishimiye, a interpellé les États-Unis d’Amérique, garants des accords de Washington signés entre Kinshasa et Kigali, afin qu’ils accentuent la pression sur les parties en vue du respect des différents engagements pris.
statements_all.translation_en: Faced with this situation, the future president of the African Union, Évariste Ndayishimiye, called on the United States of America, guarantors of the Washington accords signed between Kinshasa and Kigali, to step up pressure on the parties with a view to respecting the various commitments made.

statements_all.text: Taarifa (Rwandan outlet), in an article on remarks by Nduhungirehe, wrote that following the capture of Uvira by the M23 on 10 December 2025 (Taarifa's date), Rwandan and Burundian security officials held meetings at the shared border on 14 and 28 December to discuss confidence-building measures and de-escalation mechanisms; Taarifa narrates this sentence itself and attributes the surrounding remarks to Nduhungirehe.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Following the capture of the Congolese town of Uvira by the M23 movement on 10 December 2025, Rwandan and Burundian security officials held meetings at the shared border on 14 and 28 December to discuss confidence-building measures and de-escalation mechanisms.

statements_all.role: spokesperson of the Wazalendo in Grand Nord-Kivu
statements_all.setting: statement after a meeting, as reported
statements_all.text: Bunia Actualité reported that the military governor of North Kivu, Major General Évariste Kakule Somo, called on the VDP, known as Wazalendo, to show more discipline in a meeting on Friday in his liaison office in Butembo, and that John Maangayiko, spokesperson of the Wazalendo of Grand Nord-Kivu, spoke in the presence of the FARDC operations commander in the area, Brigadier General Joseph Mugisa.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le gouverneur militaire du Nord-Kivu, le général-major Évariste Kakule Somo, a appelé vendredi les Volontaires pour la Défense de la Patrie (VDP), dits Wazalendo, à plus de discipline, lors d’une rencontre tenue dans son bureau de liaison à Butembo, dans l’est de la République démocratique du Congo.
statements_all.translation_en: The military governor of Nord Kivu, Major General Évariste Kakule Somo, called on the Volontaires pour la Défense de la Patrie (VDP), known as Wazalendo, to show more discipline, during a meeting held in his liaison office in Butembo, in the east of the République démocratique du Congo.

statements_all.text: Under a headline saying that the bodies of people killed by FARDC drones were buried in Goma, Kigali Today reported that at the ceremony the bodies were placed at the Stade de l’Unité, where bereaved families gathered; AFC/M23 political spokesperson Laurence Kanyuka said on X that they had met to honour the civilians killed, shot by the 'bloodthirsty' coalition forces working with the Kinshasa government.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Muri uwo muhango, imibiri y’abapfuye yashyizwe kuri stade yitiriwe Ubumwe (Stade de l’Unité), aho imiryango yabuze ababo
statements_all.translation_en: At that ceremony, the bodies of the dead were placed at the stadium named Ubumwe (Stade de l'Unité), where families who had lost relatives

statements_all.role: rebel group, as reported by AP
statements_all.setting: statement at a funeral ceremony, as reported
statements_all.text: The Associated Press reported that M23 claimed that the attack of 2 January in the Masisi territory, which it said targeted its military positions, was carried out by the FARDC and their allies, and that the rebel group said all the victims are civilians, a claim questioned by at least one expert.
statements_all.excerpt_original: M23 claimed that the attack, which targeted their military positions in the Masisi territory on Jan. 2, was carried out by the Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of Congo (FARDC) and their allies. The rebel group said all the victims are civilians, a claim questioned by at least one expert

statements_all.role: administrator of the Masisi territory (M23 administration)
statements_all.setting: speech at a ceremony, as reported
statements_all.text: The Associated Press reported that the administrator of the Masisi territory, Emmanuel Ndizeye, said at the ceremony that the area had been hit by 'a series of bombings', and that the bodies transferred to Goma came only from areas accessible by road.
statements_all.excerpt_original: The administrator of the Masisi territory, Emmanuel Ndizeye, said during the ceremony that the area had been hit by “a series of bombings.” He specified that the bodies transferred to Goma came only from areas accessible by road.

statements_all.role: governor of North Kivu as named by the M23 administration
statements_all.setting: speech at a ceremony, as reported
statements_all.text: The Associated Press reported that Erasto Musanga, named as the governor of North Kivu by the M23 administration, accused President Félix Tshisekedi of being responsible for the violence, saying 'Even as we speak, Tshisekedi is killing more people', and threatened legal action through the M23's own justice system.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Erasto Musanga, named as the governor of North Kivu by the M23 administration, accused Congolese President Félix Tshisekedi of being responsible for the violence. “Even as we speak, Tshisekedi is killing more people,” he said, threatening legal action through the M23's own justice system.

statements_all.text: The Associated Press reported that Patrick Muyaya, the spokesperson for the Congolese government, said in a post on X that the funeral held on Thursday was 'the height of indecency and inhumanity'.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Patrick Muyaya, the spokesperson for the Congolese government, said in a post on X that Thursday's funeral was “the height of indecency and inhumanity.”

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that the spokesperson of the Wazalendo synergy Front Nord, John Mangaiko, had declared on 6 January 2026 at Butembo that Kakule Kaputu (« Tango Fort ») was killed in an armed operation and not in a targeted assassination, describing Tango Fort as an armed fighter involved in attacks on other Wazalendo and in acts of insecurity against the population; the outlet added that in a video published on 4 March 2026 at Burondo, Lubero territory, the political-military movement Bana Bateseka, a member of the Wazalendo Front Grand-Nord, announced the dissolution of the armed group Tango Fort, and that according to the video its deputy commander, colonel Thembo, announced his rallying to Bana Bateseka with all his fighters.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le porte-parole de la synergie des Wazalendo Front Nord, John Mangaiko, avait déclaré le 6 janvier 2026 à Butembo que ce dernier avait été tué lors d’une opération armée et non dans un assassinat ciblé.
statements_all.translation_en: The spokesperson of the Wazalendo synergy Front Nord, John Mangaiko, had declared on 6 January 2026 in Butembo that the latter had been killed during an armed operation and not in a targeted assassination.

statements_all.text: BBC News Gahuza reported that Burundian President Évariste Ndayishimiye, in what it described as correcting his foreign minister, said on X that Burundi had always praised Qatar's 'important role' in mediation on the DRC and that it was necessary to clarify 'whatever was not clearly understood and the wrong words' about Qatar's role.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Mu gisa no gukosora ibyavuzwe na Minisitiri we w'ububanyi n'amahanga, Perezida Evariste Ndayishimiye w'u Burundi yatangaje ko igihugu cye 'igihe cyose cyashimiye 'uruhare rw'ingenzi' rwa Qatar mu buhuza ku kibazo cya Repubulika ya Demokarasi ya Congo.
statements_all.translation_en: In what looked like correcting what his foreign minister said, President Evariste Ndayishimiye of Burundi declared that his country has always praised Qatar's 'important role' in mediation on the question of the Democratic Republic of Congo.

statements_all.text: SOS Médias Burundi (Swahili edition) reported that MONUSCO condemned on Saturday 3 January 2026 the drone strike of the previous day at Masisi-Center.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Ujumbe wa Umoja wa Mataifa wa Kutuliza Utulivu katika Jamhuri ya Kidemokrasia ya Kongo (MONUSCO) umelaani Jumamosi, Januari 3, 2026, shambulio la ndege zisizo na rubani lililotokea siku iliyotangulia huko Masisi-Center.
statements_all.translation_en: The United Nations Stabilisation Mission in the Democratic Republic of Congo (MONUSCO) condemned on Saturday, January 3, 2026, the drone strike that took place the previous day in Masisi-Center.

statements_all.text: BBC News Gahuza reported that on Saturday night Burundi's foreign minister Edouard Bizimana wrote on X that it was important to stress Qatar's bad role in using its word and money to stop the United States from acting, and in the same post accused Rwanda of continuing to seize areas in eastern DR Congo contrary to the Washington agreement without the United States doing anything.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Ni nyuma y'uko ku wa gatandatu nijoro Minisitiri Edouard Bizimana yanditse ku rubuga X ko ari "ingenzi gushimangira uruhare rubi rwa Qatar mu gukoresha ijambo ryayo n'amafaranga ikabuza Amerika kugira icyo ikora".
statements_all.translation_en: This is after on Saturday night Minister Edouard Bizimana wrote on X that it is "important to stress Qatar's bad role in using its word and money to prevent America from taking action".

statements_all.text: Afrique Diplo reported that on Saturday 3 January 2026 in Kinshasa the Congolese army presented to the press seven soldiers it identified as members of the Rwanda Defence Force and eight foreign civilians, arrested during recent fighting against the AFC/M23 in North Kivu and South Kivu.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Ce samedi 3 janvier 2026, à Kinshasa, l’armée congolaise a présenté à la presse sept militaires rwandais, identifiés comme membres des Forces de défense rwandaises (RDF), ainsi que huit civils étrangers, arrêtés lors des récents combats contre la rébellion de l’AFC/M23 dans les provinces du Nord-Kivu et du Sud-Kivu.
statements_all.translation_en: This Saturday 3 January 2026, in Kinshasa, the Congolese army presented to the press seven Rwandan soldiers, identified as members of the Rwanda Defence Force (RDF), and eight foreign civilians, arrested during the recent fighting against the AFC/M23 rebellion in the provinces of North Kivu and South Kivu.

statements_all.role: FARDC deputy commander of the command and information service (lieutenant-colonel)
statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that FARDC Lieutenant-Colonel Mak Hazukay said, at the press presentation in Kinshasa, that the occupation of Uvira, far from Rwanda's borders, proves that the defensive-measures reason advanced by Kigali is 'un pire mensonge'.
statements_all.excerpt_original: capturés pendant les opérations militaires menées au Nord et Sud-Kivu. L’occupation aujourd’hui d’Uvira se trouvant loin de ses frontières prouve que la raison des mesures défensives avancées par Kigali est un pire mensonge », a-t-il déploré.
statements_all.translation_en: captured during military operations carried out in North and South Kivu. The occupation of Uvira today, which lies far from its borders, proves that the reason of defensive measures put forward by Kigali is a worse lie," he lamented.

statements_all.text: Iwacu reported that on 2 January 2026 the secretary general of Burundi's ruling CNDD-FDD party, Révérien Ndikuriyo, said at a Bujumbura press conference: 'Nous avons un accord qui nous permet d’intervenir au Congo', a reply Iwacu described as radically different from the Burundian ambassador's earlier claim of withdrawal.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le 2 janvier 2026, lors d’une conférence de presse tenue à Bujumbura dans une salle pleine à craquer, largement dominée par les couleurs rouge, vert et blanc du parti au pouvoir, le secrétaire général du CNDD-FDD, Révérien Ndikuriyo, a livré une réponse radicalement différente.
statements_all.translation_en: On 2 January 2026, at a press conference held in Bujumbura in a packed hall, largely dominated by the red, green and white colours of the ruling party, the secretary general of the CNDD-FDD, Révérien Ndikuriyo, gave a radically different answer.

statements_all.text: Bwiza reported that AFC/M23, through its spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka, replied that what the Kinshasa government said was propaganda and lies intended to mislead the public.
statements_all.excerpt_original: AFC/M23 biciye mu muvugizi wayo, Lawrence Kanyuka, yasubije ko ibivugwa na Leta ya Kinshasa ari icengezamatwara n'ibinyoma bigamije kuyobya rubanda.
statements_all.translation_en: AFC/M23, through its spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka, replied that what the Kinshasa government says is propaganda and lies intended to mislead the public.

statements_all.role: head of the M23 armed branch / chief of staff of the ARC (as the page and the embedded post print it)
statements_all.setting: address to prisoners as reported by a Goma outlet relaying a post by AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka
statements_all.text: Grands Lacs News reported that, on a visit to the Rumangabo training centre in Rutshuru territory at the weekend, General Sultani Makenga, head of the M23 armed branch, spoke with prisoners of war including former FARDC soldiers captured at the fall of Goma, and told them that anyone wishing to join the rebellion voluntarily was free to do so and that those wishing to return to Kinshasa could register under the prisoner-release process of the Doha process, to be facilitated with the ICRC. The page embeds an AFC/M23 post stating that the visit took place on Friday 2 January 2026.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Lors d’une visite effectuée le weekend dernier au centre de formation de Rumangabo en territoire de Rutshuru en province du Nord-Kivu ; le Général Sultani Makenga, chef de la branche armée du M23, s’est entretenu avec les prisonniers de guerre dont d’anciens militaires des FARDC capturés lors de la chute de Goma.
statements_all.translation_en: During a visit made last weekend to the Rumangabo training centre in Rutshuru territory in North Kivu province, General Sultani Makenga, head of the armed branch of the M23, spoke with the prisoners of war including former FARDC soldiers captured at the fall of Goma.

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that AFC/M23 political coordinator Corneille Nangaa said in a recent statement that 'À ce jour, pas un seul prisonnier n’a été libéré, en violation flagrante des accords signés', accusing the Kinshasa government of blocking implementation of the Doha commitments.
statements_all.excerpt_original: À ce jour, pas un seul prisonnier n’a été libéré, en violation flagrante des accords signés », a déclaré Corneille Nangaa.
statements_all.translation_en: 'To date, not a single prisoner has been released, in flagrant violation of the agreements signed,' Corneille Nangaa said.

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that Corneille Nangaa said that in the zones controlled by the AFC/M23 'la population vit désormais dans la paix, la dignité et la sécurité retrouvées', and accused the central government of promoting hate speech, saying 'Le discours de haine est désormais devenu une doctrine d’État'.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Corneille Nangaa a affirmé que, dans les zones contrôlées par l’AFC/M23, « la population vit désormais dans la paix, la dignité et la sécurité retrouvées », ajoutant que « la jeune administration s’installe » et que « la justice est en pleine relance ».
statements_all.translation_en: Corneille Nangaa stated that, in the zones controlled by the AFC/M23, « the population now lives in peace, dignity and restored security », adding that « the young administration is settling in » and that « justice is being fully relaunched ».

statements_all.setting: instruction to Wazalendo as reported by the Group of Experts
statements_all.text: The Group of Experts reported that, according to multiple sources, government authorities including DRC President Félix Tshisekedi instructed Wazalendo elements not to target civilians, particularly the Banyamulenge, and that FARDC placed 31 Banyamulenge families remaining in Uvira under its protection.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Multiple sources indicated that government authorities, including the President of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Félix Tshisekedi, instructed Wazalendo elements not to target civilians, particularly the Banyamulenge. FARDC placed 31 Banyamulenge families remaining in Uvira under its protection.

statements_all.text: Congo Indépendant reported that government spokesperson Patrick Muyaya said the withdrawal of the Rwandan forces could not be interpreted as a gesture of appeasement nor as the end of the aggression.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Pour le porte-parole du gouvernement, Patrick Muyaya, le retrait des forces rwandaises ne saurait être interprété comme un geste d’apaisement ni comme la fin de l’agression.
statements_all.translation_en: For the government spokesperson, Patrick Muyaya, the withdrawal of the Rwandan forces cannot be interpreted as a gesture of appeasement or as the end of the aggression.

statements_all.text: The UN Group of Experts reported that in a letter to the UN Secretary-General three days before its withdrawal from Uvira, AFC/M23 justified the withdrawal by citing its "sincere commitment to the ceasefire" and its intention to pursue a peaceful and political resolution of the conflict, said it had requested MONUSCO to ensure civilian protection in Uvira, and called for the deployment of a "neutral force".
statements_all.excerpt_original: In a letter addressed to the Secretary-General three days prior to its withdrawal from Uvira, AFC/M23 justified the withdrawal by citing its “sincere commitment to the ceasefire” and its intention to pursue a peaceful and political resolution of the conflict. It further indicated that it had requested MONUSCO to ensure civilian protection in Uvira and called for the deployment of a “neutral force”.

statements_all.setting: statement to Uvira residents as reported
statements_all.text: SOS Médias Burundi (in Swahili) reported that the South Kivu governor, Jean-Jacques Purusi, had assured Uvira residents after crossing the border that the Burundi-Congo border would reopen within two to three days, by 30 January 2026 at the latest.
statements_all.excerpt_original: tangazo lililotarajiwa sana na gavana wa Kivu Kusini, Jean-Jacques Purusi. Ijumaa iliyopita, baada ya kuvuka mpaka, alikuwa amewahakikishia wakazi wa Uvira—mji mkuu wa muda wa jimbo hilo—kwamba mpaka wa Burundi na Kongo ungefunguliwa tena ndani ya siku mbili hadi tatu, ifikapo Januari 30, 2026, hivi karibuni zaidi.
statements_all.translation_en: the highly anticipated announcement by the governor of South Kivu, Jean-Jacques Purusi. Last Friday, after crossing the border, he had assured residents of Uvira, the province's provisional capital, that the Burundi-Congo border would reopen within two to three days, by 30 January 2026 at the latest.

statements_all.text: BBC News Gahuza reported that AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka said that since Wazalendo and FARDC re-entered Uvira, the city had become a hotbed of fighting, violence, looting and hate speech.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Lawrence Kanyuka, umuvugizi wa AFC/M23 avuga ko kuva Wazalendo na FARDC bakwinira muri Uvira "uyu mujyi wahindutse isibaniro ry'imirwano, ihohotera n'ubusahuzi ndetse n'imvugo z'urwango
statements_all.translation_en: Lawrence Kanyuka, spokesperson of AFC/M23, says that since Wazalendo and FARDC entered Uvira "the city has become a hotbed of fighting, violence and looting and hate speech

statements_all.setting: statement, as reported by DW Kiswahili (no date or channel given)
statements_all.text: DW Kiswahili reported that Congolese government spokesperson Patrick Muyaya said residents of Goma continue to face suffering.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Msemaji wa serikali ya Kongo Patrick Muyaya alisema wakaazi wa Goma wanaendelea kukabiliwa na mateso.
statements_all.translation_en: The Congolese government spokesperson Patrick Muyaya said Goma residents continue to face suffering.

statements_all.text: Katembo said in an interview with Igihe in January 2026 that Goma was now safe and that all activities, including trade, were going better than before.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Mu kiganiro Katembo yagiranye na IGIHE muri Mutarama 2026, yatangaje ko ubu Goma itekanye, kandi ko ibikorerwamo byose birimo ubucuruzi bigenda neza kurusha uko byahoze.
statements_all.translation_en: In an interview Katembo had with IGIHE in January 2026, he stated that Goma is now safe, and that everything done there, including trade, is going better than it used to.

statements_all.text: The UN Group of Experts reported that members of the Banyamulenge community denounced both parties for trapping civilians in an active combat zone, calling on FARDC to lift the siege and establish a humanitarian corridor and on MRDP/Twirwaneho and AFC/M23 to allow civilians to leave safely.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Members of the Banyamulenge community have denounced both parties for trapping civilians in an active combat zone, calling on FARDC to lift the siege and establish a humanitarian corridor and on MRDP/Twirwaneho and AFC/M23 to allow civilians to leave safely.

statements_all.setting: press statement as reported (outlet does not say where)
statements_all.text: Foxtime.cd reported that South Kivu governor Jean-Jacques Purusi officially announced the discovery of at least 344 bodies in three mass graves in the city of Uvira and its outskirts, brought to light after the withdrawal of the AFC/M23.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le gouverneur de province, Jean-Jacques Purusi, a officiellement annoncé la découverte d’au moins 344 corps répartis dans trois fosses communes dans la ville d’Uvira et ses zones périphériques, une situation mise au jour à la suite du retrait des rebelles de l’Alliance Fleuve Congo (AFC) et du M23.
statements_all.translation_en: Governor of the province, Jean-Jacques Purusi, officially announced the discovery of at least 344 bodies spread across three mass graves in the city of Uvira and its outskirts, uncovered following the withdrawal of the rebels of the Alliance Fleuve Congo (AFC) and the M23.

statements_all.setting: interview (RFI), as reported in a transcript-style account
statements_all.text: Xtrafrica published a transcript-style account of an RFI interview in which DRC government spokesperson Patrick Muyaya said that, according to Kinshasa, the invasion of Uvira was organised under Kigali's direct command and that bombs and kamikaze drones were used indiscriminately against peaceful civilians.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Patrick Muyaya: I would not even describe them as offensives. In most cases, what we are conducting are defensive operations because our responsibility is to protect our people. Let me remind you that in South Kivu we witnessed the invasion of Uvira, which, according to us, was organized under Kigali's direct command. Bombs were used. Kamikaze drones were used indiscriminately against peaceful civilians.

statements_all.text: The UN Group of Experts reported that MRDP/Twirwaneho and AFC/M23 leaders alleged that FARDC and FDNB committed a premeditated, systematic and targeted campaign of extermination against the Banyamulenge population, including through aerial bombardments; the Group stated it did not substantiate intentional targeting of the civilian population.
statements_all.excerpt_original: MRDP/Twirwaneho and AFC/M23 leaders alleged that FARDC and FDNB committed a premeditated, systematic and targeted campaign of extermination against the Banyamulenge population, including through aerial bombardments of densely populated areas. 99 While the civilian population in the Hauts Plateaux has been exposed to significant risks from ongoing hostilities, the Group of Experts did not substantiate their intentional targeting.

statements_all.role: Minister of Communications and government spokesperson
statements_all.text: Bwiza (a Rwandan outlet) reported that on Wednesday 31 December 2025 the DRC government, through its Communications Minister and spokesperson Patrick Muyaya, accused the Rwandan forces in a statement of attacks in the Kamanyola-Uvira areas 'with bombs and kamikaze drones' that, it said, killed more than 1,500 people and displaced about 500,000.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Ku wa Gatatu tariki ya 31 Ukuboza 2025, ni bwo RDC biciye muri Minisitiri wayo w'Itumanaho akanaba Umuvugizi wa Guverinoma yayo yashinje Ingabo z'u Rwanda ibyo birego.
statements_all.translation_en: On Wednesday 31 December 2025, the DRC, through its Minister of Communication and also its Government Spokesperson, accused the Rwandan Forces of these allegations.

statements_all.role: Minister of Communications and government spokesperson
statements_all.text: Bwiza reported that Patrick Muyaya also accused the Rwandan forces of sending three battalions of soldiers into the highlands of Uvira, Fizi and Mwenga, saying they were disguised as Twirwaneho fighters.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Uyu mugabo kandi yashinje Ingabo z'u Rwanda kohereza batayo eshatu z'abasirikare mu misozi miremire ya Uvira, Fizi na Mwenga, akavuga ko ziyoberanyije zikigira abarwanyi ba Twirwaneho.
statements_all.translation_en: This man also accused the Rwandan Forces of sending three battalions of soldiers to the high mountains of Uvira, Fizi and Mwenga, saying they were disguised as Twirwaneho fighters.

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported, citing the final communiqué it received, that the African Union Peace and Security Council asked the group of facilitators to propose urgent measures to defuse the situation in eastern DRC and to report to the AU Mediator.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le Conseil de Paix et de Sécurité de l'Union Africaine prie le Groupe de facilitateurs de proposer des mesures urgentes visant à désamorcer la situation dans l’est de la RDC et de faire rapport au Médiateur de l’UA
statements_all.translation_en: The African Union Peace and Security Council asks the group of facilitators to propose urgent measures aimed at defusing the situation in eastern DRC and to report to the AU Mediator

statements_all.role: military coordinator of AFC/M23 and chief of staff of the ARC
statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that on Monday 29 December, at an exchange of wishes of senior AFC/M23 cadres in Goma, the military coordinator of the AFC/M23 and ARC chief of staff, General-Major Sultani Makenga, told participants: 'Soyez en état de guerre, cette guerre nous allons la gagner'.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le coordonnateur militaire de l’Alliance Fleuve Congo/Mouvement du 23 mars (AFC/M23) et chef d’état-major de l’Armée révolutionnaire congolaise (ARC), le général-major Sultani Makenga, a appelé lundi 29 décembre
statements_all.translation_en: The military coordinator of the Alliance Fleuve Congo/Mouvement du 23 mars (AFC/M23) and chief of staff of the Armée révolutionnaire congolaise (ARC), General-Major Sultani Makenga, called on Monday 29 December

statements_all.text: SOS Médias Burundi reported that an official FARDC communique signed by chief of general staff Lt Gen Jules Mbanza Mwilambwe announced the suspension of Maj Gen Sylvain Ekenge, until then FARDC spokesperson.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Dans un communiqué officiel rendu public ce dimanche, signé par le chef d’état-major général des Forces armées de la République démocratique du Congo (FARDC), le lieutenant-général Jules Mbanza Mwilambwe, l’armée congolaise a annoncé la suspension du général-major Sylvain Ekenge, jusque-là porte-parole des FARDC.
statements_all.translation_en: In an official communiqué made public this Sunday, signed by the Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (FARDC), Lieutenant General Jules Mbanza Mwilambwe, the Congolese army announced the suspension of Major General Sylvain Ekenge, until then FARDC spokesperson.

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that Burundian President Évariste Ndayishimiye on Friday praised the commitment of his country's defence and security forces deployed in the DRC, at a public broadcast held at the Royal stadium in Muramvya, Gitega province, and congratulated them for their courage and commitment.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le président burundais Évariste Ndayishimiye a salué vendredi l’engagement des forces de défense et de sécurité de son pays déployées en République démocratique du Congo, lors d’une émission publique organisée au stade Royal de Muramvya, dans la province de Gitega. Le chef de l’État burundais a félicité les forces burundaises engagées en RDC pour leur courage et leur engagement.
statements_all.translation_en: Burundian President Évariste Ndayishimiye on Friday praised the commitment of the defence and security forces of his country deployed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, during a public broadcast organised at the Royal stadium in Muramvya, in Gitega province. The Burundian head of state congratulated the Burundian forces engaged in the DRC for their courage and commitment.

statements_all.role: spokesperson of the fighters seen in Makobola
statements_all.text: Igihe reported that on 25 December 2025 Wazalendo fighters appeared in Makobola centre (Fizi territory) saying they had driven AFC/M23 out, and that their spokesperson, named Winston Makufuli, said 'People should remain calm, we have taken Makobola back. We thank President Félix Tshisekedi who sent FARDC troops to protect our country's security'.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Ku wa 25 Ukuboza 2025, iyi santere yagaragayemo abarwanyi bo mu ihuriro Wazalendo rishyigikiwe n’ubutegetsi bwa RDC, bemeza ko bakuye AFC/M23 muri iyi santere.
statements_all.translation_en: On 25 December 2025, fighters of the Wazalendo alliance, supported by the DRC government, appeared in this centre, saying they had driven AFC/M23 out of this centre.

statements_all.text: The FARDC, through spokesperson Maj Gen Sylvain Ekenge, called the AFC/M23 announcement of its withdrawal from Uvira a 'simple manoeuvre of diversion' meant to ease international pressure on Rwanda and its proxies; BBC Gahuza reported that Ekenge, in a video statement read on RTNC on Saturday, said claims of withdrawal bore no relation to the reality on the ground.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Les FARDC, par la voix de leur porte-parole, le général-major Sylvain Ekenge, qualifient cette annonce de simple manœuvre de diversion visant à alléger la pression internationale exercée sur le Rwanda et ses supplétifs de l’AFC/M23.
statements_all.translation_en: The FARDC, through their spokesperson, Major General Sylvain Ekenge, describe this announcement as a simple manoeuvre of diversion aimed at easing the international pressure on Rwanda and its proxies of the AFC/M23.

statements_all.role: Minister of Communication and Media, government spokesperson
statements_all.text: Radio Okapi's press review, citing Africa News, reported that Communications Minister Patrick Muyaya, on his X account, questioned what credibility to give to the M23's unilateral manoeuvre and said the government expected an effective withdrawal of Rwandan troops from all occupied zones.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Sur son compte X, le ministre s’est interrogé: «Quelle crédibilité accorder à cette manœuvre unilatérale du M23?, Nous attendons un retrait effectif des troupes rwandaises de toutes les zones occupées de notre territoire».
statements_all.translation_en: On his X account, the minister asked: "What credibility to give to this unilateral manoeuvre by the M23? We expect an effective withdrawal of Rwandan troops from all occupied areas of our territory."

statements_all.role: Ambassador and Alternative Representative for Special Political Affairs
