statements_all.text: BBC Gahuza reported that the Burundian army (FDNB) said its troops in South Kivu had blocked the roads of people leaving the Minembwe area in order to "protect Uvira and the Burundian border", and asked residents of Minembwe to "separate from the enemies" there; FDNB spokesperson Brigadier General Gaspard Baratuza was quoted saying the route had to be blocked because it was one they had to use to reach Uvira.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Igisirikare c'Uburundi kimenesha ko ingabo zaco ziri mu ntara ya Kivu y'Epfo ya RD Congo zazibiye amayira y'abava mu karere ka Minembwe zigamije "gukingira Uvira n'urubibe rw'Uburundi", zigasaba abanyagihugu bari i Minembwe "kuvavanura n'abansi" bariyo.
statements_all.translation_en: The Burundian army confirms that its troops in South Kivu province of DR Congo blocked the roads of those leaving the Minembwe area in order to "protect Uvira and the Burundian border", asking residents of Minembwe to "separate from the enemies" who are there.

statements_all.text: BBC News Gahuza reported that the Burundian army stated that its troops in South Kivu had blocked the roads of people leaving the Minembwe area in order to 'protect Uvira and the Burundi border', and that FDNB spokesperson Brigadier General Gaspard Baratuza told BBC Gahuzamiryango that in Minembwe there was not one Burundian soldier.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Igisirikare c'Uburundi kimenesha ko ingabo zaco ziri mu ntara ya Kivu y'Epfo ya RD Congo zazibiye amayira y'abava mu karere ka Minembwe zigamije "gukingira Uvira n'urubibe rw'Uburundi", zigasaba abanyagihugu bari i Minembwe "kuvavanura n'abansi" bariyo.
statements_all.translation_en: The Burundian army confirms that its troops in South Kivu province of DR Congo blocked the roads of people leaving the Minembwe area aiming "to protect Uvira and the Burundi border", asking the citizens in Minembwe to "separate from the enemies" who are there.

statements_all.setting: statement as summarised in a radio programme
statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that Lieutenant-colonel Mutimura, spokesperson of the FDLR-FOCA, categorically rejected disarmament, justified armed struggle by the protection of Rwandan refugees and set as conditions an inter-Rwandan dialogue and a return in full dignity.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le lieutenant-colonel Mutimura, porte-parole des FDLR-FOCA, rejette catégoriquement le désarmement. Il justifie la lutte armée par la protection des réfugiés rwandais et pose comme condition un dialogue inter-rwandais et un retour en toute dignité.
statements_all.translation_en: Lieutenant-colonel Mutimura, spokesperson of the FDLR-FOCA, categorically rejects disarmament. He justifies the armed struggle by the protection of Rwandan refugees and sets as a condition an inter-Rwandan dialogue and a return in full dignity.

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that the FARDC, in a communiqué issued on Saturday, accused the rebel coalition, which it said is backed by Rwanda, of intensifying attacks in the east of the country in violation of commitments made in the Washington and Doha peace processes; according to the text signed by army spokesperson Major General Sylvain Ekeng Bomusa Efomi, the rebels attacked several military positions in South Kivu and North Kivu over the previous 72 hours.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Selon le texte signé par le général-major Sylvain Ekeng Bomusa Efomi, porte-parole de l’Armée les rebelles ont attaqué plusieurs positions militaires au Sud-Kivu et au Nord-Kivu au cours des 72 dernières heures.
statements_all.translation_en: According to the text signed by Major General Sylvain Ekeng Bomusa Efomi, spokesperson of the Army, the rebels attacked several military positions in South Kivu and North Kivu over the last 72 hours.

statements_all.role: AFC M23 governor of North Kivu
statements_all.setting: speech at public event as reported
statements_all.text: Radio Elle FM Goma reported that the de facto governor of North Kivu, Bahati Musanga Erasto, launched a large reforestation operation in Goma on a Salongo day, saying "Nous avons trouvé une ville et un parc dévastés"; in the same report the outlet wrote that disorderly felling of trees by armed groups such as the FDLR and Mai-Mai militias had profoundly affected biodiversity.
statements_all.excerpt_original: « Nous avons trouvé une ville et un parc dévastés. Nous voulons désormais que les animaux du parc puissent se reproduire à nouveau pour attirer les touristes étrangers », a-t-il ajouté.
statements_all.translation_en: 'We found a city and a park devastated. We now want the animals of the park to be able to reproduce again to attract foreign tourists', he added.

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that the fighting around Mikenge followed an alert by Twirwaneho and by former senator Moïse Nyarugabo about the encirclement and humanitarian blockade of Minembwe and several Banyamulenge villages by the Burundian and Congolese armies.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Ces affrontements surviennent après l’alerte de Twirwaneho et de l’ex-sénateur Moïse Nyarugabo concernant l’encerclement et le blocus humanitaire de Minembwe ainsi que de plusieurs villages banyamulenge par les armées burundaise et congolaise.
statements_all.translation_en: These clashes follow the alert by Twirwaneho and former senator Moïse Nyarugabo concerning the encirclement and humanitarian blockade of Minembwe and several Banyamulenge villages by the Burundian and Congolese armies.

statements_all.setting: interview (BBC) as relayed by SOS Médias Burundi
statements_all.text: SOS Médias Burundi reported that the FDNB spokesperson, Brigadier General Gaspard Baratuza, acknowledged on the BBC that some Banyamulenge are trapped in areas 'where the enemy is' and said it is understandable that those who go to buy food for the enemy are blocked.
statements_all.excerpt_original: The spokesperson for the FDNB, Brigadier General Gaspard Baratuza, acknowledged on the BBC that some Banyamulenge are trapped in areas “where the enemy is” : “It’s understandable that those who go to buy food for the enemy are blocked.”

statements_all.role: Vice-President, National Commission for Demobilisation and Reintegration (RDRC)
statements_all.text: Igihe reported that in November 2025 the vice-president of Rwanda's national demobilisation and reintegration commission (RDRC), Maj Gen (Rtd) Jacques Nziza, explained that in 10 months Rwanda had received more than 200 FDLR fighters.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Mu Ugushyingo 2025, Visi Perezida wa Komisiyo y’Igihugu Ishinzwe Gusezerera no Gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe abari abarwanyi (RDRC), Maj Gen (Rtd) Jacques Nziza, yasobanuye ko mu mezi 10, u Rwanda rwakiriye abarwanyi barenga 200 ba FDLR.
statements_all.translation_en: In November 2025, the Vice-President of the National Commission for Demobilisation and Reintegration of former fighters (RDRC), Maj Gen (Rtd) Jacques Nziza, explained that in 10 months Rwanda had received more than 200 FDLR fighters.

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that government spokesperson Patrick Muyaya recalled that the reopening of Goma airport would take place only with the authorisation of the Congolese authorities and exclusively for daytime humanitarian flights.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le porte-parole du gouvernement, Patrick Muyaya, a rappelé que la réouverture de l’aéroport de Goma se fera uniquement sur autorisation des autorités congolaises, et exclusivement pour des vols humanitaires effectués en journée.
statements_all.translation_en: The government spokesperson, Patrick Muyaya, recalled that the reopening of Goma airport will take place only with the authorisation of the Congolese authorities, and exclusively for humanitarian flights carried out in daytime.

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that AFC/M23 political coordinator Corneille Nangaa asked on X how the reopening of Goma airport for humanitarian reasons could be discussed while Walikale and Masisi in North Kivu and Fizi, Walungu and Mwenga in South Kivu were, in his words, subjected daily to bombardments by the Kinshasa regime targeting civilian sites, factories, bridges, airfields and humanitarian aircraft.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Comment évoquer la réouverture de l’aéroport de Goma pour des motifs humanitaires alors que les territoires de Walikale et de Masisi au Nord-Kivu, ainsi que ceux de Fizi, Walungu et Mwenga au Sud-Kivu, subissent quotidiennement des bombardements du régime de Kinshasa ciblant des sites civils, usines, ponts, aérodromes et avions humanitaires ? " s’est interrogé Corneille Nangaa sur le réseau social X.
statements_all.translation_en: How can the reopening of Goma airport be mentioned for humanitarian reasons when the territories of Walikale and Masisi in North Kivu, and those of Fizi, Walungu and Mwenga in South Kivu, are subjected daily to bombardments by the Kinshasa regime targeting civilian sites, factories, bridges, airfields and humanitarian aircraft? Corneille Nangaa asked on the social network X.

statements_all.text: KT Press reported that AFC/M23 rejected French President Emmanuel Macron's announcement of the planned reopening of Goma International Airport, calling it "premature, disconnected from reality, and made without consultation", in a statement issued by Corneille Nangaa.
statements_all.excerpt_original: The Alliance Fleuve Congo (AFC/M23) rebel movement which controls North and South Kivu provinces of eastern DR Congo, has rejected the recent announcement by French President Emmanuel Macron regarding the planned reopening of Goma International Airport, calling the decision “premature, disconnected from reality, and made without consultation.”

statements_all.role: Minister of Foreign Affairs and Cooperation
statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that Rwandan Foreign Minister Olivier Nduhungirehe told the press on Thursday 30 October 2025 that any decision on reopening Goma airport must be taken within the Doha negotiations, and that Paris could not reopen an airport while those concerned were not present.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Notre position est que toute décision doit être prise dans le cadre des négociations de Doha, où le gouvernement congolais et l’AFC/M23 sont engagés dans un dialogue. Paris ne peut rouvrir un aéroport alors que les principaux concernés ne sont pas présents"a déclaré jeudi 30 octobre 2025, devant la presse, Olivier Nduhungirehe.
statements_all.translation_en: Our position is that any decision must be taken within the Doha negotiations, where the Congolese government and AFC/M23 are engaged in a dialogue. Paris cannot reopen an airport while those mainly concerned are not present, said Olivier Nduhungirehe on Thursday 30 October 2025, in front of the press.

statements_all.role: Governor of North Kivu (name not given in the excerpt)
statements_all.setting: statement as reported by Radio Okapi
statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that the North Kivu governor denounced the installation of new AFC/M23 positions at Vuvatama and Kanyamitala, warned of the risk of a resumption of hostilities and reaffirmed the FARDC's determination to defend their positions in case of attack.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le gouverneur dénonce l’installation de nouvelles positions de l’AFC/M23 à Vuvatama et Kanyamitala, et alerte sur le risque d’une reprise des hostilités. Il réaffirme la détermination des FARDC à défendre leurs positions en cas d’attaque.
statements_all.translation_en: The governor denounces the installation of new AFC/M23 positions at Vuvatama and Kanyamitala, and warns of the risk of a resumption of hostilities. He reaffirms the FARDC's determination to defend their positions in case of attack.

statements_all.text: Top Africa News reported that AFC/M23 denied losing control of Kavumu airport: reliable sources who spoke to UMUSEKE maintained that the airport remained firmly under the control of AFC/M23 fighters, and in a statement the alliance dismissed the claims as deliberate misinformation, its spokesperson saying 'Wazalendo and FARDC have no such capability'.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Reliable sources who spoke to UMUSEKE maintain that Kavumu airport remains firmly under the control of AFC/M23 fighters. In a statement, the alliance dismissed the claims as deliberate misinformation. “Wazalendo and FARDC have no such capability,” said the AFC/M23 spokesperson

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that in a communiqué made public on Monday the AFC-M23 accused the Congolese army of using heavy artillery and drones against its positions from 3 a.m. until late in the evening.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Dans un communiqué rendu public lundi, l’AFC-M23 accuse l’armée congolaise d’avoir mis à contribution une artillerie lourde et des drones contre leurs positions depuis 3 heures du matin jusque tard dans la soirée.
statements_all.translation_en: In a communiqué made public on Monday, the AFC-M23 accuses the Congolese army of having used heavy artillery and drones against their positions from 3 a.m. until late in the evening.

statements_all.text: Umuryango.rw reported that AFC/M23 fighters denied information spreading on social media from Burundians that they had been dispossessed of Kavumu airport in South Kivu, and that AFC/M23-Twirwaneho said the circulating information was false and urged people to beware of rumours, saying 'Wazalendo and FARDC have no strength'.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Abarwanyi ba AFC/M23 banyomoje amakuru akomeje gusakazwa ku mbuga nkoranyambaga n’Abarundi, avuga ko bambuwe ikibuga cy’indege cya Kavumu giherereye mu Ntara ya Kivu y’Amajyepfo mu Burasirazuba bwa RDC.
statements_all.translation_en: AFC/M23 fighters denied information continuing to circulate on social media, by Burundians, saying they had been dispossessed of Kavumu airport located in South Kivu province in eastern DRC.

statements_all.text: Beto.cd reported that the military governor of North Kivu, Maj Gen Evariste Somo Kakule, said armed youths unidentified clashed with AFC/M23 fighters at Kalangira, Baswagha chiefdom (Lubero), and, in a communique, that the incident did not involve the FARDC, which remain faithful to the ceasefire.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Selon le gouverneur militaire du Nord-Kivu, le général-major Evariste Somo Kakule, ces échanges de tirs ont opposé un groupe de jeunes armés non identifiés aux combattants de l’AFC/M23 dans la localité de Kalangira, en chefferie de Baswagha.
statements_all.translation_en: According to the military governor of North Kivu, Major General Evariste Somo Kakule, these exchanges of fire pitted a group of unidentified armed youths against AFC/M23 fighters in the locality of Kalangira, in the Baswagha chiefdom.

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that the Fizi territory administrator, Sammy Kalonji Badibanga, confirmed the fighting and gave as its main cause the decision of Yakutumba's men to remove illegal barriers set up in the area.
statements_all.excerpt_original: L’information a été confirmée par Sammy Kalonji Badibanga, administrateur du territoire de Fizi, qui évoque comme principale cause du conflit la décision des hommes de Yakutumba de supprimer les barrières illégales érigées dans la zone.
statements_all.translation_en: The information was confirmed by Sammy Kalonji Badibanga, administrator of Fizi territory, who gives as the main cause of the conflict the decision of Yakutumba's men to remove the illegal barriers set up in the area.

statements_all.role: North Kivu deputy governor appointed by AFC/M23
statements_all.text: Imvahonshya (Rwanda) reported that Willy Manzi, the North Kivu deputy governor appointed by AFC/M23, confirmed on social media that an FDLR fighter known as Yoweri, nicknamed Tokyo, had been captured in fighting in Masisi; the outlet said news of his capture began circulating on social media on Friday 24 October 2025, when he was said to have been captured by AFC/M23 fighters.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Visi Guverineri wa Kivu y’Amajyaruguru washyizweho n’umutwe wa AFC/M23 Willy Manzi, yemeje ayo makuru ashimangira ko iyo ndwanyi yafatiwe ku rugamba i Masisi.
statements_all.translation_en: Willy Manzi, Deputy Governor of North Kivu appointed by the AFC/M23 group, confirmed that news, emphasising that the fighter was captured in battle in Masisi.

statements_all.role: North Kivu deputy governor appointed by AFC/M23
statements_all.text: Imvahonshya reported that Willy Manzi, the North Kivu deputy governor appointed by AFC/M23, said on social media that Yoweri, alias Tokyo, together with others including Jean-Marie of the Nyatura group, Tiger and Ignace Dunia, had committed terrible crimes including rape, killings and the burning of countless houses; this is an allegation by an AFC/M23 official.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Afatanyije n’abandi barimo Jean-Marie wo mu mutwe wa Nyatura, Tiger na Ignace Dunia, uyu mugabo yakoze ibyaha biteye ubwoba birimo gufata ku ngufu, ubwicanyi, no gutwika inzu zitagira ingano.
statements_all.translation_en: Together with others including Jean-Marie of the Nyatura group, Tiger and Ignace Dunia, this man committed terrible crimes including rape, killings and the burning of countless houses.

statements_all.setting: public statement and communiqué as reported
statements_all.text: The UN Group of Experts reported that on 23 October AFC/M23 coordinator Corneille Nangaa publicly denied the allegations made by Twangiza Mining SA, claiming that the mine was inactive, with only artisanal miners present, and that AFC/M23 lacked the necessary expertise and resources to operate gold mines; and that AFC/M23 published a communiqué on 27 October 2025 denying the accusations.
statements_all.excerpt_original: On 23 October, AFC/M23 coordinator Corneille Nangaa publicly denied the allegations, claiming that the mine was inactive, with only artisanal miners present, and that AFC/M23 lacked the necessary expertise and resources to operate gold mines

statements_all.text: Umuryango.rw (Rwanda) reported that on the evening of 18 October aircraft of the DRC army fired on AFC/M23 positions at Mpeti and Buhaya in Walikale, and that AFC/M23 deputy leader Bertrand Bisimwa condemned the attack, recalling that the DRC government was violating the agreement the two sides made in Doha, Qatar.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Ku mugoroba wa tariki ya 18 Ukwakira, indege z’ingabo za RDC zarashe ku birindiro bya AFC/M23 muri Mpeti na Buhaya muri Walikale. Umuyobozi wungirije wa AFC/M23, Bertrand Bisimwa, yamaganye iki gitero, yibutsa ko Leta ya RDC iri kurenga ku masezerano impande zombi zagiranye ubwo zari i Doha muri Qatar.
statements_all.translation_en: On the evening of 18 October, aircraft of the DRC army fired on AFC/M23 positions at Mpeti and Buhaya in Walikale. The deputy head of AFC/M23, Bertrand Bisimwa, condemned the attack, recalling that the DRC government is violating the agreement the two sides made when they were in Doha, Qatar.

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that the Congolese government and the AFC-M23 rebels signed on Tuesday 14 October 2025 in Doha, under Qatari mediation, a mechanism to monitor and verify the ceasefire in the provinces of North and South Kivu.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le gouvernement congolais et les rebelles de l'AFC-M23 ont signé le mardi 14 octobre 2025 à Doha, sous la médiation du Qatar, un mécanisme de surveillance et de vérification du cessez-le-feu dans les provinces du Nord et du Sud-Kivu.
statements_all.translation_en: The Congolese government and the AFC-M23 rebels signed on Tuesday 14 October 2025 in Doha, under Qatari mediation, a mechanism for monitoring and verifying the ceasefire in the provinces of North and South Kivu.

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi/MCP, via Mediacongo, reported that the Congolese Interior Minister said more than 100 young people from Bukavu were kidnapped and forcibly enrolled between 14 and 28 October (2025) at camp Sayo, then taken to an unknown destination.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le ministre a également indiqué que plus de 100 jeunes de la ville de Bukavu (Sud-Kivu) ont été kidnappés et enrôlés de force entre les 14 et 28 octobre derniers au camp Sayo, puis acheminés vers une destination inconnue.
statements_all.translation_en: The minister also stated that more than 100 young people from the city of Bukavu (South Kivu) were kidnapped and forcibly enrolled between 14 and 28 October at camp Sayo, then taken to an unknown destination.

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that young people of Kamituga demonstrated on Friday 10 October to demand that Wazalendo leave, accusing them of abuses including theft and murder, and that the president of the Espace Lega council, Crispin Mpombo, called on the government to protect civilians.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Des jeunes de Kamituga (Sud-Kivu) ont manifesté, vendredi 10 octobre, pour exiger le départ des Wazalendo de leurs milieux. Ils accusent ces combattants de diverses exactions dans leurs milieux dont le vol, le meurtre et autres, semant ainsi la terreur au sein de la population.
statements_all.translation_en: Young people of Kamituga (South Kivu) demonstrated on Friday 10 October to demand the departure of the Wazalendo from their areas. They accuse these fighters of various abuses in their areas, including theft, murder and others, thus sowing terror among the population.

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that at the Council of Ministers of Friday 10 October 2025, Prime Minister Judith Suminwa described President Tshisekedi's outstretched hand to Paul Kagame as a 'sincere quest' for peace.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Lors du Conseil des ministres du vendredi 10 octobre 2025, la Première ministre Judith Suminwa a qualifié la main tendue du président Félix Tshisekedi à son homologue rwandais Paul Kagame comme une « quête sincère » pour la paix.
statements_all.translation_en: During the Council of Ministers of Friday 10 October 2025, Prime Minister Judith Suminwa described President Félix Tshisekedi's outstretched hand to his Rwandan counterpart Paul Kagame as a "sincere quest" for peace.

statements_all.person: Major General Ekenge Bomusa Efomi Sylvain
statements_all.text: Congolese media reported that on Friday 10 October 2025 the FARDC issued a communiqué, signed by army spokesperson Major General Ekenge Bomusa Efomi Sylvain, calling on all FDLR factions to lay down their arms and warning that in case of refusal the FARDC would proceed to disarmament by constraint or by force; the UN Group of Experts likewise reported that FARDC issued a communiqué on 10 October 2025 calling on FDLR to disarm and surrender, warning of forced disarmament.
statements_all.excerpt_original: « Les Forces armées de la République démocratique du Congo appellent toutes les factions des FDLR à déposer les armes », déclare le communiqué signé par le général-major Ekenge Bomusa Efomi Sylvain, porte-parole de l’armée.
statements_all.translation_en: “The Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo call on all FDLR factions to lay down their arms”, says the communiqué signed by Major General Ekenge Bomusa Efomi Sylvain, spokesperson of the army.

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that President Félix Tshisekedi, speaking at a forum, offered his hand to Paul Kagame to 'make the peace of the brave' and asked him to order the M23 troops supported by Rwanda to stop the escalation.
statements_all.excerpt_original: « Il n’est pas trop tard pour bien faire les choses. Je prends ce forum à témoin pour vous tendre la main, Monsieur le Président, pour que nous fassions la paix des braves. Cela demande que vous donniez l’ordre aux troupes des M23 qui sont soutenues par votre pays d’arrêter cette escalade qui a fait suffisamment des morts », a déclaré Félix Tshisekedi.
statements_all.translation_en: "It is not too late to do things right. I take this forum as witness to extend my hand to you, Mr President, so that we make the peace of the brave. This requires that you give the order to the M23 troops that are supported by your country to stop this escalation that has caused enough deaths," Félix Tshisekedi said.

statements_all.role: Minister of the Interior, Security, Decentralisation and Customary Affairs
statements_all.text: Radio Okapi/MCP, via Mediacongo, reported that the Congolese Interior Minister said he had recorded at least 123 assassinations and 223 rapes in North and South Kivu in October (2025), according to a communiqué received by Radio Okapi on Saturday 1 November; the page headline says 'more than 120' assassinations.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le ministre de l’Intérieur, de la Sécurité, de la Décentralisation et des Affaires coutumières affirme avoir recensé, au cours du mois d’octobre dernier, au moins 123 cas d’assassinats et 223 cas de viols dans les provinces du Nord-Kivu et du Sud-Kivu.
statements_all.translation_en: The Minister of the Interior, Security, Decentralisation and Customary Affairs says he recorded, during last October, at least 123 cases of assassinations and 223 cases of rape in the provinces of North Kivu and South Kivu.

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that the Congolese army had issued an ultimatum to the FDLR a month earlier: surrender and lay down arms for repatriation to Rwanda, or face force; the army said the decision was taken within the implementation of the Washington accord of 27 June.
statements_all.excerpt_original: L’armée congolaise a lancé il y a un mois un ultimatum aux Forces démocratiques de libération du Rwanda (FDLR) : se rendre et déposer les armes pour un rapatriement au Rwanda, ou faire face à la force. Cette décision est prise dans le cadre de la mise en œuvre de l’accord de Washington du 27 juin, indique l’armée
statements_all.translation_en: The Congolese army launched an ultimatum a month ago to the Democratic Forces for the Liberation of Rwanda (FDLR): surrender and lay down arms for repatriation to Rwanda, or face force. This decision is taken within the framework of implementing the Washington accord of 27 June, the army says.

statements_all.text: Umuseke (Rwanda) reported that an AFC/M23 fighter, Col. Samuel Nsabimana Mwendangabo, said Tokyo had been shot in the leg and then captured, and that he would first be treated; the colonel said he was captured 'aho bita i Muzimu'.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Cyakora umurwanyi wa AFC/M23 witwa Col. Samuel Nsabimana Mwendangabo yavuze ko uyu Tokyo yarashwe akaguru, ubundi baramufata, kandi babanza kumuvura
statements_all.translation_en: However, an AFC/M23 fighter named Col. Samuel Nsabimana Mwendangabo said that this Tokyo was shot in the leg, then they captured him, and that they would first treat him.

statements_all.setting: report by command as relayed by the Group of Experts
statements_all.text: The UN Group of Experts reported that on 24 September FARDC's 3rd Defense Zone command reported that it received 30 alleged AFC/M23-ARC combatants, including two minors, who surrendered voluntarily to the FARDC, while 15 others were captured during clashes in North Kivu and South Kivu.
statements_all.excerpt_original: On 24 September, FARDC’s 3rd Defense Zone command reported that it received 30 alleged AFC/M23-ARC combatants, including two minors, who surrendered voluntarily to the FARDC, while 15 others were captured during clashes in North Kivu and South Kivu.

statements_all.text: The UN General Assembly's summary of President Félix-Antoine Tshisekedi's address said he stated that the withdrawal of Rwandan troops and an end to support for M23 are non-negotiable conditions for real peace.
statements_all.excerpt_original: He commended the leadership of President Trump for paving the way to dialogue leading to the signing in Washington, D.C., of a peace agreement between the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Rwanda. The withdrawal of Rwandan troops and an end to support for M23 are non-negotiable conditions for real peace.

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that, in an official communiqué dated Saturday 20 September, the spokesperson of the 3rd defence zone, Major Nestor Mavudisa, denounced 'attaques et provocations intolérables' attributed to the rebels since Thursday 18 September; the army said it reserved the 'droit de riposter avec rigueur'.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Dans un communiqué officiel daté du samedi 20 septembre, le porte-parole de la 3e zone de défense, le major Nestor Mavudisa, dénonce des « attaques et provocations intolérables » attribuées aux rebelles depuis le jeudi 18 septembre.
statements_all.translation_en: In an official communiqué dated Saturday 20 September, the spokesperson of the 3rd defence zone, Major Nestor Mavudisa, denounces 'intolerable attacks and provocations' attributed to the rebels since Thursday 18 September.

statements_all.text: 7sur7.cd reported that the Congolese Interior Ministry, in an official communiqué, denounced actions in AFC-M23-held areas of North Kivu including more than 272 assassinations and summary executions, more than 300 rapes and more than 300 acts of torture, which it said occurred mainly between 20 September and 2 October 2025 in Rutshuru, Walikale and Masisi territories.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Dans un communiqué officiel du ministère de l’Intérieur, les autorités congolaises dénoncent une série d’actes criminels perpétrés dans les zones sous contrôle de ce mouvement armé
statements_all.translation_en: In an official communiqué from the Interior Ministry, the Congolese authorities denounce a series of criminal acts committed in the areas under the control of this armed movement

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that AFC-M23 accused the FARDC on Friday 19 September of bombing the villages of Bibwe, Nyange and Hembe (Bashali Mokoto grouping, Masisi) with drones and Sukhoi-25 fighter jets; the same day, sources close to the FARDC accused the rebellion of killing about twenty civilians in the village of Chanjikiro, Kisimba grouping, Walikale.
statements_all.excerpt_original: De son côté, le mouvement AFC-M23 a accusé, vendredi 19 septembre, les FARDC d’avoir bombardé les villages de Bibwe, Nyange et Hembe — situés dans le groupement Bashali Mokoto, territoire de Masisi — à l’aide de drones et d’avions de chasse Sukhoï-25.
statements_all.translation_en: For its part, the AFC-M23 movement accused the FARDC on Friday 19 September of having bombed the villages of Bibwe, Nyange and Hembe, located in the Bashali Mokoto grouping, Masisi territory, using drones and Sukhoi-25 fighter jets.

statements_all.role: Government; Conseil Supérieur de la Magistrature
statements_all.setting: statement as reported by the Group of Experts
statements_all.text: The UN Group of Experts reported that the Government declared it would invalidate all judicial acts undertaken by AFC/M23 in violation of the country’s constitutional order, and annexed a statement of the DRC Conseil Supérieur de la Magistrature, dated 12 September 2025, declaring all judicial acts undertaken by AFC/M23 a violation of the constitutional order of the DRC.
statements_all.excerpt_original: The Government declared that it would invalidate all judicial acts undertaken by AFC/M23 in violation of the country’s constitutional order

statements_all.person: Dieudonné Kamuleta (communiqué of 12 Sep 2025); Guillaume Ngefa
statements_all.role: President of the Constitutional Court and of the Conseil supérieur de la magistrature; Minister of Justice
statements_all.setting: communiqué (as reported in a later article)
statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that the president of the Constitutional Court and of the Conseil supérieur de la magistrature, Dieudonné Kamuleta, had recalled in a communiqué published on 12 September 2025 that the country's Constitution and organic laws give the Conseil supérieur de la magistrature exclusive power to recruit and manage magistrates nationwide, and that any parallel attempt is therefore, according to him, 'nulle et de nul effet'; the Justice Minister Guillaume Ngefa had announced the forthcoming signature of an ordinance annulling all judicial decisions taken by AFC/M23 leaders.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le président de la Cour constitutionnelle et du Conseil supérieur de la magistrature, Dieudonné Kamuleta avait rappelé, dans un communiqué publié le 12 septembre 2025, que la Constitution et les lois organiques de la République démocratique du Congo confèrent exclusivement au Conseil supérieur de la magistrature le pouvoir de recruter et de gérer les magistrats sur l’ensemble du territoire national.
statements_all.translation_en: The president of the Constitutional Court and of the Conseil supérieur de la magistrature, Dieudonné Kamuleta, had recalled, in a communiqué published on 12 September 2025, that the Constitution and the organic laws of the Democratic Republic of the Congo exclusively confer on the Conseil supérieur de la magistrature the power to recruit and manage magistrates throughout the national territory.

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that Twirwaneho fighters allied to the AFC-M23 accused the Congolese army, in coalition with the Burundian army, of a targeted attack on the village of Mikenge near Minembwe, and that according to their statements the attack took place on 10 September with the support of Wazalendo forces.
statements_all.excerpt_original: De leur côté, les combattants Twirwaneho, alliés à l’AFC-M23, ont accusé l’armée congolaise, en coalition avec l’armée burundaise, d’avoir mené une attaque ciblée contre le village de Mikenge, près de Minembwe, dans les Hauts-Plateaux du Sud-Kivu. Selon leurs déclarations, l’attaque a eu lieu le 10 septembre avec le soutien des forces Wazalendo.
statements_all.translation_en: For their part, the Twirwaneho fighters, allies of the AFC-M23, accused the Congolese army, in coalition with the Burundian army, of carrying out a targeted attack on the village of Mikenge, near Minembwe, in the Hauts-Plateaux of South Kivu. According to their statements, the attack took place on 10 September with the support of the Wazalendo forces.

statements_all.text: DW reported that the Congolese army confirmed the ADF attack at Ntoyo and that military authorities in charge of operations against the ADF went to the site to reassure the population.
statements_all.excerpt_original: L’armée congolaise a confirmé l’attaque et les autorités militaires, en charge des opérations contre les Forces démocratiques alliées, se sont rendues sur les lieux pour rassurer la population.
statements_all.translation_en: The Congolese army confirmed the attack and the military authorities in charge of operations against the Allied Democratic Forces went to the site to reassure the population.

statements_all.text: Human Rights Watch said that on 8 September Congolese military forces opened fire on protesters in Uvira, killing an 8-year-old boy and wounding at least nine civilians, including an 11-year-old girl.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le 8 septembre, les forces militaires congolaises ont ouvert le feu sur des manifestants à Uvira, tuant un garçon de 8 ans et blessant au moins neuf civils, dont une fillette de 11 ans.
statements_all.translation_en: On 8 September, Congolese military forces opened fire on protesters in Uvira, killing an 8-year-old boy and wounding at least nine civilians, including an 11-year-old girl.

statements_all.role: commander of the First Defense Zone
statements_all.setting: public declaration as reported by UN Group of Experts
statements_all.text: The UN Group of Experts reported that on 8 September 'Brigadier General' Baudoin Ngaruye, commander of AFC/M23's 'First Defense Zone' covering the Goma-Rutshuru-Kanyabayonga-Kirumba axis, declared in Kirumba that AFC/M23 intended to resume hostilities aimed at capturing Butembo and Kisangani.
statements_all.excerpt_original: On 8 September, “Brigadier General” Baudoin Ngaruye, commander of AFC/M23’s ‘First Defense Zone’ covering the Goma–Rutshuru–Kanyabayonga–Kirumba axis, declared in Kirumba that AFC/M23 intended to resume hostilities aimed at capturing Butembo and Kisangani.

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that, according to the spokesperson of operations Sokola 2, sub-lieutenant Reagan Mbuyi Kalonji, the disturbances in Uvira left 1 dead (a 12-year-old child hit by a bullet) and 9 wounded (4 FARDC soldiers and 5 civilians); Radio Okapi reported that the incidents broke out when demonstrators deemed uncontrolled tried to force the entrance of a military base, and that one of them was reportedly caught with a grenade, according to the military authorities; civil society denounced a violent repression and called on the President of the Republic to intervene.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Selon le porte-parole des opérations Sokola 2, le sous-lieutenant Reagan Mbuyi Kalonji, les troubles ont fait : 1 mort : un enfant de 12 ans atteint par balle, 9 blessés : dont 4 militaires des FARDC et 5 civils.
statements_all.translation_en: According to the spokesperson of the Sokola 2 operations, sub-lieutenant Reagan Mbuyi Kalonji, the disturbances left: 1 dead: a 12-year-old child hit by a bullet, 9 wounded: including 4 FARDC soldiers and 5 civilians.

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that after an inter-institutional meeting chaired on Monday 8 September in Kinshasa by President Félix Tshisekedi, National Assembly president Vital Kamerhe said the Head of State is preoccupied by the Uvira tensions and seeks solutions through a government mission sent to Uvira.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Faisant la restitution de cette séance de travail, en ce qui concerne les tensions à Uvira, Vital Kamerhe a indiqué que « le Chef de l’État est préoccupé par cette situation et y cherche des solutions à travers une mission gouvernementale qui est diligentée à Uvira, en vue de trouver la solution à cette question. »
statements_all.translation_en: Reporting on this working session, regarding the tensions in Uvira, Vital Kamerhe indicated that "the Head of State is concerned by this situation and is seeking solutions through a government mission that is being dispatched to Uvira, in order to find a solution to this question."

statements_all.role: President of the National Assembly, speaking after a meeting chaired by the head of state
statements_all.text: MediaCongo Press reported that National Assembly president Vital Kamerhe announced on Monday 8 September 2025, after an inter-institutional meeting chaired by the head of state, that President Tshisekedi had decided to send a government mission to Uvira after protests against the appointment of General Gasita as head of military intelligence in the area.
statements_all.excerpt_original: C’est le président de l’Assemblée nationale, Vital Kamerhe, qui l’a annoncé lundi 8 septembre 2025, à l’issue d’une réunion interinstitutionnelle présidée par le chef de l’État.
statements_all.translation_en: It was the president of the National Assembly, Vital Kamerhe, who announced it on Monday 8 September 2025, after an inter-institutional meeting chaired by the head of state.

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that, at a press conference in Kinshasa on Saturday 06 September 2025, FARDC spokesperson major-general Sylvain Ekenge said that an officer no longer belongs to his community but to the whole nation.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Au cours d'une conférence de presse tenue ce samedi 06 septembre 2025 à Kinshasa, le général major Sylvain Ekenge, porte-parole des FARDC précise qu'un militaire de surcroît un officier n'appartient plus à sa communauté mais plutôt à la nation toute entière.
statements_all.translation_en: During a press conference held this Saturday 06 September 2025 in Kinshasa, major-general Sylvain Ekenge, FARDC spokesperson, states that an officer, above all, no longer belongs to his community but rather to the whole nation.

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that Sylvain Ekenge said on 6 September 2025 that no other presidential ordinance had relieved Gasita of his function and that he remained deputy commander of the 33rd military region, in charge of military operations and intelligence.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Au cours d'une conférence de presse tenue ce samedi 06 septembre 2025 à Kinshasa, le général major Sylvain Ekenge, porte-parole des FARDC précise qu'un militaire de surcroît un officier n'appartient plus à sa communauté mais plutôt à la nation toute entière.
statements_all.translation_en: During a press conference held this Saturday 06 September 2025 in Kinshasa, major-general Sylvain Ekenge, FARDC spokesperson, states that an officer, above all, no longer belongs to his community but rather to the whole nation.

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that, reacting to Wazalendo allegations that Gasita was close to Rwanda and to the AFC/M23 rebellion, Sylvain Ekenge said Gasita would have another superior in charge of the whole region.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Réagissant aux allégations de Wazalendo le qualifiant d'être proche du Rwanda et de la rébellion de l'AFC/M23, Sylvain Ekenge précise que Gasita aura à sa tête un autre supérieur qui s'occupe de l'ensemble de la région.
statements_all.translation_en: Reacting to Wazalendo allegations describing him as close to Rwanda and to the AFC/M23 rebellion, Sylvain Ekenge specifies that Gasita will have another superior at his head who looks after the whole region.

statements_all.text: Human Rights Watch reported that on 6 September 2025 the Congolese army spokesperson, Gen. Sylvain Ekenge, said at a news conference: 'We don't control the Wazalendo, the Wazalendo are not part of the armed forces', and that it was not the army's job to 'manage' them.
statements_all.excerpt_original: On September 6, Gen. Sylvain Ekenge, the spokesperson for the Congolese army, said during a news conference, “We don’t control the Wazalendo, the Wazalendo are not part of the armed forces,” and said it was not the army’s job to “manage” them.

statements_all.text: FARDC spokesperson Maj Gen Sylvain Ekenge Bomusa, according to Igihe, had asked Wazalendo to accept Brig Gen Gasita, explaining that he had not betrayed the country and had been appointed by the Head of State; the fighters refused and asked for his replacement.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi w'Ingabo za RDC, Gen Maj. Sylvain Ekenge Bomusa, yari yasabye Wazalendo kwemera kwakira Brig Gen Gasita, abasobanurira ko uyu musirikare atigeze agambanira igihugu kandi ko yashyizweho n'Umukuru w'Igihugu ariko aba barwanyi babyanze, bagasaba ko asimbuzwa.
statements_all.translation_en: The spokesperson of the DRC Forces, Maj Gen Sylvain Ekenge Bomusa, had asked Wazalendo to accept Brig Gen Gasita, explaining to them that this soldier had never betrayed the country and that he was appointed by the Head of State, but these fighters refused it and asked that he be replaced.

statements_all.text: JamboRDC reported that FARDC spokesperson Major General Sylvain Ekenge, speaking to the press on Saturday 6 September, called on the residents of Uvira to stay calm and not to give in to enemy manipulation, after protests by Wazalendo and citizen movements demanding the departure of General Olivier Gasita.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le porte-parole des Forces armées congolaises (FARDC), le général major Sylvain Ekenge a appelé ce samedi 6 septembre, les habitants d’Uvira (Sud-Kivu) au calme et à ne pas céder à la manipulation de l’ennemi.
statements_all.translation_en: The spokesperson of the Congolese armed forces (FARDC), Major General Sylvain Ekenge, called on Saturday 6 September the residents of Uvira (South Kivu) to stay calm and not give in to the enemy's manipulation.

statements_all.setting: speech at a meeting as reported
statements_all.text: Wazalendo leader William Yakutumba said at the meeting held in Uvira, according to Igihe: 'That leader who was sent here, called Gen Gasita, we do not want him here in Uvira'.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Muri iyi nama yumvikanyemo urusaku rwinshi rwa Wazalendo, Yakutumba yagize ati "Uwo muyobozi woherejwe hano, yitwa Gen Gasita, ntitumushaka hano muri Uvira."
statements_all.translation_en: At this meeting where a lot of noise from Wazalendo was heard, Yakutumba said: “That leader who was sent here, called Gen Gasita, we do not want him here in Uvira.”

statements_all.setting: statement at a meeting as reported
statements_all.text: Igihe reported that Yakutumba insisted Brig Gen Gasita must leave Uvira, and that Makanaki said that if the soldier had not left by 8 September his fighters would close the DRC-Burundi border and the Uvira port on Lake Tanganyika.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Yakutumba yashimangiye ko Brig Gen Gasita agomba kuva muri Uvira, Makanaki agaragaza ko nibigera tariki ya 8 Nzeri uyu musirikare ataragenda, abarwanyi be bazafunga umupaka wa RDC n’u Burundi n’icyambu cya Uvira ku Kiyaga cya Tanganyika.
statements_all.translation_en: Yakutumba insisted that Brig Gen Gasita must leave Uvira, Makanaki showed that if 8 September arrives and this soldier has not left, his fighters will close the DRC-Burundi border and the Uvira port on Lake Tanganyika.

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that the Wazalendo accuse General Gasita of being a double agent serving the M23 rebellion and of having played a decisive role in the take of Bukavu by that armed group in February 2025.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Les Wazalendo accusent le général Gasita d’être un agent double au service de la rébellion du M23 et d’avoir joué un rôle déterminant dans la prise de Bukavu par ce groupe armé en février 2025.
statements_all.translation_en: The Wazalendo accuse General Gasita of being a double agent serving the M23 rebellion and of having played a decisive role in the capture of Bukavu by this armed group in February 2025.

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that, in a communiqué published on Thursday, the deputy mayor of Uvira, Kifara Kapenda, deplored the disturbances to public order, called for the end of the demonstrations while saying the demonstrators' demands had been heard, and invited the organisers to an emergency meeting on Friday 5 September.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Dans un communiqué publié jeudi, le maire adjoint d’Uvira, Kifara Kapenda, a déploré les troubles à l’ordre public et appelé à la fin des manifestations, tout en affirmant que les revendications des manifestants avaient été entendues.
statements_all.translation_en: In a communiqué published Thursday, the deputy mayor of Uvira, Kifara Kapenda, deplored the disturbances to public order and called for an end to the demonstrations, while affirming that the demonstrators' demands had been heard.

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that, in a communiqué published from Goma, AFC/M23 communication head Lawrence Kanyuka warned that AFC/M23 'will no longer tolerate the barbaric surge of hate speech in Uvira, in Ituri and in the rest of the DRC'.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Dans un communiqué publié depuis Goma, Lawrence Kanyuka, chef du département de communication, a averti que l’AFC/M23 « ne tolérera plus la flambée barbare des discours de haine à Uvira, en Ituri et dans le reste de la République Démocratique du Congo tout comme les crimes abjects qui en découlent » .
statements_all.translation_en: In a communiqué published from Goma, Lawrence Kanyuka, head of the communication department, warned that the AFC/M23 "will no longer tolerate the barbaric surge of hate speech in Uvira, in Ituri and in the rest of the Democratic Republic of Congo, nor the abject crimes that result from it".

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that the movement (identified in the quoted passage as MRDP-Twirwaneho) affirms that Burundian troops and FDLR elements crossed the border at Runingu to reinforce the FARDC and Wazalendo in the area, and that it wrote that the presence of foreign troops worsens the security and humanitarian crisis.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le mouvement affirme que des troupes burundaises et des éléments FDLR ont franchi la frontière à Runingu pour renforcer les FARDC et les Wazalendo dans la zone. « La présence de troupes étrangères engagées dans une mission à caractère génocidaire sur le sol congolais, malgré les accords en cours entre gouvernements, aggrave une crise sécuritaire et humanitaire déjà alarmante » , écrit le MRDP-Twirwaneho.
statements_all.translation_en: The movement affirms that Burundian troops and FDLR elements crossed the border at Runingu to reinforce the FARDC and the Wazalendo in the area. "The presence of foreign troops engaged in a mission of a genocidal nature on Congolese soil, despite the agreements under way between governments, worsens an already alarming security and humanitarian crisis," writes the MRDP-Twirwaneho.

statements_all.text: KT Press (Rwanda) reported that Corneille Nangaa, political coordinator of AFC-M23, announced that the movement regretted the widespread violation of the ceasefire on all front lines by what he called the regime in Kinshasa, which he said trampled point II of the Declaration of Principles signed in Doha on 19 July 2025.
statements_all.excerpt_original: “We regret, we are obliged to inform the Congolese people and the entire International Community of the widespread violation of the ceasefire on all front lines by the tyrannical regime in Kinshasa, thereby definitively trampling point II, of the Declaration of Principles, signed in Doha on July 19 th 2025” announced the rebel movement’s Political Coordinator , Corneille Nangaa

statements_all.text: KT Press reported that, in a formal statement before the Q&A at a Goma media briefing, Nangaa accused Tshisekedi of tearing up the Doha peace agreement signed in July 2025 and of choosing war over dialogue, and said Kinshasa's coalition forces had launched fresh offensives across eastern Congo in violation of the ceasefire.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Earlier, in a formal statement delivered before the Q&A, Nangaa accused Tshisekedi of tearing up the Doha peace agreement signed in July 2025 and of choosing war over dialogue. He said Kinshasa’s coalition forces had launched fresh offensives across eastern Congo in violation of the ceasefire.

statements_all.role: deputy; Wazalendo coordinator in South Kivu
statements_all.text: Afrikarabia reported that the deputy Justin Bitakwira, who is also coordinator of the Wazalendo in South Kivu, accuses General Gasita of collusion with the M23 and of having delivered a speech calling on the Wazalendo to let the rebels pass, which would have facilitated the fall of Bukavu.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Olivier Gasita a été la cible du député Justin Bitakwira qui est aussi coordonnateur des Wazalendo au Sud-Kivu. Il accuse le général Gasita de collusion avec le M23 et d’avoir prononcé un discours appelant les Wazalendo à laisser passer les rebelles, ce qui aurait facilité la chute de Bukavu.
statements_all.translation_en: Olivier Gasita was the target of the deputy Justin Bitakwira, who is also coordinator of the Wazalendo in South Kivu. He accuses General Gasita of collusion with the M23 and of having given a speech calling on the Wazalendo to let the rebels through, which would have facilitated the fall of Bukavu.

statements_all.text: SOS Médias Burundi reported that the FARDC spokesperson, Major General Sylvain Ekenge, firmly rejected the demonstrators' demands, saying the Wazalendo have no instruction to give within the Armed Forces of the DRC and calling on the 'real' Wazalendo not to fall into the enemy's trap.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le Général-Major Sylvain Ekenge, porte-parole de l’armée congolaise, a fermement rejeté les revendications des manifestants : « Les Wazalendo n’ont aucune instruction à donner au sein des Forces Armées de la RDC. Il y a des vrais Wazalendo et des faux ; j’en appelle aux vrais à ne pas tomber dans le piège de l’ennemi »
statements_all.translation_en: Major General Sylvain Ekenge, spokesperson of the Congolese army, firmly rejected the demonstrators' demands: "The Wazalendo have no instruction to give within the Armed Forces of the DRC. There are real Wazalendo and fake ones; I appeal to the real ones not to fall into the enemy's trap"

statements_all.text: Afrikarabia reported that the spokesperson of the Congolese army supported General Olivier Gasita, saying that a soldier does not belong to communities and that 'un militaire communautaire n’existe pas'.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le porte-parole de l’armée congolaise a tout de même apporté son soutien à Olivier Gasita : « Un militaire n’appartient pas à des communautés, il est au service de la nation toute entière. Que des gens des mauvaises foi ne nous rabaissent pas dans des considérations communautaires, un militaire communautaire n’existe pas ».
statements_all.translation_en: The spokesperson of the Congolese army nevertheless gave his support to Olivier Gasita: "A soldier does not belong to communities, he is in the service of the whole nation. Let people of bad faith not lower us into community considerations, a communal soldier does not exist".

statements_all.role: Government of Rwanda (comments on the draft report, as relayed by the FFM)
statements_all.setting: comments on draft report, as reported by the FFM
statements_all.text: The OHCHR fact-finding mission reported that the Government of Rwanda has consistently denied allegations of its direct involvement with M23, including in response to the report.
statements_all.excerpt_original:
The Government of Rwanda
hasconsistently denied allegations of its direct involvement with M23,5
including in response
to this report.

statements_all.setting: comments on draft report, as reported by the FFM
statements_all.text: The OHCHR fact-finding mission reported in a footnote that Rwanda denied, in its response to the report, the finding of active and decisive involvement of the RDF alongside M23 during the capture of Goma.
statements_all.excerpt_original: FFM’s findings reaffirmed Group of Experts’ findings (S/2025/446, paras. 35-36) on active and decisive involvement of RDF alongside M23 during the capture of Goma. Rwanda denied this claim in its response to this report.

statements_all.setting: comments on draft report, as reported by the FFM
statements_all.text: The OHCHR fact-finding mission reported in a footnote that, in its response to the report, the Congolese Government noted that formal orders were issued by the President and the FARDC Chief of Staff to prohibit any collaboration with the FDLR.
statements_all.excerpt_original:
In its response to this report,
the Congolese Government noted that formal orders were issued by the President and FARDC Chief of
Staff to prohibit any collaboration with FDLR.

statements_all.text: Umuryango.rw reported that the AFC/M23 alliance condemned the silence of the international community, aid organisations and human rights defenders while Wazalendo continued actions depriving residents of their rights, and that spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka said, citing the Wazalendo statements, that 'these words push people into killings and war crimes'.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Ihuriro AFC/M23 rirwanya ubutegetsi bwa RDC ryamaganye uguceceka k’umuryango mpuzamahanga, imiryango y’ubutabazi n’abaharanira uburenganzira bw’ikiremwamuntu mu gihe Wazalendo ikomeje ibikorwa byambura abaturage uburenganzira bwabo.
statements_all.translation_en: The AFC/M23 alliance, which opposes the DRC government, condemned the silence of the international community, humanitarian organisations and human rights defenders while Wazalendo continues actions that deprive the population of their rights.

statements_all.person: Luganywa Bashizi Didier Kabi (relaying governor Jean Jacques Purusi)
statements_all.setting: statement relayed by spokesperson, as reported
statements_all.text: SOS Médias Burundi reported that the spokesperson of the South Kivu provincial government, Luganywa Bashizi Didier Kabi, relayed the position of governor Jean Jacques Purusi, who condemned the oral and physical violence of the previous two days in certain quarters of Uvira.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le porte-parole du gouvernement provincial, Luganywa Bashizi Didier Kabi, a relayé la position du gouverneur du Sud-Kivu, Jean Jacques Purusi : « Le gouverneur condamne avec la plus grande fermeté les violences orales et physiques survenues ces deux derniers jours dans certains quartiers d’Uvira, entre des frères et sœurs d’une même famille, pour des raisons inavouées. »
statements_all.translation_en: The spokesperson of the provincial government, Luganywa Bashizi Didier Kabi, relayed the position of the governor of South Kivu, Jean Jacques Purusi: "The governor condemns with the greatest firmness the oral and physical violence of the last two days in certain quarters of Uvira, between brothers and sisters of the same family, for unavowed reasons."

statements_all.text: Umuryango.rw reported that AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka said on 28 August 2025 that since the night of Wednesday 27 August 2025 an alliance of Kinshasa's forces, which he listed as FARDC, FDLR, Mai Mai Wazalendo, mercenaries, Imbonerakure and the Burundian army, had been shelling densely populated areas of Minembwe (Mikenke) and Kalehe (Katana, Kavumu, Katasomwa, Nyabibwe) with CH-4 drones and heavy weapons.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi wa AFC/M23, Lawrence Kanyuka, kuri uyu wa 28 Kanama 2025 yasobanuye ko ibi bitero bya drones za CH-4 n’intwaro ziremereye byagabwe mu gace ka Mikenke mu misozi ya Minembwe ituyemo Abanyamulenge no mu bice bigize teritwari ya Kalehe.
statements_all.translation_en: The spokesperson of AFC/M23, Lawrence Kanyuka, on this 28 August 2025 explained that these attacks of CH-4 drones and heavy weapons were launched in the Mikenke area in the Minembwe hills where Banyamulenge live and in areas that are part of Kalehe territory.

statements_all.text: BBC News Gahuza reported that, in an official statement on the events, the provincial governor asked the Wazalendo and the government army to 'take measures to avoid falling into the enemy's trap', saying the enemy was spreading false information that he had surrounded the town of Uvira, and that Governor Jean Jacques Purusi, on the government side, convened an 'extraordinary meeting' with representatives of the army, religious leaders, youth and women, customary authorities and the leaders of the "Volontaires pour la Défense de la Patrie" or Wazalendo.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Mu itangazo ry'ubutegetsi rivuga ku byabaye, rivuga ko Guverineri w'iyi ntara asaba Wazalendo n'ingabo za leta "gufata ingamba zo kwirinda kugwa mu mutego w'umwanzi" avuga ko uwo mwanzi "akwiza amakuru atari yo ko yagose umujyi wa Uvira, kandi bidafite ishingiro".
statements_all.translation_en: In the government statement on what happened, it says the governor of this province asks the Wazalendo and the government army to "take measures to avoid falling into the enemy's trap", saying that enemy "is spreading false information that he has surrounded the town of Uvira, and that it has no basis".

statements_all.role: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation (minaffet.gov.rw)
statements_all.text: The Government of Rwanda (Ministry of Foreign Affairs) said in a statement that it firmly rejects the findings of Human Rights Watch, OHCHR and UNJHRO alleging mass killing of civilians in Binza, that 'Human Rights Watch itself admits that it did not independently verify the alleged killings', and that only an independent investigation will shed light on these allegations.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Human Rights Watch itself admits that it did not independently verify the alleged killings of Hutu civilians over a period of almost two weeks.

statements_all.setting: communiqué, as reported by BBC Gahuza
statements_all.text: BBC Gahuza reported that AFC/M23 said the new Human Rights Watch report accusing it of killing at least 140 civilians, mostly Hutu, is 'a lie' with 'no foundation'; in a statement by spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka it said the HRW and UN allegations are politically motivated, and that HRW deliberately avoided mentioning armed groups it says work with Kinshasa, including FDLR, Nyatura, PARECO and Wazalendo.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Umutwe w'inyeshyamba wa AFC/M23 urwanya ubutegetsi bwa Repubulika ya Demokarasi ya Congo uvuga ko raporo nshya y'umuryango uharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu Human Rights Watch (HRW) iwushinja gukora itsembatsemba ku basivile biganjemo Abahutu, ari "ikinyoma" kandi ko '"nta shingiro" ifite.
statements_all.translation_en: The rebel group AFC/M23, which opposes the government of the Democratic Republic of Congo, says the new report by the human rights organisation Human Rights Watch (HRW) accusing it of carrying out a massacre of civilians, mostly Hutu, is "a lie" and has "no foundation".

statements_all.text: Kigali Today reported that a statement issued by AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka said that the allegations of HRW and the UN were based on political motives, and accused these organisations of bias toward the DRC government; AFC/M23 also said that this could not replace HRW going there in person and that those it spoke to were known extremists and DRC government employees. The statement replied to an HRW report, published on 20 August 2025, saying that residents of areas near Virunga National Park, mostly Hutu, were killed in 14 villages between 10 and 30 July.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Ni raporo uyu muryango washyize ahagaragara ku wa 20 Kanama 2025 ivuga ko abaturage bo mu duce twegereye Pariki y’Igihugu ya Virunga biganjemo Abahutu, biciwe mu midugudu 14 hagati ya tariki 10 na 30 Nyakanga
statements_all.translation_en: It is a report that this organisation published on 20 August 2025, saying that residents of areas near Virunga National Park, mostly Hutu, were killed in 14 villages between 10 and 30 July

statements_all.text: BBC Gahuza reported that AFC/M23 said a Human Rights Watch report accusing it of killing at least 140 civilians, mostly Hutu, in the previous month was 'a lie and distortion of the truth', that it had already rejected the allegations as 'unfounded' in a document of 7 August, and that a statement issued by spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka said the HRW and UN allegations were politically motivated and biased towards the 'incapable' Kinshasa government.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Raporo ya HRW yatangajwe ku wa gatatu ishinja inyeshyamba za M23 kwica abasivile nibura 140 biganjemo Abahutu mu kwezi gushize
statements_all.translation_en: The HRW report, published on Wednesday, accuses M23 rebels of killing at least 140 civilians, mostly Hutu, last month

statements_all.role: Government of Rwanda (statement to BBC Newshour)
statements_all.text: BBC Gahuza reported that the Rwandan government said, in a statement given to BBC Newshour, that the RDF has 'nothing to do with' the killings alleged in Human Rights Watch's report, that 'M23 is not controlled by Rwanda' and that M23 should be asked about these matters.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Mbere, leta y'u Rwanda yahakanye ibyo birego bya ONU, ndetse mu itangazo ku wa gatatu yahaye ikiganiro Newshour cya BBC yavuze ko "RDF nta ho ihuriye" n'ibi bivugwa ko byagezweho mu iperereza rya HRW. Iryo tangazo rigira riti: "M23 ntabwo igenzurwa n'u Rwanda ndetse ibi bibazo bikwiye kuba ari bo [M23] bibazwa."
statements_all.translation_en: Earlier, the Rwandan government rejected those UN allegations, and in a statement on Wednesday to BBC's Newshour it said that 'RDF has nothing to do with' what is alleged to have been found in the HRW investigation. The statement says: 'M23 is not controlled by Rwanda and these matters should be put to them [M23].'

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that in a communiqué of 12 August 2025 signed by FARDC spokesperson Major General Sylvain Ekenge, the FARDC denounced what they called an intentional and manifest violation of the Washington peace agreement and the Doha declaration of principles by the AFC/M23, citing near-daily attacks on their positions in North and South Kivu, and reserved the right to respond appropriately to provocations.
statements_all.excerpt_original: les FARDC réservent le droit de répondre de manière appropriée à toutes les provocations de cette coalition habituée à violer les accords et la parole donnée ", dit le communiqué signé par le Général-Major Sylvain Ekenge, porte-parole des FARDC.
statements_all.translation_en: the FARDC reserve the right to respond appropriately to all provocations of this coalition used to violating agreements and given word", says the communiqué signed by Major General Sylvain Ekenge, spokesperson of the FARDC.

statements_all.role: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation (minaffet.gov.rw)
statements_all.text: The Government of Rwanda (Ministry of Foreign Affairs) said in a statement that it rejects the false accusations in the recent OHCHR statement, that OHCHR alleges 'without any evidence' that the Rwanda Defence Force 'aided' in the killing of '319 civilians' in farms in eastern DRC, and that the gratuitous inclusion of the RDF in these allegations is 'unacceptable'.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Rwanda rejects the false accusations made in the recent statement of the Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights (OHCHR). OHCHR alleges, without any evidence, corroboration or reported motives, that the Rwanda Defence Force “aided” in the killing of “319 civilians” in farms in eastern DRC. The gratuitous inclusion of the RDF in these allegations is unacceptable

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that AFC/M23, in a communiqué signed by spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka, accused the Congolese authorities of continuing 'offensive military manoeuvres', citing troop and materiel movements at Nzimbira, Mwenga, Bunyakiri, Kibuwa, Pinga and Uvira, and said two military ships carrying more than 1 125 fighters of the 'coalition forces of the Kinshasa regime' docked at Uvira on Sunday 10 August from Kalemie.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Dans un communiqué signé par son porte-parole, Lawrence Kanyuka, le mouvement politico militaire cite plusieurs zones où auraient été observés « d’importants mouvements de troupes et de matériel militaire » , notamment Nzimbira, Mwenga, Bunyakiri, Kibuwa, Pinga et Uvira. L’AFC/M23 affirme que ces déploiements empruntent différents axes, dont Kindu–Shabunda, Kinshasa–Bujumbura, Kisangani–Walikale et Kalemie–Uvira.
statements_all.translation_en: In a communiqué signed by its spokesperson, Lawrence Kanyuka, the politico-military movement cites several areas where 'significant movements of troops and military materiel' were allegedly observed, notably Nzimbira, Mwenga, Bunyakiri, Kibuwa, Pinga and Uvira. AFC/M23 says these deployments use various axes, including Kindu–Shabunda, Kinshasa–Bujumbura, Kisangani–Walikale and Kalemie–Uvira.

statements_all.role: spokesperson of the South Kivu provincial government
statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that a few hours before the fighting resumed on 10 August, Didier Kabi, spokesperson of the South Kivu provincial government, said FARDC and wazalendo had withdrawn from Mulamba and Kaniola to avoid bloodshed and that these zones were controlled by the AFC/M23 rebels.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Quelques heures avant la reprise des hostilités, Didier Kabi, porte-parole du gouvernement provincial du Sud-Kivu a indiqué que les FARDC et wazalendo se sont retirés de Mulamba et Kaniola pour éviter le bain de sang. Et que ces zones étaient contrôlées par les rebelles de l’AFC/M23.
statements_all.translation_en: A few hours before the resumption of hostilities, Didier Kabi, spokesperson of the South Kivu provincial government, indicated that the FARDC and wazalendo withdrew from Mulamba and Kaniola to avoid bloodshed. And that these areas were controlled by the AFC/M23 rebels.

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that the AFC/M23 alerted to major FARDC troop and equipment movements at Nzimbira, Mwenga, Bunyakiri, Kibuwa, Pinga and Uvira, and said two military ships carrying 1,125 fighters of the Kinshasa-regime coalition forces docked on Kalemie-Uvira axis on Sunday 10 August 2025.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Kalemie- Uvira (où deux navires militaires transportant 1 125 combattants des forces coalisées du régime de Kinshasa ont accosté dimanche 10 août 2025).
statements_all.translation_en: Kalemie- Uvira (where two military ships carrying 1,125 fighters of the coalition forces of the Kinshasa regime docked on Sunday 10 August 2025).

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that, in a communiqué published on the previous Sunday, the M23-AFC coalition denounced the reinforcement of government troops on several axes, notably Shabunda, Uvira and Kalemie, and accused the Congolese authorities of violating the ceasefire.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Dans un communiqué publié dimanche dernier, la coalition M23–AFC a dénoncé le renforcement des troupes gouvernementales sur plusieurs axes, notamment à Shabunda, Uvira et Kalemie. Elle accuse les autorités congolaises de violer les termes du cessez-le-feu en vigueur.
statements_all.translation_en: In a communiqué published last Sunday, the M23–AFC coalition denounced the reinforcement of government troops on several axes, notably at Shabunda, Uvira and Kalemie. It accuses the Congolese authorities of violating the terms of the ceasefire in force.

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that the FARDC 3rd defence zone, based in Kisangani, published a communiqué on Friday 8 August in which its spokesperson, Major Mavudisa Kamba, condemned targeted killings of civilians and forced recruitment of minors by the RDF/M23/AFC coalition in South Kivu, and cited the killing of more than 80 civilians on 4 August 2025 at Nyamarongo village, Boavo chefferie, and of six civilians, two of them minors, at Lumbichi on 24 July.
statements_all.excerpt_original: La 3eme zone de défense des FARDC, basée à Kisangani, a publié vendredi 08 août un communiqué
statements_all.translation_en: The 3rd defence zone of the FARDC, based in Kisangani, published on Friday 8 August a communiqué

statements_all.role: coordonnateur adjoint de l'AFC, described in the article also as président du M23
statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that AFC deputy coordinator Bertrand Bisimwa, at a press conference in Goma on 7 August 2025, called the UN report on the alleged massacre of more than 300 civilians in Rutshuru in July 'non factuel'; according to Bisimwa, the villages named as massacre sites would lie in the protected zone of Virunga National Park and therefore be uninhabited, and he said there is no family in mourning in Rutshuru and that the figure of 300 dead is implausible.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Lors d’une conférence de presse ce jeudi 7 août 2025 à Goma, Bertrand Bisimwa, coordonnateur adjoint de l’AFC a qualifié ce rapport de « non factuel » et dénoncé ce qu’il considère comme une tentative de « diabolisation » du mouvement armé par certains acteurs humanitaires et politiques.
statements_all.translation_en: At a press conference on Thursday 7 August 2025 in Goma, Bertrand Bisimwa, deputy coordinator of the AFC, called this report 'non-factual' and denounced what he sees as an attempt at 'demonisation' of the armed movement by certain humanitarian and political actors.

statements_all.role: spokesperson of the Wazalendo in South Kivu
statements_all.text: SOS Médias Burundi reported that, in a communiqué sent to it, Aimable Nabulizi, spokesperson of the Wazalendo in South Kivu, accused Twirwaneho fighters of having attacked their positions, without acknowledging the support attributed to the FDLR or the Burundian and Congolese armies.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Dans un communiqué transmis à SOS Médias Burundi, Aimable Nabulizi, porte-parole des Wazalendo dans le Sud-Kivu, a accusé les combattants Twirwaneho d’avoir attaqué leurs positions, sans toutefois reconnaître l’appui reçu de la part des FDLR ni des armées burundaise et congolaise.
statements_all.translation_en: In a communiqué sent to SOS Médias Burundi, Aimable Nabulizi, spokesperson of the Wazalendo in South Kivu, accused Twirwaneho fighters of attacking their positions, without however acknowledging the support received from the FDLR or the Burundian and Congolese armies.

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that in a communiqué published on 6 August the MRDP-Twirwaneho denounced attacks by the FARDC, with the support of the FDLR and the Burundian army, targeting the villages of Kipupu, Bilalo Mbili and Lulenge in the Minembwe region, and said these offensives specifically targeted Banyamulenge civilians. The communiqué said several villages, including in the Mikenge locality, had been hit by heavy-weapon attacks causing many deaths and forcing hundreds of families to flee again, and that the victims were deprived of all emergency aid.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Dans un communiqué publié hier, le 6 août, le MRDP-Twirwaneho a dénoncé les attaques orchestrées par les FARDC, avec le soutien des FDLR et de l’armée burundaise, ciblant les villages de Kipupu, Bilalo Mbili et Lulenge, dans la région de Minembwe.
statements_all.translation_en: In a communiqué published yesterday, 6 August, the MRDP-Twirwaneho denounced the attacks orchestrated by the FARDC, with the support of the FDLR and the Burundian army, targeting the villages of Kipupu, Bilalo Mbili and Lulenge, in the Minembwe region.

statements_all.text: Umuryango.rw reported that Twirwaneho spokesperson Kamasa Ndakize Welcome announced on 5 August 2025 that attacks by FDLR, FARDC and another group, Mai Mai Ngomanzito, began at Irumba and Rugezi in the south of Minembwe, and that Twirwaneho confirmed Burundian forces took no part in that day's attacks.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi wa Twirwaneho, Kamasa Ndakize Welcome, ku wa 5 Kanama 2025 yatangaje ko ibitero bya FDLR, FARDC n’undi mutwe wa Mai Mai Ngomanzito, byatangiriye muri Irumba na Rugezi mu majyepfo ya Minembwe.
statements_all.translation_en: The spokesperson of Twirwaneho, Kamasa Ndakize Welcome, on 5 August 2025 announced that the attacks of FDLR, FARDC and another group, Mai Mai Ngomanzito, began in Irumba and Rugezi in the south of Minembwe.

statements_all.text: African Facts reported that, in a communiqué issued 'le jour même', the South Kivu government spokesperson summed up the events as a 'petite paralysie des activités dans Mulongwe' that would have caused no damage (conditional, as the article words it), and 'condamne les organisateurs des cérémonies funéraires'; the article adds that he also condemned messages aimed at tearing the social fabric between communities and spoke of a media war waged by the rebels.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Dans un communiqué diffusé le jour même, le porte-parole du gouvernement du Sud-Kivu résume les événements à une « petite paralysie des activités dans Mulongwe » qui n’aurait causé aucun dégât et « condamne les organisateurs des cérémonies funéraires ».
statements_all.translation_en: In a communiqué issued the same day, the South Kivu government spokesperson sums up the events as a "small paralysis of activities in Mulongwe" which would have caused no damage and "condemns the organisers of the funeral ceremonies".

statements_all.text: Iwacu reported that the FDNB, in a note responding to a 25 July 2025 press release by the MRDP-Twirwaneho spokesperson accusing Burundi of training the FDLR and providing it logistical support in weapons in Luvungi, Lubarika, Rurambo and Minembwe, said Burundi cannot in any way support aggressors of a neighbouring country.
statements_all.excerpt_original: C’est une mise au point faite en réaction au communiqué de presse du 25 juillet 2025 signé et publié par le porte-parole du MRDP-Twirwaneho accusant le Burundi de former et de fournir un soutien logistique en armement aux Forces démocratiques de libération du Rwanda (FDLR), dans les zones de Luvungi, Lubarika, Rurambo et Minembwe.
statements_all.translation_en: This is a clarification made in reaction to the press release of 25 July 2025 signed and published by the spokesperson of the MRDP-Twirwaneho accusing Burundi of training and providing logistical arms support to the Democratic Forces for the Liberation of Rwanda (FDLR), in the areas of Luvungi, Lubarika, Rurambo and Minembwe.

statements_all.text: Iwacu reported that the FDNB communiqué, signed by its spokesperson Brigadier General Gaspard Baratuza, said Burundian soldiers in the DRC carry out their mission of fighting Burundian and/or foreign negative forces in collaboration with the FARDC under bilateral accords, with strict respect for human rights and international humanitarian law.
statements_all.excerpt_original: ce communiqué indique que ces militaires exécutent leur mission de combattre les forces négatives burundaises et/ou étrangères en collaboration avec les FARDC conformément aux accords bilatéraux entre le Burundi et la RDC. « Cette mission est exécutée avec professionnalisme et respect strict des droits de l’Homme et du droit international humanitaire »
statements_all.translation_en: this communiqué indicates that these soldiers are carrying out their mission of fighting Burundian and/or foreign negative forces in collaboration with the FARDC in accordance with the bilateral agreements between Burundi and the DRC. "This mission is carried out with professionalism and strict respect for human rights and international humanitarian law"

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that, in a communiqué published on 26 July 2025, FARDC spokesperson Maj. Gen. Sylvain Ekenge called 'unfounded' the MRDP-Twirwaneho claims that FDLR elements trained in Burundi had infiltrated to commit targeted massacres of Banyamulenge, described them as an attempt at manipulation, and said the FARDC held verified information on a planned massacre at Minembwe involving Twirwaneho in collaboration with Red Tabara.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Les Forces armées de la République démocratique du Congo (FARDC) ont fermement rejeté les accusations du groupe armé MRDP-Twirwaneho, actif dans les Hauts plateaux de Fizi, qui affirme que des éléments des FDLR formés au Burundi auraient infiltré le pays pour commettre des massacres ciblés contre les populations banyamulenge.
statements_all.translation_en: The Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (FARDC) firmly rejected the accusations of the armed group MRDP-Twirwaneho, active in the Fizi high plateaux, which claims that FDLR elements trained in Burundi had allegedly infiltrated the country to commit targeted massacres against Banyamulenge populations.

statements_all.role: governor of North Kivu appointed by the alliance, per Umuryango.rw
statements_all.text: Umuryango.rw reported that Manzi Willy, whom it described as the governor of North Kivu appointed by AFC/M23, said on 22 July that their fighters continue to destroy everything that could disturb the security of Goma, and that when AFC/M23 took Goma the opposing forces had hidden guns, ammunition and bombs among the population, which the alliance uncovers day by day.
