statements_all.excerpt_original: Guverineri w’intara ya Kivu y’Amajyaruguru washyizweho n’iri huriro, Manzi Willy, tariki ya 22 Nyakanga yatangaje ko abarwanyi babo bakomeje gusenya ibintu byose bishobora guhungabanya umutekano w’uyu mujyi.
statements_all.translation_en: The governor of North Kivu province appointed by this alliance, Manzi Willy, announced on 22 July that their fighters continue to destroy everything that could disturb the security of this city.

statements_all.role: government spokesperson, Minister of Communication and Media
statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that government spokesperson Patrick Muyaya welcomed the 19 July signature in Doha, under Qatari facilitation, of a declaration of principles between the Congolese government and the AFC/M23, which he said contains clear commitments on civilian protection, national sovereignty and peace consolidation.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le porte-parole du gouvernement de la République démocratique du Congo (RDC), Patrick Muyaya, a salué samedi 19 juillet à Kinshasa, la signature d’une déclaration de principes entre le Gouvernement congolais et la rébellion de l’AFC/M23, ce même samedi à Doha, sous la facilitation du Qatar.
statements_all.translation_en: The spokesperson of the government of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), Patrick Muyaya, welcomed on Saturday 19 July in Kinshasa the signing of a declaration of principles between the Congolese Government and the AFC/M23 rebellion, that same Saturday in Doha, under the facilitation of Qatar.

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that on 16 July 2025 the Fizi territory administrator, Samy Kalonji Badibanga, said the humanitarian situation of displaced people from the high and middle plateaux of Fizi was critical, deprived of food, drinking water, medical care and shelter.
statements_all.excerpt_original: privées d’accès aux besoins fondamentaux tels que la nourriture, l’eau potable, les soins médicaux et l’abri.
statements_all.translation_en: deprived of access to basic needs such as food, drinking water, medical care and shelter.

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that a communiqué of the FARDC Third Defence Zone, signed by Major Nestor Mavudisa Kamba Mayoyo, spokesperson of 'cette zone militaire', said that 'ces ennemis de la paix' attacked FARDC positions at Kamatembe and Kalao (Mubuku groupement, Kalehe territory) on the morning of 12 July 2025, and that, according to the FARDC, another position was attacked at Batanga, Irambi Katana groupement, Kabare territory.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Ces ennemis de la paix ont successivement lancé des attaques contre les positions des FARDC dans les localités de KAMATEMBE et KALAO dans le groupement de MUBUKU, en territoire de KALEHE l’avant-midi du 12 juillet 2025 » , indique le communiqué signé par le Major Nestor Mavudisa Kamba Mayoyo, porte-parole de cette zone militaire.
statements_all.translation_en: These enemies of peace successively launched attacks against FARDC positions in the localities of KAMATEMBE and KALAO in MUBUKU groupement, in KALEHE territory, on the morning of 12 July 2025, states the communiqué signed by Major Nestor Mavudisa Kamba Mayoyo, spokesperson of this military zone.

statements_all.role: Minister of National Defence and Veterans
statements_all.text: SOS Médias Burundi reported that Burundi's Minister of National Defence and Veterans, Alain Tribert Mutabazi, defended the deployment of Burundian troops in the DRC, saying that this presence falls within a security cooperation agreement concluded between Bujumbura and Kinshasa.
statements_all.excerpt_original: le ministre de la Défense nationale et des Anciens combattants, Alain Tribert Mutabazi, a défendu le déploiement des troupes burundaises en RDC. Selon lui, cette présence s’inscrit dans un accord de coopération sécuritaire conclu entre Bujumbura et Kinshasa.
statements_all.translation_en: the Minister of National Defence and Veterans, Alain Tribert Mutabazi, defended the deployment of Burundian troops in the DRC. According to him, this presence is part of a security cooperation agreement concluded between Bujumbura and Kinshasa.

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that Wazalendo, in a communiqué, denied collusion with the FDLR and accused Twirwaneho of using civilians as human shields and of violence in areas under their influence, citing cases of rape, arson, property destruction and illegal land occupation.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Les Wazalendo accusent également les Twirwaneho d’utiliser les populations civiles comme boucliers humains et de commettre des violences graves dans les zones sous leur influence. Ils évoquent notamment des cas de viols, d’incendies, de destruction de biens et d’occupation illégale de terres.
statements_all.translation_en: The Wazalendo also accuse Twirwaneho of using civilian populations as human shields and of committing serious violence in areas under their influence. They notably cite cases of rapes, fires, destruction of property and illegal occupation of land.

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that the MRDP-Twirwaneho said Sukhoi fighter jets and drones were mobilised to support ground forces, that these air assets would strike MRDP-Twirwaneho positions and civilian villages, and that the plan was coordinated by General Pacifique Masunzu from Kisangani. The outlet added that a military aircraft had been overflying Minembwe, and that the Congolese government and the FARDC had not reacted.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le MRDP-Twirwaneho indique que des avions de chasse Sukhoi et des drones sont mobilisés pour soutenir les forces au sol. Ces moyens aériens viseraient à frapper les positions du MRDP-Twirwaneho et des villages civils. “Ce plan est coordonné par le Général Pacifique Masunzu depuis Kisangani,” souligne le mouvement.
statements_all.translation_en: The MRDP-Twirwaneho indicates that Sukhoi fighter jets and drones are mobilised to support ground forces. These air assets would reportedly strike the positions of MRDP-Twirwaneho and civilian villages. "This plan is coordinated by General Pacifique Masunzu from Kisangani," the movement stresses.

statements_all.text: A pro-government Rwandan outlet reported that on Wednesday, 2 July 2025, the Rwandan government spokesperson Makolo Yolande set out Rwanda's position on the report of the group of UN experts (whom the outlet calls 'so-called' experts), and that she criticised the group for what the outlet calls lies in the report aimed at distorting the truth.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Kuri uyu wa Gatatu ku itariki ya 02 Nyakanga 2025, umuvugizi wa guverinoma y’u Rwanda,Makolo Yolande yagaragaje aho u Rwanda ruhagaze kuri raporo y’itsinda ry’abiyita Impuguke z’Umuryango w’Abibumbye, aho yanenze iryo tsinda ku binyoma byaranze iyo raporo hagamijwe kugoreka ukuri.
statements_all.translation_en: On this Wednesday, 2 July 2025, the Rwandan government spokesperson Makolo Yolande set out where Rwanda stands on the report of the group of so-called UN Experts, criticising that group for the lies that marked the report, aimed at distorting the truth.

statements_all.text: The outlet (pro-government) reported that Makolo Yolande said the UN experts' report confirms that the FDLR is helped by the Congolese government, but that the experts deliberately discount the concerns of Rwanda that led to the putting in place of defensive measures.
statements_all.excerpt_original: aho yagaragaje ko iyo raporo ishimangira ko FDLR ifashwa na leta ya Congo ariko ko abo biyita impuguke z’Umuryango w’abibumbye bigiza nkana maze bagatesha agaciro impungenge z’u Rwanda zatumye hashyirwaho ingamba z’ubwirinzi.
statements_all.translation_en: where she showed that the report confirms that the FDLR is helped by the Congolese government but that those so-called UN experts deliberately discredit Rwanda's concerns that led to the putting in place of defensive measures.

statements_all.text: The UN Group of Experts reported that in a letter addressed to the President of the United States in July 2025 the FDLR leadership presented its mission as protecting the Rwandese refugee community in the DRC.
statements_all.excerpt_original: In a letter addressed to the President of the United States in July 2025, the FDLR leadership presented its mission as consisting of protecting the Rwandese refugee community in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

statements_all.role: permanent secretary and chief negotiator of AFC/M23 at Doha
statements_all.setting: public statement as reported by the Group of Experts
statements_all.text: The UN Group of Experts reported that in July 2025 Benjamin Mbonimpa, AFC/M23 permanent secretary and chief negotiator at Doha, stated that AFC/M23 was proposing federalism as a form of governance.
statements_all.excerpt_original: In July 2025, Benjamin Mbonimpa, the permanent secretary and chief negotiator of AFC/M23 at Doha, stated that AFC/M23 was proposing federalism as a form of governance.

statements_all.setting: positions as characterised by the Group of Experts
statements_all.text: The UN Group of Experts reported that the Government of the Democratic Republic of the Congo expected AFC/M23 to withdraw and accept cantonment, while AFC/M23 leaders insisted on maintaining control of current positions and seeking integration into State structures.
statements_all.excerpt_original: The Government of the Democratic Republic of the Congo expected AFC/M23 to withdraw and accept cantonment, while AFC/M23 leaders insisted on maintaining control of current positions and seeking integration into State structures.

statements_all.text: Umusare News reported that, in a statement, AFC/M23 said that 'such cruelty against a civilian aircraft carrying aid is exceptional inhumanity' and that it ended the chance of delivering to residents what they needed while they 'have been besieged for years, without access to the market'.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Mu itangazo, AFC/M23 yavuze ko “ubugome nk’ubu ku ndege ya gisivile itwaye imfashanyo ari ubunyamaswa budasanzwe” kandi ko byasibye amahirwe yo kugeza ku baturage ibyo bakeneye mu gihe “bamaze imyaka bagoswe batagera ku isoko.”
statements_all.translation_en: In a statement, AFC/M23 said that 'such cruelty against a civilian aircraft carrying aid is exceptional inhumanity' and that it ended the chance of delivering to residents what they needed while 'they have been besieged for years, without access to the market.'

statements_all.setting: statement on state broadcaster as reported
statements_all.text: Umusare News reported that, on state radio-television, the DR Congo army spokesperson Gen. Maj. Sylvain Ekenge said appropriate measures were taken against an aircraft that 'flew into Congolese airspace without authorisation'.
statements_all.excerpt_original: umuvugizi w’ingabo za DR Congo, Gen. Maj. Sylvain Ekenge, yavuze ko ingamba zikwiye zafashwe ku ndege “yagurutse mu kirere cya Congo nta ruhushya ibifitiye.”
statements_all.translation_en: the spokesperson of the DR Congo army, Gen. Maj. Sylvain Ekenge, said appropriate measures were taken against the aircraft that 'flew in Congolese airspace without the authorisation it needed.'

statements_all.setting: message published on the DRC independence day
statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that the AFC/M23, led by Corneille Nangaa, said on Monday it took note of the agreement signed in Washington on 27 June between the DRC and Rwanda while expressing strong reservations and reaffirming demands for a more inclusive peace process.
statements_all.excerpt_original: L’Alliance Fleuve Congo (AFC/M23), mouvement politico-militaire dirigé par Corneille Nangaa, a déclaré lundi prendre acte de l’accord signé à Washington le 27 juin entre la République démocratique du Congo (RDC) et le Rwanda, tout en exprimant de vives réserves et en réaffirmant ses exigences pour un processus de paix plus inclusif.
statements_all.translation_en: The Alliance Fleuve Congo (AFC/M23), a politico-military movement led by Corneille Nangaa, said on Monday it took note of the agreement signed in Washington on 27 June between the DRC and Rwanda, while expressing strong reservations and reaffirming its demands for a more inclusive peace process.

statements_all.setting: remarks to the press, as reported by Actualite.cd
statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that South Kivu governor Jean Jacques Purusi, based in Uvira since the fall of Bukavu to the M23, said Lemarquis's visit proved that peace, stability and security were returning, and that the authorities would do everything to eradicate the multiple barriers erected in places to facilitate the opening of a humanitarian corridor so that the population, including in areas occupied by the 'aggressors', could receive medicines, food and other assistance.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le Représentant Spécial adjoint du Secrétaire Général des Nations Unies, Coordonnateur résident des Nations Unies et Coordonnateur des opérations humanitaires en République Démocratique du Congo, Bruno Lemarquis séjourne depuis la journée du 28 Juin à Uvira dans la province du Sud-Kivu
statements_all.translation_en: The Deputy Special Representative of the Secretary-General of the United Nations, Resident Coordinator of the United Nations and Coordinator of humanitarian operations in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Bruno Lemarquis, has been staying since 28 June in Uvira in the province of South Kivu

statements_all.role: Deputy Special Representative of the UN Secretary-General, Resident Coordinator and Humanitarian Coordinator in the DRC
statements_all.setting: remarks to the press, as reported by Actualite.cd
statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that the UN Deputy Special Representative and Humanitarian Coordinator Bruno Lemarquis, in Uvira since 28 June, said the UN was there to assess security for the physical return of UN agencies to South Kivu, to study humanitarian access and the mechanisms for opening a humanitarian corridor, and to consider support to the provincial institutions provisionally installed in Uvira.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le Représentant Spécial adjoint du Secrétaire Général des Nations Unies, Coordonnateur résident des Nations Unies et Coordonnateur des opérations humanitaires en République Démocratique du Congo, Bruno Lemarquis séjourne depuis la journée du 28 Juin à Uvira dans la province du Sud-Kivu
statements_all.translation_en: The Deputy Special Representative of the Secretary-General of the United Nations, Resident Coordinator of the United Nations and Coordinator of humanitarian operations in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Bruno Lemarquis, has been staying since 28 June in Uvira in the province of South Kivu

statements_all.text: The DRC foreign ministry said in a press release that the comprehensive peace accord with Rwanda was signed in Washington in the presence of US Secretary of State Marco Rubio and described it as a decisive step towards ending the conflict.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Signé à Washington, D.C., en présence du Secrétaire d’État américain Marco Rubio, cet Accord historique marque une avancée décisive vers la fin du conflit.
statements_all.translation_en: Signed in Washington, D.C., in the presence of US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, this historic Accord marks a decisive advance towards the end of the conflict.

statements_all.text: UN News reported that Secretary-General António Guterres welcomed the peace agreement between the DRC and Rwanda signed on Friday in Washington, DC, and said in a statement that evening that the accord was a significant step towards de-escalation, peace and stability in the eastern DRC and the Great Lakes region.
statements_all.excerpt_original: UN Secretary-General António Guterres has welcomed the peace agreement between the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Rwanda signed on Friday in the United States capital, Washington, DC. The accord is “a significant step towards de-escalation, peace and stability in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo and the Great Lakes region,” he said in a statement that evening.

statements_all.text: La Presse Africaine reported that brigade general Dunia Kashindi Fabien, 33rd military region commander, said at the funeral of self-proclaimed Wazalendo general Rukumeta Biriho Pierre in Uvira on Thursday 26 June 2025 that the Wazalendo were giving everything for the defence of South Kivu and had sworn never to betray Congo or Uvira.
statements_all.excerpt_original: C’est par le général de brigade Dunia Kashindi Fabien, commandant de la 33e région militaire, à l’occasion des funérailles du général autoproclamé des Wazalendo Rukumeta Biriho Pierre décédé le 14 juin dernier après s’être tiré dessus à Kageregere dans le champ de bataille le 26 mai 2025.
statements_all.translation_en: It is by brigadier general Dunia Kashindi Fabien, commander of the 33rd military region, on the occasion of the funeral of the self-proclaimed general of the Wazalendo Rukumeta Biriho Pierre, who died on 14 June last after shooting himself at Kageregere on the battlefield on 26 May 2025.

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that an official FARDC communiqué signed on Monday 23 June by army spokesperson General Sylvain Ekenge denounced a massacre by the RDF/AFC/M23 coalition that cost the lives of 17 civilians on Sunday 22 June around 18:30 at Munzinzi village, Walungu territory.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Les Forces armées de la République démocratique du Congo (FARDC) dénoncent un massacre perpétré par la coalition RDF/AFC/M23, ayant coûté la vie à 17 civils. Selon un communiqué officiel signé ce lundi 23 juin par le porte-parole de l’armée, le général Sylvain Ekenge, les faits se sont déroulés la veille, dimanche 22 juin, vers 18h30 au village de Munzinzi, dans le territoire de Walungu, au Sud-Kivu.
statements_all.translation_en: The Armed Forces of the DRC (FARDC) denounce a massacre carried out by the RDF/AFC/M23 coalition, which cost the lives of 17 civilians. According to an official communiqué signed this Monday 23 June by the army spokesperson, General Sylvain Ekenge, the events took place the previous day, Sunday 22 June, around 18:30 in the village of Munzinzi, in Walungu territory, in South Kivu.

statements_all.role: private Burundian radio fact-check (not a government statement)
statements_all.text: Radio Isanganiro, in a 'vrai ou faux' item on an online claim about Congolese officials moving their families from Uvira to Bujumbura and about Burundian soldiers in camps in Burundi, wrote that the Burundian army has never published such information and that reliable international media have never published information on the number of troops Burundi has, abroad or at home.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Igisirikare c’Uburundi nticigeze gitangaza amakuru nk’ayo kandi n’ibinyamakuru mpuzamakungu vyizewe ntibirigera bitangaza amakuru ku gitigiri c’ingabo Uburundi bufise, iziri hanze n’iziri mu gihugu.
statements_all.translation_en: The Burundian army has never published such information, and reliable international media have never published information on the number of troops Burundi has, those abroad and those in the country.

statements_all.text: The ICRC reported that the majority of medical facilities noted a halving of consultations of children under five in the first quarter of 2025 compared with the same period in 2024, and quoted an observed increase of more than 4 times in the number of stillbirths in the facilities covered by the assessment, particularly in North Kivu.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Par ailleurs, « on observe une augmentation de plus de 4 fois du nombre de mort-nés dans les structures sur lesquelles a porté l’évaluation, au Nord-Kivu particulièrement »
statements_all.translation_en: Moreover, "we observe an increase of more than 4 times in the number of stillbirths in the facilities covered by the assessment, particularly in North Kivu"

statements_all.text: The UN Group of Experts reported that Bahati Erasto, North Kivu's AFC/M23-appointed governor, during visits to Kanyabayonga and Kirumba between 9–11 June (2025), claimed that Lubero, Butembo and Beni would soon fall under AFC/M23 control.
statements_all.excerpt_original:
Bahati Erasto, North Kivu’s AFC/M23-appointed governor, during visits to Kanyabayonga and Kirumba between 9–11
June, claimed that Lubero, Butembo, and Beni would soon fall under AFC/M23 control.

statements_all.role: North Kivu governor appointed by AFC/M23
statements_all.setting: speech or remarks during visits, as reported by UN experts
statements_all.text: The UN Group of Experts reported that Bahati Erasto, North Kivu's AFC/M23-appointed governor, during visits to Kanyabayonga and Kirumba between 9 and 11 June, claimed that Lubero, Butembo and Beni would soon fall under AFC/M23 control.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Bahati Erasto, North Kivu’s AFC/M23-appointed governor, during visits to Kanyabayonga and Kirumba between 9–11 June, claimed that Lubero, Butembo, and Beni would soon fall under AFC/M23 control. 177

statements_all.setting: social-media post (X), as reported by BBC Gahuza
statements_all.text: BBC Gahuza reported that M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka, replying on X to the Human Rights Watch report, said that report and the recent Amnesty International report are 'propaganda tools working for the Kinshasa authorities', and cited a report published by M23 the previous week saying that only 874 fighters died in the fighting to take Goma.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Mu gusubiza ku birego biri muri raporo ya HRW umuvugizi wa M23 Lawrence Kanyuka yanditse ubutumwa kuri X avuga ko iyo raporo, hamwe n'iya Amnesty International iheruka gusohoka, ari "ibikoresho by'icengezamatwara bikorera ubutegetsi bwa Kinshasa".
statements_all.translation_en: In response to the allegations in the HRW report, M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka wrote a message on X saying that this report, together with the recent one by Amnesty International, are "propaganda tools working for the Kinshasa authorities".

statements_all.text: BBC News Gahuza reported that the DRC government, in a statement on the Rubaya mine collapse, said that in June 2025 more than 300 civilians had died at Rubaya in a similar way, and that a ministerial order of February 2025 had banned mining in the Rubaya zone.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Leta ya DRC yavuze ko guhera muri Gashyantare (2) mu 2025, iteka rya minisitiri ryategetse ko akarere k'ubucukuzi bw'amabuye y'agaciro ka Rubaya katemerewe gucukurwamo kuko nta buryo bw'umutekano na bucye buhari ku bacukuzi, yibutsa ko no muri Kamena (6) mu 2025 abasivile barenga 300 bapfuye i Rubaya mu buryo nk'ubwo.
statements_all.translation_en: The DRC government said that since February (2) 2025 a ministerial order had ordered that the Rubaya mining area is not permitted to be mined because there is no security or little of it for miners, and recalled that in June (6) 2025 more than 300 civilians also died at Rubaya in a similar way.

statements_all.text: Umunota reported that Kimbulungu, secretary of AFC/M23, said that although the Congolese government and those close to it blamed AFC/M23 for the escape of Munzenze prison inmates and the deaths of the women there, these events happened before AFC/M23 fighters arrived; he also said that from 2 to 13 February AFC/M23 found 874 bodies in the city of Goma, although the Congolese government says about 3000 died.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Kimbulungu yagaragaje ko nubwo Leta ya Congo n’abakorana bya hafi na yo bashinje AFC/M23 uruhare mu itorokwa ry’imfungwa za gereza ya Munzenze ndetse n’urupfu rw’aba bagore, ibi byago byabaye mbere y’uko abarwanyi babo bahagera.
statements_all.translation_en: Kimbulungu showed that although the Congolese government and those close to it blame AFC/M23 for the escape of the Munzenze prison inmates and the deaths of these women, this tragedy happened before their fighters got there.

statements_all.text: BBC Gahuza reported that the Kinshasa side said the M23 group had a role in what it called the 'amahano kuri gereza ya Munzenze' (the horror at Munzenze prison).
statements_all.excerpt_original: Uruhande rwa leta rwavuze ko umutwe wa M23 wagize uruhare mu byo rwise "amahano kuri gereza ya Munzenze".
statements_all.translation_en: The government side said the M23 group played a part in what it called "the horror at Munzenze prison".

statements_all.setting: speech at a public rally, as reported by Radio Okapi
statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that South Kivu governor Jean-Jacques Pulusi returned to Uvira, the provisional capital of the province, on Tuesday 20 May after four months' absence, and, in an address to residents, said he carried a message from the head of state announcing the 'beginning of the end' of the M23 war; a local civil society actor said that for them the end of the war means the withdrawal of the rebels from occupied territories, among other things.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le gouverneur du Sud-Kivu, Jean-Jacques Pulusi, est revenu à Uvira, chef-lieu provisoire de la province, mardi 20 mai, après une absence de quatre mois.
statements_all.translation_en: The governor of South Kivu, Jean-Jacques Pulusi, returned to Uvira, the provisional capital of the province, on Tuesday 20 May, after an absence of four months.

statements_all.role: coordinator of the National Commission for Monitoring the Implementation of the Addis Ababa Agreement
statements_all.text: Bwiza (English edition, byline Fred Karege) reported that on 20 May 2025 the DRC National Commission for Monitoring the Implementation of the Addis Ababa Agreement released a report detailing serious crimes against civilians in Goma and Bukavu between January and April 2025 during the occupation by AFC-M23, presented at the National Museum in Kinshasa by the commission's coordinator Alphonse Ntumba Lwaba.
statements_all.excerpt_original: On May 20, 2025, the National Commission for Monitoring the Implementation of the Addis Ababa Agreement in Ethiopia released a comprehensive report detailing serious crimes committed against civilians in Goma and Bukavu between January and April 2025, during the occupation by AFC-M23 rebels.

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post quoted a communiqué of the Twirwaneho (MRDP-Twirwaneho) saying that the Rurambo region had been violently attacked by government forces in coalition with Burundian troops and Wazalendo elements, that these acts deliberately targeted Banyamulenge civilians, and that it would take all necessary defensive and offensive measures; in the same article Wazalendo spokesperson Aimable Nabulizi said intense fighting had been reported at Rugezi since the morning of Monday 19 May 2025, where the Wazalendo of General NGOMANZITO faced AFC Twirwaneho M23 rebels.
statements_all.excerpt_original: “La région de Rurambo a été violemment attaquée par les forces gouvernementales en coalition avec des troupes burundaises ainsi que des éléments Wazalendo. Ces actes de guerre ciblent délibérément les civils Banyamulenge
statements_all.translation_en: “The Rurambo region was violently attacked by government forces in coalition with Burundian troops as well as Wazalendo elements. These acts of war deliberately target Banyamulenge civilians

statements_all.setting: statement as reported by the Group of Experts
statements_all.text: The UN Group of Experts reported that on 17 May Rwanda's Minister of Foreign Affairs, Olivier Nduhungirehe, stated that the transferred individuals were “previously held hostages by the FDLR genocidal force.”
statements_all.excerpt_original: On 17 May, Rwanda’s Minister of Foreign Affairs, Olivier Nduhungirehe, stated that the transferred individuals were “previously held hostages by the FDLR genocidal force.”

statements_all.text: SOS Médias Burundi reported that tensions between FARDC, Wazalendo militias and Burundian troops were worsening notably in the Katogota and Kamanyola areas, and that Wazalendo militiamen accuse certain Burundian units of slowing their offensives against the M23.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Cette rencontre intervient alors que les tensions entre les FARDC, les milices Wazalendo et les troupes burundaises ne cessent de s’exacerber, notamment dans les zones de Katogota et Kamanyola. Les miliciens Wazalendo accusent certaines unités burundaises de freiner leurs offensives contre le M23
statements_all.translation_en: This meeting comes as tensions between the FARDC, the Wazalendo militias and the Burundian troops continue to worsen, notably in the areas of Katogota and Kamanyola. The Wazalendo militiamen accuse certain Burundian units of slowing down their offensives against the M23

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that the Congolese government, by an official communiqué of 8 May, denounced violence perpetrated by the AFC/M23 supported by the Rwandan army, citing more than 308 assassinations, 124 cases of rape, 315 cases of torture and hundreds of forced recruitments between April and May 2025.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le gouvernement congolais, par un communiqué officiel du 8 mai, a dénoncé les violences perpétrées par l’AFC/M23 soutenus par l’armée rwandaise. Il évoque des crimes de guerre : plus de 308 assassinats, 124 cas de viols, 315 cas de tortures, des centaines de recrutements forcés et plusieurs cas de spoliations et de destructions d’immeubles publics entre avril et mai 2025.
statements_all.translation_en: The Congolese government, by an official communiqué of 8 May, denounced the violence perpetrated by the AFC/M23 supported by the Rwandan army. It cites war crimes: more than 308 assassinations, 124 cases of rape, 315 cases of torture, hundreds of forced recruitments and several cases of spoliation and destruction of public buildings between April and May 2025.

statements_all.role: no statement from M23 as of publication
statements_all.text: Bwiza reported that M23 rebels took control of Katogota, about 80 km north of Uvira, on the Thursday before publication, and that M23 had so far neither confirmed nor denied its presence there, while videos circulating on social media showed armed men claiming to belong to M23 in the area.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Ces violences surviennent alors que, jeudi , les rebelles du M23 ont pris le contrôle de Katogota , une localité située à environ 80 km au nord de la ville d'Uvira . Jusqu’à présent, le M23 n’a ni confirmé ni démenti sa présence à Katogota
statements_all.translation_en: These acts of violence come as, on Thursday, M23 rebels took control of Katogota, a locality about 80 km north of the city of Uvira. So far, M23 has neither confirmed nor denied its presence at Katogota

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that in a communiqué published on 4 May the Congolese army confirmed the loss of Lunyasenge, denouncing a flagrant violation of the ceasefire in force, and that Colonel Mak Hazukay, FARDC spokesperson in the Grand-Nord, reaffirmed the army's will to 'riposter sur tous les fronts' if the threats persisted.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Dans un communiqué publié le 4 mai, l’armée congolaise a confirmé la perte de Lunyasenge, dénonçant une violation flagrante du cessez-le-feu en vigueur. Le colonel Mak Hazukay, porte-parole des FARDC au Grand-Nord, a réaffirmé la volonté de l’armée de « riposter sur tous les fronts » si les menaces persistent.
statements_all.translation_en: In a communiqué published on 4 May, the Congolese army confirmed the loss of Lunyasenge, denouncing a flagrant violation of the ceasefire in force. Colonel Mak Hazukay, FARDC spokesperson in the Grand-Nord, reaffirmed the army's will to 'respond on all fronts' if the threats persist.

statements_all.setting: statement as reported by Radio Okapi
statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that the spokesperson of the Sukola 2 Sud-Sud operations confirmed that the points of divergence had been smoothed out and that the FARDC were securing the city, upstream and downstream, describing a misunderstanding maintained by a small group of Wazalendo.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le porte-parole des opérations Sukola 2 Sud-Sud confirme que les points de divergence ont été aplanis et que les FARDC assurent la sécurité de la ville, en amont comme en aval. Il évoque un malentendu qui était entretenu par un petit groupe de Wazalendo.
statements_all.translation_en: The spokesperson of the Sukola 2 Sud-Sud operations confirms that the points of divergence have been smoothed out and that the FARDC are securing the city, upstream and downstream. He evokes a misunderstanding that was maintained by a small group of Wazalendo.

statements_all.text: SOS Médias Burundi reported that the South Kivu provincial administration continued to publicly deny any clash between FARDC and Wazalendo in the Uvira region, that it had received no official statement from the local FARDC command despite repeated attempts to contact it, and, citing several local testimonies, that the hostilities were triggered by an FARDC attempt to install new military positions at Kituntu, about ten kilometres from Uvira.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Pourtant, l’administration provinciale du Sud-Kivu continue de nier publiquement l’existence de tout affrontement entre les FARDC et les Wazalendo dans la région d’Uvira.
statements_all.translation_en: Yet the provincial administration of South Kivu continues to publicly deny the existence of any clash between the FARDC and the Wazalendo in the Uvira region.

statements_all.setting: statement as reported by the Group of Experts
statements_all.text: The UN Group of Experts reported that AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka echoed, shortly thereafter, the statement by Rwanda's foreign minister that the transferred individuals were “previously held hostages by the FDLR genocidal force.”
statements_all.excerpt_original: stated that the transferred individuals were “previously held hostages by the FDLR genocidal force.”223 AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka echoed this statement shortly thereafter.

statements_all.role: Minister of Interior (communiqués of 14 May and 18 June 2025)
statements_all.setting: communiqué as reported by the Group of Experts
statements_all.text: The UN Group of Experts reported that in May and June 2025 the Congolese government accused AFC/M23 and Rwanda of ethnic cleansing by resettling “Rwandan families” with Rwandan identity cards in eastern DRC, and annexed an official communiqué by the DRC Minister of Interior of 14 May 2025 accusing Rwanda of orchestrating an ethnic cleansing and repopulation operation.
statements_all.excerpt_original: In May and June 2025, the Congolese government accused AFC/M23 and Rwanda of ethnic cleansing by resettling “Rwandan families” with Rwandan identity cards in eastern DRC

statements_all.setting: document, as cited by the FFM
statements_all.text: The OHCHR fact-finding mission cited a May 2025 AFC Secretariat document titled 'AFC/M23's reaction to allegations human rights violations in the Goma and Bukavu' as the source for M23's 'stated objective' of restoring order, security and stability.
statements_all.excerpt_original: AFC Secretariat, AFC/M23’s reaction to allegations human rights violations in the Goma and Bukavu, May 2025.

statements_all.setting: public statement as reported by a Rwandan outlet
statements_all.text: Umuryango.rw reported that Rwandan government spokesperson Yolande Makolo said Kayikwamba's message was meant to mislead and that the DRC government should not hide its failure to protect Congolese from its own army and armed groups, and quoted her saying that it is not Rwandans who are killing in Beni, Ituri, Kwamouth, Goma, Minembwe or Uvira.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Yolande Makolo, yagaragaje ko ubutumwa bwa Kayikwamba bugamije kuyobya abantu, kandi ko Leta ya RDC idakwiye guhisha uburyo yananiwe kurinda Abanye-Congo bibasirwa n’ingabo zayo n’imitwe yitwaje intwaro. Yagize ati “Ntabwo ari Abanyarwanda bari kwica muri Beni, Ituri, Kwamouth, Goma, Minembwe cyangwa Uvira.
statements_all.translation_en: Yolande Makolo, showed that the message of Kayikwamba is meant to mislead, and that the DRC government should not hide how it failed to protect the Congolese targeted by its army and armed groups. She said: "It is not Rwandans who are killing in Beni, Ituri, Kwamouth, Goma, Minembwe or Uvira.

statements_all.role: Government of Rwanda spokesperson (statement attributed to the Government of Rwanda in the article)
statements_all.setting: public statement as reported by a Rwandan outlet
statements_all.text: Umuryango.rw reported that the Government of Rwanda said that reports of the UN human rights office (OHCHR) in the DRC show that armed groups, the FARDC and the FDLR are the ones raping civilians.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Guverinoma y’u Rwanda ivuga ko raporo y’ishami rya Komisiyo y’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ishinzwe uburenganzira bw’ikiremwamuntu muri RDC (OHCHR), zihamya ko imitwe yitwaje intwaro, FARDC na FDLR ari byo bifata ku ngufu abaturage.
statements_all.translation_en: The government of Rwanda says that the reports of the branch of the commission of the United Nations for human rights in the DRC (OHCHR) confirm that the armed groups, FARDC and FDLR are the ones who rape civilians.

statements_all.text: SADC said in a press release that it had officially commenced the withdrawal of SAMIDRC from eastern DRC as of 29 April 2025, by road through Rwanda to the troop-contributing countries.
statements_all.excerpt_original: The Southern African Development Community (SADC) has officially commenced with the withdrawal from the Eastern DRC as of 29 April 2025. The withdrawal is being conducted by road, transiting through the Republic of Rwanda to the respective Troop Contributing Countries (TCCs).

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that the army described the gunfire as a redeployment of its forces: a communiqué signed by Lieutenant Elongo Kyondwa Marc, spokesperson of the Sukola 2 operational sector, said the shots heard in the hills overlooking Uvira were due to loyalist soldiers redeploying on different ridges to ensure maximum protection of the city.
statements_all.excerpt_original: « Les coups des balles entendues dans les collines surplombant la ville d'Uvira sont dus à un redéploiement des militaires des forces loyalistes dans différentes crêtes des collines en vue d'assurer une protection maximale de la ville d'uvira », dit un communiqué signé par le lieutenant Elongo Kyondwa Marc, porte-parole du secteur opérationnel sukola 2.
statements_all.translation_en: "The gunshots heard in the hills overlooking the city of Uvira are due to a redeployment of loyalist soldiers on different ridges in order to ensure maximum protection of the city of Uvira," says a communiqué signed by Lieutenant Elongo Kyondwa Marc, spokesperson of the Sukola 2 operational sector.

statements_all.setting: statement as reported by Radio Okapi via MediaCongo
statements_all.text: MediaCongo, relaying Radio Okapi and MCP, reported that on Friday 25 April heavy gunfire between FARDC and Wazalendo shook Uvira again; Sukola 2 Sud-Sud spokesperson Lieutenant Marc Elongo said the fighting was linked to the redeployment of FARDC from Katongo to the Hauts Plateaux of Fizi, and that the Wazalendo, displeased, expressed opposition by firing, suspecting this regular army unit of collaborating with rebels in the Fizi Hauts Plateaux.
statements_all.excerpt_original: La ville d’Uvira est de nouveau secouée, ce vendredi 25 avril 2025, par des tirs nourris entre les FARDC et les Wazalendo.
statements_all.translation_en: The city of Uvira is shaken again, this Friday 25 April 2025, by heavy gunfire between the FARDC and the Wazalendo.

statements_all.role: signatories of the joint text for AFC/M23 and for the Congolese delegation
statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that the DRC government delegates and the AFC/M23 rebellion, after talks in Doha under Qatari auspices, agreed to work towards a truce in view of an effective ceasefire, in a joint declaration made public on Wednesday 23 April 2025 and read on RTNC.
statements_all.excerpt_original: À l’issue de pourparlers tenus à Doha sous l’égide de l’État du Qatar, les délégués du gouvernement congolais et la rébellion de l'AFC/M23 ont convenu de travailler à la conclusion d’une trêve, en vue de l’instauration d’un cessez-le-feu effectif.
statements_all.translation_en: At the end of talks held in Doha under the auspices of the State of Qatar, the delegates of the Congolese government and the AFC/M23 rebellion agreed to work towards concluding a truce, with a view to establishing an effective ceasefire.

statements_all.text: Human Rights Watch reported that the interim governor of South Kivu, Jean-Jacques Elakano, told the media on April 23 that the province was unable to collect taxes because of the Wazalendo fighters, who should 'not take the place of the state'.
statements_all.excerpt_original: The interim governor of South Kivu, Jean-Jacques Elakano, told the media on April 23 that the province was unable to collect taxes because of the Wazalendo fighters, who should “not take the place of the state.”

statements_all.role: Interim governor of South Kivu, as Human Rights Watch describes him
statements_all.setting: remarks to media, as reported by Human Rights Watch
statements_all.text: Human Rights Watch reported that South Kivu's interim governor, Jean-Jacques Elakano, told media on 23 April that the province could not collect taxes because of Wazalendo fighters, who should not 'substitute for the State'; HRW also reported that in March and April Wazalendo set up roadblocks on main roads linking several South Kivu towns, where they harassed residents and collected 500 to 1 000 Congolese francs per person.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le gouverneur intérimaire du Sud-Kivu, Jean-Jacques Elakano, a déclaré aux médias le 23 avril que la province n'était pas en mesure de collecter des impôts à cause des combattants Wazalendo, qui ne devraient « pas se substituer à l'État ».
statements_all.translation_en: The interim governor of South Kivu, Jean-Jacques Elakano, told the media on 23 April that the province was unable to collect taxes because of the Wazalendo fighters, who should "not substitute for the State".

statements_all.text: US Senior Advisor Massad Boulos said at a State Department digital press briefing that the US position was that Rwanda should cease all military support of M23 and withdraw all Rwandan troops from DRC territory.
statements_all.excerpt_original: I will also reiterate our position that Rwanda should cease all military support of M23 and withdraw all Rwandan troops from DRC territory.

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that, according to a communiqué of the DRC Interior Ministry published on Saturday 12 April 2025, at least 52 people were killed in an attack described as 'organised and simulated' and attributed to AFC/M23 rebels supported by the Rwandan army.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Selon un communiqué du ministère de l’Intérieur publié le samedi 12 avril 2025, au moins 52 personnes ont été tuées lors d’une attaque qualifiée d’« organisée et simulée » attribuée aux rebelles de l’AFC/M23, soutenus par l’armée rwandaise.
statements_all.translation_en: According to a communiqué of the Ministry of the Interior published on Saturday 12 April 2025, at least 52 people were killed during an attack described as 'organised and simulated' attributed to the AFC/M23 rebels, supported by the Rwandan army.

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that local sources spoke of an attempted incursion by Wazalendo to retake Goma, while the government rejected that thesis and instead accused M23 of having orchestrated a premeditated attack against civilians.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Si des sources locales évoquent une tentative d’incursion des Wazalendo pour reprendre la ville, le gouvernement rejette cette thèse, accusant plutôt le M23 d’avoir orchestré une attaque préméditée contre les civils.
statements_all.translation_en: If local sources mention an attempted incursion by Wazalendo to retake the city, the government rejects this thesis, instead accusing M23 of having orchestrated a premeditated attack against civilians.

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that the AFC/M23 announced the break of its agreement with the SADC after violent clashes in Goma, accusing SAMIDRC regional forces, in coordination with the FARDC, of military operations including attacks on the night of 11 April 2025.
statements_all.excerpt_original: L’Alliance Fleuve Congo (AFC/M23) a annoncé vendredi 12 avril 2025 la rupture de son accord avec la SADC (Communauté de développement de l’Afrique australe) après des affrontements violents dans la ville de Goma
statements_all.translation_en: The Alliance Fleuve Congo (AFC/M23) announced on Friday 12 April 2025 the break of its agreement with the SADC (Southern African Development Community) after violent clashes in the city of Goma.

statements_all.setting: statement at a meeting with the population, notables and Wazalendo, as reported by Radio Okapi citing local civil society
statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported, citing local civil society, that DRC Defence Minister Guy Kabombo announced in Uvira on Monday 7 April that the local Wazalendo fighters supporting the army in defending the city depend exclusively from now on on the national coordinator of the Armed Defence Reserve (RAD), General Padiri Bulenda.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le ministre de la Défense nationale a annoncé, lundi 7 avril à Uvira (Sud-Kivu), que les combattants locaux Wazalendo qui appuient l'armée dans la défense de cette cité, dépendent désormais exclusivement du coordonnateur national de la Réserve armée de la défense (RAD), le général Padiri Bulenda.
statements_all.translation_en: The Minister of National Defence announced, on Monday 7 April in Uvira (South Kivu), that the local Wazalendo fighters who support the army in the defence of this city now depend exclusively on the national coordinator of the Armed Defence Reserve (RAD), General Padiri Bulenda.

statements_all.setting: reply at meeting, as reported by SOS Médias Burundi
statements_all.text: SOS Médias Burundi reported that during the Defence Minister's visit to Uvira (dateline 7 April 2025), fighters complained that the Burundian army had reportedly forbidden them from attacking M23 positions at Kamanyola, and that Defence Minister Guy Kabombo replied that the restrictions aimed to avoid uncoordinated actions that could compromise joint operations, while reaffirming the Congolese government's confidence in the FDNB.
statements_all.excerpt_original: SOS Médias Burundi Uvira, 7 avril 2025 – Le ministre congolais de la Défense, Guy Kabombo, s’est rendu ce lundi dans la ville d’Uvira,
statements_all.translation_en: SOS Médias Burundi Uvira, 7 April 2025 - The Congolese Minister of Defence, Guy Kabombo, went this Monday to the city of Uvira,

statements_all.setting: communiqué, as reported by Radio Okapi
statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that the official document (the Interior Ministry communiqué) listed 297 assassinations and summary executions, 72 rapes, hundreds of disappearances, more than 146 cases of bodily torture and the looting of more than 2 000 head of cattle and vehicles between 6 and 11 April 2025.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le document officiel recense également 297 assassinats et exécutions sommaires, 72 viols, des centaines de disparitions, plus de 146 cas de tortures corporelles, ainsi que le pillage de plus de 2 000 têtes de bétail et de véhicules entre le 6 et le 11 avril 2025.
statements_all.translation_en: The official document also lists 297 assassinations and summary executions, 72 rapes, hundreds of disappearances, more than 146 cases of bodily torture, as well as the looting of more than 2 000 head of cattle and vehicles between 6 and 11 April 2025.

statements_all.text: AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka said in a statement on Thursday 3 April 2025, according to Igihe, that the group had repositioned its forces in Walikale and surroundings, and warned that if Kinshasa regime forces persisted in provocations or attacked civilians in liberated areas or AFC/M23 positions, the goodwill gesture would be cancelled and 'we will eliminate the threat at its source'.
statements_all.excerpt_original: In a statement released on Thursday, April 3, 2025, AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka affirmed that the rebel group had repositioned its forces in the region. He warned, however, that any aggression from Kinshasa would trigger an immediate response.

statements_all.setting: statement at meeting, as reported by UN Group of Experts
statements_all.text: The UN Group of Experts reported that, at a meeting, Wazalendo factions complained of lack of support, military logistics and funding, and that to calm them the Defence Minister announced that all Wazalendo leaders would be placed under the authority of the RAD.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Lors d ’une réunion, les factions Wazalendo se sont plaintes du manque de soutien, de logistique militaire et de financement. Pour les calmer, le Ministre a annoncé que tous les dirigeants des Wazalendo seraient placés sous l’autorité de la RAD (voir par. 62).
statements_all.translation_en: At a meeting, the Wazalendo factions complained about the lack of support, military logistics and funding. To calm them, the Minister announced that all the Wazalendo leaders would be placed under the authority of the RAD (see para. 62).

statements_all.text: The UN Group of Experts reported in annex 23 that the SADC stated in an official communiqué that 'SAMIDRC has not participated in any joint operations' and refuted AFC/M23's allegations, which it qualified as 'inaccurate and misleading'.
statements_all.excerpt_original: In an official communiqué, the Southern African development Community (SADC) stated that “SAMIDRC has not participated in any joint operations” and refuted AFC/M23’s allegations which it qualified as “inaccurate and misleading”

statements_all.role: Special Representative of the Secretary-General, Head of MONUSCO
statements_all.text: UN News reported that MONUSCO head Bintou Keita told the Security Council that armed groups were not only seizing territory but attempting to install a parallel administration, recently appointing a governor and two vice-governors in Bukavu and financial and mining officials in North Kivu.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Bintou Keita, who briefed the Security Council in New York on Thursday over escalating violence and displacement in the country since M23 overran the key cities of Goma and Bukavu last month. These armed groups are not only seizing territory, she explained, but also attempting to install “ a parallel administration ”, recently appointing a governor and two-vice governors in Bukavu as well as financial and mining officials in North Kivu.

statements_all.text: BBC News Afrique reported that President Ndayishimiye told the BBC he had "credible intelligence" that Rwanda was planning to attack Burundi; the BBC said Rwanda had responded by calling the statements surprising.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le président du Burundi a déclaré à la BBC qu'il avait pris connaissance de « renseignements crédibles » selon lesquels le Rwanda envisageait d'attaquer son pays.
statements_all.translation_en: The President of Burundi told the BBC that he had become aware of "credible intelligence" that Rwanda was planning to attack his country.

statements_all.text: SOS Médias Burundi reported that the vice-governor of South Kivu, Jean Jacques Elekano, condemned the violence against the Banyamulenge in Uvira and called for respect for all communities, saying in a communiqué that surveillance had been reinforced and calling on law enforcement to act firmly against these abuses.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le vice-gouverneur du Sud-Kivu, Jean Jacques Elekano, a condamné ces violences et appelé au respect de toutes les communautés. « Il est impératif que chacun puisse vivre en paix, sans discrimination. Nous avons renforcé la surveillance et appelons les forces de l’ordre à agir fermement contre ces exactions, » a-t-il déclaré dans un communiqué.
statements_all.translation_en: The vice-governor of South Kivu, Jean Jacques Elekano, condemned this violence and called for respect for all communities. "It is imperative that everyone can live in peace, without discrimination. We have reinforced surveillance and call on law enforcement to act firmly against these abuses," he said in a communiqué.

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that Lawrence Kanyuka, spokesperson of AFC-M23, said on X that, contrary to the communiqué of Sunday 23 March 2025, the FARDC and their coalition forces had not withdrawn their attack drones from Walikale, delaying the repositioning of AFC/M23 forces.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Lawrence Kanyuka, porte-parole de l’AFC-M23, a confirmé cette présence, précisant qu’elle résultait du refus de l’armée de lever ses mesures. « Contrairement à ce qui a été indiqué dans le communiqué du dimanche 23 mars 2025, les FARDC et leurs forces coalisées n’ont pas retiré leurs drones d’attaque de Walikale.
statements_all.translation_en: Lawrence Kanyuka, spokesperson of the AFC-M23, confirmed this presence, specifying that it resulted from the army's refusal to lift its measures. 'Contrary to what was stated in the communiqué of Sunday 23 March 2025, the FARDC and their coalition forces have not withdrawn their attack drones from Walikale.

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that the FARDC took note of the announced M23 withdrawal from Walikale and committed to avoiding any offensive action, calling on the Wazalendo to do the same.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Les FARDC ont également pris acte de ce retrait et se sont engagées à éviter toute action offensive, appelant les Wazalendo à faire de même pour favoriser la désescalade
statements_all.translation_en: The FARDC also took note of this withdrawal and committed to avoiding any offensive action, calling on the Wazalendo to do the same to promote de-escalation.

statements_all.text: Kivu Morning Post reported that AFC-M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka said on X on Monday 24 March 2025 that, contrary to the communiqué of Sunday 23 March 2025, the FARDC and their coalition forces had not withdrawn their attack drones from Walikale; he said this delayed the repositioning of AFC/M23 forces in the area and was a major obstacle to respect for the ceasefire.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Lawrence Kanyuka, porte-parole de l’AFC-M23, a confirmé cette présence, expliquant qu’elle est due à la présence continue des avions d’attaque des FARDC dans la région
statements_all.translation_en: Lawrence Kanyuka, spokesperson of the AFC-M23, confirmed this presence, explaining that it is due to the continued presence of FARDC attack aircraft in the region

statements_all.role: Office of the Rwandan government spokesperson
statements_all.text: A statement from the office of the government spokesperson of Rwanda said Rwanda welcomed M23's announcement on the repositioning of its forces from Walikale in support of peace initiatives underway, as well as the DRC's announcement that all offensive operations by FARDC and Wazalendo would be halted.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Rwanda welcomes M23's announcement on the repositioning of its forces from Walikale in support of peace initiatives underway, as well as DRC's announcement that all offensive operations by FARDC and Wazalendo will be halted.

statements_all.text: Deutsche Welle Swahili reported that the AFC/M23 alliance said, in a statement published on X, that it had decided to withdraw its forces from Walikale town and from the neighbouring areas.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Muungano wa makundi ya waasi wa AFC/M23 umesema katika taarifa yake iliyochapishwa kwenye jukwaa la X, kwamba umeamua kuviondoa vikosi vyake kutoka kwenye mji wa Walikale na pia kutoka kwenye maeneo ya jirani ya mji huo.
statements_all.translation_en: The alliance of rebel groups AFC/M23 said in its statement published on the X platform that it had decided to withdraw its forces from the town of Walikale and also from the areas neighbouring that town.

statements_all.text: Deutsche Welle Swahili reported that the Congolese Foreign Minister Therese Kayikwamba Wagner told journalists that the government was waiting eagerly to see whether M23 would really withdraw from the town of Walikale.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Waziri wa Mambo ya Nje wa Kongo Therese Kayikwamba Wagner, amewaambia waandishi wa Habari kwamba serikali inasubiri kwa hamu kuona kama kweli M23 watajiondoa kutoka kwenye mji wa Walikale
statements_all.translation_en: Congo's Foreign Minister Therese Kayikwamba Wagner has told journalists that the government is waiting eagerly to see whether M23 will really withdraw from the town of Walikale

statements_all.text: BBC Swahili reported that, in a statement issued on Sunday 23 March 2025, Rwandan government spokesperson Yolande Makolo said the government welcomed the news that FARDC and Wazalendo military activities would also be suspended.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Katika taarifa iliyotolewa Jumapili Machi 23, msemaji wa serikali Yolande Makolo alisema kwamba wamepokea vyema habari kwamba shughuli za kijeshi za jeshi la FARDC na kundi la Wazalendo linalowaunga mkono yatasitishwa pia.
statements_all.translation_en: In a statement issued on Sunday March 23, government spokesperson Yolande Makolo said that they had welcomed the news that the military activities of the FARDC army and the Wazalendo group that supports it would also be suspended.

statements_all.text: Xinhua reported that, in response to the AFC announcement, the Congolese military urged Congolese self-defence forces to de-escalate the same day, stressing the need to prioritise peace talks and advance the Luanda and Nairobi dialogue processes.
statements_all.excerpt_original: In response, the Congolese military urged Congolese self-defense forces to de-escalate on the same day, emphasizing the need to prioritize peace talks and advance the Luanda and Nairobi dialogue processes.

statements_all.text: Anadolu reported that the Alliance Fleuve Congo, a rebel alliance that includes M23, announced on Saturday that it was withdrawing from the town of Walikale and its surroundings, a few days after taking control of the area; Anadolu said residents saw rebel elements still in the town that afternoon.
statements_all.excerpt_original: L'Alliance Fleuve Congo, une alliance rebelle qui inclut les rebelles du M23, a annoncé samedi son retrait de la ville de Walikale et de ses environs dans l'est de la République Démocratique du Congo, quelques jours après avoir pris le contrôle de cette zone riche en minerais.
statements_all.translation_en: The Alliance Fleuve Congo, a rebel alliance that includes the M23 rebels, announced on Saturday its withdrawal from the town of Walikale and its surroundings in eastern DRC, a few days after taking control of this mineral-rich area.

statements_all.party: Honorary senator (as described by Radio Okapi)
statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that honorary senator Moïse Nyarugabo, in a tweet on Friday 21 March, said that since 6h that morning the FARDC and Wazalendo, coming from Fizi via Mukela and Mulima, had resumed their attack at Mukoko toward Kakenge, and that the inhabitants of the Fizi and Mwenga Hauts Plateaux, especially Minembwe, were again waking up under bombs.
statements_all.excerpt_original: le sénateur honoraire Moïse Nyarugabo a confirmé ces informations : « Les habitants des hauts-plateaux de Fizi et Mwenga , en particulier ceux de Minembwe se réveillent encore sous les bombes. Depuis 6h ce matin du 21/03/25, les mêmes FARDC et Wazalendo venus de Fizi par Mukela et Mulima viennent de reprendre leur attaque a Mukoko en direction de Kakenge
statements_all.translation_en: the honorary senator Moïse Nyarugabo confirmed this information: "The inhabitants of the Fizi and Mwenga Hauts-Plateaux, in particular those of Minembwe, are again waking up under bombs. Since 6 a.m. this morning of 21/03/25, the same FARDC and Wazalendo coming from Fizi via Mukela and Mulima have just resumed their attack at Mukoko in the direction of Kakenge

statements_all.text: Amnesty International reported that Sultani Makenga, M23's military chief, said in an interview that Congolese army members in hospitals posed as patients or carers, that M23 found 14 weapons in hospitals and that hospital staff alerted them.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Sultani Makenga, le chef militaire du M23, a récemment déclaré dans une interview que les membres de l’armée congolaise présents dans les hôpitaux se faisaient passer pour des patients ou des soignants. Il a ajouté que le M23 avait trouvé 14 armes dans des hôpitaux et que le personnel hospitalier les avait alertés de la situation.
statements_all.translation_en: Sultani Makenga, the military chief of M23, recently said in an interview that members of the Congolese army present in hospitals were posing as patients or carers. He added that M23 had found 14 weapons in hospitals and that hospital staff had alerted them to the situation.

statements_all.text: The Qatari Ministry of Foreign Affairs published a joint statement between Qatar, the DRC and Rwanda in which the Heads of State reaffirmed the commitment of all parties to an immediate and unconditional ceasefire as agreed at the EAC-SADC summit.
statements_all.excerpt_original: The Heads of State reaffirmed the commitment of all parties to an immediate and unconditional ceasefire as agreed at the said summit.

statements_all.setting: summary of officials' remarks as reported
statements_all.text: BBC News Gahuza reported that the Rwandan government had not yet said anything publicly about the new EU sanctions (on Generals Ruki Karusisi, Eugène Nkubito and Pascal Muhizi), but that regarding the earlier sanctions by the United Kingdom, America and Canada, Rwandan officials say those sanctions do not help resolve the war in DR Congo and undermine Africa's effort to seek a peaceful solution.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Nta cyo leta y'u Rwanda yari yatangaza ku mugaragaro kuri ibi bihano bishya bya EU, gusa ku bindi biheruka gufatwa n'Ubwongereza, Amerika na Canada, abategetsi b'u Rwanda bavuga ko ibyo bihano bidafasha gucyemura intambara muri DR Congo kandi ko bibangamiye umuhate w'Afurika wo gushaka igisubizo mu mahoro.
statements_all.translation_en: The Rwandan government had not yet announced anything publicly about these new EU sanctions, but on the others recently imposed by the United Kingdom, America and Canada, Rwandan officials say those sanctions do not help resolve the war in DR Congo and that they undermine Africa's effort to seek a peaceful solution.

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that, in a communiqué published on Monday, AFC/M23 announced it would not take part in the Luanda talks planned for Tuesday 18 March under Angolan mediation, denouncing individual European Union sanctions on several of its leaders.
statements_all.excerpt_original: L’Alliance Fleuve Congo (AFC/M23) ne participera pas aux discussions de Luanda prévues ce mardi 18 mars sous la médiation angolaise. Dans un communiqué publié ce lundi, le mouvement rebelle dénonce les sanctions individuelles prises par l’Union européenne contre plusieurs de ses dirigeants
statements_all.translation_en: The Alliance Fleuve Congo (AFC/M23) will not take part in the Luanda discussions planned for Tuesday 18 March under Angolan mediation. In a communiqué published on Monday, the rebel movement denounces the individual sanctions taken by the European Union against several of its leaders.

statements_all.text: BBC News Gahuza reported that Rwanda's President Paul Kagame, at a gathering with some Kigali residents on Sunday, asked Rwandans to prepare to face sanctions, which he called 'gufunga umukandara' (tightening the belt).
statements_all.excerpt_original: Mu ikoraniro yagiranye na bamwe mu baturage b'i Kigali ku cyumweru, Perezida w'u Rwanda Paul Kagame yasabye kwitegura guhangana n'ibihano, ibyo yise "gufunga umukandara".
statements_all.translation_en: At a gathering with some residents of Kigali on Sunday, Rwanda's President Paul Kagame asked [people] to prepare to face sanctions, which he called “tightening the belt”.

statements_all.setting: interview excerpt posted on X, as reported by the Group of Experts
statements_all.text: The Group of Experts reported that in an interview excerpt published on X on 13 March 2025, 'General' Sultani Makenga, asked about the raid on the Heal Africa hospital, repeated that the men arrested were former FARDC pretending to be patients or hospital staff.
statements_all.excerpt_original: On 13 March 2025, the excerpt from an interview by Alain Destexhe, a Belgian national, with “General” Sultani Makenga was published on “X”. Responding to a question about the raid on the Heal Africa hospital, Makenga repeated the claims that the men who were “arrested” were former FARDC who were pretending to be patients or hospital staff

statements_all.text: The SADC communiqué of its Extraordinary Summit stated that the Summit terminated the mandate of SAMIDRC and directed the commencement of a phased withdrawal of SAMIDRC troops from the DRC.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Summit terminated the Mandate of SAMIDRC and directed the commencement of a phased withdrawal of SAMIDRC troops from the DRC.

statements_all.text: URN (via The Observer, Uganda) reported that, on Tuesday night, South Kivu vice-governor Jean Jacques Elakano announced that the operation by the army and coalition forces had destroyed all aircraft transporting M23 rebels from Bukavu city, resulting in the deaths of over 10 fighters.
statements_all.excerpt_original: on Tuesday night, Jean Jacques Elakano, vice-governor of South Kivu province, announced that the operation by the army and coalition forces successfully destroyed all aircraft transporting M23 rebels from Bukavu city, resulting in the deaths of over 10 fighters.

statements_all.text: The FARDC, in a communiqué reported by the news site, confirmed the defection of Kasereka Kabido, head of the FPP/AP/FCR movement and a member of the Wazalendo, and that according to FARDC spokesperson major-general Sylvain Ekenge, Kabido and his group had chosen to rally to Rwanda and its M23/AFC allies.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Selon le général-major Sylvain Ekenge, porte-parole des FARDC, Kasereka Kabido et son groupe ont choisi de se rallier au Rwanda et à ses alliés du M23/AFC.
statements_all.translation_en: According to major-general Sylvain Ekenge, FARDC spokesperson, Kasereka Kabido and his group chose to rally to Rwanda and its allies of the M23/AFC.

statements_all.text: BBC News Gahuza reported that some government supporters, heard in DR Congo media, said the strikes aimed only at destroying the Minembwe airstrip and a Twirwaneho weapons store, and that the BBC could not reach the government army side to respond to accusations of targeting civilians.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Bamwe mu bashyigikiye uruhande rwa leta bumvikanye mu binyamakuru byo muri DR Congo bavuga ko ibi bitero byari bigamije gusa gusenya ikibuga cy'indege cya Minembwe, n'ububiko bw'intwaro bwa Twirwaneho.
statements_all.translation_en: Some supporters of the government side were heard in DR Congo media saying that these attacks were aimed only at destroying the Minembwe airstrip and the Twirwaneho weapons store.

statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that the army presented a soldier, described as Rwandan, captured south of Lubero during fighting against the M23 rebels, which the source describes as backed by Rwanda.
statements_all.excerpt_original: L’armée a présenté un soldat rwandais capturé au sud de Lubero lors des affrontements contre les rebelles du M23, soutenus par le Rwanda.
statements_all.translation_en: The army presented a Rwandan soldier captured south of Lubero during fighting against the M23 rebels, backed by Rwanda.

statements_all.role: colonel, spokesperson of the Front Nord operations
statements_all.text: Radio Okapi reported that Colonel Mak Hazukay, spokesperson for the Front Nord operations, assured that all persons captured or who surrendered would be treated in accordance with the principles of international humanitarian law.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Le colonel Mak Hazukay, porte-parole des opérations du front Nord, a rassuré que toutes les personnes ayant été capturées ou s’étant rendues seront traitées conformément aux principes du droit international humanitaire.
statements_all.translation_en: Colonel Mak Hazukay, spokesperson of the Front Nord operations, assured that all persons who had been captured or had surrendered would be treated in accordance with the principles of international humanitarian law.

statements_all.role: described by the source as M23 president
statements_all.text: URN (via The Observer, Uganda) reported that M23 president Bertrand Bisimwa released a statement on Monday accusing FARDC soldiers and their allies of deploying Sukhoi fighter jets and attack drones to bomb several villages in Minembwe, and that, according to Bisimwa, the strikes were aimed at areas populated by Banyamulenge civilians, as well as Minembwe airfield.
statements_all.excerpt_original: On Monday, M23 president Bertrand Bisimwa released a statement accusing FARDC soldiers and their allies of deploying fighter jets (Sukhoi) and attack drones to bomb several villages in Minembwe.

statements_all.text: The New Times (Kigali), a Rwandan state-aligned outlet, reported that Bisimwa said in an earlier, undated post that the accusations against AFC-M23 regarding human rights violations are false and that the mass rapes of female prisoners occurred before AFC-M23's presence in Goma.
statements_all.excerpt_original: In an earlier post, Bisimwa said: "We urge the world to see the situation for what it truly is and to reject harmful misinformation. The accusations against AFC-M23 regarding human rights violations are false. For instance, the mass rapes of female prisoners occurred before AFC-M23’s presence in Goma, a fact that is easily verifiable.

statements_all.setting: post on X, as reported by The New Times
statements_all.text: The New Times (Kigali), a Rwandan state-aligned outlet, reported that, according to AFC/M23's Bertrand Bisimwa on X, no Munyamulenge could travel to Baraka, Fizi, Uvira or Mwenga, that the Minembwe airstrip was the only means of evacuation for the sick and of delivery of medicine and essential supplies, and that it had been damaged by a government plane.
statements_all.excerpt_original: On Monday, March 10, the M23 leader, again took to X, saying that in the morning, "drones were flying over Minembwe, capturing images of targets."

statements_all.role: AFC/M23 political coordinator (as named in para. 79)
statements_all.text: The UN Group of Experts reported that Bertrand Bisimwa admitted the existence of regular daily and nocturnal patrols sweeping Goma but claimed they were carried out lawfully, in a statement published on X on 9 March 2025.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Bertrand Bisimwa admitted to the existence of regular daily and nocturnal patrols sweeping the city, but claimed that these were carried out lawfully, succeeding to ensure security for all

statements_all.person: Minister of State, Minister of Justice and Keeper of the Seals (not named in excerpt)
statements_all.text: According to Radio Okapi, a communiqué published on Friday 7 March 2025 by the DRC Ministry of Justice announced a reward of 5.000.000 USD for anyone enabling the arrest of the 'convicts' (condamnés) Corneille Nangaa, Bertrand Bisimwa and Sultani Makenga.
statements_all.excerpt_original: selon un communiqué publié vendredi 7 mars par le ministère de la Justice. « Le ministre d'État, ministre de la Justice et garde des sceaux annonce qu'une récompense de 5.000.000 USD est offerte à toute personne permettant l'arrestation des condamnés Corneille Nangaa, Bertrand Bisimwa et Sultani Makenga »
statements_all.translation_en: according to a communiqué published on Friday 7 March by the Ministry of Justice. “The Minister of State, Minister of Justice and Keeper of the Seals announces that a reward of 5,000,000 USD is offered to anyone enabling the arrest of the convicts Corneille Nangaa, Bertrand Bisimwa and Sultani Makenga”

statements_all.text: Actualite.cd reported that by the evening it still could not establish who controlled Kasugho: civil society sources spoke of Ugandan UPDF soldiers, a unit of which was deployed on the axis from Lubero centre to Kasugho, while the local authority said Kasugho was controlled by Wazalendo militiamen; Paluku Kuliumbwa said the UPDF soldiers were not yet at Kasugho but at Kagheri, 15 km away, and that the Wazalendo controlled Kasugho. The outlet also reported, per its sources on the spot and confirmed by Paluku Kuliumbwa, the state's delegated official at Kasugho, that Wazalendo who returned after the rebels' withdrawal came across an armed man in a drunken state, taken to be an M23 rebel, and shot him dead.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Jusque vendredi soir, ACTUALITE.CD peine à noter qui contrôle Kasugho. Si les sources de la société civile parlent des militaires ougandais de UPDF dont une unité est déployée sur l'axe Lubero-centre-Kasugho, l'autorité locale lui précise à ACTUALITE.CD que Kasugho est contrôlé par les miliciens Wazalendo.
statements_all.translation_en: Until Friday evening, ACTUALITE.CD struggles to establish who controls Kasugho. If civil society sources speak of Ugandan UPDF soldiers, a unit of which is deployed on the Lubero-centre-Kasugho axis, the local authority tells ACTUALITE.CD that Kasugho is controlled by Wazalendo militiamen.

statements_all.text: Lawrence Kanyuka, political spokesperson of AFC/M23, said the UN statement was false because those arrested in the hospitals were FARDC soldiers who had gone there to hide.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Lawrence Kanyuka, umuvugizi mu bya Politiki wa AFC/M23, yavuze ko ibyo Umuryango w’Abibumbye uvuga ari ibinyoma, kuko abafatiwe muri biriya bitaro ari abasirikare ba FARDC bagiye kuhihisha.
statements_all.translation_en: Lawrence Kanyuka, political spokesperson of AFC/M23, said that what the United Nations says is false, because those arrested in those hospitals were FARDC soldiers who had gone to hide there.

statements_all.role: Vice-Prime Minister for the Interior, Security, Decentralisation and Customary Affairs
statements_all.text: Ouragan.cd reported a communiqué published on 6 March by Deputy Prime Minister for the Interior Jacquemain Shabani. In the article's account, Kigali deployed its troops on 28 February and on 3 and 4 March in the Ndosho and CBCA Virunga hospitals to take away patients, most of them Congolese soldiers, and their carers, and some of them were executed. The article then attributes to the Interior Ministry communiqué the statement that the Rwandan army and its M23 auxiliaries carried out incursions into Goma hospitals, taking about a hundred patients and carers, among them Congolese soldiers, and that they were summarily executed.
statements_all.excerpt_original: indique, dans un communiqué publié le 6 mars, par le vice-Premier ministre de l’Intérieur, Jacquemain Shabani.
statements_all.translation_en: states, in a communiqué published on 6 March, by the Vice-Prime Minister for the Interior, Jacquemain Shabani.

statements_all.setting: communiqué as reported by the Group of Experts
statements_all.text: The Group of Experts reported that an official AFC/M23 communiqué of 5 March 2025, signed by Lawrence Kanyuka, denied responsibility for the raids on Goma hospitals and accused MONUSCO officials of erroneous interpretation of the facts; the communiqué acknowledged that 130 FARDC elements were taken but claimed the operation was peaceful and in full compliance with international humanitarian law because the elements had 'infiltrated' the medical facilities.
statements_all.excerpt_original: An official AFC/M23 communiqué was published on 5 March 2025, signed by Lawrence Kanyuka, denying responsibility for the raids on the hospitals, accusing MONUSCO officials of erroneous interpretation of the facts

statements_all.role: AFC statement as reported by The EastAfrican
statements_all.text: The EastAfrican reported that the AFC (Congo River Alliance) 'strongly denies' the UN human rights office's allegations of attacks on hospitals, saying it never targeted civilian establishments, that the UN mission MONUSCO had manipulated the details, and that its raid was aimed at securing medical infrastructure it said had been infiltrated by fighters; the AFC claimed the heads of the hospitals corroborated in the operation.
statements_all.excerpt_original: “The Congo River Alliance (AFC) strongly denies allegations by the Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights regarding attacks allegedly perpetrated against hospitals,” they said, referring to their umbrella coalition name.

statements_all.setting: public denials as reported by the UN Group of Experts
statements_all.text: The UN Group of Experts reported that, following the March 2025 hospital incidents, Bertrand Bisimwa, Lawrence Kanyuka and 'General' Makenga issued public denials of responsibility, claiming compliance with international humanitarian law and an aim of securing hospitals from 'infiltrated rogue combatants'; the Group wrote that witnesses confirmed no weapons were found in the hospitals.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Bertrand Bisimwa, Lawrence Kanyuka and “General” Makenga issued public denials of responsibility, claiming they had acted in full compliance with international humanitarian law and with the aim of securing the hospitals from “infiltrated rogue combatants” who had been “endangering” patients and medical staff (see annex 52).

statements_all.text: The UN Group of Experts reported in annex 39 that the DRC Government stated that the arrest of FDLR 'Brigadier General' Ezechiel Gakwerere was staged by the Government of Rwanda to sustain the narrative of FARDC-FDLR cooperation, in order to justify Rwanda's act of aggression.
statements_all.excerpt_original: The DRC Government stated that the arrest was staged by the Government of Rwanda to sustain the narrative of FARDC-FDLR cooperation, in order to justify Rwanda’s act of aggression.

statements_all.text: The UN Group of Experts reported in annex 39 that FDLR spokesperson Cure Ngoma denied Ezechiel Gakwerere's cooperation with the FARDC, acknowledging his FDLR membership but insisting he was no longer active as he was sick and under medical treatment in Goma.
statements_all.excerpt_original: FDLR spokesperson, Cure Ngoma, denied the allegations of Gakwerere’s cooperation with the FARDC, and raised concerns over RDF incursions in the DRC. While acknowledging Gakwerere’s FDLR membership, Cure Ngoma insisted that he has was no longer active within the movement, as he was sick and under medical treatment in Goma.

statements_all.text: Igihe reported that after taking Walikale the rebel group announced its withdrawal, describing it as 'a choice aimed at creating a climate conducive to political dialogue', and called on local authorities and residents to guarantee security in the region.
