statements_all.text: BBC News Gahuza (Kirundi) reported that FARDC spokesperson Major General Sylvain Ekenge said M23 rebels had retaken the town of Masisi on the afternoon of Thursday, after he had announced in the morning of the same day that government forces had retaken it on Wednesday.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi w'igisirikare ca Repubulika ya Demokarasi ya Congo (FARDC), Jenerali Majoro Sylvain Ekenge amenyesha ko inyeshamba za M23 zisubije igisagara ca Masisi ku muhingamo w'uno wa kane , inyuma y'aho mu gatondo ko kuri uno musi nyene amenyeshereje ko ingabo za reta zari zakigaruye ejo ku wa gatatu.
statements_all.translation_en: The spokesperson of the army of the Democratic Republic of Congo (FARDC), Major General Sylvain Ekenge, announces that M23 rebels retook the town of Masisi on the afternoon of this Thursday, after he had announced in the morning of this same day that the government forces had retaken it yesterday, Wednesday.

statements_all.text: BBC News Gahuza (Kirundi) reported that FARDC spokesperson Major General Sylvain Ekenge said government forces were doing well there and were the ones controlling the whole town of Ngungu and its surroundings.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Umuvugizi w'igisirikare ca Repubulika ya Demokarasi ya Congo (FARDC), Jenerali Majoro Sylvain Ekenge amenyesha ko inyeshamba za M23 zisubije igisagara ca Masisi ku muhingamo w'uno wa kane , inyuma y'aho mu gatondo ko kuri uno musi nyene amenyeshereje ko ingabo za reta zari zakigaruye ejo ku wa gatatu.
statements_all.translation_en: The spokesperson of the army of the Democratic Republic of Congo (FARDC), Major General Sylvain Ekenge, announces that M23 rebels retook the town of Masisi on the afternoon of this Thursday, after he had announced in the morning of this same day that the government forces had retaken it yesterday, Wednesday.

statements_all.role: spokesperson of the military governor of North Kivu
statements_all.text: The news site reported that Guillaume Ndjike Kaiko, spokesperson of the military governor of North Kivu, announced on his X account on Tuesday evening that the Tuesday counter-offensive had allowed FARDC-Wazalendo to recover several localities from the enemy, which suffered heavy losses, without naming the localities.
statements_all.excerpt_original: « La contre-offensive de mardi a permis aux FARDC-Wazalendo de récupérer plusieurs localités de l'ennemi qui a enregistré plusieurs pertes importantes », a mentionné Guillaume Ndjike Kaiko, porte-parole du gouverneur militaire de la province du Nord-Kivu.
statements_all.translation_en: "Tuesday's counter-offensive allowed FARDC-Wazalendo to recover several localities from the enemy, which recorded several significant losses," said Guillaume Ndjike Kaiko, spokesperson of the military governor of North Kivu province.

statements_all.role: member of parliament for North Kivu province
statements_all.text: BBC News Swahili reported that Alexis Bahunga, a member of parliament of North Kivu province, told AFP that it was with great sadness that he learned of the capture of the Masisi centre by M23, and that he asked the government to take steps to restore government authority across the whole area.
statements_all.excerpt_original: "Ni kwa masikitiko makubwa kufahamu kuhusu kutekwa kwa kituo cha Masisi na M23," Alexis Bahunga, mbunge wa jimbo la Kivu Kaskazini, aliliambia shirika la habari la AFP. "Tunaiomba serikali kuchukua hatua zinazolenga kurejesha mamlaka ya serikali katika eneo lote," aliongeza.
statements_all.translation_en: "It is with great sadness to learn of the capture of the Masisi centre by M23," Alexis Bahunga, member of parliament of North Kivu province, told the news agency AFP. "We ask the government to take steps aimed at restoring government authority in the whole area," he added.

statements_all.setting: public statement as reported by the Group of Experts
statements_all.text: The Group of Experts reported that Bertrand Bisimwa publicly denied civilian deaths in the fighting for Goma, claiming that all fatalities were combatants, and that the Group stated these claims were contradicted by consistent reports of civilian casualties from residents, humanitarian and medical actors, UN sources, public reporting and photographic and video evidence.
statements_all.excerpt_original: Bertrand Bisimwa publicly denied civilian deaths, claiming that all fatalities were combatants (see annex 44). These claims were contradicted by consistent reports on civilian casualties from residents, humanitarian and medical actors

statements_all.setting: public statement as reported by the Group of Experts
statements_all.text: The UN Group of Experts reported that the Government of the DRC expressed its commitment to neutralizing the FDLR, publicly stated that it did not support the FDLR and called on FDLR combatants to disarm and surrender.
statements_all.excerpt_original: The Government of the Democratic Republic of the Congo expressed its commitment to this objective, publicly stated that it did not support FDLR and called on FDLR combatants to disarm and surrender (see annex 6).

statements_all.setting: letter as reported by the Group of Experts
statements_all.text: The UN Group of Experts reported that in a letter addressed to the US President, as facilitator of the Washington peace process, the FDLR leadership alleged that the FDLR's assigned mission consisted of protecting the Rwandese refugee community in the DRC, and expressed concern that the neutralisation plan was being implemented in an indiscriminate manner, potentially targeting civilians.
statements_all.excerpt_original: In a letter addressed to the US President, acting as facilitator of the Washington peace process, the FDLR leadership alleged that the FDLR’s assigned mission consisted of protecting the Rwandese refugee community in the DRC. They expressed concern that the neutralisation plan was being implemented in an indiscriminate manner, potentially targeting civilians.

statements_all.setting: letters as reported by the Group of Experts
statements_all.text: The UN Group of Experts reported that VDP/Wazalendo spokesperson Jules Mulumba called for the recognition of the VDP/Wazalendo as legitimate stakeholders and requested their inclusion in peace negotiations, and stated that they rejected any agreements from Doha that did not consider their demands.
statements_all.excerpt_original: VDP/Wazalendo spokesperson Jules Mulumba called for the recognition of the VDP/Wazalendo as legitimate stakeholders and requested their inclusion in peace negotiations. He stated that the VDP-Wazalendo rejected any agreements from Doha that did not consider their demands

statements_all.role: self-proclaimed Wazalendo police chief for South Kivu
statements_all.text: The New Humanitarian reported that the self-proclaimed Wazalendo police chief for South Kivu, General Kimanuka Musasa Nyambwe Nungisa, denied that the militias have implemented a taxation system and said they came to defend Uvira when authorities and security services fled.

lead_register.reported: Actualite.cd reported, citing local sources, that four young girls were raped in Baraka-centre and Katanga commune; FiziMedia relayed a CJIOP youth group alert of rapes and looting.
lead_register.alleged: Not named (Actualite.cd); FARDC elements who fled Uvira (FiziMedia, CJIOP alert)
lead_register.why: Unnamed local sources and one youth group alert; separate reports with no shared details.
lead_register.test: Registers of the health facilities serving Baraka for 13 to 20 December 2025; the CJIOP alert text; the local radio journalist's interview behind the video post.

lead_register.reported: Actualite.cd reported sexual assaults in the FARDC and Wazalendo expedition; Kivu Morning Post reported rapes, citing anonymous civil society actors; AFC/M23 said, as reported by Bwiza, that government forces raped women.
lead_register.alleged: FARDC and Wazalendo (Actualite.cd); not named for the rapes (Kivu Morning Post)
lead_register.why: Anonymous civil society sources; no number of survivors; one account is a party's.
lead_register.test: Nundu health zone and Iamba health area registers from 30 December 2025; the La Voix du Kivu testimony that a Facebook post credits, link unconfirmed.

lead_register.reported: SOS Médias Burundi reported, citing residents, sexual violence in several quarters from 18 to 20 January 2026, and wrote that Wazalendo fighters assaulted a woman who was then killed.
lead_register.alleged: Wazalendo fighters for one case; not named for the others
lead_register.why: Residents' testimony via one outlet; 'violentée' does not specify rape.
lead_register.test: Uvira health zone sexual violence registers for 18 to 31 January 2026; UFMP's January 2026 case list.

lead_register.reported: Radio Okapi reported, citing sources in Katoyi sector, that a group of Wazalendo militiamen raped at least 11 women and a 13-year-old girl.
lead_register.alleged: A group of Wazalendo militiamen (faction not named)
lead_register.why: Unnamed local sources; Presse Actu repeats the same text; group not named.
lead_register.test: Katoyi health zone register for 31 August to 7 September 2025; the monitoring report shared among local leaders that Radio Okapi cites.

lead_register.place: Bwito chiefdom, including Mashango and Bukombo groupement (Rutshuru territory); Bahunde chiefdom (Masisi territory)
lead_register.reported: Radio Okapi reported eight and then nearly ten women raped, citing civil society and civilian sources; Opinion Info reported about ten, citing local sources, during fighting between AFC/M23 and the FARDC or Wazalendo.
lead_register.alleged: Not named; fighting between AFC/M23 and FARDC or CMC-FDP Wazalendo
lead_register.why: Three tolls from unnamed sources; no source names who raped.
lead_register.test: Bwito civil society's toll lists; sexual violence registers of the health zones covering Bwito chiefdom for October and November 2025.

lead_register.reported: AFC/M23 spokesperson Lawrence Kanyuka posted that AFC/M23 forces freed three girls aged 14 to 19 who he said were abducted, held and raped by Wazalendo.
lead_register.alleged: Wazalendo, as AFC/M23 said
lead_register.why: A party's own post about its opponent; no independent source found.
lead_register.test: The video attached to the post and its earliest copy; Masisi health zone registers for late May 2026.

lead_register.reported: Radio Okapi reported that EADEV recorded 18 rapes of displaced women by men in uniform over two weeks, and that Rien sans les femmes said local hospitals documented 253 cases from January to April.
lead_register.alleged: Men in uniform (EADEV); not named (Rien sans les femmes)
lead_register.why: Two NGO counts relayed by one outlet; methods not given.
lead_register.test: Lubero hospital registers for January to April 2025; EADEV's report; the Butembo military tribunal file of the February 2025 Musienene trial.

lead_register.reported: Radio Moto reported that DYFEGOU recorded five cases in Vulamba since August, in an alert on rapes and the enrolment of minors, and that police named Wazalendo; REDHO's coordinator said it listed more than nine rapes.
lead_register.alleged: Wazalendo, per police as told to DYFEGOU; not named (REDHO)
lead_register.why: NGO counts without methods; the five cases may include other violations.
lead_register.test: Butembo city police (PNC) complaint records for August to October 2026; DYFEGOU's and REDHO's monitoring lists.

lead_register.reported: The CNDH-RDC, a Congolese state commission, reported that M23/AFC members arrested, beat and raped Pascaline Ngwasi, coordinator of an association of single mothers.
lead_register.alleged: M23/AFC members, per the CNDH-RDC
lead_register.why: One state commission's account; no AFC/M23 response found; no second source.
lead_register.test: The CNDH-RDC case file behind its January to June 2025 report; the association's own records of the arrest.

lead_register.reported: SOS Médias Burundi reported that women it interviewed recounted abuses by Nyatura and CMC-FDP militiamen; one resident said almost all the women there were raped during the war and named "General Guidon's men" (translation) for her own ill-treatment.
lead_register.alleged: Nyatura and CMC-FDP militiamen; "General Guidon's men", per one resident
lead_register.why: One outlet's interviews; acts not dated; the commander is not further identified.
lead_register.test: The outlet's interview material; registers of the health facilities serving Mpati; which commander the residents mean by that name.

lead_register.place: Itombwe general referral hospital, Mikenge (Mwenga territory)
lead_register.reported: Kivutimes reported on 1 May 2025 that the hospital's medical equipment was looted during clashes between Twirwaneho and Wazalendo groups in March 2025.
lead_register.alleged: Not named
lead_register.why: One local outlet; no looter named; no UN source.
lead_register.test: The Itombwe health zone's stock and incident records for March 2025, and the Nakiele health centre's donation record cited by Kivutimes.

lead_register.place: Mi'enge (Mikenge) general referral hospital, Itombwe grouping (Mwenga territory)
lead_register.reported: FiziMedia reported, citing concordant local sources, that Twirwaneho elements vandalised and largely destroyed the hospital on the night of 30 December 2025 and looted medicines and equipment.
lead_register.alleged: Twirwaneho elements (FiziMedia)
lead_register.why: One local outlet; no AFC/M23 statement found.
lead_register.test: Satellite imagery of the hospital before and after 30 December 2025, and the health zone's report on the facility.

lead_register.place: Kibua general referral hospital and health centres, Walikale territory
lead_register.reported: Radio Okapi reported that Walikale civil society denounced looting by alleged M23 elements; Okapinews reported that the zone's chief medical officer, Dr Yves Tshongo, confirmed M23 elements attacked the hospital.
lead_register.alleged: Alleged M23 elements (Walikale civil society)
lead_register.why: Informants are civil society and one doctor; no AFC/M23 statement found.
lead_register.test: Kibua health zone's inventory and incident report for April 2025, and the 2025 Actualite.cd report on medicines donated to the hospital.

lead_register.reported: Actualite.cd reported, citing local sources, that AFC/M23 fighters entered the hospital again and fired shots inside, and that a humanitarian source said a bullet hit a patient.
lead_register.alleged: AFC/M23 (Actualite.cd)
lead_register.why: One outlet, anonymous sources; no AFC/M23 response found.
lead_register.test: The hospital's incident log for 13 March 2025; the humanitarian source Actualite.cd cites.

lead_register.place: Kasheke General Reference Hospital, Kalehe territory
lead_register.reported: Insecurity Insight listed, as publicly reported and unverified, that M23 rebels attacked three health workers accused of treating Wazalendo; a post on X cited the NGO EPDH-DRC.
lead_register.alleged: M23 (Insecurity Insight)
lead_register.why: Insecurity Insight lists unverified reports; originals not retrieved.
lead_register.test: EPDH-DRC's own report and the Kalehe health zone's record of the medical director's evacuation to Bukavu.

lead_register.place: Chahoboka (Cahoboka) health centre, Katana, Kabare territory
lead_register.reported: Insecurity Insight counted four killed on 22 November; 7sur7.cd reported that the South Kivu provincial government said six; Radio Okapi reported that the Coalition Pamoja kwa Amani counted at least 12 executed that night, one a patient taken from a health centre.
lead_register.alleged: AFC/M23 (provincial government, Coalition)
lead_register.why: Three figures and two dates; the Coalition's figure is not for the health centre alone.
lead_register.test: The Katana health zone's register of the dead, and the provincial government's communiqué signed by its spokesperson.

lead_register.reported: Actualite.cd and Kivu Morning Post reported that FARDC soldiers and Wazalendo stripped the health centre; Rwanda's foreign minister said the same in a post on X.
lead_register.alleged: FARDC and Wazalendo (outlets); Rwanda said the same
lead_register.why: Outlets cite unnamed or one named local source; Rwanda is a party.
lead_register.test: The Nundu health zone's report and the Iamba health-area committee member quoted by Actualite.cd.

lead_register.place: Kalembe health centre, Mweso health zone (Masisi territory)
lead_register.reported: Actualite.cd reported, citing local sources, that AFC/M23 elements beat the head nurse, who was shot in the hand, and the local Red Cross coordinator, took both away, and that AFC/M23 officials had not reacted.
lead_register.alleged: AFC/M23 elements (Actualite.cd)
lead_register.why: One outlet; four searches found no AFC/M23 statement.
lead_register.test: The Red Cross Masisi branch's incident report; the Mweso health zone's record of whether the two men returned.

lead_register.place: Birambizo general referral hospital, Rutshuru territory
lead_register.reported: Radio Okapi reported that persons presented as AFC/M23 military cadres arrested several health workers from 13 August and that unidentified armed men looted the hospital on 19 August; a post said Rwandan soldiers made the arrests.
lead_register.alleged: Persons presented as AFC/M23 cadres (Radio Okapi)
lead_register.why: One outlet; its two looting dates disagree.
lead_register.test: The Rutshuru health zone's report on the suspension and the hospital's record of staff released.

lead_register.reported: Kivu Morning Post reported that honorary senator Moïse Nyarugabo said a FARDC coalition killed a 101-year-old woman and that Bidegu hospital was bombed; he posted the same on X.
lead_register.alleged: FARDC coalition (Nyarugabo)
lead_register.why: Political figure from the affected community, relayed by one outlet; no outside source.
lead_register.test: Imagery of Bidegu hospital for 12 February 2026 and the Minembwe health zone's incident report.

lead_register.place: Rugezi health post, Minembwe area (Fizi territory)
lead_register.reported: A post on X of 28 August 2025, from an account of unknown affiliation, said a FARDC drone struck Rugezi, including a health post; a second unverified post accuses General Olivier Gasita of sending the drone.
lead_register.alleged: FARDC drone (first post); General Olivier Gasita, as the second post names him
lead_register.why: Posts only; no outlet or record reports it.
lead_register.test: Imagery of Rugezi for 28 August 2025 and any health-zone or humanitarian-organisation report from the area.

lead_register.place: Aircraft near Minembwe aerodrome, Bikuba area (Fizi territory)
lead_register.reported: Igihe reported that a civilian plane carrying medicines and food was shot at and quoted Twirwaneho's Colonel Fidèle Rugabo; LSi Africa reported that the Fizi administrator said it carried soldiers, equipment and food from Rwanda.
lead_register.alleged: FARDC coalition (Igihe)
lead_register.why: Both accounts are parties; cargo and origin unverified.
lead_register.test: Civil aviation flight records for Bukavu and Minembwe on 27 August 2026 and the MCVE+ mission's report.
